definitions.definition: To accommodate in beds.
definitions.example: This caravan can sleep four people comfortably.
definitions.definitionCn: 安置在床铺上。
definitions.exampleCn: 这辆房车可以舒适地睡四个人。

definitions.definition: To be slumbering in (a state).
definitions.example: to sleep a dreamless sleep
definitions.definitionCn: 处于（某种状态）中沉睡。
definitions.exampleCn: 睡一个无梦的觉。

definitions.definition: To be careless, inattentive, or unconcerned; not to be vigilant; to live thoughtlessly.
definitions.definitionCn: 粗心大意、心不在焉或漠不关心；不保持警惕；浑浑噩噩地生活。

definitions.definition: To be dead; to lie in the grave.
definitions.definitionCn: 死亡；长眠于坟墓中。

definitions.definition: To be, or appear to be, in repose; to be quiet; to be unemployed, unused, or unagitated; to rest; to lie dormant.
definitions.example: a question sleeps for the present; the law sleeps
definitions.definitionCn: 处于或看似处于静止状态；安静；闲置、未使用或未激动；休息；潜伏。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个问题暂时搁置；法律休眠。

definitions.definition: To wait for a period of time without performing any action.
definitions.example: After a failed connection attempt, the program sleeps for 5 seconds before trying again.
definitions.definitionCn: 等待一段时间而不执行任何操作。
definitions.exampleCn: 连接尝试失败后，程序会休眠5秒再重试。

definitions.definition: To place into a state of hibernation.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入休眠状态。

definitions.definition: The state of reduced consciousness during which a human or animal rests in a daily rhythm.
definitions.example: I really need some sleep.

definitions.definition: An act or instance of sleeping.
definitions.example: I’m just going to have a quick sleep.

definitions.definition: (metonymically) A night.
definitions.example: There are only three sleeps till Christmas!

definitions.definition: Rheum, crusty or gummy discharge found in the corner of the eyes after waking, whether real or a figurative objectification of sleep (in the sense of reduced consciousness).
definitions.example: Wipe the sleep from your eyes.

definitions.definition: A state of plants, usually at night, when their leaflets approach each other and the flowers close and droop, or are covered by the folded leaves.
The hibernation of animals.
To be alive; to have life.
definitions.example: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.
definitions.definitionCn: 活着；拥有生命。
definitions.exampleCn: 他预计活不过几个月。

definitions.definition: To have permanent residence somewhere, to inhabit, to reside.
definitions.example: I live at 2a Acacia Avenue.  He lives in LA, but he's staying here over the summer.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某地永久居住，栖息，定居。
definitions.exampleCn: 我住在阿卡西亚大道2a号。他住在洛杉矶，但整个夏天都会待在这里。

definitions.definition: To survive; to persevere; to continue.
definitions.example: Her memory lives in that song.
definitions.definitionCn: 幸存；坚持；延续。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的记忆永存于那首歌中。

definitions.definition: To cope.
definitions.example: You'll just have to live with it!  I can't live in a world without you.
definitions.definitionCn: 忍受；应对。
definitions.exampleCn: 你只能接受这个事实！没有你，我活不下去。

definitions.definition: To pass life in a specified manner.
definitions.example: It is difficult to live in poverty.   And they lived happily ever after.
definitions.definitionCn: 以特定方式度过一生。
definitions.exampleCn: 在贫困中生活很艰难。从此他们过上了幸福的生活。

definitions.definition: To spend, as one's life; to pass; to maintain; to continue in, constantly or habitually.
definitions.example: To live an idle or a useful life.
definitions.definitionCn: 度过（生命）；消磨；维持；习惯性地持续某种状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 过着无所事事或有益的生活。

definitions.definition: To act habitually in conformity with; to practice; to exemplify in one's way of life.
definitions.definitionCn: 习惯性地遵循；实践；以身作则。

definitions.definition: To outlast danger; to float (said of a ship, boat, etc).
definitions.example: No ship could live in such a storm.
definitions.definitionCn: 幸存于危险中；（船、艇等）漂浮。
definitions.exampleCn: 没有船能在这样的风暴中幸存。

definitions.definition: (followed by "on" or "upon") To maintain or support one's existence; to provide for oneself; to feed; to subsist.
definitions.example: It is hard to live on the minimum wage.   They lived on stale bread.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接"on"或"upon"）维持生计；自给自足；以……为食。
definitions.exampleCn: 靠最低工资很难生活。他们靠吃陈面包度日。

definitions.definition: To make the most of life; to experience a full, rich life.
definitions.example: I'm sick of spending every day studying at home: I want to go out there and live!
definitions.definitionCn: 充分利用生命；体验充实丰富的人生。
definitions.exampleCn: 我厌倦了每天在家学习：我要走出去，真正地生活！

definitions.definition: Life
(only used attributively) Having life; that is alive.
definitions.example: The post office will not ship live animals.

definitions.definition: Being in existence; actual
definitions.example: He is a live example of the consequences of excessive drinking.

definitions.definition: Having active properties; being energized.
Operational; in actual use rather than in testing etc.
Taken from a living animal.
definitions.example: live feathers

definitions.definition: Imparting power; having motion.
definitions.example: a live, or driving, axle

definitions.definition: Still in active play.
definitions.example: a live ball

definitions.definition: Seen or heard from a broadcast, as it happens.
definitions.example: The station presented a live news program every evening.

definitions.definition: (of a performance or speech) In person.
definitions.example: This nightclub has a live band on weekends.

definitions.definition: (entertainment, performing) Recorded in front of an audience and not having been edited after recording.
definitions.example: a live album

definitions.definition: Of firearms or explosives, capable of causing harm.
definitions.example: The air force practices dropping live bombs on the uninhabited island.

definitions.definition: (circuitry) Electrically charged or energized, usually indicating that the item may cause electrocution if touched.
definitions.example: Use caution when working near live wires.

definitions.definition: Being a bet which can be raised by the bettor, usually in reference to a blind or straddle.
definitions.example: Tommy's blind was live, so he was given the option to raise.

definitions.definition: Featuring humans; not animated, in the phrases “live actors” or “live action”.
Being in a state of ignition; burning.
definitions.example: a live coal; live embers

definitions.definition: Full of earnestness; active; wide awake; glowing.
definitions.example: a live man, or orator

definitions.definition: Vivid; bright.
Of an event, as it happens; in real time; direct.
definitions.example: The concert was broadcast live by radio.

definitions.definition: Of making a performance or speech, in person.
definitions.example: He'll be appearing live at the auditorium.

definitions.definition: Subsidence of the roof of a coal mine.
definitions.definitionCn: 煤矿顶板下沉。

definitions.definition: An event, usually lasting one full day or more, where the primary goal is to sit in meditation.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种通常持续一整天或更长时间的活动，主要目的是静坐冥想。

definitions.definition: (of a person) To be in a position in which the upper body is upright and supported by the buttocks.
definitions.example: After a long day of walking, it was good just to sit and relax.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）上身挺直、臀部支撑的姿势。
definitions.exampleCn: 走了一整天后，能坐下来休息真是太好了。

definitions.definition: (of a person) To move oneself into such a position.
definitions.example: I asked him to sit.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）使自己进入这种姿势。
definitions.exampleCn: 我请他坐下。

definitions.definition: (of an object) To occupy a given position permanently.
definitions.example: The temple has sat atop that hill for centuries.
definitions.definitionCn: （指物体）永久占据某个位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 那座寺庙坐落在山顶已有数百年。

definitions.definition: To remain in a state of repose; to rest; to abide; to rest in any position or condition.
definitions.definitionCn: 保持静止状态；休息；停留；以任何姿势或状态休息。

definitions.definition: To be a member of a deliberative body.
definitions.example: I currently sit on a standards committee.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为审议机构的成员。
definitions.exampleCn: 我目前在一个标准委员会任职。

definitions.definition: Of a legislative or, especially, a judicial body such as a court, to be in session.
definitions.example: In what city is the circuit court sitting for this session.
definitions.definitionCn: 指立法机构，尤其是司法机构（如法院）开庭。
definitions.exampleCn: 巡回法院本次开庭设在哪个城市？

definitions.definition: To lie, rest, or bear; to press or weigh.
definitions.definitionCn: 搁置、依靠或承载；施加压力或重量。

definitions.definition: To be adjusted; to fit.
definitions.example: Your new coat sits well.
definitions.definitionCn: 调整合适；合身。
definitions.exampleCn: 你的新外套很合身。

definitions.definition: (of an agreement or arrangement) To be accepted or acceptable; to work.
definitions.example: How will this new contract sit with the workers?
definitions.definitionCn: （指协议或安排）被接受或可接受；可行。
definitions.exampleCn: 这份新合同工人们会接受吗？

definitions.definition: (causative) To cause to be seated or in a sitting posture; to furnish a seat to.
definitions.example: Sit him in front of the TV and he might watch for hours.
definitions.definitionCn: （使役动词）使坐下或处于坐姿；提供座位。
definitions.exampleCn: 让他坐在电视机前，他可能会看几个小时。

definitions.definition: To accommodate in seats; to seat.
definitions.example: The dining room table sits eight comfortably.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供座位；容纳。
definitions.exampleCn: 餐桌可舒适地坐八个人。

definitions.definition: To babysit.
definitions.example: I need to find someone to sit my kids on Friday evening for four hours.
definitions.definitionCn: 临时照看（孩子）。
definitions.exampleCn: 周五晚上我需要找人照看我的孩子四个小时。

definitions.definition: To take, to undergo or complete (an examination or test).
definitions.definitionCn: 参加或完成（考试或测试）。

definitions.definition: To cover and warm eggs for hatching, as a fowl; to brood; to incubate.
definitions.definitionCn: （如禽类）覆盖并温暖鸡蛋以孵化；孵蛋；孵化。

definitions.definition: To take a position for the purpose of having some artistic representation of oneself made, such as a picture or a bust.
definitions.example: I'm sitting for a painter this evening.
definitions.definitionCn: 为制作艺术肖像（如照片或半身像）而摆姿势。
definitions.exampleCn: 我今晚要为一幅画作当模特。

definitions.definition: To have position, as at the point blown from; to hold a relative position; to have direction.
definitions.definitionCn: 占据位置，如风吹来的方向；保持相对位置；有方向。

definitions.definition: Short for situation.
Activity for amusement only, especially among the young.
definitions.example: Children learn through play.
definitions.definitionCn: 仅供娱乐的活动，尤指年轻人的游戏。
definitions.exampleCn: 儿童通过玩耍学习。

definitions.definition: Similar activity in young animals, as they explore their environment and learn new skills.
definitions.example: This kind of play helps the young lion cubs develop their hunting skills.
definitions.definitionCn: 幼小动物在探索环境和学习新技能时的类似活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种玩耍有助于幼狮发展捕猎技能。

definitions.definition: The conduct, or course, of a game.
definitions.example: After the rain break, play resumed at 3 o'clock.
definitions.definitionCn: 游戏的行为或进程。
definitions.exampleCn: 雨停后，比赛在3点重新开始。

definitions.definition: An individual's performance in a sport or game.
definitions.example: His play has improved a lot this season.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人在运动或比赛中的表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 本赛季他的表现进步了很多。

definitions.definition: A short sequence of action within a game.
definitions.example: That was a great play by the Mudchester Rovers forward.
definitions.definitionCn: 比赛中的一段短小动作序列。
definitions.exampleCn: 穆切斯特流浪者队前锋的那次进攻真精彩。

definitions.definition: (turn-based games) An action carried out when it is one's turn to play.
definitions.definitionCn: （回合制游戏）轮到某人行动时执行的动作。

definitions.definition: A literary composition, intended to be represented by actors impersonating the characters and speaking the dialogue.
definitions.example: This book contains all of Shakespeare's plays.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种文学作品，旨在由演员扮演角色并念台词来呈现。
definitions.exampleCn: 这本书收录了莎士比亚的所有戏剧。

definitions.definition: A theatrical performance featuring actors.
definitions.example: We saw a two-act play in the theatre.
definitions.definitionCn: 一场有演员表演的戏剧演出。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在剧院看了一出两幕剧。

definitions.definition: A major move by a business or investor.
definitions.example: ABC Widgets makes a play in the bicycle market with its bid to take over Acme Sprockets.
definitions.definitionCn: 企业或投资者的重大举措。
definitions.exampleCn: ABC小配件公司通过收购阿克梅链轮的竞标，在自行车市场展开行动。

definitions.definition: A geological formation that contains an accumulation or prospect of hydrocarbons or other resources.
definitions.definitionCn: 含有碳氢化合物或其他资源积累或前景的地质构造。

definitions.definition: The extent to which a part of a mechanism can move freely.
definitions.example: No wonder the fanbelt is slipping: there’s too much play in it.
definitions.definitionCn: 机械部件可自由移动的程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 难怪风扇皮带打滑：它的活动余地太大了。

definitions.definition: Sexual activity or sexual role-playing.
definitions.definitionCn: 性活动或性角色扮演。

definitions.definition: An instance of watching or listening to digital media.
definitions.definitionCn: 观看或收听数字媒体的一次实例。

definitions.definition: A button that, when pressed, causes media to be played.
definitions.definitionCn: 按下后会使媒体播放的按钮。

definitions.definition: (now usually in compounds) Activity relating to martial combat or fighting.
definitions.definitionCn: （现在通常用于复合词中）与武术或战斗相关的活动。

definitions.definition: To act in a manner such that one has fun; to engage in activities expressly for the purpose of recreation or entertainment.
definitions.example: They played long and hard.
definitions.definitionCn: 以有趣的方式行动；专门为娱乐或消遣而参与活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们玩得又久又投入。

definitions.definition: To perform in (a sport); to participate in (a game).
definitions.example: He plays on three teams
definitions.definitionCn: 参加（一项运动）；参与（一场比赛）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在三支队伍中打球。

definitions.definition: To take part in amorous activity; to make love.
definitions.definitionCn: 参与情爱活动；做爱。

definitions.definition: To act as the indicated role, especially in a performance.
definitions.example: He plays the King, and she's the Queen.
definitions.definitionCn: 扮演指定角色，尤指在表演中。
definitions.exampleCn: 他扮演国王，她扮演王后。

definitions.definition: (heading) To produce music or theatre.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）制作音乐或戏剧。

definitions.definition: (heading) To behave in a particular way.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）以特定方式行事。

definitions.definition: To move in any manner; especially, to move regularly with alternate or reciprocating motion; to operate.
definitions.example: He played the torch beam around the room.
definitions.definitionCn: 以任何方式移动；尤指以交替或往复运动有规律地移动；操作。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用手电筒光束在房间里扫来扫去。

definitions.definition: To move to and fro.
definitions.definitionCn: 来回移动。

definitions.definition: To put in action or motion.
definitions.example: to play a trump in a card game
definitions.definitionCn: 使行动或运动起来。
definitions.exampleCn: 在纸牌游戏中打出王牌。

definitions.definition: To keep in play, as a hooked fish in order to land it.
definitions.definitionCn: 让上钩的鱼持续挣扎以便将其捕获。

definitions.definition: To manipulate, deceive, or swindle someone.
definitions.example: You played me!
definitions.definitionCn: 操纵、欺骗或诈骗某人。
definitions.exampleCn: 你耍了我！

definitions.definition: The act of standing.
definitions.definitionCn: 站立的行为。

definitions.definition: A defensive position or effort.
definitions.example: The Commander says we will make our stand here.
definitions.definitionCn: 防御的姿势或努力。
definitions.exampleCn: 指挥官说我们将在此坚守。

definitions.definition: A resolute, unwavering position; firm opinion; action for a purpose in the face of opposition.
definitions.example: They took a firm stand against copyright infringement.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚定、不动摇的立场；坚定的意见；面对反对时为实现目标而采取的行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们坚决反对版权侵犯。

definitions.definition: A period of performance in a given location or venue.
definitions.example: They have a four-game stand at home against the Yankees.  They spent the summer touring giving 4 one-night stands a week.
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定地点或场所的一段表演期。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们在主场与洋基队进行四场比赛。 他们夏季巡演，每周进行四场一夜演出。

definitions.definition: A device to hold something upright or aloft.
definitions.example: He set the music upon the stand and began to play.  an umbrella stand;  a hat-stand
definitions.definitionCn: 用于支撑某物直立或高处的装置。
definitions.exampleCn: 他把乐谱放在架子上开始演奏。 一个伞架； 一个帽架

definitions.definition: The platform on which a witness testifies in court; the witness stand or witness box.
definitions.example: She took the stand and quietly answered questions.
definitions.definitionCn: 法庭上证人作证的平台；证人席或证人箱。
definitions.exampleCn: 她站上证人席，平静地回答了问题。

definitions.definition: A particular grove or other group of trees or shrubs.
definitions.example: This stand of pines is older than the one next to it.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定的树丛或其他树木或灌木群。
definitions.exampleCn: 这片松林比旁边那片更古老。

definitions.definition: A contiguous group of trees sufficiently uniform in age-class distribution, composition, and structure, and growing on a site of sufficiently uniform quality, to be a distinguishable unit.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片连续的树木群体，其年龄分布、组成和结构足够均匀，且生长在质量足够一致的场地上，从而成为一个可区分的单元。

definitions.definition: A standstill, a motionless state, as of someone confused, or a hunting dog who has found game.
definitions.definitionCn: 停滞状态，静止状态，如困惑的人或发现猎物的猎犬。

definitions.definition: A small building, booth, or stage, as in a bandstand or hamburger stand.
definitions.definitionCn: 小型建筑、摊位或舞台，如音乐台或汉堡摊。

definitions.definition: A designated spot where someone or something may stand or wait.
definitions.example: a taxi stand
definitions.definitionCn: 指定某人或某物站立或等待的地点。
definitions.exampleCn: 出租车候客站

definitions.definition: The situation of a shop, store, hotel, etc.
definitions.example: a good, bad, or convenient stand for business
definitions.definitionCn: 商店、店铺、酒店等的情况。
definitions.exampleCn: 适合、不适合或方便做生意的位置

definitions.definition: Grandstand. (often in the plural)
definitions.definitionCn: 大看台。（常用复数）

definitions.definition: A partnership.
definitions.definitionCn: 合伙关系。

definitions.definition: (plural often stand) A single set, as of arms.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数常为stand）一套，如武器。

definitions.definition: Rank; post; station; standing.
definitions.definitionCn: 等级；职位；岗位；地位。

definitions.definition: A state of perplexity or embarrassment.
definitions.example: to be at a stand what to do
definitions.definitionCn: 困惑或尴尬的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 不知如何是好

definitions.definition: A young tree, usually reserved when other trees are cut; also, a tree growing or standing upon its own root, in distinction from one produced from a scion set in a stock, either of the same or another kind of tree.
definitions.definitionCn: 一棵幼树，通常在砍伐其他树木时保留；也指生长或立在自己根上的树，区别于嫁接在砧木上的接穗产生的树，无论同种或异种。

definitions.definition: A weight of from two hundred and fifty to three hundred pounds, used in weighing pitch.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于称量沥青的重量单位，约250至300磅。

definitions.definition: A location or position where one may stand.
definitions.definitionCn: 可以站立的位置或地点。

definitions.definition: (heading) To position or be positioned physically.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）物理上定位或被定位。

definitions.definition: (heading) To position or be positioned mentally.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）心理上定位或被定位。

definitions.definition: (heading) To position or be positioned socially.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）社会性定位或被定位。

definitions.definition: Of a ship or its captain, to steer, sail (in a specified direction, for a specified destination etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 指船只或其船长，按指定方向、目的地等航行。

definitions.definition: To remain without ruin or injury.
definitions.definitionCn: 保持完好无损。

definitions.definition: To stop asking for more cards; to keep one's hand as it has been dealt so far.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止要求更多牌；保持已发到的手牌不变。

definitions.definition: To run.
definitions.definitionCn: 跑。

definitions.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
definitions.example: I just got back from my morning run.
definitions.definitionCn: 跑的行为或实例，即用脚快速移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我刚结束晨跑回来。

definitions.definition: Act or instance of hurrying (to or from a place) (not necessarily by foot); dash or errand, trip.
definitions.example: I need to make a run to the store.
definitions.definitionCn: 匆忙（去或离开某地）的行为或实例（不一定步行）；短途差事或行程。
definitions.exampleCn: 我需要去趟商店。

definitions.definition: A pleasure trip.
definitions.example: Let's go for a run in the car.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次愉快的旅行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们开车去兜风吧。

definitions.definition: Flight, instance or period of fleeing.

To incur a charge of; to require payment of a (specified) price.
definitions.example: It will cost you a lot of money to take a trip around the world.
definitions.definitionCn: 承担费用；要求支付（特定）价格。
definitions.exampleCn: 环游世界会花费你很多钱。

definitions.definition: To cause something to be lost; to cause the expenditure or relinquishment of.
definitions.example: Trying to rescue the man from the burning building cost them their lives.
definitions.definitionCn: 导致某物损失；引起支出或放弃。
definitions.exampleCn: 试图从燃烧的大楼中救出那个人使他们付出了生命代价。

definitions.definition: To require to be borne or suffered; to cause.
definitions.definitionCn: 要求承受或忍受；导致。

definitions.definition: To calculate or estimate a price.
definitions.example: I'd cost the repair work at a few thousand.
definitions.definitionCn: 计算或估算价格。
definitions.exampleCn: 我估计维修工作要花几千块钱。

definitions.definition: Amount of money, time, etc. that is required or used.
definitions.example: The average cost of a new house is twice as much as it was 20 years ago.

definitions.definition: A negative consequence or loss that occurs or is required to occur.
definitions.example: Spending all your time working may earn you a lot of money at the cost of your health.

definitions.definition: Manner; way; means; available course; contrivance.
Quality; condition; property; value; worth; a wont or habit; disposition; nature; kind; characteristic.
A rib; a side.
A cottise.
To stop living; to become dead; to undergo death.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止生存；变为死亡；经历死亡。

definitions.definition: To (stop living and) undergo (a specified death).
definitions.example: He died a hero's death.
definitions.definitionCn: 经历（停止生存并）承受（某种特定的死亡）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他英勇牺牲。

definitions.definition: To yearn intensely.
definitions.example: I'm dying for a packet of crisps.
definitions.definitionCn: 极度渴望。
definitions.exampleCn: 我特别想吃一包薯片。

definitions.definition: To be or become hated or utterly ignored or cut off, as if dead.
definitions.example: The day our sister eloped, she died to our mother.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得被憎恨、完全忽视或断绝关系，如同死去一般。
definitions.exampleCn: 姐姐私奔那天，她在母亲心中已经死了。

definitions.definition: To become spiritually dead; to lose hope.
definitions.example: He died a little inside each time she refused to speak to him.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神上变得死亡；失去希望。
definitions.exampleCn: 每次她拒绝和他说话，他内心都死了一点点。

definitions.definition: To be mortified or shocked by a situation.
definitions.example: If anyone sees me wearing this ridiculous outfit, I'll die.
definitions.definitionCn: 因某种情况感到羞愧或震惊。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果有人看到我穿这身可笑的衣服，我宁愿去死。

definitions.definition: To be so overcome with emotion or laughter as to be incapacitated.
definitions.example: When I found out my two favorite musicians would be recording an album together, I literally planned my own funeral arrangements and died.
definitions.definitionCn: 因情绪或笑声过度而无法自持。
definitions.exampleCn: 当我发现我最喜欢的两位音乐家要合作录制专辑时，我简直激动得“死”了。

definitions.definition: (of a machine) To stop working, to break down.
definitions.example: My car died in the middle of the freeway this morning.
definitions.definitionCn: （指机器）停止运转，发生故障。
definitions.exampleCn: 今天早上我的车在高速公路上抛锚了。

definitions.definition: (of a computer program) To abort, to terminate (as an error condition).
definitions.definitionCn: （指计算机程序）中止，终止（因错误状态）。

definitions.definition: To perish; to cease to exist; to become lost or extinct.
definitions.definitionCn: 消亡；不复存在；消失或灭绝。

definitions.definition: To sink; to faint; to pine; to languish, with weakness, discouragement, love, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 因虚弱、沮丧、爱情等而沉沦、昏厥、憔悴、萎靡。

definitions.definition: (often with "to") To become indifferent; to cease to be subject.
definitions.example: to die to pleasure or to sin
definitions.definitionCn: （常与“to”连用）变得冷漠；不再受影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 对享乐或罪恶无动于衷

definitions.definition: To disappear gradually in another surface, as where mouldings are lost in a sloped or curved face.
definitions.definitionCn: 在另一个表面上逐渐消失，如装饰线条在斜面或曲面上隐没。

definitions.definition: To become vapid, flat, or spiritless, as liquor.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得乏味、平淡或无生气，如酒类。

definitions.definition: (of a stand-up comedian or a joke) To fail to evoke laughter from the audience.
definitions.example: Then there was that time I died onstage in Montreal...
definitions.definitionCn: （指脱口秀演员或笑话）未能引发观众笑声。
definitions.exampleCn: 还有一次我在蒙特利尔舞台上彻底冷场了。

definitions.definition: A regular polyhedron, usually a cube, with numbers or symbols on each side and used in games of chance.
That which is, or might be, determined, by a throw of the die; hazard; chance.

The cubical part of a pedestal; a plinth.
A device for cutting into a specified shape.

A mold for forming metal or plastic objects.
An embossed device used in stamping coins and medals.

Any small cubical or square body.
A colourant, especially one that has an affinity to the substrate to which it is applied.
Any hue, color, or blee.
To colour with dye, or as if with dye.
An attempt.

definitions.definitionCn: 一次尝试。
definitions.exampleCn: 我试过骑独轮车，但做不到。

definitions.definition: An act of tasting or sampling.
definitions.example: I gave sushi a try but I didn’t like it.
definitions.definitionCn: 品尝或试味的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 我尝了寿司，但不喜欢。

definitions.definition: A score in rugby league and rugby union, analogous to a touchdown in American football.
definitions.example: Today I scored my first try.
definitions.definitionCn: 橄榄球联盟和橄榄球联合会中的得分，类似于美式足球的达阵。
definitions.exampleCn: 今天我第一次成功达阵。

definitions.definition: A screen, or sieve, for grain.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于谷物的筛子或滤网。

definitions.definition: A field goal or extra point
definitions.definitionCn: 射门得分或附加分。

definitions.definition: To attempt; to endeavour. Followed by infinitive.

definitions.definitionCn: 尝试；努力。后接不定式。
definitions.exampleCn: 我试着玩轮滑，但不行。

definitions.definition: To divide; to separate.
definitions.definitionCn: 分开；分离。

definitions.definition: To test, to work out.
definitions.definitionCn: 测试；检验。

definitions.definition: To experiment, to strive.
definitions.definitionCn: 实验；努力。

definitions.definition: To lie to in heavy weather under just sufficient sail to head into the wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 在恶劣天气中仅用足够迎风的帆使船顶风停泊。

definitions.definition: To strain; to subject to excessive tests.

definitions.definitionCn: 使紧张；过度考验。
definitions.exampleCn: 反复失败会消磨人的耐心。

definitions.definition: (used with another verb) To want
definitions.example: I am really not trying to hear you talk about my mama like that.
definitions.definitionCn: （与另一动词连用）想要
definitions.exampleCn: 我真的不想听你那样谈论我妈妈。

definitions.definition: Fine, excellent.
Having relevant and crucial value.
definitions.example: It is very important to give your daughter independence in her life so she learns from experience.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有相关且关键的价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 让女儿在生活中拥有独立性非常重要，这样她才能从经验中学习。

definitions.definition: Pompous; self-important.

definitions.definition: The different ideal.

definitions.definition: Not the same; exhibiting a difference.
definitions.definitionCn: 并非相同；表现出差异。

definitions.definition: Various, assorted, diverse.
definitions.definitionCn: 各种各样的，多种多样的，不同的。

definitions.definition: Distinct, separate; used for emphasis after numbers and other determiners of quantity.
definitions.example: Several different scientists all reached this conclusion at about the same time.
definitions.definitionCn: 不同的，分开的；用于数字和其他数量限定词后以加强语气。
definitions.exampleCn: 几位不同的科学家几乎同时得出了这一结论。

definitions.definition: Unlike most others; unusual.
definitions.definitionCn: 与大多数其他事物不同；不寻常的。

definitions.definition: Differently.
definitions.definitionCn: 不同地。

definitions.definition: Someone who is beautiful. Can be used as a term of address.
definitions.example: Hey, beautiful!
definitions.definitionCn: 美丽的人。可用作称呼。
definitions.exampleCn: 嘿，美人！

definitions.definition: Attractive and possessing beauty.
definitions.example: Anyone who has ever met her thought she was absolutely beautiful.
definitions.definitionCn: 迷人且拥有美貌。
definitions.exampleCn: 任何见过她的人都觉得她美极了。

definitions.definition: (of the weather) Pleasant; clear.
definitions.example: It's beautiful outside, let's go for a walk.
definitions.definitionCn: （指天气）宜人；晴朗。
definitions.exampleCn: 外面天气真好，我们去散步吧。

definitions.definition: Well executed.
definitions.example: The skater performed a beautiful axel.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行得很出色。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位滑冰者完成了一个漂亮的阿克塞尔跳。

definitions.definition: Ugliness.

definitions.definition: An ugly person or thing.
definitions.definitionCn: 丑陋的人或物。

definitions.definition: A shade for the face, projecting from a bonnet.
definitions.definitionCn: 从帽子上伸出的遮阳面罩。

definitions.definition: To make ugly (sometimes with up).
definitions.definitionCn: 使变丑（有时与up连用）。

definitions.definition: Displeasing to the eye; not aesthetically pleasing.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人不悦的视觉感受；缺乏美感。

definitions.definition: Displeasing to the ear or some other sense.
definitions.definitionCn: 刺耳或令其他感官不适。

definitions.definition: Offensive to one's sensibilities or morality.

definitions.definitionCn: 冒犯某人的情感或道德观。
definitions.exampleCn: 他对我们耍了个恶作剧。

definitions.definition: Ill-natured; crossgrained; quarrelsome.

definitions.definitionCn: 性情乖戾；执拗；好争吵。
definitions.exampleCn: 坏脾气；感到烦躁。

definitions.definition: Unpleasant; disagreeable; likely to cause trouble or loss.

definitions.definitionCn: 令人不快；讨厌；可能引发麻烦或损失。
definitions.exampleCn: 面对如此激烈的竞争，情况恐怕会变得糟糕。

definitions.definition: To make melancholy; to sadden or grieve (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 使忧郁；使悲伤或哀伤（某人）。

definitions.definition: (heading) Emotionally negative.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）情绪消极的。

definitions.definition: Sated, having had one's fill; satisfied, weary.
definitions.definitionCn: 饱足的，已满足的；满意的，厌倦的。

definitions.definition: Steadfast, valiant.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚定的，勇敢的。

definitions.definition: Dignified, serious, grave.
definitions.definitionCn: 庄重的，严肃的，沉重的。

definitions.definition: Naughty; troublesome; wicked.
definitions.definitionCn: 顽皮的；麻烦的；邪恶的。

definitions.definition: Unfashionable; socially inadequate or undesirable.
definitions.example: I can't believe you use drugs; you're so sad!
definitions.definitionCn: 不时髦的；社交上不合时宜或不受欢迎的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不敢相信你吸毒；你太可悲了！

definitions.definition: Soggy (to refer to pastries).
definitions.definitionCn: 湿软的（指糕点）。

definitions.definition: Heavy; weighty; ponderous; close; hard.

definitions.definitionCn: 沉重的；有分量的；笨重的；紧密的；坚硬的。
definitions.exampleCn: 硬面包。

The act of saying sorry; an apology.
definitions.definitionCn: 道歉的行为；致歉。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Regretful for an action; grieved or saddened, especially by the loss of something or someone.
definitions.example: I am sorry I stepped on your toes. It was an accident.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）对某行为感到后悔；因失去某人或某物而悲伤或难过。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱歉踩到你的脚了。那是个意外。

definitions.definition: Poor, pitifully sad or regrettable.

definitions.definitionCn: 可怜的，令人遗憾的或可悲的。
definitions.exampleCn: 暴风雨让他的花园一片狼藉。

definitions.definition: Pathetic and inferior to the point of causing others disgust.
definitions.example: Bob is a sorry excuse for a football player.
definitions.definitionCn: 差劲到令人厌恶的地步。
definitions.exampleCn: 鲍勃作为足球运动员实在差劲。

definitions.definition: Expresses regret, remorse, or sorrow.
definitions.example: Sorry! I didn't see that you were on the phone.
definitions.definitionCn: 表达遗憾、懊悔或悲伤。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱歉！我没看到你在打电话。

definitions.definition: Used as a request for someone to repeat something not heard or understood clearly.
definitions.example: Sorry? What was that? The phone cut out.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于请求对方重复未听清或未理解的内容。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱歉？你说什么？电话断线了。

definitions.definition: Used to correct oneself in speech.
definitions.example: There are four — sorry, five — branches of the store locally.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于说话时自我纠正。
definitions.exampleCn: 本地有四家——抱歉，五家——分店。

definitions.definition: The person or thing in the first position.
definitions.example: He was the first to complete the course.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于第一位置的人或物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是第一个完成课程的人。

definitions.definition: The first gear of an engine.
definitions.definitionCn: 发动机的一档。

definitions.definition: Something that has never happened before; a new occurrence.
definitions.example: This is a first. For once he has nothing to say.
definitions.definitionCn: 从未发生过的事情；新出现的事件。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是头一回。他难得无话可说。

definitions.definition: First base
definitions.example: There was a close play at first.
definitions.definitionCn: 一垒

definitions.definition: A first-class honours degree.

definitions.definition: A first-edition copy of some publication.

definitions.definition: A fraction of an integer ending in one.

definitions.definitionCn: 以数字一结尾的整数分数。
definitions.exampleCn: 遗产的四十一分之一。

definitions.definition: Preceding all others of a series or kind; the ordinal of one; earliest.
definitions.example: I was the first runner to reach the finish line, and won the race.
definitions.definitionCn: 先于同一系列或种类中的所有其他事物；序数词一；最早的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我是第一个到达终点的跑者，赢得了比赛。

definitions.definition: Most eminent or exalted; most excellent; chief; highest.
definitions.example: Demosthenes was the first orator of Greece.
definitions.definitionCn: 最卓越或最崇高的；最优秀的；首要的；最高的。
definitions.exampleCn: 德摩斯梯尼是希腊最伟大的演说家。

definitions.definition: Before anything else; firstly.

definitions.definitionCn: 首先；第一。
definitions.exampleCn: 在开始做饭之前，先把水槽洗干净。

definitions.definition: For the first time;
definitions.example: I first witnessed a death when I was nine years old.
definitions.definitionCn: 第一次；
definitions.exampleCn: 我九岁时第一次目睹死亡。

definitions.definition: Time; time granted; respite.
Final, ultimate, coming after all others of its kind.
definitions.example: “Eyes Wide Shut” was the last film to be directed by Stanley Kubrick.
definitions.definitionCn: 最终的、终极的，同类中排在所有其他之后的。
definitions.exampleCn: 《大开眼戒》是斯坦利·库布里克执导的最后一部电影。

definitions.definition: Most recent, latest, last so far.
definitions.example: I have received your note dated the 17th last, and am responding to say that [...]
definitions.definitionCn: 最近的、最新的，迄今为止最后的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已收到您上月17日的便条，现回复如下：[……]

definitions.definition: Farthest of all from a given quality, character, or condition; most unlikely, or least preferable.
definitions.example: He is the last person to be accused of theft.
definitions.definitionCn: 最远离某种品质、特征或状态的；最不可能的，或最不理想的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是最不可能被指控偷窃的人。

definitions.definition: Being the only one remaining of its class.
definitions.example: Japan is the last empire.
definitions.definitionCn: 同类中唯一剩下的。
definitions.exampleCn: 日本是最后的帝国。

definitions.definition: Supreme; highest in degree; utmost.
definitions.definitionCn: 至高无上的；最高程度的；极度的。

definitions.definition: Lowest in rank or degree.
definitions.example: the last prize
definitions.definitionCn: 等级或程度最低的。
definitions.exampleCn: 最末等奖。

definitions.definition: Most recently.
definitions.example: When we last met, he was based in Toronto.
definitions.definitionCn: 最近一次。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们上次见面时，他住在多伦多。

definitions.definition: (sequence) after everything else; finally
definitions.example: I'll go last.
definitions.definitionCn: （顺序上）在所有其他之后；最后。
definitions.exampleCn: 我最后一个去。

definitions.definition: To perform, carry out.
To endure, continue over time.
definitions.example: Summer seems to last longer each year.

definitions.definition: To hold out, continue undefeated or entire.
definitions.example: I don't know how much longer we can last without reinforcements.

definitions.definition: A tool for shaping or preserving the shape of shoes.

definitions.example: to last a boot

definitions.definition: A burden; load; a cargo; freight.
A measure of weight or quantity, varying in designation depending on the goods concerned.
An old English (and Dutch) measure of the carrying capacity of a ship, equal to two tons.
A load of some commodity with reference to its weight and commercial value.
A happy event, thing, person, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 快乐的事件、事物、人等。

definitions.definition: Preceded by the: happy people as a group.
definitions.definitionCn: 前面加“the”：指快乐的人群。

definitions.definition: Often followed by up: to become happy; to brighten up, to cheer up.
definitions.definitionCn: 常接“up”：变得快乐；明亮起来，振作起来。

definitions.definition: Often followed by up: to make happy; to brighten, to cheer, to enliven.
definitions.definitionCn: 常接“up”：使快乐；使明亮，使振奋，使活跃。

definitions.definitionCn: 源于安康或享受意识的情感；享受任何美好事物，如舒适、平和或宁静；幸福、满足、喜悦。
definitions.exampleCn: 音乐让我感到快乐。

definitions.definition: Experiencing the effect of favourable fortune; favored by fortune or luck; fortunate, lucky, propitious.
definitions.definitionCn: 经历好运的影响；受命运或运气眷顾；幸运、吉利、吉祥。

definitions.definition: Content, satisfied (with or to do something); having no objection (to something).
definitions.example: Are you happy to pay me back by the end of the week?
definitions.definitionCn: 满足、满意（对某事或做某事）；不反对（某事）。

definitions.definition: (Of acts, speech, etc.) Appropriate, apt, felicitous.

definitions.definition: (of people, often followed by "at" or "in") Dexterous, ready, skilful.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人，常接“at”或“in”）灵巧、熟练、擅长。

definitions.definition: Not different or other; not another or others; not different as regards self; selfsame; identical.

definitions.definitionCn: 并非不同或相异；非另一个或他人；就自身而言并无差别；自身相同；同一。
definitions.exampleCn: 你是昨天给我打电话的那个人吗？

definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏变化，难以区分。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们花了一整夜才找到酒店房间，因为忘了房号，而且每扇门看起来都一样。

definitions.definition: Similar, alike.
definitions.example: You have the same hair I do!
definitions.definitionCn: 相似，相像。
definitions.exampleCn: 你的头发和我的一样！

definitions.definition: Used to express the unity of an object or person which has various different descriptions or qualities.
definitions.example: Round here it can be cloudy and sunny even in the same day.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于表达具有不同描述或特质的同一物体或人的统一性。
definitions.exampleCn: 在这附近，即使同一天也可能既多云又晴朗。

definitions.definition: A reply of confirmation of identity.
definitions.definitionCn: 对身份确认的回复。

definitions.definition: The identical thing, ditto.
definitions.example: It's the same everywhere.
definitions.definitionCn: 相同的事物，同上。
definitions.exampleCn: 到处都一样。

definitions.definition: Something similar, something of the identical type.
definitions.example: She's having apple pie? I'll have the same.   You two are just the same.
definitions.definitionCn: 相似之物，同类型的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 她要了苹果派？我也要同样的。你们俩简直一模一样。

definitions.definition: It or them, without a connotation of similarity.
definitions.example: Light valve suspensions and films containing UV absorbers and light valves containing the same (US Patent 5,467,217)
definitions.definitionCn: 它或它们，不带相似性的含义。
definitions.exampleCn: 含有紫外线吸收剂的光阀悬浮液和薄膜，以及包含其的光阀（美国专利5,467,217）

definitions.definition: (Indian English, common) It or them, as above, meaning the last object mentioned, mainly as complement: on the same, for the same.
definitions.example: My picture/photography blog...kindly give me your reviews on the same.
definitions.definitionCn: （印度英语，常见）它或它们，如上所述，指最后提及的对象，主要作为补语：关于同一事物，为了同一事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的图片/摄影博客……请就同一内容给予我您的评价。

definitions.definition: Indicates the speaker's strong approval or agreement with the previous material.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示说话者对前述内容强烈赞同或同意。

definitions.definition: Together.
To even the slightest extent, at all.
definitions.example: I will not remain here any longer.
definitions.definitionCn: 丝毫，完全。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不会再留在这里了。

definitions.definition: Any thing(s) or person(s).
definitions.example: Any may apply.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何事物或任何人。
definitions.exampleCn: 任何情况都适用。

definitions.definition: Each of the two, or of the two kinds.
definitions.example: "Did you want this one or that one?" — "Give me both."
definitions.definitionCn: 两者之一，或两种之一。
definitions.exampleCn: “你要这个还是那个？”——“两个都给我。”

definitions.definition: Including both of (used with and).
definitions.example: Both you and I are students.
definitions.definitionCn: 包括两者（与and连用）。
definitions.exampleCn: 你和我都是学生。

definitions.definition: Including all of (used with and).
definitions.definitionCn: 包括全部（与and连用）。

definitions.definition: Of a measurement: approximately, roughly.
definitions.example: I guess he must have weighed some 90 kilos.
definitions.definitionCn: 大约，粗略地。
definitions.exampleCn: 我猜他大概有90公斤重。

definitions.definition: A certain number, at least two.
definitions.example: Some enjoy spicy food, others prefer it milder.
definitions.definitionCn: 一定数量，至少两个。
definitions.exampleCn: 有些人喜欢辣的食物，另一些人则偏爱清淡的。

definitions.definition: An indefinite quantity.
definitions.example: Can I have some of them?
definitions.definitionCn: 不确定的数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能拿一些吗？

definitions.definition: An indefinite amount, a part.
definitions.example: Everyone is wrong some of the time.
definitions.definitionCn: 不确定的量，一部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 每个人有时都会犯错。

definitions.definition: A multitude; a great aggregate; a mass of people; the generality; the common herd.
definitions.example: Democracy must balance the rights of the few against the will of the many.
definitions.definitionCn: 众多；一大群；大量民众；大多数；普通民众。
definitions.exampleCn: 民主必须在少数人的权利与多数人的意愿之间取得平衡。

definitions.definition: A considerable number.
definitions.definitionCn: 相当多的数量。

definitions.definition: A large number of; numerous.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量的；无数的。

definitions.definition: An indefinite large number of people or things.
definitions.example: Many are called, but few are chosen.
definitions.definitionCn: 数量不确定的大量人或事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 被召的人多，选上的人少。

definitions.definition: An additional one of the same kind.
definitions.example: There is one sterling and here is another
definitions.definitionCn: 同类的另一个。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里有一个英镑，那里还有一个。

definitions.definition: One that is different from the current one.
definitions.example: I saw one movie, but I think I will see another.
definitions.definitionCn: 与当前不同的一个。
definitions.exampleCn: 我看了一部电影，但我想我会再看另一部。

definitions.definition: One of a group of things of the same kind.
definitions.example: His interests keep shifting from one thing to another.
definitions.definitionCn: 同类事物中的某一个。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的兴趣总在一件事和另一件事之间转换。

definitions.definition: An other, another (person, etc), more often rendered as another.
definitions.example: I'm afraid little Robbie does not always play well with others.
definitions.definitionCn: 另一个，另一个人（等），通常译为“另一个”。
definitions.exampleCn: 恐怕小罗比并不总是能和其他人好好玩耍。

definitions.definition: The other one; the second of two.
definitions.example: One boat is not better than the other.
definitions.definitionCn: 另一个；两者中的第二个。
definitions.exampleCn: 一艘船并不比另一艘更好。

definitions.definition: To regard, label or treat as an "other", as not part of the same group; to view as different and alien.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某人视为、标记或对待为“他者”，即不属于同一群体；视为不同且异己。

definitions.definition: To treat as different or separate; segregate; ostracise.
definitions.definitionCn: 视为不同或分离；隔离；排斥。

definitions.definition: See other (determiner) below
definitions.definitionCn: 参见下面的“other（限定词）”。

definitions.definition: Second.
definitions.example: I get paid every other week.
definitions.definitionCn: 第二。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每隔一周领一次工资。

definitions.definition: Alien.
definitions.definitionCn: 异己的。

definitions.definition: Different.
definitions.definitionCn: 不同的。

definitions.definition: Left, as opposed to right.
definitions.definitionCn: 左边的，与右边相对。

definitions.definition: Apart from; in the phrase "other than".
definitions.example: Other than that, I'm fine.
definitions.definitionCn: 除……之外；用于短语“other than”。
definitions.exampleCn: 除此之外，我很好。

definitions.definition: Otherwise.
definitions.example: If you think other. — Shakespeare.
definitions.definitionCn: 否则。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你有不同想法。——莎士比亚

definitions.definition: The one that follows after this one.
definitions.example: Next, please, don't hold up the queue!
definitions.definitionCn: 紧随其后的那个。
definitions.exampleCn: 下一位，请别耽误队伍！

definitions.definition: Nearest in place or position, having nothing similar intervening; adjoining.
definitions.definitionCn: 在位置或空间上最近的，中间没有类似事物间隔；毗邻的。

definitions.definition: Nearest in order, succession, or rank; immediately following (or sometimes preceding) in order.
definitions.example: the next chapter; the next man I see; the next week; the Sunday next before Easter
definitions.definitionCn: 在顺序、连续或等级上最近的；紧随其后的（有时也指紧挨着前面的）。
definitions.exampleCn: 下一章；我接下来要见的那个人；下周；复活节前的那个星期日。

definitions.definition: Following in a hypothetical sequence of some kind.
definitions.example: The man was driven by his love for money and his desire to become the next Bill Gates.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某种假设序列中接下来的。
definitions.exampleCn: 此人受对金钱的热爱以及成为下一个比尔·盖茨的欲望驱使。

definitions.definition: Nearest in relationship. (See also next of kin.)
definitions.definitionCn: 关系上最近的。（另见“近亲”。）

definitions.definition: In a time, place, rank or sequence closest or following.
definitions.example: It's the next best thing to ice cream.
definitions.definitionCn: 在时间、地点、等级或顺序上最接近或紧随的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是仅次于冰淇淋的最佳选择。

definitions.definition: On the first subsequent occasion.
definitions.example: Financial panic, earthquakes, oil spills, riots. What comes next?
definitions.definitionCn: 在紧接着的下一次场合。
definitions.exampleCn: 金融恐慌、地震、石油泄漏、骚乱。接下来会发生什么？

definitions.definition: On the side of; nearest or adjacent to; next to.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……旁边；最接近或邻近于；紧挨着。

definitions.definition: (with a possessive pronoun) Everything that one is capable of.
definitions.example: She gave her all, and collapsed at the finish line.
definitions.definitionCn: （与所有格代词连用）一个人所能做到的一切。
definitions.exampleCn: 她倾尽所有，在终点线倒下。

definitions.definition: The totality of one's possessions.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的全部财产。

definitions.definition: All gone; dead.
definitions.example: The butter is all.
definitions.definitionCn: 全没了；死了。
definitions.exampleCn: 黄油全用完了。

definitions.definition: (degree) Intensifier.
definitions.example: It suddenly went all quiet.
definitions.definitionCn: （程度）加强语气。
definitions.exampleCn: 突然一片寂静。

definitions.definition: Entirely; completely; totally.
definitions.definitionCn: 完全地；彻底地；全部地。

definitions.definition: Apiece; each.
definitions.example: The score was 30 all when the rain delay started.
definitions.definitionCn: 每个；各。
definitions.exampleCn: 因雨延迟开始时比分是30平。

definitions.definition: (degree) so much.
definitions.example: Don't want to go? All the better since I lost the tickets.
definitions.definitionCn: （程度）如此之多。
definitions.exampleCn: 不想去？那更好，反正我丢了票。

definitions.definition: Even; just.
definitions.definitionCn: 甚至；仅仅。

definitions.definition: Everything.
definitions.example: She knows all and sees all.
definitions.definitionCn: 一切。
definitions.exampleCn: 她无所不知，无所不见。

definitions.definition: Everyone.
definitions.example: A good time was had by all.
definitions.definitionCn: 每个人。
definitions.exampleCn: 大家都玩得很开心。

definitions.definition: The only thing(s).
definitions.example: All that was left was a small pile of ash.
definitions.definitionCn: 唯一的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 只剩下一小堆灰烬。

definitions.definition: Used after who, what, where, how and similar words, either without changing their meaning, or indicating that one expects that they cover more than one element, e.g. that "who all attended" is more than one person. (Some dialects only allow this to follow some words and not others.)
definitions.definitionCn: 用于who、what、where、how等词之后，要么不改变其含义，要么表示预期这些词涵盖多个元素，例如"who all attended"意味着不止一个人。（某些方言只允许某些词后接此用法，而非所有词。）

definitions.definition: Clipping of y’all. Used only as a vocative.
definitions.definitionCn: y'all的缩略形式。仅用作呼语。

definitions.definition: Although.
definitions.definitionCn: 虽然。

definitions.definition: The digit/figure 2.
definitions.example: The number 2202 contains three twos.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字/图形2。
definitions.exampleCn: 数字2202包含三个2。

definitions.definition: A two-dollar bill.
definitions.definitionCn: 一张两美元的钞票。

definitions.definition: A child aged two.
definitions.example: This toy is suitable for the twos and threes.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个两岁的孩子。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个玩具适合两三岁的孩子。

definitions.definition: A playing card featuring two pips.
definitions.definitionCn: 一张带有两个点的扑克牌。

definitions.definition: A numerical value equal to 2; this many dots (••).
definitions.definitionCn: 数值等于2；这么多点（••）。

definitions.definition: Describing a set or group with two elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述具有两个元素的集合或组。

definitions.definition: The digit/figure 3.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字/图形3。

definitions.definition: Anything measuring three units, as length.
definitions.example: Put all the threes in a separate container.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何长度为三单位的测量物。
definitions.exampleCn: 把所有三号物品放进单独的容器。

definitions.definition: A person who is three years old.
definitions.example: All the threes will go in Mrs. Smith's class, while I'll take the fours and fives.
definitions.definitionCn: 三岁的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 所有三岁的孩子去史密斯太太的班，而我负责四岁和五岁的孩子。

definitions.definition: The playing card featuring three pips.
definitions.definitionCn: 有三点图案的扑克牌。

definitions.definition: A numerical value after two and before four. Represented in Arabic digits as 3; this many dots (•••).
definitions.definitionCn: 介于二和四之间的数值。用阿拉伯数字表示为3；这么多点（•••）。

definitions.definition: Describing a set or group with three elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述包含三个元素的集合或群体。

definitions.definition: A goal or other means of scoring worth three points.
definitions.definitionCn: 价值三分的进球或其他得分方式。

definitions.definition: A three-point shot; a basket made from beyond the three-point line.
definitions.definitionCn: 三分球；从三分线外投中的篮筐。

definitions.definition: A three-point landing; an airplane landing in which all three wheels touch the ground simultaneously.
definitions.definitionCn: 三点着陆；飞机三个轮子同时接触地面的着陆方式。

definitions.definition: A deer or other animal whose antlers feature three points or tines.
definitions.definitionCn: 鹿或其他动物，其鹿角有三个分叉或尖头。

definitions.definition: The digit/figure 5.
definitions.example: He wrote a five followed by four zeroes.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字/图形5。
definitions.exampleCn: 他写了一个5后面跟着四个0。

definitions.definition: A banknote with a denomination of five units of currency. See also fiver.
definitions.example: Can anyone here change a five?
definitions.definitionCn: 面额为五单位货币的纸币。另见五英镑钞票。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里有人能换开一张五元钞票吗？

definitions.definition: Anything measuring five units, as length.
definitions.example: All the fives are over there in the corner, next to the fours.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何长度为五单位的物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 所有五号物品都在角落那边，紧挨着四号物品。

definitions.definition: A person who is five years old.
definitions.example: The fives and sixes will have a snack first, then the older kids.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个五岁的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 五岁和六岁的孩子先吃点心，然后是大一点的孩子。

definitions.definition: Five o'clock.
definitions.example: See you at five.
definitions.definitionCn: 五点钟。
definitions.exampleCn: 五点钟见。

definitions.definition: A short rest, especially one of five minutes.
definitions.example: Take five, soldier.
definitions.definitionCn: 短暂的休息，尤指五分钟的休息。
definitions.exampleCn: 休息五分钟，士兵。

definitions.definition: A basketball team, club or lineup.
definitions.definitionCn: 一支篮球队、俱乐部或阵容。

definitions.definition: A numerical value equal to 5; the number following four and preceding six.
definitions.definitionCn: 数值等于5；四之后、六之前的数字。

definitions.definition: Describing a group or set with five elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述有五个元素的组或集合。

definitions.definition: The digit or figure 4; an occurrence thereof.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字或符号4；其出现的情况。

definitions.definition: Anything measuring four units, as length.
definitions.example: Do you have any more fours? I want to make this a little taller.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何长度为四个单位的物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 你还有更多的四吗？我想让它再高一点。

definitions.definition: A person who is four years old.
definitions.example: I'll take the threes, fours and fives and go to the playground.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个四岁的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会带上三岁、四岁和五岁的人去操场。

definitions.definition: An event in which the batsmen run four times between the wickets or, more often, a batsman hits a ball which bounces on the ground before passing over a boundary, resulting in an award of 4 runs for the batting team. If the ball does not bounce before passing over the boundary, a six is awarded instead.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球手在门柱间跑四次的事件，或者更常见的是，击球手击球后球在越过边界前弹地，从而为击球队赢得4分。如果球在越过边界前没有弹地，则判为6分。

definitions.definition: A power forward.
definitions.definitionCn: 大前锋。

definitions.definition: Four-man sweep racing shell, with or without a coxswain.
definitions.definitionCn: 四人双桨赛艇，可有舵手或无舵手。

definitions.definition: A four-pennyworth of spirits.
definitions.definitionCn: 价值四便士的烈酒。

definitions.definition: A numerical value equal to 4; the number after three and before five; two plus two. This many dots (••••)
definitions.example: There are four seasons: winter, spring, summer and autumn.
definitions.definitionCn: 数值等于4；三之后五之前的数字；二加二。这么多点（••••）
definitions.exampleCn: 有四个季节：冬季、春季、夏季和秋季。

definitions.definition: Describing a set or group with four elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述一个包含四个元素的集合或组。

definitions.definition: The colour of gold, butter, or a lemon; the colour obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light.
definitions.definitionCn: 金色、黄油或柠檬的颜色；由绿色和红色光混合，或从白光中减去蓝色所得的颜色。

definitions.definition: The intermediate light in a set of three traffic lights, the illumination of which indicates that drivers should stop short of the intersection if it is safe to do so.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组三色交通灯中的中间灯光，其亮起表示驾驶员在安全情况下应在交叉路口前停车。

definitions.definition: One of the colour balls used in snooker, with a value of 2 points.
definitions.definitionCn: 斯诺克中使用的彩色球之一，价值2分。

definitions.definition: (pocket billiards) One of two groups of object balls, or a ball from that group, as used in the principally British version of pool that makes use of unnumbered balls (the (yellow(s) and red(s)); contrast stripes and solids in the originally American version with numbered balls).
definitions.definitionCn: （落袋台球）两组目标球之一，或来自该组的球，用于主要使用无编号球的英式台球（黄球和红球）；对比美式台球中带编号球的条纹球和实心球。

definitions.definition: A yellow card.
definitions.definitionCn: 黄牌。

definitions.definition: Any of various pierid butterflies of the subfamily Coliadinae, especially the yellow coloured species. Compare sulphur.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何属于黄粉蝶亚科的粉蝶，尤其是黄色种类的蝴蝶。比较硫磺色。

definitions.definition: To become yellow or more yellow.
definitions.definitionCn: 变成黄色或更黄。

definitions.definition: To make (something) yellow or more yellow.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某物）变成黄色或更黄。

definitions.definition: Having yellow as its colour.
definitions.definitionCn: 以黄色为其颜色。

definitions.definition: Lacking courage.
definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏勇气。

definitions.definition: Characterized by sensationalism, lurid content, and doubtful accuracy.
definitions.definitionCn: 以耸人听闻、露骨内容和可疑准确性为特征。

definitions.definition: Far East Asian (relating to Asian people).
definitions.definitionCn: 远东亚洲的（与亚洲人相关）。

definitions.definition: Of mixed Aboriginal and Caucasian ancestry.
definitions.definitionCn: 混血原住民与白种人血统的。

definitions.definition: High yellow.
definitions.definitionCn: 高黄肤色。

definitions.definition: Related to the Liberal Democrats.
definitions.example: 2012 March 2, Andrew Grice, "Yellow rebels take on Clegg over NHS 'betrayal'", The Independent
definitions.definitionCn: 与自由民主党相关。
definitions.exampleCn: 2012年3月2日，安德鲁·格莱斯，“黄色反叛者就NHS‘背叛’挑战克莱格”，《独立报》

definitions.definition: Related to the Free Democratic Party of Germany.
definitions.example: the black-yellow coalition
definitions.definitionCn: 与德国自由民主党相关。
definitions.exampleCn: 黑黄联盟。

definitions.definition: An abstract entity used to describe quantity.
definitions.example: Zero, one, −1, 2.5, and pi are all numbers.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于描述数量的抽象实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 零、一、负一、二点五和圆周率都是数字。

definitions.definition: A numeral: a symbol for a non-negative integer.
definitions.example: The number 8 is usually made with a single stroke.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字符号：表示非负整数的符号。
definitions.exampleCn: 数字8通常一笔写成。

definitions.definition: An element of one of several sets: natural numbers, integers, rational numbers, real numbers, complex numbers, and sometimes extensions such as hypercomplex numbers, etc.
definitions.example: The equation e^{i\pi}+1=0 includes the most important numbers: 1, 0, \pi, i, and e.
definitions.definitionCn: 若干集合中的元素：自然数、整数、有理数、实数、复数，有时还包括超复数等扩展形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 方程 e^{i\pi}+1=0 包含了最重要的数字：1、0、π、i 和 e。

definitions.definition: (Followed by a numeral; used attributively) Indicating the position of something in a list or sequence. Abbreviations: No or No., no or no. (in each case, sometimes written with a superscript "o", like Nº or №). The symbol "#" is also used in this manner.
definitions.example: Horse number 5 won the race.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接数字，用作定语）表示某物在列表或序列中的位置。缩写：No 或 No.，no 或 no.（每种情况有时用上标"o"书写，如 Nº 或 №）。符号"#"也用于此方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 5号马赢得了比赛。

definitions.definition: Quantity.
definitions.example: Any number of people can be reading from a given repository at a time.
definitions.definitionCn: 数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 任意数量的人可以同时从给定存储库中读取。

definitions.definition: A sequence of digits and letters used to register people, automobiles, and various other items.
definitions.example: Her passport number is C01X864TN.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于登记人员、汽车及其他各种物品的数字和字母序列。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的护照号码是 C01X864TN。

definitions.definition: A telephone number.
definitions.definitionCn: 电话号码。

definitions.definition: (grammar) Of a word or phrase, the state of being singular, dual or plural, shown by inflection.
definitions.example: Adjectives and nouns should agree in gender, number, and case.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）指单词或短语的单数、双数或复数状态，通过屈折变化表示。
definitions.exampleCn: 形容词和名词应在性、数和格上保持一致。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Poetic metres; verses, rhymes.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）诗歌格律；诗句、韵文。

definitions.definition: A performance; especially, a single song or song and dance routine within a larger show.
definitions.example: For his second number, he sang "The Moon Shines Bright".
definitions.definitionCn: 表演；尤指大型演出中的单首歌曲或歌舞节目。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的第二个节目是演唱《月亮明亮照耀》。

definitions.definition: A person.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人。

definitions.definition: An item of clothing, particularly a stylish one.
definitions.definitionCn: 一件衣物，尤指时髦的款式。

definitions.definition: A marijuana cigarette, or joint; also, a quantity of marijuana bought form a dealer.
definitions.definitionCn: 一支大麻香烟或大麻烟卷；也可指从毒贩处购买的一定数量的大麻。

definitions.definition: An issue of a periodical publication.
definitions.example: the latest number of a magazine
definitions.definitionCn: 期刊的一期。
definitions.exampleCn: 最新一期杂志

definitions.definition: A large amount, in contrast to a smaller amount; numerical preponderance.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量，相对于较小数量；数量上的优势。

definitions.definition: To label (items) with numbers; to assign numbers to (items).
definitions.example: Number the baskets so that we can find them easily.
definitions.definitionCn: 给（物品）标上数字；为（物品）分配编号。
definitions.exampleCn: 给篮子编号，这样我们就能轻松找到它们。

definitions.definition: To total or count; to amount to.
definitions.example: I don’t know how many books are in the library, but they must number in the thousands.
definitions.definitionCn: 总计或计数；达到某个数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不知道图书馆里有多少本书，但它们肯定数以千计。

definitions.definition: Physically unable to feel, not having the power of sensation.
definitions.example: fingers numb with cold

definitions.definition: Emotionally unable to feel or respond in a normal way.
definitions.example: numb with shock; numb with boredom

definitions.definition: Causing numbness.
The color/colour of snow or milk; the colour of light containing equal amounts of all visible wavelengths.
definitions.definitionCn: 雪或牛奶的颜色；包含所有可见波长等量光线的颜色。

definitions.definition: A person of European descent with light-coloured skin.
definitions.definitionCn: 浅色皮肤的欧洲裔白人。

definitions.definition: Any butterfly of the family Pieridae.
definitions.definitionCn: 粉蝶科的任何蝴蝶。

definitions.definition: White wine.
definitions.definitionCn: 白葡萄酒。

definitions.definition: Any object or substance that is of the color white.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何呈白色的物体或物质。

definitions.definition: The central part of the butt, which was formerly painted white; the centre of a mark at which a missile is shot.
definitions.definitionCn: 靶心中央部分，旧时涂成白色；射击标靶的中心点。

definitions.definition: The enclosed part of a letter of the alphabet, especially when handwritten.
definitions.definitionCn: 字母的封闭部分，尤指手写体。

definitions.definition: To make white; to whiten; to bleach.
definitions.definitionCn: 使变白；漂白；增白。

definitions.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.
definitions.example: Write in black ink on white paper.
definitions.definitionCn: 明亮无色的；反射所有可见光频率等量。
definitions.exampleCn: 用黑墨水在白纸上书写。

definitions.definition: (sometimes capitalized) Of or relating to Caucasians, people of European descent with light-coloured skin.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时大写）与高加索人种相关的，即浅色皮肤的欧洲裔。

definitions.definition: Designated for use by Caucasians.
definitions.example: white drinking fountain
definitions.definitionCn: 指定供白人使用的。
definitions.exampleCn: 白人饮水器。

definitions.definition: Relatively light or pale in colour.
definitions.example: white birch
definitions.definitionCn: 颜色相对浅淡或苍白。
definitions.exampleCn: 白桦树。

definitions.definition: Pale or pallid, as from fear, illness, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 因恐惧、疾病等而面色苍白或惨白。

definitions.definition: (of a person or skin) Lacking coloration (tan) from ultraviolet light; not tanned.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人或皮肤）缺乏紫外线照射形成的肤色；未晒黑的。

definitions.definition: (of coffee or tea) Containing cream, milk, or creamer.
definitions.definitionCn: （指咖啡或茶）含奶油、牛奶或奶精的。

definitions.definition: The standard denomination of the playing pieces of a board game deemed to belong to the white set, no matter what the actual colour.
definitions.example: The white pieces in this set are in fact made of light green glass.
definitions.definitionCn: 棋盘游戏中属于白色一方的标准棋子颜色，无论实际颜色如何。
definitions.exampleCn: 这套白色棋子实际上是用浅绿色玻璃制成的。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to an ecclesiastical order whose adherents dress in white habits; Cistercian.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于穿白色修士服的教会教团的；西多会修士的。

definitions.definition: Honourable, fair; decent.
definitions.definitionCn: 可敬的；公正的；体面的。

definitions.definition: Grey, as from old age; having silvery hair; hoary.
definitions.definitionCn: 因年老而灰白的；银发的；苍白的。

definitions.definition: Characterized by freedom from that which disturbs, and the like; fortunate; happy; favourable.
definitions.definitionCn: 以不受干扰等为特征的；幸运的；快乐的；有利的。

definitions.definition: Regarded with especial favour; favourite; darling.
definitions.definitionCn: 受到特别偏爱的；宠爱的；亲爱的。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to constitutional or anti-revolutionary political parties or movements.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于宪政或反革命的政党或运动的。

definitions.definition: (of tea) Made from immature leaves and shoots.
definitions.definitionCn: （指茶）用未成熟叶芽制成的。

definitions.definition: Not containing characters; see white space.
definitions.definitionCn: 不含字符的；参见空白区域。

definitions.definition: Said of a symbol or character outline, not solid, not filled with color. Compare black.
definitions.definitionCn: 指符号或字符轮廓，非实心，未填充颜色。与黑色相对。

definitions.definition: Characterised by the presence of snow.
definitions.example: a white Christmas
definitions.definitionCn: 以雪为特征的。
definitions.exampleCn: 白色圣诞节。

definitions.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.
definitions.example: In unary and k-adic notation in general, zero is the empty string.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表基数零的数字符号。
definitions.exampleCn: 在一元和k元记数法中，零是空字符串。

definitions.definition: The digit 0 in the decimal, binary, and all other base numbering systems.
definitions.example: One million has six zeroes.
definitions.definitionCn: 十进制、二进制及所有其他进制中的数字0。
definitions.exampleCn: 一百万有六个零。

definitions.definition: Nothing, or none.
definitions.example: He knows zero about humour.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有，或全无。
definitions.exampleCn: 他对幽默一窍不通。

definitions.definition: The value of a magnitude corresponding to the cardinal number zero.
definitions.example: The electromagnetic field does not drop all of the way to zero before a reversal.
definitions.definitionCn: 与基数零对应的量值。
definitions.exampleCn: 电磁场在反转前不会完全降至零。

definitions.definition: The point on a scale at which numbering or measurement originates.
definitions.example: The temperature outside is ten degrees below zero.
definitions.definitionCn: 刻度上编号或测量起始的点。
definitions.exampleCn: 室外温度是零下十度。

definitions.definition: A value of the independent variables of a function, for which the function is equal to zero.
definitions.example: The derivative of a continuous, differentiable function that twice crosses the axis must have a zero.
definitions.definitionCn: 函数自变量取某值时函数值为零。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个连续可微函数两次穿过坐标轴，其导数必有一个零点。

definitions.definition: The additive identity element of a monoid or greater algebraic structure, particularly a group or ring.
definitions.example: Since a commutative zero is the inverse of any additive identity, it must be unique when it exists.
definitions.definitionCn: 幺半群或更大代数结构（特别是群或环）中的加法单位元。
definitions.exampleCn: 由于交换零是任何加法单位元的逆元，它存在时必唯一。

definitions.definition: A person of little or no importance.
definitions.example: They rudely treated him like a zero.
definitions.definitionCn: 无足轻重的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们粗鲁地把他当零看待。

definitions.definition: A Mitsubishi A6M Zero, a long range fighter aircraft operated by the Japanese Navy Air Service from 1940 to 1945.
definitions.definitionCn: 三菱A6M零式战斗机，日本海军航空队1940年至1945年使用的远程战斗机。

definitions.definition: A setting of calibrated instruments such as a firearm.
definitions.definitionCn: 校准仪器（如火器）的设定。

definitions.definition: A security which has a zero coupon (paying no periodic interest).
definitions.example: The takeovers were financed by issuing zeroes.
definitions.definitionCn: 零息债券（不支付定期利息）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些收购通过发行零息债券融资。

definitions.definition: To set a measuring instrument to zero; to calibrate instrument scale to valid zero.
definitions.example: Zero the fluorometer with the same solvent used in extraction.
definitions.definitionCn: 将测量仪器归零；将仪器刻度校准至有效零值。
definitions.exampleCn: 用提取所用的同种溶剂将荧光计调零。

definitions.definition: To change a memory location or range to values of zero; to set a variable in a computer program to zero.
definitions.example: Results were inconsistent because an array wasn’t zeroed during initialization.
definitions.definitionCn: 将内存位置或范围的值设为零；将计算机程序中的变量设为零。
definitions.exampleCn: 结果不一致，因为初始化时数组未归零。

definitions.definition: To cause or set some value or amount to be zero.
definitions.example: They tried to zero the budget by the end of the quarter.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某个值或数量变为零。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们试图在季度末将预算归零。

definitions.definition: To eliminate; to delete; to overwrite with zeros.
definitions.definitionCn: 消除；删除；用零覆盖。

definitions.definition: To disappear
definitions.definitionCn: 消失。

definitions.definition: No, not any
definitions.example: She showed zero respect.
definitions.definitionCn: 不，没有任何。
definitions.exampleCn: 她表现出零尊重。

definitions.definition: Of a cloud ceiling, limiting vision to 50 feet (15 meters) or less.
definitions.definitionCn: 云层高度限制能见度在50英尺（15米）或以下。

definitions.definition: Of horizontal visibility, limited to 165 feet (50.3 meters) or less.
definitions.definitionCn: 水平能见度限制在165英尺（50.3米）或以下。

definitions.definition: Present at an abstract level, but not realized in the surface form.
definitions.example: The stem of "kobieta" with the zero ending is "kobiet".
definitions.definitionCn: 存在于抽象层面，但未在表面形式中实现。
definitions.exampleCn: "kobieta"的词干加零结尾是"kobiet"。

definitions.definition: The cardinal number occurring before one and that denotes no quantity or amount at all, represented in Arabic numerals as 0.
definitions.example: A cheque for zero dollars and zero cents crashed the computers on division by zero.
definitions.definitionCn: 出现在一之前且表示完全没有数量或数值的基数，阿拉伯数字写作0。
definitions.exampleCn: 一张零美元零美分的支票因除以零导致计算机崩溃。

definitions.definition: The digit or figure 1.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字或图形1。

definitions.definition: The neutral element with respect to multiplication in a ring.
definitions.definitionCn: 环中关于乘法的单位元。

definitions.definition: A one-dollar bill.
definitions.definitionCn: 一张一美元纸币。

definitions.definition: One run scored by hitting the ball and running between the wickets; a single.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球并跑动得分的一分；一分打。

definitions.definition: A joke or amusing anecdote.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个笑话或趣闻。

definitions.definition: A particularly special or compatible person or thing.
definitions.example: I knew as soon I met him that John was the one for me and we were married within a month.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个特别合适或相容的人或事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我一见到约翰就知道他是我的真命天子，我们一个月内就结婚了。

definitions.definition: (leet) Used instead of ! to amplify an exclamation, parodying unskilled typists who forget to press the shift key while typing exclamation points, thus typing "1".
definitions.example: 2003 September 26, "DEAL WITH IT!!!!11one!!", in alt.games.video.nintendo.gamecube, Usenet
definitions.definitionCn: （黑客语）用于代替感叹号以加强语气，模仿不熟练的打字员忘记按Shift键而打出"1"。
definitions.exampleCn: 2003年9月26日，“搞定它!!!!11one!!”，在alt.games.video.nintendo.gamecube新闻组中。

definitions.definition: To cause to become one; to gather into a single whole; to unite.
definitions.definitionCn: 使成为一体；聚集成一个整体；联合。

definitions.definition: Of a period of time, being particular.
definitions.example: One day the prince set forth to kill the dragon that had brought terror to his father’s kingdom for centuries.
definitions.definitionCn: 指一段时间，特定的。
definitions.exampleCn: 有一天，王子出发去杀死那条几个世纪以来一直给父王国度带来恐怖的恶龙。

definitions.definition: Being a single, unspecified thing; a; any.
definitions.example: My aunt used to say, "One day is just like the other."
definitions.definitionCn: 一个单一的、未指定的事物；一个；任何。
definitions.exampleCn: 我姑妈常说：“一天和另一天没什么两样。”

definitions.definition: Sole, only.
definitions.example: He is the one man who can help you.
definitions.definitionCn: 唯一的，仅有的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是唯一能帮助你的人。

definitions.definition: Whole, entire.
definitions.example: Body and soul are not separate; they are one.
definitions.definitionCn: 整个的，全部的。
definitions.exampleCn: 身体和灵魂不是分离的；它们是一体的。

definitions.definition: In agreement.
definitions.example: We are one on the importance of learning.
definitions.definitionCn: 意见一致。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在学习的重要性上意见一致。

definitions.definition: The same.
definitions.example: The two types look very different, but are one species.
definitions.definitionCn: 相同的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这两种类型看起来非常不同，但却是同一个物种。

definitions.definition: Being a preeminent example.
definitions.example: He is one hell of a guy.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为杰出的典范。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是个了不起的家伙。

definitions.definition: Being an unknown person with the specified name; see also "a certain".
definitions.example: The town records from 1843 showed the overnight incarceration of one “A. Lincoln”.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个名字未知的人，参见“某个”。
definitions.exampleCn: 1843年的镇记录显示，一个叫“A.林肯”的人被关押了一夜。

definitions.definition: The number represented by the Arabic numeral 1; the numerical value equal to that cardinal number.
definitions.example: In many cultures, a baby turns one year old a year after its birth.
definitions.definitionCn: 阿拉伯数字1所代表的数字；等于该基数的数值。
definitions.exampleCn: 在许多文化中，婴儿出生一年后满一岁。

definitions.definition: The first positive number in the set of natural numbers.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然数集合中的第一个正数。

definitions.definition: The cardinality of the smallest nonempty set.
definitions.definitionCn: 最小非空集合的基数。

definitions.definition: The ordinality of an element which has no predecessor, usually called first or number one.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有前驱元素的序数，通常称为第一或一号。

definitions.definition: (impersonal pronoun, indefinite) One thing (among a group of others); one member of a group.
definitions.example: Any one of the boys.  The big one looks good.  I want the green one.  A good driver is one who drives carefully.
definitions.definitionCn: （非人称代词，不定）一组中的一件事物；一组中的一个成员。
definitions.exampleCn: 男孩中的任何一个。大的那个看起来不错。我要绿色的那个。好司机是开车小心的人。

definitions.definition: (impersonal pronoun, sometimes with "the") The first mentioned of two things or people, as opposed to the other.
definitions.example: She offered him an apple and an orange; he took one and left the other.
definitions.definitionCn: （非人称代词，有时与“the”连用）两个事物或人中首先提到的那个，与另一个相对。
definitions.exampleCn: 她给了他一个苹果和一个橙子；他拿了一个，留下了另一个。

definitions.definition: (indefinite personal pronoun) Any person (applying to people in general).
definitions.example: One’s guilt may trouble one, but it is best not to let oneself be troubled by things which cannot be changed.  One shouldn’t be too quick to judge.
definitions.definitionCn: （不定人称代词）任何人（适用于一般人群）。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个人的内疚可能会困扰他，但最好不要让无法改变的事情困扰自己。一个人不应过于仓促地评判。

definitions.definition: (pronoun) Any person, entity or thing.
definitions.example: "driver", noun: one who drives.
definitions.definitionCn: （代词）任何人、实体或事物。
definitions.exampleCn: “司机”，名词：开车的人。

definitions.definition: The colour/color perceived in the absence of light, but also when no light is reflected, but rather absorbed.
definitions.definitionCn: 在无光时感知到的颜色，也指光线未被反射而是被吸收时呈现的颜色。

definitions.definition: A black dye or pigment.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种黑色染料或颜料。

definitions.definition: A pen, pencil, crayon, etc., made of black pigment.
definitions.definitionCn: 由黑色颜料制成的笔、铅笔、蜡笔等。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Black cloth hung up at funerals.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）葬礼上悬挂的黑布。

definitions.definition: (sometimes capitalised) A person of African, Aborigine, or Maori descent; a dark-skinned person.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时大写）非洲裔、原住民或毛利人后裔；深色皮肤的人。

definitions.definition: Blackness, the condition of having dark skin.
definitions.definitionCn: 黑皮肤的状态。

definitions.definition: The black ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 黑球。

definitions.definition: The edge of home plate.
definitions.definitionCn: 本垒板的边缘。

definitions.definition: A type of firecracker that is really more dark brown in colour.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种实际呈深棕色的鞭炮。

definitions.definition: Blackcurrant syrup (in mixed drinks, e.g. snakebite and black, cider and black).
definitions.definitionCn: 黑加仑糖浆（用于混合饮料，如蛇咬加黑、苹果酒加黑）。

definitions.definition: (in chess and similar games) The person playing with the black set of pieces.
definitions.example: At this point black makes a disastrous move.
definitions.definitionCn: （国际象棋及类似游戏中）执黑棋的一方。
definitions.exampleCn: 此时黑方走出了一步灾难性的棋。

definitions.definition: Something, or a part of a thing, which is black.
definitions.definitionCn: 黑色的事物或某物的黑色部分。

definitions.definition: A stain; a spot.
definitions.definitionCn: 污渍；斑点。

definitions.definition: A dark smut fungus, harmful to wheat.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种危害小麦的黑色真菌。

definitions.definition: Marijuana.
definitions.definitionCn: 大麻。

definitions.definition: To make black; to blacken.
definitions.definitionCn: 使变黑；涂黑。

definitions.definition: To apply blacking to (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 给（某物）涂上黑色涂料。

definitions.definition: To boycott, usually as part of an industrial dispute.
definitions.definitionCn: 抵制，通常作为劳资纠纷的一部分。

definitions.definition: (of an object) Absorbing all light and reflecting none; dark and hueless.
definitions.definitionCn: （物体）吸收所有光线且不反射；黑暗且无色。

definitions.definition: (of a place, etc) Without light.
definitions.definitionCn: （地方等）无光的。

definitions.definition: (sometimes capitalized) Of or relating to any of various ethnic groups having dark pigmentation of the skin.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时大写）与任何深色皮肤族群相关的。

definitions.definition: Designated for use by those ethnic groups which have dark pigmentation of the skin.
definitions.example: black drinking fountain; black hospital
definitions.definitionCn: 指定供深色皮肤族群使用的。
