definitions.definition: A performer or performers in a show.
definitions.example: Which act did you prefer? The soloist or the band?
definitions.definitionCn: 演出中的表演者或表演团体。
definitions.exampleCn: 你更喜欢哪个表演？独奏者还是乐队？

definitions.definition: Any organized activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何有组织的活动。

definitions.definition: A display of behaviour.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种行为表现。

definitions.definition: A thesis maintained in public, in some English universities, by a candidate for a degree, or to show the proficiency of a student.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某些英国大学中，学位候选人公开维护的论点，或展示学生能力。

definitions.definition: A display of behaviour meant to deceive.
definitions.example: to put on an act
definitions.definitionCn: 意在欺骗的行为表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 装模作样。

definitions.definition: To do something.
definitions.example: If you don't act soon, you will be in trouble.
definitions.definitionCn: 采取行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你不尽快行动，就会有麻烦。

definitions.definition: To do (something); to perform.
definitions.definitionCn: 做（某事）；执行。

definitions.definition: To perform a theatrical role.
definitions.example: I started acting at the age of eleven in my local theatre.
definitions.definitionCn: 扮演戏剧角色。
definitions.exampleCn: 我十一岁时开始在本地剧院表演。

definitions.definition: Of a play: to be acted out (well or badly).
definitions.definitionCn: 关于戏剧：被（好或坏地）演绎。

definitions.definition: To behave in a certain manner for an indefinite length of time.
definitions.example: A dog which acts aggressively is likely to bite.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式行为一段时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 具有攻击性的狗可能会咬人。

definitions.definition: To convey an appearance of being.
definitions.example: He acted unconcerned so the others wouldn't worry.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出某种样子。
definitions.exampleCn: 他装作若无其事，以免他人担心。

definitions.definition: To do something that causes a change binding on the doer.
definitions.example: act on behalf of John
definitions.definitionCn: 做导致对行为者产生约束性改变的事。
definitions.exampleCn: 代表约翰行事。

definitions.definition: (construed with on or upon) To have an effect (on).
definitions.example: Gravitational force acts on heavy bodies.
definitions.definitionCn: （与on或upon连用）对……产生影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 重力作用于重物。

definitions.definition: To play (a role).
definitions.example: He's been acting Shakespearean leads since he was twelve.
definitions.definitionCn: 扮演（角色）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他十二岁起就一直在演莎士比亚剧的主角。

definitions.definition: To feign.
definitions.example: He acted the angry parent, but was secretly amused.
definitions.definitionCn: 假装。
definitions.exampleCn: 他假装生气的家长，但暗地里觉得好笑。

definitions.definition: (construed with on or upon, of a group) To map via a homomorphism to a group of automorphisms (of).
definitions.example: This group acts on the circle, so it can't be left-orderable!
definitions.definitionCn: （与on或upon连用，指群体）通过同态映射到自同构群（的）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个群作用于圆，因此它不能是左序的！

definitions.definition: To move to action; to actuate; to animate.
definitions.definitionCn: 促使行动；激励；赋予活力。

definitions.definition: Heaven.
definitions.definitionCn: 天堂。

definitions.definition: Something, especially a person's name in legal documents, that appears higher on the same page or on a preceding page.
definitions.definitionCn: 法律文件中，尤指人名，出现在同一页或前一页较高位置的内容。

definitions.definition: Higher authority.
definitions.definitionCn: 更高权威。

definitions.definition: Betterment, raised status or condition.
definitions.definitionCn: 改善，提升的地位或状况。

definitions.definition: Of heaven; heavenly.
definitions.definitionCn: 天堂的；神圣的。

definitions.definition: (by ellipsis) Being located higher on the same page or on a preceding page.
definitions.definitionCn: （省略用法）位于同一页或前一页较高位置。

definitions.definition: Directly overhead; vertically on top of.
definitions.definitionCn: 正上方；垂直在上。

definitions.definition: Higher in the same page; earlier in the order as far as writing products go.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一页中更靠前；按书写顺序更早出现。

definitions.definition: Into or from heaven; in the sky.
definitions.example: He's in a better place now, floating free as the clouds above.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入天堂或来自天堂；在空中。
definitions.exampleCn: 他现在身处更好的地方，如天上云朵般自由飘浮。

definitions.definition: In a higher place; upstairs; farther upstream.
definitions.definitionCn: 在更高处；楼上；更上游。

definitions.definition: Higher in rank, power, or position.
definitions.example: He appealed to the court above.
definitions.definitionCn: 在等级、权力或地位上更高。
definitions.exampleCn: 他向上一级法院上诉。

definitions.definition: In addition.
definitions.definitionCn: 此外。

definitions.definition: More in number.
definitions.definitionCn: 数量更多。

definitions.definition: Above zero; above freezing.
definitions.example: It was a cold day at only 5 above.
definitions.definitionCn: 零度以上；冰点以上。
definitions.exampleCn: 那天很冷，只有零上5度。

definitions.definition: On the upper half or the dorsal surface of an animal.
definitions.example: The sparrow I saw was rufous above and off-white below.
definitions.definitionCn: 在动物的上半部或背面。
definitions.exampleCn: 我看到的麻雀背部红褐色，腹部灰白色。

definitions.definition: Physically over; on top of; worn on top of, said of clothing.
definitions.example: He always put his coat on above his sweater.
definitions.definitionCn: 物理上在……之上；在……顶部；穿在……外面，指衣物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他总是把外套穿在毛衣外面。

definitions.definition: In or to a higher place; higher than; on or over the upper surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 在更高处；高于；在……上面或表面。

definitions.definition: Farther north than.
definitions.example: Idaho is above Utah.
definitions.definitionCn: 比……更靠北。
definitions.exampleCn: 爱达荷州在犹他州以北。

definitions.definition: Rising; appearing out of reach height-wise.
definitions.definitionCn: 上升；出现在难以触及的高度。

definitions.definition: Higher than; superior to in any respect; surpassing; higher in measure, degree, volume, or pitch, etc. than; out of reach; not exposed to; not likely to be affected by; incapable of negative actions or thoughts.
definitions.example: Even the chief of police is not above suspicion.
definitions.definitionCn: 比……更高；在任何方面优于；超越；在度量、程度、音量或音高等上超过；无法触及；不受……影响；不可能有负面行为或想法。
definitions.exampleCn: 即使是警察局长也并非无可怀疑。

definitions.definition: Higher in rank, status, or position.
definitions.example: to stand head and shoulders above the rest
definitions.definitionCn: 在等级、地位或职位上更高。
definitions.exampleCn: 鹤立鸡群

definitions.definition: In addition to; besides.
definitions.example: above and beyond the call of duty
definitions.definitionCn: 除……之外；此外。
definitions.exampleCn: 超越职责要求

definitions.definition: Surpassing in number or quantity; more than.
definitions.example: That amount is way above our asking price.
definitions.definitionCn: 在数量上超过；多于。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个金额远高于我们的要价。

definitions.definition: In preference to.
definitions.definitionCn: 优先于……。

definitions.definition: Too proud to stoop to; averse to; disinclined towards;
definitions.example: The owner was above taking more than a token salary.
definitions.definitionCn: 过于骄傲而不愿屈就；反感；不倾向于。
definitions.exampleCn: 老板只愿象征性地领取薪水。

definitions.definition: Beyond; on the other side.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……之外；在另一边。

definitions.definition: Upstage of.
definitions.definitionCn: 在舞台后部。

definitions.definition: A device for taking still or moving pictures or photographs.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于拍摄静态或动态图像或照片的设备。

definitions.definition: The viewpoint in a three-dimensional game or simulation.
definitions.definitionCn: 三维游戏或模拟中的视角。

definitions.definition: A vaulted room.
definitions.definitionCn: 拱形房间。

definitions.definition: The judge's private chamber, where cases may be heard in camera.
definitions.definitionCn: 法官的私人房间，案件可在此进行非公开审理。

definitions.definition: Taking care; attentive to potential danger, error or harm; cautious.
definitions.example: He was a slow and careful driver.
definitions.definitionCn: 小心的；注意潜在危险、错误或伤害的；谨慎的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他开车又慢又小心。

definitions.definition: Conscientious and painstaking; meticulous.
definitions.example: They made a careful search of the crime scene.
definitions.definitionCn: 认真细致的；一丝不苟的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们对犯罪现场进行了仔细搜查。

definitions.definition: Full of care or grief; sorrowful, sad.
definitions.definitionCn: 充满忧虑或悲伤的；悲伤的，难过的。

definitions.definition: Full of cares or anxiety; worried, troubled.
definitions.definitionCn: 充满担忧或焦虑的；烦恼的，不安的。

definitions.definition: Able and efficient; having the ability needed for a specific task; having the disposition to do something; permitting or being susceptible to something.
definitions.example: As everyone knew, he was capable of violence when roused.
definitions.definitionCn: 能干且高效；具备完成特定任务所需的能力；有意愿做某事；容许或易受某事影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 众所周知，他在被激怒时会表现出暴力倾向。

definitions.definition: Of sufficient capacity or size for holding, containing, receiving or taking in; accessible to. Construed with of, for or an infinitive.
definitions.definitionCn: 容量或尺寸足以容纳、包含、接收或吸收；可进入的。与of、for或不定式连用。

definitions.definition: A series of operations undertaken to achieve a set goal.
definitions.example: The company is targeting children in their latest advertising campaign.
definitions.definitionCn: 为实现既定目标而采取的一系列行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 该公司在最新的广告活动中将目标锁定为儿童。

definitions.definition: The period during which a blast furnace is continuously in operation.
definitions.definitionCn: 高炉连续运行的时间段。

definitions.definition: An open field; a large, open plain without considerable hills; a champaign.
definitions.definitionCn: 开阔的田野；没有显著山丘的大片平原；原野。

definitions.definition: An excursion into the countryside.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次乡村远足。

definitions.definition: To take part in a campaign.
definitions.example: She campaigned for better social security.
definitions.definitionCn: 参加一项活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 她为改善社会保障而奔走。

definitions.definition: Consistently ride in races for a racing season.
definitions.definitionCn: 在赛马赛季中持续参赛。

definitions.definition: One's calling in life; a person's occupation; one's profession.
definitions.definitionCn: 人生的使命；职业；专业。

definitions.definition: General course of action or conduct in life, or in a particular part of it.
definitions.example: Washington's career as a soldier
definitions.definitionCn: 人生或其中特定阶段的一般行动或行为准则。
definitions.exampleCn: 华盛顿的军旅生涯。

definitions.definition: Speed.
definitions.definitionCn: 速度。

definitions.definition: A jouster's path during a joust.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑士比武中的行进路线。

definitions.definition: A short gallop of a horse.
definitions.definitionCn: 马的短距离疾驰。

definitions.definition: The flight of a hawk.
definitions.definitionCn: 鹰的飞行。

definitions.definition: A racecourse; the ground run over.
definitions.definitionCn: 赛马场；跑过的地面。

definitions.definition: To move rapidly straight ahead, especially in an uncontrolled way.
definitions.example: The car careered down the road, missed the curve, and went through a hedge.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速直线移动，尤指失控地。
definitions.exampleCn: 那辆车失控地冲下道路，错过弯道，穿过了树篱。

definitions.definition: An act of capturing; a seizing by force or stratagem.
definitions.definitionCn: 捕获的行为；通过武力或计谋夺取。

definitions.definition: The securing of an object of strife or desire, as by the power of some attraction.
definitions.example: the capture of a lover's heart
definitions.definitionCn: 通过某种吸引力获得争斗或渴望的对象。
definitions.exampleCn: 俘获爱人的心

definitions.definition: Something that has been captured; a captive.
definitions.definitionCn: 被捕获的事物；俘虏。

definitions.definition: The recording or storage of something for later playback.
definitions.example: video capture
definitions.definitionCn: 为日后回放而进行的记录或存储。
definitions.exampleCn: 视频捕获

definitions.definition: A particular match found for a pattern in a text string.
definitions.definitionCn: 文本字符串中与模式匹配的特定结果。

definitions.definition: To take control of; to seize by force or stratagem.
definitions.example: to capture an enemy, a vessel, or a criminal
definitions.definitionCn: 控制；通过武力或计谋夺取。
definitions.exampleCn: 捕获敌人、船只或罪犯

definitions.definition: To store (as in sounds or image) for later revisitation.
definitions.example: She captured the details of the fresco in a series of photographs.
definitions.definitionCn: 存储（如声音或图像）以备日后重温。
definitions.exampleCn: 她通过一系列照片捕捉了壁画的细节。

definitions.definition: To reproduce convincingly.
definitions.example: His film adaptation captured the spirit of the original work.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人信服地再现。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的电影改编捕捉到了原作的精髓。

definitions.definition: To remove or take control of an opponent’s piece in a game (e.g., chess, go, checkers).
definitions.example: He captured his opponent’s queen on the 15th move.
definitions.definitionCn: 在游戏（如国际象棋、围棋、跳棋）中移除或控制对手的棋子。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在第15步吃掉了对手的王后。

definitions.definition: (in a person) The state of being calm; peacefulness; absence of worry, anger, fear or other strong negative emotion.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）平静的状态；安宁；无担忧、愤怒、恐惧或其他强烈负面情绪。

definitions.definition: (in a place or situation) The state of being calm; absence of noise and disturbance.
definitions.definitionCn: （指地点或情境）平静的状态；无噪音和干扰。

definitions.definition: A period of time without wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 无风的一段时间。

definitions.definition: To make calm.
definitions.example: to calm a crying baby
definitions.definitionCn: 使平静。
definitions.exampleCn: 安抚哭泣的婴儿。

definitions.definition: To become calm.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得平静。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Peaceful, quiet, especially free from anger and anxiety.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）平和、安静，尤指无愤怒和焦虑。

definitions.definition: (of a place or situation) Free of noise and disturbance.
definitions.definitionCn: （指地点或情境）无噪音和干扰。

definitions.definition: (of water) with few or no waves on the surface; not rippled.
definitions.definitionCn: （指水面）几乎没有波浪；无涟漪。

definitions.definition: Without wind or storm.
definitions.definitionCn: 无风或无风暴。

definitions.definition: Already-produced durable goods available for use as a factor of production, such as steam shovels (equipment) and office buildings (structures).
definitions.definitionCn: 已生产的耐用品，可作为生产要素使用，例如蒸汽挖掘机（设备）和办公楼（建筑）。

definitions.definition: Money and wealth. The means to acquire goods and services, especially in a non-barter system.
definitions.example: He does not have enough capital to start a business.
definitions.definitionCn: 货币与财富。获取商品和服务的手段，尤其在非易货体系中。
definitions.exampleCn: 他没有足够的资本来创业。

definitions.definition: A city designated as a legislative seat by the government or some other authority, often the city in which the government is located; otherwise the most important city within a country or a subdivision of it.
definitions.example: The Welsh government claims that Cardiff is Europe’s youngest capital.
definitions.definitionCn: 由政府或其他权威机构指定为立法所在地的城市，通常是政府所在城市；否则是一个国家或其下属区域中最重要的城市。
definitions.exampleCn: 威尔士政府声称加的夫是欧洲最年轻的首都。

definitions.definition: The most important city in the field specified.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定领域内最重要的城市。

definitions.definition: An uppercase letter.
definitions.definitionCn: 大写字母。

definitions.definition: The uppermost part of a column.
definitions.definitionCn: 柱子的顶端部分。

definitions.definition: Knowledge; awareness; proficiency.
definitions.example: Interpreters need a good amount of cultural capital in order to function efficiently in the profession.
definitions.definitionCn: 知识；意识；熟练度。
definitions.exampleCn: 口译员需要具备丰富的文化资本才能高效从事这一职业。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The chief or most important thing.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）首要或最重要的事物。

definitions.definition: Of prime importance.
definitions.definitionCn: 至关重要的。

definitions.definition: Chief, in a political sense, as being the seat of the general government of a state or nation.
definitions.example: London and Paris are capital cities.
definitions.definitionCn: 在政治意义上，作为国家或州政府所在地的首席城市。
definitions.exampleCn: 伦敦和巴黎是首都城市。

definitions.definition: Excellent.
definitions.example: That is a capital idea!
definitions.definitionCn: 极好的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是个绝妙的主意！

definitions.definition: Involving punishment by death.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及死刑的惩罚。

definitions.definition: Uppercase.
definitions.example: One begins a sentence with a capital letter.
definitions.definitionCn: 大写的。
definitions.exampleCn: 句子开头要用大写字母。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to the head.
definitions.definitionCn: 与头部相关的。

definitions.definition: A cancellation (US); (nonstandard in some kinds of English).
definitions.definitionCn: 取消（美国用法；在某些英语中为非标准用法）。

definitions.definition: An enclosure; a boundary; a limit.
definitions.definitionCn: 围栏；边界；限制。

definitions.definition: The suppression on striking out of matter in type, or of a printed page or pages.
definitions.definitionCn: 删除排版中的内容或印刷页面的行为。

definitions.definition: The page thus suppressed.
definitions.definitionCn: 被删除的页面。

definitions.definition: The page that replaces it.
definitions.definitionCn: 替换它的页面。

definitions.definition: To cross out something with lines etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 用线条等划掉某物。

definitions.definition: To invalidate or annul something.
definitions.example: He cancelled his order on their website.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某物无效或废止。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在他们的网站上取消了订单。

definitions.definition: To mark something (such as a used postage stamp) so that it can't be reused.
definitions.example: This machine cancels the letters that have a valid zip code.
definitions.definitionCn: 标记某物（如用过的邮票）使其无法重复使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 这台机器取消具有有效邮政编码的信件。

definitions.definition: To offset or equalize something.
definitions.example: The corrective feedback mechanism cancels out the noise.
definitions.definitionCn: 抵消或平衡某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 纠正性反馈机制消除了噪音。

definitions.definition: To remove a common factor from both the numerator and denominator of a fraction, or from both sides of an equation.
definitions.definitionCn: 从分数的分子和分母中，或从方程的两边移除公因子。

definitions.definition: To stop production of a programme.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止制作某个节目。

definitions.definition: To suppress or omit; to strike out, as matter in type.
definitions.definitionCn: 抑制或省略；删除，如排版中的内容。

definitions.definition: To shut out, as with a railing or with latticework; to exclude.
definitions.definitionCn: 用栏杆或格子结构隔开；排除。

definitions.definition: To kill.
definitions.definitionCn: 杀死。

definitions.definition: To cease to provide financial or moral support to (someone deemed unacceptable). Compare cancel culture.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止向（被认为不可接受的人）提供财务或道德支持。比较“取消文化”。

definitions.definition: A specific commercial enterprise or establishment.
definitions.example: I was left my father's business.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个特定的商业企业或机构。
definitions.exampleCn: 我继承了父亲的生意。

definitions.definition: A person's occupation, work, or trade.
definitions.example: He is in the motor and insurance businesses.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人的职业、工作或行业。
definitions.exampleCn: 他从事汽车和保险行业。

definitions.definition: Commercial, industrial, or professional activity.
definitions.example: He's such a poor cook, I can't believe he's still in business!
definitions.definitionCn: 商业、工业或专业活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他厨艺太差，真不敢相信他还在做生意！

definitions.definition: The volume or amount of commercial trade.
definitions.example: Business has been slow lately.
definitions.definitionCn: 商业贸易的规模或数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 最近生意清淡。

definitions.definition: One's dealings; patronage.
definitions.example: I shall take my business elsewhere.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的交易；光顾。
definitions.exampleCn: 我要去别处做生意。

definitions.definition: Private commercial interests taken collectively.
definitions.example: This proposal will satisfy both business and labor.
definitions.definitionCn: 私营商业利益的总称。
definitions.exampleCn: 这项提议将同时满足商界和劳工界。

definitions.definition: The management of commercial enterprises, or the study of such management.
definitions.example: I studied business at Harvard.
definitions.definitionCn: 商业企业的管理，或对此管理的研究。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在哈佛学习商业。

definitions.definition: A particular situation or activity.

definitions.exampleCn: 这UFO的事真是件怪事。

definitions.definition: Any activity or objective needing to be dealt with; especially, one of a financial or legal matter.
definitions.example: Let's get down to business.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何需要处理的活动或目标；尤指财务或法律事务。

definitions.definition: Something involving one personally.

definitions.definition: (parliamentary procedure) Matters that come before a body for deliberation or action.
definitions.example: If that concludes the announcements, we'll move on to new business.
definitions.definitionCn: （议会程序）提交给机构审议或行动的事项。

definitions.definition: (travel) Business class, the class of seating provided by airlines between first class and coach.
definitions.definitionCn: （旅行）商务舱，航空公司提供的介于头等舱和经济舱之间的座位等级。

definitions.definition: Action carried out with a prop or piece of clothing, usually away from the focus of the scene.
definitions.definitionCn: 用道具或衣物进行的动作，通常远离场景焦点。

definitions.definition: The collective noun for a group of ferrets.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群雪貂的集合名词。

definitions.definition: Something very good; top quality. (possibly from "the bee's knees")
definitions.example: These new phones are the business!
definitions.definitionCn: 非常好的东西；顶级品质（可能源自“蜜蜂的膝盖”）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些新手机太棒了！

definitions.definition: Excrement, particularly that of a non-human animal.
definitions.example: As the cart went by, its horse lifted its tail and did its business.
definitions.definitionCn: 排泄物，尤指非人类动物的粪便。
definitions.exampleCn: 马车经过时，马抬起尾巴拉了屎。

definitions.definition: Of, to, pertaining to or utilized for purposes of conducting trade, commerce, governance, advocacy or other professional purposes.
definitions.example: Please do not use this phone for personal calls; it is a business phone.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于、关于或用于进行贸易、商业、治理、倡导或其他专业目的的。
definitions.exampleCn: 请勿用这部电话打私人电话；这是商务电话。

definitions.definition: Professional, businesslike, having concern for good business practice.
definitions.definitionCn: 专业的、务实的，注重良好商业实践的。

definitions.definition: Supporting business, conducive to the conduct of business.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持商业的，有利于商业运作的。

definitions.definition: Being in the centre.
definitions.definitionCn: 位于中心。

definitions.definition: Having or containing the centre of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有或包含某物的中心。

definitions.definition: Being very important, or key to something.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常重要，或对某事至关重要。

definitions.definition: Exerting its action towards the peripheral organs.
definitions.definitionCn: 其作用指向外周器官。

definitions.definition: An opportunity or possibility.
definitions.example: We had the chance to meet the president last week.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个机会或可能性。
definitions.exampleCn: 上周我们有机会见到了总统。

definitions.definition: Random occurrence; luck.
definitions.example: Why leave it to chance when a few simple steps will secure the desired outcome?
definitions.definitionCn: 随机发生；运气。
definitions.exampleCn: 既然几个简单步骤就能确保理想结果，何必听凭运气？

definitions.definition: The probability of something happening.
definitions.example: There is a 30 percent chance of rain tomorrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事发生的概率。
definitions.exampleCn: 明天降雨概率为30%。

definitions.definition: What befalls or happens to a person; their lot or fate.
definitions.definitionCn: 降临在某人身上的事；命运或际遇。

definitions.definition: Happening by chance, casual.
definitions.definitionCn: 偶然发生的，随意的。

definitions.definition: Perchance; perhaps.
definitions.definitionCn: 或许；可能。

definitions.definition: To happen by chance, to occur.
definitions.example: It chanced that I found a solution the very next day.

definitions.definition: To befall; to happen to.
To try or risk.
definitions.example: Shall we carry the umbrella, or chance a rainstorm?

definitions.definition: To discover something by chance.
definitions.example: He chanced upon a kindly stranger who showed him the way.

definitions.definition: (Belize) To rob, cheat or swindle someone.
definitions.example: The car broke down a week after I bought it. I was chanced by that fast-talking salesman.

definitions.definition: (with "the") Something certain.
definitions.definitionCn: （与"the"连用）确定无疑的事物。

definitions.definition: Sure, positive, not doubting.
definitions.example: I was certain of my decision.
definitions.definitionCn: 确信的，肯定的，不怀疑的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我对自己的决定很确定。

definitions.definition: Determined; resolved.
definitions.definitionCn: 下定决心的；坚决的。

definitions.definition: Not to be doubted or denied; established as a fact.
definitions.definitionCn: 不容置疑或否认的；确凿的事实。

definitions.definition: Actually existing; sure to happen; inevitable.
definitions.example: Bankruptcy is the certain outcome of your constant gambling and lending.
definitions.definitionCn: 实际存在的；必然发生的；不可避免的。
definitions.exampleCn: 破产是你持续赌博和借贷的必然结果。

definitions.definition: Unfailing; infallible.
definitions.definitionCn: 万无一失的；绝对可靠的。

definitions.definition: I have often wished , that I knew so certain a remedy in any other disease
definitions.definitionCn: 我常希望，在其他疾病中也能知道如此可靠的治疗方法。

definitions.definition: Fixed or stated; regular; determinate.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定的或规定的；有规律的；确定的。

definitions.definition: Known but not specifically named; indeterminate; indefinite; one or some; sometimes used independently as a noun, and meaning certain persons; see also "one".
definitions.definitionCn: 已知但未具体指明的；不确定的；不定的；一个或某些；有时独立用作名词，指某些人；另见"one"。

definitions.definition: (with of) Unnamed or undescribed members (of).
definitions.example: There were serious objections to certain of the proposals.
definitions.definitionCn: （与of连用）未指名或未描述的（某些）成员。
definitions.exampleCn: 对某些提案存在严重反对意见。

definitions.definition: A period of 100 consecutive years; often specifically a numbered period with conventional start and end dates, e.g., the twentieth century, which stretches from (strictly) 1901 through 2000, or (informally) 1900 through 1999. The first century AD was from 1 to 100.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个连续的100年时期；通常指有特定起始和结束日期的编号时期，例如20世纪，严格来说从1901年持续到2000年，或非正式地从1900年持续到1999年。公元1世纪是从1年到100年。

definitions.definition: A unit in ancient Roman army, originally of 100 army soldiers as part of a cohort, later of more varied sizes (but typically containing 60 to 70 or 80) soldiers or other men (guards, police, firemen), commanded by a centurion.
definitions.definitionCn: 古罗马军队中的一个单位，最初由100名士兵组成，作为大队的一部分，后来规模多变（通常包含60到70或80名）士兵或其他人员（警卫、警察、消防员），由百夫长指挥。

definitions.definition: A political division of ancient Rome, meeting in the Centuriate Assembly.
definitions.definitionCn: 古罗马的一个政治分区，在百人团会议上集会。

definitions.definition: A hundred things of the same kind; a hundred.
definitions.definitionCn: 一百个同类事物；一百。

definitions.definition: A hundred runs scored either by a single player in one innings, or by two players in a partnership.
definitions.definitionCn: 一名球员在一局中或两名球员合作打出的一百分。

definitions.definition: A score of one hundred points.
definitions.example: That was his tenth professional century.
definitions.definitionCn: 一百分的得分。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是他职业生涯的第十个百分。

definitions.definition: A race a hundred units (as meters, kilometres, miles) in length.
definitions.definitionCn: 长度为一百个单位（如米、公里、英里）的赛跑。

definitions.definition: A banknote in the denomination of one hundred dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: 面值为一百美元的钞票。

definitions.definition: Trade; traffic; chaffer; chaffering.
definitions.definitionCn: 贸易；交易；讨价还价；议价。

definitions.definition: A market; marketplace.
definitions.definitionCn: 市场；集市。

definitions.definition: Price.
definitions.definitionCn: 价格。

definitions.definition: A low price; a bargain.
definitions.definitionCn: 低价；便宜货。

definitions.definition: Cheapness; lowness of price; abundance of supply.
definitions.definitionCn: 廉价；价格低廉；供应充足。

definitions.definition: To trade; traffic; bargain; chaffer; ask the price of goods; cheapen goods.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行贸易；交易；讨价还价；议价；询问商品价格；砍价。

definitions.definition: To bargain for; chaffer for; ask the price of; offer a price for; cheapen.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……讨价还价；为……议价；询问……的价格；出价购买；砍价。

definitions.definition: To buy; purchase.
definitions.definitionCn: 购买；采购。

definitions.definition: To sell.
definitions.definitionCn: 出售。

definitions.definition: Low and/or reduced in price.
definitions.definitionCn: 价格低廉和/或降价的。

definitions.definition: Of poor quality.
definitions.definitionCn: 质量差的。

definitions.definition: Of little worth.
definitions.definitionCn: 价值不高的。

definitions.definition: (of an action or tactic in a game of skill) Underhand or unfair.
definitions.example: the cheap trick of hiding deadly lava under pushable blocks
definitions.definitionCn: （在技巧游戏中，指动作或策略）不正当或不公平的。
definitions.exampleCn: 将致命熔岩藏在可推动方块下的卑鄙伎俩。

definitions.definition: Stingy; mean; excessively frugal.
definitions.example: Insurance is expensive, but don't be so cheap that you risk losing your home because of a fire.
definitions.definitionCn: 吝啬的；小气的；过度节俭的。
definitions.exampleCn: 保险很贵，但别因为吝啬而冒险因火灾失去家园。

definitions.definition: Trading at a price level which is low relative to historical trends, a similar asset, or (for derivatives) a theoretical value.
definitions.definitionCn: 以相对历史趋势、类似资产或（对于衍生品）理论价值较低的价格水平交易。

definitions.definition: Cheaply.
definitions.definitionCn: 廉价地。

definitions.definition: A situation in which the king is directly threatened by an opposing piece.
definitions.definitionCn: 国王被对方棋子直接威胁的局面。

definitions.definition: An inspection or examination.
definitions.example: I don't know if she will be there, but it's worth a check.
definitions.definitionCn: 检查或审视。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不知道她是否会在那里，但值得一试。

definitions.definition: A control; a limit or stop.
definitions.example: The castle moat should hold the enemy in check.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种控制；限制或阻止。
definitions.exampleCn: 城堡的护城河应该能牵制住敌人。

definitions.definition: A mark (especially a checkmark: ✓) used as an indicator.

definitions.definitionCn: 用作指示符的标记（尤其是对勾：✓）。
definitions.exampleCn: 在你已完成的事情旁打勾。

definitions.definition: An order to a bank to pay money to a named person or entity.
definitions.example: I was not carrying cash, so I wrote a check for the amount.
definitions.definitionCn: 向银行支付指定个人或实体款项的指令。
definitions.exampleCn: 我没带现金，所以开了一张等额支票。

definitions.definition: A bill, particularly in a restaurant.
definitions.example: I summoned the waiter, paid the check, and hurried to leave.
definitions.definitionCn: 账单，尤指餐厅账单。
definitions.exampleCn: 我叫来服务员，付了账单，匆匆离开。

definitions.definition: A maneuver performed by a player to take another player out of the play.

definitions.definitionCn: 球员为将另一名球员逐出比赛而做出的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 冰球队员用力一记阻截抢到了球。

definitions.definition: A token used instead of cash in gaming machines, or in gambling generally.
definitions.definitionCn: 在游戏机或赌博中代替现金使用的代币。

definitions.definition: A lengthwise separation through the growth rings in wood.
definitions.definitionCn: 木材中沿年轮纵向的裂缝。

definitions.definition: A mark, certificate or token by which errors may be prevented, or a thing or person may be identified.

definitions.definitionCn: 用于防止错误或识别事物或人员的标记、证书或凭证。

definitions.definition: The forsaking by a hawk of its proper game to follow other birds.
definitions.definitionCn: 猎鹰放弃正当猎物去追逐其他鸟类的行为。

definitions.definition: A small chink or crack.
definitions.definitionCn: 小裂缝或裂纹。

definitions.definition: To inspect; to examine.
definitions.example: Check the oil in your car once a month.

definitions.definition: To verify the accuracy of a text or translation, usually making some corrections (proofread) or many (copyedit).

(often used with "off") To mark items on a list (with a checkmark or by crossing them out) that have been chosen for keeping or removal or that have been dealt with (for example, completed or verified as correct or satisfactory).
definitions.example: Check off the items that you've checked (inspected).

definitions.definition: To control, limit, or halt.
definitions.example: Check your enthusiasm during a negotiation.

definitions.definition: To verify or compare with a source of information.
definitions.example: Check your data against known values.

definitions.definition: To leave in safekeeping.
definitions.example: Check your hat and coat at the door.

definitions.definition: To leave with a shipping agent for shipping.
definitions.example: Check your bags at the ticket counter before the flight.

definitions.definition: To pass or bounce the ball to an opponent from behind the three-point line and have the opponent pass or bounce it back to start play.
definitions.example: He checked the ball and then proceeded to perform a perfect layup.

definitions.definition: To disrupt another player with the stick or body to obtain possession of the ball or puck.
definitions.example: The hockey player checked the defenceman to obtain the puck.

definitions.definition: To remain in a hand without betting. Only legal if no one has yet bet.
definitions.example: Tom didn't think he could win, so he checked.

definitions.definition: To make a move which puts an adversary's king in check; to put in check.
To chide, rebuke, or reprove.
To slack or ease off, as a brace which is too stiffly extended.
To crack or gape open, as wood in drying; or to crack in small checks, as varnish, paint, etc.
To make checks or chinks in; to cause to crack.
definitions.example: The sun checks timber.

definitions.definition: To make a stop; to pause; with at.
To clash or interfere.
To act as a curb or restraint.
To turn, when in pursuit of proper game, and fly after other birds.
(usually pluralized) A pattern made up of a grid of squares of alternating colors; a checkered pattern.

definitions.definition: Any fabric woven with such a pattern.
To mark with a check pattern.
Divided into small squares by transverse, perpendicular, and horizontal lines.
A being involved in the action of a story.
definitions.definitionCn: 故事行动中的参与者。

definitions.definition: A distinguishing feature; characteristic; trait; phene.

definitions.definitionCn: 一种区分性特征；特性；特质；表型特征。
definitions.exampleCn: 在连锁群A2上检测到一个控制花瓣颜色的单一位点。

definitions.definition: A complex of traits marking a person, group, breed, or type.
definitions.example: A study of the suspect's character and his cast iron alibi ruled him out.
definitions.definitionCn: 标志个人、群体、品种或类型的一组复杂特征。
definitions.exampleCn: 对嫌疑人性格及其铁证如山的不可推翻证据的研究排除了他的嫌疑。

definitions.definition: Strength of mind; resolution; independence; individuality; moral strength.
definitions.example: "You may not like to eat liver," said Calvin's father, "but it builds character."
definitions.definitionCn: 意志力；决心；独立性；个性；道德力量。

definitions.definition: A unique or extraordinary individual; a person characterized by peculiar or notable traits, especially charisma.
definitions.example: Julius Caesar is a great historical character.
definitions.definitionCn: 独特或非凡的人；以奇特或显著特质（尤其是魅力）为特征的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 尤利乌斯·凯撒是一位伟大的历史人物。

definitions.definition: A written or printed symbol, or letter.
definitions.definitionCn: 书写或印刷的符号或字母。

definitions.definition: Style of writing or printing; handwriting; the particular form of letters used by a person or people.
definitions.example: an inscription in the Runic character
definitions.definitionCn: 书写或印刷的风格；笔迹；个人或群体使用的特定字母形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 用如尼字母刻写的铭文。

definitions.definition: A secret cipher; a way of writing in code.
definitions.definitionCn: 秘密密码；一种编码书写方式。

definitions.definition: One of the basic elements making up a text file or string: a code representing a printing character or a control character.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成文本文件或字符串的基本元素之一：代表打印字符或控制字符的代码。

definitions.definition: A person or individual, especially one who is unknown or raises suspicions.
definitions.example: That old guy is a real character.
definitions.definitionCn: 人，尤指未知或引起怀疑的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个老家伙真是个怪人。

definitions.definition: A complex number representing an element of a finite Abelian group.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示有限阿贝尔群元素的复数。

definitions.definition: Quality, position, rank, or capacity; quality or conduct with respect to a certain office or duty.
definitions.example: in his character as a magistrate
definitions.definitionCn: 品质、地位、等级或身份；与特定职务或职责相关的品质或行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 以他地方法官的身份。

definitions.definition: The estimate, individual or general, put upon a person or thing; reputation.
definitions.example: Her actions give her a bad character.
definitions.definitionCn: 对人或事物的个人或普遍评价；声誉。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的行为给她带来了坏名声。

definitions.definition: A reference given to a servant, attesting to his/her behaviour, competence, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 给仆人的推荐信，证明其行为、能力等。

definitions.definition: Personal appearance.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人外貌。

definitions.definition: To write (using characters); to describe.
definitions.definitionCn: 书写（使用字符）；描述。

definitions.definition: The act of seizing or capturing.
definitions.example: The catch of the perpetrator was the product of a year of police work.
definitions.definitionCn: 抓捕或捕获的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 抓获罪犯是警方一年工作的成果。

definitions.definition: The act of catching an object in motion, especially a ball.
definitions.example: Nice catch!
definitions.definitionCn: 接住运动中的物体，尤其是球。
definitions.exampleCn: 接得好！

definitions.definition: The act of noticing, understanding or hearing.
definitions.example: Good catch. I never would have remembered that.
definitions.definitionCn: 注意到、理解或听到的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 好眼力。我根本不会记得那件事。

definitions.definition: The game of catching a ball.
definitions.example: The kids love to play catch.
definitions.definitionCn: 接球游戏。
definitions.exampleCn: 孩子们喜欢玩接球。

definitions.definition: Something which is captured or caught.

definitions.definitionCn: 被捕获或抓住的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 捕获量达五吨箭鱼。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A find, in particular a boyfriend or girlfriend or prospective spouse.
definitions.example: Did you see his latest catch?
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）发现，尤指男女朋友或潜在配偶。
definitions.exampleCn: 你看到他最新的对象了吗？

definitions.definition: A stopping mechanism, especially a clasp which stops something from opening.
definitions.example: She installed a sturdy catch to keep her cabinets closed tight.
definitions.definitionCn: 止动装置，尤指防止东西打开的搭扣。
definitions.exampleCn: 她安装了一个结实的搭扣，让橱柜紧闭。

definitions.definition: A hesitation in voice, caused by strong emotion.

definitions.definitionCn: 因强烈情感而声音停顿。

definitions.definition: (sometimes noun adjunct) A concealed difficulty, especially in a deal or negotiation.

definitions.definitionCn: （有时作名词修饰语）隐藏的困难，尤指交易或谈判中的陷阱。
definitions.exampleCn: 小心，那是个陷阱问题。

definitions.definition: A crick; a sudden muscle pain during unaccustomed positioning when the muscle is in use.
definitions.example: I bent over to see under the table and got a catch in my side.
definitions.definitionCn: 抽筋；肌肉在不习惯姿势下使用时突然疼痛。
definitions.exampleCn: 我弯腰看桌底时，肋部抽了一下。

definitions.definition: A fragment of music or poetry.
definitions.definitionCn: 音乐或诗歌的片段。

definitions.definition: A state of readiness to capture or seize; an ambush.
definitions.definitionCn: 准备捕获或伏击的状态；埋伏。

definitions.definition: A crop which has germinated and begun to grow.
definitions.definitionCn: 已发芽并开始生长的作物。

definitions.definition: A type of strong boat, usually having two masts; a ketch.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种坚固的船，通常有两根桅杆；双桅帆船。

definitions.definition: A type of humorous round in which the voices gradually catch up with one another; usually sung by men and often having bawdy lyrics.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种幽默轮唱曲，声音逐渐互相追赶；通常由男性演唱，歌词常粗俗。

definitions.definition: The refrain; a line or lines of a song which are repeated from verse to verse.
definitions.definitionCn: 副歌；歌曲中每段重复的一行或几行歌词。

definitions.definition: The act of catching a hit ball before it reaches the ground, resulting in an out.
definitions.definitionCn: 在球落地前接住击球，导致出局。

definitions.definition: A player in respect of his catching ability; particularly one who catches well.
definitions.definitionCn: 球员的接球能力；尤指接球好的人。

definitions.definition: The first contact of an oar with the water.
definitions.definitionCn: 桨与水的第一次接触。

definitions.definition: A stoppage of breath, resembling a slight cough.
definitions.definitionCn: 呼吸停顿，类似轻微咳嗽。

definitions.definition: Passing opportunities seized; snatches.
definitions.definitionCn: 抓住的短暂机会；片段。

definitions.definition: A slight remembrance; a trace.
definitions.definitionCn: 微弱的记忆；痕迹。

definitions.definition: (heading) To capture, overtake.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）捕获、追上。

definitions.definition: (heading) To seize hold of.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）抓住。

definitions.definition: (heading) To intercept.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）拦截。

definitions.definition: (heading) To receive (by being in the way).
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）接收（因挡在路上）。

definitions.definition: (heading) To take in with one's senses or intellect.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）用感官或智力理解。

definitions.definition: (heading) To seize attention, interest.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）吸引注意力、兴趣。

definitions.definition: (heading) To obtain or experience
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）获得或体验。

definitions.definition: The amount of money levied for a service.
definitions.example: There will be a charge of five dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: 服务收取的费用。
definitions.exampleCn: 将收取五美元的费用。

definitions.definition: A ground attack against a prepared enemy.
definitions.example: Pickett did not die leading his famous charge.
definitions.definitionCn: 对准备好的敌人发起地面攻击。
definitions.exampleCn: 皮克特并非在率领他那著名的冲锋中阵亡。

definitions.definition: A forceful forward movement.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次有力的向前推进。

definitions.definition: An accusation.
definitions.example: That's a slanderous charge of abuse of trust.
definitions.definitionCn: 一项指控。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是对滥用信任的诽谤性指控。

definitions.definition: An electric charge.
definitions.definitionCn: 电荷。

definitions.definition: The scope of someone's responsibility.
definitions.example: The child was in the nanny's charge.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的职责范围。
definitions.exampleCn: 孩子由保姆照看。

definitions.definition: Someone or something entrusted to one's care, such as a child to a babysitter or a student to a teacher.
definitions.example: The child was a charge of the nanny.
definitions.definitionCn: 受托照管的人或物，如交给保姆的孩子或交给老师的学生。
definitions.exampleCn: 这孩子是保姆照管的对象。

definitions.definition: A load or burden; cargo.
definitions.example: The ship had a charge of colonists and their belongings.
definitions.definitionCn: 负载或负担；货物。
definitions.exampleCn: 船上载满了殖民者及其财物。

definitions.definition: An instruction.
definitions.example: I gave him the charge to get the deal closed by the end of the month.
definitions.definitionCn: 一项指示。
definitions.exampleCn: 我指示他在月底前完成这笔交易。

definitions.definition: An offensive foul in which the player with the ball moves into a stationary defender.
definitions.definitionCn: 进攻犯规，指持球队员撞向站定的防守队员。

definitions.definition: A measured amount of powder and/or shot in a firearm cartridge.
definitions.definitionCn: 枪弹中装填的定量火药和/或弹丸。

definitions.definition: An image displayed on an escutcheon.
definitions.definitionCn: 盾徽上显示的图案。

definitions.definition: A position (of a weapon) fitted for attack.
definitions.example: to bring a weapon to the charge
definitions.definitionCn: 武器处于待击发状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 将武器端平准备攻击。

definitions.definition: A sort of plaster or ointment.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种膏药或软膏。

definitions.definition: Weight; import; value.
definitions.definitionCn: 重量；重要性；价值。

definitions.definition: A measure of thirty-six pigs of lead, each pig weighing about seventy pounds; a charre.
definitions.definitionCn: 三十六块铅的计量单位，每块约重七十磅；即一卡。

definitions.definition: An address given at a church service concluding a visitation.
definitions.definitionCn: 教堂礼拜结束时的训诫致辞。

definitions.definition: To assign a duty or responsibility to
definitions.definitionCn: 指派职责或责任。

definitions.definition: To assign (a debit) to an account
definitions.example: Let's charge this to marketing.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（一笔借方款项）记入账户。
definitions.exampleCn: 把这笔费用记到营销账上。

definitions.definition: To pay on account, as by using a credit card
definitions.example: Can I charge my purchase to my credit card?
definitions.definitionCn: 赊账支付，如使用信用卡。
definitions.exampleCn: 我可以用信用卡付款吗？

definitions.definition: To require payment (of) (a price or fee, for goods, services, etc.)
definitions.example: I won't charge you for the wheat
definitions.definitionCn: 要求支付（商品、服务等的价格或费用）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不会收你小麦的钱。

definitions.definition: (possibly archaic) to sell at a given price.
definitions.example: to charge coal at $5 per unit
definitions.definitionCn: （可能已过时）以某价格出售。
definitions.exampleCn: 以每单位5美元的价格出售煤炭。

definitions.definition: To formally accuse (a person) of a crime.
definitions.example: I'm charging you with assault and battery.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式指控（某人）犯罪。
definitions.exampleCn: 我指控你犯有殴打罪。

definitions.definition: To impute or ascribe
definitions.definitionCn: 归咎或认为。

definitions.definition: To call to account; to challenge
definitions.definitionCn: 要求解释；质疑。

definitions.definition: To place a burden or load on or in
definitions.definitionCn: 将负担或负载放置于……上或内。

definitions.definition: To load equipment with material required for its use, as a firearm with powder, a fire hose with water, a chemical reactor with raw materials
definitions.example: Charge your weapons; we're moving up.
definitions.definitionCn: 为设备装填所需材料，如给枪装火药、给消防水管注水、给化学反应器加原料。
definitions.exampleCn: 装填你们的武器；我们要前进了。

definitions.definition: To move forward quickly and forcefully, particularly in combat and/or on horseback
definitions.definitionCn: 快速有力地向前移动，尤指在战斗中和/或骑马时。

definitions.definition: (of a hunting dog) to lie on the belly and be still (A command given by a hunter to a dog)
definitions.definitionCn: （猎犬用语）趴下不动（猎人给狗的命令）。

definitions.definition: A manner of transporting or lifting something; the grip or position in which something is carried.
definitions.example: Adjust your carry from time to time so that you don't tire too quickly.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种搬运或提升物品的方式；携带物品时的握持方式或位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 时不时调整你的携带方式，以免过快疲劳。

definitions.definition: A tract of land over which boats or goods are carried between two bodies of navigable water; a portage.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接两片通航水域的陆上运输通道或货物搬运路线；陆上搬运。

definitions.definition: The bit or digit that is carried in an addition operation.
definitions.definitionCn: 加法运算中进位的数字或数位。

definitions.definition: The benefit or cost of owning an asset over time.
definitions.example: The carry on this trade is 25 basis points per annum.
definitions.definitionCn: 长期持有资产所产生的收益或成本。
definitions.exampleCn: 这笔交易的年化持有收益为25个基点。

definitions.definition: The distance travelled by the ball when struck, until it hits the ground.
definitions.definitionCn: 球被击出后到落地前飞行的距离。

definitions.definition: Carried interest.
definitions.definitionCn: 附带权益。

definitions.definition: The sky; cloud-drift.
definitions.definitionCn: 天空；云层飘移。

definitions.definition: To lift (something) and take it to another place; to transport (something) by lifting.
definitions.definitionCn: 举起（某物）并带到别处；通过提举运输（某物）。

definitions.definition: To transfer from one place (such as a country, book, or column) to another.
definitions.example: to carry an account to the ledger
definitions.definitionCn: 从一个地方（如国家、书籍或栏目）转移到另一个地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 将账目过入总账。

definitions.definition: To convey by extension or continuance; to extend.
definitions.example: The builders are going to carry the chimney through the roof.  They would have carried the road ten miles further, but ran out of materials.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过延伸或持续来传递；扩展。
definitions.exampleCn: 建筑工人打算将烟囱穿过屋顶。他们本想把路再修十英里，但材料用完了。

definitions.definition: To move; to convey using force
definitions.definitionCn: 移动；用力搬运。

definitions.definition: To lead or guide.
definitions.definitionCn: 引导或带领。

definitions.definition: To stock or supply (something); to have in store.
definitions.example: The corner drugstore doesn't carry his favorite brand of aspirin.
definitions.definitionCn: 储备或供应（某物）；有库存。
definitions.exampleCn: 街角药店不卖他最喜欢的阿司匹林品牌。

definitions.definition: To adopt (something); take (something) over.
definitions.example: I think I can carry Smith's work while she is out.
definitions.definitionCn: 采纳（某物）；接管（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想在她外出期间能接手史密斯的工作。

definitions.definition: To adopt or resolve on, especially in a deliberative assembly
definitions.example: The court carries that motion.
definitions.definitionCn: 在审议机构中采纳或决定。
definitions.exampleCn: 法庭通过那项动议。

definitions.definition: In an addition, to transfer the quantity in excess of what is countable in the units in a column to the column immediately to the left in order to be added there.
definitions.example: Five and nine are fourteen; carry the one to the tens place.
definitions.definitionCn: 在加法中，将一列中超出可计数单位的数量转移到左边相邻列以便相加。
definitions.exampleCn: 五加九等于十四；把进位的一加到十位。

definitions.definition: To have, hold, possess or maintain (something).
definitions.example: Always carry sufficient insurance to protect against a loss.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有、持有、占有或维持（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 始终购买足够的保险以防损失。

definitions.definition: To be transmitted; to travel.
definitions.example: The sound of the bells carried for miles on the wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 被传播；传播。
definitions.exampleCn: 钟声随风传了数英里。

definitions.definition: To insult, to diss.
definitions.definitionCn: 侮辱，贬低。

definitions.definition: To capture a ship by coming alongside and boarding.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过靠近并登船来捕获船只。

definitions.definition: To transport (the ball) whilst maintaining possession.
definitions.definitionCn: 在保持控球的情况下运输（球）。

definitions.definition: To have on one's person.
definitions.example: she always carries a purse;  marsupials carry their young in a pouch
definitions.definitionCn: 随身携带。
definitions.exampleCn: 她总是带着一个钱包；有袋类动物把幼崽放在育儿袋里。

definitions.definition: To be pregnant (with).
definitions.example: The doctor said she's carrying twins.
definitions.definitionCn: 怀孕（怀有）。
definitions.exampleCn: 医生说她怀了双胞胎。

definitions.definition: To have propulsive power; to propel.
definitions.example: A gun or mortar carries well.
definitions.definitionCn: 有推进力；推进。
definitions.exampleCn: 枪或迫击炮射程很远。

definitions.definition: To hold the head; said of a horse.
definitions.example: to carry well, i.e. to hold the head high, with arching neck
definitions.definitionCn: 昂首；指马。
definitions.exampleCn: 昂首挺立，即高昂着头，颈部弯曲。

definitions.definition: To have earth or frost stick to the feet when running, as a hare.
definitions.definitionCn: 奔跑时脚上沾土或霜，如野兔。

definitions.definition: To bear or uphold successfully through conflict, for example a leader or principle
definitions.definitionCn: 在冲突中成功支持或维护，例如领导者或原则。

definitions.definition: To succeed in (e.g. a contest); to succeed in; to win.
definitions.example: The Tories carried the election.
definitions.definitionCn: 在（如竞赛中）成功；获胜；赢得。
definitions.exampleCn: 保守党赢得了选举。

definitions.definition: To get possession of by force; to capture.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过武力夺取；捕获。

definitions.definition: To contain; to comprise; have a particular aspect; to show or exhibit
definitions.definitionCn: 包含；包括；具有特定方面；展示或表现。

definitions.definition: To bear (oneself); to behave or conduct.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现（自己）；举止或行为。

definitions.definition: To bear the charges or burden of holding or having, as stocks, merchandise, etc., from one time to another.
definitions.example: A merchant is carrying a large stock;  a farm carries a mortgage;  a broker carries stock for a customer;  to carry a life insurance.
definitions.definitionCn: 承担持有或拥有（如股票、商品等）从一段时间到另一段时间的费用或负担。
definitions.exampleCn: 商人持有大量库存；农场有抵押贷款；经纪人为客户持有股票；持有寿险保单。

definitions.definition: To have a weapon on one's person; to be armed.
definitions.definitionCn: 随身携带武器；武装。

definitions.definition: To be disproportionately responsible for a team's success.
definitions.example: He absolutely carried the game, to the point of killing the entire enemy team by himself.
definitions.definitionCn: 不成比例地承担团队成功的责任。
definitions.exampleCn: 他完全主导了比赛，甚至独自消灭了整支敌方队伍。

definitions.definition: Having to do with people and government office as opposed to the military or religion.
definitions.example: She went into civil service because she wanted to help the people.
definitions.definitionCn: 与人民和政府机构相关，而非军事或宗教。
definitions.exampleCn: 她进入公务员队伍是因为想帮助人民。

definitions.definition: Behaving in a reasonable or polite manner.
definitions.example: It was very civil of him to stop the argument.
definitions.definitionCn: 以合理或礼貌的方式行事。
definitions.exampleCn: 他停止争论的行为非常文明。

definitions.definition: Relating to private relations among citizens, as opposed to criminal matters.
definitions.example: a civil case
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及公民之间的私人关系，而非刑事事务。
definitions.exampleCn: 民事案件

definitions.definition: Secular.
definitions.definitionCn: 世俗的。

definitions.definition: An area of the earth's surface between two parallels of latitude.
definitions.definitionCn: 地球表面介于两条纬度线之间的区域。

definitions.definition: A region of the Earth.
definitions.definitionCn: 地球上的一个区域。

definitions.definition: The long-term manifestations of weather and other atmospheric conditions in a given area or country, now usually represented by the statistical summary of its weather conditions during a period long enough to ensure that representative values are obtained (generally 30 years).
definitions.definitionCn: 某一地区或国家长期天气及其他大气状况的表现，现通常通过足够长时期（一般为30年）内天气条件的统计总结来代表，以确保获得具有代表性的数值。

definitions.definition: The context in general of a particular political, moral etc. situation.
definitions.example: Industries that require a lot of fossil fuels are unlikely to be popular in the current political climate.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定政治、道德等情境的总体背景。
definitions.exampleCn: 需要大量化石燃料的产业在当前政治气候下不太可能受欢迎。

definitions.definition: To dwell.
definitions.definitionCn: 居住。

definitions.definition: A large settlement, bigger than a town; sometimes with a specific legal definition, depending on the place.
definitions.example: São Paulo is the largest city in South America.
definitions.definitionCn: 大型定居点，规模大于城镇；有时根据地区有特定的法律定义。
definitions.exampleCn: 圣保罗是南美洲最大的城市。

definitions.definition: A settlement granted special status by royal charter or letters patent; traditionally, a settlement with a cathedral regardless of size.
definitions.definitionCn: 由皇家特许状或专利证书授予特殊地位的定居点；传统上，无论规模大小，拥有大教堂的定居点。

definitions.definition: The central business district; downtown.
definitions.example: I'm going into the city today to do some shopping.
definitions.definitionCn: 中央商务区；市中心。
definitions.exampleCn: 我今天要进城购物。

definitions.definition: A large amount of something (used after the noun).
definitions.example: It's video game city in here!
definitions.definitionCn: 大量某物（用于名词后）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里简直是电子游戏的天堂！

definitions.definition: An option; a decision; an opportunity to choose or select something.
definitions.example: Do I have a choice of what color to paint it?
definitions.definitionCn: 一个选项；一个决定；选择或挑选某物的机会。
definitions.exampleCn: 我可以选择把它漆成什么颜色吗？

definitions.definition: The power to choose.
definitions.example: She didn't leave us much choice.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择的权利。
definitions.exampleCn: 她没给我们留下太多选择。

definitions.definition: One selection or preference; that which is chosen or decided; the outcome of a decision.
definitions.example: The ice cream sundae is a popular choice for dessert.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个选择或偏好；被选中或决定的事物；决定的结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 冰淇淋圣代是甜点的热门选择。

definitions.definition: Anything that can be chosen.
definitions.example: You have three choices: vanilla, strawberry or chocolate
definitions.definitionCn: 任何可以被选择的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 你有三种选择：香草、草莓或巧克力。

definitions.definition: (usually with the) The best or most preferable part.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与定冠词连用）最好或最可取的部分。

definitions.definition: Care and judgement in selecting; discrimination, selectiveness.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择时的谨慎与判断；辨别力；选择性。

definitions.definition: A sufficient number to choose among.
definitions.definitionCn: 足够多的选择数量。

definitions.definition: Especially good or preferred.
definitions.example: It's a choice location, but you will pay more to live there.
definitions.definitionCn: 特别好或更受偏爱的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是个绝佳的位置，但住在那儿要花更多钱。

definitions.definition: Careful in choosing; discriminating.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择时很谨慎；有辨别力的。

definitions.definition: A cheerful attitude; happiness; a good, happy, or positive mood.
definitions.definitionCn: 愉快的心情；幸福；良好、快乐或积极的情绪。

definitions.definition: That which promotes good spirits or cheerfulness; provisions prepared for a feast; entertainment.
definitions.example: a table loaded with good cheer
definitions.definitionCn: 能带来好心情或愉悦的事物；为盛宴准备的食物；款待。
definitions.exampleCn: 摆满佳肴的餐桌。

definitions.definition: A cry expressing joy, approval or support such as "hurray".
definitions.example: A cheer rose from the crowd.
definitions.definitionCn: 表达喜悦、赞同或支持的呼喊声，如"好哇"。
definitions.exampleCn: 人群中响起一阵欢呼声。

definitions.definition: A chant made in support of a team at a sports event.
definitions.definitionCn: 体育赛事中为队伍助威的呐喊。

definitions.definition: One's facial expression or countenance.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的面部表情或神态。

definitions.definition: One's attitude, mood.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的态度或情绪。

definitions.definition: To gladden; to make cheerful; often with up.
definitions.example: We were cheered by the offer of a cup of tea.
definitions.definitionCn: 使高兴；使愉快；常与up连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 一杯茶的款待让我们感到振奋。

definitions.definition: To infuse life, courage, animation, or hope, into; to inspirit; to solace or comfort.
definitions.definitionCn: 注入活力、勇气、生气或希望；鼓舞；安慰或抚慰。

definitions.definition: To applaud or encourage with cheers or shouts.
definitions.example: The crowd cheered in support of the athletes.
definitions.definitionCn: 用欢呼或呐喊表示赞赏或鼓励。
definitions.exampleCn: 人群欢呼着支持运动员们。

definitions.definition: Cheerleading.
definitions.example: I'm going to wear my new cheer shoes at cheer today.

definitions.definition: Nimble with hands or body; skillful; adept.
definitions.definitionCn: 手脚灵活或身体敏捷；灵巧；熟练。

definitions.definition: Resourceful, sometimes to the point of cunning.
definitions.example: clever like a fox
definitions.definitionCn: 足智多谋，有时近乎狡猾。
definitions.exampleCn: 像狐狸一样聪明。

definitions.definition: Smart, intelligent, or witty; mentally quick or sharp.
definitions.definitionCn: 聪明、机智或诙谐；思维敏捷或敏锐。

definitions.definition: Showing inventiveness or originality; witty.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出创造力或独创性；诙谐。

definitions.definition: (of an Aboriginal Australian) Possessing magical abilities.
definitions.definitionCn: （指澳大利亚原住民）拥有魔法能力。

definitions.definition: Fit; suitable; having propriety.
definitions.definitionCn: 合适；恰当；得体。

definitions.definition: Well-shaped; handsome.
definitions.definitionCn: 体型匀称；英俊。

definitions.definition: Good-natured; obliging.
definitions.definitionCn: 性情温和；乐于助人。

definitions.definition: Fit and healthy; free from fatigue or illness.
definitions.definitionCn: 健康强壮；无疲劳或疾病。

definitions.definition: Full extent; distance between extreme limits; especially; the distance between the nearest surfaces of two bodies, or the space between walls.
definitions.example: a room ten feet square in the clear
definitions.definitionCn: 全部范围；极端界限之间的距离；尤指两个物体最近表面之间的距离，或墙壁之间的空间。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个十英尺见方的房间（净空间）。

definitions.definition: The completion of a stage or challenge, or of the whole game.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成一个阶段、挑战或整个游戏。

definitions.definition: A person who is free from the influence of engrams.
definitions.definitionCn: 不受印痕影响的人。

definitions.definition: To remove obstructions, impediments or other unwanted items from.
definitions.example: If you clear the table, I'll wash up.
definitions.definitionCn: 清除障碍、阻碍或其他不需要的物品。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你清理桌子，我就洗碗。

definitions.definition: To remove (items or material) so as to leave something unobstructed or open.
definitions.example: Please clear all this stuff off the table.
definitions.definitionCn: 移除（物品或材料）以使某物畅通无阻或开放。
definitions.exampleCn: 请把桌上所有这些杂物清理掉。

definitions.definition: To become free from obstruction or obscurement; to become transparent.
definitions.example: After a heavy rain, the sky cleared nicely for the evening.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得无阻碍或清晰；变得透明。
definitions.exampleCn: 大雨过后，天空在傍晚变得晴朗。

definitions.definition: To eliminate ambiguity or doubt from (a matter); to clarify or resolve; to clear up.
definitions.example: We need to clear this issue once and for all.
definitions.definitionCn: 消除（某事的）歧义或疑虑；澄清或解决；弄清楚。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们需要一劳永逸地解决这个问题。

definitions.definition: To remove from suspicion, especially of having committed a crime.
definitions.example: The court cleared the man of murder.
definitions.definitionCn: 解除嫌疑，尤其是犯罪嫌疑。
definitions.exampleCn: 法庭宣判该男子谋杀罪名不成立。

definitions.definition: To pass without interference; to miss.
definitions.example: The door just barely clears the table as it closes.
definitions.definitionCn: 无干扰地通过；错过。
definitions.exampleCn: 门关上时刚好擦过桌子。

definitions.definition: (activities such as jumping or throwing) To exceed a stated mark.
definitions.example: She was the first female high jumper to clear two metres.
definitions.definitionCn: （跳跃或投掷等活动）超过规定标记。
definitions.exampleCn: 她是第一位跳过两米的女跳高运动员。

definitions.definition: To finish or complete (a stage, challenge, or game).
definitions.example: I cleared the first level in 36 seconds.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成（一个阶段、挑战或游戏）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在36秒内通过了第一关。

definitions.definition: Of a check or financial transaction, to go through as payment; to be processed so that the money is transferred.
definitions.example: The check might not clear for a couple of days.
definitions.definitionCn: 支票或金融交易通过付款处理；资金被转移。
definitions.exampleCn: 这张支票可能几天后才能兑现。

definitions.definition: To earn a profit of; to net.
definitions.example: He's been clearing seven thousand a week.
definitions.definitionCn: 赚取利润；净得。
definitions.exampleCn: 他每周净赚七千。

definitions.definition: To approve or authorise for a particular purpose or action; to give clearance to.
definitions.example: Air traffic control cleared the plane to land.
definitions.definitionCn: 批准或授权特定目的或行动；给予许可。
definitions.exampleCn: 空中交通管制批准飞机降落。

definitions.definition: To obtain approval or authorisation in respect of.
definitions.example: I've cleared the press release with the marketing department, so go ahead and publish it.
definitions.definitionCn: 就某事获得批准或授权。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已与市场部确认了新闻稿，请继续发布。

definitions.definition: To obtain a clearance.
definitions.example: The steamer cleared for Liverpool today.
definitions.definitionCn: 获得许可。
definitions.exampleCn: 这艘轮船今天获准驶往利物浦。

definitions.definition: To obtain permission to use (a sample of copyrighted audio) in another track.
definitions.definitionCn: 获得使用（另一曲目中受版权保护的音频样本）的许可。

definitions.definition: To disengage oneself from incumbrances, distress, or entanglements; to become free.
definitions.definitionCn: 摆脱负担、困境或纠缠；获得自由。

definitions.definition: To hit, kick, head, punch etc. (a ball, puck) away in order to defend one's goal.
definitions.example: A low cross came in, and Smith cleared.
definitions.definitionCn: 击、踢、头球、拳击等（球、冰球）以防守球门。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个低平传中过来，史密斯解围了。

definitions.definition: To reset or unset; to return to an empty state or to zero.
definitions.example: to clear an array;  to clear a single bit (binary digit) in a value
definitions.definitionCn: 重置或清零；返回空状态或零值。
definitions.exampleCn: 清除数组；清除值中的单个位（二进制数字）。

definitions.definition: To style (an element within a document) so that it is not permitted to float at a given position.
definitions.definitionCn: 设置（文档中的元素）使其不允许在给定位置浮动。

definitions.definition: Transparent in colour.
definitions.example: as clear as crystal
definitions.definitionCn: 颜色透明。
definitions.exampleCn: 像水晶一样清澈。

definitions.definition: Bright, not dark or obscured.

definitions.definitionCn: 明亮，不暗或不模糊。
definitions.exampleCn: 国会通过了总统的“晴朗天空”法案。

definitions.definition: Free of obstacles.
definitions.example: The coast is clear.
definitions.definitionCn: 无障碍的。
definitions.exampleCn: 畅通无阻。

definitions.definition: Without clouds.
definitions.example: clear weather; a clear day
definitions.definitionCn: 无云的。
definitions.exampleCn: 晴朗的天气；晴朗的一天。

definitions.definition: Of the sky, such that less than one eighth of its area is obscured by clouds.
definitions.definitionCn: 天空的云量少于八分之一。

definitions.definition: Free of ambiguity or doubt.

definitions.definitionCn: 无歧义或无疑虑。
definitions.exampleCn: 我说清楚了吗？非常清楚。

definitions.definition: Distinct, sharp, well-marked.
definitions.definitionCn: 清晰、鲜明、轮廓分明。

definitions.definition: Free of guilt, or suspicion.

definitions.definitionCn: 无罪或无疑虑的。
definitions.exampleCn: 问心无愧。

definitions.definition: (of a soup) Without a thickening ingredient.
definitions.definitionCn: （汤类）不加增稠成分的。

definitions.definition: Possessing little or no perceptible stimulus.

definitions.definitionCn: 几乎没有或没有可感知的刺激。
definitions.exampleCn: 质地纯净；气味清新。

definitions.definition: Free from the influence of engrams; see Clear (Scientology).
definitions.definitionCn: 不受印痕影响的；见“清晰者”（山达基教）。

definitions.definition: Able to perceive clearly; keen; acute; penetrating; discriminating.

definitions.definitionCn: 能清晰感知的；敏锐的；尖锐的；有洞察力的。
definitions.exampleCn: 清晰的智力；清醒的头脑。

definitions.definition: Not clouded with passion; serene; cheerful.
definitions.definitionCn: 不为激情所蒙蔽的；平静的；愉快的。

definitions.definition: Easily or distinctly heard; audible.
definitions.definitionCn: 容易或清晰地听到的；可听见的。

definitions.definition: Unmixed; entirely pure.

definitions.definitionCn: 未混合的；完全纯净的。

definitions.definition: Without defects or blemishes, such as freckles or knots.

definitions.definitionCn: 无瑕疵或缺陷的，如雀斑或节疤。
definitions.exampleCn: 清透的肤色；无节疤的木材。

definitions.definition: Without diminution; in full; net.

definitions.definitionCn: 无减少的；完全的；净的。
definitions.exampleCn: 纯利润。

definitions.definition: All the way; entirely.

definitions.definitionCn: 一直；完全地。

definitions.definition: Not near something or touching it.

definitions.definition: Free (or separate) from others

definitions.definition: In a clear manner; plainly.

definitions.definition: To reduce, to nothing, the strength of.

definitions.definition: The act or instance of being defeated, of being overcome or vanquished; a loss.

definitions.definition: The act or instance of defeating, of overcoming, vanquishing.

definitions.definition: Frustration (by prevention of success), stymieing; nullification.
Destruction, ruin.
Pleasing to taste; tasty.

definitions.definition: Metaphorically pleasing to taste; pleasing to the eyes or mind.

definitions.definition: Having tremendous sex appeal.
definitions.definitionCn: 极具性感魅力。

definitions.definition: (followed by on or upon, formerly also by of) To be contingent or conditioned; to have something as a necessary condition; to hinge on.
definitions.example: We would like to go skiing, but it depends on the amount of snow.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接on或upon，旧时也接of）取决于；视……而定；以……为必要条件。

definitions.definition: (followed by on or upon) To trust; to have confidence; to rely.

definitions.definitionCn: （后接on或upon）信任；信赖；依靠。

definitions.definition: To hang down; to be sustained by being fastened or attached to something above.
definitions.definitionCn: 悬挂；由上方固定或附着的东西支撑。

definitions.definition: To be pending; to be undetermined or undecided.

definitions.definition: A period of time before an event occurs; the act of delaying; procrastination; lingering inactivity.

definitions.definitionCn: 一种引入受控延迟的音频效果单元。

definitions.definition: To put off until a later time; to defer.

definitions.definition: To allay; to temper.
definitions.definitionCn: 减轻；缓和。

definitions.definition: To dilute, temper.
To assuage, quench, allay.
To ward off attacks against; to fight to protect; to guard.
definitions.definitionCn: 抵御攻击；为保护而战斗；守卫。

definitions.definition: To support by words or writing; to vindicate, talk in favour of.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过言语或文字支持；辩护，为……说好话。

definitions.definition: To make legal defence of; to represent (the accused).
definitions.definitionCn: 进行法律辩护；代表（被告）。

definitions.definition: To focus one's energies and talents on preventing opponents from scoring, as opposed to focusing on scoring.
definitions.definitionCn: 集中精力与才能阻止对手得分，而非专注于得分。

definitions.definition: To attempt to retain a title, or attempt to reach the same stage in a competition as one did in the previous edition of that competition.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图保住头衔，或试图在比赛中达到与上届相同的阶段。

definitions.definition: To call a raise from the big blind.
definitions.definitionCn: 在大盲注位置跟注加注。

definitions.definition: To ward off, repel (an attack or attacker).
definitions.definitionCn: 抵挡、击退（攻击或攻击者）。

definitions.definition: To prevent, to keep (from doing something).
definitions.definitionCn: 阻止、防止（某人做某事）。

definitions.definition: To prohibit, forbid.
definitions.definitionCn: 禁止、不允许。

definitions.definition: To set free from restraint or danger.

definitions.definitionCn: 从束缚或危险中释放。
definitions.exampleCn: 将囚犯从监狱中解救出来。

definitions.definition: (process) To do with birth.
definitions.definitionCn: （过程）与出生有关。

definitions.definition: To free from or disburden of anything.
definitions.definitionCn: 使摆脱或卸下任何负担。

definitions.definition: To bring or transport something to its destination.
definitions.example: deliver a package;  deliver the mail
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物运送至其目的地。
definitions.exampleCn: 递送包裹；  递送邮件。

definitions.definition: To hand over or surrender (someone or something) to another.
definitions.example: deliver the thief to the police
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某人或某物）移交或交出给另一方。
definitions.exampleCn: 将小偷交给警察。

definitions.definition: To produce what was expected or required.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生预期或要求的结果。

definitions.definition: To express in words or vocalizations, declare, utter, or vocalize.
definitions.example: deliver a speech
definitions.definitionCn: 用言语或声音表达、宣告、说出或发声。

definitions.definition: To give forth in action or exercise; to discharge.

definitions.definitionCn: 在行动或实践中发出；释放。

definitions.definition: To discover; to show.
definitions.definitionCn: 发现；展示。

definitions.definition: To admit; to allow to pass.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许；准许通过。

definitions.definition: To administer a drug.
definitions.definitionCn: 施用药物。

definitions.definition: The desire to purchase goods and services.

definitions.definitionCn: 购买商品和服务的欲望。
definitions.exampleCn: 当需求超过供给时，价格通常会上涨。

definitions.definition: The amount of a good or service that consumers are willing to buy at a particular price.
definitions.definitionCn: 消费者愿意以特定价格购买的商品或服务数量。

definitions.definition: A forceful claim for something.

definitions.definitionCn: 对某物的强烈要求。
definitions.exampleCn: 现代社会正在回应女性对平等的要求。

definitions.definition: A requirement.

definitions.definitionCn: 一项需求。

definitions.definition: An urgent request.
definitions.example: She couldn't ignore the newborn baby's demands for attention.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧急请求。
definitions.exampleCn: 她无法忽视新生儿对关注的索求。

definitions.definition: An order.
definitions.definitionCn: 命令。

definitions.definitionCn: （电力供应）更准确地说是峰值需求或峰值负荷，衡量公用事业客户在短时间内最大电力负荷的指标；在指定时间间隔内整合的电力负荷。

definitions.definition: To request forcefully.
definitions.example: I demand to see the manager.
definitions.definitionCn: 强烈要求。

definitions.definition: To claim a right to something.

definitions.definitionCn: 主张对某物的权利。

definitions.definition: To ask forcefully for information.

definitions.definitionCn: 强烈要求信息。

definitions.definition: To require of someone.

definitions.definitionCn: 要求某人做某事。

definitions.definition: To issue a summons to court.
definitions.definitionCn: 发出法庭传票。

definitions.definition: A part, portion, or subdivision.
definitions.definitionCn: 一部分、一份或分支。

definitions.definition: A distinct course of life, action, study, or the like.

France is composed of 101 départements organized in 18 régions, each department is divided into arrondissements, in turn divided into cantons.
definitions.definitionCn: 领土划分；行政区；尤其在法国，为国家治理而划分的区域，类似英国和美国的郡。法国由18个大区下的101个省组成，每个省又分为区，区再分为县。

definitions.definition: A military subdivision of a country

definitions.definitionCn: 国家的军事分区。

definitions.definition: Act of departing; departure.
definitions.definitionCn: 离开的行为；出发。

definitions.definition: A deep shade of colour.
definitions.definitionCn: 深色调

definitions.definition: The profound part of a problem.
definitions.definitionCn: 问题的深层部分

definitions.definition: (with "the") The sea, the ocean.
definitions.definitionCn: （与"the"连用）大海，海洋

definitions.definition: A fielding position near the boundary.

definitions.definitionCn: 靠近边界的防守位置

definitions.definition: (of a physical distance) Extending far away from a point of reference, especially downwards.

definitions.definition: (intellectual, social) Complex, involved.
definitions.definitionCn: （智力、社会层面）复杂，涉及面广

definitions.definition: (sound, voice) Low in pitch.

definitions.definition: (of a color) Highly saturated.

definitions.definitionCn: （颜色）高饱和度的

definitions.definition: Muddy; boggy; sandy; said of roads.
