definitions.definitionCn: 总长度。
definitions.exampleCn: 一本书的长度。

definitions.definition: Part of something that is long; a physical piece of something.
definitions.example: a length of rope
definitions.definitionCn: 某物中长的部分；某物的物理片段。
definitions.exampleCn: 一段绳子。

definitions.definition: To lengthen.
definitions.definitionCn: 加长。

definitions.definition: A smaller amount or quantity.
definitions.example: I have less to do today than yesterday.
definitions.definitionCn: 较少的数量或数额。
definitions.exampleCn: 我今天要做的事比昨天少。

definitions.definition: To make less; to lessen.
definitions.definitionCn: 使减少；减轻。

definitions.definition: To a smaller extent or degree.
definitions.example: I like him less each time I see him.
definitions.definitionCn: 在较小程度上或程度上。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每次见到他，对他的好感就减少一分。

definitions.definition: Minus; not including
definitions.example: It should then tax all of that as personal income, less the proportion of the car's annual mileage demonstrably clocked up on company business.
definitions.definitionCn: 减去；不包括。
definitions.exampleCn: 那么，它应将全部金额作为个人收入征税，但要减去该车年度里程中明确用于公司业务的部分。

definitions.definition: Unless
An institution which holds books and/or other forms of media for use by the public or qualified people often lending them out, as well as providing various other services for its users.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个向公众或符合条件的人提供书籍和/或其他媒体形式的机构，通常提供外借服务，并为其用户提供各种其他服务。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Any institution that lends out its goods for use by the public or a community.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）任何向公众或社区出借其物品供使用的机构。

definitions.definition: A collection of books or other forms of stored information.
definitions.definitionCn: 书籍或其他形式存储信息的收藏。

definitions.definition: An equivalent collection of analogous information in a non-printed form, e.g. record library.
definitions.definitionCn: 非印刷形式的类似信息的对应收藏，例如唱片图书馆。

definitions.definition: A room dedicated to storing books.
definitions.definitionCn: 专门用于存放书籍的房间。

definitions.definition: A collection of software routines that provide functionality to be incorporated into or used by a computer program.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供功能以供计算机程序集成或使用的软件例程集合。

definitions.definition: A collection of DNA material from a single organism or relative to a single disease.
definitions.definitionCn: 来自单一生物体或与单一疾病相关的DNA材料集合。

definitions.definition: The deck or draw pile.
definitions.definitionCn: 牌组或抽牌堆。

definitions.definition: The condition of being free from control or restrictions.
definitions.example: The army is here, your liberty is assured.
definitions.definitionCn: 不受控制或限制的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 军队在此，你的自由得到保障。

definitions.definition: The condition of being free from imprisonment, slavery or forced labour.
definitions.example: The prisoners gained their liberty from an underground tunnel.
definitions.definitionCn: 免于监禁、奴役或强迫劳动的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 囚犯们通过一条地下隧道获得了自由。

definitions.definition: The condition of being free to act, believe or express oneself as one chooses.
definitions.example: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person.
definitions.definitionCn: 自由行动、信仰或表达自我的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 人人有权享有生命、自由和人身安全。

definitions.definition: Freedom from excessive government control.
definitions.definitionCn: 免于过度政府控制的状态。

definitions.definition: A short period when a sailor is allowed ashore.
definitions.example: We're going on a three-day liberty as soon as we dock.
definitions.definitionCn: 水手获准上岸的短暂假期。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们一靠岸就要享受三天的自由假期。

definitions.definition: (often plural) A breach of social convention.
definitions.example: You needn't take such liberties.
definitions.definitionCn: （常复数）违反社会惯例的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 你不必如此放肆。

definitions.definition: A local division of government administration in medieval England.
definitions.definitionCn: 中世纪英格兰地方政府的一个行政区划。

definitions.definition: (game of go) an empty space next to a group of stones of the same color.
definitions.definitionCn: （围棋术语）同色棋子相邻的空位。

definitions.definition: A restriction; a bound beyond which one may not go.
definitions.example: There are several existing limits to executive power.
definitions.definitionCn: 限制；不可逾越的界限。
definitions.exampleCn: 行政权力存在若干现有限制。

definitions.definition: A value to which a sequence converges. Equivalently, the common value of the upper limit and the lower limit of a sequence: if the upper and lower limits are different, then the sequence has no limit (i.e., does not converge).
definitions.example: The sequence of reciprocals has zero as its limit.
definitions.definitionCn: 序列收敛的值。等价于序列上极限与下极限的共同值：若上下极限不同，则序列无极限（即不收敛）。
definitions.exampleCn: 倒数序列以零为极限。

definitions.definition: Any of several abstractions of this concept of limit.
definitions.example: Category theory defines a very general concept of limit.
definitions.definitionCn: 该极限概念的若干抽象形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 范畴论定义了非常广义的极限概念。

definitions.definition: The cone of a diagram through which any other cone of that same diagram can factor uniquely.
definitions.definitionCn: 图的锥形，使得同一图的任何其他锥形可唯一分解。

definitions.definition: Fixed limit.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定限额。

definitions.definition: The final, utmost, or furthest point; the border or edge.
definitions.example: the limit of a walk, of a town, or of a country
definitions.definitionCn: 最终、极致或最远点；边界或边缘。
definitions.exampleCn: 步行、城镇或国家的界限。

definitions.definition: The space or thing defined by limits.
definitions.definitionCn: 由界限定义的空间或事物。

definitions.definition: That which terminates a period of time; hence, the period itself; the full time or extent.
definitions.definitionCn: 终结一段时间的事物；因此指该时段本身；完整时间或范围。

definitions.definition: A restriction; a check or curb; a hindrance.
definitions.definitionCn: 限制；约束或抑制；障碍。

definitions.definition: A determining feature; a distinguishing characteristic.
definitions.definitionCn: 决定性特征；区分性标志。

definitions.definition: The first group of riders to depart in a handicap race.
definitions.definitionCn: 让分赛中首批出发的骑手组。

definitions.definition: (as "the limit") A person who is exasperating, intolerable, astounding, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: （作“极限”义）令人恼怒、难以容忍、震惊等的人。

definitions.definition: Being a fixed limit game.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于固定限额游戏。

definitions.definition: To restrict; not to allow to go beyond a certain bound, to set boundaries.
definitions.example: I'm limiting myself to two drinks tonight.

definitions.definition: To have a limit in a particular set.
definitions.example: The sequence limits on the point a.

definitions.definition: To beg, or to exercise functions, within a certain limited region.
definitions.example: a limiting friar

definitions.definition: One with liberal views, supporting individual liberty (see Wikipedia's article on Liberalism).
definitions.definitionCn: 持有自由观点、支持个人自由者（参见维基百科关于自由主义的文章）。

definitions.definition: Someone left-wing; one with a left-wing ideology.
definitions.definitionCn: 左翼人士；持左翼意识形态者。

definitions.definition: A supporter of any of several liberal parties.
definitions.definitionCn: 任一自由党的支持者。

definitions.definition: One who favors individual voting rights, human and civil rights, and laissez-faire markets (also called "classical liberal"; compare libertarian).
definitions.definitionCn: 支持个人投票权、人权与公民权利以及自由市场者（亦称"古典自由主义者"；与自由意志主义者比较）。

definitions.definition: (now rare outside set phrases) Pertaining to those arts and sciences the study of which is considered to provide general knowledge, as opposed to vocational/occupational, technical or mechanical training.
definitions.example: 1983, David Leslie Wagner, The Seven liberal arts in the Middle Ages
definitions.definitionCn: （现除固定短语外罕见）指那些被认为提供通识教育的文科与科学，区别于职业/专业、技术或机械培训。
definitions.exampleCn: 1983年，大卫·莱斯利·瓦格纳，《中世纪七艺》

definitions.definition: Generous; willing to give unsparingly.
definitions.example: He was liberal with his compliments.
definitions.definitionCn: 慷慨的；愿意毫无保留地给予。
definitions.exampleCn: 他毫不吝啬地赞美。

definitions.definition: Ample, abundant; generous in quantity.
definitions.example: Add a liberal sprinkling of salt.
definitions.definitionCn: 充足的；数量丰沛的。
definitions.exampleCn: 撒上满满一把盐。

definitions.definition: Unrestrained, licentious.
definitions.definitionCn: 无拘束的，放纵的。

definitions.definition: Widely open to new ideas, willing to depart from established opinions or conventions; permissive.
definitions.example: Her parents had liberal ideas about child-rearing.
definitions.definitionCn: 对新思想广泛开放，愿意背离既定观点或惯例；宽容的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的父母在育儿方面持有开明观念。

definitions.definition: Open to political or social changes and reforms associated with either classical or modern liberalism.
definitions.definitionCn: 对与古典或现代自由主义相关的政治或社会变革持开放态度。

definitions.definition: Visible electromagnetic radiation. The human eye can typically detect radiation (light) in the wavelength range of about 400 to 750 nanometers. Nearby shorter and longer wavelength ranges, although not visible, are commonly called ultraviolet and infrared light.
definitions.example: As you can see, this spacious dining-room gets a lot of light in the mornings.
definitions.definitionCn: 可见电磁辐射。人眼通常能检测到波长范围约400至750纳米的辐射（光）。邻近的较短和较长波长范围虽不可见，但通常被称为紫外线和红外线。
definitions.exampleCn: 如你所见，这间宽敞的餐厅早晨采光很好。

definitions.definition: A source of illumination.
definitions.example: Put that light out!
definitions.definitionCn: 光源。
definitions.exampleCn: 把灯关掉！

definitions.definition: Spiritual or mental illumination; enlightenment, useful information.
definitions.example: Can you throw any light on this problem?
definitions.definitionCn: 精神或心智的启迪；启发，有用信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能为这个问题提供一些线索吗？

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Facts; pieces of information; ideas, concepts.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）事实；信息片段；想法，概念。

definitions.definition: A notable person within a specific field or discipline.
definitions.example: Picasso was one of the leading lights of the cubist movement.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定领域或学科中的杰出人物。
definitions.exampleCn: 毕加索是立体主义运动的领军人物之一。

definitions.definition: The manner in which the light strikes a picture; that part of a picture which represents those objects upon which the light is supposed to fall; the more illuminated part of a landscape or other scene; opposed to shade.
definitions.definitionCn: 光线照射画面的方式；画面中代表光线应照射物体的部分；风景或其他场景中较亮的部分；与阴影相对。

definitions.definition: A point of view, or aspect from which a concept, person or thing is regarded.
definitions.example: I'm really seeing you in a different light today.
definitions.definitionCn: 看待概念、人或事物的视角或方面。
definitions.exampleCn: 我今天真的从不同角度看待你了。

definitions.definition: A flame or something used to create fire.
definitions.example: Hey, buddy, you got a light?
definitions.definitionCn: 火焰或用于生火的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 嘿，伙计，有火吗？

definitions.definition: A firework made by filling a case with a substance which burns brilliantly with a white or coloured flame.
definitions.example: a Bengal light
definitions.definitionCn: 一种烟花，通过在外壳中填充能发出白色或彩色火焰的燃烧物质制成。
definitions.exampleCn: 孟加拉烟火。

definitions.definition: A window, or space for a window in architecture.
definitions.example: This facade has eight south-facing lights.
definitions.definitionCn: 窗户，或建筑中留作窗户的空间。
definitions.exampleCn: 这面立面有八扇朝南的窗户。

definitions.definition: The series of squares reserved for the answer to a crossword clue.
definitions.example: The average length of a light on a 15×15 grid is 7 or 8.
definitions.definitionCn: 填字游戏答案对应的方格系列。
definitions.exampleCn: 15×15网格中一个单词的平均长度为7或8个字母。

definitions.definition: A cross-light in a double acrostic or triple acrostic.
definitions.definitionCn: 双行或三行字谜中的交叉提示。

definitions.definition: Open view; a visible state or condition; public observation; publicity.
definitions.definitionCn: 开阔视野；可见状态或条件；公众观察；公开性。

definitions.definition: The power of perception by vision.
definitions.definitionCn: 视觉感知能力。

definitions.definition: The brightness of the eye or eyes.
definitions.definitionCn: 眼睛的明亮度。

definitions.definition: A traffic light, or, by extension, an intersection controlled by one or more that will face a traveler who is receiving instructions.
definitions.example: To get to our house, turn right at the third light.
definitions.definitionCn: 交通信号灯，或引申为由一个或多个信号灯控制的交叉路口，这些信号灯为接受指示的旅行者提供指引。
definitions.exampleCn: 到我们家，在第三个红绿灯处右转。

definitions.definition: To start (a fire).
definitions.example: We lit the fire to get some heat.

definitions.definition: To set fire to; to set burning.
definitions.example: She lit her last match.

definitions.definition: To illuminate; to provide light for when it is dark.
definitions.example: I used my torch to light the way home through the woods in the night.

definitions.definition: To become ignited; to take fire.
definitions.example: This soggy match will not light.

definitions.definition: To attend or conduct with a light; to show the way to by means of a light.
To make (a bonus) available to be collected by hitting a target, and thus light up the feature light corresponding to that bonus to indicate its availability.
definitions.example: Light the extra ball by amassing 500 million points in the wizard mode.

definitions.definition: Having light; bright; clear; not dark or obscure.
definitions.example: The room is light when the Sun shines through the window.

definitions.definition: Pale or whitish in color; highly luminous and more or less deficient in chroma.
definitions.example: She had light skin.

definitions.definition: (of coffee) Served with extra milk or cream.
definitions.example: I like my coffee light.

definitions.definition: A stone that is not thrown hard enough.
See lights.
To unload a ship, or to jettison material to make it lighter
To lighten; to ease of a burden; to take off.
Having little or relatively little actual weight; not cumbrous or unwieldy.
definitions.example: a light load ; a lighter backpack after having removed the books ; light weapons

definitions.definition: Having little weight as compared with bulk; of little density or specific gravity.
definitions.example: feathers and cork are light ; oil is lighter than water

definitions.definition: Of short or insufficient weight; weighing less than the legal, standard or proper amount; clipped or diminished.
definitions.example: to issue light coin

definitions.definition: Lacking that which burdens or makes heavy.
Not heavy or soggy; spongy; well raised.
definitions.example: a light bread ; sponge cake is a light cake

definitions.definition: Gentle; having little force or momentum.
definitions.example: This artist clearly had a light, flowing touch.

definitions.definition: Easy to endure or perform.
definitions.example: light duties around the house

definitions.definition: Low in fat, calories, alcohol, salt, etc.
definitions.example: This light beer still gets you drunk if you have enough of it.

definitions.definition: Unimportant, trivial, having little value or significance.
definitions.example: I made some light comment, and we moved on.

definitions.definition: Unchaste, wanton.
Not encumbered; unembarrassed; clear of impediments; hence, active; nimble; swift.
Easily influenced by trifling considerations; unsteady; unsettled; volatile.
definitions.example: a light, vain person; a light mind

definitions.definition: Indulging in, or inclined to, levity; lacking dignity or solemnity; frivolous; airy.
definitions.example: Ogden Nash was a writer of light verse.

definitions.definition: Not quite sound or normal; somewhat impaired or deranged; dizzy; giddy.
Easily interrupted by stimulation.
definitions.example: light sleep; light anesthesia

definitions.definition: Carrying little.
definitions.example: I prefer to travel light.

definitions.definition: To find by chance.
definitions.example: I lit upon a rare book in a second-hand bookseller's.

definitions.definition: To stop upon (of eyes or a glance); to notice
To alight; to land or come down.
definitions.example: She fell out of the window but luckily lit on her feet.

definitions.definition: An act of lifting or raising.
definitions.definitionCn: 举起或抬起的动作。

definitions.definition: The act of transporting someone in a vehicle; a ride; a trip.
definitions.example: He gave me a lift to the bus station.
definitions.definitionCn: 用车辆运送某人的行为；搭车；行程。
definitions.exampleCn: 他让我搭车到公交车站。

definitions.definition: Mechanical device for vertically transporting goods or people between floors in a building; an elevator.
definitions.example: Take the lift to the fourth floor.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于在建筑物楼层间垂直运送货物或人员的机械装置；电梯。
definitions.exampleCn: 乘电梯到四楼。

definitions.definition: An upward force, such as the force that keeps aircraft aloft.
definitions.definitionCn: 向上的力，例如使飞机保持升空的力。

definitions.definition: (measurement) The difference in elevation between the upper pool and lower pool of a waterway, separated by lock.
definitions.definitionCn: （测量）水道中由船闸分隔的上游与下游之间的高度差。

definitions.definition: A thief.
definitions.definitionCn: 小偷。

definitions.definition: The lifting of a dance partner into the air.
definitions.definitionCn: 将舞伴举到空中的动作。

definitions.definition: Permanent construction with a built-in platform that is lifted vertically.
definitions.definitionCn: 带有内置平台、可垂直升降的永久性建筑。

definitions.definition: An improvement in mood.
definitions.definitionCn: 情绪的好转。

definitions.definition: The amount or weight to be lifted.
definitions.example: What's the maximum lift of this crane?
definitions.definitionCn: 被举起的东西的数量或重量。
definitions.exampleCn: 这台起重机的最大起重量是多少？

definitions.definition: The space or distance through which anything is lifted.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何物体被举起时经过的空间或距离。

definitions.definition: A rise; a degree of elevation.
definitions.example: the lift of a lock in canals
definitions.definitionCn: 上升；升高的程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 运河中船闸的升程。

definitions.definition: A liftgate.
definitions.definitionCn: 升降门。

definitions.definition: A rope leading from the masthead to the extremity of a yard below, and used for raising or supporting the end of the yard.
definitions.definitionCn: 从桅顶连接到下方帆桁末端的绳索，用于升起或支撑帆桁末端。

definitions.definition: One of the steps of a cone pulley.
definitions.definitionCn: 锥形皮带轮的台阶之一。

definitions.definition: (shoemaking) A layer of leather in the heel of a shoe.
definitions.definitionCn: （制鞋）鞋跟中的一层皮革。

definitions.definition: That portion of the vibration of a balance during which the impulse is given.
definitions.definitionCn: 摆轮振动中施加冲力的那部分。

definitions.definition: To raise or rise.
definitions.example: The fog eventually lifted, leaving the streets clear.
definitions.definitionCn: 举起或上升。
definitions.exampleCn: 雾最终散去，街道变得清晰。

definitions.definition: To steal.
definitions.definitionCn: 偷窃。

definitions.definition: To source directly without acknowledgement; to plagiarise.
definitions.definitionCn: 未经承认直接引用；剽窃。

definitions.definition: To arrest (a person).
definitions.definitionCn: 逮捕（某人）。

definitions.definition: To remove (a ban, restriction, etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 解除（禁令、限制等）。

definitions.definition: To alleviate, to lighten (pressure, tension, stress, etc.)
definitions.definitionCn: 减轻，缓解（压力、紧张、压力等）。

definitions.definition: To cause to move upwards.
definitions.definitionCn: 使向上移动。

definitions.definition: To lift weights; to weight-lift.
definitions.example: She lifts twice a week at the gym.
definitions.definitionCn: 举重；进行举重训练。
definitions.exampleCn: 她每周在健身房举重两次。

definitions.definition: To try to raise something; to exert the strength for raising or bearing.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图举起某物；用力举起或支撑。

definitions.definition: To elevate or improve in rank, condition, etc.; often with up.
definitions.definitionCn: 提升或改善等级、状况等；常与up连用。

definitions.definition: To bear; to support.
definitions.definitionCn: 承受；支撑。

definitions.definition: To collect, as moneys due; to raise.
definitions.definitionCn: 收取（应付款项）；筹集。

definitions.definition: To transform (a function) into a corresponding function in a different context.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（函数）转换为不同上下文中的对应函数。

definitions.definition: To buy a security or other asset previously offered for sale.
definitions.definitionCn: 购买先前已发售的证券或其他资产。

definitions.definition: Air.
The sky; the heavens; firmament; atmosphere.
A tool for finding whether a surface is level, or for creating a horizontal or vertical line of reference.
definitions.example: Hand me the level so I can tell if this is correctly installed.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于检测表面是否水平，或创建水平或垂直参考线的工具。
definitions.exampleCn: 把水平仪递给我，这样我就能判断这个安装是否正确。

definitions.definition: A distance relative to a given reference elevation.
definitions.example: By the end of the day, we'd dug down to the level of the old basement floor.
definitions.definitionCn: 相对于给定参考高程的距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 到一天结束时，我们已经挖到了旧地下室地板的高度。

definitions.definition: Degree or amount.
definitions.example: The sound level is much too high; this hurts my ears.   We've reached a new level of success.
definitions.definitionCn: 程度或数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 音量太高了，这伤了我的耳朵。我们达到了新的成功水平。

definitions.definition: Achievement or qualification.
definitions.example: She achieved a high level of distinction.
definitions.definitionCn: 成就或资格。
definitions.exampleCn: 她获得了很高的荣誉。

definitions.definition: Distance from the root node of a tree structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 从树结构根节点出发的距离。

definitions.definition: One of several discrete segments of a game, generally increasing in difficulty and representing different locations in the game world.
definitions.example: It took me weeks to get to level seven.   Watch out for the next level; the bad guys there are really overpowered.
definitions.definitionCn: 游戏中的几个独立关卡之一，通常难度递增，代表游戏世界中不同的地点。
definitions.exampleCn: 我花了几周才打到第七关。小心下一关，那里的敌人实在太强了。

definitions.definition: A numeric value that quantifies a character's experience and power.
definitions.example: My half-orc barbarian reached fifth level before he was squashed by a troll.
definitions.definitionCn: 量化角色经验和力量的数值。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的半兽人野蛮人在被巨魔压扁前达到了第五级。

definitions.definition: A floor of a multi-storey building.
definitions.example: Take the elevator and get off at the promenade level.
definitions.definitionCn: 多层建筑的一层。
definitions.exampleCn: 乘电梯到长廊层下车。

definitions.definition: An area of almost perfectly flat land.
definitions.definitionCn: 几乎完全平坦的土地区域。

definitions.definition: A school grade or year.
definitions.definitionCn: 学校的一个年级或学年。

definitions.definition: To adjust so as to make as flat or perpendicular to the ground as possible.
definitions.example: You can level the table by turning the pads that screw into the feet.
definitions.definitionCn: 调整以使尽可能平坦或垂直于地面。
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以通过旋转拧入桌脚的垫片来调平桌子。

definitions.definition: To destroy by reducing to ground level; to raze.
definitions.example: The hurricane leveled the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过夷为平地来摧毁；彻底破坏。
definitions.exampleCn: 飓风夷平了森林。

definitions.definition: To progress to the next level.
definitions.example: I levelled after defeating the dragon.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入下一级别。
definitions.exampleCn: 我打败龙后升级了。

definitions.definition: To aim or direct (a weapon, a stare, an accusation, etc).
definitions.example: He levelled an accusation of fraud at the directors.  The hunter levels the gun before taking a shot.
definitions.definitionCn: 瞄准或指向（武器、凝视、指控等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他向董事们提出了欺诈指控。猎人在开枪前瞄准了枪。

definitions.definition: To direct or impose (a penalty, fine, etc) at or upon (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 对（某人）施加或强加（惩罚、罚款等）。

definitions.definition: To make the score of a game equal.
definitions.definitionCn: 使比赛得分相等。

definitions.definition: To bring to a common level or plane, in respect of rank, condition, character, privilege, etc.
definitions.example: to level all the ranks and conditions of men
definitions.definitionCn: 在等级、条件、性格、特权等方面达到共同水平或平面。
definitions.exampleCn: 使所有等级和条件的人平等。

definitions.definition: To adjust or adapt to a certain level.
definitions.example: to level remarks to the capacity of children
definitions.definitionCn: 调整或适应到一定水平。
definitions.exampleCn: 使言论适应儿童的理解能力。

definitions.definition: (usually with "with") To speak honestly and openly with.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与“with”连用）坦诚地交谈。

definitions.definition: The same height at all places; parallel to a flat ground.
definitions.example: This table isn't quite level; see how this marble rolls off it?
definitions.definitionCn: 所有地方高度相同；与平坦地面平行。
definitions.exampleCn: 这张桌子不太平；看这颗弹珠怎么滚下去了？

definitions.definition: At the same height as some reference; constructed as level with.
definitions.example: We tried to hang the pictures so that the bottom of the frames were level with the dark line in the wallpaper.
definitions.definitionCn: 与某个参考高度相同；建造得与……齐平。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们试着挂画，让画框底部与墙纸上的深色线条齐平。

definitions.definition: Unvaried in frequency.
definitions.example: His pulse has been level for 12 hours.
definitions.definitionCn: 频率不变。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的脉搏已经平稳了12个小时。

definitions.definition: Unvaried in volume.
definitions.example: His voice has been unchanged. It has been level for 12 hours.
definitions.definitionCn: 音量不变。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的声音一直没变，平稳了12个小时。

definitions.definition: Calm.
definitions.example: He kept a level gaze.
definitions.definitionCn: 平静的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他保持着平静的凝视。

definitions.definition: In the same position or rank.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于相同位置或等级。

definitions.definition: Straightforward; direct; clear.
definitions.definitionCn: 直截了当的；直接的；清晰的。

definitions.definition: Well balanced; even; just; steady; impartial.
definitions.example: a level head; a level understanding
definitions.definitionCn: 平衡良好的；公正的；稳定的；不偏不倚的。
definitions.exampleCn: 冷静的头脑；公正的理解。

definitions.definition: Of even tone; without rising or falling inflection; monotonic.
definitions.definitionCn: 音调平稳；无升降变化；单调的。

definitions.definition: Perpendicular to a gravitational force.
definitions.example: The earth's oceans remain level in relation to the pull of gravity.
definitions.definitionCn: 垂直于重力。
definitions.exampleCn: 地球的海洋在重力作用下保持水平。

definitions.definition: To place; to set in a particular spot or position.
definitions.definitionCn: 放置；将某物置于特定地点或位置。

definitions.definition: To find out where something is located.
definitions.definitionCn: 查明某物的位置所在。

definitions.definition: To designate the site or place of; to define the limits of (Note: the designation may be purely descriptive: it need not be prescriptive.)
definitions.example: The council must locate the new hospital
definitions.definitionCn: 指定某物的地点或场所；界定其范围（注：该指定可以是纯粹描述性的，不必是规定性的）。
definitions.exampleCn: 委员会必须确定新医院的位置。

definitions.definition: To place oneself; to take up one's residence; to settle.
definitions.definitionCn: 安置自己；定居；安顿下来。

definitions.definition: The body of all written works.
definitions.definitionCn: 所有书面作品的总称。

definitions.definition: The collected creative writing of a nation, people, group or culture.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个国家、民族、群体或文化所积累的创造性写作。

definitions.definition: (usually preceded by the) All the papers, treatises etc. published in academic journals on a particular subject.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常前接定冠词）某一特定学科领域内发表于学术期刊的所有论文、专著等。

definitions.definition: Written fiction of a high standard.
definitions.example: However, even “literary” science fiction rarely qualifies as literature, because it treats characters as sets of traits rather than as fully realized human beings with unique life stories. —Adam Cadre, 2008
definitions.definitionCn: 具有高水准的虚构文学作品。
definitions.exampleCn: 然而，即便是“文学性”科幻小说也鲜少能称得上文学，因为它将人物视为一组特质，而非拥有独特人生经历的完整人类。——亚当·卡德尔，2008年

definitions.definition: An act or instance of lending, an act or instance of granting something for temporary use.
definitions.example: Because of the loan that John made to me, I was able to pay my tuition for the upcoming semester.
definitions.definitionCn: 借贷的行为或实例，即暂时提供某物的行为或实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 由于约翰借给我的那笔贷款，我得以支付下学期的学费。

definitions.definition: A sum of money or other property that a natural or legal person borrows from another with the condition that it be returned or repaid over time or at a later date (sometimes with interest).
definitions.example: All loans from the library, whether books or audio material, must be returned within two weeks.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然人或法人从他人处借入的一笔金钱或其他财产，条件是在一段时间后或将来某个日期归还或偿还（有时附带利息）。
definitions.exampleCn: 图书馆的所有借出物品，无论是书籍还是音频资料，都必须在两周内归还。

definitions.definition: The contract and array of legal or ethical obligations surrounding a loan.
definitions.example: He made a payment on his loan.
definitions.definitionCn: 围绕贷款产生的合同及一系列法律或道德义务。
definitions.exampleCn: 他支付了一笔贷款款项。

definitions.definition: The permission to borrow any item.
definitions.example: Thank you for the loan of your lawn mower.
definitions.definitionCn: 借用任何物品的许可。
definitions.exampleCn: 感谢你借给我割草机。

definitions.definition: To lend (something) to (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）借给（某人）。

definitions.definition: A lonnen.

A substance that is flowing, and keeping no shape, such as water; a substance of which the molecules, while not tending to separate from one another like those of a gas, readily change their relative position, and which therefore retains no definite shape, except that determined by the containing receptacle; an inelastic fluid.
definitions.example: A liquid can freeze to become a solid or evaporate into a gas.
definitions.definitionCn: 流动且无固定形状的物质，如水；其分子虽不像气体分子那样相互分离，但易改变相对位置，因此除容器所限形状外无固定形态；一种非弹性流体。
definitions.exampleCn: 液体可冻结成固体，或蒸发为气体。

definitions.definition: A class of consonant sounds that includes l and r.
definitions.definitionCn: 包括l和r的一类辅音。

definitions.definition: Flowing freely like water; fluid; not solid and not gaseous; composed of particles that move freely among each other on the slightest pressure.
definitions.example: liquid nitrogen
definitions.definitionCn: 像水一样自由流动；流体；非固态非气态；由在轻微压力下即可自由移动的粒子组成。
definitions.exampleCn: 液氮

definitions.definition: (of an asset) Easily sold or disposed of without losing value.
definitions.definitionCn: （资产）易于出售或处置而不损失价值。

definitions.definition: (of a market) Having sufficient trading activity to make buying or selling easy.
definitions.definitionCn: （市场）交易活跃，便于买卖。

definitions.definition: Flowing or sounding smoothly or without abrupt transitions or harsh tones.
definitions.example: a liquid melody
definitions.definitionCn: 流动或发声流畅，无突兀转折或刺耳音调。
definitions.exampleCn: 流畅的旋律

definitions.definition: Pronounced without any jar or harshness; smooth.
definitions.example: L and R are liquid letters.
definitions.definitionCn: 发音无刺耳或生硬感；平滑。
definitions.exampleCn: L和R是流音字母。

definitions.definition: Fluid and transparent.
definitions.example: the liquid air
definitions.definitionCn: 清澈透明的。
definitions.exampleCn: 液态空气

definitions.definition: Either of the two fleshy protrusions around the opening of the mouth.
definitions.definitionCn: 嘴唇：口腔开口周围的两个肉质突起之一。

definitions.definition: A part of the body that resembles a lip, such as the edge of a wound or the labia.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体上类似嘴唇的部分，如伤口边缘或阴唇。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The projecting rim of an open container; a short open spout.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）开口容器的突出边缘；短而敞开的壶嘴。

definitions.definition: Backtalk; verbal impertinence.
definitions.example: Don’t give me any lip!
definitions.definitionCn: 顶嘴；言语无礼。
definitions.exampleCn: 别跟我顶嘴！

definitions.definition: The edge of a high spot of land.
definitions.definitionCn: 高地边缘。

definitions.definition: The sharp cutting edge on the end of an auger.
definitions.definitionCn: 螺旋钻末端的锋利切削刃。

definitions.definition: One of the two opposite divisions of a labiate corolla.
definitions.definitionCn: 唇形花冠的两个相对裂片之一。

definitions.definition: The distinctive petal of the Orchis family.
definitions.definitionCn: 兰科植物的独特花瓣。

definitions.definition: One of the edges of the aperture of a univalve shell.
definitions.definitionCn: 单壳类贝壳开口的边缘之一。

definitions.definition: Embouchure: the condition or strength of a wind instrumentalist's lips.
definitions.definitionCn: 吹奏口型：管乐器演奏者嘴唇的状态或力度。

definitions.definition: To touch or grasp with the lips; to kiss; to lap the lips against (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 用嘴唇触碰或抓取；亲吻；用嘴唇轻触（某物）。

definitions.definition: (of something inanimate) To touch lightly.
definitions.definitionCn: （无生命物）轻触。

definitions.definition: To wash against a surface, lap.
definitions.definitionCn: 冲刷表面，拍打。

definitions.definition: To rise or flow up to or over the edge of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 上升或流动至某物边缘或越过边缘。

definitions.definition: To form the rim, edge or margin of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成某物的边缘、边界或边际。

definitions.definition: To utter verbally.
definitions.definitionCn: 用言语表达。

definitions.definition: To simulate speech by moving the lips without making any sound; to mouth.
definitions.definitionCn: 只动嘴唇不出声地模拟说话；做口型。

definitions.definition: To make a golf ball hit the lip of the cup, without dropping in.
definitions.definitionCn: 使高尔夫球碰到球洞边缘而未落入。

definitions.definition: To change the sound of (a musical note played on a wind instrument) by moving or tensing the lips.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过移动或绷紧嘴唇改变（管乐器吹奏音符）的声音。

definitions.definition: A person who lives near a given place.
definitions.example: It's easy to tell the locals from the tourists.
definitions.definitionCn: 住在某地附近的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 很容易区分当地人和游客。

definitions.definition: A branch of a nationwide organization such as a trade union.
definitions.example: I'm in the TWU, too. Local 6.
definitions.definitionCn: 全国性组织（如工会）的分支机构。
definitions.exampleCn: 我也是TWU的，第六分会。

definitions.definition: A train that stops at all, or almost all, stations between its origin and destination, including very small ones.
definitions.example: The expresses skipped my station, so I had to take a local.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种在其起点和终点之间所有或几乎所有车站（包括非常小的车站）都停靠的火车。
definitions.exampleCn: 快车跳过了我那一站，所以我只好坐慢车。

definitions.definition: One's nearest or regularly frequented public house or bar.
definitions.example: I got barred from my local, so I've started going all the way into town for a drink.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人最近或常去的酒吧。
definitions.exampleCn: 我被我的常去酒吧禁止入内了，所以开始一路进城喝酒。

definitions.definition: A locally scoped identifier.
definitions.example: Functional programming languages usually don't allow changing the immediate value of locals once they've been initialized, unless they're explicitly marked as being mutable.
definitions.definitionCn: 局部作用域的标识符。
definitions.exampleCn: 函数式编程语言通常不允许在局部变量初始化后改变其直接值，除非明确标记为可变。

definitions.definition: An item of news relating to the place where the newspaper is published.
definitions.definitionCn: 与报纸出版地相关的新闻。

definitions.definition: From or in a nearby location.
definitions.example: We prefer local produce.
definitions.definitionCn: 来自或位于附近地点。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们更喜欢本地农产品。

definitions.definition: (of a variable or identifier) Having limited scope (either lexical or dynamic); only being accessible within a certain portion of a program.
definitions.definitionCn: （变量或标识符）具有有限作用域（词法或动态）；只能在程序的特定部分访问。

definitions.definition: (of a condition or state) Applying to each point in a space rather than the space as a whole.
definitions.definitionCn: （条件或状态）适用于空间中的每个点而非整个空间。

definitions.definition: Of or pertaining to a restricted part of an organism.
definitions.example: The patient didn't want to be sedated, so we applied only local anesthesia.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于生物体受限部分的。
definitions.exampleCn: 病人不想被镇静，所以我们只用了局部麻醉。

definitions.definition: Descended from an indigenous population.
definitions.example: Hawaiian Pidgin is spoken by the local population.
definitions.definitionCn: 源自本土人口的。
definitions.exampleCn: 当地居民说夏威夷皮钦语。

definitions.definition: In the local area; within a city, state, country, etc.
definitions.example: It's never been more important to buy local.
definitions.definitionCn: 在本地范围内；在城市、州、国家等内。
definitions.exampleCn: 购买本地产品从未如此重要。

definitions.definition: An anesthetic (anesthetic substance) that causes loss of sensation only to the area to which it is applied.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种仅使涂抹区域失去感觉的麻醉剂（麻醉物质）。

definitions.definition: A strip of fabric, especially from the edge of a piece of cloth.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条布料，尤指从布匹边缘剪下的部分。

definitions.definition: Material used for cloth selvage.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于制作布边的材料。

definitions.definition: A register or roll of paper consisting of a compilation or enumeration of a set of possible items; the compilation or enumeration itself.
definitions.definitionCn: 一份记录或卷轴，包含一系列可能项目的汇编或列举；该汇编或列举本身。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The barriers or palisades used to fence off a space for jousting or tilting tournaments.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）用于围起比武或枪术比赛场地的栅栏或木桩。

definitions.definition: A codified representation of a list used to store data or in processing; especially, in the LISP programming language, a data structure consisting of a sequence of zero or more items.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于存储数据或处理过程的编码化列表表示；尤其在LISP编程语言中，由零个或多个项目组成的数据结构。

definitions.definition: A little square moulding; a fillet or listel.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种小方形线脚；细饰条或窄饰条。

definitions.definition: A narrow strip of wood, especially sapwood, cut from the edge of a board or plank.
definitions.definitionCn: 从木板或厚板边缘切下的窄木条，尤指边材。

definitions.definition: (ropemaking) A piece of woollen cloth with which the yarns are grasped by a worker.
definitions.definitionCn: （制绳工艺）工人用来抓握纱线的一块羊毛布。

definitions.definition: (tin-plate manufacture) The first thin coating of tin; a wire-like rim of tin left on an edge of the plate after it is coated.
definitions.definitionCn: （镀锡板制造）第一层薄锡涂层；镀锡后留在板边缘的线状锡边。

definitions.definition: A stripe.
definitions.definitionCn: 条纹。

definitions.definition: A boundary or limit; a border.
definitions.definitionCn: 边界或界限；边缘。

definitions.definition: To create or recite a list.
definitions.definitionCn: 创建或背诵列表。

definitions.definition: To place in listings.
definitions.definitionCn: 列入清单中。

definitions.definition: To sew together, as strips of cloth, so as to make a show of colours, or to form a border.
definitions.definitionCn: 将布条缝合在一起，以展示色彩或形成边缘。

definitions.definition: To cover with list, or with strips of cloth; to put list on; to stripe as if with list.
definitions.example: to list a door
definitions.definitionCn: 用列表或布条覆盖；给……加上列表；像用列表一样画条纹。
definitions.exampleCn: 给门镶边。

definitions.definition: To plough and plant with a lister.
definitions.definitionCn: 用条播机犁地并播种。

definitions.definition: To prepare (land) for a cotton crop by making alternating beds and alleys with a hoe.
definitions.definitionCn: 用锄头交替制作垄沟和通道，为棉花作物准备（土地）。

definitions.definition: To cut away a narrow strip, as of sapwood, from the edge of.
definitions.example: to list a board
definitions.definitionCn: 从边缘切下窄条，如边材。
definitions.exampleCn: 给木板修边。

definitions.definition: To enclose (a field, etc.) for combat.
definitions.definitionCn: 围起（田地等）用于战斗。

definitions.definition: To engage a soldier, etc.; to enlist.
definitions.definitionCn: 招募士兵等；征募。

definitions.definition: To engage in public service by enrolling one's name; to enlist.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过登记姓名从事公共服务；入伍。

definitions.definition: Art; craft; cunning; skill.
To listen.
To listen to.
Desire, inclination.
To be pleasing to.
To desire, like, or wish (to do something).
A tilt to a building.
A careening or tilting to one side, usually not intentionally or under a vessel's own power.
To cause (something) to tilt to one side.
definitions.example: the steady wind listed the ship

definitions.definition: To tilt to one side.
definitions.example: the ship listed to port

definitions.definition: Some text or a graphic in an electronic document that can be activated to display another document or trigger an action.
definitions.example: Click the hyperlink to go to the next page.
definitions.definitionCn: 电子文档中可被激活以显示另一文档或触发操作的文本或图形。
definitions.exampleCn: 点击超链接可跳转至下一页。

definitions.definition: (by extension) An address, URL, or program that defines a hyperlink's function.
definitions.example: Copy the hyperlink and paste it into an email.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）定义超链接功能的地址、URL或程序。
definitions.exampleCn: 复制超链接并粘贴到电子邮件中。

definitions.definition: A connection between places, people, events, things, or ideas.
definitions.example: The mayor’s assistant serves as the link to the media.
definitions.definitionCn: 地点、人物、事件、事物或想法之间的联系。
definitions.exampleCn: 市长的助理负责与媒体沟通。

definitions.definition: One element of a chain or other connected series.
definitions.example: The third link of the silver chain needs to be resoldered.
definitions.definitionCn: 链条或其他连接系列中的一个环节。
definitions.exampleCn: 银链的第三个环需要重新焊接。

definitions.definition: The connection between buses or systems.
definitions.example: A by-N-link is composed of N lanes.
definitions.definitionCn: 总线或系统之间的连接。
definitions.exampleCn: 一条N车道链路由N条车道组成。

definitions.definition: A space comprising one or more disjoint knots.

definitions.example: It's a lovely day and the sun is shining.
definitions.definitionCn: 美丽的；迷人的；在形态、外貌、语调或举止上非常令人愉悦。
definitions.exampleCn: 天气真好，阳光明媚。

definitions.definition: Very nice, wonderful.
definitions.example: It would be lovely to have a little more money to spend.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常好，极好。
definitions.exampleCn: 能多些钱花就太好了。

definitions.definition: Inspiring love or friendship; amiable.
definitions.definitionCn: 激发爱意或友谊的；和蔼可亲的。

definitions.definition: Loving, filled with love.
definitions.definitionCn: 充满爱意的，满怀爱意的。

definitions.definition: In a lovely fashion or manner; beautifully.
definitions.definitionCn: 以可爱的方式或姿态；美丽地。

definitions.definition: Worthy of praise.
A loud sound or part of a sound.
definitions.definitionCn: 响亮的声音或声音的一部分。

definitions.definition: High-quality marijuana.
definitions.definitionCn: 高品质的大麻。

definitions.definition: (of a sound) Of great intensity.
definitions.example: Turn that music down; it's too loud.
definitions.definitionCn: （指声音）强度很大的。
definitions.exampleCn: 把音乐关小点，太吵了。

definitions.definition: (of a person, thing, event, etc.) Noisy.
definitions.example: a loud party that went on all night

definitions.definition: (of a person, event, etc.) Not subtle or reserved, brash.

definitions.definition: (of clothing, decorations, etc.) Having unpleasantly and tastelessly contrasting colours or patterns; gaudy.
definitions.example: a loud style of dress;  loud colors
definitions.definitionCn: （指服装、装饰等）有令人不悦且俗气的对比色或图案的；花哨的。
definitions.exampleCn: 花哨的着装风格；俗艳的颜色

definitions.definition: (of marijuana) High-quality; premium; (by extension) having a strong or pungent odour indicating good quality
definitions.definitionCn: （指大麻）高品质的；优质的；（引申义）有强烈或刺鼻气味表明品质好的。

definitions.definition: Loudly.
A method of human thought that involves thinking in a linear, step-by-step manner about how a problem can be solved. Logic is the basis of many principles including the scientific method.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种人类思维方式，涉及以线性、逐步的方式思考如何解决问题。逻辑是许多原则（包括科学方法）的基础。

definitions.definition: The study of the principles and criteria of valid inference and demonstration.
definitions.definitionCn: 研究有效推理和论证的原则与标准。

definitions.definition: The mathematical study of relationships between rigorously defined concepts and of mathematical proof of statements.
definitions.definitionCn: 对严格定义的概念之间关系以及陈述的数学证明的数学研究。

definitions.definition: A formal or informal language together with a deductive system or a model-theoretic semantics.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种形式或非形式语言，连同演绎系统或模型论语义。

definitions.definition: Any system of thought, whether rigorous and productive or not, especially one associated with a particular person.
definitions.example: It's hard to work out his system of logic.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何思想体系，无论是否严谨且富有成效，尤其是与特定人物相关的体系。
definitions.exampleCn: 很难理解他的逻辑体系。

definitions.definition: The part of a system (usually electronic) that performs the boolean logic operations, short for logic gates or logic circuit.
definitions.example: Fred is designing the logic for the new controller.
definitions.definitionCn: 系统中执行布尔逻辑运算的部分（通常为电子部分），逻辑门或逻辑电路的简称。
definitions.exampleCn: 弗雷德正在设计新控制器的逻辑。

definitions.definition: To engage in excessive or inappropriate application of logic.
definitions.definitionCn: 过度或不恰当地应用逻辑。

definitions.definition: To apply logical reasoning to.
definitions.definitionCn: 运用逻辑推理。

definitions.definition: To overcome by logical argument.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过逻辑论证来克服。

definitions.definition: Logical
The master of the servants of a household; the master of a feudal manor
definitions.definitionCn: 一家之主的仆人总管；封建庄园的领主

definitions.definition: One possessing similar mastery over others; any feudal superior generally; any nobleman or aristocrat; any chief, prince, or sovereign ruler; in Scotland, a male member of the lowest rank of nobility (the equivalent rank in England is baron)
definitions.definitionCn: 在他人之上拥有类似支配权的人；泛指任何封建上级；任何贵族或显贵；任何首领、君主或统治者；在苏格兰，最低等级贵族中的男性成员（在英格兰对应等级为男爵）

definitions.definition: One possessing similar mastery in figurative senses (esp. as lord of ~)
definitions.definitionCn: 在比喻意义上拥有类似支配权的人（尤指作为……之主）

definitions.definition: The heavenly body considered to possess a dominant influence over an event, time, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 被认为对事件、时间等具有主导影响力的天体

definitions.definition: A hunchback.
definitions.definitionCn: 驼背者

definitions.definition: (via Cockney rhyming slang) Sixpence.
definitions.definitionCn: （源自伦敦押韵俚语）六便士

definitions.definition: Domineer or act like a lord.
definitions.definitionCn: 专横跋扈或摆出领主派头

definitions.definition: To invest with the dignity, power, and privileges of a lord; to grant the title of lord.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予领主尊严、权力与特权；赐予领主头衔

definitions.definition: To cause (something) to cease to be in one's possession or capability due to unfortunate or unknown circumstances, events or reasons.
definitions.example: He lost his hearing in the explosion.
definitions.definitionCn: 因不幸或未知的情况、事件或原因，使（某物）不再属于自己或失去掌控能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在爆炸中失去了听力。

definitions.definition: To wander from; to miss, so as not to be able to find; to go astray from.
definitions.example: I lost my way in the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏离；错过，以致无法找到；迷失方向。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在森林里迷了路。

definitions.definition: To fail to win (a game, competition, trial, etc).
definitions.example: We lost the football match.
definitions.definitionCn: 未能赢得（比赛、竞争、审判等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们输掉了足球比赛。

definitions.definition: To be unable to follow or trace (somebody or something) any longer.
definitions.example: Mission control lost the satellite as its signal died down.
definitions.definitionCn: 无法再追踪或跟随（某人或某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 随着信号减弱，任务控制中心失去了与卫星的联系。

definitions.definition: To cause (somebody) to be unable to follow or trace one any longer.
definitions.example: We managed to lose our pursuers in the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）无法再追踪或跟随自己。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们设法在森林里甩掉了追踪者。

definitions.definition: To cease exhibiting; to overcome (a behavior or emotion).
definitions.definitionCn: 不再表现出；克服（某种行为或情绪）。

definitions.definition: To shed, remove, discard, or eliminate.
definitions.example: When we get into the building, please lose the hat.
definitions.definitionCn: 脱落、移除、丢弃或消除。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们进入大楼后，请脱掉帽子。

definitions.definition: Of a clock, to run slower than expected.
definitions.example: It's already 5:30? My watch must have lost a few minutes.
definitions.definitionCn: （指钟表）走得比预期慢。
definitions.exampleCn: 已经5:30了？我的表肯定慢了几分钟。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To cause (someone) the loss of something; to deprive of.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）使（某人）失去某物；剥夺。

definitions.definition: To fail to catch with the mind or senses; to miss.
definitions.example: I lost a part of what he said.
definitions.definitionCn: 未能用头脑或感官捕捉到；错过。
definitions.exampleCn: 他说的有一部分我没听清。

definitions.definition: To cause to part with; to deprive of.
definitions.definitionCn: 使失去；剥夺。

definitions.definition: Fame, renown; praise.
The result of no longer possessing an object, a function, or a characteristic due to external causes or misplacement.
definitions.example: In other areas, glacier loss creates serious risk of a dry period across the Third Pole, Wang said.
definitions.definitionCn: 因外部原因或放错位置而不再拥有某物、某种功能或某种特性。
definitions.exampleCn: 在其他地区，冰川消融给第三极地区带来了严重的干旱风险，王说。

definitions.definition: The destruction or ruin of an object.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的毁坏或毁灭。

definitions.definition: Something that has been destroyed or ruined.
definitions.example: It was a terrible crash; both cars were total losses.
definitions.definitionCn: 已被毁坏或毁灭的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是一次可怕的撞车事故；两辆车都完全报废了。

definitions.definition: Defeat; an instance of being defeated.
definitions.example: The match ended in their first loss of the season.
definitions.definitionCn: 失败；被击败的情况。
definitions.exampleCn: 这场比赛以他们本赛季的首次失利告终。

definitions.definition: The death of a person or animal.
definitions.example: The battle was won, but losses were great.
definitions.definitionCn: 人或动物的死亡。
definitions.exampleCn: 战斗胜利了，但损失惨重。

definitions.definition: The condition of grief caused by losing someone or something, especially someone who has died.
definitions.example: Her daughter's sense of loss eventually led to depression.
definitions.definitionCn: 因失去某人或某物（尤其是已故之人）而引起的悲伤状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 她女儿的失落感最终导致了抑郁。

definitions.definition: (financial) The sum an entity loses on balance.
definitions.example: The sum of expenditures and taxes minus total income is a loss, when this difference is positive.
definitions.definitionCn: （财务）实体在结算中亏损的总额。
definitions.exampleCn: 支出和税收的总和减去总收入为亏损，当这一差值为正时。

definitions.definition: Electricity of kinetic power expended without doing useful work.
definitions.example: The inefficiency of many old-fashioned power plants exceeds 60% loss before the subsequent losses during transport over the grid.
definitions.definitionCn: 消耗的动能电力未做有用功。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多老式发电厂的效率低下，在电网传输过程中的后续损失之前，损失已超过60%。

definitions.definition: A large quantity or number; a great deal.

definitions.definitionCn: 大量或许多；很多。

definitions.definition: A separate portion; a number of things taken collectively.

definitions.definitionCn: 单独的部分；若干事物集合在一起。

definitions.definition: One or more items auctioned or sold as a unit, separate from other items.

definitions.definition: A number of people taken collectively.

definitions.definitionCn: 一群人集合在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 一群坏人。

definitions.definition: A distinct portion or plot of land, usually smaller than a field.

definitions.definitionCn: 一块明确划分的土地，通常比田地小。
definitions.exampleCn: 城市里的一块建筑用地。

definitions.definition: That which happens without human design or forethought.
definitions.definitionCn: 非人为设计或预谋而发生的事。

definitions.definition: Anything (as a die, pebble, ball, or slip of paper) used in determining a question by chance, or without human choice or will.

definitions.definitionCn: 任何用于通过随机方式决定问题的事物（如骰子、卵石、球或纸条），而非人为选择或意愿。

definitions.definition: The part, or fate, that falls to one, as it were, by chance, or without his planning.

definitions.definition: A prize in a lottery.

definitions.definition: Allotment; lottery.

definitions.definition: (definite, the lot) All members of a set; everything.

definitions.exampleCn: 如果我负责，我会把他们全部解雇。

definitions.definition: An old unit of weight used in many European countries from the Middle Ages, often defined as 1/30 or 1/32 of a (local) pound.

definitions.definition: To allot; to sort; to apportion.

definitions.definition: To count or reckon (on or upon).

definitions.definition: A lot; a great deal; tons; loads.

definitions.definitionCn: 许多；大量；吨；负载。
definitions.exampleCn: 别担心，我家有很多钱。

definitions.definition: A great deal; very much.

definitions.definitionCn: 非常；很多。
definitions.exampleCn: 我非常关心对动物的人道待遇。

definitions.definition: The release of an arrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 箭的释放。

definitions.definition: A state of laxity or indulgence; unrestrained freedom, abandonment.
definitions.definitionCn: 松懈或放纵的状态；无拘无束的自由，放任。

definitions.definition: All play other than set pieces (scrums and line-outs).
definitions.definitionCn: 除定位球（争球和边线球）外的所有比赛。

definitions.definition: Freedom from restraint.
definitions.definitionCn: 不受约束。

definitions.definition: A letting go; discharge.

definitions.definition: To let loose, to free from restraints.

definitions.definition: To unfasten, to loosen.

definitions.definition: To make less tight, to loosen.

definitions.definition: Of a grip or hold, to let go.
definitions.definitionCn: （指抓握或控制）松开，放手。

definitions.definition: To shoot (an arrow)
definitions.definitionCn: 射（箭）

definitions.definition: To set sail.
definitions.definitionCn: 起航。

definitions.definition: To solve; to interpret.
definitions.definitionCn: 解决；解释。

definitions.definition: Not fixed in place tightly or firmly.

definitions.definitionCn: 未固定牢固的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这辆独轮车有一个松动的轮子。

definitions.definition: Not held or packaged together.
definitions.example: 'You can buy apples in a pack, but they are cheaper loose.
definitions.definitionCn: 未捆扎或包装在一起的。

definitions.definition: Not under control.
definitions.example: The dog is loose again.
definitions.definitionCn: 不受控制的。
definitions.exampleCn: 狗又跑出来了。

definitions.definition: Not fitting closely
definitions.example: 'I wear loose clothes when it is hot.
definitions.definitionCn: 不贴合的。
definitions.exampleCn: “天热时我穿宽松的衣服。”

definitions.definition: Not compact.
definitions.example: 'It is difficult walking on loose gravel.
definitions.definitionCn: 不紧密的。
definitions.exampleCn: “在松散的砾石上行走很困难。”

definitions.definition: Relaxed.
definitions.example: She danced with a loose flowing movement.
definitions.definitionCn: 放松的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她以流畅的动作跳舞。

definitions.definition: Not precise or exact; vague; indeterminate.

definitions.definitionCn: 不精确或确切的；模糊的；不确定的。

definitions.definition: Indiscreet.

definitions.definitionCn: 轻率的。

definitions.definition: (somewhat dated) Free from moral restraint; immoral, unchaste.

definitions.definition: Not being in the possession of any competing team during a game.

definitions.definition: Not costive; having lax bowels.
definitions.definitionCn: 不便秘的；肠道通畅的。

definitions.definitionCn: 开始射击；释放你的箭。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A mutex or other token restricting access to a resource.

definitions.definition: A segment of a canal or other waterway enclosed by gates, used for raising and lowering boats between levels.
definitions.definitionCn: 运河或其他水道中被闸门封闭的一段，用于在不同水位间升降船只。

definitions.definition: The firing mechanism.
definitions.definitionCn: 击发机构。

definitions.definition: Complete control over a situation.
definitions.definitionCn: 对局势的完全掌控。

definitions.definition: Something sure to be a success.
definitions.definitionCn: 必定成功的事情。

definitions.definition: A player in the scrum behind the front row, usually the tallest members of the team.
definitions.definitionCn: 争球中位于前排之后的球员，通常是队中身材最高的成员。

definitions.definition: A fastening together or interlacing; a closing of one thing upon another; a state of being fixed or immovable.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定或交织在一起；一物闭合于另一物之上；处于固定或不可移动的状态。

definitions.definition: A place from which egress is prevented, as by a lock.
definitions.definitionCn: 无法离开的地方，如同被锁住一般。

definitions.definition: A device for keeping a wheel from turning.
definitions.definitionCn: 防止车轮转动的装置。

definitions.definition: A grapple in wrestling.
definitions.definitionCn: 摔跤中的擒拿动作。

definitions.definition: To become fastened in place.
definitions.example: If you put the brakes on too hard, the wheels will lock.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得固定不动。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果刹车踩得太猛，车轮会锁死。

definitions.definition: To fasten with a lock.
definitions.example: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
definitions.definitionCn: 用锁固定。
definitions.exampleCn: 离开时记得锁门。

definitions.definition: To be capable of becoming fastened in place.
definitions.example: This door locks with a key.
definitions.definitionCn: 能够被固定住。
definitions.exampleCn: 这扇门需要用钥匙锁上。

definitions.definition: To intertwine or dovetail.
definitions.example: We locked arms and stepped out into the night.
definitions.definitionCn: 交织或嵌合。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们挽起手臂，步入夜色。

definitions.definition: (break dancing) To freeze one's body or a part thereof in place.
definitions.example: a pop and lock routine
definitions.definitionCn: （霹雳舞）使身体或身体某部分定格。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个定格与锁定的舞蹈动作。

definitions.definition: To furnish (a canal) with locks.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（运河）安装船闸。

definitions.definition: To raise or lower (a boat) in a lock.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过船闸升降（船只）。

definitions.definition: To seize (e.g. the sword arm of an antagonist) by turning the left arm around it, to disarm him.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过左臂缠绕对手持剑手臂来夺取（对手的剑）以解除其武装。

definitions.definition: To modify (a thread) so that users cannot make new posts in it.
definitions.definitionCn: 修改（帖子）使用户无法在其中发布新内容。

definitions.definition: (WMF jargon) To prevent a page from being edited by other users.
definitions.example: Frequently vandalized pages are generally locked to prevent further damage.
definitions.definitionCn: （维基媒体术语）阻止其他用户编辑页面。

definitions.definition: A tuft or length of hair, wool etc.
A small quantity of straw etc.
A quantity of meal, the perquisite of a mill-servant.
Having or demonstrating undivided and constant support for someone or something.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某人或某事给予或表现出坚定不移、持续不断的支持。

definitions.definition: Firm in allegiance to a person or institution.
definitions.definitionCn: 对个人或机构忠诚不渝。

definitions.definition: Faithful to a person or cause.
definitions.definitionCn: 忠于某人或某项事业。

definitions.definition: A light meal usually eaten around midday, notably when not as main meal of the day.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常在中午食用的便餐，尤其不作为当日主餐时。

definitions.definition: A break in play between the first and second sessions.
definitions.definitionCn: 第一场和第二场比赛之间的休息时间。

definitions.definition: (Minnesota) Any small meal, especially one eaten at a social gathering.
definitions.example: After the funeral there was a lunch for those who didn't go to the cemetery.
definitions.definitionCn: （明尼苏达州）任何小餐，尤指社交聚会上食用的。
definitions.exampleCn: 葬礼后，为未去墓地的人准备了午餐。

definitions.definition: To eat lunch.
definitions.example: I like to lunch in Italian restaurants.
definitions.definitionCn: 吃午餐。
definitions.exampleCn: 我喜欢在意大利餐厅吃午餐。

definitions.definition: To treat to lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 请客吃午餐。

definitions.definition: A biological organ of vertebrates that controls breathing and oxygenates the blood.
definitions.definitionCn: 脊椎动物控制呼吸和使血液氧化的生物器官。

definitions.definition: (plural) Capacity for exercise or exertion; breath.
definitions.example: He hasn't the lungs to play long rallies like he use to.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）运动或劳累的能力；呼吸。
definitions.exampleCn: 他不再像以前那样有足够的肺活量来打长时间的拉锯战。

definitions.definition: That which supplies oxygen or fresh air, such as trees, parklands, forest, etc., to a place.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某地提供氧气或新鲜空气的事物，如树木、公园绿地、森林等。

definitions.definition: A non-academic periodical publication, generally consisting of sheets of paper folded in half and stapled at the fold.
definitions.definitionCn: 非学术性期刊出版物，通常由对折并用订书钉装订的纸张组成。

definitions.definition: An ammunition storehouse.
definitions.definitionCn: 弹药库。

definitions.definition: A chamber in a firearm enabling multiple rounds of ammunition to be fed into the firearm.
definitions.definitionCn: 枪械中用于将多发弹药送入枪膛的装置。

definitions.definition: A reservoir or supply chamber for a stove, battery, camera, typesetting machine, or other apparatus.
definitions.definitionCn: 炉具、电池、相机、排字机或其他设备的储料或供料室。

definitions.definition: A country or district especially rich in natural products.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然资源特别丰富的国家或地区。

definitions.definition: A city viewed as a marketing center.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为营销中心的城市。

definitions.definition: A store, or shop, where goods are kept for sale.
definitions.definitionCn: 存放商品以供销售的商店或店铺。

definitions.definition: Short for mainline.
definitions.definitionCn: 主线（游戏术语）。

definitions.definition: To mainly play a specific character, or side, during a game.
definitions.example: He mains the same character as me in that game.
definitions.definitionCn: 在游戏中主要扮演某个特定角色或阵营。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在那款游戏里和我主玩同一个角色。

definitions.definition: Of a road: to convert into a main or primary road.
definitions.definitionCn: （道路）改造成主干道。

definitions.definition: Of chief or leading importance; prime, principal.
definitions.definitionCn: 首要或主导地位的；主要的，首要的。

definitions.definition: Chief, most important, or principal in extent, size, or strength; consisting of the largest part.
definitions.example: main timbers  main branch of a river  main body of an army
definitions.definitionCn: 在范围、规模或强度上最重要的；由最大部分组成的。
definitions.exampleCn: 主梁 河流主干 军队主力

definitions.definition: (of force, strength, etc.) Full, sheer, undivided.
definitions.definitionCn: （力量、强度等）完全的，纯粹的，未分割的。

definitions.definition: Big; angry.
definitions.definitionCn: 巨大的；愤怒的。

definitions.definition: Belonging to or connected with the principal mast in a vessel.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或连接船只主桅的。

definitions.definition: Great in size or degree; important, powerful, strong, vast.
definitions.definitionCn: 规模或程度大的；重要的，强大的，有力的，广阔的。

definitions.definition: Exceedingly, extremely, greatly, mightily, very, very much.
definitions.definitionCn: 极其，非常，极大地，强有力地，很，非常。

definitions.definition: That which is chief or principal; the chief or main portion; the bulk, the greater part, gross.
A large cable or pipe providing utility service to an area or a building, such as a water main or electric main.
Short for main course.
definitions.example: I had scampi and chips for my main and a slice of cheesecake for dessert.

definitions.definition: The high seas.
The mainland.
Short for mainsail.
(except in might and main) Force, power, strength, violent effort.
A hand or match in a game of dice.
The largest throw in a match at dice; in the game of hazard, a number from one to nine called out by a person before the dice are thrown.
A stake played for at dice.
A sporting contest or match, especially a cockfighting match.
A banker's shovel for coins.
A basket for gathering grapes.
Something that happens to someone by chance, a chance occurrence, especially a favourable one.
definitions.example: Gilbert had some bad luck yesterday — he got pick-pocketed and lost fifty dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: 偶然发生在某人身上的事，意外事件，尤指好事。
definitions.exampleCn: 吉尔伯特昨天运气不好——他被扒手偷了五十美元。

definitions.definition: A superstitious feeling that brings fortune or success.
definitions.example: He blew on the dice for luck.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种迷信的感觉，认为能带来好运或成功。
definitions.exampleCn: 他对着骰子吹了口气以求好运。

definitions.definition: Success.
definitions.example: He has a lot of luck with the ladies, perhaps it is because of his new motorbike.
definitions.definitionCn: 成功。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在女性中很有运气，也许是因为他的新摩托车。

definitions.definition: The results of a random number generator.
definitions.example: The creators of tool-assisted speedruns often manipulate a lot of luck to get the most favorable results in order to save the most time.
definitions.definitionCn: 随机数生成器的结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 工具辅助速通的创作者们经常操控大量运气来获得最有利的结果，以节省最多时间。

definitions.definition: To succeed by chance.
definitions.example: His plan lucked out.
definitions.definitionCn: 靠运气成功。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的计划侥幸成功了。

definitions.definition: To rely on luck.
definitions.example: No plan. We're just to going to have to luck through.
definitions.definitionCn: 依赖运气。
definitions.exampleCn: 没有计划。我们只能碰运气了。

definitions.definition: To carry out relying on luck.
definitions.example: Our plan is to luck it through.
definitions.definitionCn: 靠运气执行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的计划就是碰运气完成。

definitions.definition: A device that directs and controls energy, often in the form of movement or electricity, to produce a certain effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种引导和控制能量的装置，通常以运动或电力的形式产生特定效果。

definitions.definition: A vehicle operated mechanically, such as an automobile or an airplane.
definitions.definitionCn: 机械驱动的交通工具，如汽车或飞机。

definitions.definition: (abbreviation) An answering machine or, by extension, voice mail.
definitions.example: I called you earlier, but all I got was the machine.
definitions.definitionCn: （缩写）答录机，或引申为语音信箱。
definitions.exampleCn: 我之前给你打过电话，但只听到了机器应答。

definitions.definition: A computer.
definitions.example: Game developers assume they're pushing the limits of the machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 计算机。
definitions.exampleCn: 游戏开发者认为他们正在突破机器的极限。

definitions.definition: A person or organisation that seemingly acts like a machine, being particularly efficient, single-minded, or unemotional.
definitions.example: Bruce Campbell was a "demon-killing machine" because he made quick work of killing demons.
definitions.definitionCn: 看似像机器一样高效、专注或冷漠的人或组织。
definitions.exampleCn: 布鲁斯·坎贝尔是个“杀魔机器”，因为他能迅速消灭恶魔。

definitions.definition: Especially, the group that controls a political or similar organization; a combination of persons acting together for a common purpose, with the agencies which they use.
definitions.definitionCn: 特指控制政治或类似组织的团体；为共同目标而行动的一群人及其使用的机构。

definitions.definition: Supernatural agency in a poem, or a superhuman being introduced to perform some exploit.
definitions.definitionCn: 诗歌中的超自然媒介，或为完成某项壮举而引入的超人类存在。

definitions.definition: The system of special interest groups that supports a political party, especially in urban areas.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持政党的特殊利益集团体系，尤其在城区。

definitions.definition: Penis.
definitions.definitionCn: 阴茎。

definitions.definition: A contrivance in the Ancient Greek theatre for indicating a change of scene, by means of which a god might cross the stage or deliver a divine message; the deus ex machina.
definitions.definitionCn: 古希腊戏剧中用于指示场景变换的装置，神可通过它穿越舞台或传达神谕；即“机械降神”。

definitions.definition: A bathing machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 沐浴机。

definitions.definition: To make by machinery.
definitions.definitionCn: 用机器制造。

definitions.definition: To shape or finish by machinery.
definitions.definitionCn: 用机器塑形或精加工。

definitions.definition: The application of rituals or actions, especially those based on occult knowledge, to subdue or manipulate natural or supernatural beings and forces in order to have some benefit from them
definitions.definitionCn: 运用仪式或行为，尤其是基于神秘知识的行为，以制服或操控自然或超自然存在及力量，从而从中获益

definitions.definition: A specific ritual or procedure associated with such magic; a spell.
definitions.definitionCn: 与这种魔法相关的特定仪式或程序；咒语

definitions.definition: The supernatural forces which are drawn on in such a ritual
definitions.definitionCn: 此类仪式中所调用的超自然力量

definitions.definition: Something producing successful and remarkable results, especially when not fully understood; an enchanting quality; exceptional skill.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生成功且显著结果的事物，尤其是当未被完全理解时；迷人的特质；非凡的技巧

definitions.definition: A conjuring trick or illusion performed to give the appearance of supernatural phenomena or powers.
definitions.definitionCn: 为呈现超自然现象或力量而表演的戏法或幻术

definitions.definition: The art or practice of performing conjuring tricks and illusions.
definitions.definitionCn: 表演戏法和幻术的艺术或实践

definitions.definition: Complicated or esoteric code that is not expected to be generally understood.
definitions.definitionCn: 不期望被普遍理解的复杂或深奥代码

definitions.definition: To produce, transform (something), (as if) by magic.
definitions.definitionCn: （仿佛）通过魔法产生、转变（某物）

definitions.definition: Having supernatural talents, properties or qualities attributed to magic.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有归因于魔法的超自然天赋、属性或特质

definitions.definition: Producing extraordinary results, as though through the use of magic; wonderful, amazing.
definitions.example: a magic moment
definitions.definitionCn: 产生非凡结果，如同使用了魔法；奇妙、令人惊叹
definitions.exampleCn: 神奇时刻

definitions.definition: Pertaining to conjuring tricks or illusions performed for entertainment etc.
definitions.example: a magic show; a magic trick
definitions.definitionCn: 与娱乐表演中的戏法或幻术相关的
definitions.exampleCn: 魔术表演；魔术把戏

definitions.definition: Great; excellent.
definitions.example: — I cleaned up the flat while you were out. — Really? Magic!
definitions.definitionCn: 极好的；出色的
definitions.exampleCn: ——你出去时我把公寓打扫干净了。——真的吗？太棒了！

definitions.definition: Describing the number of nucleons in a particularly stable isotopic nucleus; 2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126, and 184.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述特别稳定的同位素原子核中的核子数：2、8、20、28、50、82、126和184

definitions.definition: Being a literal number or string value with no meaning or context, not defined as a constant or variable
definitions.example: The code is full of magic numbers and we can't figure out what they mean.
definitions.definitionCn: 指没有意义或上下文的字面数字或字符串值，未定义为常量或变量
definitions.exampleCn: 代码中充满了魔法数字，我们无法理解它们的含义

definitions.definition: To be or become mad.
definitions.definitionCn: 发疯或变得疯狂。

definitions.definition: To madden, to anger, to frustrate.
definitions.definitionCn: 使发怒，使生气，使沮丧。

definitions.definition: Insane; crazy, mentally deranged.
definitions.example: He's got this mad idea that he's irresistible to women.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神错乱的；疯狂的，精神失常的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他有个疯狂的想法，认为自己让女人无法抗拒。

definitions.definition: (chiefly US; informal in UK) Angry, annoyed.
definitions.example: Are you mad at me?
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于美国；英国非正式）生气的，恼怒的。
definitions.exampleCn: 你在生我的气吗？

definitions.definition: Bizarre; incredible.
definitions.example: It's mad that I got that job back a day after being fired.
definitions.definitionCn: 离奇的；难以置信的。
definitions.exampleCn: 被解雇一天后我又拿回了那份工作，真是不可思议。

definitions.definition: Wildly confused or excited.
definitions.example: to be mad with terror, lust, or hatred
definitions.definitionCn: 极度困惑或兴奋。
definitions.exampleCn: 因恐惧、欲望或仇恨而发狂。

definitions.definition: Extremely foolish or unwise; irrational; imprudent.
definitions.definitionCn: 极其愚蠢或不明智的；非理性的；轻率的。

definitions.definition: (usually with for or about) Extremely enthusiastic about; crazy about; infatuated with; overcome with desire for.
definitions.example: Aren't you just mad for that red dress?
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与for或about连用）对……极度热衷；痴迷于；迷恋；渴望。
definitions.exampleCn: 你是不是对那条红裙子痴迷得不行？

definitions.definition: (of animals) Abnormally ferocious or furious; or, rabid, affected with rabies.
definitions.example: a mad dog
definitions.definitionCn: （指动物）异常凶猛或狂暴的；或患狂犬病的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一条疯狗。

definitions.definition: (chiefly Northeastern US) Intensifier, signifies an abundance or high quality of a thing; very, much or many.
definitions.example: I gotta give you mad props for scoring us those tickets.   Their lead guitarist has mad skills.   There are always mad girls at those parties.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于美国东北部）强调词，表示某物数量多或质量高；非常，很多。
definitions.exampleCn: 我真心佩服你搞到了那些票。他们的主音吉他手技艺超群。那些派对上总是有很多女孩。

definitions.definition: (of a compass needle) Having impaired polarity.
definitions.definitionCn: （指指南针指针）极性受损的。

definitions.definition: Intensifier; to a large degree; extremely; exceedingly; very; unbelievably.
definitions.example: He seems mad keen on her.
definitions.definitionCn: 强调词；在很大程度上；极其；非常；难以置信地。
definitions.exampleCn: 他似乎对她痴迷得不得了。

definitions.definition: Situated close to, or even below, the ground or another normal reference plane; not high or lofty.
definitions.example: a low wall  a low shelf
definitions.definitionCn: 靠近甚至低于地面或其他正常参考平面；不高或高耸的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一堵矮墙 一个低矮的架子

definitions.definition: Of less than normal height; below the average or normal level from which elevation is measured.
definitions.example: a low bow
definitions.definitionCn: 低于正常高度；低于测量高度的平均水平或正常水平。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个低头的鞠躬

definitions.definition: Not high in status, esteem or rank, dignity, or quality. (Compare vulgar.)
definitions.example: Now that was low even for you!
definitions.definitionCn: 在地位、尊重、等级、尊严或品质上不高。（比较：粗俗的。）
definitions.exampleCn: 就算对你来说，那也太低劣了！

definitions.definition: Humble, meek, not haughty.
definitions.definitionCn: 谦卑的，温顺的，不傲慢的。

definitions.definition: Disparaging; assigning little value or excellence.
definitions.example: She had a low opinion of cats. He took a low view of dogs.
definitions.definitionCn: 贬低的；认为价值或优点很少的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她对猫评价很低。他对狗评价不高。

definitions.definition: Being a nadir, a bottom.
definitions.example: the low point in her career
definitions.definitionCn: 处于最低点，底部。
definitions.exampleCn: 她职业生涯的低谷

definitions.definition: Depressed in mood, dejected, sad.
definitions.example: low spirits
definitions.definitionCn: 情绪低落，沮丧，悲伤。
definitions.exampleCn: 情绪低落

definitions.definition: Lacking health or vitality, strength or vivacity; feeble; weak.
definitions.example: a low pulse
definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏健康或活力、力量或生气；虚弱的；无力的。
definitions.exampleCn: 脉搏微弱

definitions.definition: Small, not high (in amount or quantity, value, force, energy, etc).
definitions.example: My credit union charges a low interest rate.   Jogging during a whiteout, with such low temperatures and low visibility, is dangerous.   The store sold bread at low prices, and milk at even lower prices.   The contractors gave a low estimate of the costs.   low cholesterol   a low voltage wire   a low number
definitions.definitionCn: 小的，不高的（在数量、价值、力量、能量等方面）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的信用合作社收取低利率。在暴风雪中慢跑，温度如此低、能见度如此差，是很危险的。这家商店以低价出售面包，牛奶的价格甚至更低。承包商给出了较低的成本估算。低胆固醇 一根低压电线 一个低数字

definitions.definition: Simple in complexity or development; (in several set phrases) favoring simplicity; (see e.g. low church, Low Tory).
definitions.example: low protozoan animals, low cryptogamic plants, and other low organisms
definitions.definitionCn: 在复杂性或发展程度上简单的；（在几个固定短语中）倾向于简单的；（例如，参见低教会派、低托利党）。
definitions.exampleCn: 低等原生动物、低等隐花植物和其他低等生物

definitions.definition: (in several set phrases) Being near the equator.
definitions.example: the low northern latitudes
definitions.definitionCn: （在几个固定短语中）靠近赤道的。
definitions.exampleCn: 低北纬地区

definitions.definition: (acoustics) Grave in pitch, due to being produced by relatively slow vibrations (wave oscillations); flat.
definitions.example: Generally, European men have lower voices than their Indian counterparts.
definitions.definitionCn: （声学）音调低沉，由于由相对较慢的振动（波振荡）产生；平坦的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一般来说，欧洲男性的嗓音比印度男性低沉。

definitions.definition: Quiet; soft; not loud.
definitions.example: They spoke in low voices so I would not hear what they were saying.
definitions.definitionCn: 安静的；轻柔的；不响亮的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们低声说话，这样我就听不到他们在说什么。

definitions.definition: Made with a relatively large opening between the tongue and the palate; made with (part of) the tongue positioned low in the mouth, relative to the palate.
definitions.definitionCn: 发音时舌头与上颚之间开口相对较大；舌头（部分）在口腔中位置较低，相对于上颚。

definitions.definition: Lesser in value than other cards, denominations, suits, etc.
definitions.example: a low card
definitions.definitionCn: 价值低于其他牌、面值、花色等的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一张小牌

definitions.definition: Not rich or seasoned; offering the minimum of nutritional requirements; plain, simple.
definitions.definitionCn: 不丰富或不加调料的；提供最低营养需求的；简单的，朴素的。

definitions.definition: (of an automobile, gear, etc) Designed for a slow (or the slowest) speed.
definitions.example: low gear
definitions.definitionCn: （指汽车、齿轮等）设计用于低速（或最慢速度）的。
definitions.exampleCn: 低速挡

definitions.definition: Close to the ground.
definitions.definitionCn: 靠近地面。

definitions.definition: Of a pitch, at a lower frequency.
definitions.definitionCn: （指音高）频率较低的。

definitions.definition: With a low voice or sound; not loudly; gently.
definitions.example: to speak low
definitions.definitionCn: 用低沉的声音或声音；不响亮地；轻柔地。
definitions.exampleCn: 低声说话

definitions.definition: Under the usual price; at a moderate price; cheaply.
definitions.example: He sold his wheat low.
definitions.definitionCn: 低于通常价格；以适中价格；便宜地。
definitions.exampleCn: 他以低价出售了他的小麦。

definitions.definition: In a low mean condition; humbly; meanly.
definitions.definitionCn: 在低微的状态下；谦卑地；卑贱地。

definitions.definition: In a time approaching our own.
definitions.definitionCn: 在接近我们时代的时期。

definitions.definition: In a path near the equator, so that the declination is small, or near the horizon, so that the altitude is small; said of the heavenly bodies with reference to the diurnal revolution.
definitions.example: The moon runs low, i.e. comparatively near the horizon when on or near the meridian.
definitions.definitionCn: 在靠近赤道的路径上，因此赤纬很小，或靠近地平线，因此高度很小；指天体相对于周日运动。
definitions.exampleCn: 月亮运行得很低，即当在子午线上或附近时相对靠近地平线。

definitions.definition: To let descend by its own weight, as something suspended; to let down
definitions.example: lower a bucket into a well
definitions.definitionCn: 让悬挂物靠自身重量下降；放低
definitions.exampleCn: 把水桶放到井里

definitions.definition: To pull down
definitions.example: to lower a flag
definitions.definitionCn: 拉下
definitions.exampleCn: 降下旗帜

definitions.definition: To reduce the height of
definitions.example: lower a chimney or turret
definitions.definitionCn: 降低高度
definitions.exampleCn: 降低烟囱或塔楼

definitions.definition: To depress as to direction
definitions.example: lower the aim of a gun
definitions.definitionCn: 压低方向
definitions.exampleCn: 降低枪的瞄准点

definitions.definition: To make less elevated
definitions.example: to lower one's ambition, aspirations, or hopes
definitions.definitionCn: 使不那么崇高
definitions.exampleCn: 降低某人的抱负、志向或希望
