definitions.definitionCn: 集合或其他数学结构的最大值，特别是函数的全局最大值或局部最大值

definitions.definition: An upper bound of a set which is also an element of that set
definitions.definitionCn: 集合的上界，且该上界也是该集合的一个元素

definitions.definition: The largest value of a batch or sample or the upper bound of a probability distribution
definitions.definitionCn: 一批或样本的最大值，或概率分布的上界

definitions.definition: A 147 break; the highest possible break
definitions.definitionCn: 147分满分杆；可能的最高得分

definitions.definition: A score of 180 with three darts
definitions.definitionCn: 三镖投出180分

definitions.definition: A scoring shot for 6 runs
definitions.definitionCn: 一次得6分的击球得分

definitions.definition: To the highest degree.
definitions.example: Use the proper dose for the maximum effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 达到最高程度
definitions.exampleCn: 使用适当剂量以达到最大效果

definitions.definition: Substance, material.
definitions.definitionCn: 物质，材料。

definitions.definition: A condition, subject or affair, especially one of concern.
definitions.example: What's the matter?;   state matters
definitions.definitionCn: 状况、主题或事务，尤指令人关切之事。
definitions.exampleCn: 怎么了？；陈述事宜

definitions.definition: An approximate amount or extent.
definitions.example: I stayed for a matter of months.
definitions.definitionCn: 大约的数量或程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 我待了大约几个月。

definitions.definition: The essence; the pith; the embodiment.
definitions.definitionCn: 本质；精髓；体现。

definitions.definition: Inducing cause or reason, especially of anything disagreeable or distressing.
definitions.definitionCn: 诱因或理由，尤指令人不快或痛苦之事。

definitions.definition: Pus.
definitions.definitionCn: 脓液。

definitions.definition: To be important.
definitions.example: Sorry for pouring ketchup on your clean white shirt! - Oh, don't worry, it does not matter.
definitions.definitionCn: 重要。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱歉把番茄酱洒在你干净的白衬衫上了！——哦，别担心，没关系。

definitions.definition: (in negative constructions) To care about, to mind; to find important.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于否定结构）在乎，介意；认为重要。

definitions.definition: To form pus or matter, as an abscess; to maturate.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成脓液或物质，如脓肿；化脓。

definitions.definition: (physical) Matter, material.
definitions.definitionCn: （物理）物质，材料。

definitions.definition: A large quantity; a sum.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量；总数。

definitions.definition: To form or collect into a mass; to form into a collective body; to bring together into masses; to assemble.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成或聚集为团块；形成集体；聚集成团；集合。

definitions.definition: To have a certain mass.
definitions.example: I mass 70 kilograms.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有特定质量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我体重70公斤。

definitions.definition: Involving a mass of things; concerning a large quantity or number.
definitions.example: There is evidence of mass extinctions in the distant past.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及大量事物；关于大数量或大数目。
definitions.exampleCn: 有证据表明远古时期发生过大规模灭绝。

definitions.definition: Involving a mass of people; of, for, or by the masses.
definitions.example: Mass unemployment resulted from the financial collapse.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及大量人群；属于、为了或由大众进行的。
definitions.exampleCn: 金融崩溃导致了大规模失业。

definitions.definition: The Eucharist, now especially in Roman Catholicism.
Celebration of the Eucharist.
(usually as the Mass) The sacrament of the Eucharist.
A musical setting of parts of the mass.
To celebrate mass.
The chief executive of the municipal government of a city, borough, &c., formerly usually appointed as a caretaker by European royal courts but now usually appointed or elected locally.
definitions.definitionCn: 市长：城市、自治市等地方政府的首席执行官，过去通常由欧洲王室任命为临时管理者，现在通常由地方任命或选举产生。

definitions.definition: Short for mayor of the palace, the royal stewards of the Frankish Empire.
definitions.definitionCn: 宫相（mayor of the palace的简称）：法兰克帝国的王室总管。

definitions.definition: Synonym of mair, various former officials in the Kingdom of Scotland.
definitions.definitionCn: 苏格兰王国各类前官员的同义词（mair）。

definitions.definition: A member of a city council.
definitions.definitionCn: 市议会议员。

definitions.definition: A high justice, an important judge.
definitions.definitionCn: 高级法官，重要审判官。

definitions.definition: A largely ceremonial position in some municipal governments that presides over the city council while a contracted city manager holds actual executive power.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些市政府中主要担任礼仪职务的官员，主持市议会，而实际行政权力由合同聘用的城市经理掌握。

definitions.definition: A local VIP, a muckamuck or big shot reckoned to lead some local group.
definitions.definitionCn: 地方要人，被视为领导某地方团体的权贵或大人物。

definitions.definition: The state of being married.
definitions.example: You should enter marriage for love.
definitions.definitionCn: 已婚状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 你应当为爱而结婚。

definitions.definition: A union of two or more people that creates a family tie and carries legal, social, and/or religious rights and responsibilities.
definitions.definitionCn: 两人或多人结合形成家庭纽带，并承担法律、社会和/或宗教权利与责任的关系。

definitions.definition: A homosexual relationship between male prisoners.
definitions.definitionCn: 男囚犯之间的同性恋关系。

definitions.definition: A wedding; a ceremony in which people wed.
definitions.example: You are cordially invited to the marriage of James Smith and Jane Doe.
definitions.definitionCn: 婚礼；人们结婚的仪式。
definitions.exampleCn: 诚挚邀请您参加詹姆斯·史密斯与简·多伊的婚礼。

definitions.definition: A close union.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧密的结合。

definitions.definition: A joining of two parts.
definitions.definitionCn: 两个部分的连接。

definitions.definition: A king and a queen, when held as a hand in Texas hold 'em or melded in pinochle.
definitions.definitionCn: 在德州扑克中作为手牌，或在皮诺克尔中组合成的一对国王与王后。

definitions.definition: In solitaire or patience games, the placing a card of the same suit on the next one above or below it in value.
definitions.definitionCn: 在单人纸牌或耐心游戏中，将同花色的牌放在相邻的上一张或下一张牌上。

definitions.definition: To enter into the conjugal or connubial state; to take a husband or a wife.
definitions.example: Neither of her daughters showed any desire to marry.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入婚姻或夫妻状态；娶妻或嫁人。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的两个女儿都没有表现出任何结婚的愿望。

definitions.definition: (in passive) To be joined to (someone) as spouse according to law or custom.
definitions.example: His daughter was married some five years ago to a tailor's apprentice.
definitions.definitionCn: （被动语态）依法或依习俗与某人结为配偶。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的女儿大约五年前嫁给了一个裁缝学徒。

definitions.definition: To arrange for the marriage of; to give away as wife or husband.
definitions.example: He was eager to marry his daughter to a nobleman.
definitions.definitionCn: 安排婚姻；将某人作为妻子或丈夫嫁出。
definitions.exampleCn: 他急于将女儿嫁给一位贵族。

definitions.definition: To take as husband or wife.
definitions.example: In some cultures, it is acceptable for an uncle to marry his niece.
definitions.definitionCn: 娶为妻或嫁为夫。
definitions.exampleCn: 在某些文化中，叔叔娶侄女是可以接受的。

definitions.definition: To unite; to join together into a close union.
definitions.example: The attempt to marry medieval plainsong with speed metal produced interesting results.
definitions.definitionCn: 结合；紧密联合在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 将中世纪素歌与速度金属结合起来的尝试产生了有趣的结果。

definitions.definition: To unite in wedlock or matrimony; to perform the ceremony of joining spouses; to bring about a marital union according to the laws or customs of a place.
definitions.example: A justice of the peace will marry Jones and Smith.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过婚礼结合；主持结为夫妻的仪式；根据某地法律或习俗促成婚姻结合。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位治安法官将为琼斯和史密斯主持婚礼。

definitions.definition: To place (two ropes) alongside each other so that they may be grasped and hauled on at the same time.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（两根绳子）并排放置，以便同时抓住并拉动。

definitions.definition: To join (two ropes) end to end so that both will pass through a block.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（两根绳子）首尾相接，使两者都能穿过一个滑轮。

definitions.definition: Indeed!, in truth!; a term of asseveration.
Matter which may be shaped or manipulated, particularly in making something.
definitions.example: Asphalt, composed of oil and sand, is a widely used material for roads.
definitions.definitionCn: 可被塑形或操控的物质，尤指用于制造物品的材料。
definitions.exampleCn: 由石油和沙子组成的沥青是广泛用于铺路的材料。

definitions.definition: Text written for a specific purpose.
definitions.example: We were a warm-up act at the time; we didn't have enough original material to headline.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定目的而撰写的文字。
definitions.exampleCn: 当时我们只是暖场表演，没有足够的原创作品来担任主角。

definitions.definition: A sample or specimens for study.
definitions.definitionCn: 供研究用的样本或标本。

definitions.definition: Cloth to be made into a garment. Fabric.
definitions.example: You'll need about a yard of material to make this.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于制作服装的布料。织物。
definitions.exampleCn: 制作这件衣服大约需要一码布料。

definitions.definition: The people collectively who are qualified for a certain position or activity.
definitions.example: He is not the only one. I believe we have lots of presidential material in various public offices.
definitions.definitionCn: 符合特定职位或活动资格的人群。
definitions.exampleCn: 他并非唯一人选。我相信各公职部门中不乏总统之才。

definitions.definition: Related data of various kinds, especially if collected as the basis for a document or book.
definitions.definitionCn: 各类相关数据，尤指作为文件或书籍基础收集的资料。

definitions.definition: The substance that something is made or composed of.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成某物的物质或成分。

definitions.definition: All of a player's pieces and pawns on the chessboard.
definitions.definitionCn: 棋盘上某方所有棋子的总称。

definitions.definition: To form from matter; to materialize.
definitions.definitionCn: 从物质中形成；具体化。

definitions.definition: Having to do with matter; consisting of matter.
definitions.example: This compound has a number of interesting material properties.
definitions.definitionCn: 与物质相关的；由物质构成的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种化合物具有多种有趣的物质特性。

definitions.definition: Worldly, as opposed to spiritual.
definitions.example: Don't let material concerns get in the way of living a happy life.
definitions.definitionCn: 世俗的，与精神相对。
definitions.exampleCn: 别让物质问题妨碍你享受幸福生活。

definitions.definition: Significant.
definitions.example: This is the most material fact in this lawsuit.
definitions.definitionCn: 重要的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是本案中最关键的事实。

definitions.definition: A competitive sporting event such as a boxing meet, a baseball game, or a cricket match.
definitions.example: My local team are playing in a match against their arch-rivals today.
definitions.definitionCn: 拳击赛、棒球赛或板球赛这类竞技体育赛事。
definitions.exampleCn: 今天我的本地队伍将与他们的宿敌进行一场比赛。

definitions.definition: Any contest or trial of strength or skill, or to determine superiority.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何力量或技巧的较量，或为决定优劣而进行的竞赛。

definitions.definition: Someone with a measure of an attribute equaling or exceeding the object of comparison.
definitions.example: He knew he had met his match.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人在某项特质上达到或超过比较对象。
definitions.exampleCn: 他知道自己遇到了旗鼓相当的对手。

definitions.definition: A marriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 婚姻。

definitions.definition: A candidate for matrimony; one to be gained in marriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 适婚对象；可通过婚姻获得的人。

definitions.definition: Suitability.

definitions.definition: Equivalence; a state of correspondence.
definitions.definitionCn: 对等；对应状态。

definitions.definition: Equality of conditions in contest or competition.
definitions.definitionCn: 竞赛或竞争中条件的平等。

definitions.definition: A pair of items or entities with mutually suitable characteristics.

definitions.definitionCn: 一对具有相互适配特性的物品或实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 地毯和窗帘很相配。

definitions.definition: An agreement or compact.
definitions.definitionCn: 协议或契约。

definitions.definition: A perforated board, block of plaster, hardened sand, etc., in which a pattern is partly embedded when a mould is made, for giving shape to the surfaces of separation between the parts of the mould.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作模具时部分嵌入模型的有孔板、石膏块、硬化砂等，用于塑造模具各部分之间的分离面。

definitions.definition: To agree; to be equal; to correspond.
definitions.example: Their interests didn't match, so it took a long time to agree what to do together.
definitions.definitionCn: 一致；相等；对应。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们的兴趣不匹配，所以花了很长时间才就共同行动达成一致。

definitions.definition: To agree with; to be equal to; to correspond to.
definitions.example: His interests didn't match her interests.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……一致；等于；对应。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的兴趣与她的兴趣不符。

definitions.definition: To make a successful match or pairing.
definitions.example: They found out about his color-blindness when he couldn't match socks properly.
definitions.definitionCn: 成功配对或搭配。
definitions.exampleCn: 当他无法正确配对袜子时，他们发现了他有色盲。

definitions.definition: To equal or exceed in achievement.
definitions.example: She matched him at every turn: anything he could do, she could do as well or better.
definitions.definitionCn: 在成就上相等或超越。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在每个回合都与他匹敌：他能做的任何事，她都能做得一样好或更好。

definitions.definition: To unite in marriage, to mate.
definitions.definitionCn: 使结为夫妻，配对。

definitions.definition: To fit together, or make suitable for fitting together; specifically, to furnish with a tongue and groove at the edges.

definitions.exampleCn: 拼接木板。

definitions.definition: A device made of wood or paper, at the tip coated with chemicals that ignite with the friction of being dragged (struck) against a rough dry surface.
definitions.example: He struck a match and lit his cigarette.

definitions.definition: Someone who has control over something or someone.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某事或某人有控制权的人。

definitions.definition: The owner of an animal or slave.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物或奴隶的主人。

definitions.definition: The captain of a merchant ship; a master mariner.
definitions.definitionCn: 商船的船长；资深海员。

definitions.definition: The head of a household.
definitions.definitionCn: 一家之主。

definitions.definition: Someone who employs others.
definitions.definitionCn: 雇佣他人的人。

definitions.definition: An expert at something.
definitions.example: Mark Twain was a master of fiction.
definitions.definitionCn: 某方面的专家。
definitions.exampleCn: 马克·吐温是小说大师。

definitions.definition: A tradesman who is qualified to teach apprentices.
definitions.definitionCn: 有资格教授学徒的工匠。

definitions.definition: A schoolmaster.
definitions.definitionCn: 校长。

definitions.definition: A skilled artist.
definitions.definitionCn: 技艺精湛的艺术家。

definitions.definition: A man or a boy; mister. See Master.
definitions.definitionCn: 男人或男孩；先生。参见Master。

definitions.definition: A master's degree; a type of postgraduate degree, usually undertaken after a bachelor degree.
definitions.example: She has a master in psychology.
definitions.definitionCn: 硕士学位；一种研究生学位，通常在学士学位后攻读。
definitions.exampleCn: 她拥有心理学硕士学位。

definitions.definition: A person holding such a degree.
definitions.example: He is a master of marine biology.
definitions.definitionCn: 持有该学位的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是海洋生物学硕士。

definitions.definition: The original of a document or of a recording.
definitions.example: The band couldn't find the master, so they re-recorded their tracks.
definitions.definitionCn: 文件或录音的原件。
definitions.exampleCn: 乐队找不到母带，于是重新录制了他们的曲目。

definitions.definition: The primary wide shot of a scene, into which the closeups will be edited later.
definitions.definitionCn: 场景的主广角镜头，特写镜头将随后剪辑进去。

definitions.definition: A parajudicial officer (such as a referee, an auditor, an examiner, or an assessor) specially appointed to help a court with its proceedings.
definitions.example: The case was tried by a master, who concluded that the plaintiffs were the equitable owners of the property. [...]
definitions.definitionCn: 特别任命协助法庭诉讼的准司法官员（如仲裁员、审计员、审查员或评估员）。
definitions.exampleCn: 该案由一名主审官审理，他裁定原告是该财产的衡平法所有者。[……]

definitions.definition: A device that is controlling other devices or is an authoritative source.
definitions.example: a master database
definitions.definitionCn: 控制其他设备或作为权威来源的设备。
definitions.exampleCn: 主数据库。

definitions.definition: A person holding an office of authority, especially the presiding officer.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任权威职务的人，尤其是主持官员。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A person holding a similar office in other civic societies.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）在其他公民社会中担任类似职务的人。

definitions.definition: To be a master.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为大师。

definitions.definition: To become the master of; to subject to one's will, control, or authority; to conquer; to overpower; to subdue.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为……的主人；使服从于某人的意志、控制或权威；征服；压制；制服。

definitions.definition: To learn to a high degree of proficiency.
definitions.example: It took her years to master the art of needlecraft.
definitions.definitionCn: 精通到高水平。
definitions.exampleCn: 她花了多年时间掌握了针线技艺。

definitions.definition: To own; to possess.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有；占有。

definitions.definition: (especially of a musical performance) To make a master copy of.
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指音乐表演）制作母版。

definitions.definition: (usually with in) To earn a Master's degree.
definitions.example: He mastered in English at the state college.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与in连用）获得硕士学位。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在州立大学获得了英语硕士学位。

definitions.definition: Masterful.
definitions.example: a master performance
definitions.definitionCn: 大师级的。
definitions.exampleCn: 大师级表演。

definitions.definition: Main, principal or predominant.
definitions.definitionCn: 主要的、首要的或占主导地位的。

definitions.definition: Highly skilled.
definitions.example: master batsman
definitions.definitionCn: 技艺高超的。
definitions.exampleCn: 击球大师。

definitions.definition: Original.
definitions.example: master copy
definitions.definitionCn: 原始的。
definitions.exampleCn: 母版。

definitions.definition: (in combination) A vessel having a specified number of masts.
definitions.example: a two-master

definitions.definition: Of or relating to the mind or an intellectual process.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于心智或智力过程的。

definitions.definition: Insane, mad, crazy.
definitions.example: He is the most mental freshman I've seen yet.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神错乱的，疯狂的，疯癫的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是我见过最疯的大一新生。

definitions.definition: Enjoyable or fun, especially in a frenetic way.
definitions.example: That was a mental party last night.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人愉快的或有趣的，尤指以狂乱的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 昨晚那场派对真是疯狂。

definitions.definition: A plate or scale covering the mentum or chin of a fish or reptile.
Of or relating to the chin or median part of the lower jaw, genial.
definitions.example: the mental nerve;  the mental region

definitions.definition: Of or relating to the chin-like or lip-like structure.
To lament.
definitions.definitionCn: 哀叹。

definitions.definition: To intend.
definitions.definitionCn: 意图。

definitions.definition: To convey (a meaning).
definitions.definitionCn: 传达（某种含义）。

definitions.definition: To have conviction in (something said or expressed); to be sincere in (what one says).
definitions.example: Does she really mean what she said to him last night?
definitions.definitionCn: 对（所说或表达的内容）深信不疑；对（所说的话）真诚。
definitions.exampleCn: 她昨晚对他说的那些话，真的是真心的吗？

definitions.definition: To cause or produce (a given result); to bring about (a given result).
definitions.example: One faltering step means certain death.
definitions.definitionCn: 导致或产生（某种结果）；引发（某种结果）。
definitions.exampleCn: 一步踉跄就意味着必死无疑。

definitions.definition: (usually with to) To be of some level of importance.
definitions.example: Formality and titles mean nothing in their circle.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与to连用）具有一定的重要性。
definitions.exampleCn: 在他们圈子里，礼节和头衔毫无意义。

definitions.definition: Common; general.
Of a common or low origin, grade, or quality; common; humble.
definitions.example: a man of mean parentage / a mean abode

definitions.definition: Low in quality or degree; inferior; poor; shabby.
definitions.example: a mean appearance / mean dress

definitions.definition: Without dignity of mind; destitute of honour; low-minded; spiritless; base.

definitions.definition: A track record of similar behaviour.

definitions.definition: Prior; occurring before something else, either in time or order.

definitions.definitionCn: 先前的；在时间或顺序上发生在某事之前的。

definitions.definition: Premature; acting or occurring too soon.

definitions.definition: A high-ranking member of a monastery, usually lower in rank than an abbot.

definitions.definition: A chief magistrate in Italy.
definitions.definitionCn: 意大利的首席行政长官。

definitions.definition: (law enforcement) A previous arrest or criminal conviction on someone's record.

definitions.definitionCn: 在贝叶斯推断中，指先验概率分布，即基于收集额外数据前的信息或信念。

definitions.definition: Advance; previous; coming before.

definitions.definitionCn: 先前的；之前的；在前的。

definitions.definition: Former, previous.

definitions.definitionCn: 以前的，先前的。

definitions.definition: Previously.

definitions.definitionCn: 先前地。

definitions.definition: A place or institution of confinement, especially of long-term confinement for those convicted of serious crimes or otherwise considered undesirable by the government.

definitions.definitionCn: 监狱，一种限制自由的场所或机构，尤其指对重罪犯或被政府视为不受欢迎者进行长期监禁的地方。

definitions.definition: Confinement in prison.

definitions.definitionCn: 监禁于监狱之中。
definitions.exampleCn: 监狱对他来说是一段痛苦的经历。

definitions.definition: Any restrictive environment, such as a harsh academy or home.

definitions.definitionCn: 任何限制性的环境，如严苛的学校或家庭。

definitions.definition: To imprison.
definitions.definitionCn: 监禁，关押。

definitions.definition: A (male) ruler, a sovereign; a king, monarch.

definitions.definition: Someone who is preeminent in their field; a great person.

definitions.definition: A male member of a royal family other than the ruler; especially (in the United Kingdom) the son or grandson of the monarch.

definitions.definition: A non-royal high title of nobility, especially in France and the Holy Roman Empire.

definitions.definition: The mushroom Agaricus augustus.

definitions.definition: A type of court card used in tarot cards, the equivalent of the jack.

definitions.definition: A fundamental assumption or guiding belief.

definitions.definition: A rule used to choose among solutions to a problem.

definitions.definitionCn: 用于在问题解决方案中进行选择的规则。

definitions.definition: (sometimes pluralized) Moral rule or aspect.

definitions.definition: A rule or law of nature, or the basic idea on how the laws of nature are applied.

definitions.definition: A fundamental essence, particularly one producing a given quality.

definitions.definition: A beginning.

definitions.definition: A source, or origin; that from which anything proceeds; fundamental substance or energy; primordial substance; ultimate element, or cause.

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) A private lesson.

definitions.definition: Not accessible by the public.

definitions.definition: Not in governmental office or employment.

definitions.definition: Not publicly known; not open; secret.

definitions.definitionCn: 不公开的；不开放的；秘密的。
definitions.exampleCn: 信托受益人的身份是保密的。

definitions.definition: Protected from view or disturbance by others; secluded.

definitions.definitionCn: 不受他人视线或干扰的；隐蔽的。

definitions.definition: Secretive; reserved.

definitions.definitionCn: 直接驱动的感应线圈，如变压器或感应电动机中与次级线圈磁耦合的部分。

definitions.example: the proportion of the parts of a building, or of the body
definitions.definitionCn: 一部分与另一部分或与整体在大小、数量或程度上的关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 建筑物或身体各部分的比例。

definitions.definition: A statement of equality between two ratios.
definitions.definitionCn: 两个比率相等的陈述。

definitions.definition: The "rule of three", in which three terms are given to find a fourth.
definitions.definitionCn: “三分律”，即已知三项求第四项。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) Size.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用复数）尺寸。

definitions.definition: To divide into proper shares; to apportion.
definitions.definitionCn: 分成适当份额；分配。

definitions.definition: To form symmetrically.
definitions.definitionCn: 对称地形成。

definitions.definition: To set or render in proportion.
definitions.definitionCn: 使成比例或按比例设置。

definitions.definition: To correspond to.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……相称。

definitions.definition: The region which the eye overlooks at one time; view; scene; outlook.
definitions.definitionCn: 眼睛一次所能俯瞰的区域；视野；景象；景色。

definitions.definition: A picturesque or panoramic view; a landscape; hence, a sketch of a landscape.
definitions.definitionCn: 如画或全景的景色；风景；因此，也指风景素描。

definitions.definition: A position affording a fine view; a lookout.
definitions.definitionCn: 能提供优美景色的位置；瞭望台。

definitions.definition: Relative position of the front of a building or other structure; face; relative aspect.
definitions.definitionCn: 建筑物或其他结构正面的相对位置；朝向；相对方位。

definitions.definition: The act of looking forward; foresight; anticipation.
definitions.definitionCn: 向前看的行为；远见；预期。

definitions.definition: The potential things that may come to pass, often favorable.
definitions.definitionCn: 可能发生的事物，通常指有利的。

definitions.definition: A hope; a hopeful.
definitions.definitionCn: 希望；有希望的人或事。

definitions.definition: Any player whose rights are owned by a top-level professional team, but who has yet to play a game for said team.
definitions.definitionCn: 其权利归顶级职业球队所有，但尚未为该队参赛的任何球员。

definitions.definition: (sales) A potential client or customer.
definitions.definitionCn: （销售）潜在客户或顾客。

definitions.definition: The façade of an organ.
definitions.definitionCn: 管风琴的正面。

definitions.definition: To search, as for gold.
definitions.definitionCn: 搜寻，如寻找黄金。

definitions.definition: To determine which minerals or metals are present in a location.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定某地存在哪些矿物或金属。

definitions.definition: A reminder or cue.
definitions.definitionCn: 提示或线索。

definitions.definition: A time limit given for payment of an account for produce purchased, this limit varying with different goods.
definitions.definitionCn: 购买农产品付款的期限，不同商品期限各异。

definitions.definition: A sequence of characters that appears on a monitor to indicate that the computer is ready to receive input.
definitions.example: I filled in my name where the prompt appeared on the computer screen but my account wasn't recognized.
definitions.definitionCn: 显示器上出现的一串字符，表示计算机已准备好接收输入。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在电脑屏幕提示处填了名字，但账户未被识别。

definitions.definition: (writing) A suggestion for inspiration given to an author.
definitions.definitionCn: （写作）给作者的灵感建议。

definitions.definition: To lead (someone) toward what they should say or do.
definitions.example: I prompted him to get a new job.
definitions.definitionCn: 引导（某人）该说什么或做什么。
definitions.exampleCn: 我促使他找了份新工作。

definitions.definition: To show or tell an actor/person the words they should be saying, or actions they should be doing.
definitions.example: If he forgets his words I will prompt him.
definitions.definitionCn: 向演员/人员提示应说的台词或应做的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果他忘词了，我会提示他。

definitions.definition: To initiate; to cause or lead to.
definitions.definitionCn: 引发；导致或促使。

definitions.definition: Quick; acting without delay.
definitions.example: He was very prompt at getting a new job.
definitions.definitionCn: 迅速的；毫不拖延的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他找工作非常迅速。

definitions.definition: On time; punctual.
definitions.example: Be prompt for your appointment.
definitions.definitionCn: 准时的；守时的。
definitions.exampleCn: 请准时赴约。

definitions.definition: Ready; willing to act.
definitions.definitionCn: 准备好的；愿意行动的。

definitions.definition: Something that is owned.
definitions.example: Important types of property include real property (land), personal property (other physical possessions), and intellectual property (rights over artistic creations, inventions, etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 被拥有的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 财产的重要类型包括不动产（土地）、个人财产（其他有形物品）和知识产权（对艺术创作、发明等的权利）。

definitions.definition: A piece of real estate, such as a parcel of land.
definitions.example: There is a large house on the property.
definitions.definitionCn: 一块不动产，例如一片土地。
definitions.exampleCn: 该房产上有一栋大房子。

definitions.definition: Real estate; the business of selling houses.
definitions.example: He works in property as a housing consultant.
definitions.definitionCn: 房地产；销售房屋的业务。
definitions.exampleCn: 他从事房地产行业，担任住房顾问。

definitions.definition: The exclusive right of possessing, enjoying and disposing of a thing.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有、享用和处置某物的专有权利。

definitions.definition: An attribute or abstract quality associated with an individual, object or concept.
definitions.example: Charm is his most endearing property.
definitions.definitionCn: 与个体、物体或概念相关的属性或抽象特质。
definitions.exampleCn: 魅力是他最讨人喜欢的特质。

definitions.definition: An attribute or abstract quality which is characteristic of a class of objects.
definitions.example: Matter can have many properties, including color, mass and density.
definitions.definitionCn: 某类物体特有的属性或抽象特质。
definitions.exampleCn: 物质可以有许多属性，包括颜色、质量和密度。

definitions.definition: An editable or read-only parameter associated with an application, component or class, or the value of such a parameter.
definitions.example: You need to set the debugging property to "verbose".
definitions.definitionCn: 与应用程序、组件或类相关的可编辑或只读参数，或此类参数的值。
definitions.exampleCn: 你需要将调试属性设置为“详细”。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) A prop, an object used in a dramatic production.
definitions.example: Costumes and scenery are distinguished from property properly speaking.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）道具，戏剧制作中使用的物品。
definitions.exampleCn: 服装和布景与严格意义上的道具不同。

definitions.definition: Propriety; correctness.
definitions.definitionCn: 得体；正确性。

definitions.definition: To invest with properties, or qualities.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予属性或特质。

definitions.definition: To make a property of; to appropriate.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物据为己有；占用。

definitions.definition: A formal objection, especially one by a group.
definitions.example: They lodged a protest with the authorities.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式反对，尤指群体性的反对。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们向当局提出抗议。

definitions.definition: A collective gesture of disapproval; a demonstration.
definitions.example: We held a protest in front of City Hall.
definitions.definitionCn: 集体表示不赞同的行为；示威游行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在市政厅前举行了抗议。

definitions.definition: The noting by a notary public of an unpaid or unaccepted bill.
definitions.definitionCn: 公证人对未支付或未承兑票据的注明。

definitions.definition: A written declaration, usually by the master of a ship, stating the circumstances attending loss or damage of ship or cargo, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常由船长作出的书面声明，说明船舶或货物遭受损失或损坏的情况。

definitions.definition: To make a strong objection.
definitions.example: How dare you, I protest!
definitions.definitionCn: 提出强烈反对。
definitions.exampleCn: 你竟敢这样，我抗议！

definitions.definition: To affirm (something).
definitions.example: I do protest and declare …
definitions.definitionCn: 肯定（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我确实抗议并声明……

definitions.definition: To object to.
definitions.example: They protested the demolition of the school.
definitions.definitionCn: 反对。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们抗议拆除学校。

definitions.definition: To call as a witness in affirming or denying, or to prove an affirmation; to appeal to.
definitions.definitionCn: 在肯定或否定时传唤证人，或证明一项肯定；诉诸。

definitions.definition: To make a solemn written declaration, in due form, on behalf of the holder, against all parties liable for any loss or damage to be sustained by non-acceptance or non-payment of (a bill or note). This should be made by a notary public, whose seal it is the usual practice to affix.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表持票人，以适当形式作出庄严的书面声明，针对因（票据）未承兑或未支付而可能遭受任何损失或损坏的所有责任方。此声明应由公证人作出，通常加盖其印章。

definitions.definition: To publish; to make known.
definitions.definitionCn: 公布；使知晓。

definitions.definition: An effort, process, or operation designed to establish or discover a fact or truth; an act of testing; a test; a trial.
definitions.definitionCn: 旨在确立或发现事实真相的努力、过程或操作；测试的行为；试验；检验。

definitions.definition: The degree of evidence which convinces the mind of any truth or fact, and produces belief; a test by facts or arguments which induce, or tend to induce, certainty of the judgment; conclusive evidence; demonstration.
definitions.definitionCn: 使心灵确信任何真理或事实并产生信念的证据程度；通过事实或论据进行的检验，这些事实或论据诱导或倾向于诱导判断的确定性；确凿证据；证明。

definitions.definition: The quality or state of having been proved or tried; firmness or hardness which resists impression, or does not yield to force; impenetrability of physical bodies.
definitions.definitionCn: 已被证明或检验过的性质或状态；抵抗压印或不受外力屈服时的坚固或硬度；物理实体的不可穿透性。

definitions.definition: Experience of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某事的体验。

definitions.definition: Firmness of mind; stability not to be shaken.
definitions.definitionCn: 心灵的坚定；不可动摇的稳定性。

definitions.definition: A proof sheet; a trial impression, as from type, taken for correction or examination.
definitions.definitionCn: 校样；为修正或检查而从活字上取下的试印样张。

definitions.definition: A sequence of statements consisting of axioms, assumptions, statements already demonstrated in another proof, and statements that logically follow from previous statements in the sequence, and which concludes with a statement that is the object of the proof.
definitions.definitionCn: 由公理、假设、已在其他证明中论证的陈述以及逻辑上遵循序列中先前陈述的陈述组成的一系列陈述，并以作为证明对象的陈述结尾。

definitions.definition: A process for testing the accuracy of an operation performed. Compare prove, transitive verb, 5.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于测试所执行操作准确性的过程。比较及物动词prove的第5义项。

definitions.definition: Armour of excellent or tried quality, and deemed impenetrable; properly, armour of proof.
definitions.definitionCn: 品质优良或经过检验、被认为不可穿透的铠甲；严格来说，指经得起考验的铠甲。

definitions.definition: A measure of the alcohol content of liquor. Originally, in Britain, 100 proof was defined as 57.1% by volume (no longer used). In the US, 100 proof means that the alcohol content is 50% of the total volume of the liquid; thus, absolute alcohol would be 200 proof.
definitions.definitionCn: 酒类酒精含量的度量标准。最初在英国，100度被定义为体积分数57.1%（现已不再使用）。在美国，100度意味着酒精含量占液体总体积的50%；因此，纯酒精为200度。

definitions.definition: To proofread.
definitions.definitionCn: 校对。

definitions.definition: To make resistant, especially to water.
definitions.definitionCn: 使具有抵抗力，尤其是防水性。

definitions.definition: To allow yeast-containing dough to rise.
definitions.definitionCn: 让含酵母的面团发酵。

definitions.definition: To test the activeness of yeast.
definitions.definitionCn: 测试酵母的活性。

definitions.definition: Used in proving or testing.
definitions.example: a proof load; a proof charge
definitions.definitionCn: 用于证明或测试的。
definitions.exampleCn: 测试负荷；测试装药。

definitions.definition: Firm or successful in resisting.
definitions.example: proof against harm
definitions.definitionCn: 抵抗时坚固或成功的。
definitions.exampleCn: 防伤害的。

definitions.definition: (of alcoholic liquors) Being of a certain standard as to alcohol content.
definitions.definitionCn: （指酒精饮料）酒精含量达到特定标准的。

definitions.definition: To cause to suffer for crime or misconduct, to administer disciplinary action.
definitions.example: If a prince violates the law, then he must be punished like an ordinary person.
definitions.definitionCn: 因犯罪或不当行为而使其受苦，执行纪律处分。
definitions.exampleCn: 若王子犯法，则须与庶民同罪。

definitions.definition: To treat harshly and unfairly.
definitions.definitionCn: 严苛且不公地对待。

definitions.definition: To handle or beat severely; to maul.
definitions.definitionCn: 粗暴处理或痛打；严重伤害。

definitions.definition: To consume a large quantity of.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量消耗。

definitions.definition: A region of the earth or of a continent; a district or country.
definitions.definitionCn: 地球或大陆的一个区域；一个地区或国家。

definitions.definition: An administrative subdivision of certain countries, including Canada and China.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些国家（包括加拿大和中国）的行政分区。

definitions.definition: (Roman history) An area outside Italy which is administered by a Roman governor.
definitions.definitionCn: （罗马历史）意大利以外由罗马总督管理的区域。

definitions.definition: An area under the jurisdiction of an archbishop, typically comprising a number of adjacent dioceses.
definitions.definitionCn: 大主教管辖的区域，通常包括若干相邻教区。

definitions.definition: An area under the jurisdiction of a provincial within a monastic order.
definitions.definitionCn: 修道会中省会长管辖的区域。

definitions.definition: (in plural, chiefly with definite article) The parts of a country outside its capital city.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式，常与定冠词连用）首都以外的国家地区。

definitions.definition: An area of activity, responsibility or knowledge; the proper concern of a particular person or concept.
definitions.definitionCn: 活动、责任或知识的领域；特定个人或概念所涉及的范围。

definitions.definition: A hit or strike with one's fist.
definitions.definitionCn: 用拳头击打或猛击。

definitions.definition: Power, strength, energy.
definitions.definitionCn: 力量、力气、能量。

definitions.definition: Impact.
definitions.definitionCn: 冲击力。

definitions.definition: To strike with one's fist.
definitions.example: If she punches me, I'm gonna break her nose.
definitions.definitionCn: 用拳头击打。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果她打我，我就打断她的鼻子。

definitions.definition: (of cattle) To herd.
definitions.definitionCn: （指牛群）驱赶。

definitions.definition: To operate (a device or system) by depressing a button, key, bar, or pedal, or by similar means.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过按下按钮、按键、横杆或踏板，或类似方式操作（设备或系统）。

definitions.definition: To enter (information) on a device or system.
definitions.definitionCn: 在设备或系统上输入（信息）。

definitions.definition: To hit (a ball or similar object) with less than full force.
definitions.example: He punched a hit into shallow left field.
definitions.definitionCn: 用不足全力击打（球或类似物体）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他打出一记安打，球飞向左外场浅区。

definitions.definition: To make holes in something (rail ticket, leather belt, etc)
definitions.definitionCn: 在（火车票、皮带等）上打孔。

definitions.definition: To thrust against; to poke.
definitions.example: to punch one with the end of a stick or the elbow
definitions.definitionCn: 用力推撞；戳刺。
definitions.exampleCn: 用棍棒末端或手肘戳某人。

definitions.definition: A device, generally slender and round, used for creating holes in thin material, for driving an object through a hole in a containing object, or to stamp or emboss a mark or design on a surface.
A hole or opening created with a punch.
(piledriving) An extension piece applied to the top of a pile; a dolly.
A prop, as for the roof of a mine.
To employ a punch to create a hole in or stamp or emboss a mark on something.
To mark a ticket.
A beverage, generally containing a mixture of fruit juice and some other beverage, often alcoholic.
Any of various riodinid butterflies of the genus Dodona of Asia.
Feeling honoured (by something); feeling happy or satisfied about an event or fact; gratified.
definitions.example: I am proud of Sivu’s schoolwork.
definitions.definitionCn: 感到荣幸（因某事）；对某事件或事实感到高兴或满足；欣慰。
definitions.exampleCn: 我为西武的学业感到骄傲。

definitions.definition: Possessed of a due sense of what one deserves or is worth.
definitions.example: I was too proud to apologise.
definitions.definitionCn: 对自己应得或应有的价值有恰当的认识。
definitions.exampleCn: 我因过于骄傲而不愿道歉。

definitions.definition: Having too high an opinion of oneself; arrogant, supercilious.
definitions.definitionCn: 对自己评价过高；傲慢，目中无人。

definitions.definition: Generating a sense of pride; being a cause for pride.
definitions.example: It was a proud day when we finally won the championship.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生自豪感；成为骄傲的原因。
definitions.exampleCn: 当我们最终赢得冠军时，那是自豪的一天。

definitions.definition: (Of things) standing upwards as in the manner of a proud person; stately or majestic.
definitions.definitionCn: （指事物）像骄傲的人一样挺立；庄严或雄伟。

definitions.definition: Standing out or raised; swollen.
definitions.example: After it had healed, the scar tissue stood proud of his flesh.
definitions.definitionCn: 突出或隆起；肿胀。
definitions.exampleCn: 伤口愈合后，疤痕组织在他皮肤上隆起。

definitions.definition: Brave, valiant; gallant.
definitions.definitionCn: 勇敢，英勇；豪侠。

definitions.definition: Excited by sexual desire; specifically of a female animal: in heat.
definitions.definitionCn: 因性欲而兴奋；特指雌性动物：处于发情期。

definitions.definition: The people in general, regardless of membership of any particular group.
definitions.example: Members of the public may not proceed beyond this point.
definitions.definitionCn: 普通大众，不论是否属于任何特定群体。
definitions.exampleCn: 公众不得越过此点。

definitions.definition: A public house; an inn.
definitions.definitionCn: 酒馆；客栈。

definitions.definition: Able to be seen or known by everyone; open to general view, happening without concealment.
definitions.definitionCn: 能被所有人看见或知晓的；公开可见的，不加掩饰地发生的。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to the people as a whole (as opposed to a private group); concerning the whole country, community etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 关乎全体人民的（相对于私人团体）；涉及整个国家、社区等的。

definitions.definition: Officially representing the community; carried out or funded by the state on behalf of the community.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式代表社区的；由国家代表社区执行或资助的。

definitions.definition: Open to all members of a community; especially, provided by national or local authorities and supported by money from taxes.
definitions.definitionCn: 对社区所有成员开放的；尤指由国家或地方当局提供并由税收支持的。

definitions.definition: (of a company) Traded publicly via a stock market.
definitions.definitionCn: （公司）通过股票市场公开交易的。

definitions.definition: Accessible to the program in general, not only to the class or any subclasses.
definitions.definitionCn: 对程序整体可访问的，不仅限于类或其任何子类。

definitions.definition: To make a living; earn money for necessities.
definitions.example: It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.
definitions.definitionCn: 谋生；赚取生活必需品所需之财。
definitions.exampleCn: 靠最低工资难以养家糊口。

definitions.definition: To act to prepare for something.
definitions.example: Provide against disaster.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某事做准备。
definitions.exampleCn: 防范灾难。

definitions.definition: To establish as a previous condition; to stipulate.
definitions.example: I'll lend you the money, provided that you pay it back by Monday.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为前提条件设定；规定。
definitions.exampleCn: 只要你周一前还钱，我就借给你。

definitions.definition: To give what is needed or desired, especially basic needs.
definitions.example: Don't bother bringing equipment, as we will provide it.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供所需或所求之物，尤指基本需求。
definitions.exampleCn: 别费心带设备了，我们会提供。

definitions.definition: To furnish (with), cause to be present.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供（给），使存在。

definitions.definition: To make possible or attainable.
definitions.example: He provides us with an alternative option.
definitions.definitionCn: 使成为可能或可实现。
definitions.exampleCn: 他为我们提供了另一种选择。

definitions.definition: (Latinism) To foresee.
definitions.definitionCn: （拉丁语用法）预见。

definitions.definition: To appoint to an ecclesiastical benefice before it is vacant. See provisor.
definitions.definitionCn: 在教会圣职空缺前预先任命。参见“provisor”。

definitions.definition: To proofread.
definitions.definitionCn: 校对。

definitions.definition: To make resistant, especially to water.
definitions.definitionCn: 使具有抗性，尤其是防水性。

definitions.definition: To allow yeast-containing dough to rise.
definitions.definitionCn: 让含酵母的面团发酵。

definitions.definition: To test the activeness of yeast.
definitions.definitionCn: 测试酵母的活性。

definitions.definition: The process of dough proofing.
definitions.definitionCn: 面团发酵的过程。

definitions.definition: To demonstrate that something is true or viable; to give proof for.
definitions.example: I will prove that my method is more effective than yours.
definitions.definitionCn: 证明某事真实或可行；提供证据。
definitions.exampleCn: 我将证明我的方法比你的更有效。

definitions.definition: The act of seeking, or looking after anything; attempt to find or obtain; search; pursuit.
definitions.example: to rove in quest of game, of a lost child, of property, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 寻求或寻找某物的行为；试图找到或获得；搜索；追求。
definitions.exampleCn: 为了寻找猎物、失踪儿童、财产等而漫游。

definitions.definition: Request; desire; solicitation.
definitions.definitionCn: 请求；渴望；恳求。

definitions.definition: A group of people making search or inquiry.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群进行搜索或询问的人。

definitions.definition: Inquest; jury of inquest.
definitions.definitionCn: 审讯；审讯陪审团。

definitions.definition: To seek or pursue a goal; to undertake a mission or job.
definitions.definitionCn: 寻求或追求目标；承担使命或任务。

definitions.definition: To search for; to examine.
definitions.definitionCn: 搜索；检查。

definitions.definition: (of a tick) To locate and attach to a host animal.
definitions.definitionCn: （指蜱虫）定位并附着在宿主动物身上。

definitions.definition: A female monarch. Example: Queen Victoria.
definitions.definitionCn: 一位女性君主。例如：维多利亚女王。

definitions.definition: The wife or widow of a king.
definitions.definitionCn: 国王的妻子或遗孀。

definitions.definition: The most powerful piece, able to move any number of spaces horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
definitions.definitionCn: 最具威力的棋子，可沿水平、垂直或对角线方向移动任意格数。

definitions.definition: A playing card with the letter "Q" and the image of a queen on it, the twelfth card in a given suit.
definitions.definitionCn: 印有字母"Q"和女王图案的扑克牌，同一花色中的第十二张牌。

definitions.definition: A red disk that is the most valuable piece in the Asian game of carom.
definitions.definitionCn: 亚洲撞球游戏中价值最高的红色圆盘。

definitions.definition: A powerful or forceful female person.
definitions.definitionCn: 强大或强势的女性。

definitions.definition: An effeminate male homosexual. (See usage notes.)
definitions.definitionCn: 女性化的男同性恋者（参见用法说明）。

definitions.definition: A reproductive female animal in a hive, such as an ant, bee, termite or wasp.
definitions.definitionCn: 蜂巢中具有繁殖能力的雌性动物，如蚂蚁、蜜蜂、白蚁或黄蜂。

definitions.definition: An adult female cat valued for breeding. See also tom.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于繁殖的成年雌猫。另见"tom"。

definitions.definition: A queen olive.
definitions.definitionCn: 女王橄榄。

definitions.definition: A monarch butterfly (Danaus spp., esp. Danaus gilippus).
definitions.definitionCn: 君主斑蝶（斑蝶属，尤指丹娜斑蝶）。

definitions.definition: To make a queen.
definitions.definitionCn: 使成为女王。

definitions.definition: To act the part of a queen; to queen it.
definitions.definitionCn: 扮演女王的角色；以女王姿态行事。

definitions.definition: To promote a pawn, usually to a queen.
definitions.definitionCn: 将兵升变为后，通常指升变为后。

definitions.definition: To provide with a new queen.
definitions.definitionCn: 为新蜂后提供蜂王。

definitions.definition: To be the queen of a colony.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为蜂群的女王。

definitions.definition: (BDSM, of a female) To sit on the face of (a partner) to receive oral sex.
definitions.definitionCn: （BDSM中，指女性）坐在（伴侣）脸上接受口交。

definitions.definition: A short, directed application of force; an act of pushing.
definitions.example: Give the door a hard push if it sticks.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次短暂、定向的用力；推的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果门卡住了，就用力推一下。

definitions.definition: An act of tensing the muscles of the abdomen in order to expel its contents.
definitions.example: One more push and the baby will be out.
definitions.definitionCn: 收紧腹部肌肉以排出其内容物的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 再推一次，婴儿就会出来了。

definitions.definition: A great effort (to do something).
definitions.example: Let's give one last push on our advertising campaign.
definitions.definitionCn: （做某事的）巨大努力。
definitions.exampleCn: 让我们为广告活动做最后一次冲刺。

definitions.definition: An attempt to persuade someone into a particular course of action.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图说服某人采取特定行动。

definitions.definition: A marching or drill maneuver/manoeuvre performed by moving a formation (especially a company front) forward or toward the audience, usually to accompany a dramatic climax or crescendo in the music.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种行进或操练动作，通过移动队形（尤其是连队正面）向前或朝向观众，通常伴随音乐中的戏剧性高潮或渐强。

definitions.definition: A wager that results in no loss or gain for the bettor as a result of a tie or even score
definitions.definitionCn: 因平局或平分而让投注者不输不赢的赌注。

definitions.definition: The addition of a data item to the top of a stack.
definitions.definitionCn: 将数据项添加到栈顶。

definitions.definition: The situation where a server sends data to a client without waiting for a request.
definitions.example: server push; a push technology
definitions.definitionCn: 服务器无需等待请求即向客户端发送数据的情况。
definitions.exampleCn: 服务器推送；推送技术。

definitions.definition: A particular crowd or throng or people.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定的人群或一群人。

definitions.definition: A foul shot in which the cue ball is in contact with the cue and the object ball at the same time
definitions.definitionCn: 母球同时接触球杆和目标球的犯规击球。

definitions.definition: To apply a force to (an object) such that it moves away from the person or thing applying the force.
definitions.example: In his anger he pushed me against the wall and threatened me.
definitions.definitionCn: 对（物体）施加力，使其远离施力的人或物。
definitions.exampleCn: 愤怒之下，他把我推到墙边并威胁我。

definitions.definition: To continually attempt to persuade (a person) into a particular course of action.
definitions.definitionCn: 不断试图说服（某人）采取特定行动。

definitions.definition: To press or urge forward; to drive.
definitions.example: to push an objection too far; to push one's luck
definitions.definitionCn: 催促或推动前进；驱使。
definitions.exampleCn: 把反对意见推得太远；得寸进尺。

definitions.definition: To continually promote (a point of view, a product for sale, etc.).
definitions.example: Stop pushing the issue — I'm not interested.
definitions.definitionCn: 不断推广（观点、待售产品等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 别再纠缠这个问题了——我不感兴趣。

definitions.definition: To continually exert oneself in order to achieve a goal.
definitions.definitionCn: 不断努力以实现目标。

definitions.definition: To approach; to come close to.
definitions.example: He's pushing sixty. (= he's nearly sixty years old)
definitions.definitionCn: 接近；靠近。
definitions.exampleCn: 他快六十岁了。（= 他将近六十岁）

definitions.definition: To tense the muscles in the abdomen in order to expel its contents.
definitions.example: During childbirth, there are times when the obstetrician advises the woman not to push.
definitions.definitionCn: 收紧腹部肌肉以排出其内容物。
definitions.exampleCn: 分娩时，有时产科医生会建议产妇不要用力。

definitions.definition: To continue to attempt to persuade a person into a particular course of action.
definitions.definitionCn: 继续试图说服某人采取特定行动。

definitions.definition: To make a higher bid at an auction.
definitions.definitionCn: 在拍卖中出更高价。

definitions.definition: To make an all-in bet.
definitions.definitionCn: 全押下注。

definitions.definition: To move (a pawn) directly forward.
definitions.definitionCn: （在国际象棋中）将（兵）直接向前移动。

definitions.definition: To add (a data item) to the top of a stack.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（数据项）添加到栈顶。

definitions.definition: To publish (an update, etc.) by transmitting it to other computers.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过传输到其他计算机来发布（更新等）。

definitions.definition: To thrust the points of the horns against; to gore.
definitions.definitionCn: 用角尖顶撞；刺伤。

definitions.definition: To burst out of its pot, as a bud or shoot.
definitions.definitionCn: （如芽或嫩枝）破盆而出。

definitions.definition: To strike the cue ball in such a way that it stays in contact with the cue and object ball at the same time (a foul shot).
definitions.definitionCn: 击打母球使其同时接触球杆和目标球（犯规击球）。

definitions.definition: A pustule; a pimple.
One who, or that which, is pure.
definitions.definitionCn: 纯净的人或物。

definitions.definition: To hit (the ball) completely cleanly and accurately
definitions.example: Tiger Woods pured his first drive straight down the middle of the fairway.
definitions.definitionCn: 干净利落地击中（球）。
definitions.exampleCn: 泰格·伍兹完美地将第一杆击出，直落球道中央。

definitions.definition: To cleanse; to refine.
definitions.definitionCn: 净化；精炼。

definitions.definition: Free of flaws or imperfections; unsullied.
definitions.definitionCn: 无瑕疵或缺陷；纯洁的。

definitions.definition: Free of foreign material or pollutants.
definitions.definitionCn: 无外来物质或污染物。

definitions.definition: Free of immoral behavior or qualities; clean.
definitions.definitionCn: 无道德败坏行为或品质；清白的。

definitions.definition: Mere; that and that only.
definitions.example: That idea is pure madness!
definitions.definitionCn: 纯粹的；仅此而已。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个想法简直是疯了！

definitions.definition: (of a branch of science) Done for its own sake instead of serving another branch of science.
definitions.definitionCn: （科学分支）为自身目的而研究，而非服务于其他科学分支。

definitions.definition: Of a single, simple sound or tone; said of some vowels and the unaspirated consonants.
definitions.definitionCn: 单一、简单的声音或音调；指某些元音和不送气辅音。

definitions.definition: (of sound) Without harmonics or overtones; not harsh or discordant.
definitions.definitionCn: （声音）无泛音或谐波；不刺耳或不和谐。

definitions.definition: To a great extent or degree; extremely; exceedingly.
definitions.example: You’re pure busy.
definitions.definitionCn: 在很大程度上或程度上；极其；非常。
definitions.exampleCn: 你真是忙得不可开交。

definitions.definition: Dung (of dogs, fowls, etc) used in tanning, after applying lime, to soften skins.
An archetype of eternal youth; (loosely), a man who remains emotionally childlike.
The acquisition of title to, or property in, anything for a price; buying for money or its equivalent.
definitions.example: They offer a free hamburger with the purchase of a drink.
definitions.definitionCn: 以金钱或等价物购买任何物品的所有权或财产；用钱或等价物购买。
definitions.exampleCn: 购买饮料时附赠一个免费汉堡。

definitions.definition: That which is obtained, got or acquired, in any manner, honestly or dishonestly; property; possession; acquisition.
definitions.definitionCn: 以任何方式（诚实或不诚实）获得、得到或取得的东西；财产；占有物；获得物。

definitions.definition: That which is obtained for a price in money or its equivalent.
definitions.example: He was pleased with his latest purchase.
definitions.definitionCn: 用金钱或等价物购买所得之物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他对最近买的东西很满意。

definitions.definition: The act or process of seeking and obtaining something (e.g. property, etc.)
definitions.definitionCn: 寻求并获取某物（如财产等）的行为或过程。

definitions.definition: A price paid for a house or estate, etc. equal to the amount of the rent or income during the stated number of years.
definitions.definitionCn: 为房屋或地产等支付的价格，相当于规定年限内租金或收入的总额。

definitions.definition: Any mechanical hold or advantage, applied to the raising or removing of heavy bodies, as by a lever, a tackle or capstan.
definitions.example: It is hard to get purchase on a nail without a pry bar or hammer.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何用于起重或移动重物的机械握持或杠杆作用，如通过杠杆、滑车或绞盘。
definitions.exampleCn: 没有撬棍或锤子很难抓住钉子。

definitions.definition: The apparatus, tackle or device by which such mechanical advantage is gained and in nautical terminology the ratio of such a device, like a pulley, or block and tackle.
definitions.definitionCn: 获得这种机械优势的装置、滑车或设备，在航海术语中指此类装置（如滑轮或滑轮组）的传动比。

definitions.definition: The amount of hold one has from an individual foothold or ledge.
definitions.definitionCn: 从一个立足点或岩架上获得的握持力。

definitions.definition: Acquisition of lands or tenements by means other than descent or inheritance, namely, by one's own act or agreement.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过自身行为或协议而非继承方式获取土地或保有物。

definitions.definition: To buy, obtain by payment of a price in money or its equivalent.
definitions.example: to purchase land, to purchase a house
definitions.definitionCn: 通过支付金钱或等价物购买、获得。
definitions.exampleCn: 购买土地，购买房屋。

definitions.definition: To pursue and obtain; to acquire by seeking; to gain, obtain, or acquire.
definitions.definitionCn: 追求并获取；通过寻找获得；赢得、得到或取得。

definitions.definition: To obtain by any outlay, as of labor, danger, or sacrifice, etc.
definitions.example: to purchase favor with flattery
definitions.definitionCn: 通过任何付出（如劳动、危险或牺牲等）获得。
definitions.exampleCn: 用谄媚换取恩惠。

definitions.definition: To expiate by a fine or forfeit.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过罚款或没收来赎罪。

definitions.definition: To apply to (anything) a device for obtaining a mechanical advantage; to get a purchase upon, or apply a purchase to; to raise or move by mechanical means.
definitions.example: to purchase a cannon
definitions.definitionCn: 将获得机械优势的装置应用于（某物）；抓住或施加机械作用；通过机械手段升起或移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 架设大炮。

definitions.definition: To put forth effort to obtain anything; to strive; to exert oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 努力获取某物；奋斗；尽力。

definitions.definition: To constitute the buying power for a purchase, have a trading value.
definitions.example: Many aristocratic refugees' portable treasures purchased their safe passage and comfortable exile during the revolution
definitions.definitionCn: 构成购买某物的购买力，具有交易价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多贵族流亡者携带的便携财宝在革命期间为他们买到了安全通行和舒适的流亡生活。

definitions.definition: (often in the plural) a rough section of a river or stream which is difficult to navigate due to the swift and turbulent motion of the water.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）河流或溪流中因水流湍急而难以航行的险峻段。

definitions.definition: A burst of rapid fire.
definitions.definitionCn: 一阵急促的射击。

definitions.definition: Very swift or quick.
definitions.example: a rapid stream
definitions.definitionCn: 非常迅速或快速的。
definitions.exampleCn: 湍急的溪流。

definitions.definition: Steep, changing altitude quickly. (of a slope)
definitions.definitionCn: 陡峭的，海拔变化迅速的（指斜坡）。

definitions.definition: Needing only a brief exposure time. (of a lens, plate, film, etc.)
definitions.definitionCn: 只需短暂曝光时间的（指镜头、底片、胶片等）。

definitions.definition: Violent, severe.
definitions.definitionCn: 猛烈的，剧烈的。

definitions.definition: Happy.
definitions.definitionCn: 快乐的。

definitions.definition: (archaic or colloquial) Rapidly.
definitions.definitionCn: （古语或口语）迅速地。

definitions.definition: An odd, puzzling or absurd person or thing.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个古怪、令人费解或荒谬的人或事物。

definitions.definition: A competition in the answering of questions.
definitions.example: We came second in the pub quiz.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种回答问题的竞赛。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在酒吧问答比赛中获得了第二名。

definitions.definition: A school examination of less importance, or of greater brevity, than others given in the same course.
definitions.definitionCn: 学校中比同一课程其他考试重要性较低或时间更短的测验。

definitions.definition: To hoax; to chaff or mock with pretended seriousness of discourse; to make sport of, as by obscure questions.
definitions.definitionCn: 欺骗；用假装严肃的言辞戏弄或嘲笑；通过晦涩的问题取笑。

definitions.definition: To peer at; to eye suspiciously or mockingly.
definitions.definitionCn: 偷看；怀疑或嘲弄地注视。

definitions.definition: To question closely, to interrogate.
definitions.definitionCn: 仔细询问，审问。

definitions.definition: To instruct by means of a quiz.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过测验进行指导。

definitions.definition: To play with a quiz.
definitions.definitionCn: 用测验来玩耍。

definitions.definition: A quotation; a statement attributed to a person.
definitions.definitionCn: 引文；归因于某人的陈述。

definitions.definition: A quotation mark.
definitions.definitionCn: 引号。

definitions.definition: A summary of work to be done with a set price.
definitions.example: After going over the hefty quotes, the board decided it was cheaper to have the project executed by its own staff.
definitions.definitionCn: 对需完成工作及设定价格的摘要。
definitions.exampleCn: 在仔细审查了那些高昂的报价后，董事会决定由内部员工执行该项目更划算。

definitions.definition: A price set for a financial security or commodity.
definitions.definitionCn: 为金融证券或商品设定的价格。

definitions.definition: To repeat the exact words of (a person).
definitions.example: The writer quoted the president.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复（某人）的原话。
definitions.exampleCn: 作者引用了总统的话。

definitions.definition: To repeat (the exact words of a person).
definitions.example: The writer quoted the president's speech.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复（某人的原话）。
definitions.exampleCn: 作者引用了总统的演讲。

definitions.definition: To prepare a summary of work to be done and set a price.
definitions.definitionCn: 准备一份待完成工作的摘要并设定价格。

definitions.definition: (Commerce) To name the current price, notably of a financial security.
definitions.definitionCn: （商业）报出当前价格，尤指金融证券的价格。

definitions.definition: To indicate verbally or by equivalent means the start of a quotation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过口头或同等方式表示引用的开始。

definitions.definition: To observe, to take account of.
definitions.definitionCn: 观察，考虑。

definitions.definition: To pay (a debt, fine etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 支付（债务、罚款等）。

definitions.definition: To repay (someone) for (something).
definitions.definitionCn: （因某事）回报（某人）。

definitions.definition: To repay, pay back (a good deed, injury etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 回报、偿还（善行、伤害等）。

definitions.definition: To conduct or acquit (oneself); to behave (in a specified way).
definitions.definitionCn: 表现或行事（以特定方式）；举止（如所述）。

definitions.definition: To carry through; to go through to the end.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚持到底；完成到底。

definitions.definition: To set at rest; to free, as from anything harmful or oppressive; to relieve; to clear; to liberate.
definitions.definitionCn: 使平息；解除（有害或压迫之物）；缓解；清除；解放。

definitions.definition: To release from obligation, accusation, penalty, etc.; to absolve; to acquit.
definitions.definitionCn: 免除义务、指控、惩罚等；赦免；宣告无罪。

definitions.definition: To abandon, renounce (a thing).
definitions.definitionCn: 放弃、抛弃（某物）。

definitions.definition: To leave (a place).
definitions.definitionCn: 离开（某地）。

definitions.definition: To resign from (a job, office, position, etc.).
definitions.example: After having to work overtime without being paid, I quit my job.
definitions.definitionCn: 辞去（工作、职务、职位等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 在被迫无偿加班后，我辞去了工作。

definitions.definition: To stop, give up (an activity) (usually + gerund or verbal noun).
definitions.example: John is planning to quit smoking.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止、放弃（某项活动）（通常后接动名词或动词性名词）。
definitions.exampleCn: 约翰正计划戒烟。

definitions.definition: To close (an application).
definitions.definitionCn: 关闭（应用程序）。

definitions.definition: (usually followed by of) Released from obligation, penalty, etc; free, clear, or rid.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常后接of）免除义务、惩罚等；自由、清除或摆脱。

definitions.definition: Any of numerous species of small passerine birds native to tropical America.
An animal's tail.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物的尾巴。

definitions.definition: A men's hairstyle whose primary attribute is a braid or ponytail at the back of the head, such as that worn by men in Imperial China.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种男性发型，主要特征是在脑后编成辫子或扎成马尾，例如中国帝国时期男性所留的发型。

definitions.definition: A line of people, vehicles or other objects, in which one at the front end is dealt with first, the one behind is dealt with next, and so on, and which newcomers join at the opposite end (the back).
definitions.definitionCn: 一列人、车辆或其他物体，排在前端的先被处理，后面的依次处理，新来者加入另一端（即队尾）。

definitions.definition: A waiting list or other means of organizing people or objects into a first-come-first-served order.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种等候名单或其他将人或物按先到先得顺序组织的方式。

definitions.definition: A data structure in which objects are added to one end, called the tail, and removed from the other, called the head (- a FIFO queue). The term can also refer to a LIFO queue or stack where these ends coincide.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种数据结构，对象从一端（称为队尾）添加，从另一端（称为队首）移除（即先进先出队列）。该术语也可指后进先出队列或栈，此时两端重合。

definitions.definition: To put oneself or itself at the end of a waiting line.
definitions.definitionCn: 将自己或自身置于等候队伍的末尾。

definitions.definition: To arrange themselves into a physical waiting queue.
definitions.definitionCn: 排列成物理上的等候队列。

definitions.definition: To add to a queue data structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 添加到队列数据结构中。

definitions.definition: To fasten the hair into a queue.
definitions.definitionCn: 将头发扎成辫子或马尾。

definitions.definition: Strong of its kind or in character; unmitigated; virulent; thorough; utter (used of negative things).
definitions.example: rank nonsense
definitions.definitionCn: 同类中或特性上强烈的；十足的；恶性的；彻底的；完全的（用于负面事物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 十足的胡说八道。

definitions.definition: Strong in growth; growing with vigour or rapidity, hence, coarse or gross.
definitions.example: rank grass
definitions.definitionCn: 生长旺盛的；蓬勃或快速生长的，因而粗糙或粗俗。
definitions.exampleCn: 疯长的野草。

definitions.definition: Suffering from overgrowth or hypertrophy; plethoric.
definitions.definitionCn: 因过度生长或肥大而受苦的；过多的。

definitions.definition: Causing strong growth; producing luxuriantly; rich and fertile.
definitions.example: rank land
definitions.definitionCn: 导致旺盛生长的；丰产的；肥沃的。
definitions.exampleCn: 肥沃的土地。

definitions.definition: Strong to the senses; offensive; noisome.
definitions.definitionCn: 感官上强烈的；令人不快的；恶臭的。

definitions.definition: Having a very strong and bad taste or odor.
definitions.example: Your gym clothes are rank, bro – when'd you last wash 'em?
definitions.definitionCn: 有非常强烈且难闻的味道或气味。
definitions.exampleCn: 老兄，你的运动服臭死了——你上次洗是什么时候？

definitions.definition: Complete, used as an intensifier (usually negative, referring to incompetence).
definitions.example: I am a rank amateur as a wordsmith.
definitions.definitionCn: 完全的，用作强调词（通常为负面，指无能）。
definitions.exampleCn: 作为文字工作者，我是个彻头彻尾的门外汉。

definitions.definition: Gross, disgusting.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人作呕的；恶心的。

definitions.definition: Strong; powerful; capable of acting or being used with great effect; energetic; vigorous; headstrong.
definitions.definitionCn: 强大的；有力的；能有效行动或使用的；精力充沛的；有力的；任性的。

definitions.definition: Inflamed with venereal appetite; ruttish.
definitions.definitionCn: 因性欲而兴奋的；发情的。

definitions.definition: Quickly, eagerly, impetuously.
definitions.definitionCn: 迅速地；急切地；冲动地。

definitions.definition: A row of people or things organized in a grid pattern, often soldiers [the corresponding term for the perpendicular columns in such a pattern is "file"].
definitions.example: The front rank kneeled to reload while the second rank fired over their heads.

definitions.definition: In a pipe organ, a set of pipes of a certain quality for which each pipe corresponds to one key or pedal.
One's position in a list sorted by a shared property such as physical location, population, or quality
definitions.example: Based on your test scores, you have a rank of 23.

definitions.definition: The level of one's position in a class-based society
A hierarchical level in an organization such as the military
definitions.example: He rose up through the ranks of the company, from mailroom clerk to CEO.

definitions.definition: A level in a scientific taxonomy system
definitions.example: Phylum is the taxonomic rank below kingdom and above class.

definitions.definition: Maximal number of linearly independent columns (or rows) of a matrix.
The dimensionality of an array or tensor.
The maximum quantity of D-linearly independent elements of a module (over an integral domain D).
The size of any basis of a given matroid.
One of the eight horizontal lines of squares on a chessboard (i.e., those identified by a number). The analog vertical lines are the files.
(typically in the plural) A category of people, such as those who share an occupation.
To place abreast, or in a line.
To have a ranking.
definitions.example: Their defense ranked third in the league.

definitions.definition: To assign a suitable place in a class or order; to classify.
To take rank of; to outrank.

A contest between people, animals, vehicles, etc. where the goal is to be the first to reach some objective. Example: Several horses run in a horse race, and the first one to reach the finishing post wins
definitions.example: The race around the park was won by Johnny, who ran faster than the others.
definitions.definitionCn: 人与人、动物、车辆等之间的竞赛，目标是率先到达某个终点。例如：几匹马参加赛马比赛，第一匹到达终点柱的马获胜。
definitions.exampleCn: 公园赛跑中约翰尼获胜，他跑得比其他人都快。

definitions.definition: Swift progress; rapid motion; an instance of moving or driving at high speed.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速前进；高速运动；高速移动或驾驶的实例。

definitions.definition: A race condition.
definitions.definitionCn: 竞态条件。

definitions.definition: A progressive movement toward a goal.
definitions.example: the race to cure cancer
definitions.definitionCn: 向目标逐步推进的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 攻克癌症的竞赛。

definitions.definition: A fast-moving current of water, such as that which powers a mill wheel.
definitions.definitionCn: 推动水车运转的急流。

definitions.definition: A water channel, esp. one built to lead water to or from a point where it is utilised.
definitions.definitionCn: 水道，尤指为引水或排水而修建的渠道。

definitions.definition: Competitive action of any kind, especially when prolonged; hence, career; course of life.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何形式的竞争性行为，尤其是长期持续的；引申为职业；人生历程。

definitions.definition: The bushings of a rolling element bearing which contacts the rolling elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 滚动轴承中与滚动体接触的套圈。

definitions.definition: To take part in a race (in the sense of a contest).
definitions.example: The drivers were racing around the track.
definitions.definitionCn: 参加竞赛（指比赛形式）。
definitions.exampleCn: 车手们在赛道上竞速。

definitions.definition: To compete against in such a race.
definitions.example: I raced him to the car, but he was there first, so he got to ride shotgun.
definitions.definitionCn: 在比赛中与某人竞争。
definitions.exampleCn: 我和他赛跑去汽车旁，但他先到，所以坐上了副驾驶座。

definitions.definition: To move or drive at high speed; to hurry or speed.
definitions.example: As soon as it was time to go home, he raced for the door.
definitions.definitionCn: 高速移动或驾驶；匆忙或加速。
definitions.exampleCn: 一到回家时间，他就冲向门口。

definitions.definition: Of a motor, to run rapidly when not engaged to a transmission.
definitions.definitionCn: （指发动机）在未挂挡时空转。

definitions.definition: A group of sentient beings, particularly people, distinguished by common ancestry, heritage or characteristics:
A population geographically separated from others of its species that develops significantly different characteristics; an informal term for a subspecies.
A breed or strain of domesticated animal.
A category or species of something that has emerged or evolved from an older one (with an implied parallel to animal breeding or evolutionary science).
definitions.example: Recent developments in artificial intelligence has brought about a new race of robots that can perform household chores without supervision.

definitions.definition: Peculiar flavour, taste, or strength, as of wine; that quality, or assemblage of qualities, which indicates origin or kind, as in wine; hence, characteristic flavour.
Characteristic quality or disposition.
To assign a race to; to perceive as having a (usually specified) race.
A rhizome or root, especially of ginger.
To demolish; to level to the ground.
To scrape as if with a razor.
An increase in wages or salary; a rise (UK).
definitions.example: The boss gave me a raise.
definitions.definitionCn: 工资或薪水的增加；加薪（英国用法）。
definitions.exampleCn: 老板给我加了薪。

definitions.definition: A shoulder exercise in which the arms are elevated against resistance.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种肩部锻炼，手臂在阻力下抬起。

definitions.definition: A shot in which the delivered stone bumps another stone forward.
definitions.definitionCn: 冰壶运动中，投出的石球将另一石球向前撞击。

definitions.definition: A bet that increases the previous bet.
definitions.definitionCn: 增加前一次下注金额的赌注。

definitions.definition: (physical) To cause to rise; to lift or elevate.
definitions.example: to raise your hand if you want to say something; to raise your walking stick to defend yourself
definitions.definitionCn: （物理）使上升；举起或抬高。
definitions.exampleCn: 想说话时举手；举起手杖自卫。

definitions.definition: To create, increase or develop.
definitions.example: We need to raise the motivation level in the company.
definitions.definitionCn: 创造、增加或发展。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们需要提高公司的积极性水平。

definitions.definition: To establish contact with (e.g., by telephone or radio).
definitions.example: Despite all the call congestion, she was eventually able to raise the police.
definitions.definitionCn: 建立联系（例如通过电话或无线电）。
definitions.exampleCn: 尽管通话拥堵，她最终还是联系上了警方。

definitions.definition: To respond to a bet by increasing the amount required to continue in the hand.
definitions.example: John bet, and Julie raised, requiring John to put in more money.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过增加继续游戏所需金额来回应下注。
definitions.exampleCn: 约翰下注，朱莉加注，要求约翰投入更多钱。

definitions.definition: To exponentiate, to involute.
definitions.example: Two raised to the fifth power equals 32.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行乘方运算。
definitions.exampleCn: 2的5次方等于32。

definitions.definition: (of a verb) To extract (a subject or other verb argument) out of an inner clause.
definitions.definitionCn: （动词）从内层从句中提取（主语或其他动词论元）。

definitions.definition: (of a vowel) To produce a vowel with the tongue positioned closer to the roof of the mouth.
definitions.definitionCn: （元音）将舌头靠近上颚以发出元音。

definitions.definition: To increase the nominal value of (a cheque, money order, etc.) by fraudulently changing the writing or printing in which the sum payable is specified.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过欺诈性地更改书写或印刷来增加（支票、汇票等）的票面金额。

definitions.definition: To throw (an exception).
definitions.example: A division by zero will raise an exception.
definitions.definitionCn: 抛出（异常）。
definitions.exampleCn: 除以零将引发异常。

definitions.definition: A cairn or pile of stones.
(historical: 19th-century Britain) A member of the most progressive wing of the Liberal Party; someone favouring social reform (but generally stopping short of socialism).
definitions.definitionCn: (历史：19世纪英国) 自由党最进步派别的成员；支持社会改革（但通常不触及社会主义）的人。

definitions.definition: (historical: early 20th-century France) A member of an influential, centrist political party favouring moderate social reform, a republican constitution, and secular politics.
definitions.definitionCn: (历史：20世纪初法国) 一个有影响力的中间派政党成员，主张温和的社会改革、共和宪法和世俗政治。

definitions.definition: A person with radical opinions.
definitions.definitionCn: 持有激进观点的人。

definitions.definition: A root (of a number or quantity).
definitions.definitionCn: （数字或量的）根。

definitions.definition: In logographic writing systems such as the Chinese writing system, the portion of a character (if any) that provides an indication of its meaning, as opposed to phonetic.
definitions.definitionCn: 在汉字等语素文字系统中，字符中（若有）提供意义提示的部分，与声旁相对。

definitions.definition: In Semitic languages, any one of the set of consonants (typically three) that make up a root.
definitions.definitionCn: 在闪米特语中，构成词根的一组辅音（通常为三个）。

definitions.definition: A group of atoms, joined by covalent bonds, that take part in reactions as a single unit.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组通过共价键结合、作为整体参与反应的原子。

definitions.definition: A free radical.
definitions.definitionCn: 自由基。

definitions.definition: (commutative algebra, of an ideal) Given an ideal I in a commutative ring R, another ideal, denoted Rad(I) or \sqrt{I}, such that an element x ∈ R is in Rad(I) if, for some positive integer n, xn ∈ I; equivalently, the intersection of all prime ideals containing I.
definitions.definitionCn: （交换代数，用于理想）给定交换环R中的理想I，另一个理想记为Rad(I)或√I，若存在正整数n使xⁿ∈I，则元素x∈R属于Rad(I)；等价于所有包含I的素理想的交集。

definitions.definition: (of a ring) Given a ring R, an ideal containing elements of R that share a property considered, in some sense, "not good".
definitions.definitionCn: （用于环）给定环R，包含具有某种“不良”性质元素的理想。

definitions.definition: (of a module) The intersection of maximal submodules of a given module.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于模）给定模的所有极大子模的交集。

definitions.definition: The product of the distinct prime factors of a given positive integer.
definitions.definitionCn: 给定正整数的不同质因数的乘积。

definitions.definition: Favoring fundamental change, or change at the root cause of a matter.
definitions.example: His beliefs are radical.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持根本性变革，或从根源上改变事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的信仰很激进。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to a root (of a plant).
definitions.definitionCn: 与（植物的）根相关的。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to the basic or intrinsic nature of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 与事物的基本或内在性质相关的。

definitions.definition: Thoroughgoing; far-reaching.
definitions.example: The spread of the cancer required radical surgery, and the entire organ was removed.
definitions.definitionCn: 彻底的；深远的。
definitions.exampleCn: 癌症扩散需要根治性手术，整个器官被切除。

definitions.definition: Of or pertaining to the root of a word.
definitions.definitionCn: 与词根相关的。

definitions.definition: (of a sound) Produced using the root of the tongue.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于发音）用舌根发出的。

definitions.definition: Involving free radicals.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及自由基的。

definitions.definition: Relating to a radix or mathematical root.
definitions.example: a radical quantity; a radical sign
definitions.definitionCn: 与基数或数学根相关的。
definitions.exampleCn: 根式；根号

definitions.definition: (1980s & 1990s) Excellent; awesome.
definitions.example: That was a radical jump!
definitions.definitionCn: （20世纪80年代和90年代）极好的；棒极了。
definitions.exampleCn: 那真是绝妙的跳跃！

definitions.definition: A line or series of mountains, buildings, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 山脉、建筑等的一排或一系列。

definitions.definition: A fireplace; a fire or other cooking apparatus; now specifically, a large cooking stove with many hotplates.
definitions.definitionCn: 壁炉；火或其他烹饪器具；现特指带有多个加热板的大型烹饪炉。

definitions.definition: Selection, array.
definitions.example: We sell a wide range of cars.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择，排列。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们销售各种类型的汽车。

definitions.definition: An area for practicing shooting at targets.
definitions.definitionCn: 练习射击目标的区域。

definitions.definition: An area for military training or equipment testing.
definitions.definitionCn: 军事训练或设备测试的区域。

definitions.definition: The distance from a person or sensor to an object, target, emanation, or event.
definitions.example: One can use the speed of sound to estimate the range of a lightning flash.
definitions.definitionCn: 从人或传感器到物体、目标、发射源或事件的距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 可以利用声速估算闪电的距离。

definitions.definition: Maximum distance of capability (of a weapon, radio, detector, fuel supply, etc.).
definitions.example: This missile's range is 500 kilometres.
definitions.definitionCn: （武器、无线电、探测器、燃料供应等）的最大能力距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 这枚导弹的射程为500公里。

definitions.definition: An area of open, often unfenced, grazing land.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片开阔、通常无围栏的放牧地。

definitions.definition: Extent or space taken in by anything excursive; compass or extent of excursion; reach; scope.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何漫游事物所占据的范围或空间；漫游的广度；范围；领域。

definitions.definition: The set of values (points) which a function can obtain.
definitions.definitionCn: 函数能够获取的值的集合（点）。

definitions.definition: The length of the smallest interval which contains all the data in a sample; the difference between the largest and smallest observations in the sample.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含样本中所有数据的最小区间的长度；样本中最大观测值与最小观测值之差。

definitions.definition: The defensive area that a player can cover.
definitions.example: Jones has good range for a big man.
definitions.definitionCn: 球员能够防守的区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯作为大个子球员有很好的防守范围。

definitions.definition: The scale of all the tones a voice or an instrument can produce.
definitions.definitionCn: 声音或乐器能产生的所有音调的范围。

definitions.definition: The geographical area or zone where a species is normally naturally found.
definitions.definitionCn: 物种通常自然分布的地理区域或地带。

definitions.definition: A sequential list of values specified by an iterator.
definitions.example: std::for_each  calls the given function on each value in the input range.
definitions.definitionCn: 由迭代器指定的值的顺序列表。
definitions.exampleCn: `std::for_each` 对输入范围内的每个值调用给定的函数。

definitions.definition: An aggregate of individuals in one rank or degree; an order; a class.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一等级或级别的个体集合；等级；类别。

definitions.definition: The step of a ladder; a rung.
definitions.definitionCn: 梯子的台阶；横档。

definitions.definition: A bolting sieve to sift meal.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于筛面粉的筛子。

definitions.definition: A wandering or roving; a going to and fro; an excursion; a ramble; an expedition.
definitions.definitionCn: 漫游或徘徊；来回走动；短途旅行；漫步；远征。

definitions.definition: In the public land system, a row or line of townships lying between two succession meridian lines six miles apart.
definitions.definitionCn: 在公共土地系统中，位于两条相距六英里的子午线之间的一排或一行镇区。

definitions.definition: The scope of something, the extent that something covers or includes.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物的范围，其涵盖或包含的程度。

definitions.definition: The variety of roles that an actor can play in a satisfactory way.
definitions.example: By playing in comedies as well as in dramas he has proved his acting range.
definitions.definitionCn: 演员能令人满意地扮演的角色种类。
definitions.exampleCn: 通过出演喜剧和戏剧，他证明了自己的表演范围。

definitions.definition: To travel over (an area, etc); to roam, wander.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿越（某区域等）；漫游，闲逛。

definitions.definition: To rove over or through.
definitions.example: to range the fields
definitions.definitionCn: 漫游或穿过。
definitions.exampleCn: 在田野中漫游。

definitions.definition: To exercise the power of something over something else; to cause to submit to, over.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某物行使权力；使服从于。

definitions.definition: To bring (something) into a specified position or relationship (especially, of opposition) with something else.
