definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）置于与另一物特定的位置或关系（尤指对立关系）。

definitions.definition: (followed by over) Of a variable, to be able to take any of the values in a specified range.
definitions.example: The variable x ranges over all real values from 0 to 10.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接 over）变量能够取指定范围内的任意值。
definitions.exampleCn: 变量 x 的取值范围是从0到10的所有实数。

definitions.definition: To classify.
definitions.example: to range plants and animals in genera and species
definitions.definitionCn: 分类。
definitions.exampleCn: 将植物和动物按属和种分类。

definitions.definition: To form a line or a row.
definitions.example: The front of a house ranges with the street.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成一排或一行。
definitions.exampleCn: 房子的正面与街道对齐。

definitions.definition: To be placed in order; to be ranked; to admit of arrangement or classification; to rank.
definitions.definitionCn: 按顺序排列；被排名；允许安排或分类；排名。

definitions.definition: To set in a row, or in rows; to place in a regular line or lines, or in ranks; to dispose in the proper order.
definitions.definitionCn: 排成一行或数行；置于规则的线或行中，或按等级排列；按适当顺序排列。

definitions.definition: To place among others in a line, row, or order, as in the ranks of an army; usually, reflexively and figuratively, to espouse a cause, to join a party, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某人置于一行、一排或一列中，如军队的队列中；通常反身且比喻地，支持某事业，加入某党派等。

definitions.definition: To be native to, or live in, a certain district or region.
definitions.example: The peba ranges from Texas to Paraguay.
definitions.definitionCn: 原产于或生活在某特定区域或地区。
definitions.exampleCn: 犰狳的分布范围从德克萨斯州到巴拉圭。

definitions.definition: To separate into parts; to sift.
definitions.definitionCn: 分成部分；筛选。

definitions.definition: To sail or pass in a direction parallel to or near.
definitions.example: to range the coast
definitions.definitionCn: 沿平行于或靠近的方向航行或经过。
definitions.exampleCn: 沿海岸航行。

definitions.definition: Of a player, to travel a significant distance for a defensive play.
definitions.definitionCn: （球员）为防守而移动相当远的距离。

definitions.definition: Not occurring at a regular interval; seldom; not often.
definitions.example: Rarely do you ever find an eagle this far up the river.
definitions.definitionCn: 不经常发生；很少；不常。
definitions.exampleCn: 你很少会在河的上游这么远的地方发现一只鹰。

definitions.definition: Unusually well; excellently.
definitions.definitionCn: 异常地好；极好。

definitions.definition: To a rare degree; very.
definitions.definitionCn: 达到罕见的程度；非常。

definitions.definition: The state of being actual or real.
definitions.example: The reality of the crash scene on TV dawned upon him only when he saw the victim was no actor but his friend.
definitions.definitionCn: 实际或真实的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 当他看到受害者不是演员而是他的朋友时，电视上事故现场的真实性才让他恍然大悟。

definitions.definition: A real entity, event or other fact.
definitions.example: The ultimate reality of life is that it ends in death.
definitions.definitionCn: 真实存在的实体、事件或其他事实。
definitions.exampleCn: 生命的终极现实是它终将走向死亡。

definitions.definition: The entirety of all that is real.
definitions.definitionCn: 所有真实事物的整体。

definitions.definition: An individual observer's own subjective perception of that which is real.
definitions.definitionCn: 个体观察者对真实事物的主观感知。

definitions.definition: Loyalty; devotion.
definitions.definitionCn: 忠诚；奉献。

definitions.definition: Realty; real estate.
definitions.definitionCn: 不动产；房地产。

definitions.definition: An emoji used to express a reaction to a post on social media.
definitions.example: Sad reacts only
definitions.definitionCn: 用于在社交媒体上表达对帖子的反应。
definitions.exampleCn: 仅限悲伤反应。

definitions.definition: To act or perform a second time; to do over again; to reenact.
definitions.definitionCn: 再次行动或表演；重复做；重新演绎。

definitions.definition: To return an impulse or impression; to resist the action of another body by an opposite force
definitions.example: Every body reacts on the body that impels it from its natural state.
definitions.definitionCn: 对冲动或印象作出回应；通过相反的力量抵抗另一物体的作用。
definitions.exampleCn: 每个物体都会对使其脱离自然状态的物体产生反作用。

definitions.definition: To act upon each other; to exercise a reciprocal or a reverse effect, as two or more chemical agents; to act in opposition.
definitions.definitionCn: 相互影响；如同两种或多种化学试剂一样，产生相互或反向作用；起对抗作用。

definitions.definition: To cause chemical agents to react; to cause one chemical agent to react with another.
definitions.definitionCn: 使化学试剂发生反应；使一种化学试剂与另一种反应。

definitions.definition: A number representing a comparison between two named things.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示两个命名事物之间比较的数字。

definitions.definition: The relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient).
definitions.definitionCn: 两个量的相对大小（通常表示为商）。

definitions.definition: Short for ratio decidendi.
definitions.definitionCn: ratio decidendi的缩写。

definitions.definition: The amount of comments to a post or other expression on social media relative to the number of likes.
definitions.definitionCn: 社交媒体上某条帖子或其他表达收到的评论数量相对于点赞数量的比例。

definitions.definition: (social media) To respond to a post or message on social media in a greater number than the number of likes the post receives.
definitions.example: The schoolchildren ganged up to ratio the school catering over its shamefully undemocratic inclusion of vegetables in meals.
definitions.definitionCn: （社交媒体）以超过帖子点赞数量的更大数量回复社交媒体上的帖子或消息。
definitions.exampleCn: 学生们联合起来，以压倒性的评论数量抨击学校餐饮，因其可耻地不民主地在餐食中加入了蔬菜。

definitions.definition: To make real; to convert from the imaginary or fictitious into reality; to bring into real existence
definitions.example: The objectives of the project were never fully realized.
definitions.definitionCn: 使成为现实；将想象中的或虚构的事物转化为现实；使其真实存在
definitions.exampleCn: 该项目的目标从未完全实现。

definitions.definition: To become aware of (a fact or situation, especially of something that has been true for a long time).
definitions.example: He realized that he had left his umbrella on the train.
definitions.definitionCn: 意识到（一个事实或情况，尤其是长期存在的事实）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他意识到自己把伞落在了火车上。

definitions.definition: To cause to seem real; to sense vividly or strongly; to make one's own in thought or experience.
definitions.definitionCn: 使显得真实；生动或强烈地感知；在思想或经历中将其化为己有。

definitions.definition: To acquire as an actual possession; to obtain as the result of plans and efforts; to gain; to get
definitions.example: to realize large profits from a speculation
definitions.definitionCn: 作为实际财产获得；通过计划和努力取得成果；获得；得到
definitions.exampleCn: 从投机中获取巨额利润

definitions.definition: To convert any kind of property into money, especially property representing investments, such as shares, bonds, etc.
definitions.example: By realizing the company's assets, the liquidator was able to return most of the shareholders' investments.
definitions.definitionCn: 将任何形式的财产转换为货币，尤其是代表投资的财产，如股票、债券等。
definitions.exampleCn: 通过变现公司资产，清算人得以返还大部分股东的投资。

definitions.definition: To convert into real property; to make real estate of.
definitions.definitionCn: 转换为不动产；使其成为房地产。

definitions.definition: To turn an abstract linguistic object into actual language, especially said of a phoneme's conversion into speech sound.
definitions.example: The southern /v/ is realized as the voiced approximant [ʋ].
definitions.definitionCn: 将抽象的语言对象转化为实际语言，尤指音素转化为语音。
definitions.exampleCn: 南方的/v/音实现为浊近音[ʋ]。

definitions.definition: To prefer; to prefer to.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏好；更倾向于。

definitions.definition: Prior; earlier; former.
definitions.definitionCn: 先前的；更早的；从前的。

definitions.definition: More quickly; sooner, earlier.
definitions.definitionCn: 更快地；更早地。

definitions.definition: Used to specify a choice or preference; preferably, in preference to. (Now usually followed by than)
definitions.example: I'd like this one rather than the other one.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于指定选择或偏好；最好地，优先地。（现在通常后接than）
definitions.exampleCn: 我更喜欢这个而不是另一个。

definitions.definition: Used to introduce a contradiction; on the contrary.
definitions.example: It wasn't supposed to be popular; rather, it was supposed to get the job done.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于引出矛盾；相反地。
definitions.exampleCn: 它本不该受欢迎；相反，它本应完成工作。

definitions.definition: Introducing a qualification or clarification; more precisely. (Now usually preceded by or.)
definitions.example: I didn't want to leave. Or rather I did, just not alone.
definitions.definitionCn: 引出限定或澄清；更准确地说。（现在通常前接or）
definitions.exampleCn: 我不想离开。或者更准确地说，我想离开，只是不想独自一人。

definitions.definition: (degree) Somewhat, fairly.
definitions.example: This melon is rather tasteless, especially compared to the one we had last time.
definitions.definitionCn: （程度）有点，相当。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个瓜相当无味，尤其是和我们上次吃的那个相比。

definitions.definition: An enthusiastic affirmation.
definitions.example: "Would you like some?" -- "Rather!"
definitions.definitionCn: 热情的肯定。
definitions.exampleCn: “你想要一些吗？”——“当然！”

definitions.definition: To assign or be assigned a particular rank or level.
definitions.example: She is rated fourth in the country.
definitions.definitionCn: 被指定或指定某一特定等级或级别。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在国内排名第四。

definitions.definition: To evaluate or estimate the value of.
definitions.example: They rate his talents highly.
definitions.definitionCn: 评估或估计价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们高度评价他的才能。

definitions.definition: To consider or regard.
definitions.example: He rated this book brilliant.
definitions.definitionCn: 认为或看待。
definitions.exampleCn: 他认为这本书很出色。

definitions.definition: To deserve; to be worth.
definitions.example: The view here hardly rates a mention in the travel guide.
definitions.definitionCn: 应得；值得。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里的景色在旅游指南中几乎不值一提。

definitions.definition: To determine the limits of safe functioning for a machine or electrical device.
definitions.example: The transformer is rated at 10 watts.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定机器或电气设备安全运行的极限。
definitions.exampleCn: 这台变压器的额定功率为10瓦。

definitions.definition: To evaluate a property's value for the purposes of local taxation.
definitions.definitionCn: 为地方税收目的评估财产价值。

definitions.definition: To like; to think highly of.
definitions.example: The customers don't rate the new burgers.
definitions.definitionCn: 喜欢；高度评价。
definitions.exampleCn: 顾客们不喜欢新款汉堡。

definitions.definition: To have position (in a certain class).
definitions.example: He rates as the best cyclist in the country.
definitions.definitionCn: 在（某一类别中）占据位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 他堪称国内最佳自行车手。

definitions.definition: To have value or standing.
definitions.example: This last performance of hers didn't rate very high with the judges.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有价值或地位。
definitions.exampleCn: 她最后一场表演在评委眼中评价不高。

definitions.definition: To ratify.
definitions.definitionCn: 批准。

definitions.definition: To ascertain the exact rate of the gain or loss of (a chronometer) as compared with true time.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定（天文钟）相对于标准时间的精确快慢率。

definitions.definition: To berate, scold.
definitions.definitionCn: 严厉责备，训斥。

definitions.definition: A position on a scale
definitions.definitionCn: 等级量表上的位置。

definitions.definition: An evaluation of status, especially of financial status
definitions.example: They have a poor credit rating.
definitions.definitionCn: 对状况的评估，尤指财务状况。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们的信用评级很差。

definitions.definition: A number, letter, or other mark that refers to the ability of something.
definitions.example: He has a high chess rating.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示某物能力的数字、字母或其他标记。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的国际象棋等级分很高。

definitions.definition: A seaman in a warship
definitions.definitionCn: 军舰上的水兵。

definitions.definition: The status of a seaman, corresponding to rank in officers.
definitions.definitionCn: 水兵的级别，对应军官的军衔。

definitions.definition: (sugar refining, sugar trade) An unprocessed sugar; a batch of such.
definitions.definitionCn: (制糖、糖贸易) 未经加工的糖；一批这样的糖。

definitions.definition: A galled place; an inveterate sore.
definitions.definitionCn: 擦伤处；顽固的疮口。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A point about which a person is particularly sensitive.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）某人特别敏感的话题。

definitions.definition: A recording or rip of a show that has not been fansubbed.
definitions.definitionCn: 未经字幕组翻译的节目录制版或盗录版。

definitions.definition: A scan that has not been cleaned (purged of blemishes arising from the scanning process) and has not been scanlated.
definitions.definitionCn: 未经清理（去除扫描过程中产生的瑕疵）且未经翻译的扫描件。

definitions.definition: (of food) Not cooked.
definitions.definitionCn: （指食物）未煮熟的。

definitions.definition: (of materials, products, etc.) Not treated or processed; in a natural state, unrefined, unprocessed.
definitions.example: raw cane sugar
definitions.definitionCn: （指材料、产品等）未经处理或加工的；处于自然状态，未精炼，未加工。
definitions.exampleCn: 原蔗糖。

definitions.definition: Having had the skin removed or abraded; chafed, tender; exposed, lacerated.
definitions.example: a raw wound
definitions.definitionCn: 皮肤被剥落或擦伤的；擦痛的、敏感的；暴露的、撕裂的。
definitions.exampleCn: 未愈合的伤口。

definitions.definition: New or inexperienced.
definitions.example: a raw beginner
definitions.definitionCn: 新手或缺乏经验的。
definitions.exampleCn: 纯粹的新手。

definitions.definition: Crude in quality; rough, uneven, unsophisticated.
definitions.example: a raw voice
definitions.definitionCn: 质量粗糙的；粗劣的、不平整的、不精细的。
definitions.exampleCn: 粗哑的嗓音。

definitions.definition: (of data) Uncorrected, without analysis.
definitions.definitionCn: （指数据）未经校正的，未分析的。

definitions.definition: (of weather) Unpleasantly cold or damp.
definitions.example: a raw wind
definitions.definitionCn: （指天气）令人不适的寒冷或潮湿。
definitions.exampleCn: 刺骨的寒风。

definitions.definition: (of an emotion, personality, etc.) Unmasked, undisguised, strongly expressed
definitions.example: raw emotion
definitions.definitionCn: （指情感、性格等）不加掩饰的、毫不隐瞒的、强烈表达的。
definitions.exampleCn: 赤裸的情感。

definitions.definition: Candid in a representation of unpleasant facts, conditions, etc.
definitions.example: a raw description of the American political arena
definitions.definitionCn: 对不愉快事实、状况等坦率描述的。
definitions.exampleCn: 对美国政治舞台的直白描述。

definitions.definition: (of language) Unrefined, crude, or insensitive, especially with reference to sexual matters
definitions.definitionCn: （指语言）粗俗的、粗鲁的或冒犯的，尤指涉及性方面。

definitions.definition: Not covered; bare; bald.
definitions.definitionCn: 未覆盖的；裸露的；光秃的。

definitions.definition: Without a condom.
definitions.example: We did it raw.
definitions.definitionCn: 未使用安全套的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们无套做了。

definitions.definition: The worth of something; value.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的价值；重要性。

definitions.definition: The proportional relationship between one amount, value etc. and another.
definitions.example: At the height of his powers, he was producing pictures at the rate of four a year.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个数量、价值等与另一个之间的比例关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 在他能力巅峰时期，他以每年四幅的速度创作画作。

definitions.definition: Speed.
definitions.example: The car was speeding down here at a hell of a rate.
definitions.definitionCn: 速度。
definitions.exampleCn: 那辆车正以极快的速度朝这里飞驰。

definitions.definition: The relative speed of change or progress.
definitions.example: The rate of production at the factory is skyrocketing.
definitions.definitionCn: 变化或进展的相对速度。
definitions.exampleCn: 工厂的生产率正在飙升。

definitions.definition: The price of (an individual) thing; cost.
definitions.example: He asked quite a rate to take me to the airport.
definitions.definitionCn: （单个）物品的价格；成本。
definitions.exampleCn: 他送我去机场要价相当高。

definitions.definition: A set price or charge for all examples of a given case, commodity, service etc.
definitions.example: Postal rates here are low.
definitions.definitionCn: 针对特定情况、商品、服务等所有实例设定的固定价格或收费。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里的邮资很低。

definitions.definition: A wage calculated in relation to a unit of time.
definitions.example: We pay an hourly rate of between $10 – $15 per hour depending on qualifications and experience.
definitions.definitionCn: 按时间单位计算的工资。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们根据资历和经验支付每小时10至15美元的时薪。

definitions.definition: Any of various taxes, especially those levied by a local authority.
definitions.example: I hardly have enough left every month to pay the rates.
definitions.definitionCn: 各种税费，尤其是地方当局征收的税。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每个月几乎剩不下多少钱来支付地方税。

definitions.definition: A class into which ships were assigned based on condition, size etc.; by extension, rank.
definitions.example: This textbook is first-rate.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据状况、大小等划分的船舶等级；引申为级别。
definitions.exampleCn: 这本教科书是一流的。

definitions.definition: Established portion or measure; fixed allowance; ration.
definitions.definitionCn: 规定的份额或度量；固定配给；定量。

definitions.definition: Order; arrangement.
definitions.definitionCn: 顺序；安排。

definitions.definition: Ratification; approval.
definitions.definitionCn: 批准；认可。

definitions.definition: The gain or loss of a timepiece in a unit of time.
definitions.example: daily rate; hourly rate; etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 钟表在单位时间内的快慢误差。
definitions.exampleCn: 日费率；小时费率等。

definitions.definition: To assign or be assigned a particular rank or level.
definitions.example: She is rated fourth in the country.
definitions.definitionCn: 被指定或指定特定的等级或水平。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在国内排名第四。

definitions.definition: To evaluate or estimate the value of.
definitions.example: They rate his talents highly.
definitions.definitionCn: 评估或估计价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们对他的才能评价很高。

definitions.definition: To consider or regard.
definitions.example: He rated this book brilliant.
definitions.definitionCn: 认为；看待。
definitions.exampleCn: 他认为这本书很出色。

definitions.definition: To deserve; to be worth.
definitions.example: The view here hardly rates a mention in the travel guide.
definitions.definitionCn: 值得；配得上。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里的景色在旅游指南中几乎不值一提。

definitions.definition: To determine the limits of safe functioning for a machine or electrical device.
definitions.example: The transformer is rated at 10 watts.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定机器或电气设备安全运行的极限。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个变压器的额定功率是10瓦。

definitions.definition: To evaluate a property's value for the purposes of local taxation.
definitions.definitionCn: 为地方征税目的评估房产价值。

definitions.definition: To like; to think highly of.
definitions.example: The customers don't rate the new burgers.
definitions.definitionCn: 喜欢；高度评价。
definitions.exampleCn: 顾客们不喜欢新款汉堡。

definitions.definition: To have position (in a certain class).
definitions.example: He rates as the best cyclist in the country.
definitions.definitionCn: （在某一类别中）占据位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 他堪称国内最佳自行车手。

definitions.definition: To have value or standing.
definitions.example: This last performance of hers didn't rate very high with the judges.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有价值或地位。
definitions.exampleCn: 她最后的这次表演在评委眼中评价不高。

definitions.definition: To ratify.
definitions.definitionCn: 批准。

definitions.definition: To ascertain the exact rate of the gain or loss of (a chronometer) as compared with true time.
definitions.definitionCn: 测定（精密计时器）与标准时间相比的准确快慢率。

definitions.definition: To berate, scold.
The act of stretching or extending; extension.
definitions.definitionCn: 伸展或延伸的动作；扩展。

definitions.definition: The ability to reach or touch with the person, a limb, or something held or thrown.
definitions.example: The fruit is beyond my reach.
definitions.definitionCn: 用手、肢体或握持、投掷的物体触及或够到的能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个水果我够不着。

definitions.definition: The power of stretching out or extending action, influence, or the like; power of attainment or management; extent of force or capacity.
definitions.definitionCn: 延伸行动、影响等的能力；达成或管理的能力；力量或能力的范围。

definitions.definition: Extent; stretch; expanse; hence, application; influence; result; scope.
definitions.definitionCn: 范围；延伸；广阔区域；由此引申为应用、影响、结果、范围。

definitions.definition: An exaggeration; an extension beyond evidence or normal; a stretch.
definitions.example: To call George eloquent is certainly a reach.
definitions.definitionCn: 夸张；超出证据或常态的延伸；牵强附会。
definitions.exampleCn: 称乔治雄辩确实有些牵强。

definitions.definition: The distance a boxer's arm can extend to land a blow.
definitions.definitionCn: 拳击手手臂伸展以击中对手的距离。

definitions.definition: Any point of sail in which the wind comes from the side of a vessel, excluding close-hauled.
definitions.definitionCn: 风从船侧吹来的任何航向（不包括抢风行驶）。

definitions.definition: The distance traversed between tacks.
definitions.definitionCn: 两次转向之间航行的距离。

definitions.definition: A stretch of a watercourse which can be sailed in one reach (in the previous sense). An extended portion of water; a stretch; a straightish portion of a stream, river, or arm of the sea extending up into the land, as from one turn to another. By extension, the adjacent land.
definitions.definitionCn: 可一次航行（按前义）的一段水道。延伸的水域；一段；河流、溪流或海湾中较直的部分（从一个转弯到另一个转弯）。引申为相邻的陆地。

definitions.definition: A level stretch of a watercourse, as between rapids in a river or locks in a canal. (examples?)
definitions.definitionCn: 水道中平坦的一段，如河流急流间或运河船闸间。（示例？）

definitions.definition: An extended portion or area of land or water.
definitions.definitionCn: 陆地或水域的延伸部分或区域。

definitions.definition: An article to obtain an advantage.
definitions.definitionCn: 为获取优势而写的文章。

definitions.definition: The pole or rod connecting the rear axle with the forward bolster of a wagon.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接马车后轴与前横梁的杆或棒。

definitions.definition: An effort to vomit; a retching.
definitions.definitionCn: 呕吐的尝试；干呕。

definitions.definition: To extend, stretch, or thrust out (for example a limb or object held in the hand).
definitions.example: He reached for a weapon that was on the table.
definitions.definitionCn: 伸出、伸展或探出（例如肢体或手中握持的物体）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他伸手去够桌上的武器。

definitions.definition: To give to someone by stretching out a limb, especially the hand; to give with the hand; to pass to another person; to hand over.
definitions.example: to reach one a book
definitions.definitionCn: 通过伸展肢体（尤其是手）递给某人；用手给予；递给另一个人；交出。
definitions.exampleCn: 递给某人一本书。

definitions.definition: To stretch out the hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 伸出手。

definitions.definition: To attain or obtain by stretching forth the hand; to extend some part of the body, or something held, so as to touch, strike, grasp, etc.
definitions.example: The gun was stored in a small box on a high closet shelf, but the boy managed to reach it by climbing on other boxes.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过伸手获得或取得；伸展身体某部分或握持物以触及、击打、抓住等。
definitions.exampleCn: 枪存放在高柜架上的小盒子里，但男孩通过爬其他盒子设法够到了它。

definitions.definition: To strike or touch with a missile.
definitions.example: His bullet reached its intended target.
definitions.definitionCn: 用投掷物击打或触及。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的子弹击中了预定目标。

definitions.definition: Hence, to extend an action, effort, or influence to; to penetrate to; to pierce, or cut.
definitions.definitionCn: 由此引申为将行动、努力或影响延伸至；穿透；刺穿或切割。

definitions.definition: To extend to; to stretch out as far as; to touch by virtue of extent.
definitions.example: When the forest reaches the river, you will be able to rest.
definitions.definitionCn: 延伸至；伸展到；因范围而触及。
definitions.exampleCn: 当森林延伸到河边时，你就能休息了。

definitions.definition: To arrive at (a place) by effort of any kind.
definitions.example: After three years, he reached the position of manager.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过任何努力到达（某地）。
definitions.exampleCn: 三年后，他达到了经理的职位。

definitions.definition: To make contact with.
definitions.example: I tried to reach you all day.
definitions.definitionCn: 取得联系。
definitions.exampleCn: 我整天都在试图联系你。

definitions.definition: To connect with (someone) on an emotional level, making them receptive of (one); to get through to (someone).
definitions.example: What will it take for me to reach him?
definitions.definitionCn: 在情感层面与（某人）沟通，使其接受（自己）；打动（某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我怎样才能打动他？

definitions.definition: To arrive at a particular destination.
definitions.definitionCn: 到达特定目的地。

definitions.definition: To continue living until, or up to, a certain age.
definitions.example: You can only access the inheritance money when you reach the age of 25.
definitions.definitionCn: 继续活到某个年龄。
definitions.exampleCn: 你只有到25岁才能获得遗产。

definitions.definition: To understand; to comprehend.
definitions.definitionCn: 理解；领悟。

definitions.definition: To overreach; to deceive.
definitions.definitionCn: 欺骗；耍花招。

definitions.definition: To strain after something; to make (sometimes futile or pretentious) efforts.
definitions.example: Reach for the stars!
definitions.definitionCn: 努力追求某物；做出（有时徒劳或做作的）努力。
definitions.exampleCn: 伸手摘星！

definitions.definition: To extend in dimension, time etc.; to stretch out continuously (past, beyond, above, from etc. something).
definitions.definitionCn: 在维度、时间等方面延伸；连续伸展（越过、超出、高于、从某物等）。

definitions.definition: To sail on the wind, as from one point of tacking to another, or with the wind nearly abeam.
definitions.definitionCn: 迎风航行，如从一个转向点到另一个，或风几乎正横。

definitions.definition: To experience a vomiting reflex; to gag; to retch.
definitions.definitionCn: 经历呕吐反射；作呕；干呕。

definitions.definition: Having the faculty of reason; rational, reasoning.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有推理能力的；理性的，善于思考的。

definitions.definition: Just; fair; agreeable to reason.
definitions.definitionCn: 公正的；公平的；合乎情理的。

definitions.definition: Not excessive or immoderate; within due limits; proper.
definitions.example: a reasonable demand, amount, or price
definitions.definitionCn: 不过分的；适度的；在合理范围内的；恰当的。
definitions.exampleCn: 合理的要求、数量或价格。

definitions.definition: Not expensive; fairly priced.
definitions.example: $20 a bottle is very reasonable for a good wine at a restaurant.
definitions.definitionCn: 不贵的；价格公道的。
definitions.exampleCn: 在餐厅，一瓶好酒20美元是非常合理的价格。

definitions.definition: Satisfactory.
definitions.example: The builders did a reasonable job, given the short notice.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人满意的。
definitions.exampleCn: 考虑到时间仓促，建筑工人们干得还算不错。

definitions.definition: Having happened a short while ago.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生在不久之前。

definitions.definition: Up-to-date; not old-fashioned or dated.
definitions.definitionCn: 最新的；不陈旧或过时的。

definitions.definition: Having done something a short while ago that distinguishes them as what they are called.
definitions.example: I met three recent graduates at the conference.
definitions.definitionCn: 刚做了某事，因而被称为某种身份。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在会议上遇到了三位刚毕业的学生。

definitions.definition: Particularly in geology, palaeontology, and astronomy: having occurred a relatively short time ago, but still potentially thousands or even millions of years ago.
definitions.definitionCn: 尤指地质学、古生物学和天文学中：发生在相对较近的时间，但仍可能数千年甚至数百万年前。

definitions.definition: (capitalised as "Recent") Of the Holocene, particularly pre-21st century.
definitions.definitionCn: （首字母大写为"Recent"）指全新世，特别是21世纪之前。

definitions.definition: The act of recognizing or the condition of being recognized (matching a current observation with a memory of a prior observation of the same entity)
definitions.example: He looked at her for ten full minutes before recognition dawned.
definitions.definitionCn: 识别行为或被识别的状态（将当前观察与先前对同一实体的观察记忆相匹配）
definitions.exampleCn: 他盯着她看了整整十分钟才认出她来。

definitions.definition: Acceptance as valid or true
definitions.example: The law was a recognition of their civil rights.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为有效或真实的认可
definitions.exampleCn: 这项法律是对他们公民权利的承认。

definitions.definition: Official acceptance of the status of a new government by that of another country
definitions.definitionCn: 一国政府对另一国新政府地位的正式接受

definitions.definition: Honour, favourable note, or attention
definitions.example: The charity gained plenty of recognition for its efforts, but little money.
definitions.definitionCn: 荣誉、好评或关注
definitions.exampleCn: 该慈善机构因其努力获得了大量认可，但几乎没有资金。

definitions.definition: The propriety consisting for antibodies to bind to some specific antigens and not to others.
definitions.definitionCn: 抗体与某些特定抗原结合而不与其他抗原结合的特性。

definitions.definition: A return of the feu to the superior.
definitions.definitionCn: 土地所有权归还给上级领主。

definitions.definition: An operation in which data is received.
definitions.definitionCn: 接收数据的操作。

definitions.definition: To take, as something that is offered, given, committed, sent, paid, etc.; to accept; to be given something.
definitions.example: She received many presents for her birthday.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受某物，如被提供、给予、承诺、发送、支付等；接纳；被给予某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 她收到了许多生日礼物。

definitions.definition: To take goods knowing them to be stolen.
definitions.definitionCn: 明知是赃物仍予以接收。

definitions.definition: To act as a host for guests; to give admittance to; to permit to enter, as into one's house, presence, company, etc.
definitions.example: to receive a lodger, visitor, ambassador, messenger, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为主人接待客人；允许进入；准许进入，如进入某人的房屋、面前、陪伴等。
definitions.exampleCn: 接待房客、访客、大使、信使等。

definitions.definition: To incur (an injury).
definitions.example: I received a bloody nose from the collision.
definitions.definitionCn: 遭受（伤害）。
definitions.exampleCn: 碰撞中我的鼻子流血了。

definitions.definition: To allow (a custom, tradition, etc.); to give credence or acceptance to.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许（习俗、传统等）；给予信任或接受。

definitions.definition: To detect a signal from a transmitter.
definitions.definitionCn: 检测来自发射器的信号。

definitions.definition: To be in a position to take possession, or hit back the ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于接球或回击球的位置。

definitions.definition: To accept into the mind; to understand.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受于心中；理解。

definitions.definition: A disk, usually made of a polymer, used to record sound for playback on a phonograph.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常由聚合物制成的圆盘，用于记录声音并在留声机上播放。

definitions.definition: An item of information put into a temporary or permanent physical medium.
definitions.example: The person had a record of the interview so she could review her notes.
definitions.definitionCn: 放入临时或永久物理介质中的一条信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个人有采访记录，以便她可以回顾笔记。

definitions.definition: Any instance of a physical medium on which information was put for the purpose of preserving it and making it available for future reference.
definitions.example: We have no record of you making this payment to us.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何为保存信息并供将来参考而将其放入物理介质的实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们没有你向我们支付这笔款项的记录。

definitions.definition: A set of data relating to a single individual or item.
definitions.definitionCn: 与单个个人或项目相关的一组数据。

definitions.definition: The most extreme known value of some variable, particularly that of an achievement in competitive events.
definitions.example: The heat and humidity were both new records.
definitions.definitionCn: 某个变量的已知最极端值，特别是竞技赛事中的成就。
definitions.exampleCn: 高温和湿度都创下了新纪录。

definitions.definition: To make a record of information.
definitions.example: I wanted to record every detail of what happened, for the benefit of future generations.

definitions.definition: To make an audio or video recording of.
definitions.example: Within a week they had recorded both the song and the video for it.

definitions.definition: To give legal status to by making an official public record.
definitions.example: When the deed was recorded, we officially owned the house.

definitions.definition: To fix in a medium, usually in a tangible medium.
To make an audio, video, or multimedia recording.
To repeat; to practice.
To sing or repeat a tune.
To reflect; to ponder.
To direct the attention of.
definitions.definitionCn: 引起注意。

definitions.definition: To submit to (another person or group) for consideration; to send or direct elsewhere.
definitions.definitionCn: 提交（给另一个人或团体）考虑；发送或指引至别处。

definitions.definition: To place in or under by a mental or rational process; to assign to, as a class, a cause, source, a motive, reason, or ground of explanation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过心理或理性过程置于或归入；归因于，如类别、原因、来源、动机、理由或解释依据。

definitions.definition: (construed with to) To allude to, make a reference or allusion to.
definitions.definitionCn: （与to连用）提及，引用或暗指。

definitions.definition: (grammar) To be referential to another element in a sentence.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）指代句子中的另一个成分。

definitions.definition: To address a specific location in computer memory.
definitions.definitionCn: 指向计算机内存中的特定地址。

definitions.definition: Required to resit an examination.
definitions.definitionCn: 需要重考。

definitions.definition: The action or fact of calling someone or something back.
definitions.definitionCn: 召回某人或某物的行为或事实。

definitions.definition: Memory; the ability to remember.
definitions.definitionCn: 记忆；回忆的能力。

definitions.definition: (information retrieval) the fraction of (all) relevant material that is returned by a search
definitions.definitionCn: （信息检索中）搜索返回的相关材料所占的比例。

definitions.definition: To withdraw, retract (one's words etc.); to revoke (an order).
definitions.definitionCn: 撤回、收回（某人的话等）；撤销（命令）。

definitions.definition: To call back, bring back or summon (someone) to a specific place, station etc.
definitions.example: He was recalled to service after his retirement.
definitions.definitionCn: 召回、带回或召唤（某人）到特定地点、岗位等。
definitions.exampleCn: 他退休后被召回服役。

definitions.definition: To bring back (someone) to or from a particular mental or physical state, activity etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）恢复或脱离特定的精神或身体状态、活动等。

definitions.definition: To call back (a situation, event etc.) to one's mind; to remember, recollect.
definitions.definitionCn: 回想（某个情境、事件等）；记住、回忆。

definitions.definition: To call again, to call another time.
definitions.definitionCn: 再次呼叫，另一次呼叫。

definitions.definition: To request or order the return of (a faulty product).
definitions.definitionCn: 要求或命令退回（有缺陷的产品）。

definitions.definition: To bestow commendation on; to represent favourably; to suggest, endorse or encourage as an appropriate choice.
definitions.example: The board recommends Philips, given his ample experience in similar positions.
definitions.definitionCn: 给予赞扬；以有利的方式呈现；作为合适的选择而建议、认可或鼓励。
definitions.exampleCn: 鉴于菲利普斯在类似职位上的丰富经验，董事会推荐他。

definitions.definition: To make acceptable; to attract favor to.
definitions.example: A city that has much to recommend it.
definitions.definitionCn: 使可接受；吸引好感。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个有许多值得推荐之处的城市。

definitions.definition: To advise, propose, counsel favorably
definitions.example: The therapist recommends resting the mind and exercising the body.
definitions.definitionCn: 建议、提议、善意地劝告。
definitions.exampleCn: 治疗师建议放松心灵、锻炼身体。

definitions.definition: To commit, confide to another's care, confidence or acceptance, with favoring representations
definitions.example: A medieval oblate's parents recommended the boy for life to God and the monastery
definitions.definitionCn: 将某人托付给另一人的照顾、信任或接纳，并附以有利的陈述。
definitions.exampleCn: 中世纪献身者的父母将男孩终身托付给上帝和修道院。

definitions.definition: To bring down the size, quantity, quality, value or intensity of something; to diminish, to lower.
definitions.example: to reduce weight, speed, heat, expenses, price, personnel etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 降低某物的尺寸、数量、质量、价值或强度；减少，降低。
definitions.exampleCn: 减少重量、速度、热量、开支、价格、人员等。

definitions.definition: To lose weight.
definitions.definitionCn: 减肥。

definitions.definition: To bring to an inferior rank; to degrade, to demote.
definitions.example: Hester Prynne was shocked at the condition to which she found the clergyman reduced.
definitions.definitionCn: 使降级；贬低，降职。
definitions.exampleCn: 海丝特·白兰对牧师沦落到如此境地感到震惊。

definitions.definition: To humble; to conquer; to subdue; to capture.
definitions.example: to reduce a province or a fort
definitions.definitionCn: 使谦卑；征服；制服；俘获。
definitions.exampleCn: 征服一个省份或堡垒。

definitions.definition: To bring to an inferior state or condition.
definitions.example: to reduce a city to ashes
definitions.definitionCn: 使陷入更糟糕的状态或境况。
definitions.exampleCn: 将一座城市化为灰烬。

definitions.definition: To decrease the liquid content of food by boiling much of its water off.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过煮沸蒸发大量水分来减少食物中的液体含量。

definitions.definition: To add electrons / hydrogen or to remove oxygen.
definitions.definitionCn: 添加电子/氢或去除氧。

definitions.definition: To produce metal from ore by removing nonmetallic elements in a smelter.
definitions.definitionCn: 在熔炉中通过去除非金属元素从矿石中提炼金属。

definitions.definition: To simplify an equation or formula without changing its value.
definitions.definitionCn: 在不改变值的情况下简化方程或公式。

definitions.definition: To express the solution of a problem in terms of another (known) algorithm.
definitions.definitionCn: 用另一个（已知）算法表达问题的解。

definitions.definition: To convert a syllogism to a clearer or simpler form
definitions.definitionCn: 将三段论转换为更清晰或更简单的形式。

definitions.definition: To convert to written form. (Usage note: this verb almost always appears as "reduce to writing".)
definitions.example: It is important that all business contracts be reduced to writing.
definitions.definitionCn: 转换为书面形式。（用法说明：这个动词几乎总是以“reduce to writing”的形式出现。）
definitions.exampleCn: 所有商业合同都必须以书面形式记录，这一点很重要。

definitions.definition: To perform a reduction; to restore a fracture or dislocation to the correct alignment.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行复位；将骨折或脱位恢复到正确对齐位置。

definitions.definition: To reform a line or column from (a square).
definitions.definitionCn: 从（方阵）重新排列成一行或一列。

definitions.definition: To strike off the payroll.
definitions.definitionCn: 从工资单中剔除。

definitions.definition: To annul by legal means.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过法律手段废除。

definitions.definition: To translate (a book, document, etc.).
definitions.example: a book reduced into English
definitions.definitionCn: 翻译（一本书、文件等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 一本被译成英文的书。

definitions.definition: Recovery.
definitions.definitionCn: 恢复。

definitions.definition: A position of holding a firearm during exercises, whereby the lock is at shoulder height and the sling facing out.
definitions.definitionCn: 演习中持枪姿势，枪机与肩同高，枪带朝外。

definitions.definition: The forward movement in rowing, after one stroke to take another (recovery)
definitions.definitionCn: 划船时一次划桨后向前移动以准备下一次划桨（恢复动作）。

definitions.definition: To get back, to regain (a physical thing; in astronomy and navigation, sight of a thing or a signal).
definitions.example: After days of inquiries, he finally recovered his lost wallet.
definitions.definitionCn: 重新获得，找回（实物；天文学和导航中，重新看到某物或信号）。
definitions.exampleCn: 经过多日询问，他终于找回了丢失的钱包。

definitions.definition: To salvage, to extricate, to rescue (a thing or person)
definitions.example: They recovered three of the explorers very much alive, then another, wracked with severe hypothermia, who was taken to hospital.
definitions.definitionCn: 拯救，解救，营救（某物或某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们救回了三名探险者，他们非常清醒，随后又救出一名严重失温者，被送往医院。

definitions.definition: To replenish to, resume (a good state of mind or body).
definitions.example: At the top of the hill I asked to stop for a few minutes to recover my strength.
definitions.definitionCn: 恢复，重获（良好的身心状态）。
definitions.exampleCn: 在山顶，我请求停下几分钟恢复体力。

definitions.definition: To obtain a positive judgement; to win in a lawsuit.
definitions.example: The plaintiff recovered in his suit, being awarded declaratory relief and a clearing of his name.
definitions.definitionCn: 获得有利判决；在诉讼中胜诉。
definitions.exampleCn: 原告在诉讼中胜诉，获得了宣告性救济并洗清了名誉。

definitions.definition: To gain as compensation or reparation, usually by formal legal process
definitions.example: to recover damages in trespass; to recover debt and costs in a legal action or that is owing
definitions.definitionCn: 通常通过正式法律程序获得赔偿或补偿。
definitions.exampleCn: 在侵权案中追回损害赔偿；在法律诉讼中追回债务或应付款项。

definitions.definition: To reach (a place), arrive at.
definitions.definitionCn: 到达（某地），抵达。

definitions.definition: To restore to good health, consciousness, life etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 恢复健康、意识、生命等。

definitions.definition: To make good by reparation; to make up for; to retrieve; to repair the loss or injury of.
definitions.example: to recover lost time
definitions.definitionCn: 通过补偿弥补；弥补；挽回；修复损失或伤害。
definitions.exampleCn: 弥补失去的时间。

definitions.definition: To get better, to regain health or prosperity
definitions.example: I lost out in the deal, but I quickly recovered financially
definitions.definitionCn: 好转，恢复健康或繁荣。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在那笔交易中亏损了，但很快在经济上恢复了。

definitions.definition: To regain one's composure, balance etc.
definitions.example: Spinning round, he caught a stone with his ankle, but recovered quickly before turning to face me.
definitions.definitionCn: 恢复镇定、平衡等。
definitions.exampleCn: 他转身时脚踝撞到石头，但迅速恢复平衡，然后转向面对我。

definitions.definition: To cover again.
(roofing) To add a new roof membrane or steep-slope covering over an existing one.
Collectively, items or material that have been discarded; rubbish, garbage.
definitions.definitionCn: 被丢弃的物品或材料；垃圾，废物。

definitions.definition: Discarded, rejected.
definitions.definitionCn: 被丢弃的，被拒绝的。

definitions.definition: Refusal
To decline (a request or demand).
definitions.example: My request for a pay rise was refused.

definitions.definition: To decline a request or demand, forbear; to withhold permission.
definitions.example: I asked the star if I could have her autograph, but she refused.

definitions.definition: To throw back, or cause to keep back (as the centre, a wing, or a flank), out of the regular alignment when troops are about to engage the enemy.
definitions.example: to refuse the right wing while the left wing attacks

definitions.definition: To disown.
To melt again.
Something that is rejected.
definitions.definitionCn: 被拒绝的事物。

definitions.definition: An unpopular person.
definitions.definitionCn: 不受欢迎的人。

definitions.definition: A rejected defective product in a production line
definitions.definitionCn: 生产线上被拒收的次品。

definitions.definition: To refuse to accept.
definitions.example: She even rejected my improved offer.
definitions.definitionCn: 拒绝接受。
definitions.exampleCn: 她甚至拒绝了我改进后的提议。

definitions.definition: To block a shot, especially if it sends the ball off the court.
definitions.definitionCn: 封盖投篮，尤其是将球打出球场。

definitions.definition: To refuse a romantic advance.
definitions.example: I've been rejected three times this week.
definitions.definitionCn: 拒绝浪漫的示好。
definitions.exampleCn: 这周我已经被拒绝三次了。

definitions.definition: A steady look, a gaze.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚定的注视，凝视。

definitions.definition: One's concern for another; esteem; relation, reference.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某人的关心；尊重；关系，关联。

definitions.definition: (preceded by “in” or “with”) A particular aspect or detail; respect, sense.
definitions.definitionCn: （前面加“in”或“with”）某个特定方面或细节；方面，意义。

definitions.definition: The worth or estimation in which something or someone is held.
definitions.example: He is held in great regard in Whitehall.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物或某人被赋予的价值或评价。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在白厅备受尊敬。

definitions.definition: To look at; to observe.
definitions.example: She regarded us warily.

definitions.definition: To consider, look upon (something) in a given way etc.
definitions.example: He regards honesty as a duty.

definitions.definition: To take notice of, pay attention to.
To face toward.
To have to do with, to concern.
definitions.example: That argument does not regard the question.

definitions.definition: To set store by (something), to hold (someone) in esteem; to consider to have value, to respect.
To tell in a descriptive way.
definitions.example: Please relate the circumstances of your journey here today.
definitions.definitionCn: 以描述的方式讲述。
definitions.exampleCn: 请讲述你今天来这里的经过。

definitions.definition: To bring into a relation, association, or connection (between one thing and another).
definitions.definitionCn: 建立（事物之间的）关系、关联或联系。

definitions.definition: To have a connection.
definitions.example: The patterns on the screen relate to the pitch and volume of the music being played.
definitions.definitionCn: 存在关联。
definitions.exampleCn: 屏幕上的图案与正在播放的音乐的音高和音量相关。

definitions.definition: To interact.
definitions.definitionCn: 互动。

definitions.definition: To respond through reaction.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过反应来回应。

definitions.definition: (with to) To identify with; to understand.
definitions.example: I find it difficult to relate to others because I'm extremely introverted.
definitions.definitionCn: （与to连用）产生共鸣；理解。
definitions.exampleCn: 我发现自己很难与他人产生共鸣，因为我极度内向。

definitions.definition: To bring back; to restore.
definitions.definitionCn: 带回；恢复。

definitions.definition: Emotional pain on account of something done or experienced in the past, with a wish that it had been different; a looking back with dissatisfaction or with longing.
definitions.definitionCn: 因过去所做或所经历之事而感到情感上的痛苦，并希望事情有所不同；带着不满或渴望回顾过去。

definitions.definition: Dislike; aversion.
definitions.definitionCn: 厌恶；反感。

definitions.definition: To feel sorry about (a thing that has or has not happened), afterthink: to wish that a thing had not happened, that something else had happened instead.
definitions.example: He regretted his words.
definitions.definitionCn: 对（已发生或未发生之事）感到遗憾；事后反思：希望某事未曾发生，而其他事情取而代之。
definitions.exampleCn: 他为自己的话感到后悔。

definitions.definition: (more generally) To feel sorry about (any thing).
definitions.example: I regret that I have to do this, but I don't have a choice.
definitions.definitionCn: （更广义地）对（任何事）感到遗憾。
definitions.exampleCn: 我很遗憾不得不这样做，但我别无选择。

definitions.definition: To miss; to feel the loss or absence of.
definitions.definitionCn: 思念；因失去或缺失而感到痛惜。

definitions.definition: To bend back (light, etc.) from a surface.
definitions.example: A mirror reflects the light that shines on it.
definitions.definitionCn: 从表面反射（光线等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 镜子反射照在它上面的光。

definitions.definition: To be bent back (light, etc.) from a surface.
definitions.example: The moonlight reflected from the surface of water.
definitions.definitionCn: 从表面被反射（光线等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 月光从水面反射回来。

definitions.definition: To mirror, or show the image of something.
definitions.example: The shop window reflected his image as he walked past.
definitions.definitionCn: 映照，或显示某物的影像。
definitions.exampleCn: 他走过时，商店橱窗映出了他的身影。

definitions.definition: To be mirrored.
definitions.example: His image reflected from the shop window as he walked past.
definitions.definitionCn: 被映照。
definitions.exampleCn: 他走过时，他的身影从商店橱窗中映出。

definitions.definition: To agree with; to closely follow.
definitions.example: Entries in English dictionaries aim to reflect common usage.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……一致；紧密遵循。
definitions.exampleCn: 英语词典的词条旨在反映常见用法。

definitions.definition: To give evidence of someone's or something's character etc.
definitions.example: The teacher's ability reflects well on the school.
definitions.definitionCn: 体现某人或某物的特征等。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位老师的能力为学校增光。

definitions.definition: To think seriously; to ponder or consider.
definitions.example: People do that sort of thing every day, without ever stopping to reflect on the consequences.
definitions.definitionCn: 认真思考；深思或考虑。
definitions.exampleCn: 人们每天都做那种事，却从不停下来思考后果。

definitions.definition: Any considerable and connected part of a space or surface; specifically, a tract of land or sea of considerable but indefinite extent; a country; a district; in a broad sense, a place without special reference to location or extent but viewed as an entity for geographical, social or cultural reasons.
definitions.example: the equatorial regions
definitions.definitionCn: 任何空间或表面中相当大且相连的部分；特指一片范围相当大但界限不明确的陆地或海洋区域；一个国家；一个地区；广义上，指一个地点，不特指位置或范围，而是出于地理、社会或文化原因被视为一个实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 赤道地区

definitions.definition: An administrative subdivision of a city, a territory, a country.
definitions.definitionCn: 城市、领土或国家的一个行政分区。

definitions.definition: The inhabitants of a region or district of a country.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个国家某个地区或区域的居民。

definitions.definition: A place in or a part of the body in any way indicated.
definitions.example: the abdominal regions
definitions.definitionCn: 身体上以任何方式指示的部位或部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 腹部区域

definitions.definition: Place; rank; station; dignity.
definitions.definitionCn: 位置；等级；地位；尊严。

definitions.definition: The space from the earth's surface out to the orbit of the moon: properly called the elemental region.
definitions.definitionCn: 从地球表面到月球轨道的空间：恰当地称为元素区域。

definitions.definition: The change of something that is defective, broken, inefficient or otherwise negative, in order to correct or improve it
definitions.example: A major reform is needed to improve the efficiency in the factory.
definitions.definitionCn: 对存在缺陷、破损、低效或其他负面问题的事物进行改变，以修正或改进它
definitions.exampleCn: 工厂需要进行重大改革以提高效率

definitions.definition: To put into a new and improved form or condition; to restore to a former good state, or bring from bad to good; to change from worse to better
definitions.example: 1909, H. G. Wells, The History of Mr. Polly Chapter 9
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物转变为新的、改进的形式或状态；恢复其原有的良好状态，或从坏变好；从差变优
definitions.exampleCn: 1909年，H.G.威尔斯，《波利先生传》第九章

definitions.definition: To return to a good state; to amend or correct one's own character or habits
definitions.example: It is hoped that many criminals, upon being freed, will eventually reform.
definitions.definitionCn: 回归良好状态；修正或改善自身的性格或习惯
definitions.exampleCn: 希望许多罪犯在获释后最终能改过自新

definitions.definition: To form again or in a new configuration.
definitions.example: The regiment reformed after surviving the first attack.
definitions.definitionCn: 重新形成或采用新的配置
definitions.exampleCn: 该团在第一次攻击中幸存后重新整编

definitions.definition: A machine that tabulates the amount of sales transactions, makes a permanent and cumulative record of them, and has a drawer in which cash can be kept.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于统计销售交易金额、生成永久累积记录并设有现金抽屉的机器。

definitions.definition: A point of sale.
definitions.definitionCn: 销售点终端。

definitions.definition: A formal recording of names, events, transactions etc.
definitions.example: The teacher took the register by calling out each child's name.
definitions.definitionCn: 对姓名、事件、交易等进行的正式记录。
definitions.exampleCn: 老师通过点名的方式进行了登记。

definitions.definition: A book of such entries.
definitions.definitionCn: 记录此类条目的簿册。

definitions.definition: An entry in such a book.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类簿册中的一条记录。

definitions.definition: The act of registering.
definitions.definitionCn: 登记的行为。

definitions.definition: A certificate issued by the collector of customs of a port or district to the owner of a vessel, containing the description of a vessel, its name, ownership, and other material facts. It is kept on board the vessel, to be used as evidence of nationality or as a muniment of title.
definitions.definitionCn: 由港口或地区海关关长向船主颁发的证书，包含船舶描述、名称、所有权及其他重要信息。该证书保存在船上，作为国籍证明或所有权凭证。

definitions.definition: One who registers or records; a registrar; especially, a public officer charged with the duty of recording certain transactions or events.
definitions.example: a register of deeds
definitions.definitionCn: 负责登记或记录的人；登记官；特指负责记录特定交易或事件的公职人员。
definitions.exampleCn: 契约登记簿。

definitions.definition: A distinct horizontal (or, more rarely, vertical) section of a work of art or inscription that is divided into several such sections
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术品或铭文中被划分为多个部分的独立水平（或罕见情况下垂直）区域。

definitions.definition: A device that automatically records a quantity.
definitions.definitionCn: 自动记录数量的设备。

definitions.definition: The part of a telegraphic apparatus that automatically records the message received.
definitions.definitionCn: 电报设备中自动记录接收信息的部件。

definitions.definition: A list of received calls in a phone set.
definitions.definitionCn: 电话机中已接来电的列表。

definitions.definition: A small unit of very fast memory that is directly accessible to the central processing unit, and is mostly used to store inputs, outputs or intermediate results of computations.
definitions.definitionCn: 中央处理器可直接访问的极快内存小单元，主要用于存储计算输入、输出或中间结果。

definitions.definition: The exact alignment of lines, margins and colors.
definitions.definitionCn: 线条、页边距和颜色的精确对齐。

definitions.definition: The inner part of the mould in which types are cast.
definitions.definitionCn: 铸造铅字时模具的内部部分。

definitions.definition: The range of a voice or instrument.
definitions.definitionCn: 声音或乐器的音域。

definitions.definition: An organ stop.
definitions.definitionCn: 管风琴的音栓。

definitions.definition: A style of a language used in a particular context.
definitions.example: My ex-boss used "let go", in the euphemistic register, when he sacked me.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定语境下使用的语言风格。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的前老板在解雇我时，使用了委婉语体中的“放手”一词。

definitions.definition: A grille at the outflow of a ventilation duct, capable of being opened and closed to direct the air flow.
definitions.definitionCn: 通风管道出口处的格栅，可开合以调节气流方向。

definitions.definition: To enter in a register.
definitions.definitionCn: 登记入册。

definitions.definition: To enroll, especially to vote.
definitions.definitionCn: 注册，尤指为投票而登记。

definitions.definition: To record, especially in writing.
definitions.definitionCn: 记录，尤指书面记录。

definitions.definition: To buy the full version of trial software by providing one's details and payment.
definitions.example: This is a trial version, and will expire in 30 days. Please register!
definitions.definitionCn: 通过提供个人信息和付款购买试用软件的完整版本。
definitions.exampleCn: 此为试用版，30天后将过期。请注册！

definitions.definition: To express outward signs.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出外在迹象。

definitions.definition: (mail) To record officially and handle specially.
definitions.definitionCn: （邮件）正式记录并特殊处理。

definitions.definition: To make or adjust so as to be properly or precisely aligned.
definitions.definitionCn: 调整至正确或精确对齐。

definitions.definition: To place one's name, or have one's name placed in a register.
definitions.example: They registered for school.
definitions.definitionCn: 将姓名登记或让他人将姓名登记在册。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们已注册入学。

definitions.definition: To make an impression.
definitions.definitionCn: 留下印象。

definitions.definition: To be in proper alignment; to align or correspond exactly.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于正确对齐状态；精确对齐或对应。

definitions.definition: To voluntarily sign over for safe keeping, abandoning complete ownership for partial.
definitions.definitionCn: 为安全保管而自愿签署放弃完全所有权，换取部分所有权。

definitions.definition: A member of the British Army (as opposed to a member of the Territorial Army or Reserve).
definitions.definitionCn: 英国陆军成员（区别于本土军或预备役成员）。

definitions.definition: A frequent, routine visitor to an establishment.
definitions.example: Bartenders usually know their regulars by name.
definitions.definitionCn: 某场所的常客、例行访客。
definitions.exampleCn: 调酒师通常能叫出常客的名字。

definitions.definition: A frequent customer, client or business partner.
definitions.example: This gentleman was one of the architect's regulars.
definitions.definitionCn: 频繁光顾的顾客、客户或商业伙伴。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位先生是建筑师的常客之一。

definitions.definition: A coffee with one cream and one sugar.
definitions.definitionCn: 加一份奶和一份糖的咖啡。

definitions.definition: Anything that is normal or standard.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何正常或标准的事物。

definitions.definition: A member of a religious order who has taken the three ordinary vows.
definitions.definitionCn: 已立下三项普通誓愿的修会成员。

definitions.definition: A number for each year, giving, added to the concurrents, the number of the day of the week on which the Paschal full moon falls.
definitions.definitionCn: 每年一个数字，与同期数相加，可得出复活节满月降临的星期几。

definitions.definition: A fixed number for each month serving to ascertain the day of the week, or the age of the moon, on the first day of any month.
definitions.definitionCn: 每月固定数字，用于确定任何月份首日的星期或月龄。

definitions.definition: Bound by religious rule; belonging to a monastic or religious order (often as opposed to secular).
definitions.example: regular clergy, in distinction from the secular clergy
definitions.definitionCn: 受宗教规则约束；属于修道或修会（常与世俗相对）。
definitions.exampleCn: 修会神职人员，区别于世俗神职人员。

definitions.definition: Having a constant pattern; showing evenness of form or appearance.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有恒定模式；形态或外观均匀。

definitions.definition: (of a polygon) Both equilateral and equiangular; having all sides of the same length, and all (corresponding) angles of the same size
definitions.definitionCn: （多边形）等边且等角；所有边长相等，所有（对应）角大小相同。

definitions.definition: (of a polyhedron) Whose faces are all congruent regular polygons, equally inclined to each other.
definitions.definitionCn: （多面体）所有面均为全等正多边形，且彼此倾角相等。

definitions.definition: Demonstrating a consistent set of rules; showing order, evenness of operation or occurrence.
definitions.definitionCn: 遵循一套一致的规则；操作或发生有序且均匀。

definitions.definition: Well-behaved, orderly; restrained (of a lifestyle etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 行为端正、有序；生活方式等有节制。

definitions.definition: Happening at constant (especially short) intervals.
definitions.example: He made regular visits to go see his mother.
definitions.definitionCn: 以恒定（尤指短）间隔发生。
definitions.exampleCn: 他定期去看望母亲。

definitions.definition: (grammar, of a verb, plural, etc) Following a set or common pattern; according to the normal rules of a given language.
definitions.example: "Walked" is the past tense of the regular verb "to walk".
definitions.definitionCn: （语法，动词、复数等）遵循固定或常见模式；符合特定语言的正常规则。
definitions.exampleCn: "Walked"是规则动词"to walk"的过去式。

definitions.definition: Having the expected characteristics or appearances; normal, ordinary, standard.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有预期特征或外观；正常、普通、标准。

definitions.definition: Permanently organised; being part of a set professional body of troops.
definitions.definitionCn: 永久组织化；属于常备职业军队。

definitions.definition: Having bowel movements or menstrual periods at constant intervals in the expected way.
definitions.example: Maintaining a high-fibre diet keeps you regular.
definitions.definitionCn: 按预期方式以恒定间隔排便或行经。
definitions.exampleCn: 保持高纤维饮食能让你排便规律。

definitions.definition: Exemplary; excellent example of; utter, downright.
definitions.example: a regular genius; a regular John Bull
definitions.definitionCn: 典范的；极好的例子；完全的、彻底的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个真正的天才；一个典型的约翰牛。

definitions.definition: Having all the parts of the same kind alike in size and shape.
definitions.example: a regular flower; a regular sea urchin
definitions.definitionCn: 所有同类部分大小和形状一致。
definitions.exampleCn: 整齐花；规则海胆。

definitions.definition: Isometric.
definitions.definitionCn: 等轴的。

definitions.definition: Riding with the left foot forward.
definitions.definitionCn: 左脚在前骑行。

definitions.definition: (of a Borel measure) Such that every set in its domain is both outer regular and inner regular.
definitions.definitionCn: （关于博雷尔测度）其定义域内每个集合既外正则又内正则。

definitions.definition: Regularly, on a regular basis.
definitions.definitionCn: 定期地，按常规基础。

definitions.definition: (with on or upon, formerly also with in) to trust; to have confidence in; to depend.
definitions.definitionCn: （与on或upon连用，旧时也与in连用）信任；信赖；依靠。

definitions.definition: Directly related, connected, or pertinent to a topic.
definitions.example: His mother provided some relevant background information concerning his medical condition.
definitions.definitionCn: 直接相关、有联系或与某个主题相关的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的母亲提供了一些关于他健康状况的相关背景信息。

definitions.definition: Not out of date; current.
definitions.definitionCn: 不过时的；当前的。

definitions.definition: Something that corrects or counteracts.
definitions.definitionCn: 纠正或抵消的事物。

definitions.definition: The legal means to recover a right or to prevent or obtain redress for a wrong.
definitions.definitionCn: 为恢复权利、防止错误或获得赔偿的法律手段。

definitions.definition: A medicine, application, or treatment that relieves or cures a disease.
definitions.definitionCn: 缓解或治愈疾病的药物、敷剂或疗法。

definitions.definition: The accepted tolerance or deviation in fineness or weight in the production of gold coins etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 金币等生产中，成色或重量的公认公差或偏差。

definitions.definition: To provide or serve as a remedy for.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……提供或充当补救措施。

definitions.definition: The removal of stress or discomfort.
definitions.example: I sighed with relief when I found out that my daughter hadn't got lost, but was waiting for me at home.
definitions.definitionCn: 压力或不适的消除。
definitions.exampleCn: 当我发现女儿并未走失，而是在家等我时，我如释重负地松了口气。

definitions.definition: The feeling associated with the removal of stress or discomfort.
definitions.definitionCn: 与压力或不适消除相关的感受。

definitions.definition: Release from a post or duty, as when replaced by another.
definitions.definitionCn: 从职位或职责中解脱，例如被他人接替时。

definitions.definition: The person who takes over a shift for another.
definitions.example: Officer Schmidt can finally go home because his relief has arrived.
definitions.definitionCn: 为他人接替班次的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 施密特警官终于可以回家了，因为他的接替者已经到了。

definitions.definition: Aid or assistance offered in time of need.
definitions.definitionCn: 在需要时提供的援助或帮助。

definitions.definition: Court-ordered compensation, aid, or protection, a redress.
definitions.definitionCn: 法院命令的赔偿、援助或保护，一种补救措施。

definitions.definition: A lowering of a tax through special provisions; tax relief.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过特殊条款降低税收；税收减免。

definitions.definition: A certain fine or composition paid by the heir of a tenant upon the death of the ancestor.
definitions.definitionCn: 佃户继承人在祖先去世时支付的特定罚金或补偿金。

definitions.definition: A type of sculpture or other artwork in which shapes or figures protrude from a flat background.
The apparent difference in elevation in the surface of a painting or drawing made noticeable by a variation in light or color.
The difference of elevations on a surface.
definitions.example: the relief on that part of the Earth's surface

definitions.definition: The supposed projection of a charge from the surface of a field, indicated by shading on the sinister and lower sides.
(of a surface) Characterized by surface inequalities.
Of or used in letterpress.
The manner in which two things may be associated.
definitions.example: The relation between diet and health is complex.
definitions.definitionCn: 两件事可能关联的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 饮食与健康之间的关系很复杂。

definitions.definition: A member of one's family.
definitions.example: Yes, he's a relation of mine, but only a distant one.
definitions.definitionCn: 家庭成员。
definitions.exampleCn: 是的，他是我的亲戚，但只是远亲。

definitions.definition: The act of relating a story.
definitions.example: Your relation of the events is different from mine.
definitions.definitionCn: 讲述故事的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 你对事件的叙述与我的不同。

definitions.definition: A set of ordered tuples.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组有序元组。

definitions.definition: Specifically, a set of ordered pairs.
definitions.example: Equality is a symmetric relation, while divisibility is not.
definitions.definitionCn: 具体来说，一组有序对。
definitions.exampleCn: 相等是对称关系，而可除性则不是。

definitions.definition: A set of ordered tuples retrievable by a relational database; a table.
definitions.example: This relation uses the customer's social security number as a key.
definitions.definitionCn: 可由关系数据库检索的一组有序元组；一个表。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个关系使用客户的社会安全号码作为键。

definitions.definition: A statement of equality of two products of generators, used in the presentation of a group.
definitions.definitionCn: 生成元两个乘积的等式陈述，用于群的表示。

definitions.definition: A subobject of a product of objects.
definitions.definitionCn: 对象乘积的子对象。

definitions.definition: (usually collocated: sexual relation) The act of intercourse.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常搭配：性关系）性交行为。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) That which is left; relic; remainder.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用复数形式）遗留之物；遗迹；剩余物。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) That which is left of a human being after the life is gone; relics; a dead body.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）生命消逝后留下的部分；遗骸；尸体。

definitions.definition: Posthumous works or productions, especially literary works.
definitions.definitionCn: 死后出版的作品或创作，尤指文学作品。

definitions.definition: State of remaining; stay.
definitions.definitionCn: 停留的状态；逗留。

definitions.definition: To stay behind while others withdraw; to be left after others have been removed or destroyed; to be left after a number or quantity has been subtracted or cut off; to be left as not included or comprised.
definitions.definitionCn: 当他人撤退时留在后面；在他人或他物被移除或摧毁后留下；在数量被减去或截断后剩余；未被包含或计入而留下。

definitions.definition: To continue unchanged in place, form, or condition, or undiminished in quantity; to abide; to stay; to endure; to last.
definitions.example: There was no food in the house, so I had to remain hungry.
definitions.definitionCn: 在位置、形式或条件上保持不变，或在数量上未减少；持续存在；停留；忍耐；持久。
definitions.exampleCn: 房子里没有食物，所以我不得不继续挨饿。

definitions.definition: To await; to be left to.
definitions.definitionCn: 等待；留给。

definitions.definition: To continue in a state of being.
definitions.example: The light remained red for two full minutes.
definitions.definitionCn: 继续处于某种状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 红灯持续亮了整整两分钟。

definitions.definition: Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.
definitions.example: Why do my relatives always talk about sex?
definitions.definitionCn: 同一家族的人；通过血缘、婚姻或收养关系相连的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 为什么我的亲戚总是谈论性？

definitions.definition: A type of adjective that inflects like a relative clause, rather than a true adjective, in certain Bantu languages.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某些班图语中，一种像关系从句而非真正形容词那样屈折变化的形容词类型。

definitions.definition: Connected to or depending on something else; comparative.
definitions.definitionCn: 与某物相关或依赖于某物；比较性的。

definitions.definition: (of a URL, URI, path, or similar) Expressed in relation to another item, rather than in complete form.
definitions.example: The relative URL /images/pic.jpg, when evaluated in the context of http://example.com/docs/pic.html, corresponds to the absolute URL http://example.com/images/pic.jpg.
definitions.definitionCn: （指URL、URI、路径或类似内容）相对于另一项表达，而非完整形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 相对URL /images/pic.jpg，在http://example.com/docs/pic.html的上下文中解析时，对应绝对URL http://example.com/images/pic.jpg。

definitions.definition: (grammar) That relates to an antecedent.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）指代先行词的。

definitions.definition: Having the same key but differing in being major or minor.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有相同调性但大小调不同的。

definitions.definition: Relevant; pertinent; related.
definitions.example: relative to your earlier point about taxes, ...
definitions.definitionCn: 相关的；切题的；有联系的。
definitions.exampleCn: 关于你之前提到的税收问题，……

definitions.definition: Capable to be changed by other beings or circumstance; conditional.
definitions.definitionCn: 能够被其他存在或情况改变的；有条件的。

definitions.definition: An act of pointing out or noticing; notice or observation.
definitions.definitionCn: 指出或注意的行为；注意或观察。

definitions.definition: An expression, in speech or writing, of something remarked or noticed; a mention of something
definitions.example: a biting remark
definitions.definitionCn: 在言语或文字中表达所评论或注意到的事物；提及某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 尖刻的评论。

definitions.definition: A casual observation, comment, or statement
definitions.definitionCn: 随意的观察、评论或陈述。

definitions.definition: To make a remark or remarks; to comment.
definitions.definitionCn: 发表评论或言论；进行评论。

definitions.definition: To express in words or writing; to state; to make a comment
definitions.example: He remarked that it was getting late.
definitions.definitionCn: 用言语或文字表达；陈述；作出评论。
definitions.exampleCn: 他评论说天色已晚。

definitions.definition: To pay heed to; notice; to take notice of
definitions.definitionCn: 注意；留意；关注。

definitions.definition: To mark in a notable manner; to distinguish clearly; to make noticeable or conspicuous; to point out.
definitions.definitionCn: 以显著方式标记；清晰区分；使显眼或引人注目；指出。

definitions.definition: (engraving) A small design etched on the margin of a plate and supposed to be removed after the earliest proofs have been taken.
definitions.definitionCn: （雕刻）蚀刻在版画边缘的小图案，通常应在早期校样完成后移除。

definitions.definition: (engraving) Any feature distinguishing a particular stage of the plate.
definitions.definitionCn: （雕刻）区分版画特定阶段的任何特征。

definitions.definition: (engraving) A print or proof distinguished by such a mark.
definitions.definitionCn: （雕刻）带有此类标记的印刷品或校样。

definitions.definition: A mark that replaces another mark.
To mark again.
Belief in a spiritual or metaphysical reality (often including at least one deity), accompanied by practices or rituals pertaining to the belief.
definitions.example: My brother tends to value religion, but my sister not as much.
definitions.definitionCn: 对精神或形而上现实（通常至少包含一位神祇）的信仰，以及与此信仰相关的实践或仪式。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的兄弟倾向于重视宗教，但我的姐妹则不那么在意。

definitions.definition: A particular system of such belief, and the rituals and practices proper to it.
definitions.example: Eckankar is a new religion but Zoroastrianism is an old religion.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种特定的信仰体系，及其相应的仪式和实践。
definitions.exampleCn: 埃坎卡是一种新兴宗教，而琐罗亚斯德教则是一种古老宗教。

definitions.definition: The way of life committed to by monks and nuns.
definitions.example: The monk entered religion when he was 20 years of age.
definitions.definitionCn: 僧侣和修女所奉行的生活方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位僧侣在20岁时进入了宗教生活。

definitions.definition: Rituals and actions associated with religious beliefs, but considered apart from them.
definitions.example: I think some Christians would love Jesus more if they weren't so stuck in religion.
definitions.definitionCn: 与宗教信仰相关的仪式和行动，但被视为独立于信仰本身。
definitions.exampleCn: 我认为有些基督徒如果不那么拘泥于宗教形式，会更爱耶稣。

definitions.definition: Any practice to which someone or some group is seriously devoted.
definitions.example: At this point, Star Trek has really become a religion.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何个人或群体认真投入的实践。
definitions.exampleCn: 在这一点上，《星际迷航》真的成了一种宗教。

definitions.definition: Faithfulness to a given principle; conscientiousness.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某一原则的忠诚；尽责。

definitions.definition: Engage in religious practice.
definitions.definitionCn: 从事宗教实践。

definitions.definition: Indoctrinate into a specific religion.
definitions.definitionCn: 向某人灌输特定宗教教义。

definitions.definition: To make sacred or symbolic; sanctify.
definitions.definitionCn: 使神圣化或象征化；奉为神圣。

definitions.definition: The event of setting (someone or something) free (e.g. hostages, slaves, prisoners, caged animals, hooked or stuck mechanisms).
definitions.definitionCn: 释放某人或某物的事件（例如人质、奴隶、囚犯、笼中动物、钩住或卡住的机械装置）。

definitions.definition: The distribution of an initial or new and upgraded version of a computer software product; the distribution can be either public or private.
definitions.definitionCn: 计算机软件产品的初始版本或新升级版本的发布；发布可以是公开或私密的。

definitions.definition: Anything recently released or made available (as for sale).
definitions.example: The video store advertised that it had all the latest releases.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何最近发布或可用的东西（例如用于销售）。
definitions.exampleCn: 视频商店广告称其拥有所有最新发行的影片。

definitions.definition: That which is released, untied or let go.
definitions.example: They marked the occasion with a release of butterflies.
definitions.definitionCn: 被释放、解开或放手的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们以放飞蝴蝶来纪念这一时刻。

definitions.definition: The giving up of a claim, especially a debt.
definitions.definitionCn: 放弃某项权利主张，尤其是债务。

definitions.definition: Liberation from pain or suffering.
definitions.definitionCn: 从痛苦或苦难中解脱。

definitions.definition: The process by which a chemical substance is set free.
definitions.definitionCn: 化学物质被释放的过程。

definitions.definition: (sound synthesis) The act or manner of ending a sound.
definitions.definitionCn: （声音合成）结束声音的行为或方式。

definitions.definition: In the block system, a printed card conveying information and instructions to be used at intermediate sidings without telegraphic stations.
definitions.definitionCn: 在闭塞系统中，一种印有信息并指示在无电报站的中途侧线使用的卡片。

definitions.definition: A device adapted to hold or release a device or mechanism as required.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种根据需要固定或释放设备或机制的装置。

definitions.definition: To let go (of); to cease to hold or contain.
definitions.example: He released his grasp on the lever.
definitions.definitionCn: 放手（对某物）；停止持有或包含。
definitions.exampleCn: 他松开了对杠杆的抓握。

definitions.definition: To make available to the public.
definitions.example: They released the new product later than intended.
definitions.definitionCn: 向公众提供。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们比原计划晚发布了新产品。

definitions.definition: To free or liberate; to set free.
definitions.example: He was released after two years in prison.
definitions.definitionCn: 使自由或解放；释放。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在两年监禁后被释放。

definitions.definition: To discharge.
definitions.example: They released thousands of gallons of water into the river each month.
definitions.definitionCn: 排放。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们每月向河中排放数千加仑的水。

definitions.definition: (of a call) To hang up.
definitions.example: If you continue to use abusive language, I will need to release the call.
definitions.definitionCn: （指通话）挂断。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你继续使用辱骂性语言，我将需要挂断电话。

definitions.definition: To let go, as a legal claim; to discharge or relinquish a right to, as lands or tenements, by conveying to another who has some right or estate in possession, as when the person in remainder releases his right to the tenant in possession; to quit.
definitions.definitionCn: 放弃，如法律上的权利主张；通过将权利转让给已拥有某些权利或地产的他人（例如当剩余权人将其权利释放给占有土地的租户时），放弃或让渡对土地或房屋的权利；终止。

definitions.definition: To loosen; to relax; to remove the obligation of.
definitions.example: to release an ordinance
definitions.definitionCn: 放松；缓和；解除义务。
definitions.exampleCn: 解除一项法令。

definitions.definition: To set up; to provide with a goal-scoring opportunity
definitions.definitionCn: 设置；提供得分机会。

definitions.definition: To set free a chemical substance.
definitions.definitionCn: 释放一种化学物质。

definitions.definition: To lease again; to grant a new lease of; to let back.
The act of repairing something.
definitions.example: I took the car to the workshop for repair.
definitions.definitionCn: 修理某物的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 我把车开到修理厂进行维修。

definitions.definition: The result of repairing something.
definitions.example: If you look closely you can see the repair in the paintwork.
definitions.definitionCn: 修理某物的结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你仔细看，就能在漆面上看到修补的痕迹。

definitions.definition: The condition of something, in respect of need for repair.
definitions.example: The car was overall in poor repair before the accident. But after the workshop had it for three weeks it was returned in excellent repair. But the other vehicle was beyond repair.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物在需要修理方面的状况。
definitions.exampleCn: 事故前，这辆车整体状况很差。但修理厂修了三周后，它被送回来时状态极佳。而另一辆车则无法修复。

definitions.definition: To restore to good working order, fix, or improve damaged condition; to mend; to remedy.
definitions.example: to repair a house, a road, a shoe, or a ship
definitions.definitionCn: 恢复到良好的工作状态，修复或改善损坏状况；修补；补救。
definitions.exampleCn: 修理房屋、道路、鞋子或船只。

definitions.definition: To make amends for, as for an injury, by an equivalent; to indemnify for.
definitions.example: to repair a loss or damage
definitions.definitionCn: 通过等价物对伤害等进行补偿；赔偿损失。
definitions.exampleCn: 弥补损失或损害。

definitions.definition: The act of repairing or resorting to a place.
definitions.example: our annual repair to the mountains

definitions.definition: A place to which one goes frequently or habitually; a haunt.
To transfer oneself to another place.
definitions.example: to repair to sanctuary for safety

definitions.definition: To pair again
A written or spoken response; part of a conversation.
definitions.definitionCn: 书面或口头回应；对话的一部分。

definitions.definition: Something given in reply.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为回复给出的内容。

definitions.definition: A counterattack.
definitions.definitionCn: 反击。

definitions.definition: The answer of a figure.
definitions.definitionCn: 图形的答案。

definitions.definition: A document written by a party specifically replying to a responsive declaration and in some cases an answer.
definitions.definitionCn: 一方专门针对回应性声明撰写的文件，某些情况下也指答辩状。

definitions.definition: To give a written or spoken response, especially to a question, request, accusation or criticism; to answer.
definitions.definitionCn: 给出书面或口头回应，尤指对问题、请求、指控或批评的答复；回答。

definitions.definition: To act or gesture in response.
definitions.example: Joanne replied to Pete's insult with a slap to his face.
definitions.definitionCn: 以行动或手势作出回应。
definitions.exampleCn: 乔安妮以扇皮特耳光回应了他的侮辱。

definitions.definition: To repeat something back; to echo.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复某事物；回声。

definitions.definition: A payment made by a tenant at intervals in order to occupy a property.
definitions.definitionCn: 租户为占用房产而定期支付的款项。

definitions.definition: A similar payment for the use of equipment or a service.
definitions.definitionCn: 为使用设备或服务而支付的类似费用。

definitions.definition: A profit from possession of a valuable right, as a restricted license to engage in a trade or business.

definitions.definitionCn: 因拥有某项有价值的权利（如从事贸易或商业的受限许可）而获得的收益。

definitions.definition: An object for which rent is charged or paid.
definitions.definitionCn: 被收取或支付租金的物品。

definitions.definition: Income; revenue.
definitions.definitionCn: 收入；收益。

definitions.definition: To occupy premises in exchange for rent.

definitions.definitionCn: 为换取租金而占用场所。
definitions.exampleCn: 我从朋友的父母那里租了一间房子，租期一年。

definitions.definition: To grant occupation in return for rent.
definitions.example: We rented our house to our son's friend for a year.
definitions.definitionCn: 为换取租金而授予占用权。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们把房子租给了儿子的朋友，租期一年。

definitions.definition: To obtain or have temporary possession of an object (e.g. a movie) in exchange for money.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过支付金钱获得或临时拥有某物（如电影）的使用权。

definitions.definition: To be leased or let for rent.
definitions.example: The house rents for five hundred dollars a month.
definitions.definitionCn: 被出租或按租金出租。
definitions.exampleCn: 这栋房子每月租金为五百美元。

definitions.definition: To separate into parts with force or sudden violence; to split; to burst

definitions.definition: To part or tear off forcibly; to take away by force; to amputate.
To be rent or torn; to become parted; to separate; to split.
definitions.example: Relationships may rend if tempers flare.

definitions.definition: A tear or rip in some surface.
A division or schism.
To restore to a former place, position, condition, etc.; to put back
definitions.example: When you've finished using the telephone, please replace the handset.
definitions.definitionCn: 恢复到以前的位置、状态或条件等；放回原处
definitions.exampleCn: 当你用完电话后，请将听筒放回原位。

definitions.definition: To refund; to repay; to pay back

definitions.definitionCn: 退还；偿还；付还
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以从零用现金中取用所需，但明早必须补还。

definitions.definition: To supply or substitute an equivalent for
definitions.example: I replaced my car with a newer model.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供或替换等价物
definitions.exampleCn: 我用一辆较新的车型替换了我的旧车。

definitions.definition: To take over the position or role from.
definitions.definitionCn: 接替某人的职位或角色。

definitions.definition: To take the place of; to be used instead of
definitions.example: This security pass replaces the one you were given earlier.
definitions.definitionCn: 取代；被用作替代
definitions.exampleCn: 这张安全通行证替换了你之前拿到的那张。

definitions.definition: To demolish (a building) and build an updated form of that building in its place.
definitions.definitionCn: 拆除（建筑物）并在原址重建更新版本。

definitions.definition: To place again.
definitions.definitionCn: 再次放置。

definitions.definition: To put in a new or different place.
definitions.definitionCn: 放到新的或不同的地方。

definitions.definition: An iteration; a repetition.
definitions.example: We gave up after the third repeat because it got boring.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次迭代；一次重复。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在第三次重复后放弃了，因为太无聊了。

definitions.definition: A television program shown after its initial presentation; a rerun.
definitions.definitionCn: 首次播出后再次播放的电视节目；重播。

definitions.definition: A refill of a prescription.
definitions.definitionCn: 处方的再次配药。

definitions.definition: A pattern of nucleic acids that occur in multiple copies throughout a genome (or of amino acids in a protein).
definitions.definitionCn: 在整个基因组中多次出现的核酸模式（或蛋白质中的氨基酸模式）。

definitions.definition: A mark in music notation directing a part to be repeated.
definitions.definitionCn: 音乐记谱中指示某部分重复的标记。

definitions.definition: To do or say again (and again).
