definitions.definitionCn: 反复做或说（一次又一次）。
definitions.exampleCn: 科学家们重复实验以确认结果。

definitions.definition: To refill (a prescription).
definitions.definitionCn: 再次配药（处方）。

definitions.definition: To happen again; recur.
definitions.definitionCn: 再次发生；重现。

definitions.definition: To echo the words of (a person).
definitions.definitionCn: 重复（某人的）话语。

definitions.definition: To strike the hours, as a watch does.
definitions.definitionCn: 像手表一样报时。

definitions.definition: To make trial of again; to undergo or encounter again.
definitions.definitionCn: 再次尝试；再次经历或遭遇。

definitions.definition: To repay or refund (an excess received).
definitions.definitionCn: 偿还或退还（多收的款项）。

definitions.example: Add 100, left 50. Repeat, over.
definitions.definitionCn: （程序用语）因目标摧毁不足或未命中，使用相同弹药和方法对坐标或调整后的坐标再次呼叫先前炮兵火力任务。

definitions.definition: To commit fraud in an election by voting more than once for the same candidate.
definitions.definitionCn: 在选举中通过多次投票给同一候选人进行欺诈。

definitions.definition: Reputation.
definitions.definitionCn: 声誉。

definitions.definition: The sharp, loud sound from a gun or explosion.
definitions.definitionCn: 枪声或爆炸发出的尖锐响亮声音。

definitions.definition: An employee whose position in a corporate hierarchy is below that of a particular manager.
definitions.definitionCn: 在公司层级中职位低于特定经理的员工。

definitions.definition: To relate details of (an event or incident); to recount, describe (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 详细叙述（某个事件或事故）；讲述、描述（某事）。

definitions.definition: To repeat (something one has heard), to retell; to pass on, convey (a message, information etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 重复（听到的某事），转述；传递、传达（信息、消息等）。

definitions.definition: To take oneself (to someone or something) for guidance or support; to appeal.
definitions.definitionCn: 向（某人或某物）寻求指导或支持；求助。

definitions.definitionCn: 从群体中识别或选出某个成员；通常与out连用，即single out或single (something) out。
definitions.exampleCn: 埃迪从袋子里挑出了他最喜欢的弹珠。

definitions.definition: To get a hit that advances the batter exactly one base.
definitions.example: Pedro singled in the bottom of the eighth inning, which, if converted to a run, would put the team back into contention.
definitions.definitionCn: 击出使击球员恰好上一垒的安打。
definitions.exampleCn: 佩德罗在第八局下半击出一垒安打，如果转化为得分，将使球队重回竞争行列。

definitions.definition: To thin out.
definitions.definitionCn: 间苗。

definitions.definition: (of a horse) To take the irregular gait called singlefoot.
definitions.definitionCn: （指马）采用称为单步的不规则步法。

definitions.definition: To sequester; to withdraw; to retire.
definitions.definitionCn: 隔离；退出；隐退。

definitions.definition: To take alone, or one by one.
definitions.definitionCn: 独自或逐一取用。

definitions.definition: Not accompanied by anything else; one in number.
definitions.example: Can you give me a single reason not to leave right now?
definitions.definitionCn: 没有其他伴随物；数量为一。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能给我一个现在不离开的理由吗？

definitions.definition: Not divided in parts.
definitions.example: The potatoes left the spoon and landed in a single big lump on the plate.
definitions.definitionCn: 未分成部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 土豆从勺子里滑落，在盘子里聚成一大块。

definitions.definition: Designed for the use of only one.
definitions.example: a single room
definitions.definitionCn: 专为单人使用设计。
definitions.exampleCn: 单人间

definitions.definition: Performed by one person, or one on each side.
definitions.example: a single combat
definitions.definitionCn: 由一人或每方一人完成。
definitions.exampleCn: 单挑

definitions.definition: Not married or (in modern times) not involved in a romantic relationship without being married or not dating anyone exclusively.
definitions.example: Forms often ask if a person is single, married, divorced or widowed. In this context, a person who is dating someone but who has never married puts "single".
definitions.definitionCn: 未婚或（现代）未处于恋爱关系，或未专一约会任何人。
definitions.exampleCn: 表格常询问是否单身、已婚、离异或丧偶。在此语境中，有约会对象但从未结婚的人填“单身”。

definitions.definition: Having only one rank or row of petals.
definitions.definitionCn: 只有一轮或一排花瓣。

definitions.definition: Simple and honest; sincere, without deceit.
definitions.definitionCn: 简单诚实；真诚无欺。

definitions.definition: Uncompounded; pure; unmixed.
definitions.definitionCn: 未混合的；纯粹的；无杂质的。

definitions.definition: Simple; foolish; weak; silly.
definitions.definitionCn: 简单的；愚笨的；软弱的；傻气的。

definitions.definition: A thin, slippery mix of clay and water.
definitions.definitionCn: 粘土与水的稀薄滑腻混合物。

definitions.definition: Mud, slime.
definitions.definitionCn: 泥浆，黏液。

definitions.definition: A twig or shoot; a cutting.
A descendant, a scion.
A young person (now usually with of introducing descriptive qualifier).
definitions.example: She couldn't hurt a fly, young slip of a girl that she is.

definitions.definition: A long, thin piece of something.
A small piece of paper, especially one longer than it is wide, typically a form for writing on or one giving printed information.
definitions.example: a salary slip

definitions.definition: (marine insurance) A memorandum of the particulars of a risk for which a policy is to be executed. It usually bears the broker's name and is initiated by the underwriters.
An act or instance of slipping.
definitions.example: I had a slip on the ice and bruised my hip.

definitions.definition: A woman's undergarment worn under a skirt or dress to conceal unwanted nudity that may otherwise be revealed by the skirt or dress itself; a shift.
A slipdress.
A mistake or error.
A berth; a space for a ship to moor.
A difference between the theoretical distance traveled per revolution of the propeller and the actual advance of the vessel.
A slipway.
A one-time return to previous maladaptive behaviour after cure.

Any of several fielding positions to the off side of the wicket keeper, designed to catch the ball after being deflected from the bat; a fielder in that position (See first slip, second slip, third slip, fourth slip and fifth slip.)
A number between 0 and 1 that is the difference between the angular speed of a rotating magnetic field and the angular speed of its rotor, divided by the angular speed of the magnetic field.
A leash or string by which a dog is held; so called from its being made in such a manner as to slip, or become loose, by relaxation of the hand.
An escape; a secret or unexpected desertion.
definitions.example: He gave the warden the slip and escaped from the prison.

definitions.definition: A portion of the columns of a newspaper etc. struck off by itself; a proof from a column of type when set up and in the galley.
A child's pinafore.
An outside covering or case.
definitions.example: a pillow slip

definitions.definition: A counterfeit piece of money, made from brass covered with silver.
Matter found in troughs of grindstones after the grinding of edge tools.
An aqueous suspension of minerals, usually clay, used, among other things, to stick workpieces together.
A particular quantity of yarn.
A narrow passage between buildings.
A long seat or narrow pew in churches, often without a door.
A dislocation of a lead, destroying continuity.

The motion of the centre of resistance of the float of a paddle wheel, or the blade of an oar, through the water horizontally, or the difference between a vessel's actual speed and the speed it would have if the propelling instrument acted upon a solid; also, the velocity, relatively to still water, of the backward current of water produced by the propeller.
The difference between the actual and synchronous speeds of an induction motor.
A fish, the sole.
To lose one’s traction on a slippery surface; to slide due to a lack of friction.
To err.
To accidentally reveal a secret or otherwise say something unintentional.
To move or fly (out of place); to shoot; often with out, off, etc.
definitions.example: A bone may slip out of place.

definitions.definition: To pass (a note, money, etc.), often covertly.
definitions.example: She thanked the porter and slipped a ten-dollar bill into his hand.

definitions.definition: To cause to move smoothly and quickly; to slide; to convey gently or secretly.
To move quickly and often secretively; to depart, withdraw, enter, appear, intrude, or escape as if by sliding.
definitions.example: Some errors slipped into the appendix.

definitions.definition: To move down; to slide.
definitions.example: Profits have slipped over the past six months.

definitions.definition: To release (a dog, a bird of prey, etc.) to go after a quarry.
To remove the skin of a soft fruit, such as a tomato or peach, by blanching briefly in boiling water, then transferring to cold water so that the skin peels, or slips, off easily.
To omit; to lose by negligence.
To cut slips from; to cut; to take off; to make a slip or slips of.
definitions.example: to slip a piece of cloth or paper

definitions.definition: To cause to slip or slide off, or out of place.
definitions.example: A horse slips his bridle; a dog slips his collar.

definitions.definition: To bring forth (young) prematurely; to slink.
To cause (a schedule or release, etc.) to go, or let it go, beyond the allotted deadline.
Encoded computer instructions, usually modifiable (unless stored in some form of unalterable memory such as ROM).
definitions.definitionCn: 编码后的计算机指令，通常可修改（除非存储在只读存储器等不可更改的存储形式中）。

definitions.definition: The human beings involved in warfare, as opposed to hardware such as weapons and vehicles.
definitions.definitionCn: 参与战争的人类个体，区别于武器、车辆等硬件设备。

definitions.definition: To hurt or sting.
definitions.example: After being hit with a pitch, the batter exclaimed "Ouch, my arm smarts!"
definitions.definitionCn: 刺痛或蜇痛。
definitions.exampleCn: 被投球击中后，击球手喊道：“哎哟，我的胳膊好疼！”

definitions.definition: To cause a smart or sting in.
definitions.definitionCn: 引起刺痛或蜇痛。

definitions.definition: To feel a pungent pain of mind; to feel sharp pain or grief; be punished severely; to feel the sting of evil.
definitions.definitionCn: 感到精神上的剧烈痛苦；感到尖锐的疼痛或悲伤；受到严厉惩罚；感受到邪恶的刺痛。

definitions.definition: Exhibiting social ability or cleverness.
Exhibiting intellectual knowledge, such as that found in books.
(often in combination) Equipped with intelligent behaviour (digital/computer technology).
definitions.example: smart bomb

definitions.definition: Good-looking; well dressed; fine; fashionable.
definitions.example: You look smart in that business suit.

definitions.definition: Cleverly shrewd and humorous in a way that may be rude and disrespectful.
definitions.example: Don't get smart with me!

definitions.definition: Sudden and intense.
Causing sharp pain; stinging.
Sharp; keen; poignant.
definitions.example: a smart pain

definitions.definition: (Southern) Intense in feeling; painful. Used usually with the adverb intensifier right.
definitions.example: He raised his voice, and it hurt her feelings right smart.

definitions.definition: Efficient; vigorous; brilliant.
Pretentious; showy; spruce.
definitions.example: a smart gown

definitions.definition: Brisk; fresh.
definitions.example: a smart breeze

definitions.definition: A sharp, quick, lively pain; a sting.
Mental pain or suffering; grief; affliction.
Smart-money.
A dandy; one who is smart in dress; one who is brisk, vivacious, or clever.
The act of slighting; a deliberate act of neglect or discourtesy.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻视的行为；一种故意的忽视或无礼举动。

definitions.definition: Sleight.
definitions.definitionCn: 巧妙手法。

definitions.definition: To treat as unimportant or not worthy of attention; to make light of.
definitions.definitionCn: 视为不重要或不值得关注；轻描淡写。

definitions.definition: To give lesser weight or importance to.
definitions.definitionCn: 给予较低权重或重要性。

definitions.definition: To treat with disdain or neglect, usually out of prejudice, hatred, or jealousy; to ignore disrespectfully.
definitions.definitionCn: 因偏见、仇恨或嫉妒而轻蔑或忽视；无礼地忽略。

definitions.definition: To act negligently or carelessly.
definitions.definitionCn: 疏忽或粗心地行事。

definitions.definition: (of a fortification) To render no longer defensible by full or partial demolition.
definitions.definitionCn: （指防御工事）通过全部或部分拆除使其不再具备防御能力。

definitions.definition: To make even or level.
definitions.definitionCn: 使平坦或平整。

definitions.definition: To throw heedlessly.
definitions.definitionCn: 随意抛掷。

definitions.definition: Small
definitions.definitionCn: 细小的。

definitions.definition: Of slender build
definitions.example: a slight but graceful woman
definitions.definitionCn: 身材纤细的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位苗条优雅的女子。

definitions.definition: Even, smooth or level
definitions.example: A slight stone
definitions.definitionCn: 平坦、光滑或水平的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一块光滑的石头。

definitions.definition: (especially said of the swa) still; with little or no movement on the surface
definitions.example: The sea was slight and calm
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指水面）静止的；表面几乎没有波动。
definitions.exampleCn: 海面平静无波。

definitions.definition: Foolish; silly; not intellectual.
definitions.definitionCn: 愚蠢的；傻气的；不聪明的。

definitions.definition: Bad, of poor quality.
definitions.definitionCn: 糟糕的，质量差的。

definitions.definition: Slighting; treating with disdain.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻视的；以轻蔑态度对待的。

definitions.definition: An immersion in water etc.
definitions.example: After the strenuous climb, I had a nice long soak in a bath.
definitions.definitionCn: 浸泡在水中等。
definitions.exampleCn: 经过艰苦的攀登后，我在浴缸里好好泡了个长时间澡。

definitions.definition: A drunkard.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个醉汉。

definitions.definition: A carouse; a drinking session.
definitions.definitionCn: 一场狂饮；一次饮酒聚会。

definitions.definition: A low-lying depression that fills with water after rain.
definitions.definitionCn: 雨后积水的低洼地。

definitions.definition: To be saturated with liquid by being immersed in it.
definitions.example: I'm going to soak in the bath for a couple of hours.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过浸泡使液体饱和。
definitions.exampleCn: 我打算在浴缸里泡上几个小时。

definitions.definition: To immerse in liquid to the point of saturation or thorough permeation.
definitions.example: Soak the beans overnight before cooking.
definitions.definitionCn: 将液体浸入至饱和或彻底渗透的程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 烹饪前将豆子浸泡一夜。

definitions.definition: To penetrate or permeate by saturation.
definitions.example: The water soaked into my shoes and gave me wet feet.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过饱和作用渗透或渗入。
definitions.exampleCn: 水浸透了我的鞋子，弄湿了我的脚。

definitions.definition: To allow (especially a liquid) to be absorbed; to take in, receive. (usually + up)
definitions.example: A sponge soaks up water; the skin soaks in moisture.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许（尤其是液体）被吸收；接收。（通常+up）
definitions.exampleCn: 海绵吸水；皮肤吸收水分。

definitions.definition: To take money from.
definitions.definitionCn: 从……处拿钱。

definitions.definition: To drink intemperately or gluttonously.
definitions.definitionCn: 无节制或贪婪地饮酒。

definitions.definition: To heat (a metal) before shaping it.
definitions.definitionCn: 在塑形前加热（金属）。

definitions.definition: To hold a kiln at a particular temperature for a given period of time.
definitions.example: We should soak the kiln at cone 9 for half an hour.
definitions.definitionCn: 将窑炉在特定温度下保持一段时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们应在锥体9号温度下浸泡窑炉半小时。

definitions.definition: To absorb; to drain.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸收；排干。

definitions.definition: A person who is held in servitude as the property of another person, and whose labor (and often also whose body and life) is subject to the owner's volition and control.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为他人财产被奴役的人，其劳动（通常也包括身体和生命）完全服从于主人的意志和控制。

definitions.definition: A drudge; one who labors or is obliged (e.g. by prior contract) to labor like a slave with limited rights, e.g. an indentured servant.
definitions.definitionCn: 苦工；被迫（如通过预先契约）像奴隶一样劳动且权利受限的人，例如契约佣工。

definitions.definition: An abject person.
definitions.definitionCn: 卑贱之人。

definitions.definition: One who has no power of resistance (to something), one who surrenders to or is under the domination (of something).
definitions.example: a slave to passion, to strong drink, or to ambition
definitions.definitionCn: 毫无抵抗能力（对某事）的人，屈服于或受制于（某事物）的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 激情、烈酒或野心的奴隶

definitions.definition: (BDSM) A submissive partner in a BDSM relationship who (consensually) submits to (sexually and/or personally) serving one or more masters or mistresses.
definitions.definitionCn: （BDSM）BDSM关系中顺从的一方，自愿（在性方面和/或个人方面）服从于一位或多位主人或女主人。

definitions.definition: A sex slave, a person who is forced against their will to perform, for another person or group, sexual acts on a regular or continuing basis.
definitions.definitionCn: 性奴隶，被迫违背自身意愿，定期或持续为他人或群体进行性行为的人。

definitions.definition: A device (such as a secondary flash or hard drive) that is subject to the control of another (a master).
definitions.definitionCn: 受另一设备（主设备）控制的设备（如副闪光灯或硬盘）。

definitions.definition: To work as a slaver, to enslave people.
definitions.definitionCn: 从事奴隶贩卖，奴役他人。

definitions.definition: To work hard.
definitions.example: I was slaving all day over a hot stove.
definitions.definitionCn: 辛苦劳作。
definitions.exampleCn: 我整天在滚烫的炉子前辛苦工作。

definitions.definition: To place a device under the control of another.
definitions.example: to slave a hard disk
definitions.definitionCn: 将设备置于另一设备的控制之下。
definitions.exampleCn: 将硬盘设为从属设备。

definitions.definition: An area of ground that tends evenly upward or downward.
definitions.example: I had to climb a small slope to get to the site.
definitions.definitionCn: 一块地面，倾向于均匀向上或向下。
definitions.exampleCn: 我必须爬一个小坡才能到达那个地点。

definitions.definition: The degree to which a surface tends upward or downward.
definitions.example: The road has a very sharp downward slope at that point.
definitions.definitionCn: 表面向上或向下的倾斜程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 那条路在那个位置有一个非常陡的下坡。

definitions.definition: The ratio of the vertical and horizontal distances between two points on a line; zero if the line is horizontal, undefined if it is vertical.
definitions.example: The slope of this line is 0.5
definitions.definitionCn: 一条线上两点之间垂直距离与水平距离的比值；如果线是水平的，比值为零；如果线是垂直的，比值未定义。
definitions.exampleCn: 这条线的斜率是0.5。

definitions.definition: The slope of the line tangent to a curve at a given point.
definitions.example: The slope of a parabola increases linearly with x.
definitions.definitionCn: 曲线在给定点处切线的斜率。
definitions.exampleCn: 抛物线的斜率随x线性增加。

definitions.definition: The angle a roof surface makes with the horizontal, expressed as a ratio of the units of vertical rise to the units of horizontal length (sometimes referred to as run).
definitions.example: The slope of an asphalt shingle roof system should be 4:12 or greater.
definitions.definitionCn: 屋顶表面与水平面所成的角度，表示为垂直上升单位与水平长度单位（有时称为跨度）的比值。
definitions.exampleCn: 沥青瓦屋顶系统的坡度应为4:12或更大。

definitions.definition: A person of Chinese or other East Asian descent.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个中国人或其他东亚裔的人。

definitions.definition: To tend steadily upward or downward.
definitions.example: The road slopes sharply down at that point.
definitions.definitionCn: 稳定地向上或向下倾斜。
definitions.exampleCn: 那条路在那个位置急剧向下倾斜。

definitions.definition: To form with a slope; to give an oblique or slanting direction to; to incline or slant.
definitions.example: to slope the ground in a garden;   to slope a piece of cloth in cutting a garment
definitions.definitionCn: 形成坡度；赋予倾斜或斜向的方向；使倾斜或歪斜。
definitions.exampleCn: 在花园里使地面倾斜；在裁剪衣服时使一块布倾斜。

definitions.definition: (usually followed by a preposition) To try to move surreptitiously.
definitions.example: I sloped in through the back door, hoping my boss wouldn't see me.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常后接介词）试图偷偷移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我从后门悄悄溜进去，希望老板没看见我。

definitions.definition: To hold a rifle at a slope with forearm perpendicular to the body in front holding the butt, the rifle resting on the shoulder.
definitions.example: The order was given to "slope arms".
definitions.definitionCn: 以倾斜姿势持步枪，前臂垂直于身体前方握住枪托，步枪靠在肩上。
definitions.exampleCn: 下达了“持枪倾斜”的命令。

definitions.definition: Sloping.
definitions.definitionCn: 倾斜的。

definitions.definition: Slopingly
definitions.definitionCn: 倾斜地。

definitions.definition: A festive gathering to foster introductions.
definitions.example: They organized a social at the dance club to get people to know each other.
definitions.definitionCn: 促进结识的社交聚会。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们组织了一场舞会社交活动，让大家互相认识。

definitions.definition: A dance held to raise money for a couple to be married.
definitions.definitionCn: 为帮助一对新人筹集婚礼费用而举办的舞会。

definitions.definition: A dinner dance event, usually held annually by a company or sporting club.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常由公司或体育俱乐部每年举办的晚宴舞会活动。

definitions.definition: A social media account.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个社交媒体账号。

definitions.definition: Being extroverted or outgoing.
definitions.example: James is a very social guy; he knows lots of people.
definitions.definitionCn: 性格外向或善于交际。
definitions.exampleCn: 詹姆斯是个非常善于社交的人，他认识很多人。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to society.
definitions.example: Teresa feels uncomfortable in certain social situations.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于社会的。
definitions.exampleCn: 特蕾莎在某些社交场合感到不自在。

definitions.definition: Relating to social media or social networks.
definitions.example: social gaming
definitions.definitionCn: 与社交媒体或社交网络相关的。
definitions.exampleCn: 社交游戏

definitions.definition: Relating to a nation's allies.
definitions.definitionCn: 关于国家盟友的。

definitions.definition: Cooperating or growing in groups.
definitions.example: a social insect
definitions.definitionCn: 以群体形式合作或成长。
definitions.exampleCn: 一种社会性昆虫

definitions.definition: Interactive forms of media that allow users to interact with and publish to each other, generally by means of the Internet.
definitions.example: The early 21st century saw a huge increase in social media thanks to the widespread availability of the Internet.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许用户通过互联网相互互动和发布内容的互动媒体形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 21世纪初，由于互联网的广泛普及，社交媒体出现了巨大增长。

definitions.definition: A system whereby the state either through general or specific taxation provides various benefits to help ensure the wellbeing of its citizens.
definitions.definitionCn: 国家通过一般或特定税收提供各种福利，以帮助确保公民福祉的制度。

definitions.definition: Those benefits paid under such a system.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据该制度支付的福利。

definitions.definition: A specific such social benefit providing income in retirement or disability.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种特定的社会福利，提供退休或残疾收入。

definitions.definition: A nine-digit number issued to citizens, permanent residents, and temporary (working) residents under section 205(c)(2) of the Social Security Act, codified as 42 U.S.C. § 405(c)(2). The number is issued to an individual by the Social Security Administration. Its primary purpose is to track individuals for taxation purposes. Abbreviated as SSN. In recent years the SSN has become a de facto national identification number.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据《社会保障法》第205(c)(2)条（编入美国法典第42卷第405(c)(2)节）发给公民、永久居民和临时（工作）居民的九位数字号码。该号码由社会保障管理局发放给个人，主要目的是用于税务追踪。缩写为SSN。近年来，SSN已成为事实上的国民身份证号码。

definitions.definition: A corresponding number in other countries.
definitions.definitionCn: 其他国家对应的号码。

definitions.definition: The study of history, geography, civics, sociology, economics, and other social-science subjects, especially in primary and secondary school.
definitions.definitionCn: 历史、地理、公民学、社会学、经济学及其他社会科学学科的研究，尤其在小学和中学阶段。

definitions.definition: Something that is smooth, or that goes smoothly and easily.
definitions.definitionCn: 光滑的，或进行得顺畅容易的事物。

definitions.definition: A smoothing action.
definitions.definitionCn: 抚平的动作。

definitions.definition: A domestic animal having a smooth coat.
definitions.definitionCn: 毛皮光滑的家养动物。

definitions.definition: A member of an anti-hippie fashion movement in 1970s Britain.
definitions.definitionCn: 20世纪70年代英国反嬉皮时尚运动的成员。

definitions.definition: The analysis obtained through a smoothing procedure.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过平滑处理得到的分析结果。

definitions.definition: To make smooth or even.
definitions.definitionCn: 使光滑或平整。

definitions.definition: To make straightforward or easy.
definitions.definitionCn: 使简单或容易。

definitions.definition: To calm or palliate.
definitions.example: to smooth a person's temper
definitions.definitionCn: 使平静或缓和。
definitions.exampleCn: 安抚某人的脾气。

definitions.definition: (image processing, digital audio) To capture important patterns in the data, while leaving out noise.
definitions.definitionCn: （图像处理、数字音频）捕捉数据中的重要模式，同时忽略噪声。

definitions.definition: To stroke; especially to stroke an animal's fur.
definitions.example: Can I smooth your cat?
definitions.definitionCn: 抚摸；尤指抚摸动物的毛发。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能摸摸你的猫吗？

definitions.definition: Having a texture that lacks friction. Not rough.
definitions.definitionCn: 质地无摩擦，不粗糙。

definitions.definition: Without difficulty, problems, or unexpected consequences or incidents.
definitions.example: We hope for a smooth transition to the new system.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有困难、问题或意外后果或事件。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们希望平稳过渡到新系统。

definitions.definition: Bland; glib.
definitions.definitionCn: 平淡的；油嘴滑舌的。

definitions.definition: Flowing or uttered without check, obstruction, or hesitation; not harsh; fluent.
definitions.definitionCn: 流畅或毫无阻碍、停顿地说出；不刺耳；流利。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Suave; sophisticated.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）温文尔雅；老练的。

definitions.definition: (of an action) Natural; unconstrained.
definitions.definitionCn: （指动作）自然的；不受拘束的。

definitions.definition: (of a motion) Unbroken.
definitions.definitionCn: （指运动）不间断的。

definitions.definition: (chiefly of water) Placid, calm.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要指水）平静的，安宁的。

definitions.definition: (of an edge) Lacking projections or indentations; not serrated.
definitions.definitionCn: （指边缘）无突出或凹陷；不呈锯齿状。

definitions.definition: (of food or drink) Not grainy; having an even texture.
definitions.definitionCn: （指食物或饮料）无颗粒感；质地均匀。

definitions.definition: (of a beverage) Having a pleasantly rounded flavor; neither rough nor astringent.
definitions.definitionCn: （指饮品）口感圆润宜人；既不涩也不苦。

definitions.definition: (of a function) Having derivatives of all finite orders at all points within the function’s domain.
definitions.definitionCn: （指函数）在定义域内所有点具有所有有限阶导数。

definitions.definition: (of a number) That factors completely into small prime numbers.
definitions.definitionCn: （指数）能完全分解为小质数。

definitions.definition: (of a vowel) Lacking marked aspiration.
definitions.definitionCn: （指元音）无明显送气。

definitions.definition: (of muscles) Involuntary and non-striated.
definitions.definitionCn: （指肌肉）不随意且无横纹的。

definitions.definition: Smoothly.
definitions.definitionCn: 平滑地。

definitions.definition: A quick breaking or cracking sound or the action of producing such a sound.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速断裂或爆裂的声音，或产生这种声音的动作。

definitions.definition: A sudden break.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然的断裂。

definitions.definition: An attempt to seize, bite, attack, or grab.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图抓住、咬住、攻击或抢夺的动作。

definitions.definition: The act of making a snapping sound by pressing the thumb and an opposing finger of the same hand together and suddenly releasing the grip so that the finger hits against the palm.
definitions.definitionCn: 用同一只手的拇指和另一根手指按压后突然松开，使手指击打手掌发出啪声的动作。

definitions.definition: A fastening device that makes a snapping sound when used.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用时发出啪声的扣合装置。

definitions.definition: A photograph; a snapshot.
definitions.example: We took a few snaps of the old church before moving on.
definitions.definitionCn: 照片；快照。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在继续前行前拍了几张老教堂的快照。

definitions.definition: The sudden release of something held under pressure or tension.
definitions.definitionCn: 受压或拉紧物体的突然释放。

definitions.definition: A thin circular cookie or similar baked good.
definitions.example: a ginger snap
definitions.definitionCn: 薄脆的圆形饼干或类似烘焙食品。
definitions.exampleCn: 姜味脆饼。

definitions.definition: A brief, sudden period of a certain weather; used primarily in the phrase cold snap.
definitions.definitionCn: 某种天气的短暂突然时期；主要用于短语“寒潮”。

definitions.definition: A very short period of time (figuratively, the time taken to snap one's fingers), or a task that can be accomplished in such a period.
definitions.example: I can fix most vacuum cleaners in a snap.
definitions.definitionCn: 极短的时间（比喻弹指之间），或能在如此短时间内完成的任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能在瞬间修好大多数吸尘器。

definitions.definition: A snap bean such as Phaseolus vulgaris.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种豆荚类蔬菜，如菜豆。

definitions.definition: A backward pass or handoff of a football from its position on the ground that puts the ball in play; a hike.
definitions.definitionCn: 从地面位置向后传球或手递手开球，使球进入比赛状态；开球。

definitions.definition: (somewhat colloquial) A rivet: a scrapbooking embellishment.
definitions.definitionCn: （略带口语）一种铆钉：剪贴簿装饰物。

definitions.definition: A small meal, a snack; lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 小餐，零食；午餐。

definitions.definition: A card game, primarily for children, in which players cry "snap" to claim pairs of matching cards as they are turned up.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种主要供儿童玩的纸牌游戏，玩家在翻到配对牌时喊“snap”。

definitions.definition: A greedy fellow.
definitions.definitionCn: 贪婪的人。

definitions.definition: That which is, or may be, snapped up; something bitten off, seized, or obtained by a single quick movement; hence, a bite, morsel, or fragment; a scrap.
definitions.definitionCn: 被迅速抢购或可能被抢购的东西；一口咬下、夺取或通过快速动作获得的东西；因此，一口、一小块或碎片；残片。

definitions.definition: Briskness; vigour; energy; decision
definitions.definitionCn: 敏捷；活力；精力；果断。

definitions.definition: Any circumstance out of which money may be made or an advantage gained. used primarily in the phrase soft snap.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何能赚钱或获利的状况；主要用于短语“轻松赚钱”。

definitions.definition: Something that is easy or effortless.
definitions.definitionCn: 容易或不费力的事情。

definitions.definition: A snapper, or snap beetle.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种叩头虫。

definitions.definition: Jounce (the fourth derivative of the position vector with respect to time), followed by crackle and pop
definitions.definitionCn: 急动度（位置向量对时间的四阶导数），随后是“crackle”和“pop”。

definitions.definition: A quick offhand shot with a firearm; a snap shot.
definitions.definitionCn: 用火器快速随意射击；快射。

definitions.definition: Something of no value.
definitions.example: not worth a snap
definitions.definitionCn: 无价值的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 一文不值。

definitions.definition: A visual message sent through the Snapchat application.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过Snapchat应用发送的视觉信息。

definitions.definition: A crisp or pithy quality; epigrammatic point or force.
definitions.definitionCn: 简洁或精炼的特质；警句式的要点或力量。

definitions.definition: A tool used by riveters.
definitions.definitionCn: 铆工使用的工具。

definitions.definition: A tool used by glass-moulders.
definitions.definitionCn: 玻璃模具工使用的工具。

definitions.definition: A brief theatrical engagement.
definitions.definitionCn: 短暂的戏剧表演。

definitions.definition: An easy and profitable place or task; a sinecure.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻松有利可图的地方或任务；闲职。

definitions.definition: A cheat or sharper.
definitions.definitionCn: 骗子或欺诈者。

definitions.definition: To fracture or break apart suddenly.
definitions.example: He snapped his stick in anger.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然断裂或破碎。
definitions.exampleCn: 他愤怒地折断了手杖。

definitions.definition: To give forth or produce a sharp cracking noise; to crack.
definitions.example: Blazing firewood snaps.
definitions.definitionCn: 发出或产生尖锐的爆裂声；噼啪作响。
definitions.exampleCn: 燃烧的木柴噼啪作响。

definitions.definition: To attempt to seize with the teeth or bite.
definitions.example: A dog snaps at a passenger. A fish snaps at the bait.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图用牙齿抓住或咬住。
definitions.exampleCn: 狗向行人猛咬。鱼咬饵。

definitions.definition: To attempt to seize with eagerness.
definitions.example: She snapped at the chance to appear on television.
definitions.definitionCn: 急切地试图抓住。
definitions.exampleCn: 她抓住机会上电视。

definitions.definition: To speak abruptly or sharply.
definitions.example: He snapped at me for the slightest mistake.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然或尖锐地说话。
definitions.exampleCn: 他因最微小的错误对我厉声斥责。

definitions.definition: To give way abruptly and loudly.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然大声地垮掉。

definitions.definition: To suffer a mental breakdown, usually while under tension.
definitions.example: She should take a break before she snaps.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神崩溃，通常在压力下。
definitions.exampleCn: 她应该在崩溃前休息一下。

definitions.definition: To flash or appear to flash as with light.
definitions.definitionCn: 闪光或看似闪光，如光一般。

definitions.definition: To fit or fasten together with a snapping sound.
definitions.definitionCn: 用啪声配合或扣紧。

definitions.definition: To jump to a fixed position relative to another element.
definitions.example: The floating toolbar will snap to the edge of the screen when dragged towards it.
definitions.definitionCn: 跳至相对于另一元素的固定位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 浮动工具栏拖向屏幕边缘时会吸附过去。

definitions.definition: To snatch with or as if with the teeth.
definitions.definitionCn: 用或仿佛用牙齿抢夺。

definitions.definition: To pull apart with a snapping sound; to pop loose.
definitions.definitionCn: 用啪声拉开；弹开。

definitions.definition: To say abruptly or sharply.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然或尖锐地说出。

definitions.definition: To speak to abruptly or sharply; to treat snappishly; usually with up.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然或尖锐地对某人说话；粗暴对待；通常与“up”连用。

definitions.definition: To cause something to emit a snapping sound.
definitions.example: to snap a fastener
definitions.definitionCn: 使某物发出啪声。
definitions.exampleCn: 扣上扣件。

definitions.definition: To close something using a snap as a fastener.
definitions.definitionCn: 用按扣关闭某物。

definitions.definition: To snap one's fingers: to make a snapping sound, often by pressing the thumb and an opposing finger of the same hand together and suddenly releasing the grip so that the finger hits against the palm; alternatively, by bringing the index finger quickly down onto the middle finger and thumb.
definitions.definitionCn: 弹响手指：通过按压同一只手的拇指和另一根手指后突然松开，使手指击打手掌发出啪声；或者，快速将食指向下击打中指和拇指。

definitions.definition: To cause to move suddenly and smartly.
definitions.definitionCn: 使突然而敏捷地移动。

definitions.definition: To take a photograph; to release a camera's shutter (which may make a snapping sound).
definitions.example: He snapped a picture of me with my mouth open and my eyes closed.
definitions.definitionCn: 拍照；释放相机快门（可能发出啪声）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他拍了一张我张着嘴闭着眼照片。

definitions.definition: To put (a football) in play by a backward pass or handoff from its position on the ground; to hike (a football).
definitions.example: He can snap the ball to a back twenty yards behind him.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过向后传球或手递手从地面位置开球，使球进入比赛状态；开球（橄榄球）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他能把球传给身后二十码的后卫。

definitions.definition: To misfire.
definitions.example: The gun snapped.
definitions.definitionCn: 哑火。
definitions.exampleCn: 枪哑火了。

definitions.definition: To catch out sharply (a batsman who has just snicked a bowled ball).
definitions.definitionCn: 迅速接杀（刚擦到投球的击球手）。

definitions.definition: Done, made, performed, etc., quickly and unexpectedly, or without deliberation.
definitions.example: a snap judgment or decision    a snap political convention
definitions.definitionCn: 快速、意外或未经深思熟虑地完成、制作、执行等。
definitions.exampleCn: 仓促的判断或决定   仓促的政治会议。

definitions.definition: The cry used in a game of snap when winning a hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 在“snap”游戏中赢牌时喊出的叫声。

definitions.definition: By extension from the card game, "I've got one the same!", "Me too!"
definitions.example: Snap! We've both got pink buckets and spades.
definitions.definitionCn: 从纸牌游戏引申，“我也一样！”，“我也是！”
definitions.exampleCn: “Snap！”我们都有粉色桶和铲子。

definitions.definition: Ritual utterance of agreement (after the cry in the card game snap).
definitions.definitionCn: 表示同意的仪式性话语（在纸牌游戏喊叫之后）。

definitions.definition: Used in place of expletive to express surprise, usually in response to a negative statement or news; often used facetiously.
definitions.example: "I just ran over your phone with my car." "Oh, snap!"
definitions.definitionCn: 用于代替咒骂语表达惊讶，通常回应负面陈述或消息；常带戏谑。
definitions.exampleCn: “我刚用车碾过你的手机。”“哦，天哪！”

definitions.definition: Ritual utterance used after something is said by two people at exactly the same time.
definitions.example: "Wasn't that John?" "Wasn't that John?" "Snap!"
definitions.definitionCn: 两人同时说出相同话语后使用的仪式性话语。
definitions.exampleCn: “那不是约翰吗？”“那不是约翰吗？”“Snap！”

definitions.definition: More or less; a certain quantity or degree; a part, more or less; something.
definitions.definitionCn: 或多或少；一定数量或程度；一部分，或多或少；某事物。

definitions.definition: A person or thing of importance; a somebody.
definitions.definitionCn: 重要的人或事物；大人物。

definitions.definition: (degree) To a limited extent or degree.

definitions.definitionCn: （程度）在有限的范围或程度上。
definitions.exampleCn: 人群比预期的要大一些，也许是因为天气好。

definitions.definition: Something.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物。

definitions.definition: A wooden band or yoke put around the neck of an ox or cow in the stall.
definitions.definitionCn: 牛棚中套在牛脖子上的木制项圈或轭。

definitions.definition: A pond or pool; a dirty pond of standing water.

definitions.definitionCn: 记者的线人。

definitions.definition: Source code.
definitions.definitionCn: 源代码。

definitions.definition: The name of one terminal of a field effect transistor (FET).
definitions.definitionCn: 场效应晶体管（FET）的一个端子名称。

definitions.definition: To obtain or procure: used especially of a business resource.
definitions.definitionCn: 获取或采购：尤指商业资源。

definitions.definition: To find information about (a quotation)'s source (from which it comes): to find a citation for.
definitions.definitionCn: 查找（引文）的来源：找到其出处。

definitions.definition: The spirit or essence of a person usually thought to consist of one's thoughts and personality. Often believed to live on after the person's death.
definitions.definitionCn: 人的精神或本质，通常被认为由思想和个性构成，常被认为在人死后依然存在。

definitions.definition: The spirit or essence of anything.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何事物的精神或本质。

definitions.definition: Life, energy, vigor.
definitions.definitionCn: 生命、能量、活力。

definitions.definition: Soul music.
definitions.definitionCn: 灵魂乐。

definitions.definition: A person, especially as one among many.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人，尤其是作为众多中的一员。

definitions.definition: An individual life.

definitions.definitionCn: 个体的生命。

definitions.definition: Of, facing, situated in, or related to the south.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于、面向、位于或与南方相关的。

definitions.definition: Of or pertaining to a southern region, especially Southern Europe or the southern United States.
definitions.example: The southern climate.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于南方地区的，尤其是南欧或美国南部。
definitions.exampleCn: 南方气候。

definitions.definition: Of a wind: blowing from the south; southerly.
definitions.definitionCn: 指风：从南方吹来的；南风。

definitions.definition: A native or inhabitant of the south of a region (or of the world as a whole), such as the United Kingdom.
definitions.definitionCn: 南方地区（或整个世界）的本地人或居民，例如英国。

definitions.definition: (heading) Of time.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 论时间。

definitions.definition: (heading) Unlimited or generalized extent, physical or otherwise.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 无限或广义的范围，物理或其他方面。

definitions.definition: (heading) A bounded or specific extent, physical or otherwise.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 有限或特定的范围，物理或其他方面。

definitions.definition: To roam, walk, wander.
definitions.definitionCn: 漫游、行走、徘徊。

definitions.definition: To set some distance apart.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物间隔一定距离。

definitions.definition: To insert or utilise spaces in a written text.
definitions.definitionCn: 在书面文本中插入或使用空格。

definitions.definition: To eject into outer space, usually without a space suit.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常不穿宇航服）弹射到外太空。

definitions.definition: To travel into and through outer space.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入并穿越外太空旅行。

definitions.definition: The space from the thumb to the end of the little finger when extended; nine inches; an eighth of a fathom.
definitions.definitionCn: 拇指尖到小指尖展开时的距离；九英寸；一英寻的八分之一。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A small space or a brief portion of time.

definitions.definitionCn: 针对特定疾病的特效药。
definitions.exampleCn: 奎宁是治疗疟疾的特效药。

definitions.definition: Limited to a particular antibody or antigen
definitions.definitionCn: 仅限于特定抗体或抗原的。

definitions.definition: Of a value divided by mass (e.g. specific orbital energy)
definitions.definitionCn: 除以质量后的值（如比轨道能量）。

definitions.definition: Similarly referring to a value divided by any measure which acts to standardize it (e.g. thrust specific fuel consumption, referring to fuel consumption divided by thrust)
definitions.definitionCn: 类似地，指除以任何标准化度量后的值（如推力比油耗，即油耗除以推力）。

definitions.definition: A measure compared with a standard reference value by division, to produce a ratio without unit or dimension (e.g. specific refractive index is a pure number, and is relative to that of air)
definitions.definitionCn: 通过与标准参考值相除得到的度量，产生无量纲的比值（如比折射率是纯数值，相对于空气的折射率）。

definitions.definition: A regular three-dimensional object in which every cross-section is a circle; the figure described by the revolution of a circle about its diameter .
definitions.definitionCn: 一个每个横截面都是圆形的规则三维物体；由圆绕其直径旋转形成的图形。

definitions.definition: A spherical physical object; a globe or ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 球形物理物体；球体或球。

definitions.definition: The apparent outer limit of space; the edge of the heavens, imagined as a hollow globe within which celestial bodies appear to be embedded.
definitions.definitionCn: 太空的明显外部界限；天穹的边缘，被想象为一个中空的球体，天体似乎镶嵌其中。

definitions.definition: Any of the concentric hollow transparent globes formerly believed to rotate around the Earth, and which carried the heavenly bodies; there were originally believed to be eight, and later nine and ten; friction between them was thought to cause a harmonious sound (the music of the spheres).
definitions.definitionCn: 任何曾经被认为绕地球旋转的同心透明中空球体，它们承载着天体；最初认为有八个，后来有九个和十个；它们之间的摩擦被认为会产生和谐的声音（天体音乐）。

definitions.definition: An area of activity for a planet; or by extension, an area of influence for a god, hero etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 行星的活动区域；或引申为神、英雄等的影响范围。

definitions.definition: The region in which something or someone is active; one's province, domain.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物或某人活跃的区域；某人的领域、范围。

definitions.definition: The set of all points in three-dimensional Euclidean space (or n-dimensional space, in topology) that are a fixed distance from a fixed point .
definitions.definitionCn: 三维欧几里得空间中（或拓扑学中的n维空间）所有与固定点距离固定的点的集合。

definitions.definition: The extension of a general conception, or the totality of the individuals or species to which it may be applied.
definitions.definitionCn: 一般概念的延伸，或可应用该概念的个体或物种的总和。

definitions.definition: To place in a sphere, or among the spheres; to ensphere.
definitions.definitionCn: 放置于球体中，或置于球体之间；使成球状。

definitions.definition: To make round or spherical; to perfect.
definitions.definitionCn: 使变圆或呈球形；使完美。

definitions.definition: The act of sparing; moderation; restraint.
definitions.definitionCn: 节省的行为；适度；克制。

definitions.definition: Parsimony; frugal use.
definitions.definitionCn: 节俭；节约使用。

definitions.definition: An opening in a petticoat or gown; a placket.
definitions.definitionCn: 衬裙或长袍上的开口；门襟。

definitions.definition: That which has not been used or expended.
definitions.definitionCn: 未被使用或消耗的东西。

definitions.definition: A spare part, especially a spare tire.
definitions.definitionCn: 备用零件，尤指备用轮胎。

definitions.definition: A superfluous or second-best person, specially (in a dynastic context) in the phrase "An heir and a spare".
definitions.definitionCn: 多余或次等的人，尤其在王朝语境中“继承人与备胎”这一说法。

definitions.definition: The right of bowling again at a full set of pins, after having knocked all the pins down in less than three bowls. If all the pins are knocked down in one bowl it is a double spare; in two bowls, a single spare.
definitions.definitionCn: 在少于三次投球中击倒全部球瓶后，再次投满瓶的权利。若一次投球击倒所有球瓶则为双倍备用；两次投球则为单倍备用。

definitions.definition: The act of knocking down all remaining pins in second ball of a frame; this entitles the pins knocked down on the next ball to be added to the score for that frame.
definitions.definitionCn: 在一局中第二次投球击倒所有剩余球瓶的行为；这使下一球击倒的球瓶数可计入该局得分。

definitions.definition: A free period; a block of school during which one does not have a class.
definitions.definitionCn: 空闲时段；学校中没有课的一段时间。

definitions.definition: Scant; not abundant or plentiful.
definitions.example: a spare diet
definitions.definitionCn: 不足的；不丰富的。
definitions.exampleCn: 节俭的饮食。

definitions.definition: Sparing; frugal; parsimonious; not spending much money.
definitions.definitionCn: 节省的；节俭的；吝啬的；不花太多钱的。

definitions.definition: Being more than what is necessary, or what must be used or reserved; not wanted, or not used; superfluous.
definitions.example: I have no spare time.
definitions.definitionCn: 超出必要或必须使用或保留的；不需要或不使用的；多余的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我没有空闲时间。

definitions.definition: Held in reserve, to be used in an emergency.
definitions.example: a spare anchor; a spare bed or room
definitions.definitionCn: 保留以备紧急使用的。
definitions.exampleCn: 备用锚；备用床或房间。

definitions.definition: Lean; lacking flesh; meager; thin; gaunt.
definitions.definitionCn: 瘦削的；缺乏肌肉的；贫瘠的；瘦弱的；憔悴的。

definitions.definition: Very angry; frustrated or distraught.
definitions.example: The poor girl is going spare, stuck in the house all day with the kids like that.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常生气的；沮丧或心烦意乱的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那可怜的女孩快要疯了，整天被孩子们困在屋里。

definitions.definition: Slow.
definitions.definitionCn: 缓慢的。

definitions.definition: To show mercy.
To keep.
To give up To deprive oneself of, as by being frugal; to do without; to dispense with; to give up; to part with.
Any of various eight-legged, predatory arthropods, of the order Araneae, most of which spin webs to catch prey.
definitions.definitionCn: 八足捕食性节肢动物，属蛛形纲，多数会结网捕猎。

definitions.definition: A program which follows links on the World Wide Web in order to gather information.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种通过追踪万维网链接来收集信息的程序。

definitions.definition: A float (drink) made by mixing ice-cream and a soda or fizzy drink (such as lemonade).
definitions.example: 2002, Katharine Gasparini, Cranberry and vanilla ice cream spider, recipe in Cool Food, page 339.
definitions.definitionCn: 由冰淇淋与苏打水或汽水（如柠檬水）混合制成的浮饮。
definitions.exampleCn: 2002年，凯瑟琳·加斯帕里尼，《蔓越莓香草冰淇淋蜘蛛》，收录于《酷食》第339页。

definitions.definition: An alcoholic drink made with brandy and lemonade or ginger beer.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用白兰地与柠檬水或姜汁啤酒调制的酒精饮料。

definitions.definition: A spindly person.
definitions.definitionCn: 瘦长如蛛的人。

definitions.definition: A man who persistently approaches or accosts a woman in a public social setting, particularly in a bar.
definitions.definitionCn: 在公共社交场合（尤指酒吧）持续接近或搭讪女性的男子。

definitions.definition: A stick with a convex arch-shaped notched head used to support the cue when the cue ball is out of reach at normal extension; a bridge.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种带有凸拱形凹槽头的球杆架，用于在母球超出正常延伸范围时支撑球杆。

definitions.definition: A cast-iron frying pan with three legs, once common in open-hearth cookery.
definitions.definitionCn: 三足铸铁煎锅，曾广泛用于明火烹饪。

definitions.definition: Implement for moving food in and out of hot oil for deep frying, with a circular metal mesh attached to a long handle; a spider skimmer
definitions.definitionCn: 用于在油炸时从热油中取放食物的工具，带有长柄的圆形金属网；即蜘蛛漏勺。

definitions.definition: A part of a crank, to which the chainrings are attached.
definitions.definitionCn: 曲柄的一部分，用于安装齿盘。

definitions.definition: Heroin (street drug).
definitions.definitionCn: 海洛因（街头毒品）。

definitions.definition: Part of a resonator instrument that transmits string vibrations from the bridge to a resonator cone at multiple points.
definitions.definitionCn: 共鸣乐器中，将琴桥振动多点传递至共鸣锥的部件。

definitions.definition: A skeleton or frame with radiating arms or members, often connected by crosspieces, such as a casting forming the hub and spokes to which the rim of a fly wheel or large gear is bolted; the body of a piston head; or a frame for strengthening a core or mould for a casting.
definitions.definitionCn: 带有辐射状臂杆或构件的骨架或框架，常以横杆连接，如飞轮或大齿轮轮缘螺栓固定的轮毂与辐条铸件、活塞头主体，或用于加固铸造型芯或模具的框架。

definitions.definition: (fly fishing) a soft-hackle fly
definitions.definitionCn: （飞钓）一种软钩毛钩。

definitions.definition: The network of wires separating the areas of a dartboard
definitions.definitionCn: 分隔飞镖盘区域的金属丝网。

definitions.definition: A spider graph or spider tree
definitions.definitionCn: 蜘蛛图或蜘蛛树。

definitions.definition: A type of light phaeton.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种轻型四轮马车。

definitions.definition: To move like a spider.
definitions.definitionCn: 像蜘蛛一样移动。

definitions.definition: To cover a surface like a cobweb.
definitions.definitionCn: 像蛛网般覆盖表面。

definitions.definition: (of a computer program) To follow links on the World Wide Web in order to gather information.
definitions.example: The online dictionary is regularly spidered by search engines.
definitions.definitionCn: （计算机程序）通过追踪万维网链接来收集信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 在线词典会被搜索引擎定期爬取。

definitions.definition: A person or organisation with some sort of responsibility for another person or organisation, especially where the responsibility has a religious, legal, or financial aspect.
definitions.example: He was my sponsor when I applied to join the club.
definitions.definitionCn: 对他人或组织负有某种责任的人或组织，尤其是涉及宗教、法律或财务方面的责任。
definitions.exampleCn: 我申请加入俱乐部时，他是我的担保人。

definitions.definition: One that pays all or part of the cost of an event, a publication, or a media program, usually in exchange for advertising time.
definitions.example: And now a word from our sponsor.
definitions.definitionCn: 为活动、出版物或媒体节目支付全部或部分费用的一方，通常以换取广告时段为条件。
definitions.exampleCn: 接下来有请我们的赞助商发言。

definitions.definition: To be a sponsor for.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任……的赞助人。

definitions.definition: Ill will or hatred toward another, accompanied with the desire to irritate, annoy, or thwart; a want to disturb or put out another; mild malice
definitions.example: He was so filled with spite for his ex-wife, he could not hold down a job.
definitions.definitionCn: 对他人的恶意或仇恨，伴随想要激怒、烦扰或阻挠的欲望；一种想要打扰或使他人不安的念头；轻微的恶意
definitions.exampleCn: 他对前妻充满怨恨，以至于无法保住工作

definitions.definition: Vexation; chagrin; mortification.
definitions.definitionCn: 烦恼；懊恼；屈辱

definitions.definition: To treat maliciously; to try to injure or thwart.
definitions.example: She soon married again, to spite her ex-husband.
definitions.definitionCn: 恶意对待；试图伤害或阻挠
definitions.exampleCn: 她很快再婚，以此报复前夫

definitions.definition: To be angry at; to hate.
definitions.definitionCn: 对……生气；憎恨

definitions.definition: To fill with spite; to offend; to vex.
definitions.definitionCn: 使充满恶意；冒犯；使烦恼

definitions.definition: Notwithstanding; despite.
(Also in plural: spoils) Plunder taken from an enemy or victim.
definitions.definitionCn: （亦作复数：spoils）从敌人或受害者处夺取的战利品。

definitions.definition: Material (such as rock or earth) removed in the course of an excavation, or in mining or dredging. Tailings.
definitions.definitionCn: 挖掘、采矿或疏浚过程中移除的物质（如岩石或泥土）。尾矿。

definitions.definition: To strip (someone who has been killed or defeated) of their arms or armour.
definitions.definitionCn: 剥去（被杀或战败者）的武器或盔甲。

definitions.definition: To strip or deprive (someone) of their possessions; to rob, despoil.
definitions.definitionCn: 剥夺（某人）的财物；抢劫，掠夺。

definitions.definition: To plunder, pillage (a city, country etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 洗劫（城市、国家等）。

definitions.definition: To carry off (goods) by force; to steal.
definitions.definitionCn: 用武力夺走（货物）；偷窃。

definitions.definition: To ruin; to damage (something) in some way making it unfit for use.
definitions.definitionCn: 毁坏；以某种方式损坏（某物）使其无法使用。

definitions.definition: To ruin the character of, by overindulgence; to coddle or pamper to excess.
definitions.definitionCn: 因过度纵容而毁掉（某人的）性格；过分溺爱或娇惯。

definitions.definition: Of food, to become bad, sour or rancid; to decay.
definitions.example: Make sure you put the milk back in the fridge, otherwise it will spoil.
definitions.definitionCn: （食物）变质、发酸或腐坏；腐烂。
definitions.exampleCn: 确保你把牛奶放回冰箱，否则它会变质。

definitions.definition: To render (a ballot paper) invalid by deliberately defacing it.
definitions.definitionCn: 故意涂损（选票）使其无效。

definitions.definition: To reveal the ending or major events of (a story etc.); to ruin (a surprise) by exposing it ahead of time.
definitions.definitionCn: 提前透露（故事等的）结局或主要情节；提前曝光（惊喜）而破坏它。

definitions.definition: The soul of a person or other creature. What moves through experience into self-definition as souls purpose.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人或其他生灵的灵魂。那种通过经历走向自我定义、成为灵魂目的的东西。

definitions.definition: A supernatural being, often but not exclusively without physical form; ghost, fairy, angel.
definitions.example: A wandering spirit haunts the island.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种超自然存在，通常但不一定没有实体形态；鬼魂、精灵、天使。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个游荡的幽灵萦绕在岛上。

definitions.definition: Enthusiasm.
definitions.example: School spirit is at an all-time high.
definitions.definitionCn: 热情。
definitions.exampleCn: 校园精神空前高涨。

definitions.definition: The manner or style of something.
definitions.example: In the spirit of forgiveness, we didn't press charges.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物的方式或风格。
definitions.exampleCn: 本着宽恕的精神，我们没有提起诉讼。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) A volatile liquid, such as alcohol. The plural form spirits is a generic term for distilled alcoholic beverages.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）一种挥发性液体，如酒精。复数形式spirits是蒸馏酒精饮料的统称。

definitions.definition: Energy; ardour.
definitions.definitionCn: 精力；热情。

definitions.definition: One who is vivacious or lively; one who evinces great activity or peculiar characteristics of mind or temper.
definitions.example: a ruling spirit; a schismatic spirit
definitions.definitionCn: 一个活泼或充满活力的人；一个展现出极大活动力或独特心智或性情特征的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 主导精神；分裂精神。

definitions.definition: Temper or disposition of mind; mental condition or disposition; intellectual or moral state; often in the plural.
definitions.example: to be cheerful, or in good spirits; to be down-hearted, or in bad spirits
definitions.definitionCn: 心境或性情；心理状态或倾向；智力或道德状态；常用复数形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 心情愉快或情绪高涨；心情沮丧或情绪低落。

definitions.definition: Air set in motion by breathing; breath; hence, sometimes, life itself.
definitions.definitionCn: 呼吸时流动的空气；气息；因此，有时指生命本身。

definitions.definition: A rough breathing; an aspirate, such as the letter h; also, a mark denoting aspiration.
definitions.definitionCn: 粗送气音；送气音，如字母h；也指表示送气的符号。

definitions.definition: Intent; real meaning; opposed to the letter, or formal statement.
definitions.example: the spirit of an enterprise, or of a document
definitions.definitionCn: 意图；真实含义；与字面或正式表述相对。
definitions.exampleCn: 一项事业或一份文件的精神实质。

definitions.definition: Any of the four substances: sulphur, sal ammoniac, quicksilver, and arsenic (or, according to some, orpiment).
definitions.definitionCn: 四种物质之一：硫磺、氯化铵、水银和砷（或根据某些说法，雌黄）。

definitions.definition: (dyeing) Stannic chloride.
definitions.definitionCn: （染色）氯化锡。

definitions.definition: To carry off, especially in haste, secrecy, or mystery.
definitions.definitionCn: 匆忙、秘密或神秘地带走。

definitions.definition: To animate with vigor; to excite; to encourage; to inspirit; sometimes followed by up.
definitions.example: Civil dissensions often spirit the ambition of private men.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予活力；激发；鼓励；鼓舞；有时后接up。
definitions.exampleCn: 内乱常常激发个人的野心。

definitions.definition: The act of spreading.
definitions.definitionCn: 铺展的动作。

definitions.definition: Something that has been spread.
definitions.definitionCn: 被铺展开的东西。

definitions.definition: A layout, pattern or design of cards arranged for a reading.
definitions.definitionCn: 为占卜而排列的牌阵、图案或设计。

definitions.definition: An expanse of land.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片广阔的土地。

definitions.definition: A large tract of land used to raise livestock; a cattle ranch.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于饲养牲畜的大片土地；牧场。

definitions.definition: A piece of material used as a cover (such as a bedspread).
definitions.definitionCn: 用作覆盖物的材料（如床罩）。

definitions.definition: A large meal, especially one laid out on a table.
definitions.definitionCn: 丰盛的一餐，尤指摆放在桌上的大餐。

definitions.definition: (bread, etc.) Any form of food designed to be spread, such as butters or jams.
definitions.definitionCn: （面包等）任何设计成可涂抹的食品，如黄油或果酱。

definitions.definition: Food improvised by inmates from various ingredients to relieve the tedium of prison food.
definitions.definitionCn: 囚犯用各种食材临时制作的食物，以缓解监狱伙食的单调。

definitions.definition: An item in a newspaper or magazine that occupies more than one column or page.
definitions.definitionCn: 报纸或杂志中占据超过一栏或一页的条目。

definitions.definition: Two facing pages in a book, newspaper etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 书籍、报纸等中相对的两页。

definitions.definition: A numerical difference.
definitions.definitionCn: 数值差异。

definitions.definition: The difference between the wholesale and retail prices.
definitions.definitionCn: 批发价与零售价之间的差额。

definitions.definition: The difference between the price of a futures month and the price of another month of the same commodity.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一商品不同交割月份期货价格之间的差额。

definitions.definition: The purchase of a futures contract of one delivery month against the sale of another futures delivery month of the same commodity.
definitions.definitionCn: 买入某交割月份的期货合约，同时卖出同一商品另一交割月份的期货合约。

definitions.definition: The purchase of one delivery month of one commodity against the sale of that same delivery month of a different commodity.
definitions.definitionCn: 买入某商品某交割月份的合约，同时卖出不同商品同一交割月份的合约。

definitions.definition: An arbitrage transaction of the same commodity in two markets, executed to take advantage of a profit from price discrepancies.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一商品在两个市场间的套利交易，旨在利用价格差异获利。

definitions.definition: The difference between bidding and asking price.
definitions.definitionCn: 买价与卖价之间的差额。

definitions.definition: The difference between the prices of two similar items.
definitions.definitionCn: 两种相似物品价格之间的差额。

definitions.definition: An unlimited expanse of discontinuous points.
definitions.definitionCn: 无限延伸的不连续点集合。

definitions.definition: The surface in proportion to the depth of a cut gemstone.
definitions.definitionCn: 切割宝石表面与深度的比例。

definitions.definition: To stretch out, open out (a material etc.) so that it more fully covers a given area of space.
definitions.example: He spread his newspaper on the table.
definitions.definitionCn: 展开、摊开（材料等），使其更充分地覆盖给定空间区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将报纸摊开在桌上。

definitions.definition: To extend (individual rays, limbs etc.); to stretch out in varying or opposing directions.
definitions.example: I spread my arms wide and welcomed him home.
definitions.definitionCn: 伸展（单个肢体、射线等）；向不同或相反方向延伸。
definitions.exampleCn: 我张开双臂欢迎他回家。

definitions.definition: To disperse, to scatter or distribute over a given area.
definitions.example: I spread the rice grains evenly over the floor.
definitions.definitionCn: 分散、散布或分布到给定区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 我将米粒均匀地撒在地板上。

definitions.definition: To proliferate; to become more widely present, to be disseminated.
definitions.definitionCn: 扩散；更广泛地出现，被传播。

definitions.definition: To disseminate; to cause to proliferate, to make (something) widely known or present.
definitions.example: The missionaries quickly spread their new message across the country.
definitions.definitionCn: 传播；使扩散，使（某事物）广为人知或广泛存在。
definitions.exampleCn: 传教士迅速将他们的新教义传遍全国。

definitions.definition: To take up a larger area or space; to expand, be extended.
definitions.example: I dropped my glass; the water spread quickly over the tiled floor.
definitions.definitionCn: 占据更大面积或空间；扩展、延伸。
definitions.exampleCn: 我打碎了杯子；水迅速在瓷砖地面上蔓延开来。

definitions.definition: To smear, to distribute in a thin layer.
definitions.example: She liked to spread butter on her toast while it was still hot.
definitions.definitionCn: 涂抹，薄薄地分布一层。
definitions.exampleCn: 她喜欢在吐司还热时涂上黄油。

definitions.definition: To cover (something) with a thin layer of some substance, as of butter.
definitions.example: He always spreads his toast with peanut butter and strawberry jam.
definitions.definitionCn: 用某种物质（如黄油）薄薄地覆盖（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他总是用花生酱和草莓酱涂抹吐司。

definitions.definition: To prepare; to set and furnish with provisions.
definitions.example: to spread a table
definitions.definitionCn: 准备；布置并供应食物。
definitions.exampleCn: 摆好餐桌。

definitions.definition: To open one’s legs, especially for sexual favours.
definitions.definitionCn: 张开双腿，尤指为性行为。

definitions.definition: Rapid circular motion.
definitions.example: He put some spin on the cue ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速圆周运动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他给母球加了些旋转。

definitions.definition: A quantum angular momentum associated with subatomic particles, which also creates a magnetic moment.
definitions.definitionCn: 与亚原子粒子相关的量子角动量，也能产生磁矩。

definitions.definition: A favourable comment or interpretation intended to bias opinion on an otherwise unpleasant situation.
definitions.example: The politician was mocked in the press for his reliance on spin rather than facts.
definitions.definitionCn: 旨在影响对不愉快局面看法的有利评论或解释。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位政客因依赖粉饰而非事实而受到媒体嘲讽。

definitions.definition: Rotation of the ball as it flies through the air; sideways movement of the ball as it bounces.
definitions.definitionCn: 球在空中飞行时的旋转；弹跳时的侧向移动。

definitions.definition: A condition of flight where a stalled aircraft is simultaneously pitching, yawing and rolling in a spinning motion.
definitions.definitionCn: 失速飞机同时俯仰、偏航和滚转的螺旋飞行状态。

definitions.definition: A brief trip by vehicle, especially one made for pleasure.
definitions.example: I'm off out for a spin in my new sports car.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘车短途旅行，尤指为消遣的出行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我要开新跑车出去兜风。

definitions.definition: A bundle of spun material; a mass of strands and filaments.
definitions.definitionCn: 纺成的材料束；一束纤维和细丝。

definitions.definition: A single play of a record by a radio station.
definitions.definitionCn: 电台播放一张唱片的一次。

definitions.definition: A search of a prisoner's cell for forbidden articles.
definitions.definitionCn: 搜查囚犯牢房以寻找违禁品。

definitions.definition: Unmarried woman, spinster.
definitions.definitionCn: 未婚女子，老处女。

definitions.definition: The use of an exercise bicycle, especially as part of a gym class.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用健身自行车，尤指作为健身课程的一部分。

definitions.definition: To rotate, revolve, gyrate (usually quickly); to partially or completely rotate to face another direction.
definitions.example: I spun myself around a few times.
definitions.definitionCn: 旋转、转动、回旋（通常快速）；部分或完全转向另一方向。
definitions.exampleCn: 我转了几圈。

definitions.definition: To make yarn by twisting and winding fibers together.
definitions.example: They spin the cotton into thread.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过捻合纤维纺成纱线。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们把棉花纺成线。

definitions.definition: To present, describe, or interpret, or to introduce a bias or slant, so as to give something a favorable or advantageous appearance.
definitions.definitionCn: 呈现、描述或解释，或引入偏见，以使某事物显得有利或体面。

definitions.definition: (of a bowler) To make the ball move sideways when it bounces on the pitch.
definitions.definitionCn: （指投球手）使球在球场上弹跳时侧向移动。

definitions.definition: (of a ball) To move sideways when bouncing.
definitions.definitionCn: （指球）弹跳时侧向移动。

definitions.definition: To form into thin strips or ribbons, as with sugar
definitions.definitionCn: 形成薄条或带状，如糖丝。

definitions.definition: To form (a web, a cocoon, silk, etc.) from threads produced by the extrusion of a viscid, transparent liquid, which hardens on coming into contact with the air; said of the spider, the silkworm, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过挤出粘稠透明液体（接触空气后硬化）形成（网、茧、丝等）；指蜘蛛、蚕等。

definitions.definition: To shape, as malleable sheet metal, into a hollow form, by bending or buckling it by pressing against it with a smooth hand tool or roller while the metal revolves, as in a lathe.
definitions.definitionCn: 将可延展金属板压成空心形状，通过用光滑手工具或滚轮在金属旋转时弯曲或压皱，如在车床上。

definitions.definition: To move swiftly.
definitions.example: to spin along the road in a carriage, on a bicycle, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 乘马车、骑自行车等沿路疾驰。

definitions.definition: To stream or issue in a thread or a small current or jet.
definitions.example: Blood spins from a vein.
definitions.definitionCn: 以细流或小股喷射而出。
definitions.exampleCn: 血从静脉中喷出。

definitions.definition: To wait in a loop until some condition becomes true.
definitions.definitionCn: 在循环中等待直到某个条件成立。

definitions.definition: To play (vinyl records, etc.) as a disc jockey.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为唱片骑师播放（黑胶唱片等）。

definitions.definition: To use an exercise bicycle, especially as part of a gym class.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用健身自行车，尤指作为健身课程的一部分。

definitions.definition: An abnormal condition in journal bearings where the bearing seizes to the shaft that is rotating and rotates inside the journal, destroying both the shaft and the journal.
definitions.definitionCn: 滑动轴承的异常状态，轴承卡住旋转轴并在轴瓦内旋转，导致轴和轴瓦均损坏。

definitions.definition: A round or irregular patch on the surface of a thing having a different color, texture etc. and generally round in shape.
definitions.example: The leopard is noted for the spots of color in its fur.
definitions.definitionCn: 物体表面上的圆形或不规则斑块，颜色、质地等不同，通常呈圆形。
definitions.exampleCn: 豹因其皮毛上的彩色斑点而闻名。

definitions.definition: A stain or disfiguring mark.
definitions.example: I have tried everything, and I can’t get this spot out.
definitions.definitionCn: 污渍或毁容性印记。
definitions.exampleCn: 我试了所有方法，还是去不掉这个污点。

definitions.definition: A pimple, papule or pustule.
definitions.example: I think she's got chicken pox; she's covered in spots.
definitions.definitionCn: 丘疹、脓疱或疱疹。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想她得了水痘；她全身都是斑点。

definitions.definition: A small, unspecified amount or quantity.
definitions.example: Would you like to come round on Sunday for a spot of lunch?
definitions.definitionCn: 少量或不定量的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 你周日愿意过来吃顿便饭吗？

definitions.definition: A bill of five-dollar or ten-dollar denomination in dollars.
definitions.example: Here's the twenty bucks I owe you, a ten spot and two five spots.
definitions.definitionCn: 五美元或十美元面额的钞票。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是我欠你的二十美元，一张十元和两张五元。

definitions.definition: A location or area.
definitions.example: For our anniversary we went back to the same spot where we first met.
definitions.definitionCn: 地点或区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 纪念日那天，我们回到了初次相遇的地方。

definitions.definition: A parking space.
definitions.definitionCn: 停车位。

definitions.definition: An official determination of placement.
definitions.example: The fans were very unhappy with the referee's spot of the ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 官方对位置的判定。
definitions.exampleCn: 球迷们对裁判的球位判定非常不满。

definitions.definition: A bright lamp; a spotlight.
definitions.definitionCn: 明亮的灯；聚光灯。

definitions.definition: A brief advertisement or program segment on television.
definitions.example: Did you see the spot on the news about the shoelace factory?
definitions.definitionCn: 电视上的简短广告或节目片段。
definitions.exampleCn: 你看到新闻里关于鞋带厂的片段了吗？

definitions.definition: Difficult situation; predicament.
definitions.example: She was in a real spot when she ran into her separated husband while on a date.
definitions.definitionCn: 困境；窘境。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在约会时撞见分居的丈夫，真是陷入了窘境。

definitions.definition: One who spots (supports or assists a maneuver, or is prepared to assist if safety dictates); a spotter.
definitions.definitionCn: 负责保护或协助动作的人（或在安全需要时准备协助）；保护者。

definitions.definition: Penalty spot.
definitions.definitionCn: 罚球点。

definitions.definition: The act of spotting or noticing something.
definitions.example: - Whoops. Good spot.
definitions.definitionCn: 发现或注意到某事物的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: - 哎呀。好眼力。

definitions.definition: A variety of the common domestic pigeon, so called from a spot on its head just above the beak.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种常见的家鸽品种，因其喙上方头部有斑点而得名。

definitions.definition: A food fish (Leiostomus xanthurus) of the Atlantic coast of the United States, with a black spot behind the shoulders and fifteen oblique dark bars on the sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 美国大西洋沿岸的一种食用鱼（斑点叉尾鲷），肩后有黑斑，身侧有十五条斜向深色条纹。

definitions.definition: The southern redfish, or red horse (Sciaenops ocellatus), which has a spot on each side at the base of the tail.
definitions.definitionCn: 南方红鱼或红马鱼（眼斑拟石首鱼），尾基部两侧各有一个斑点。

definitions.definition: (in the plural, brokers' slang) Commodities, such as merchandise and cotton, sold for immediate delivery.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数，经纪人俚语）商品，如货物和棉花，现货出售。

definitions.definition: An autosoliton.
definitions.definitionCn: 自孤子。

definitions.definition: A decimal point; point.
definitions.example: Twelve spot two five pounds sterling. (ie. £12.25)
definitions.definitionCn: 小数点；点。
definitions.exampleCn: 十二点二五英镑（即12.25英镑）。

definitions.definition: Any of various points marked on the table, from which balls are played, in snooker, pool, billiards, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 斯诺克、普尔、台球等球台上标记的各种击球点。

definitions.definition: Any of the balls marked with spots in the game of pool, which one player aims to pot, the other player taking the stripes.
definitions.definitionCn: 普尔球中带斑点的球，一方瞄准击打，另一方则打条纹球。

definitions.definition: To see, find; to pick out, notice, locate, distinguish or identify.
definitions.example: Try to spot the differences between these two pictures.
definitions.definitionCn: 看见、找到；挑选、注意、定位、区分或识别。
definitions.exampleCn: 试着找出这两张图片的不同之处。

definitions.definition: To loan a small amount of money to someone.
definitions.example: I’ll spot you ten dollars for lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 借给某人少量钱。
definitions.exampleCn: 我借你十美元吃午饭。

definitions.definition: To stain; to leave a spot (on).
definitions.example: Hard water will spot if it is left on a surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 留下污渍；在表面留下斑点。
definitions.exampleCn: 硬水如果留在表面上会留下水渍。

definitions.definition: To remove, or attempt to remove, a stain.
definitions.example: I spotted the carpet where the child dropped spaghetti.
definitions.definitionCn: 去除或试图去除污渍。
definitions.exampleCn: 我清理了孩子掉意大利面的地毯。

definitions.definition: To retouch a photograph on film to remove minor flaws.
definitions.definitionCn: 修整胶片上的照片以去除微小瑕疵。

definitions.definition: To support or assist a maneuver, or to be prepared to assist if safety dictates.
definitions.example: I can’t do a back handspring unless somebody spots me.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持或协助动作，或在安全需要时准备协助。
definitions.exampleCn: 除非有人保护，否则我做不出后手翻。

definitions.definition: To keep the head and eyes pointing in a single direction while turning.
definitions.example: Most figure skaters do not spot their turns like dancers do.
definitions.definitionCn: 转身时保持头部和眼睛指向单一方向。
definitions.exampleCn: 大多数花样滑冰选手不像舞者那样定点转身。

definitions.definition: To stain; to blemish; to taint; to disgrace; to tarnish, as reputation.
definitions.definitionCn: 玷污；损害；败坏；使名誉受损。

definitions.definition: To cut or chip (timber) in preparation for hewing.
definitions.definitionCn: 在准备砍伐前切割或削凿（木材）。

definitions.definition: To place an object at a location indicated by a spot. Notably in billiards or snooker.
definitions.example: The referee had to spot the pink on the blue spot.
definitions.definitionCn: 将物体放置在斑点指示的位置，尤指台球或斯诺克中。
definitions.exampleCn: 裁判必须把粉球放在蓝球点上。

definitions.definition: Available on the spot; for immediate payment or delivery.
definitions.example: spot wheat; spot cash; a spot contract
definitions.definitionCn: 现货供应；立即付款或交货。
definitions.exampleCn: 现货小麦；现货现金；现货合同。

definitions.definition: A crack or longitudinal fissure.
definitions.definitionCn: 裂缝或纵向裂隙。

definitions.definition: A breach or separation, as in a political party; a division.
definitions.definitionCn: （如政党内部的）分裂或分离；分歧。

definitions.definition: A piece that is split off, or made thin, by splitting; a splinter; a fragment.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过劈裂而分离出的薄片；碎片；碎块。

definitions.definition: (leather manufacture) One of the sections of a skin made by dividing it into two or more thicknesses.
definitions.definitionCn: （皮革制造）将一张皮分割成两层或多层中的一层。

definitions.definition: (cheerleading, usually in the phrase "to do the splits") A maneuver of spreading or sliding the feet apart until the legs are flat on the floor 180 degrees apart, either sideways to the body or with one leg in front and one behind, thus lowering the body completely to the floor in an upright position.
definitions.definitionCn: （啦啦队，通常用于短语“做劈叉”）一种将双脚分开或滑开直至双腿平贴地面、呈180度分开的动作，可侧向身体或一前一后，从而直立姿势下将身体完全降至地面。

definitions.definition: A workout routine as seen by its distribution of muscle groups or the extent and manner they are targetted in a microcycle.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据肌肉群分布或微周期中针对程度和方式所见的训练计划。

definitions.definition: A split-finger fastball.
definitions.example: He’s got a nasty split.
definitions.definitionCn: 指叉球。
definitions.exampleCn: 他有个严重的裂口。

definitions.definition: A result of a first throw that leaves two or more pins standing with one or more pins between them knocked down.
definitions.definitionCn: 第一次投球后留下两个或更多球瓶，且它们之间有一个或多个球瓶被击倒的结果。

definitions.definition: A split shot or split stroke.
definitions.definitionCn: 分球击法或分球击球。

definitions.definition: A dessert or confection resembling a banana split.
definitions.definitionCn: 类似香蕉船甜点的甜品或糖果。

definitions.definition: A unit of measure used for champagne or other spirits: 18.75 centiliters or one quarter of a standard 75-centiliter bottle. Commercially comparable to 1/20 gallon, which is 1/2 of a fifth.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于香槟或其他烈酒的计量单位：18.75厘升，或标准75厘升瓶的四分之一。商业上相当于1/20加仑，即五分之一加仑的一半。

definitions.definition: A bottle of wine containing 37.5 centiliters, half the volume of a standard 75-centiliter bottle; a demi.
definitions.definitionCn: 容量为37.5厘升的葡萄酒瓶，为标准75厘升瓶的一半；半瓶装。

definitions.definition: The elapsed time at specific intermediate points in a race.
definitions.example: In the 3000 m race, his 800 m split was 1:45.32
definitions.definitionCn: 比赛中特定中间点的经过时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 在3000米比赛中，他的800米分段用时为1分45秒32。

definitions.definition: The elapsed time at specific intermediate points in a speedrun.
definitions.definitionCn: 速通中特定中间点的经过时间。

definitions.definition: A tear resulting from tensile stresses.
definitions.definitionCn: 由拉伸应力引起的撕裂。

definitions.definition: A division of a stake happening when two cards of the kind on which the stake is laid are dealt in the same turn.
definitions.definitionCn: 当同一轮中发出两张与赌注相同的牌时，赌注的分割。

definitions.definition: A recording containing songs by multiple artists.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含多位艺术家歌曲的录音。

definitions.definition: Of something solid, to divide fully or partly along a more or less straight line.
definitions.example: He has split his lip.
definitions.definitionCn: 对于固体物质，沿大致直线完全或部分分裂。
definitions.exampleCn: 他嘴唇裂开了。

definitions.definition: Of something solid, particularly wood, to break along the grain fully or partly along a more or less straight line.
definitions.definitionCn: 对于固体物质，特别是木材，沿纹理大致直线完全或部分裂开。

definitions.definition: To share; to divide.
definitions.example: We split the money among three people.
definitions.definitionCn: 分享；分配。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们把钱分给了三个人。

definitions.definition: To leave.
definitions.example: Let's split this scene and see if we can find a real party.
definitions.definitionCn: 离开。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们离开这个场景，看看能不能找到真正的派对。

definitions.definition: (of a couple) To separate.
definitions.example: Did you hear Dick and Jane split? They'll probably get a divorce.
definitions.definitionCn: （情侣）分手。
definitions.exampleCn: 你听说迪克和简分手了吗？他们可能会离婚。

definitions.definition: To (cause to) break up; to throw into discord.
definitions.example: Accusations of bribery split the party just before the election.
definitions.definitionCn: （使）破裂；引起不和。
definitions.exampleCn: 选举前，贿赂指控使该党分裂。

definitions.definition: (acts on a polynomial) To factor into linear factors.
definitions.definitionCn: （作用于多项式）分解为线性因子。

definitions.definition: To be broken; to be dashed to pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: 被打破；摔成碎片。

definitions.definition: To burst out laughing.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然大笑。

definitions.definition: To divulge a secret; to betray confidence; to peach.
definitions.definitionCn: 泄露秘密；背叛信任；告密。

definitions.definition: In athletics (especially baseball), for both teams involved in a doubleheader to win one game each and lose another game.
definitions.example: Boston split with Philadelphia in a doubleheader, winning the first game 3-1 before losing 2-0 in the nightcap.
definitions.definitionCn: 在体育（尤其是棒球）中，指双赛的两队各赢一场、各输一场。
definitions.exampleCn: 波士顿在双赛中与费城平分秋色，第一场3-1获胜，第二场0-2失利。

definitions.definition: To vote for candidates of opposite parties.
definitions.definitionCn: 投票给对立政党的候选人。

definitions.definition: Divided.
definitions.example: Republicans appear split on the centerpiece of Mr. Obama's economic recovery plan.
definitions.definitionCn: 分裂的。
definitions.exampleCn: 共和党人在奥巴马经济复苏计划的核心问题上似乎存在分歧。

definitions.definition: (of a short exact sequence) Having the middle group equal to the direct product of the others.
definitions.definitionCn: （关于短正合序列）中间群等于其他群的直积。

definitions.definition: (of coffee) Comprising half decaffeinated and half caffeinated espresso.
definitions.definitionCn: （关于咖啡）由一半低因咖啡和一半含因浓缩咖啡组成。

definitions.definition: (of an order, sale, etc.) Divided so as to be done or executed part at one time or price and part at another time or price.
definitions.definitionCn: （关于订单、销售等）分次或分价执行。

definitions.definition: (of quotations) Given in sixteenths rather than eighths.
definitions.definitionCn: （关于报价）以十六分之一而非八分之一给出。

definitions.definition: (London stock exchange) Designating ordinary stock that has been divided into preferred ordinary and deferred ordinary.
definitions.definitionCn: （伦敦证券交易所）指已分为优先普通股和递延普通股的普通股。

definitions.definition: A polygon with four sides of equal length and four right angles; an equilateral rectangle; a regular quadrilateral.
definitions.definitionCn: 四条边等长且四个角均为直角的四边形；等边矩形；正四边形。

definitions.definition: Something characterized by a square, or nearly square, form.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有正方形或近似正方形特征的事物。

definitions.definition: An L- or T-shaped tool used to place objects or draw lines at right angles.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于放置物体或绘制直角线的L形或T形工具。

definitions.definition: An open space or park, often in the center of a town, not necessarily square in shape, often containing trees, seating and other features pleasing to the eye.

definitions.definition: A unit of measurement of area, equal to a 10 foot by 10 foot square, i.e. 100 square feet or roughly 9.3 square metres. Used in real estate for the size of a house or its rooms, though progressively being replaced by square metres in metric countries such as Australia.

definitions.definition: (roofing) A unit used in measuring roof area equivalent to 100 square feet (9.29 m2) of roof area.

definitions.definition: A square meal.

definitions.definition: The relation of harmony, or exact agreement; equality; level.
