definitions.definition: The act of knocking down all ten pins in on the first roll of a frame.
definitions.definitionCn: 在一局中第一次投球即击倒全部十根球瓶的行为。

definitions.definition: A work stoppage (or otherwise concerted stoppage of an activity) as a form of protest.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为抗议形式的工作停止（或其他有组织的活动停止）。

definitions.definition: A blow or application of physical force against something.
definitions.example: Thus hand strikes now include single knuckle strikes, knife hand strikes, finger strikes, ridge hand strikes etc., and leg strikes include front kicks, knee strikes, axe kicks, ...
definitions.definitionCn: 对某物施加的打击或物理力量。
definitions.exampleCn: 因此手部打击现在包括单指关节打击、手刀打击、指击、掌脊打击等，腿部打击包括前踢、膝击、斧踢等。

definitions.definition: In an option contract, the price at which the holder buys or sells if they choose to exercise the option.
definitions.definitionCn: 在期权合约中，持有人选择行权时买入或卖出的价格。

definitions.definition: An old English measure of corn equal to the bushel.
definitions.definitionCn: 古英国谷物计量单位，等于一蒲式耳。

definitions.definition: The status of being the batsman that the bowler is bowling at.
definitions.example: The batsmen have crossed, and Dhoni now has the strike.
definitions.definitionCn: 投手正在向其投球的击球员的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 击球员已交换位置，现在轮到多尼击球。

definitions.definition: The primary face of a hammer, opposite the peen.
definitions.definitionCn: 锤子的主要工作面，与锤头相对。

definitions.definition: The compass direction of the line of intersection between a rock layer and the surface of the Earth.
definitions.definitionCn: 岩层与地球表面交线的罗盘方向。

definitions.definition: An instrument with a straight edge for levelling a measure of grain, salt, etc., scraping off what is above the level of the top; a strickle.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于刮平谷物、盐等计量物表面多余部分的直边工具；刮板。

definitions.definition: Fullness of measure; hence, excellence of quality.
definitions.definitionCn: 足量；引申为品质卓越。

definitions.definition: An iron pale or standard in a gate or fence.
definitions.definitionCn: 门或栅栏中的铁柱或标准件。

definitions.definition: (ironworking) A puddler's stirrer.
definitions.definitionCn: （铁工）炼铁工的搅拌器。

definitions.definition: The extortion of money, or the attempt to extort money, by threat of injury; blackmail.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过伤害威胁勒索金钱或企图勒索金钱的行为；敲诈。

definitions.definition: The discovery of a source of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 发现某物的来源。

definitions.definition: The strike plate of a door.
definitions.definitionCn: 门的锁舌片。

definitions.definition: (sometimes with out or through) To delete or cross out; to scratch or eliminate.
definitions.example: Please strike the last sentence.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时与out或through连用）删除或划掉；擦除或消除。
definitions.exampleCn: 请删除最后一句。

definitions.definition: (physical) To have a sharp or sudden effect.
definitions.definitionCn: （物理）产生尖锐或突然的效果。

definitions.definition: To thrust in; to cause to enter or penetrate.
definitions.example: A tree strikes its roots deep.
definitions.definitionCn: 刺入；使进入或穿透。
definitions.exampleCn: 树根扎得很深。

definitions.definition: (personal, social) To have a sharp or severe effect.
definitions.definitionCn: （个人、社会）产生尖锐或严重的影响。

definitions.definition: To touch; to act by appulse.
definitions.definitionCn: 接触；通过冲击起作用。

definitions.definition: To take down, especially in the following contexts.
definitions.definitionCn: 取下，尤其在以下语境中。

definitions.definition: To set off on a walk or trip.
definitions.example: They struck off along the river.
definitions.definitionCn: 出发步行或旅行。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们沿着河出发了。

definitions.definition: To pass with a quick or strong effect; to dart; to penetrate.
definitions.definitionCn: 以快速或强烈的效果通过；猛冲；穿透。

definitions.definition: To break forth; to commence suddenly; with into.
definitions.example: to strike into reputation;  to strike into a run
definitions.definitionCn: 突然爆发；突然开始；与into连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 突然获得声誉；突然开始奔跑

definitions.definition: To become attached to something; said of the spat of oysters.
definitions.definitionCn: 附着在某物上；指牡蛎的附着。

definitions.definition: To make and ratify.
definitions.example: to strike a bargain
definitions.definitionCn: 达成并批准。
definitions.exampleCn: 达成交易

definitions.definition: To level (a measure of grain, salt, etc.) with a straight instrument, scraping off what is above the level of the top.
definitions.definitionCn: 用直尺刮平（谷物、盐等计量物）表面多余部分。

definitions.definition: To cut off (a mortar joint, etc.) even with the face of the wall, or inward at a slight angle.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（灰缝等）切平至墙面齐平，或向内微斜。

definitions.definition: To hit upon, or light upon, suddenly.
definitions.example: My eye struck a strange word in the text.  They soon struck the trail.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然发现或偶然遇到。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的眼睛在文本中突然看到一个奇怪的词。他们很快找到了踪迹。

definitions.definition: (sugar-making) To lade thickened sugar cane juice from a teache into a cooler.
definitions.definitionCn: （制糖）将浓缩的甘蔗汁从加热槽舀入冷却器。

definitions.definition: To stroke or pass lightly; to wave.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻抚或轻拍；挥动。

definitions.definition: To advance; to cause to go forward; used only in the past participle.
definitions.definitionCn: 前进；使向前移动；仅用于过去分词。

definitions.definition: To balance (a ledger or account).
definitions.definitionCn: 平衡（分类账或账户）。

definitions.definition: A building, wing or dependency set apart and adapted for lodging and feeding (and training) animals with hoofs, especially horses.
definitions.example: There were stalls for fourteen horses in the squire's stables.
definitions.definitionCn: 一栋建筑、侧翼或附属建筑，专门用于安置、喂养（和训练）有蹄动物，尤其是马匹。
definitions.exampleCn: 乡绅的马厩里有十四个马位。

definitions.definition: (metonymy) All the racehorses of a particular stable, i.e. belonging to a given owner.
definitions.definitionCn: （转喻）指特定马厩中所有赛马，即属于同一主人的马匹。

definitions.definition: A set of advocates; a barristers' chambers.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群辩护律师；律师办公室。

definitions.definition: An organization of sumo wrestlers who live and train together.
definitions.definitionCn: 相扑力士共同生活和训练的团体。

definitions.definition: A group of prostitutes managed by one pimp.
definitions.definitionCn: 由一名皮条客管理的一群妓女。

definitions.definition: A long, thin and flexible structure made from threads twisted together.
definitions.definitionCn: 由线捻合而成的细长柔软结构。

definitions.definition: Such a structure considered as a substance.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为一种物质的此类结构。

definitions.definition: Any similar long, thin and flexible object.
definitions.example: a bowstring
definitions.definitionCn: 任何类似的细长柔软物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 弓弦

definitions.definition: A thread or cord on which a number of objects or parts are strung or arranged in close and orderly succession; hence, a line or series of things arranged on a thread, or as if so arranged.
definitions.example: a string of sausages
definitions.definitionCn: 一根线或绳，上面串着许多物体或部件，排列紧密有序；因此，指一串或一系列串在线上的东西，或看似如此排列的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 一串香肠

definitions.definition: A cohesive substance taking the form of a string.
definitions.example: The string of spittle dangling from his chin was most unattractive
definitions.definitionCn: 呈线状的黏性物质。
definitions.exampleCn: 他下巴上垂下的口水线极不雅观。

definitions.definition: A series of items or events.
definitions.example: a string of successes
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列项目或事件。
definitions.exampleCn: 一连串成功

definitions.definition: The members of a sports team or squad regarded as most likely to achieve success. (Perhaps metaphorical as the "strings" that hold the squad together.) Often first string, second string etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为最有可能取得成功的运动队或小队成员。（可能比喻为将队伍凝聚在一起的“绳索”。）常指第一阵容、第二阵容等。

definitions.definition: In various games and competitions, a certain number of turns at play, of rounds, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 在各种游戏和比赛中，指一定轮次的回合等。

definitions.definition: A drove of horses, or a group of racehorses kept by one owner or at one stable.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群马，或由同一主人或同一马厩饲养的一组赛马。

definitions.definition: An ordered sequence of text characters stored consecutively in memory and capable of being processed as a single entity.
definitions.definitionCn: 按顺序存储在内存中、可作为单一实体处理的文本字符序列。

definitions.definition: A stringed instrument.
definitions.definitionCn: 弦乐器。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) The stringed instruments as a section of an orchestra, especially those played by a bow, or the persons playing those instruments.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）管弦乐队中的弦乐器部分，尤指用弓演奏的乐器，或演奏这些乐器的人。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The conditions and limitations in a contract collectively.
definitions.example: no strings attached
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）合同中的条件和限制的总称。
definitions.exampleCn: 无附加条件

definitions.definition: The main object of study in string theory, a branch of theoretical physics.
definitions.definitionCn: 弦理论（理论物理学分支）的主要研究对象。

definitions.definition: Cannabis or marijuana.
definitions.definitionCn: 大麻或 marijuana。

definitions.definition: Part of the game of billiards, where the order of the play is determined by testing who can get a ball closest to the bottom rail by shooting it onto the end rail.
definitions.definitionCn: 台球游戏的一部分，通过测试谁能将球击向底边最近来确定比赛顺序。

definitions.definition: The buttons strung on a wire by which the score is kept.
definitions.definitionCn: 串在金属线上用于计分的按钮。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The points made in a game of billiards.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申）台球比赛中获得的分数。

definitions.definition: The line from behind and over which the cue ball must be played after being out of play, as by being pocketed or knocked off the table; also called the string line.
definitions.definitionCn: 母球出界（如落袋或被打落台面）后必须从其后和上方击打的线；也称为弦线。

definitions.definition: A strip, as of leather, by which the covers of a book are held together.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条（如皮革）带子，用于固定书籍的封面。

definitions.definition: A fibre, as of a plant; a little fibrous root.
definitions.definitionCn: 植物的纤维；细小的根须。

definitions.definition: A nerve or tendon of an animal body.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物体内的神经或肌腱。

definitions.definition: An inside range of ceiling planks, corresponding to the sheer strake on the outside and bolted to it.
definitions.definitionCn: 天花板木板的内侧范围，对应外侧的舷弧板并用螺栓固定。

definitions.definition: The tough fibrous substance that unites the valves of the pericarp of leguminous plants.
definitions.example: the strings of beans
definitions.definitionCn: 连接豆科植物果皮瓣的坚韧纤维物质。
definitions.exampleCn: 豆荚的筋

definitions.definition: A small, filamentous ramification of a metallic vein.
definitions.definitionCn: 金属矿脉的细小丝状分支。

definitions.definition: A stringcourse.
definitions.definitionCn: 腰线（建筑装饰线）。

definitions.definition: A hoax; a fake story.
definitions.definitionCn: 骗局；虚假故事。

definitions.definition: To put (items) on a string.
definitions.example: You can string these beads on to this cord to make a colorful necklace.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（物品）串在线上。
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以把这些珠子串在这根线上，做成一条彩色项链。

definitions.definition: To put strings on (something).
definitions.example: It is difficult to string a tennis racket properly.
definitions.definitionCn: 给（某物）装上弦。
definitions.exampleCn: 正确给网球拍穿弦很困难。

definitions.definition: To form into a string or strings, as a substance which is stretched, or people who are moving along, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（如拉伸的物质或行进中的人等）形成一串或一列。

definitions.definition: To drive the ball against the end of the table and back, in order to determine which player is to open the game.
definitions.definitionCn: 将球击向球桌末端并弹回，以决定哪位选手开球。

definitions.definition: To deliberately state that a certain bird is present when it is not; to knowingly mislead other birders about the occurrence of a bird, especially a rarity; to misidentify a common bird as a rare species.
definitions.definitionCn: 故意声称某种鸟存在而实际没有；明知故犯地误导其他观鸟者关于鸟类的出现（尤其是稀有鸟类）；将常见鸟类误认为稀有物种。

definitions.definition: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.
definitions.example: He's subject to sneezing fits.
definitions.definitionCn: 可能受某事影响或经历某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 他容易打喷嚏。

definitions.definition: Conditional upon.
definitions.example: The local board sets local policy, subject to approval from the State Board.
definitions.definitionCn: 取决于。
definitions.exampleCn: 地方委员会制定地方政策，但须经州委员会批准。

definitions.definition: Placed or situated under; lying below, or in a lower situation.
definitions.definitionCn: 置于下方；位于较低位置。

definitions.definition: Placed under the power of another; owing allegiance to a particular sovereign or state.
definitions.definitionCn: 受他人权力支配；效忠于特定君主或国家。

definitions.definition: (grammar) In a clause: the word or word group (usually a noun phrase) that is dealt with. In active clauses with verbs denoting an action, the subject and the actor are usually the same.
definitions.example: In the sentence ‘The mouse is eaten by the cat in the kitchen.’, ‘The mouse’ is the subject, ‘the cat’ being the agent.

definitions.definition: An actor; one who takes action.
definitions.example: The subjects and objects of power.

definitions.definition: The main topic of a paper, work of art, discussion, field of study, etc.
A particular area of study.
definitions.example: Her favorite subject is physics.

definitions.definition: A citizen in a monarchy.
definitions.example: I am a British subject.

definitions.definition: A person ruled over by another, especially a monarch or state authority.
The main theme or melody, especially in a fugue.
A human, animal or an inanimate object that is being examined, treated, analysed, etc.
A being that has subjective experiences, subjective consciousness, or a relationship with another entity.
That of which something is stated.
The variable in terms of which an expression is defined.
definitions.example: Making x the subject of x2 − 6x + 3y = 0, we have x = 3 ± √(9 − 3y).

definitions.definition: (construed with to) To cause (someone or something) to undergo a particular experience, especially one that is unpleasant or unwanted.
definitions.example: I came here to buy souvenirs, not to be subjected to a tirade of abuse!

definitions.definition: To make subordinate or subservient; to subdue or enslave.
Following in time; coming or being after something else at any time, indefinitely.
definitions.example: Growth was dampened by a softening of the global economy in 2001, but picked up in the subsequent years due to strong growth in China.
definitions.definitionCn: 随时间推移；在任何时间紧随或发生于某事之后，无明确期限。
definitions.exampleCn: 2001年全球经济疲软抑制了增长，但随后几年因中国强劲增长而回升。

definitions.definition: Following in order of place; succeeding.
definitions.definitionCn: 按空间顺序排列；后续的。

definitions.definition: To yield or give way to another.
definitions.example: They will not submit to the destruction of their rights.
definitions.definitionCn: 屈服或让步于他人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们不会屈服于自身权利被摧毁。

definitions.definition: To yield (something) to another, as when defeated.
definitions.definitionCn: （战败时）向他人交出（某物）。

definitions.definition: To enter or put forward for approval, consideration, marking etc.
definitions.example: I submit these plans for your approval.
definitions.definitionCn: 提交以供批准、考虑、评分等。
definitions.exampleCn: 我提交这些计划供您审批。

definitions.definition: To subject; to put through a process.
definitions.definitionCn: 使服从；使经历某个过程。

definitions.definition: (mixed martial arts) To win a fight against (an opponent) by submission.
definitions.definitionCn: （综合格斗）通过降服击败（对手）。

definitions.definition: To let down; to lower.
definitions.definitionCn: 放下；降低。

definitions.definition: To put or place under.
definitions.definitionCn: 置于下方。

definitions.definition: Physical matter; material.
definitions.definitionCn: 物质；材料。

definitions.definition: The essential part of anything; the most vital part.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何事物的本质部分；最关键的部分。

definitions.definition: Substantiality; solidity; firmness.
definitions.example: Some textile fabrics have little substance.
definitions.definitionCn: 实质性；坚固性；牢固性。
definitions.exampleCn: 某些纺织面料缺乏实质感。

definitions.definition: Material possessions; estate; property; resources.
definitions.example: a man of substance
definitions.definitionCn: 物质财富；地产；财产；资源。
definitions.exampleCn: 有资产的人

definitions.definition: A form of matter that has constant chemical composition and characteristic properties.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有恒定化学成分和特性的一种物质形式。

definitions.definition: Drugs (illegal narcotics)
definitions.example: substance abuse
definitions.definitionCn: 毒品（非法麻醉品）
definitions.exampleCn: 药物滥用

definitions.definition: Hypostasis.
definitions.definitionCn: 本质。

definitions.definition: To give substance to; to make real or substantial.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予实质；使成为真实或实在。

definitions.definition: A cohesive whole built up of distinct parts.
definitions.example: The birds had built an amazing structure out of sticks and various discarded items.
definitions.definitionCn: 由不同部分构成的有机整体。
definitions.exampleCn: 鸟儿用树枝和各种废弃物品搭建了一个惊人的结构。

definitions.definition: The underlying shape of a solid.
definitions.example: He studied the structure of her face.
definitions.definitionCn: 固体的基本形状。
definitions.exampleCn: 他研究了她面部的结构。

definitions.definition: The overall form or organization of something.
definitions.example: The structure of a sentence.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的整体形式或组织。
definitions.exampleCn: 句子的结构。

definitions.definition: A set of rules defining behaviour.
definitions.example: For some, the structure of school life was oppressive.
definitions.definitionCn: 一套定义行为规范的规则。
definitions.exampleCn: 对一些人来说，学校生活的结构令人压抑。

definitions.definition: Several pieces of data treated as a unit.
definitions.example: This structure contains both date and timezone information.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为整体处理的若干数据项。
definitions.exampleCn: 此结构包含日期和时区信息。

definitions.definition: Underwater terrain or objects (such as a dead tree or a submerged car) that tend to attract fish
definitions.example: There's lots of structure to be fished along the west shore of the lake; the impoundment submerged a town there when it was built.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸引鱼类的水下地形或物体（如枯树或沉没的汽车）
definitions.exampleCn: 湖的西岸有很多结构可供垂钓；水库建造时淹没了一个小镇。

definitions.definition: A body, such as a political party, with a cohesive purpose or outlook.
definitions.example: The South African leader went off to consult with the structures.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有共同目标或愿景的团体（如政党）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位南非领导人前去与各组织协商。

definitions.definition: A set along with a collection of finitary functions and relations.
definitions.definitionCn: 带有有限函数和关系的集合。

definitions.definition: To give structure to; to arrange.
definitions.example: I'm trying to structure my time better so I'm not always late.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予结构；进行安排。
definitions.exampleCn: 我正在努力更好地安排时间，这样就不会总是迟到了。

definitions.definition: A long, relatively straight region of a single colour.
definitions.example: zebra stripes
definitions.definitionCn: 单一颜色的长条相对笔直区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 斑马条纹

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The badge worn by certain officers in the military or other forces.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）某些军事或其他部队中特定军官佩戴的徽章。

definitions.definition: Distinguishing characteristic; sign; likeness; sort.
definitions.example: persons of the same political stripe
definitions.definitionCn: 区分特征；标志；相似性；种类。
definitions.exampleCn: 同一政治倾向的人

definitions.definition: A long, narrow mark left by striking someone with a whip or stick; a blow with a whip or stick.
definitions.definitionCn: 用鞭子或棍棒击打某人留下的细长痕迹；鞭打或棍击。

definitions.definition: A pattern produced by arranging the warp threads in sets of alternating colours, or in sets presenting some other contrast of appearance.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过将经线按交替颜色或呈现其他外观对比的组排列产生的图案。

definitions.definition: Any of the balls marked with stripes in the game of pool, which one player aims to pot, the other player taking the spots.
definitions.definitionCn: 台球游戏中标记有条纹的球，一名玩家瞄准击入袋中，另一名玩家则处理点球。

definitions.definition: A portion of data distributed across several separate physical disks for the sake of redundancy.
definitions.definitionCn: 为冗余目的分布在多个独立物理磁盘上的数据片段。

definitions.definition: To mark with stripes.
definitions.definitionCn: 用条纹标记。

definitions.definition: To lash with a whip or strap.
definitions.definitionCn: 用鞭子或皮带抽打。

definitions.definition: To distribute data across several separate physical disks to reduce the time to read and write.
definitions.definitionCn: 将数据分布在多个独立物理磁盘上以减少读写时间。

definitions.definition: A replacement or stand-in for something that achieves a similar result or purpose.
definitions.definitionCn: 替代或临时替代某物，以达到相似结果或目的的人或物。

definitions.definition: A player who is available to replace another if the need arises, and who may or may not actually do so.
definitions.definitionCn: 在需要时能够替换他人的球员，实际替换与否不确定。

definitions.definition: One who enlists for military service in the place of a conscript.
definitions.definitionCn: 代替应征者入伍服役的人。

definitions.definition: To use in place of something else, with the same function.
definitions.example: I had no shallots so I substituted onion.
definitions.definitionCn: 用其他具有相同功能的事物替代。
definitions.exampleCn: 我没有青葱，所以用了洋葱代替。

definitions.definition: (in the phrase "substitute X for Y") To use X in place of Y.
definitions.example: I had to substitute new parts for the old ones.
definitions.definitionCn: （在短语“用X替代Y”中）用X代替Y。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不得不用新零件替换旧零件。

definitions.definition: (in the phrase "substitute X with/by Y") To use Y in place of X; to replace X with Y.
definitions.example: I had to substitute old parts with the new ones.
definitions.definitionCn: （在短语“用Y替换X”中）用Y代替X；用Y替换X。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不得不用新零件替换旧零件。

definitions.definition: To remove (a player) from the field of play and bring on another in his place.
definitions.example: He was playing poorly and was substituted after twenty minutes
definitions.definitionCn: 将（一名球员）从场上换下，并让另一名球员上场。

definitions.definition: To serve as a replacement (for someone or something).

definitions.definition: A good that a consumer perceives as similar to another good, which decreases the demand for that other good
definitions.definitionCn: 消费者认为与另一种商品相似的商品，会降低对另一种商品的需求。

definitions.definition: An act of stroking (moving one's hand over a surface).

definitions.definitionCn: 抚摸（用手在表面移动的动作）。

definitions.definition: A blow or hit.

definitions.definition: A single movement with a tool.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用工具的一次单一动作。

definitions.definition: One of a series of beats or movements against a resisting medium, by means of which movement through or upon it is accomplished.

definitions.definition: A powerful or sudden effort by which something is done, produced, or accomplished; also, something done or accomplished by such an effort.

definitions.definition: A line drawn with a pen or other writing implement, particularly:

definitions.definition: A style, a single movement within a style.

definitions.definitionCn: 一种泳姿，泳姿中的单一动作。

definitions.definition: The oar nearest the stern of a boat, by which the other oars are guided.

definitions.definition: The rower who is nearest the stern of the boat.

definitions.definition: Backstage influence.

definitions.definition: An individual discharge of lightning.

definitions.definition: The result or effect of a striking; injury or affliction; soreness.

definitions.definition: An addition or amendment to a written composition; a touch.

definitions.definition: To move one's hand or an object (such as a broom) along (a surface) in one direction.

definitions.definition: Abstract substance or character.

definitions.definition: To load goods into (a container) for transport.
definitions.definitionCn: 将货物装入（容器）以便运输。

definitions.definition: (used in the passive) To sate.
definitions.example: I’m stuffed after having eaten all that turkey, mashed potatoes and delicious stuffing.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于被动语态）使饱足。

definitions.definition: (pronominal) To eat, especially in a hearty or greedy manner.

definitions.definitionCn: （反身代词）大吃，尤其是尽情或贪婪地吃。

definitions.definition: To preserve a dead bird or other animal by filling its skin.

definitions.definition: To form or fashion by packing with the necessary material.

definitions.definition: To crowd with facts; to cram the mind of; sometimes, to crowd or fill with false or idle tales or fancies.

definitions.definitionCn: 一片无垠的广阔。

definitions.definition: To wander; to roam; to stray.
definitions.definitionCn: 漫游；闲逛；迷失。

definitions.definition: To become vague or act in a vague manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得模糊或以模糊的方式行动。

definitions.definition: Not clearly expressed; stated in indefinite terms.
definitions.definitionCn: 表达不清；用不确定的措辞陈述。

definitions.definition: Not having a precise meaning.
definitions.example: a vague term of abuse
definitions.definitionCn: 没有精确的含义。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个模糊的辱骂词。

definitions.definition: Not clearly defined, grasped, or understood; indistinct; slight.
definitions.example: I haven’t the vaguest idea.
definitions.definitionCn: 未明确定义、掌握或理解的；模糊的；微弱的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我毫无头绪。

definitions.definition: Not clearly felt or sensed; somewhat subconscious.
definitions.example: a vague longing
definitions.definitionCn: 未清晰感受或察觉的；有些潜意识的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一种模糊的渴望。

definitions.definition: Not thinking or expressing one’s thoughts clearly or precisely.
definitions.definitionCn: 不清晰或不精确地思考或表达自己的想法。

definitions.definition: Lacking expression; vacant.
definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏表情的；茫然的。

definitions.definition: Not sharply outlined; hazy.
definitions.definitionCn: 轮廓不清晰的；朦胧的。

definitions.definition: Wandering; vagrant; vagabond.
definitions.definitionCn: 漂泊的；流浪的；游荡的。

definitions.definition: Something that is variable.
definitions.definitionCn: 可变的事物。

definitions.definition: Something whose value may be dictated or discovered.
definitions.example: There are several variables to consider here.
definitions.definitionCn: 其值可能被指定或发现的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 这里有几个变量需要考虑。

definitions.definition: A quantity that may assume any one of a set of values.
definitions.definitionCn: 可以取一组值中任意一个的量。

definitions.definition: A symbol representing a variable.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表变量的符号。

definitions.definition: A named memory location in which a program can store intermediate results and from which it can read them.
definitions.definitionCn: 程序中用于存储中间结果并可从中读取的命名内存位置。

definitions.definition: A variable star.
definitions.definitionCn: 变星。

definitions.definition: A shifting wind, or one that varies in force.
definitions.definitionCn: 方向不定或强度变化的风。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Those parts of the sea where a steady wind is not expected, especially the parts between the trade-wind belts.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）指海洋中预计无稳定风的区域，尤指信风带之间的部分。

definitions.definition: Able to vary or be varied.
definitions.example: variable winds or seasons; a variable quantity; a variable resistor
definitions.definitionCn: 能够变化或可被改变。
definitions.exampleCn: 变化的风或季节；可变量；可变电阻。

definitions.definition: Likely to vary.
definitions.definitionCn: 容易变化的。

definitions.definition: Marked by diversity or difference.
definitions.definitionCn: 以多样性或差异为特征。

definitions.definition: Having no fixed quantitative value.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有固定数值的。

definitions.definition: Tending to deviate from a normal or recognized type.
definitions.definitionCn: 倾向于偏离正常或公认类型的。

definitions.definition: The quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable.
definitions.example: The Shakespearean Shylock is of dubious value in the modern world.
definitions.definitionCn: 质量（正面或负面）使某物具有吸引力或价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 莎士比亚笔下的夏洛克在现代世界中价值存疑。

definitions.definition: The degree of importance given to something.
definitions.example: The value of my children's happiness is second only to that of my wife.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物被赋予的重要程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 我孩子的幸福价值仅次于我的妻子。

definitions.definition: That which is valued or highly esteemed, such as one's morals, morality, or belief system.
definitions.example: He does not share his parents' values.
definitions.definitionCn: 被珍视或高度推崇的事物，如道德、伦理或信仰体系。
definitions.exampleCn: 他与父母的价值观不同。

definitions.definition: The amount (of money or goods or services) that is considered to be a fair equivalent for something else.
definitions.definitionCn: 被认为与某物等值的（金钱、商品或服务）数量。

definitions.definition: The relative duration of a musical note.
definitions.example: The value of a crotchet is twice that of a quaver.
definitions.definitionCn: 音符的相对时值。
definitions.exampleCn: 四分音符的时值是八分音符的两倍。

definitions.definition: The relative darkness or lightness of a color in (a specific area of) a painting etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 绘画等（特定区域）中颜色的相对明暗度。

definitions.definition: Any definite numerical quantity or other mathematical object, determined by being measured, computed, or otherwise defined.
definitions.example: The exact value of pi cannot be represented in decimal notation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过测量、计算或其他方式确定的任何具体数值或其他数学对象。
definitions.exampleCn: π的精确值无法用十进制表示。

definitions.definition: Precise meaning; import.
definitions.example: the value of a word; the value of a legal instrument
definitions.definitionCn: 精确含义；意义。
definitions.exampleCn: 词语的价值；法律文书的效力

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The valuable ingredients to be obtained by treating a mass or compound; specifically, the precious metals contained in rock, gravel, etc.
definitions.example: The vein carries good values.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）通过处理大量物质或化合物获得的有价值成分；特指岩石、砾石等中含有的贵金属。
definitions.exampleCn: 矿脉含有高价值矿物。

definitions.definition: Esteem; regard.
definitions.definitionCn: 尊重；重视。

definitions.definition: Valour; also spelled valew.
definitions.definitionCn: 勇气；亦拼写为valew。

definitions.definition: To estimate the value of; judge the worth of something.
definitions.example: I will have the family jewels valued by a professional.
definitions.definitionCn: 评估某物的价值；判断某物的价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会请专业人士评估家族珠宝的价值。

definitions.definition: To fix or determine the value of; assign a value to, as of jewelry or art work.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定或规定价值；为珠宝或艺术品等赋值。

definitions.definition: To regard highly; think much of; place importance upon.
definitions.example: Gold was valued highly among the Romans.
definitions.definitionCn: 高度重视；非常看重；认为重要。
definitions.exampleCn: 黄金在罗马人中受到高度重视。

definitions.definition: To hold dear.
definitions.example: I value these old photographs.
definitions.definitionCn: 珍视。
definitions.exampleCn: 我珍视这些老照片。

definitions.definition: A vast space.
definitions.definitionCn: 广阔的空间。

definitions.definition: Very large or wide (literally or figuratively).
definitions.example: The Sahara desert is vast.
definitions.definitionCn: （字面或比喻）非常大或宽广。
definitions.exampleCn: 撒哈拉沙漠非常广阔。

definitions.definition: Very great in size, amount, degree, intensity, or especially extent.
definitions.definitionCn: 在尺寸、数量、程度、强度，尤其是范围上非常大。

definitions.definition: Waste; desert; desolate; lonely.
definitions.definitionCn: 荒芜；沙漠；荒凉；孤寂。

definitions.definition: Having a broad range (of different elements).
definitions.example: The reasons are various.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含多种不同元素。
definitions.exampleCn: 原因多种多样。

definitions.definition: That varies or differs from others; variant; different.
definitions.example: a various reading of a Biblical text
definitions.definitionCn: 与他人不同或相异的；变异的；不同的。
definitions.exampleCn: 对圣经文本的多种解读。

definitions.definition: A person with long experience of a particular activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某项活动有长期经验的人。

definitions.definition: A group, animal, etc. with long experience of a particular activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某项活动有长期经验的群体、动物等。

definitions.definition: A person who has served in the armed forces, especially an old soldier who has seen long service; also called a war veteran to distinguish from veterans that weren't in armed conflict.
definitions.definitionCn: 曾在军队服役的人，尤指服役多年的老兵；也称为战争老兵，以区别于未参与武装冲突的老兵。

definitions.definition: Having had long experience, practice, or service.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有长期经验、实践或服务的。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to former members of the military armed forces, especially those who served during wartime.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于前军事武装部队成员，尤其是战时服役者。

definitions.definition: Any craft designed for transportation on water, such as a ship or boat.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何设计用于水上运输的交通工具，如船舶或小船。

definitions.definition: A craft designed for transportation through air or space.
definitions.definitionCn: 设计用于空中或太空运输的交通工具。

definitions.definition: Dishes and cutlery collectively, especially if made of precious metals.
definitions.definitionCn: 餐具和刀具的总称，尤指由贵金属制成的。

definitions.definition: A container of liquid or other substance, such as a glass, goblet, cup, bottle, bowl, or pitcher.
definitions.definitionCn: 盛放液体或其他物质的容器，如玻璃杯、高脚杯、杯子、瓶子、碗或水壶。

definitions.definition: A person as a container of qualities or feelings.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为品质或情感容器的人。

definitions.definition: A tube or canal that carries fluid in an animal or plant.
definitions.example: Blood and lymph vessels are found in humans; xylem and phloem vessels are found in plants.
definitions.definitionCn: 在动物或植物中输送液体的管道或导管。
definitions.exampleCn: 人类体内有血管和淋巴管；植物体内有木质部和韧皮部导管。

definitions.definition: To put into a vessel.
definitions.definitionCn: 装入容器中。

definitions.definition: A conveyance; a device for carrying or transporting substances, objects or individuals.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种运输工具；用于携带或运输物质、物体或个体的装置。

definitions.definition: A medium for expression of talent or views.
definitions.definitionCn: 表达才华或观点的媒介。

definitions.definition: A liquid content (e.g. oil) which acts as a binding and drying agent in paint. (FM 55-501).
definitions.definitionCn: 在油漆中充当粘合和干燥剂的液体成分（如油）。（FM 55-501）

definitions.definition: (pharmaceuticals) The main excipient (such as an oil or gel) that conveys the active ingredient of a drug.
definitions.definitionCn: （制药）承载药物活性成分的主要辅料（如油或凝胶）。

definitions.definition: An entity to achieve an end.
definitions.definitionCn: 实现目的之实体。

definitions.definition: A mode or method of spiritual practice; a yana.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神实践的模式或方法；一种乘（yana）。

definitions.definition: An animal or (rarely) a plant on which a Hindu deity rides or sits
definitions.definitionCn: 印度教神祇骑乘或安坐的动物或（罕见）植物。

definitions.definition: A vertex or zenith.
definitions.definitionCn: 顶点或天顶。

definitions.definition: A vertical geometrical figure; a perpendicular.
definitions.definitionCn: 垂直的几何图形；垂直线。

definitions.definition: An individual slat in a set of vertical blinds.
definitions.definitionCn: 垂直百叶窗中的单个叶片。

definitions.definition: A vertical component of a structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 结构的垂直组成部分。

definitions.definition: A vertical market.
definitions.example: We offer specialised accounting software targeting various verticals.
definitions.definitionCn: 垂直市场。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们提供针对不同垂直领域的专业会计软件。

definitions.definition: Standing, pointing, or moving straight up or down; along the direction of a plumb line; perpendicular to something horizontal.
definitions.definitionCn: 直立、指向或沿垂直方向移动；沿铅垂线方向；与水平方向垂直。

definitions.definition: In a two-dimensional Cartesian co-ordinate system, describing the axis y oriented normal (perpendicular, at right angles) to the horizontal axis x.
definitions.definitionCn: 在二维笛卡尔坐标系中，描述与水平轴x垂直（正交、成直角）的y轴。

definitions.definition: In a three-dimensional co-ordinate system, describing the axis z oriented normal (perpendicular, orthogonal) to the basic plane xy.
definitions.definitionCn: 在三维坐标系中，描述与基本平面xy垂直（正交）的z轴。

definitions.definition: Of or pertaining to vertical markets.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于垂直市场的。

definitions.definition: (wine tasting) Involving different vintages of the same wine type from the same winery.
definitions.definitionCn: （品酒）指同一酒庄同一类型葡萄酒的不同年份。

definitions.definition: Of an interval: having the two notes sound simultaneously.
definitions.definitionCn: （音程）指两个音同时发声。

definitions.definition: The quality of being varied; diversity.
definitions.example: Variety is the spice of life.
definitions.definitionCn: 多样性的特质；多样化。
definitions.exampleCn: 变化是生活的调味品。

definitions.definition: A specific variation of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物的特定变体。

definitions.definition: A number of different things.
definitions.definitionCn: 多种不同的事物。

definitions.definition: A state of constant change.
definitions.definitionCn: 持续变化的状态。

definitions.definition: A rank in a taxonomic classification, below species and subspecies.
definitions.definitionCn: 分类学中的等级，位于种和亚种之下。

definitions.definition: The total number of distinct states of a system.
definitions.definitionCn: 系统不同状态的总数。

definitions.definition: Logarithm of the base 2 of the total number of distinct states of a system.
definitions.definitionCn: 系统不同状态总数的以2为底的对数。

definitions.definition: A term used for a specific form of a language, neutral to whether that form is a dialect, accent, register, etc. and to its prestige level.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于指代语言特定形式的术语，中性于该形式是方言、口音、语域等，以及其声望水平。

definitions.definition: (universal algebra) An equational class; the class of all algebraic structures of a given signature, satisfying a given set of identities.
definitions.definitionCn: （泛代数）等式类；给定签名且满足给定恒等式集的所有代数结构的类。

definitions.definition: An algebraic variety.
definitions.definitionCn: 代数簇。

definitions.definition: The kind of theatrical entertainment given in variety shows.
definitions.definitionCn: 综艺节目中提供的戏剧娱乐形式。

definitions.definition: The production of, or performance in, variety shows.
definitions.definitionCn: 综艺节目的制作或表演。

definitions.definition: The state behind or past.
definitions.definitionCn: 后方或过去的状态。

definitions.definition: (of motion) In the direction towards the back.
definitions.example: They left without a backward glance.
definitions.definitionCn: （运动方向）朝向后方。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们头也不回地离开了。

definitions.definition: (of motion) In the direction reverse of normal.
definitions.example: The occasional backward movement of planets is evidence they revolve around the sun.
definitions.definitionCn: （运动方向）与正常方向相反。
definitions.exampleCn: 行星偶尔的逆行运动证明它们围绕太阳公转。

definitions.definition: Reluctant or unable to advance.
definitions.definitionCn: 不愿或无法前进。

definitions.definition: Of a culture: undeveloped or unsophisticated.
definitions.definitionCn: 指文化：未开化或缺乏 sophistication。

definitions.definition: Outdated.
definitions.definitionCn: 过时的。

definitions.definition: On that part of the field behind the batsman's popping crease.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球员起跑线后方的场地部分。

definitions.definition: Further behind the batsman's popping crease than something else.
definitions.definitionCn: 比另一位置更靠近击球员起跑线后方。

definitions.definition: Unwilling; averse; reluctant.
definitions.definitionCn: 不情愿的；厌恶的；勉强的。

definitions.definition: Slow to apprehend; having difficulties in learning.
definitions.example: a backward child
definitions.definitionCn: 理解迟钝；学习困难。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个迟钝的孩子。

definitions.definition: Late or behindhand.
definitions.example: a backward season
definitions.definitionCn: 迟到的；落后的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个迟来的季节。

definitions.definition: Already past or gone; bygone.
definitions.definitionCn: 已经过去或消逝的；往昔的。

definitions.definition: (of motion) In the direction towards the back; backwards
definitions.example: to throw the arms backward
definitions.definitionCn: （运动方向）朝向后方；向后。
definitions.exampleCn: 向后甩动手臂。

definitions.definition: Toward, or in, past time or events; ago.
definitions.definitionCn: 朝向或处于过去的时间或事件；以前。

definitions.definition: By way of reflection; reflexively.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过反思的方式；反身地。

definitions.definition: From a better to a worse state, as from honor to shame, from religion to sin.
definitions.definitionCn: 从较好状态到较差状态，例如从荣誉到耻辱，从信仰到罪恶。

definitions.definition: A structure that bars passage.
definitions.definitionCn: 阻挡通行的结构。

definitions.definition: An obstacle or impediment.
definitions.definitionCn: 障碍或阻碍。

definitions.definition: A boundary or limit.
definitions.definitionCn: 边界或限制。

definitions.definition: (grammar) A node (in government and binding theory) said to intervene between other nodes A and B if it is a potential governor for B, c-commands B, and does not c-command A.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）在管辖与约束理论中，若某节点是B的潜在管辖者、成分统制B且不成分统制A，则称该节点介于节点A与B之间。

definitions.definition: A separation between two areas of the body where specialized cells allow the entry of certain substances but prevent the entry of others.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体两个区域间的分隔，其中特化细胞允许特定物质进入但阻止其他物质进入。

definitions.definition: The lists in a tournament.
definitions.definitionCn: 锦标赛中的对阵表。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) A martial exercise of the 15th and 16th centuries.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）15至16世纪的武术演练。

definitions.definition: To block or obstruct with a barrier.
definitions.definitionCn: 用屏障阻挡或妨碍。

definitions.definition: A wide bowl for washing, sometimes affixed to a wall
definitions.definitionCn: 用于洗涤的宽碗，有时固定在墙上

definitions.definition: A shallow bowl used for a single serving of a drink or liquidy food
definitions.definitionCn: 用于单份饮品或流质食物的浅碗

definitions.definition: A depression, natural or artificial, containing water
definitions.definitionCn: 天然或人工形成的、蓄水的洼地

definitions.definition: An area of land from which water drains into a common outlet; drainage basin
definitions.definitionCn: 水流汇入共同出口的陆地区域；流域

definitions.definition: A rock formation scooped out by water erosion
definitions.definitionCn: 被水侵蚀掏空的岩石构造

definitions.definition: To create a concavity or depression in.
definitions.definitionCn: 在...中形成凹陷或洼地

definitions.definition: To serve as or become a basin.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为或成为盆地

definitions.definition: To shelter or enclose in a basin.
definitions.definitionCn: 将...遮蔽或围入盆地中

definitions.definition: An agreement between parties concerning the sale of property; or a contract by which one party binds himself to transfer the right to some property for a consideration, and the other party binds himself to receive the property and pay the consideration.
definitions.definitionCn: 当事人之间关于财产出售的协议；或一方承诺为对价转让某项财产权利，另一方承诺接收财产并支付对价的合同。

definitions.definition: An agreement or stipulation; mutual pledge.
definitions.definitionCn: 协议或约定；相互承诺。

definitions.definition: An item purchased for significantly less than the usual, or recommended, price
definitions.definitionCn: 以远低于通常或建议价格购买的物品。

definitions.definition: A gainful transaction; an advantageous purchase.
definitions.example: At that price, it's not just a bargain, it's a steal.
definitions.definitionCn: 有利可图的交易；合算的购买。
definitions.exampleCn: 以那个价格，这不仅是便宜货，简直是白捡。

definitions.definition: The thing stipulated or purchased.
definitions.definitionCn: 约定或购买的事物。

definitions.definition: To make a bargain; to make a deal or contract for the exchange of property or services; to negotiate
definitions.example: They had to bargain for a few minutes to get a decent price for the rug.
definitions.definitionCn: 讨价还价；就财产或服务的交换达成协议或合同；进行谈判。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们不得不讨价还价几分钟，才能为地毯争取到合适的价格。

definitions.definition: To transfer for a consideration; to barter; to trade
definitions.definitionCn: 为对价而转让；以物易物；交易。

definitions.definition: An institution where one can place and borrow money and take care of financial affairs.
definitions.definitionCn: 可以存钱、借钱和处理财务事务的机构。

definitions.definition: A branch office of such an institution.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类机构的分支办事处。

definitions.definition: An underwriter or controller of a card game; also banque.
definitions.definitionCn: 纸牌游戏中的庄家或控制者；也指庄家资金。

definitions.definition: A fund from deposits or contributions, to be used in transacting business; a joint stock or capital.
definitions.definitionCn: 来自存款或捐款的资金，用于开展业务；合股资本或资金。

definitions.definition: The sum of money etc. which the dealer or banker has as a fund from which to draw stakes and pay losses.
definitions.definitionCn: 庄家或银行家用于下注和支付损失的基金。

definitions.definition: Money; profit
definitions.definitionCn: 金钱；利润。

definitions.definition: In certain games, such as dominos, a fund of pieces from which the players are allowed to draw.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某些游戏中，如多米诺骨牌，允许玩家抽取的牌堆。

definitions.definitionCn: 音乐团体中产生低音的部分，低于男中音和男高音。
definitions.exampleCn: 指挥更喜欢将低音部置于乐队中后方，而非一侧。

definitions.definition: One who sings in the bass range.
definitions.example: Halfway through middle school, Edgar morphed from a soprano to a bass, much to the amazement and amusement of his fellow choristers.
definitions.definitionCn: 唱低音的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 中学读到一半时，埃德加从女高音变成了男低音，令合唱团成员既惊讶又好笑。

definitions.definition: An instrument that plays in the bass range, in particular a double bass, bass guitar, electric bass or bass synthesiser.
definitions.example: The musician swung the bass over his head like an axe and smashed it into the amplifier, creating a discordant howl of noise.
definitions.definitionCn: 演奏低音域的乐器，尤指低音提琴、低音吉他、电贝司或低音合成器。
definitions.exampleCn: 音乐家将贝司像斧头一样抡过头顶砸向音箱，发出刺耳的噪音。

definitions.definition: The clef sign that indicates that the pitch of the notes is below middle C; a bass clef.
definitions.example: The score had been written without the treble and bass, but it was easy to pick out which was which based on the location of the notes on the staff.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示音符音高低于中央C的谱号；低音谱号。
definitions.exampleCn: 乐谱未标注高音和低音，但根据音符在五线谱上的位置很容易区分。

definitions.definition: A root.
definitions.definitionCn: 根。

definitions.definition: A primitive word, from which other words may be derived.
definitions.definitionCn: 原始词，其他词可能由此派生。

definitions.definition: The number of distinct symbols used to represent numbers in a particular base, as ten for decimal.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定进制中用于表示数字的不同符号数量，如十进制为十。

definitions.definition: Low in height; short.
Low in place or position.
Of low value or degree.
Of low social standing or rank; vulgar, common.
Morally reprehensible, immoral; cowardly.
Inferior; unworthy, of poor quality.
Designating those metals which are not classed as precious or noble.
Alloyed with inferior metal; debased.

definitions.definition: Of illegitimate birth; bastard.
Not classical or correct.
definitions.example: base Latin

definitions.definition: Not held by honourable service.
definitions.example: A base estate is one held by services not honourable, or held by villenage. Such a tenure is called base, or low, and the tenant is a base tenant.

definitions.definition: Of sound, a voice or an instrument, low in pitch or frequency.
definitions.example: The giant spoke in a deep, bass, rumbling voice that shook me to my boots.

definitions.definition: The game of prisoners' bars.
Acronym of building, antenna-tower, span, earth.
A solid, more or less rigid object of metal or wood with a uniform cross-section smaller than its length.
definitions.example: The window was protected by steel bars.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种由金属或木材制成的坚固、大致刚硬的物体，其均匀横截面小于长度。
definitions.exampleCn: 窗户由钢条保护。

definitions.definition: A solid metal object with uniform (round, square, hexagonal, octagonal or rectangular) cross-section; in the US its smallest dimension is 1/4 inch or greater, a piece of thinner material being called a strip.
definitions.example: Ancient Sparta used iron bars instead of handy coins in more valuable alloy, to physically discourage the use of money.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种具有均匀（圆形、方形、六边形、八边形或矩形）横截面的实心金属物体；在美国，其最小尺寸为1/4英寸或更大，更薄的材料称为条带。
definitions.exampleCn: 古斯巴达使用铁棒代替更贵重合金的便携硬币，以物理方式阻止货币使用。

definitions.definition: A cuboid piece of any solid commodity.
definitions.example: bar of chocolate
definitions.definitionCn: 任何固体商品的长方体块。
definitions.exampleCn: 巧克力棒

definitions.definition: A broad shaft, or band, or stripe.
definitions.example: a bar of colour
definitions.definitionCn: 宽阔的轴、带或条纹。
definitions.exampleCn: 一条颜色带

definitions.definition: A long, narrow drawn or printed rectangle, cuboid or cylinder, especially as used in a bar code or a bar chart.
definitions.definitionCn: 长而窄的绘制或印刷矩形、长方体或圆柱体，尤其用于条形码或条形图。

definitions.definition: Any of various lines used as punctuation or diacritics, such as the pipe ⟨|⟩, fraction bar (as in 12), and strikethrough (as in Ⱥ), formerly including oblique marks such as the slash.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作标点或变音符号的各种线条，如管道符⟨|⟩、分数杠（如12）和删除线（如Ⱥ），以前还包括斜线等倾斜标记。

definitions.definition: The sign indicating that the characteristic of a logarithm is negative, conventionally placed above the digit(s) to show that it applies to the characteristic only and not to the mantissa.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示对数为负的符号，通常置于数字上方，表示仅适用于首数而非尾数。

definitions.definition: A similar sign indicating that the charge on a particle is negative (and that consequently the particle is in fact an antiparticle).
definitions.definitionCn: 表示粒子带负电的类似符号（因此该粒子实际上是反粒子）。

definitions.definition: A business licensed to sell alcoholic drinks for consumption on the premises, or the premises themselves; public house.
definitions.example: The street was lined with all-night bars.
definitions.definitionCn: 获准在店内销售酒精饮料供饮用的商业场所，或该场所本身；酒吧。
definitions.exampleCn: 这条街两旁都是通宵营业的酒吧。

definitions.definition: The counter of such premises.
definitions.example: Step up to the bar and order a drink.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类场所的柜台。
definitions.exampleCn: 走到吧台前点一杯饮料。

definitions.definition: A counter, or simply a cabinet, from which alcoholic drinks are served in a private house or a hotel room.
definitions.definitionCn: 在私人住宅或酒店房间中供应酒精饮料的柜台或简单橱柜。

definitions.definition: (by extension, in combinations such as coffee bar, juice bar etc.) Premises or a counter serving any type of beverage.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义，用于咖啡吧、果汁吧等组合词中）供应任何类型饮料的场所或柜台。

definitions.definition: An establishment where alcohol and sometimes other refreshments are served.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供酒精饮料及有时其他小吃的场所。

definitions.definition: An informal establishment selling food to be consumed on the premises.
definitions.example: a burger bar
definitions.definitionCn: 提供现场食用食品的非正式场所。
definitions.exampleCn: 汉堡吧

definitions.definition: An establishment offering cosmetic services.
definitions.example: a nail bar; a brow bar
definitions.definitionCn: 提供美容服务的场所。
definitions.exampleCn: 美甲吧；修眉吧

definitions.definition: An official order or pronouncement that prohibits some activity.
definitions.example: The club has lifted its bar on women members.
definitions.definitionCn: 禁止某些活动的官方命令或声明。
definitions.exampleCn: 俱乐部已取消对女性会员的禁令。

definitions.definition: Anything that obstructs, hinders, or prevents; an obstruction; a barrier.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何阻碍、妨碍或阻止的事物；障碍；屏障。

definitions.definition: (whimsical, derived from fubar) A metasyntactic variable representing an unspecified entity, often the second in a series, following foo.
definitions.example: Suppose we have two objects, foo and bar.
definitions.definitionCn: （异想天开，源自fubar）表示未指定实体的元语法变量，通常为系列中的第二个，跟在foo之后。
definitions.exampleCn: 假设我们有两个对象：foo和bar。

definitions.definition: (Parliament) A dividing line (physical or notional) in the chamber of a legislature beyond which only members and officials may pass.
definitions.definitionCn: （议会）立法机构会议厅中的分界线（物理或象征性），仅限议员和官员通过。

definitions.definition: The railing surrounding the part of a courtroom in which the judges, lawyers, defendants and witnesses stay
definitions.definitionCn: 法庭中法官、律师、被告和证人所在区域的围栏。

definitions.definition: "the Bar" or "the bar" The bar exam, the legal licensing exam.
definitions.example: He's studying hard to pass the Bar this time; he's failed it twice before.
definitions.definitionCn: “律师界”或“律师资格考试”：法律执业资格考试。
definitions.exampleCn: 他这次正努力学习通过律师资格考试；之前他已失败两次。

definitions.definition: (metonym, "the Bar", "the bar") Collectively, lawyers or the legal profession; specifically applied to barristers in some countries but including all lawyers in others.
definitions.example: He was called to the bar, he became a barrister.
definitions.definitionCn: （转喻，“律师界”）集体指律师或法律职业；在某些国家特指出庭律师，但在其他国家包括所有律师。
definitions.exampleCn: 他被召入律师界，成为出庭律师。

definitions.definition: One of an array of bar-shaped symbols that display the level of something, such as wireless signal strength or battery life remaining.
definitions.example: I don't have any bars in the middle of this desert.
definitions.definitionCn: 显示某物水平（如无线信号强度或剩余电池寿命）的条形符号阵列之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 在这片沙漠中央，我没有任何信号条。

definitions.definition: A vertical line across a musical staff dividing written music into sections, typically of equal durational value.
definitions.definitionCn: 音乐谱表上的垂直线，将乐谱分成通常等时值的部分。

definitions.definition: One of those musical sections.
definitions.definitionCn: 这些音乐部分之一。

definitions.definition: A horizontal pole that must be crossed in high jump and pole vault
definitions.definitionCn: 跳高和撑杆跳中必须越过的水平杆。

definitions.definition: Any level of achievement regarded as a challenge to be overcome.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为需要克服挑战的任何成就水平。

definitions.definition: (most codes) The crossbar.
definitions.definitionCn: （大多数代码）横杆。

definitions.definition: The central divider between the inner and outer table of a backgammon board, where stones are placed if they are hit.
definitions.definitionCn: 双陆棋棋盘内外桌之间的中央分隔线，被击中时棋子放置于此。

definitions.definition: An addition to a military medal, on account of a subsequent act
definitions.definitionCn: 因后续行为而添加在军事勋章上的附加条。

definitions.definition: A linear shoaling landform feature within a body of water.
definitions.definitionCn: 水体中的线性浅滩地貌特征。

definitions.definition: A ridge or succession of ridges of sand or other substance, especially a formation extending across the mouth of a river or harbor or off a beach, and which may obstruct navigation. (FM 55-501).
definitions.definitionCn: 沙或其他物质的脊或连续脊，尤其形成于河口、港口或海滩前，可能阻碍航行（FM 55-501）。

definitions.definition: One of the ordinaries in heraldry; a fess.
definitions.definitionCn: 纹章学中的普通图记之一；横带。

definitions.definition: A city gate, in some British place names.
definitions.example: Potter's Bar
definitions.definitionCn: 某些英国地名中的城门。
definitions.exampleCn: 波特斯巴

definitions.definition: A drilling or tamping rod.
definitions.definitionCn: 钻孔或捣固杆。

definitions.definition: A vein or dike crossing a lode.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿过矿脉的矿脉或岩墙。

definitions.definition: A gatehouse of a castle or fortified town.
definitions.definitionCn: 城堡或设防城镇的门楼。

definitions.definition: The part of the crust of a horse's hoof which is bent inwards towards the frog at the heel on each side, and extends into the centre of the sole.
definitions.definitionCn: 马蹄蹄壁部分，在脚跟两侧向内弯曲朝向蹄叉，并延伸至蹄底中心。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The space between the tusks and grinders in the upper jaw of a horse, in which the bit is placed.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）马上颚门齿与臼齿之间的空间，用于放置马衔铁。

definitions.definition: To obstruct the passage of (someone or something).
definitions.example: Our way was barred by a huge rockfall.

definitions.definition: To prohibit.
definitions.example: I couldn't get into the nightclub because I had been barred.

definitions.definition: To lock or bolt with a bar.
definitions.example: bar the door

definitions.definition: To imprint or paint with bars, to stripe.
Except, other than, besides.
definitions.example: He invited everyone to his wedding bar his ex-wife.

definitions.definition: Denotes the minimum odds offered on other horses not mentioned by name.
definitions.example: Leg At Each Corner is at 3/1, Lost My Shirt 5/1, and it's 10/1 bar.

definitions.definition: A non-SI unit of pressure equal to 100,000 pascals, approximately equal to atmospheric pressure at sea level.
Any of the flying mammals of the order Chiroptera, usually small and nocturnal, insectivorous or frugivorous.
definitions.definitionCn: 翼手目中的任何一种飞行哺乳动物，通常体型较小且夜间活动，以昆虫或水果为食。

definitions.definition: An old woman.
definitions.definitionCn: 老妇人。

definitions.definition: A club made of wood or aluminium used for striking the ball in sports such as baseball, softball and cricket.
A turn at hitting the ball with a bat in a game.
definitions.example: You've been in for ages. Can I have a bat now?

definitions.definition: The piece of wood on which the spinner places the coins and then uses for throwing them.
Shale or bituminous shale.
A sheet of cotton used for filling quilts or comfortables; batting.
A part of a brick with one whole end.
A stroke; a sharp blow.
A stroke of work.
Rate of motion; speed.
A spree; a jollification.
Manner; rate; condition; state of health.
To hit with a bat or (figuratively) as if with a bat.

To strike or swipe as though with a bat.

definitions.definition: To flutter

To bate or flutter, as a hawk.

definitions.definition: A packsaddle.
The official currency of Thailand, equal to 100 satang.
A living creature.

definitions.definition: The state or fact of existence, consciousness, or life, or something in such a state.
definitions.definitionCn: 存在、意识或生命的状态或事实，或处于这种状态的事物。

definitions.definition: That which has actuality (materially or in concept).
definitions.definitionCn: 具有现实性（物质上或概念上）的东西。

definitions.definition: One's basic nature, or the qualities thereof; essence or personality.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人的基本本质或其特质；精髓或个性。

definitions.definition: An abode; a cottage.
definitions.definitionCn: 住所；小屋。

definitions.definition: Given that; since.
definitions.definitionCn: 鉴于；既然。

definitions.definition: Human conduct relative to social norms.
definitions.definitionCn: 人类行为相对于社会规范。

definitions.definition: The way a living creature behaves or acts generally.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物体一般的行为或行动方式。

definitions.definition: A state of probation about one's conduct.
definitions.example: He was on his best behavior when her family visited.
definitions.definitionCn: 对个人行为的考验状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 当她的家人来访时，他表现得非常好。

definitions.definition: An instance of the way a living creature behaves.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物体行为的一个实例。

definitions.definition: Observable response produced by an organism.
definitions.definitionCn: 有机体产生的可观察反应。

definitions.definition: The way a device or system operates.
definitions.definitionCn: 设备或系统运行的方式。

definitions.definition: A berry.
definitions.definitionCn: 一颗浆果。

definitions.definition: Laurus nobilis, a tree or shrub of the family Lauraceae, having dark green leaves and berries.
definitions.definitionCn: 月桂树，樟科的一种乔木或灌木，具有深绿色叶片和浆果。

definitions.definition: Bay leaf, the leaf of this or certain other species of tree or shrub, used as a herb.
definitions.definitionCn: 月桂叶，该植物或某些其他乔木或灌木的叶片，用作香草。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The leaves of this shrub, woven into a garland used to reward a champion or victor; hence, fame, victory.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）这种灌木的叶片编织成花环，用于奖励冠军或胜利者；因此引申为名誉、胜利。

definitions.definition: A tract covered with bay trees.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片月桂树覆盖的区域。

definitions.definition: A kind of mahogany obtained from Campeche in Mexico.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种从墨西哥坎佩切获得的桃花心木。

definitions.definition: A body of water (especially the sea) more or less three-quarters surrounded by land.
A bank or dam to keep back water.
An opening in a wall, especially between two columns.
An internal recess; a compartment or area surrounded on three sides.
The distance between two supports in a vault or building with a pitched roof.
Each of the spaces, port and starboard, between decks, forward of the bitts, in sailing warships.
A bay platform.
A bay window.
The excited howling of dogs when hunting or being attacked.
(by extension) The climactic confrontation between hunting-dogs and their prey.
A state of being obliged to face an antagonist or a difficulty, when escape has become impossible.
To howl.
To bark at; hence, to follow with barking; to bring or drive to bay.

definitions.definition: To pursue noisily, like a pack of hounds.
A brown colour/color of the coat of some horses.
A horse of this color.
Of a reddish-brown colour (especially of horses).
A physical base or foundation.
definitions.definitionCn: 物理基础或地基。

definitions.definition: A starting point, base or foundation for an argument or hypothesis.
definitions.definitionCn: 论点或假设的起点、基础或依据。

definitions.definition: An underlying condition or circumstance.
definitions.definitionCn: 潜在的条件或环境。

definitions.definition: A regular frequency.

definitions.definitionCn: 固定的频率。
definitions.exampleCn: 汽车必须每年检查一次。

definitions.definition: In a vector space, a linearly independent set of vectors spanning the whole vector space.
definitions.definitionCn: 在向量空间中，一组线性无关且张成整个向量空间的向量。

definitions.definition: Amount paid for an investment, including commissions and other expenses.
definitions.definitionCn: 为投资支付的金额，包括佣金和其他费用。

definitions.example: The collection of all possible unions of basis elements of a basis is said to be the topology generated by that basis.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个集合的子集族（“基元素”），使得该族覆盖该集合，并且对于任意两个同时包含该集合中某个元素的基元素，存在第三个基元素包含于前两个的交集中，且也包含该元素。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个基的所有基元素之并集的全体，称为由该基生成的拓扑。

definitions.definition: Any animal other than a human; usually only applied to land vertebrates, especially large or dangerous four-footed ones.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何非人类的动物；通常仅指陆生脊椎动物，尤其是大型或危险的四足动物。

definitions.definition: (more specific) A domestic animal, especially a bovine farm animal.
definitions.definitionCn: （更具体）家养动物，尤其是牛类农场动物。

definitions.definition: A person who behaves in a violent, antisocial or uncivilized manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 行为暴力、反社会或野蛮的人。

definitions.definition: Anything regarded as larger or more powerful than one of its normal size or strength.

definitions.definitionCn: 被视为比正常体型或力量更大或更强的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是一个野兽般的体育场。

definitions.definition: Someone who is particularly impressive, especially athletically or physically.
definitions.definitionCn: 特别令人印象深刻的人，尤其是在运动或体能方面。

definitions.definition: (prisons) A sex offender.
definitions.definitionCn: （监狱用语）性犯罪者。

definitions.definition: Something unpleasant and difficult.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人不愉快且困难的事物。

definitions.definition: A thing or matter, especially a difficult or unruly one.
definitions.definitionCn: 一件事或问题，尤其是棘手或难以控制的。

definitions.definition: To impose arduous exercises, either as training or as punishment.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加艰苦的训练，无论是作为训练还是惩罚。

definitions.definition: (chiefly Midwestern and northeastern US) great; excellent; powerful
definitions.definitionCn: （主要在美国中西部和东北部）极好的；出色的；强大的。

definitions.definition: To endeavour to depress the price of, or prices in.
definitions.example: to bear a railroad stock
definitions.definitionCn: 努力压低价格或市场行情。
definitions.exampleCn: 做空铁路股票。

definitions.definition: To carry or convey, literally or figuratively.
definitions.example: Judging from the look on his face, he wasn't bearing good news.
definitions.definitionCn: 字面或比喻意义上的携带或运送。
definitions.exampleCn: 从他脸上的表情来看，他带来的不是好消息。

definitions.definition: To support, sustain, or endure.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持、承受或忍耐。

definitions.definition: To support, keep up, or maintain.
definitions.definitionCn: 维持、保持或维护。

definitions.definition: To press or impinge upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加压力或撞击。

definitions.definition: To produce, yield, give birth to.
definitions.definitionCn: 生产、产出、生育。

definitions.definition: (originally nautical) To be, or head, in a specific direction or azimuth (from somewhere).
definitions.example: By my readings, we're bearing due south, so we should turn about ten degrees east.
definitions.definitionCn: （原为航海用语）朝向或指向（某处的）特定方向或方位角。
definitions.exampleCn: 根据我的读数，我们正朝正南方向行驶，所以应该向东偏转约十度。

definitions.definition: To gain or win.
definitions.definitionCn: 赢得或获得。

definitions.definition: (in combination) That bears (some specified thing).
definitions.example: a gift-bearing visitor
definitions.definitionCn: （用于复合词）携带（某特定事物）的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位带礼物的访客。

definitions.definition: Of a beam, column, or other device, carrying weight or load.

definitions.definition: The infliction of unlawful physical violence on a person, legally distinguished from assault, which includes the threat of impending violence.

definitions.definition: An elevated platform on which cannon could be placed.

definitions.definition: A set of small cages where hens are kept for the purpose of farming their eggs.

definitions.definition: The state of a firearm when it is possible to be fired.

definitions.definition: Apparatus for preparing or serving meals.

definitions.definition: The cluster of small feathers at the base of the beak in some birds.

definitions.definition: The appendages to the jaw in some cetaceans, and to the mouth or jaws of some fishes.
