definitions.exampleCn: 前方道路有一个急转弯。

definitions.definition: Any of the various knots which join the ends of two lines.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接两条线末端的各种绳结之一。

definitions.definition: (in the plural, underwater diving, with the) A severe condition caused by excessively quick decompression, causing bubbles of nitrogen to form in the blood; decompression sickness.
definitions.example: A diver who stays deep for too long must ascend very slowly in order to prevent the bends.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式，用于潜水领域）因减压过快导致的严重状况，血液中形成氮气泡；减压病。
definitions.exampleCn: 在深水停留过久的潜水员必须非常缓慢地上浮，以防止减压病。

definitions.definition: One of the honourable ordinaries formed by two diagonal lines drawn from the dexter chief to the sinister base; it generally occupies a fifth part of the shield if uncharged, but if charged one third.
definitions.definitionCn: 由从右上角到左下角的两条对角线构成的荣誉普通纹章之一；若无图案通常占盾牌的五分之一，若有图案则占三分之一。

definitions.definition: Turn; purpose; inclination; ends.
definitions.definitionCn: 转向；目的；倾向；末端。

definitions.definition: In the leather trade, the best quality of sole leather; a butt; sometimes, half a butt cut lengthwise.
definitions.definitionCn: 在皮革贸易中，最优质的鞋底皮革；一块整皮；有时指纵向切割的半块整皮。

definitions.definition: Hard, indurated clay; bind.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚硬的黏土；粘结物。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The thickest and strongest planks in a ship's sides, more generally called wales, which have the beams, knees, and futtocks bolted to them.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）船侧最厚最坚固的木板，通常称为舷侧厚板，梁、肘材和肋材用螺栓固定其上。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The frames or ribs that form the ship's body from the keel to the top of the sides.
definitions.example: the midship bends
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）从龙骨到船舷顶部构成船体的框架或肋骨。
definitions.exampleCn: 船中部的弯曲部分。

definitions.definition: A glissando, or glide between one pitch and another.
definitions.definitionCn: 滑音，或从一个音高滑向另一个音高。

definitions.definition: To cause (something) to change its shape into a curve, by physical force, chemical action, or any other means.
definitions.example: Don’t bend your knees.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过物理力、化学作用或其他方式使（某物）改变形状成为曲线。
definitions.exampleCn: 不要弯曲你的膝盖。

definitions.definition: To become curved.
definitions.example: Look at the trees bending in the wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 变成弯曲状。
definitions.exampleCn: 看那些在风中弯曲的树。

definitions.definition: To cause to change direction.
definitions.definitionCn: 使改变方向。

definitions.definition: To change direction.
definitions.example: The road bends to the right
definitions.definitionCn: 改变方向。
definitions.exampleCn: 道路向右转弯。

definitions.definition: To be inclined; to direct itself.
definitions.definitionCn: 倾向于；自行转向。

definitions.definition: (usually with "down") To stoop.
definitions.example: He bent down to pick up the pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与“down”连用）弯腰。
definitions.exampleCn: 他弯腰捡起碎片。

definitions.definition: To bow in prayer, or in token of submission.
definitions.definitionCn: 在祈祷或表示顺从时鞠躬。

definitions.definition: To force to submit.
definitions.example: They bent me to their will.
definitions.definitionCn: 迫使屈服。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们迫使我服从他们的意愿。

definitions.definition: To submit.
definitions.example: I am bending to my desire to eat junk food.
definitions.definitionCn: 屈服。
definitions.exampleCn: 我正屈从于吃垃圾食品的欲望。

definitions.definition: To apply to a task or purpose.
definitions.example: He bent the company's resources to gaining market share.
definitions.definitionCn: 致力于某项任务或目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将公司资源用于获取市场份额。

definitions.definition: To apply oneself to a task or purpose.
definitions.example: He bent to the goal of gaining market share.
definitions.definitionCn: 专注于某项任务或目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他致力于实现获取市场份额的目标。

definitions.definition: To adapt or interpret to for a purpose or beneficiary.
definitions.definitionCn: 为了某个目的或受益者而调整或解释。

definitions.definition: To tie, as in securing a line to a cleat; to shackle a chain to an anchor; make fast.
definitions.example: Bend the sail to the yard.
definitions.definitionCn: 系紧，如将绳索固定在系缆桩上；将锚链拴在锚上；系牢。
definitions.exampleCn: 将帆系在帆桁上。

definitions.definition: To smoothly change the pitch of a note.
definitions.example: You should bend the G slightly sharp in the next measure.
definitions.definitionCn: 平滑地改变音符的音高。
definitions.exampleCn: 你应在下一小节将G音略微升高。

definitions.definition: To swing the body when rowing.
definitions.definitionCn: 划船时摆动身体。

definitions.definition: That which binds or ties.
definitions.definitionCn: 捆绑或系住之物。

definitions.definition: A troublesome situation; a problem; a predicament or quandary.
definitions.definitionCn: 麻烦的局面；问题；困境或窘境。

definitions.definition: Any twining or climbing plant or stem, especially a hop vine; a bine.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何缠绕或攀爬的植物或茎干，尤指啤酒花藤；蔓藤。

definitions.definition: A ligature or tie for grouping notes.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于组合音符的连音符或连线。

definitions.definition: A strong grip or stranglehold on a position that is difficult for the opponent to break.
definitions.example: the Maróczy Bind
definitions.definitionCn: 在对手难以突破的位置上形成的强力控制或锁喉。
definitions.exampleCn: 马罗奇束缚。

definitions.definition: The indurated clay of coal mines.
definitions.definitionCn: 煤矿中硬化的黏土。

definitions.definition: To tie; to confine by any ligature.
definitions.definitionCn: 系住；用任何绳索束缚。

definitions.definition: To cohere or stick together in a mass.
definitions.example: Just to make the cheese more binding
definitions.definitionCn: 聚集成团并粘合在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 只是为了增加奶酪的粘合力。

definitions.definition: To be restrained from motion, or from customary or natural action, as by friction.
definitions.example: I wish I knew why the sewing machine binds up after I use it for a while.
definitions.definitionCn: 因摩擦等作用而无法移动，或无法进行惯常或自然动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 我希望知道为什么缝纫机用一会儿后就卡住了。

definitions.definition: To exert a binding or restraining influence.
definitions.example: These are the ties that bind.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加束缚或限制的影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些是维系彼此的纽带。

definitions.definition: To tie or fasten tightly together, with a cord, band, ligature, chain, etc.
definitions.example: to bind grain in bundles  to bind a prisoner
definitions.definitionCn: 用绳索、带子、链条等紧紧系住或固定在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 将谷物捆成捆  捆绑囚犯。

definitions.definition: To confine, restrain, or hold by physical force or influence of any kind.
definitions.example: Frost binds the earth.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过任何形式的体力或影响力来限制、约束或控制。
definitions.exampleCn: 霜冻封住了大地。

definitions.definition: To couple.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接。

definitions.definition: To oblige, restrain, or hold, by authority, law, duty, promise, vow, affection, or other social tie.
definitions.example: to bind the conscience  to bind by kindness  bound by affection  commerce binds nations to each other
definitions.definitionCn: 通过权威、法律、职责、承诺、誓言、情感或其他社会纽带，使某人必须服从、约束或保持。
definitions.exampleCn: 约束良心  以善意约束  被情感束缚  商业将各国联系在一起。

definitions.definition: To put (a person) under definite legal obligations, especially, under the obligation of a bond or covenant.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）承担明确的法律义务，尤其是债券或契约下的义务。

definitions.definition: To place under legal obligation to serve.
definitions.example: to bind an apprentice  bound out to service
definitions.definitionCn: 使某人承担法律义务去服务。
definitions.exampleCn: 约束学徒  被派去服务。

definitions.definition: To protect or strengthen by applying a band or binding, as the edge of a carpet or garment.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过施加带子或镶边来保护或加固，如地毯或衣服的边缘。

definitions.definition: To make fast (a thing) about or upon something, as by tying; to encircle with something.
definitions.example: to bind a belt about one  to bind a compress upon a wound
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）系在或缠绕在某物上；用某物环绕。
definitions.exampleCn: 在腰间系上腰带  在伤口上敷上压布。

definitions.definition: To cover, as with a bandage.
definitions.example: to bind up a wound
definitions.definitionCn: 用绷带等覆盖。
definitions.exampleCn: 包扎伤口。

definitions.definition: To prevent or restrain from customary or natural action, as by producing constipation.
definitions.example: Certain drugs bind the bowels.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过引起便秘等方式，阻止或限制惯常或自然动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 某些药物会抑制肠道蠕动。

definitions.definition: To put together in a cover, as of books.
definitions.example: The three novels were bound together.
definitions.definitionCn: 将书页装订成封面。
definitions.exampleCn: 这三部小说被合订在一起。

definitions.definition: To make two or more elements stick together.
definitions.definitionCn: 使两个或多个元素粘合在一起。

definitions.definition: To associate an identifier with a value; to associate a variable name, method name, etc. with the content of a storage location.
definitions.definitionCn: 将标识符与值关联；将变量名、方法名等与存储位置的内容关联。

definitions.definition: To complain; to whine about something.
definitions.definitionCn: 抱怨；对某事发牢骚。

definitions.definition: A band worn around the waist to hold clothing to one's body (usually pants), hold weapons (such as a gun or sword), or serve as a decorative piece of clothing.
definitions.example: As part of the act, the fat clown's belt broke, causing his pants to fall down.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条系在腰间用于固定衣物（通常是裤子）、携带武器（如枪或剑）或作为装饰品的带子。
definitions.exampleCn: 作为表演的一部分，胖小丑的腰带断了，导致他的裤子掉了下来。

definitions.definition: A band used as a restraint for safety purposes, such as a seat belt.
definitions.example: Keep your belt fastened; this is going to be quite a bumpy ride.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于安全目的的限制性带子，例如安全带。
definitions.exampleCn: 系好你的安全带；这将是一段相当颠簸的旅程。

definitions.definition: A band that is used in a machine to help transfer motion or power.
definitions.example: The motor had a single belt that snaked its way back and forth around a variety of wheels.
definitions.definitionCn: 机器中用于帮助传递运动或动力的带子。
definitions.exampleCn: 马达上有一条单带，蜿蜒地来回绕过各种轮子。

definitions.definition: Anything that resembles a belt, or that encircles or crosses like a belt; a strip or stripe.
definitions.example: a belt of trees; a belt of sand
definitions.definitionCn: 任何类似腰带的东西，或像腰带一样环绕或交叉的东西；一条带子或条纹。
definitions.exampleCn: 一条树带；一条沙带

definitions.definition: A trophy in the shape of a belt, generally awarded for martial arts.
definitions.example: the heavyweight belt
definitions.definitionCn: 通常授予武术的腰带形状的奖杯。
definitions.exampleCn: 重量级冠军腰带

definitions.definition: A collection of rocky-constituted bodies (such as asteroids) which orbit a star.
definitions.definitionCn: 由岩石构成的天体（如小行星）组成的环带，绕恒星运行。

definitions.definition: One of certain girdles or zones on the surface of the planets Jupiter and Saturn, supposed to be of the nature of clouds.
definitions.definitionCn: 木星和土星表面某些带状或区域，被认为是云的性质。

definitions.definition: A powerful blow, often made with a fist or heavy object.
definitions.example: After the bouncer gave him a solid belt to the gut, Simon had suddenly had enough of barfighting.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常用拳头或重物进行的强力打击。
definitions.exampleCn: 在保安狠狠给了他一拳肚子后，西蒙突然受够了酒吧斗殴。

definitions.definition: A quick drink of liquor.
definitions.example: Care to join me in a belt of scotch?
definitions.definitionCn: 快速喝下的一口酒。
definitions.exampleCn: 想和我一起喝杯苏格兰威士忌吗？

definitions.definition: (usually capitalized) A geographical region known for a particular product, feature or demographic (Corn Belt, Bible Belt, Black Belt, Green Belt).
definitions.definitionCn: （通常大写）以特定产品、特征或人口统计闻名的地理区域（玉米带、圣经带、黑土带、绿化带）。

definitions.definition: The part of the strike zone at the height of the batter's waist.
definitions.example: That umpire called that pitch a strike at the belt.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球区中与击球员腰部齐高的部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个裁判判定那个投球在腰带高度是好球。

definitions.definition: Device that holds and feeds cartridges into a belt-fed weapon
definitions.definitionCn: 用于容纳并将弹药送入弹链供弹武器的装置。

definitions.definition: To encircle.
definitions.example: The small town was belted by cornfields in all directions.
definitions.definitionCn: 环绕。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个小镇被玉米地四面环绕。

definitions.definition: To fasten a belt on.
definitions.example: Edgar belted himself in and turned the car's ignition.
definitions.definitionCn: 系上腰带。
definitions.exampleCn: 埃德加系好安全带，转动了汽车的点火开关。

definitions.definition: To invest (a person) with a belt as part of a formal ceremony such as knighthood.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为正式仪式（如授爵）的一部分，授予（某人）腰带。

definitions.definition: To hit with a belt.
definitions.example: The child was misbehaving so he was belted as punishment.
definitions.definitionCn: 用腰带击打。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个孩子行为不端，所以被用腰带惩罚作为教训。

definitions.definition: To scream or sing in a loud manner.
definitions.example: He belted out the national anthem.
definitions.definitionCn: 大声喊叫或唱歌。
definitions.exampleCn: 他大声唱出了国歌。

definitions.definition: To drink quickly, often in gulps.
definitions.example: He belted down a shot of whisky.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速喝下，通常是一大口。
definitions.exampleCn: 他一口灌下了一杯威士忌。

definitions.definition: To hit someone or something.
definitions.example: The angry player belted the official across the face, and as a result was ejected from the game.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打某人或某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 愤怒的球员打了裁判的脸，结果被驱逐出比赛。

definitions.definition: To hit a pitched ball a long distance, usually for a home run.
definitions.example: He belted that pitch over the grandstand.
definitions.definitionCn: 将投出的球击出很远距离，通常是本垒打。
definitions.exampleCn: 他把那个球击过了看台。

definitions.definition: To move very fast
definitions.example: He was really belting along.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他真是飞速前进。

definitions.definition: The study of all life or living matter.
definitions.definitionCn: 对所有生命或生物体的研究。

definitions.definition: The living organisms of a particular region.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定区域的生物有机体。

definitions.definition: The structure, function, and behavior of an organism or type of organism.
definitions.example: the biology of the whale
definitions.definitionCn: 某一生物或生物类型的结构、功能和行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 鲸鱼的生物学。

definitions.definition: To make something holy by religious rite, sanctify.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过宗教仪式使某物神圣化，祝圣。

definitions.definition: To make the sign of the cross upon, so as to sanctify.
definitions.definitionCn: 画十字于其上以祝圣。

definitions.definition: To invoke divine favor upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 祈求神圣的眷顾。

definitions.definition: To honor as holy, glorify; to extol for excellence.
definitions.definitionCn: 尊为神圣，颂扬；因卓越而赞美。

definitions.definition: To esteem or account happy; to felicitate.
definitions.definitionCn: 视为幸福，祝贺。

definitions.definition: To wave; to brandish.
definitions.definitionCn: 挥舞；摇动。

definitions.definition: (past tense only blessed) To turn (a reference) into an object.
definitions.definitionCn: （仅过去式blessed）将（引用）转化为对象。

definitions.definition: (with from) To secure, defend, or prevent from.
definitions.definitionCn: （与from连用）保护、防御或阻止。

definitions.definition: Used as an expression of endearment, gratitude, or (ironically) belittlement.
A mixture of two or more things.
definitions.example: Our department has a good blend of experienced workers and young promise.
definitions.definitionCn: 两种或多种事物的混合物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们部门既有经验丰富的员工，也有年轻有为的新人，两者相得益彰。

definitions.definition: A word formed by combining two other words; a grammatical contamination, portmanteau word.
definitions.definitionCn: 由两个单词组合而成的新词；语法上的混合词，合成词。

definitions.definition: To mingle; to mix; to unite intimately; to pass or shade insensibly into each other.
definitions.example: To make hummus you need to blend chickpeas, olive oil, lemon juice and garlic.
definitions.definitionCn: 混合；融合；紧密结合；逐渐过渡或交融。
definitions.exampleCn: 制作鹰嘴豆泥需要将鹰嘴豆、橄榄油、柠檬汁和大蒜混合在一起。

definitions.definition: To be mingled or mixed.
definitions.definitionCn: 被混合或掺和在一起。

definitions.definition: To pollute by mixture or association; to spoil or corrupt; to blot; to stain.
definitions.definitionCn: 因混合或关联而污染；破坏或腐化；玷污；留下污点。

definitions.definition: A brag; ostentatious positive appraisal of oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 自夸；对自己进行炫耀性的正面评价。

definitions.definition: Something that one brags about.
definitions.example: It was his regular boast that he could eat two full English breakfasts in one sitting.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人自夸的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他常夸口说自己能一口气吃下两份全套英式早餐。

definitions.definition: A shot where the ball is driven off a side wall and then strikes the front wall.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种击球方式，球先击中侧墙再弹向前墙。

definitions.definition: To brag; to talk loudly in praise of oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 吹嘘；高声赞美自己。

definitions.definition: To speak of with pride, vanity, or exultation, with a view to self-commendation; to extol.
definitions.definitionCn: 带着自豪、虚荣或得意地谈论，旨在自我表扬；极力称赞。

definitions.definition: To speak in exulting language of another; to glory; to exult.
definitions.definitionCn: 以得意洋洋的语气谈论他人；引以为豪；欢欣鼓舞。

definitions.definition: To play a boast shot.
definitions.definitionCn: 打一记炫耀性的击球。

definitions.definition: To possess something special.
definitions.example: His family boasted a famous name.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有某种特别的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的家族曾拥有一个显赫的姓氏。

definitions.definition: To dress, as a stone, with a broad chisel.
(sculpting) To shape roughly as a preparation for the finer work to follow; to cut to the general form required.
A blossom; the flower of a plant; an expanded bud.
definitions.definitionCn: 花朵；植物的花；展开的花蕾。

definitions.definition: Flowers, collectively.
definitions.definitionCn: 花卉总称。

definitions.definition: The opening of flowers in general; the state of blossoming or of having the flowers open.
definitions.example: The cherry trees are in bloom.
definitions.definitionCn: 泛指花朵开放；开花或花朵绽放的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 樱花正值盛开。

definitions.definition: A state or time of beauty, freshness, and vigor; an opening to higher perfection, analogous to that of buds into blossoms.
definitions.example: the bloom of youth
definitions.definitionCn: 美丽、清新与活力的状态或时期；向更高完美境界的开启，如同花蕾绽放成花朵。
definitions.exampleCn: 青春年华。

definitions.definition: Rosy colour; the flush or glow on a person's cheek.
definitions.definitionCn: 红润色泽；脸颊上的红晕或光彩。

definitions.definition: The delicate, powdery coating upon certain growing or newly-gathered fruits or leaves, as on grapes, plums, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些生长中或新采摘的果实或叶片上细腻的粉状覆盖物，如葡萄、李子等。

definitions.definition: Anything giving an appearance of attractive freshness.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何赋予清新迷人外观的东西。

definitions.definition: The clouded appearance which varnish sometimes takes upon the surface of a picture.
definitions.definitionCn: 清漆在画作表面有时形成的朦胧外观。

definitions.definition: A yellowish deposit or powdery coating which appears on well-tanned leather.
definitions.definitionCn: 出现在鞣制良好的皮革上的淡黄色沉积物或粉状涂层。

definitions.definition: A bright-hued variety of some minerals.
definitions.example: the rose-red cobalt bloom
definitions.definitionCn: 某些矿物的鲜艳变种。

definitions.definition: (of a storm) To begin; to end.

definitions.definition: (of morning, dawn, day etc.) To arrive.
definitions.example: Morning has broken.

definitions.definition: To render (a game) unchallenging by altering its rules or exploiting loopholes or weaknesses in them in a way that gives a player an unfair advantage.
definitions.example: Changing the rules to let white have three extra queens would break chess.

definitions.definition: To stop, or to cause to stop, functioning properly or altogether.
definitions.example: Did you two break the trolley by racing with it?

definitions.definition: To cause (a barrier) to no longer bar.
definitions.example: break a seal

definitions.definition: To destroy the arrangement of; to throw into disorder; to pierce.
definitions.example: The cavalry were not able to break the British squares.

definitions.definition: (of a wave of water) To collapse into surf, after arriving in shallow water.
To burst forth; to make its way; to come into view.
To interrupt or cease one's work or occupation temporarily.
definitions.example: Let's break for lunch.

definitions.definition: To interrupt (a fall) by inserting something so that the falling object does not (immediately) hit something else beneath.
definitions.example: He survived the jump out the window because the bushes below broke his fall.

definitions.definition: To disclose or make known an item of news, etc.
definitions.example: I don't know how to break this to you, but your cat is not coming back.

definitions.definition: (of a sound) To become audible suddenly.
To change a steady state abruptly.
definitions.example: His coughing broke the silence.

definitions.definition: To suddenly become.
definitions.example: The arrest was standard, when suddenly the suspect broke ugly.

definitions.definition: Of a male voice, to become deeper at puberty.
Of a voice, to alter in type due to emotion or strain: in men generally to go up, in women sometimes to go down; to crack.
definitions.example: His voice breaks when he gets emotional.

definitions.definition: To surpass or do better than (a specific number), to do better than (a record), setting a new record.
definitions.example: He broke the men's 100-meter record.

definitions.definition: (most often in the passive tense) To demote, to reduce the military rank of.
To end (a connection), to disconnect.
definitions.example: I couldn't hear a thing he was saying, so I broke the connection and called him back.

definitions.definition: (of an emulsion) To demulsify.
To counter-attack
To lay open, as a purpose; to disclose, divulge, or communicate.
To become weakened in constitution or faculties; to lose health or strength.
To fail in business; to become bankrupt.
To destroy the strength, firmness, or consistency of.
definitions.example: to break flax

definitions.definition: To destroy the official character and standing of; to cashier; to dismiss.
To make an abrupt or sudden change; to change the gait.
definitions.example: to break into a run or gallop

definitions.definition: To fall out; to terminate friendship.
To terminate the execution of a program before normal completion.
To suspend the execution of a program during debugging so that the state of the program can be investigated.
The dividing line or location between two areas.
definitions.definitionCn: 两个区域之间的分界线或位置。

definitions.definition: (often in the plural) The bounds, confines, or limits between immaterial things (such as one’s comfort zone, privacy, or professional sphere and the realm beyond).
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）非物质事物（如个人舒适区、隐私或职业领域与外界）之间的界限、范围或限制。

definitions.definition: An edge or line marking an edge of the playing field.
definitions.definitionCn: 标记运动场地边缘的边线或界线。

definitions.definition: An event whereby the ball is struck and either touches or passes over a boundary (with or without bouncing), usually resulting in an award of 4 (four) or 6 (six) runs respectively for the batting team.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球后球触及或越过边界线（无论是否弹跳）的事件，通常分别判给击球队4分或6分。

definitions.definition: (of a set) The set of points in the closure of a set S, not belonging to the interior of that set.
definitions.definitionCn: （集合论中）属于集合S闭包但不属于其内部的点集。

definitions.definition: A light, gentle wind.
definitions.example: The breeze rustled the papers on her desk.
definitions.definitionCn: 一阵轻柔的风。
definitions.exampleCn: 微风翻动了她桌上的文件。

definitions.definition: Any activity that is easy, not testing or difficult.
definitions.example: After studying Latin, Spanish was a breeze.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何轻松、不具挑战性或困难的活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 学完拉丁语后，西班牙语简直是小菜一碟。

definitions.definition: Wind blowing across a cricket match, whatever its strength.
definitions.definitionCn: 风吹过板球比赛，无论风力大小。

definitions.definition: Ashes and residue of coal or charcoal, usually from a furnace. See Wikipedia article on Clinker.
definitions.definitionCn: 煤或木炭的灰烬和残渣，通常来自熔炉。参见维基百科关于炉渣的文章。

definitions.definition: An excited or ruffled state of feeling; a flurry of excitement; a disturbance; a quarrel.

definitions.definitionCn: 激动或烦躁的情绪状态；一阵兴奋；骚动；争吵。
definitions.exampleCn: 这一发现引发了一阵骚动。

definitions.definition: A brief workout for a racehorse.
definitions.definitionCn: 赛马前的简短热身运动。

definitions.definition: (usually with along) To move casually, in a carefree manner.

definitions.definition: To blow gently.

definitions.definition: A gadfly; a horsefly; a strong-bodied dipterous insect of the family Tabanidae.
To buzz.
A metallic alloy of copper and zinc used in many industrial and plumbing applications.
definitions.definitionCn: 铜锌合金，用于工业和管道领域。

definitions.definition: A class of wind instruments, usually made of metal (such as brass), that use vibrations of the player's lips to produce sound; the section of an orchestra that features such instruments
definitions.definitionCn: 一类管乐器，通常由金属（如黄铜）制成，利用演奏者嘴唇振动发声；管弦乐队中演奏此类乐器的声部。

definitions.definition: Spent shell casings (usually made of brass); the part of the cartridge left over after bullets have been fired.
definitions.definitionCn: 弹壳（通常由黄铜制成）；子弹发射后留下的弹壳部分。

definitions.definition: The colour of brass.
definitions.definitionCn: 黄铜的颜色。

definitions.definition: (used as a singular or plural noun, metonym) High-ranking officers.

definitions.definitionCn: （用作单数或复数名词，转喻）高级军官。
definitions.exampleCn: 高层不会喜欢这个。

definitions.definition: A brave or foolhardy attitude; impudence.
definitions.example: You've got a lot of brass telling me to do that!
definitions.definitionCn: 勇敢或鲁莽的态度；厚颜无耻。

definitions.definition: Money.
definitions.definitionCn: 金钱。

definitions.definition: Inferior composition.
definitions.definitionCn: 劣质材料。

definitions.definition: To coat with brass.
definitions.definitionCn: 用黄铜覆盖。

definitions.definition: Made of brass, of or pertaining to brass.
definitions.definitionCn: 由黄铜制成，与黄铜相关的。

definitions.definition: Of the colour of brass.
definitions.definitionCn: 黄铜色的。

definitions.definition: Impertinent, bold: brazen.
definitions.definitionCn: 无礼的，大胆的；厚颜无耻的。

definitions.definition: Bad, annoying; as wordplay applied especially to brass instruments.
definitions.definitionCn: 糟糕的，烦人的；尤指对铜管乐器的文字游戏。

definitions.definition: Of inferior composition.
definitions.definitionCn: 劣质的。

definitions.definition: Brass in pocket; money.
A brass nail; a prostitute.
Brass monkey; cold.

definitions.definitionCn: 同一物种或亚种的所有动物或植物。
definitions.exampleCn: 一种动物品种。

definitions.definition: A race or lineage; offspring or issue.
definitions.definitionCn: 种族或血统；后代或子嗣。

definitions.definition: A group of people with shared characteristics.

definitions.definitionCn: 具有共同特征的一群人。
definitions.exampleCn: 在学校学过古典希腊语和拉丁语的人正逐渐消失。

definitions.definition: To produce offspring sexually; to bear young.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过有性生殖产生后代；生育幼崽。

definitions.definition: To give birth to; to be the native place of.

definitions.definitionCn: 生育；作为……的出生地。

definitions.definition: Of animals, to mate.
definitions.definitionCn: （指动物）交配。

definitions.definition: To keep animals and have them reproduce in a way that improves the next generation’s qualities.
definitions.definitionCn: 以改良下一代品质的方式饲养动物并使其繁殖。

definitions.definition: To arrange the mating of specific animals.
definitions.example: She wanted to breed her cow to the neighbor's registered bull.
definitions.definitionCn: 安排特定动物的交配。
definitions.exampleCn: 她想让自己的母牛与邻居注册的公牛配种。

definitions.definition: To propagate or grow plants trying to give them certain qualities.
definitions.example: He tries to breed blue roses.
definitions.definitionCn: 繁殖或种植植物，试图赋予它们特定品质。
definitions.exampleCn: 他试图培育蓝色玫瑰。

definitions.definition: To take care of in infancy and through childhood; to bring up.
definitions.definitionCn: 在婴儿期和童年期照料；抚养。

definitions.definition: To yield or result in.

definitions.definitionCn: 导致或产生结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 灾难导致饥荒；熟悉导致轻视。

definitions.definition: To be formed in the parent or dam; to be generated, or to grow, like young before birth.
definitions.definitionCn: 在母体内形成；像出生前的幼体一样被生成或生长。

definitions.definition: (sometimes as breed up) To educate; to instruct; to bring up
definitions.definitionCn: （有时作 breed up）教育；指导；抚养。

definitions.definition: To produce or obtain by any natural process.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过任何自然过程产生或获得。

definitions.definition: To have birth; to be produced, developed or multiplied.
definitions.definitionCn: 出生；被产生、发展或繁殖。

definitions.definition: To ejaculate inside someone's ass
definitions.definitionCn: 在某人肛门内射精。

definitions.definition: The chest, or front of the human thorax.
definitions.definitionCn: 胸部，或人类胸腔的前部。

definitions.definition: A section of clothing covering the breast area.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖乳房区域的衣物部分。

definitions.definition: The figurative seat of the emotions, feelings etc.; one's heart or innermost thoughts.

definitions.definitionCn: 情感、感受等的比喻性所在；内心或最深处思想。

definitions.definition: The ventral portion of an animal's thorax.

definitions.example: Would you like breast or wing?

definitions.exampleCn: 您要胸肉还是翅膀？

definitions.definition: The front or forward part of anything.
definitions.example: a chimney breast; a plough breast
definitions.definitionCn: 任何物体的前部或向前部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 烟囱胸墙；犁胸

definitions.definition: The face of a coal working.
definitions.definitionCn: 煤矿工作面的正面。

definitions.definition: The front of a furnace.
definitions.definitionCn: 熔炉的前部。

definitions.definition: The power of singing; a musical voice.
definitions.definitionCn: 歌唱的能力；音乐嗓音。

definitions.definition: To push against with the breast; to meet full on, oppose, face.
definitions.definitionCn: 用胸部推挤；正面迎击、对抗、面对。

definitions.definition: To reach the top (of a hill).
definitions.example: He breasted the hill and saw the town before him.
definitions.definitionCn: 到达（山丘）顶部。
definitions.exampleCn: 他登上山顶，看到了前方的城镇。

definitions.definition: To debreast.
definitions.definitionCn: 去除乳房。

definitions.definition: The extent or measure of how broad or wide something is.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物宽广或宽阔的程度或度量。

definitions.definition: A piece of fabric of standard width.
definitions.definitionCn: 标准宽度的布料。

definitions.definition: Scope or range, especially of knowledge or skill.
definitions.definitionCn: 范围或领域，尤指知识或技能。

definitions.definition: A style in painting in which details are strictly subordinated to the harmony of the whole composition.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种绘画风格，其中细节严格服从于整体构图的和谐。

definitions.definitionCn: 图中两个顶点之间最长路径的长度。

definitions.definition: A hardened rectangular block of mud, clay etc., used for building.

definitions.definition: Such hardened mud, clay, etc. considered collectively, as a building material.
definitions.example: This house is made of brick.
definitions.definitionCn: 这种硬化的泥、黏土等材料统称为建筑材料。

definitions.definition: Something shaped like a brick.

definitions.definitionCn: 形状像砖块的东西。

definitions.definition: A helpful and reliable person.

definitions.definitionCn: 一个乐于助人且可靠的人。

definitions.definition: A power brick; an external power supply consisting of a small box with an integral male power plug and an attached electric cord terminating in another power plug.

definitions.definitionCn: 一种电子设备，尤其是笨重的盒状设备，已失效或过时。

definitions.definition: The colour brick red.

definitions.definition: One kilo of cocaine.

definitions.definition: To build with bricks.

definitions.definition: (of weather) Extremely cold.

definitions.definition: To make something bend or curve.

definitions.definitionCn: 烙铁。

definitions.definition: The symbolic identity, represented by a name and/or a logo, which indicates a certain product or service to the public.
definitions.definitionCn: 以名称和/或标志为代表的象征性身份，向公众表明某种产品或服务。

definitions.definition: A specific product, service, or provider so distinguished.
definitions.example: Some brands of breakfast cereal contain a lot of sugar.
definitions.definitionCn: 如此区分的特定产品、服务或提供者。
definitions.exampleCn: 某些品牌的早餐麦片含糖量很高。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Any specific type or variety of something; a distinct style or manner.
definitions.example: I didn't appreciate his particular brand of flattery.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）任何特定类型或种类的某物；独特的风格或方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不欣赏他那种特别的奉承方式。

definitions.definition: The public image or reputation and recognized, typical style of an individual or group.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人或群体的公众形象、声誉以及公认的典型风格。

definitions.definition: A mark of infamy; stigma.
definitions.definitionCn: 耻辱的标记；污名。

definitions.definition: Any minute fungus producing a burnt appearance in plants.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何使植物呈现烧焦外观的微小真菌。

definitions.definition: To burn the flesh with a hot iron, either as a marker (for criminals, slaves etc.) or to cauterise a wound.
definitions.example: When they caught him, he was branded and then locked up.
definitions.definitionCn: 用热铁灼烧皮肤，作为标记（用于罪犯、奴隶等）或烧灼伤口。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们抓住他后，给他打上烙印并关押起来。

definitions.definition: To mark (especially cattle) with a brand as proof of ownership.
definitions.example: The ranch hands had to brand every new calf by lunchtime.
definitions.definitionCn: 用烙印标记（尤指牲畜）作为所有权证明。
definitions.exampleCn: 牧场工人们必须在午餐前给每头新生的牛犊打上烙印。

definitions.definition: To make an indelible impression on the memory or senses.
definitions.example: Her face is branded upon my memory.
definitions.definitionCn: 在记忆或感官上留下不可磨灭的印象。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的面容深深烙印在我的记忆中。

definitions.definition: To stigmatize, label (someone).
definitions.example: He was branded a fool by everyone that heard his story.
definitions.definitionCn: 污名化，给（某人）贴上标签。
definitions.exampleCn: 每个听到他故事的人都把他视为傻瓜。

definitions.definition: To associate a product or service with a trademark or other name and related images.
definitions.example: They branded the new detergent "Suds-O", with a nature scene inside a green O on the muted-colored recycled-cardboard box.
definitions.definitionCn: 将产品或服务与商标或其他名称及相关形象关联起来。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们将新洗涤剂命名为“Suds-O”，在哑色再生纸板盒上，绿色O内有一幅自然场景。

definitions.definition: The ridge over the eyes; the eyebrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 眉脊；眉毛。

definitions.definition: The first tine of an antler's beam.
definitions.definitionCn: 鹿角主枝的第一叉。

definitions.definition: The forehead.
definitions.definitionCn: 前额。

definitions.definition: The projecting upper edge of a steep place such as a hill.
definitions.example: the brow of a precipice
definitions.definitionCn: 陡峭地形（如山丘）的突出上缘。
definitions.exampleCn: 悬崖的边缘。

definitions.definition: A gallery in a coal mine running across the face of the coal.
definitions.definitionCn: 煤矿中横穿煤面的巷道。

definitions.definition: Aspect; appearance.
definitions.definitionCn: 外观；面貌。

definitions.definition: The gangway from ship to shore when a ship is lying alongside a quay.
definitions.definitionCn: 船舶靠岸时连接船与岸的舷梯。

definitions.definition: The hinged part of a landing craft or ferry which is lowered to form a landing platform; a ramp.
definitions.definitionCn: 登陆艇或渡轮上铰接的部分，放下后形成登陆平台；坡道。

definitions.definition: To bound or limit; to be at, or form, the edge of.
definitions.definitionCn: 界定或限制；处于或形成……的边缘。

definitions.definition: The amount of money or resources earmarked for a particular institution, activity or time-frame.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定机构、活动或时间段预留的资金或资源。

definitions.definition: An itemized summary of intended expenditure; usually coupled with expected revenue.
definitions.definitionCn: 预期支出的分项汇总；通常与预期收入并列。

definitions.definition: A wallet, purse or bag.
definitions.definitionCn: 钱包、钱袋或手提包。

definitions.definition: A compact collection of things.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧凑的物品集合。

definitions.definition: A socket in which the end of a cavalry carbine rests.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑兵卡宾枪枪托的插座。

definitions.definition: To construct or draw up a budget.
definitions.example: Budgeting is even harder in times of recession
definitions.definitionCn: 编制或起草预算。
definitions.exampleCn: 经济衰退时期预算编制更加困难。

definitions.definition: To provide funds, allow for in a budget.
definitions.example: The PM’s pet projects are budgeted rather generously
definitions.definitionCn: 提供资金，在预算中允许。
definitions.exampleCn: 首相的宠儿项目预算相当慷慨。

definitions.definition: To plan for the use of in a budget.
definitions.example: The prestigious building project is budgeted in great detail, from warf facilities to the protocollary opening.
definitions.definitionCn: 计划在预算中使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个著名的建筑项目预算编制得非常详细，从码头设施到礼仪性开幕。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to a budget.
definitions.definitionCn: 预算的或与预算相关的。

definitions.definition: Appropriate to a restricted budget.
definitions.example: We flew on a budget airline.
definitions.definitionCn: 适合有限预算的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们乘坐廉价航空飞行。

definitions.definition: Size, specifically, volume.
definitions.definitionCn: 尺寸，特指体积。

definitions.definition: Any huge body or structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何巨大的物体或结构。

definitions.definition: The major part of something.
definitions.example: I understood the bulk of what you were saying, just one of two points I need to hear again.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物的主要部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 我理解了你所说的大部分内容，只有一两个点需要再听一遍。

definitions.definition: Dietary fibre.
definitions.definitionCn: 膳食纤维。

definitions.definition: Unpackaged goods when transported in large volumes, e.g. coal, ore or grain.
definitions.definitionCn: 散装运输的货物，如煤、矿石或谷物。

definitions.definition: A cargo or any items moved or communicated in the manner of cargo.
definitions.definitionCn: 以货物方式运输或传递的货物或任何物品。

definitions.definition: Excess body mass, especially muscle.
definitions.definitionCn: 过量的身体质量，尤其是肌肉。

definitions.definition: A period where one tries to gain muscle.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图增肌的时期。

definitions.definition: (brane cosmology) A hypothetical higher-dimensional space within which our own four-dimensional universe may exist.
definitions.definitionCn: （膜宇宙学）一个假设的高维空间，我们的四维宇宙可能存在于其中。

definitions.definition: The body.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体。

definitions.definition: To appear or seem to be, as to bulk or extent.
definitions.definitionCn: 看起来或似乎是，就体积或范围而言。

definitions.definition: To grow in size; to swell or expand.
definitions.definitionCn: 尺寸增大；膨胀或扩展。

definitions.definition: To gain body mass by means of diet, exercise, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过饮食、锻炼等方式增加体重。

definitions.definition: To put or hold in bulk.
definitions.definitionCn: 以散装形式放置或持有。

definitions.definition: To add bulk to, to bulk out.
definitions.definitionCn: 增加体积，使膨胀。

definitions.definition: Being large in size, mass or volume (of goods, etc.)
definitions.definitionCn: （货物等）尺寸、质量或体积大。

definitions.definition: Total
definitions.definitionCn: 总计。

definitions.definition: A transmission of a radio or television programme intended to be received by anyone with a receiver.
definitions.definitionCn: 无线电或电视节目的传输，旨在让任何拥有接收器的人都能接收。

definitions.definition: A programme (bulletin, documentary, show, etc.) so transmitted.
definitions.example: The DJ was feeling nervous before his first national broadcast.
definitions.definitionCn: 以这种方式传输的节目（简报、纪录片、演出等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位DJ在首次全国广播前感到紧张。

definitions.definition: The act of scattering seed; a crop grown from such seed.
definitions.definitionCn: 撒种的行为；由此种子长成的作物。

definitions.definition: To transmit a message or signal through radio waves or electronic means.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过无线电波或电子方式传输信息或信号。

definitions.definition: To transmit a message over a wide area; specifically, to send an email in a single transmission to a (typically large) number of people.
definitions.definitionCn: 在广泛区域内传输信息；特指通过单次传输向（通常为大量）人群发送电子邮件。

definitions.definition: To appear as a performer, presenter, or speaker in a broadcast programme.
definitions.definitionCn: 在广播节目中作为表演者、主持人或演讲者出现。

definitions.definition: To sow seeds over a wide area.
definitions.definitionCn: 在广阔区域撒播种子。

definitions.definition: Cast or scattered widely in all directions; cast abroad.
definitions.definitionCn: 向四面八方广泛播撒或散布；传播到远方。

definitions.definition: Communicated, signalled, or transmitted through radio waves or electronic means.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过无线电波或电子方式传达、发送信号或传输。

definitions.definition: Relating to transmissions of messages or signals through radio waves or electronic means.
definitions.definitionCn: 与通过无线电波或电子方式传输信息或信号相关的。

definitions.definition: Widely in all directions; abroad.
definitions.definitionCn: 向四面八方广泛地；在远方。

definitions.definition: By having its seeds sown over a wide area.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过将其种子播撒在广阔区域。

definitions.definition: A naturally occurring or man-made alloy of copper, usually in combination with tin, but also with one or more other metals.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种天然存在或人造的铜合金，通常与锡结合，但也可能包含一种或多种其他金属。

definitions.definition: A reddish-brown colour, the colour of bronze.
definitions.definitionCn: 红褐色，青铜的颜色。

definitions.definition: A work of art made of bronze, especially a sculpture.
definitions.definitionCn: 用青铜制成的艺术品，尤指雕塑。

definitions.definition: A bronze medal.
definitions.example: She wanted to win the tournament, but had to settle for the bronze after being beaten in the semi-finals.
definitions.definitionCn: 铜牌。
definitions.exampleCn: 她想赢得比赛，但在半决赛中被击败后只能屈居铜牌。

definitions.definition: Boldness; impudence; brass.
definitions.definitionCn: 大胆；厚颜无耻；厚脸皮。

definitions.definition: To plate with bronze.
definitions.example: My mother bronzed my first pair of baby shoes.
definitions.definitionCn: 镀青铜。
definitions.exampleCn: 我母亲把我第一双婴儿鞋镀成了青铜色。

definitions.definition: To color bronze; (of the sun) to tan.
definitions.definitionCn: 使呈青铜色；（太阳）晒黑。

definitions.definition: (of the skin) To change to a bronze or tan colour due to exposure to the sun.
definitions.definitionCn: （皮肤）因日晒变成青铜色或古铜色。

definitions.definition: To make hard or unfeeling; to brazen.
definitions.definitionCn: 使变硬或变得冷酷；使厚颜无耻。

definitions.definition: Made of bronze metal.
definitions.definitionCn: 由青铜金属制成的。

definitions.definition: Having a reddish-brown colour.
definitions.definitionCn: 呈红褐色的。

definitions.definition: (of the skin) Tanned; darkened as a result of exposure to the sun.
definitions.definitionCn: （皮肤）晒黑的；因日晒而变黑的。

definitions.definition: Son of the same parents as another person.
definitions.definitionCn: 与另一个人有相同父母的人。

definitions.definition: A male having at least one parent in common with another (see half-brother, stepbrother).
definitions.definitionCn: 与另一个人至少有一个共同父母的男性（参见同父异母/同母异父兄弟、继兄弟）。

definitions.definition: A male fellow member of a religious community, church, trades union etc.
definitions.example: I would like to thank the brother who just spoke.
definitions.definitionCn: 宗教团体、教会、工会等组织中的男性成员。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想感谢刚才发言的兄弟。

definitions.definition: A form of address to a man.
definitions.example: Listen, brother, I don't know what you want, but I'm not interested.
definitions.definitionCn: 对男性的称呼。
definitions.exampleCn: 听着，兄弟，我不知道你想要什么，但我不感兴趣。

definitions.definition: A black male.
definitions.definitionCn: 黑人男性。

definitions.definition: Somebody, usually male, connected by a common cause or situation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常指因共同事业或处境而联系在一起的男性。

definitions.definition: Someone who is a peer, whether male or female.
definitions.definitionCn: 同辈的人，无论男女。

definitions.definition: To treat as a brother.
definitions.definitionCn: 像兄弟一样对待。

definitions.definition: Expressing exasperation.
definitions.example: We're being forced to work overtime? Oh, brother!
definitions.definitionCn: 表示恼怒。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们被迫加班？哦，天哪！

definitions.definition: A finely cut gemstone, especially a diamond, cut in a particular form with numerous facets so as to maximize light return through the top (called "table") of the stone.
definitions.definitionCn: 精细切割的宝石，尤指钻石，以特定形状切割出众多刻面，使光线从顶部（称为"台面"）最大程度反射回来。

definitions.definition: The size of type between excelsior and diamond, standardized as 4-point.
definitions.definitionCn: 介于极细字与钻石体之间的字号，标准为4点。

definitions.definition: Most hummingbird species of the genus Heliodoxa.
definitions.definitionCn: 大多数属于Heliodoxa属的蜂鸟物种。

definitions.definition: A kind of cotton goods, figured on the weaving.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种棉织品，织造时带有花纹。

definitions.definition: Shining brightly.
definitions.example: the brilliant lights along the promenade
definitions.definitionCn: 明亮地闪耀。
definitions.exampleCn: 海滨大道上璀璨的灯光

definitions.definition: (of a colour) Both bright and saturated.
definitions.example: butterflies with brilliant blue wings
definitions.definitionCn: （指颜色）既明亮又饱和。
definitions.exampleCn: 翅膀闪着亮蓝色的蝴蝶

definitions.definition: (of a voice or sound) Having a sharp, clear tone
definitions.definitionCn: （指声音或音色）具有尖锐清晰的音调。

definitions.definition: Of surpassing excellence.
definitions.example: The actor's performance in the play was simply brilliant.
definitions.definitionCn: 卓越超群。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位演员在剧中的表演简直精彩绝伦。

definitions.definition: Magnificent or wonderful.
definitions.definitionCn: 壮丽或绝妙的。

definitions.definition: Highly intelligent.
definitions.example: She is a brilliant scientist.
definitions.definitionCn: 极其聪明的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她是一位杰出的科学家。

definitions.definition: A writ summoning one to answer to any action.
definitions.definitionCn: 传唤某人应诉任何诉讼的令状。

definitions.definition: An answer to any action.
definitions.definitionCn: 对任何诉讼的答辩。

definitions.definition: A memorandum of points of fact or of law for use in conducting a case.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于处理案件的事实或法律要点备忘录。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A position of interest or advocacy.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）利益或倡导的立场。

definitions.definition: An attorney's legal argument in written form for submission to a court.
definitions.definitionCn: 律师以书面形式向法院提交的法律论点。

definitions.definition: (English law) The material relevant to a case, delivered by a solicitor to the barrister who tries the case.
definitions.definitionCn: （英国法律）由事务律师交给出庭律师的案件相关材料。

definitions.definition: A short news story or report.
definitions.example: We got a news brief.
definitions.definitionCn: 简短的新闻报道或报告。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们收到了一条新闻简报。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) undershorts briefs.
definitions.example: I wear boxers under trousers but for sports I usually wear a brief.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）平角内裤。
definitions.exampleCn: 我穿裤子时里面穿平角裤，但运动时通常穿紧身内裤。

definitions.definition: A summary, précis or epitome; an abridgement or abstract.
definitions.definitionCn: 摘要、概要或节略；删节或摘要。

definitions.definition: A letter patent, from proper authority, authorizing a collection or charitable contribution of money in churches, for any public or private purpose.
definitions.definitionCn: 由主管当局颁发的专利许可，授权在教堂为任何公共或私人目的募捐或慈善捐款。

definitions.definition: (slang) A ticket of any type.
definitions.definitionCn: （俚语）任何类型的票据。

definitions.definition: To summarize a recent development to some person with decision-making power.
definitions.example: The U.S. president was briefed on the military coup and its implications on African stability.
definitions.definitionCn: 向有决策权的人简要总结最新进展。
definitions.exampleCn: 美国总统听取了关于军事政变及其对非洲稳定影响的简报。

definitions.definition: To write a legal argument and submit it to a court.
definitions.definitionCn: 撰写法律论点并提交给法院。

definitions.definition: Of short duration; happening quickly.
definitions.example: Her reign was brief but spectacular.
definitions.definitionCn: 持续时间短的；迅速发生的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的统治短暂却辉煌。

definitions.definition: Concise; taking few words.
definitions.example: His speech of acceptance was brief but moving.
definitions.definitionCn: 简洁的；用词少的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的获奖感言简短却感人。

definitions.definition: Occupying a small distance, area or spatial extent; short.
definitions.example: Her skirt was extremely brief but doubtless cool.
definitions.definitionCn: 占据小距离、面积或空间范围的；短的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的裙子极短，但无疑很凉爽。

definitions.definition: Rife; common; prevalent.
definitions.definitionCn: 普遍的；常见的；流行的。

definitions.definition: Briefly.
definitions.definitionCn: 简短地。

definitions.definition: Soon; quickly.
definitions.definitionCn: 不久；很快。

definitions.definition: A spherically contained volume of air or other gas, especially one made from soapy liquid.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个球形封闭容器内的空气或其他气体，尤指肥皂液制成的气泡。

definitions.definition: A small spherical cavity in a solid material.
definitions.example: bubbles in window glass, or in a lens
definitions.definitionCn: 固体材料中的微小球形空腔。
definitions.exampleCn: 窗玻璃或透镜中的气泡。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Anything resembling a hollow sphere.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）任何类似空心球体的东西。

definitions.definition: Anything lacking firmness or solidity; a cheat or fraud; an empty project.
definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏坚实性或稳固性的事物；骗局或欺诈；空洞的计划。

definitions.definition: A period of intense speculation in a market, causing prices to rise quickly to irrational levels as the metaphorical bubble expands, and then fall even more quickly as the bubble bursts.
definitions.example: dot-com bubble
definitions.definitionCn: 市场中一段投机狂潮，导致价格迅速升至非理性水平（如同气泡膨胀），随后因泡沫破裂而更急剧下跌。
definitions.exampleCn: 互联网泡沫。

definitions.definition: The emotional and/or physical atmosphere in which the subject is immersed.
definitions.definitionCn: 主体沉浸其中的情感和/或物理氛围。

definitions.definition: An officer's station in a prison dormitory, affording views on all sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 监狱宿舍中可环视四周的狱警岗位。

definitions.definition: Someone who has been ‘bubbled’ or fooled; a dupe.
definitions.definitionCn: 被欺骗或愚弄的人；受骗者。

definitions.definition: A small, hollow, floating bead or globe, formerly used for testing the strength of spirits.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于测试烈酒浓度的小型空心浮球或浮珠。

definitions.definition: The globule of air in the chamber of a spirit level.
definitions.definitionCn: 水平仪气泡管中的气泡。

definitions.definition: A laugh.
definitions.example: Are you having a bubble?!
definitions.definitionCn: 笑声。
definitions.exampleCn: 你在开玩笑吗？！

definitions.definition: A Greek.
definitions.definitionCn: 希腊人。

definitions.definition: Any of the small magnetized areas that make up bubble memory.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成磁泡存储器的微小磁化区域。

definitions.definition: The point in a poker tournament when the last player without a prize loses all their chips and leaves the game, leaving only players that are going to win prizes. (e.g., if the last remaining 9 players win prizes, then the point when the 10th player leaves the tournament)
definitions.example: Many players tend to play timidly (not play many hands) around the bubble, to keep their chips and last longer in the game.
definitions.definitionCn: 扑克锦标赛中最后一名未获奖的玩家输光筹码离场，仅剩获奖玩家的时刻（例如，若最后9名玩家获奖，则第10名玩家离场时即为该点）。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多玩家在泡沫期倾向于谨慎出牌（少玩手牌），以保住筹码并在游戏中存活更久。

definitions.definition: A group of people who are in quarantine together.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群共同隔离的人。

definitions.definition: To produce bubbles, to rise up in bubbles (such as in foods cooking or liquids boiling).
definitions.definitionCn: 产生气泡，以气泡形式上升（如食物烹饪或液体沸腾时）。

definitions.definition: To churn or foment, as if wishing to rise to the surface.
definitions.example: Rage bubbled inside him.
definitions.definitionCn: 搅动或翻腾，仿佛要浮出水面。
definitions.exampleCn: 愤怒在他心中翻涌。

definitions.definition: To rise through a medium or system, similar to the way that bubbles rise in liquid.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过介质或系统上升，类似气泡在液体中上升的方式。

definitions.definition: To cheat, delude.
definitions.definitionCn: 欺骗，蒙骗。

definitions.definition: To cry, weep.
definitions.definitionCn: 哭泣，流泪。

definitions.definition: To pat a baby on the back so as to cause it to belch.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻拍婴儿背部促使其打嗝。

definitions.definition: To cause to feel as if bubbling or churning.
definitions.definitionCn: 使人感觉像在冒泡或翻腾。

definitions.definition: To express in a bubbly or lively manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 以活泼冒泡的方式表达。

definitions.definition: To form into a protruding round shape.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成凸起的圆形形状。

definitions.definition: To cover with bubbles.
definitions.definitionCn: 用气泡覆盖。

definitions.definition: To bubble in; to mark a response on a form by filling in a circular area (‘bubble’).
definitions.definitionCn: 在表格上通过填充圆形区域（“气泡”）标记答案。

definitions.definition: To separate into two or more pieces, to fracture or crack, by a process that cannot easily be reversed for reassembly.
definitions.example: If the vase falls to the floor, it might break.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物分成两块或多块，通过难以轻易复原的过程使其断裂或开裂。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果花瓶掉到地板上，它可能会碎。

definitions.definition: To divide (something, often money) into smaller units.
definitions.example: Can you break a hundred-dollar bill for me?
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物，常指钱）分成更小的单位。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能帮我把一百美元钞票换成零钱吗？

definitions.definition: To cause (a person or animal) to lose spirit or will; to crush the spirits of.
definitions.example: Her child's death broke Angela.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（人或动物）失去精神或意志；摧毁其士气。
definitions.exampleCn: 她孩子的去世让安吉拉崩溃了。

definitions.definition: To be crushed, or overwhelmed with sorrow or grief.
definitions.example: My heart is breaking.
definitions.definitionCn: 被悲伤或悲痛压垮。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的心碎了。

definitions.definition: To interrupt; to destroy the continuity of; to dissolve or terminate.
definitions.example: I had won four games in a row, but now you've broken my streak of luck.
definitions.definitionCn: 打断；破坏连续性；解散或终止。
definitions.exampleCn: 我连续赢了四场比赛，但现在你打破了我的好运。

definitions.definition: To ruin financially.
definitions.example: The recession broke some small businesses.
definitions.definitionCn: 使经济破产。
definitions.exampleCn: 经济衰退击垮了一些小企业。

definitions.definition: To violate, to not adhere to.
definitions.example: He broke his vows by cheating on his wife.
definitions.definitionCn: 违反，不遵守。
definitions.exampleCn: 他因对妻子不忠而违背了誓言。

definitions.definition: (of a fever) To pass the most dangerous part of the illness; to go down, in terms of temperature.
definitions.example: Susan's fever broke at about 3 AM, and the doctor said the worst was over.
definitions.definitionCn: （指发烧）度过疾病最危险的阶段；体温下降。
definitions.exampleCn: 苏珊的发烧大约在凌晨3点退了，医生说最坏的情况已经过去。

definitions.definition: (of a spell of settled weather) To end.
definitions.example: The forecast says the hot weather will break by midweek.
definitions.definitionCn: （指一段稳定天气）结束。
definitions.exampleCn: 天气预报说炎热天气将在周中结束。

definitions.definition: (of a storm) To begin; to end.
definitions.example: Around midday the storm broke, and the afternoon was calm and sunny.
definitions.definitionCn: （指风暴）开始；结束。
definitions.exampleCn: 中午时分风暴开始了，下午则平静晴朗。

definitions.definition: (of morning, dawn, day etc.) To arrive.
definitions.example: Morning has broken.
definitions.definitionCn: （指早晨、黎明、白天等）到来。
definitions.exampleCn: 早晨已经来临。

definitions.definition: To render (a game) unchallenging by altering its rules or exploiting loopholes or weaknesses in them in a way that gives a player an unfair advantage.
definitions.example: Changing the rules to let white have three extra queens would break chess.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过改变规则或利用漏洞使游戏失去挑战性，从而给玩家不公平的优势。
definitions.exampleCn: 改变规则让白方多三个皇后会破坏国际象棋。

definitions.definition: To stop, or to cause to stop, functioning properly or altogether.
definitions.example: Did you two break the trolley by racing with it?
definitions.definitionCn: 停止或导致停止正常运作或完全失效。
definitions.exampleCn: 你们俩是不是比赛时把推车弄坏了？

definitions.definition: To cause (a barrier) to no longer bar.
definitions.example: break a seal
definitions.definitionCn: 使（障碍物）不再阻挡。
definitions.exampleCn: 打破封条。

definitions.definition: To destroy the arrangement of; to throw into disorder; to pierce.
definitions.example: The cavalry were not able to break the British squares.
definitions.definitionCn: 破坏排列；使混乱；刺穿。
definitions.exampleCn: 骑兵未能突破英军方阵。

definitions.definition: (of a wave of water) To collapse into surf, after arriving in shallow water.
definitions.definitionCn: （指波浪）到达浅水后碎成浪花。

definitions.definition: To burst forth; to make its way; to come into view.
definitions.definitionCn: 迸发；前进；出现。

definitions.definition: To interrupt or cease one's work or occupation temporarily.
definitions.example: Let's break for lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 暂时中断或停止工作或职业。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们休息一下吃午饭吧。

definitions.definition: To interrupt (a fall) by inserting something so that the falling object does not (immediately) hit something else beneath.
definitions.example: He survived the jump out the window because the bushes below broke his fall.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过插入某物中断（坠落），使坠落物体不会（立即）撞到下方其他物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 他跳窗幸存，因为下面的灌木丛缓冲了他的坠落。

definitions.definition: To disclose or make known an item of news, etc.
definitions.example: I don't know how to break this to you, but your cat is not coming back.
definitions.definitionCn: 披露或公布某条新闻等。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不知道怎么告诉你这件事，但你的猫回不来了。

definitions.definition: (of a sound) To become audible suddenly.
definitions.definitionCn: （指声音）突然变得可听见。

definitions.definition: To change a steady state abruptly.
definitions.example: His coughing broke the silence.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然改变稳定状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的咳嗽打破了沉默。

definitions.definition: To suddenly become.
definitions.example: The arrest was standard, when suddenly the suspect broke ugly.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然变成。
definitions.exampleCn: 逮捕很平常，但突然嫌疑人变得凶恶起来。

definitions.definition: Of a male voice, to become deeper at puberty.
definitions.definitionCn: （指男性声音）在青春期变得低沉。

definitions.definition: Of a voice, to alter in type due to emotion or strain: in men generally to go up, in women sometimes to go down; to crack.
definitions.example: His voice breaks when he gets emotional.
definitions.definitionCn: （指声音）因情绪或压力而改变类型：男性通常变高，女性有时变低；变嘶哑。
definitions.exampleCn: 他情绪激动时声音会破。

definitions.definition: To surpass or do better than (a specific number), to do better than (a record), setting a new record.
definitions.example: He broke the men's 100-meter record.
definitions.definitionCn: 超越或做得比（特定数字）更好，打破（记录），创造新纪录。
definitions.exampleCn: 他打破了男子100米纪录。

definitions.definitionCn: ：（常用于被动语态）降级，降低军衔。

definitions.definition: (most often in the passive tense) To demote, to reduce the military rank of.
definitions.definitionCn: 结束（连接），断开。

definitions.definition: To end (a connection), to disconnect.
definitions.example: I couldn't hear a thing he was saying, so I broke the connection and called him back.
definitions.definitionCn: 我一点也听不清他说什么，所以我断开了连接并给他回电。
definitions.exampleCn: （指乳液）破乳。

definitions.definition: (of an emulsion) To demulsify.
definitions.definitionCn: 反击。

definitions.definitionCn: 揭示目的；披露、泄露或传达。

definitions.definition: To lay open, as a purpose; to disclose, divulge, or communicate.
definitions.definitionCn: 体质或能力变弱；失去健康或力量。

definitions.definition: To become weakened in constitution or faculties; to lose health or strength.
definitions.definitionCn: 生意失败；破产。

definitions.definition: To fail in business; to become bankrupt.
definitions.definitionCn: 破坏强度、坚固性或一致性。

definitions.definition: To destroy the strength, firmness, or consistency of.

definitions.definitionCn: 打麻。
definitions.exampleCn: 破坏官方身份和地位；革职；解雇。

definitions.definition: To destroy the official character and standing of; to cashier; to dismiss.
definitions.definitionCn: 做出突然或急剧的变化；改变步态。

definitions.definition: To make an abrupt or sudden change; to change the gait.

definitions.definitionCn: 突然跑起来或疾驰。
definitions.exampleCn: 闹翻；终止友谊。

definitions.definition: To fall out; to terminate friendship.

definitions.definitionCn: 在调试期间暂停程序执行以便调查程序状态。

definitions.definitionCn: 破碎的，分成碎片的。

definitions.definition: Fragmented, in separate pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: （指承诺等）被违背的；违反的；未遵守的。

definitions.definition: (of a promise, etc) Breached; violated; not kept.

definitions.definitionCn: 违背的中立承诺。
definitions.exampleCn: 不工作的；功能不正常的。

definitions.definition: Non-functional; not functioning properly.
definitions.example: I think my doorbell is broken.
definitions.definitionCn: 我想我的门铃坏了。
definitions.exampleCn: （指人）完全被打败且沮丧；破碎；毁灭。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Completely defeated and dispirited; shattered; destroyed.
definitions.example: The bankruptcy and divorce, together with the death of his son, left him completely broken.
definitions.definitionCn: 破产和离婚，加上儿子的去世，让他彻底崩溃。
definitions.exampleCn: 没有钱；破产的，身无分文的。

definitions.definition: Having no money; bankrupt, broke.
definitions.definitionCn: （指土地）不平整的。

definitions.definition: (of land) Uneven.
definitions.definitionCn: （指策略或选项）过于强大的；过于有力的；太强了。

definitions.definition: (of a tactic or option) Overpowered; overly powerful; too powerful.
An administrative unit of government; office.

definitions.definitionCn: 收集或提供信息、新闻的组织或机构。

definitions.definitionCn: 办公室（处理文书或专业事务的房间）。

definitions.definitionCn: 一种照片尺寸，特指3⅞英寸×5½英寸。

definitions.definitionCn: 政府或商业实体的顾问团。

definitions.definition: A small chamber or private room.
definitions.definitionCn: 小房间或私室。

definitions.definition: (often capitalized) A collection of art or ethnographic objects.
definitions.definitionCn: （常大写）艺术或民族志物品的收藏。

definitions.definition: (Rhode Island) Milkshake.
definitions.definitionCn: （罗德岛州用语）奶昔。

definitions.definition: A hut; a cottage; a small house.
definitions.definitionCn: 小屋；村舍；小房子。

definitions.definition: An enclosure for mechanical or electrical equipment.
definitions.definitionCn: 机械或电气设备的围护结构。

definitions.definition: A burrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个洞穴。

definitions.definition: To ritualistically inter in a grave or tomb.
definitions.definitionCn: 以仪式方式埋葬于坟墓或墓穴中。

definitions.definition: To place in the ground.
definitions.example: bury a bone;  bury the embers
definitions.definitionCn: 放入土中。
definitions.exampleCn: 埋一根骨头；埋掉余烬。

definitions.definition: To hide or conceal as if by covering with earth or another substance.
definitions.example: she buried her face in the pillow;  they buried us in paperwork
definitions.definitionCn: 像用土或其他物质覆盖一样隐藏或遮蔽。
definitions.exampleCn: 她把脸埋在枕头里；他们用文书工作把我们埋没了。

definitions.definition: To suppress and hide away in one's mind.
definitions.example: secrets kept buried; she buried her shame and put on a smiling face.
definitions.definitionCn: 在脑海中压抑并隐藏。
definitions.exampleCn: 深藏的秘密；她掩埋了羞耻，露出笑脸。

definitions.definition: To put an end to; to abandon.
definitions.example: They buried their argument and shook hands.
definitions.definitionCn: 终结；放弃。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们搁置了争论，握手言和。

definitions.definition: To score a goal.
definitions.definitionCn: 进球得分。

definitions.definition: To kill or murder.
definitions.definitionCn: 杀死或谋杀。

definitions.definition: To render imperceptible by other, more prominent stimuli; drown out.
definitions.example: vocals buried in the mix
definitions.definitionCn: 被其他更突出的刺激掩盖而难以察觉；淹没。
definitions.exampleCn: 人声被混音淹没。

definitions.definition: A borough; a manor
A soft, fatty foodstuff made by churning the cream of milk (generally cow's milk).
definitions.definitionCn: 一种通过搅拌奶油（通常为牛奶）制成的柔软、高脂肪食品。

definitions.definition: Any of various foodstuffs made from other foods or oils, similar in consistency to, eaten like or intended as a substitute for butter (preceded by the name of the food used to make it).

definitions.definitionCn: 由其他食物或油制成的各种食品，质地类似黄油，食用方式或作为黄油替代品（前面会加上制作该食品的原料名称）。

definitions.definition: A sudden, often intense, expression, manifestation or display.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然的、通常是强烈的表达、表现或展示。

definitions.definition: A series of shots fired from an automatic firearm.
definitions.definitionCn: 自动武器射出的一连串子弹。

definitions.definition: A drinking spree.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次狂饮作乐。

definitions.definition: To break from internal pressure.

definitions.definitionCn: 因内部压力而破裂。
definitions.exampleCn: 我把气球吹得太大了，结果它爆了。

definitions.definition: To cause to break from internal pressure.
definitions.example: I burst the balloon when I blew it up too much.
definitions.definitionCn: 因内部压力导致破裂。
definitions.exampleCn: 我把气球吹得太大了，结果弄爆了它。

definitions.definition: To cause to break by any means.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过任何方式导致破裂。

definitions.definition: To separate (printer paper) at perforation lines.
definitions.example: I printed the report on form-feed paper, then burst the sheets.
definitions.definitionCn: 在穿孔线上分离（打印机纸张）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在连续打印纸上打印了报告，然后撕开了纸张。

definitions.definition: To enter or exit hurriedly and unexpectedly.
definitions.definitionCn: 匆忙且意外地进入或离开。

definitions.definition: To erupt; to change state suddenly as if bursting.
definitions.example: The flowers burst into bloom on the first day of spring.
definitions.definitionCn: 爆发；像爆裂一样突然改变状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 春天第一天，花朵突然绽放。

definitions.definition: To produce as an effect of bursting.
definitions.example: to burst a hole through the wall
definitions.definitionCn: 作为爆裂的结果而产生。
definitions.exampleCn: 在墙上炸出一个洞。

definitions.definition: To interrupt suddenly in a violent or explosive manner; to shatter.

definitions.definition: A collection of objects, together with a transitively closed collection of composable arrows between them, such that every object has an identity arrow, and such that arrow composition is associative.
definitions.example: Just as a monoid consists of an underlying set with a binary operation "on top of it" which is closed, associative and with an identity, a category consists of an underlying digraph with an arrow composition operation "on top of it" which is transitively closed, associative, and with an identity at each object. In fact, a category's composition operation, when restricted to a single one of its objects, turns that object's set of arrows (which would all be loops) into a monoid.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组对象，以及它们之间可组合箭头的传递闭包集合，使得每个对象都有一个恒等箭头，并且箭头组合满足结合律。
