definitions.example: He poled off the serial of the Gulfstream to confirm its identity.
definitions.definitionCn: 用望远镜精确识别某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用望远镜确认了湾流飞机的序列号。

definitions.definition: To furnish with poles for support.
definitions.example: to pole beans or hops
definitions.definitionCn: 用杆子支撑。
definitions.exampleCn: 给豆子或啤酒花搭架。

definitions.definition: To convey on poles.
definitions.example: to pole hay into a barn
definitions.definitionCn: 用杆子搬运。
definitions.exampleCn: 用杆子把干草运进谷仓。

definitions.definition: To stir, as molten glass, with a pole.
definitions.definitionCn: 用杆子搅拌（如熔融玻璃）。

definitions.definition: To strike (the ball) very hard.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常用力地击打（球）。

definitions.definition: Either of the two points on the earth's surface around which it rotates; also, similar points on any other rotating object.
A point of magnetic focus, especially each of the two opposing such points of a magnet (designated north and south).
A fixed point relative to other points or lines.
A contact on an electrical device (such as a battery) at which electric current enters or leaves.
For a meromorphic function f(z), any point a for which f(z) \rightarrow \infty as z \rightarrow a.
definitions.example: The function f(z) = \frac{1}{z-3} has a single pole at z = 3

definitions.definition: The firmament; the sky.
Either of the states that characterize a bipolar disorder.
To induce piezoelectricity in (a substance) by aligning the dipoles.
A survey of people, usually statistically analyzed to gauge wider public opinion.
definitions.definitionCn: 一项通常通过统计分析来评估更广泛公众意见的调查。

definitions.definition: A formal election.
definitions.example: The student council had a poll to see what people want served in the cafeteria.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次正式选举。
definitions.exampleCn: 学生会进行了一次投票，了解大家想在食堂吃到什么。

definitions.definition: A polling place (usually as plural, polling places)
definitions.example: The polls close at 8 p.m.
definitions.definitionCn: 投票站（通常以复数形式“投票站”出现）。
definitions.exampleCn: 投票于晚上8点关闭。

definitions.definition: (now rare outside veterinary medicine contexts) The head, particularly the scalp or pate upon which hair (normally) grows.
definitions.definitionCn: （现除兽医语境外罕见）头部，尤指通常长头发的头皮或头顶。

definitions.definition: (in extended senses of the above) A mass of people, a mob or muster, considered as a head count.
definitions.definitionCn: （上述含义的引申）一群人、暴民或集合，被视为人头计数。

definitions.definition: The broad or butt end of an axe or a hammer.
definitions.definitionCn: 斧头或锤子的宽端或钝端。

definitions.definition: The pollard or European chub, a kind of fish.
definitions.definitionCn: 截角鱼或欧洲圆鳍雅罗鱼，一种鱼类。

definitions.definition: To take, record the votes of (an electorate).
definitions.definitionCn: 记录（某选区的）选票。

definitions.definition: To solicit mock votes from (a person or group).
definitions.definitionCn: 向（某个人或团体）征求模拟投票。

definitions.definition: To vote at an election.
definitions.definitionCn: 在选举中投票。

definitions.definition: To register or deposit, as a vote; to elicit or call forth, as votes or voters.
definitions.example: He polled a hundred votes more than his opponent.
definitions.definitionCn: 登记或投下（选票）；征集或唤起（选票或选民）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他比对手多获得了一百张选票。

definitions.definition: To cut off; to remove by clipping, shearing, etc.; to mow or crop.
definitions.example: to poll the hair; to poll wool; to poll grass
definitions.definitionCn: 剪掉；通过剪、割等方式去除；割或修剪。
definitions.exampleCn: 剪头发；剪羊毛；割草。

definitions.definition: To cut the hair of (a creature).
definitions.definitionCn: 剪去（某生物）的毛发。

definitions.definition: To remove the horns of (an animal).
definitions.definitionCn: 去除（动物）的角。

definitions.definition: To remove the top or end of; to clip; to lop.
definitions.example: to poll a tree
definitions.definitionCn: 去除顶部或末端；剪短；截断。
definitions.exampleCn: 修剪树木。

definitions.definition: (communication) To (repeatedly) request the status of something (such as a computer or printer on a network).
definitions.example: The network hub polled the department's computers to determine which ones could still respond.
definitions.definitionCn: （通信）反复询问某物（如网络上的计算机或打印机）的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 网络集线器轮询了部门的计算机，以确定哪些仍能响应。

definitions.definition: (with adverb) To be judged in a poll.
definitions.definitionCn: （与副词连用）在投票中被评判。

definitions.definition: To extort from; to plunder; to strip.
definitions.definitionCn: 勒索；掠夺；剥夺。

definitions.definition: To impose a tax upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 征税。

definitions.definition: To pay as one's personal tax.
definitions.definitionCn: 缴纳个人税。

definitions.definition: To enter, as polls or persons, in a list or register; to enroll, especially for purposes of taxation; to enumerate one by one.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（投票人或人员）列入名单或登记册；登记，尤指为征税目的；逐一清点。

definitions.definition: To cut or shave smooth or even; to cut in a straight line without indentation.
definitions.example: a polled deed
definitions.definitionCn: 切割或刮平；沿直线切割而无凹痕。
definitions.exampleCn: 一份平整的契约。

definitions.definition: (of kinds of livestock which typically have horns) Bred without horns, and thus hornless.
definitions.example: Poll Hereford
definitions.definitionCn: （通常有角的牲畜品种）培育成无角的，因此无角。
definitions.exampleCn: 无角赫里福德牛。

definitions.definition: A pet parrot.
(Cambridge University) One who does not try for honors at university, but is content to take a degree merely; a passman.
A state of safety, protection or shelter.
definitions.definitionCn: 安全、保护或庇护的状态。

definitions.definition: A place providing safety, protection or shelter.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供安全、保护或庇护的场所。

definitions.definition: Something or someone turned to for safety or assistance; a recourse or resort.
definitions.definitionCn: 为寻求安全或援助而求助的人或事物；一种依靠或手段。

definitions.definition: An expedient to secure protection or defence.
definitions.definitionCn: 确保保护或防御的权宜之计。

definitions.definition: A refuge island.
definitions.definitionCn: 安全岛。

definitions.definition: To return to a place of shelter.
definitions.definitionCn: 返回庇护所。

definitions.definition: To shelter; to protect.
definitions.definitionCn: 庇护；保护。

definitions.definition: Superfluous; exceeding what is necessary.
definitions.definitionCn: 多余的；超出必要的。

definitions.definition: (of words, writing, etc) Repetitive or needlessly wordy.
definitions.definitionCn: （指言语、文字等）重复的或不必要地冗长的。

definitions.definition: Dismissed from employment because no longer needed.
definitions.example: Four employees were made redundant.
definitions.definitionCn: 因不再需要而被解雇。
definitions.exampleCn: 四名员工被裁掉了。

definitions.definition: Duplicating or able to duplicate the function of another component of a system, providing backup in the event the other component fails.
definitions.definitionCn: 复制或能够复制系统中另一组件的功能，在另一组件失效时提供备份。

definitions.definition: The act of reflecting or the state of being reflected.
definitions.definitionCn: 反射的行为或被反射的状态。

definitions.definition: The property of a propagated wave being thrown back from a surface (such as a mirror).
definitions.definitionCn: 传播的波从表面（如镜子）被反射回来的特性。

definitions.definition: Something, such as an image, that is reflected.
definitions.example: The dog barked at his own reflection in the mirror.
definitions.definitionCn: 被反射的事物，例如影像。
definitions.exampleCn: 狗对着镜中自己的倒影吠叫。

definitions.definition: Careful thought or consideration.
definitions.example: After careful reflection, I have decided not to vote for that proposition.
definitions.definitionCn: 仔细的思考或考虑。
definitions.exampleCn: 经过仔细考虑后，我决定不支持那项提案。

definitions.definition: An implied criticism.
definitions.example: It is a reflection on his character that he never came back to see them.
definitions.definitionCn: 隐含的批评。
definitions.exampleCn: 他从未回来看他们，这反映了他的品性。

definitions.definition: The process or mechanism of determining the capabilities of an object at run-time.
definitions.definitionCn: 在运行时确定对象能力的过程或机制。

definitions.definition: The folding of a part; a fold.
definitions.definitionCn: 某部分的折叠；一个褶皱。

definitions.definition: The periodic energizing required to maintain the contents of computer memory, the display luminance of a computer screen, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 维持计算机内存内容、屏幕显示亮度等所需的周期性刷新。

definitions.definition: The update of a display (in a web browser or similar software) to show the latest version of the data.
definitions.definitionCn: （在网页浏览器或类似软件中）更新显示以展示数据的最新版本。

definitions.definition: The process of modernizing something.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某事物现代化的过程。

definitions.definition: To renew or revitalize.
definitions.example: Sleep refreshes the body and the mind.
definitions.definitionCn: 更新或恢复活力。
definitions.exampleCn: 睡眠使身心焕然一新。

definitions.definition: To become fresh again; to be revitalized.
definitions.definitionCn: 重新变得新鲜；恢复活力。

definitions.definition: To reload (a document, especially a webpage) and show any new changes.
definitions.definitionCn: 重新加载（文档，尤其是网页）并显示任何新变化。

definitions.definition: To cause (a web browser or similar software) to refresh its display.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（网页浏览器或类似软件）刷新其显示。

definitions.definition: To perform the periodic energizing required to maintain the contents of computer memory, the display luminance of a computer screen, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行维持计算机内存内容、屏幕显示亮度等所需的周期性刷新。

definitions.definition: To take refreshment; to eat or drink.
definitions.definitionCn: 进食或饮水以补充精力。

definitions.definition: To purify; reduce to a fine, unmixed, or pure state; to free from impurities.
definitions.example: to refine gold
definitions.definitionCn: 提纯；使达到精细、纯净或纯粹的状态；去除杂质。
definitions.exampleCn: 精炼黄金。

definitions.definition: To become pure; to be cleared of impure matter.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得纯净；清除杂质。

definitions.definition: To purify of coarseness, vulgarity, inelegance, etc.; to polish.
definitions.example: a refined style
definitions.definitionCn: 去除粗俗、低劣、不雅等；使文雅。
definitions.exampleCn: 优雅的风格。

definitions.definition: To improve in accuracy, delicacy, or excellence.
definitions.definitionCn: 提高准确性、精致度或卓越性。

definitions.definition: To make nice or subtle.
definitions.example: to refine someone's language
definitions.definitionCn: 使变得微妙或精细。
definitions.exampleCn: 使某人的语言更文雅。

definitions.definition: A person seeking refuge in a foreign country out of fear of political persecution or the prospect of such persecution in their home country, i.e., a person seeking political asylum.
definitions.definitionCn: 因担心在本国遭受政治迫害或有此风险而前往外国寻求庇护的人，即寻求政治避难者。

definitions.definition: A person seeking refuge due to a natural disaster, war, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 因自然灾害、战争等原因寻求避难的人。

definitions.definition: A person formally granted political or economic asylum by a country other than their home country.
definitions.definitionCn: 被非本国正式授予政治或经济庇护的人。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A person who flees one place or institution for another.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）从一个地方或机构逃往另一个地方或机构的人。

definitions.definition: To convey (slaves) away from the advance of the federal forces.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（奴隶）转移至联邦军队推进范围之外。

definitions.definition: A direct popular vote on a proposed law or constitutional amendment. The adposition on is usually used before the related subject of the vote.
definitions.definitionCn: 对拟议法律或宪法修正案进行的直接全民投票。介词on通常用于投票相关主题之前。

definitions.definition: An action, choice, etc., which is perceived as passing judgment on another matter.
definitions.example: My father is taking my decision on whether to go to university as a referendum on his performance as a parent, and it's very stressful.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为对另一事项作出评判的行动、选择等。
definitions.exampleCn: 我父亲将我是否上大学的决定视为对他作为家长表现的一次公投，这让我压力很大。

definitions.definition: An umpire or judge; an official who makes sure the rules are followed during a game.
definitions.example: The referee kicked Jim out of the game for fighting.
definitions.definitionCn: 裁判或法官；确保比赛规则得到遵守的官员。
definitions.exampleCn: 裁判因打架将吉姆罚出场外。

definitions.definition: A person who settles a dispute.
definitions.definitionCn: 解决争端的人。

definitions.definition: A person who writes a letter of reference or provides a reference by phone call for someone.
definitions.example: Your application, along with letters from three referees, should be received by January 31.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某人撰写推荐信或通过电话提供推荐的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 你的申请及三封推荐信需在1月31日前收到。

definitions.definition: An expert who judges the manuscript of an article or book to decide if it should be published.
definitions.definitionCn: 评判文章或书籍手稿以决定是否出版的专家。

definitions.definition: To act as a referee.
definitions.example: He has to referee three hockey games this weekend.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任裁判。
definitions.exampleCn: 他本周末必须担任三场曲棍球比赛的裁判。

definitions.definition: The act, process, or result of reducing.
definitions.definitionCn: 减少的行为、过程或结果。

definitions.definition: The amount or rate by which something is reduced, e.g. in price.
definitions.example: A 5% reduction in robberies
definitions.definitionCn: 某物减少的数量或比率，例如价格降低。
definitions.exampleCn: 抢劫案减少5%

definitions.definition: A reaction in which electrons are gained and valence is reduced; often by the removal of oxygen or the addition of hydrogen.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种获得电子且化合价降低的反应；通常通过去除氧或添加氢实现。

definitions.definition: The process of rapidly boiling a sauce to concentrate it.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速煮沸酱汁以浓缩的过程。

definitions.definition: The rewriting of an expression into a simpler form.
definitions.definitionCn: 将表达式改写为更简形式的过程。

definitions.definition: (computability theory) a transformation of one problem into another problem, such as mapping reduction or polynomial reduction.
definitions.definitionCn: （可计算性理论）将一个问题的变换转化为另一个问题，例如映射归约或多项式归约。

definitions.definition: An arrangement for a far smaller number of parties, e.g. a keyboard solo based on a full opera.
definitions.definitionCn: 为更少演奏者编排的改编版本，例如基于整部歌剧的键盘独奏。

definitions.definition: (phenomenology) A philosophical procedure intended to reveal the objects of consciousness as pure phenomena. (See phenomenological reduction.)
definitions.definitionCn: （现象学）旨在揭示意识对象为纯粹现象的一种哲学方法。（参见现象学还原。）

definitions.definition: A medical procedure to restore a fracture or dislocation to the correct alignment.
definitions.definitionCn: 将骨折或脱位恢复至正确对位的医疗操作。

definitions.definition: A relationship or relation (to something).
definitions.definitionCn: 关系或关联（与某事物）。

definitions.definition: A measurement one can compare to.
definitions.definitionCn: 可供比较的衡量标准。

definitions.definition: Information about a person, provided by someone (a referee) with whom they are well acquainted.
definitions.definitionCn: 由熟悉某人者（推荐人）提供的关于此人的信息。

definitions.definition: A person who provides this information; a referee.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供此信息的人；推荐人。

definitions.definition: A reference work.
definitions.definitionCn: 参考著作。

definitions.definition: That which serves as a reference work.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作参考著作的事物。

definitions.definition: The act of referring: a submitting for information or decision.
definitions.definitionCn: 参考行为：为获取信息或决策而提交。

definitions.definition: A relation between objects in which one object designates, or acts as a means by which to connect to or link to, another object.
definitions.definitionCn: 对象间的关系，其中一个对象指定或作为连接另一对象的手段。

definitions.definition: (academic writing) A short written identification of a previously published work which is used as a source for a text.
definitions.definitionCn: （学术写作）对先前出版作品的简短书面标识，用作文本来源。

definitions.definition: (academic writing) A previously published written work thus indicated; a source.
definitions.definitionCn: （学术写作）由此指出的先前出版书面作品；来源。

definitions.definition: An object containing information which refers to data stored elsewhere, as opposed to containing the data itself.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含指向别处存储数据的信息的对象，而非包含数据本身。

definitions.definition: (character entity) A special sequence used to represent complex characters in markup languages, such as ™ for the ™ symbol.
definitions.definitionCn: （字符实体）标记语言中用于表示复杂字符的特殊序列，例如™表示™符号。

definitions.definition: Appeal.
definitions.definitionCn: 呼吁。

definitions.definition: To provide a list of references for (a text).
definitions.example: You must thoroughly reference your paper before submitting it.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（文本）提供参考文献列表。
definitions.exampleCn: 提交前你必须为论文详尽列出参考文献。

definitions.definition: To refer to, to use as a reference.
definitions.example: Reference the dictionary for word meanings.
definitions.definitionCn: 参考，用作参考。
definitions.exampleCn: 查阅词典了解词义。

definitions.definition: To mention, to cite.
definitions.example: In his speech, the candidate obliquely referenced the past failures of his opponent.
definitions.definitionCn: 提及，引用。
definitions.exampleCn: 在演讲中，候选人间接提及了对手过去的失败。

definitions.definition: To contain the value that is a memory address of some value stored in memory.
definitions.example: The given pointer will reference the actual generated data.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含存储在内存中某值的地址值。
definitions.exampleCn: 给定指针将引用实际生成的数据。

definitions.definition: To get back; to recover possession of.
definitions.definitionCn: 收回；重新获得。

definitions.definition: The act of refusing.
definitions.definitionCn: 拒绝的行为。

definitions.definition: Depth or point at which well or borehole drilling cannot continue.
definitions.definitionCn: 钻井或钻孔无法继续的深度或位置。

definitions.definition: The practicing of something which is to be performed before an audience, usually to test or improve the interaction between several participating people, or to allow technical adjustments with respect to staging to be done.
definitions.definitionCn: 排练是指为观众表演前进行的练习，通常用于测试或改进多位参与者之间的配合，或对舞台技术进行调整。

definitions.definition: To dictate policy.
definitions.definitionCn: 制定政策。

definitions.definition: To control or direct according to rule, principle, or law.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据规则、原则或法律进行控制或指导。

definitions.definition: To adjust to a particular specification or requirement: regulate temperature.
definitions.definitionCn: 按照特定规格或要求进行调整：调节温度。

definitions.definition: To adjust (a mechanism) for accurate and proper functioning.
definitions.example: to regulate a watch, i.e. adjust its rate of running so that it will keep approximately standard time
definitions.definitionCn: 调整（机械装置）以确保准确和正常运作。
definitions.exampleCn: 调节手表，即调整其运行速率，使其大致保持标准时间。

definitions.definition: To put or maintain in order.
definitions.example: to regulate one's eating habits
definitions.definitionCn: 使有序或维持秩序。
definitions.exampleCn: 调节个人的饮食习惯。

definitions.definition: Having no regard; heedless; careless.
definitions.definitionCn: 不顾；不注意；粗心大意。

definitions.definition: Without attention to warnings or indications of bad consequences.
definitions.example: Tatiana knew the meat had passed its expiry date, but she ate it regardless.
definitions.definitionCn: 无视警告或不良后果的迹象。
definitions.exampleCn: 塔季扬娜知道肉已过保质期，但她还是吃了。

definitions.definition: Paying no attention to; regardless of.
definitions.definitionCn: 不理会；不顾。

definitions.definition: An amount of money returned.
definitions.example: If the camera is faulty, you can return it to the store where you bought it for a full refund.
definitions.definitionCn: 一笔退款。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果相机有故障，你可以将其退回购买商店以获得全额退款。

definitions.definition: To return (money) to (someone); to reimburse.
definitions.example: If you find this computer for sale anywhere at a lower price, we'll refund you the difference.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（钱）退还（给某人）；报销。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你发现这台电脑在任何地方以更低价格出售，我们将退还差价。

definitions.definition: To supply again with funds.
definitions.example: to refund a railroad loan
definitions.definitionCn: 再次提供资金。
definitions.exampleCn: 退还铁路贷款。

definitions.definition: To pour back.
definitions.definitionCn: 倒回。

definitions.definition: Mode of rule or management.
definitions.example: a prison regime
definitions.definitionCn: 统治或管理模式。
definitions.exampleCn: 监狱管理制度。

definitions.definition: A form of government, or the government in power.
definitions.example: a capitalist regime
definitions.definitionCn: 一种政府形式，或执政的政府。
definitions.exampleCn: 资本主义政权。

definitions.definition: A period of rule.
definitions.definitionCn: 统治时期。

definitions.definition: A regulated system; a regimen.
definitions.example: Heaven will eliminate the tyrannical regimes.

definitions.definition: The part of an airship, such as a balloon or dirigible, which houses the passengers and control apparatus.

definitions.definition: A sliding fitting that runs along a track.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿轨道滑动的配件。

definitions.definition: The aggregate of desirable characteristics of a car.

definitions.definitionCn: 汽车理想特性的总和。

definitions.definition: A floating perforated box for living fish.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于存放活鱼的浮动穿孔箱。

definitions.definition: A turn.
The first part of a cons in LISP. The first element of a list
A settlement; an area with residential districts, shops and amenities, and its own local government; especially one larger than a village and smaller than a city.

definitions.definition: Any more urbanized center than the place of reference.

definitions.definitionCn: 比参照地点更城市化的中心。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会先去扬克斯，然后开车进城，今晚到麦迪逊广场花园看尼克斯队的比赛。

definitions.definition: A rural settlement in which a market was held at least once a week.
definitions.definitionCn: 每周至少举办一次集市的乡村定居点。

definitions.definition: The residents (as opposed to gown: the students, faculty, etc.) of a community which is the site of a university.
definitions.definitionCn: 大学所在社区的居民（与“长袍”相对，指学生、教职员工等）。

definitions.definition: Used to refer to a town or similar entity under discussion.
definitions.example: Call me when you get to town.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于指代正在讨论的城镇或类似实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 你到镇上时给我打电话。

definitions.definition: A major city, especially one where the speaker is located.
definitions.definitionCn: 主要城市，尤其指说话者所在的城市。

definitions.definition: A municipal organization, such as a corporation, defined by the laws of the entity of which it is a part.
definitions.definitionCn: 市政组织，如法人团体，由其所属实体的法律定义。

definitions.definition: An enclosure which surrounded the mere homestead or dwelling of the lord of the manor.
definitions.definitionCn: 围绕庄园领主住宅或宅邸的围场。

definitions.definition: The whole of the land which constituted the domain.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成领地的全部土地。

definitions.definition: A collection of houses enclosed by fences or walls.
definitions.definitionCn: 由篱笆或围墙围起来的房屋群。

definitions.definition: A farm or farmstead; also, a court or farmyard.
definitions.definitionCn: 农场或农庄；也指庭院或农场庭院。

definitions.definition: A piece of furniture, usually flat and soft, on which to rest or sleep.

My cat often sleeps on my bed.
I keep a glass of water next to my bed when I sleep.

definitions.definition: A place, or flat surface or layer, on which something else rests or is laid.

definitions.definitionCn: 我睡觉时会在床边放一杯水。

definitions.definition: Senses relating to a bed as a place for resting or sleeping.

definitions.definition: In scientific usage, a multicellular organism that is usually mobile, whose cells are not encased in a rigid cell wall (distinguishing it from plants and fungi) and which derives energy solely from the consumption of other organisms (distinguishing it from plants).
definitions.example: A cat is an animal, not a plant. Humans are also animals, under the scientific definition, as we are not plants.

definitions.exampleCn: 猫是动物，不是植物。根据科学定义，人类也是动物，因为我们不是植物。

definitions.definition: In non-scientific usage, any member of the kingdom Animalia other than a human.
definitions.definitionCn: 在非科学用法中，指动物界中除人类以外的任何成员。

definitions.definition: In non-scientific usage, any land-living vertebrate (i.e. not fishes, insects, etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 在非科学用法中，指任何陆生脊椎动物（即不包括鱼类、昆虫等）。

definitions.definition: A person who behaves wildly; a bestial, brutal, brutish, cruel, or inhuman person.

definitions.definition: A person of a particular type.

definitions.definition: Matter, thing.

definitions.definition: Of or relating to animals.

A portal of entry into a building, room, or vehicle, consisting of a rigid plane movable on a hinge. Doors are frequently made of wood or metal. May have a handle to help open and close, a latch to hold the door closed and a lock that ensures the door cannot be opened without the key.

definitions.definition: Personal, intimate.

definitions.definition: The form or shape of something; a quintessential aspect or characteristic.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的形式或形状；本质性的方面或特征。

definitions.definition: An image of an object that is formed in the mind or recalled by the memory.
definitions.example: The mere idea of you is enough to excite me.
definitions.definitionCn: 在脑海中形成或由记忆唤起的物体形象。
definitions.exampleCn: 仅仅是你的想法就足以让我兴奋。

definitions.definition: More generally, any result of mental activity; a thought, a notion; a way of thinking.
definitions.definitionCn: 更广义地说，任何心智活动的结果；思想、概念；思维方式。

definitions.definition: A conception in the mind of something to be done; a plan for doing something, an intention.
definitions.example: I have an idea of how we might escape.
definitions.definitionCn: 心中对要做之事的构想；做某事的计划、意图。
definitions.exampleCn: 我有个关于如何逃脱的想法。

definitions.definition: A purposeful aim or goal; intent
definitions.example: Yeah, that's the idea.
definitions.definitionCn: 有目的的目标或意图；意向。
definitions.exampleCn: 对，就是这个意思。

definitions.definition: A vague or fanciful notion; a feeling or hunch; an impression.
definitions.example: He had the wild idea that if he leant forward a little, he might be able to touch the mountain-top.
definitions.definitionCn: 模糊或异想天开的念头；感觉或直觉；印象。
definitions.exampleCn: 他有个疯狂的想法：如果身体前倾一点，也许能碰到山顶。

definitions.definition: A musical theme or melodic subject.
definitions.definitionCn: 音乐主题或旋律性素材。

definitions.definition: A sequence of rhythmic steps or movements usually performed to music, for pleasure or as a form of social interaction.
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列有节奏的舞步或动作，通常伴随音乐进行，用于娱乐或社交互动。

definitions.definition: A social gathering where dancing is the main activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 以跳舞为主要活动的社交聚会。

definitions.definition: A normally horizontal stripe called a fess that has been modified to zig-zag across the center of a coat of arms from dexter to sinister.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种通常为水平条纹的纹章图案，称为横带，被修改为从盾徽左侧到右侧呈锯齿状穿过中心。

definitions.definition: A genre of modern music characterised by sampled beats, repetitive rhythms and few lyrics.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种现代音乐流派，以采样节拍、重复节奏和少量歌词为特征。

definitions.definition: The art, profession, and study of dancing.
definitions.definitionCn: 舞蹈的艺术、职业和研究。

definitions.definition: A piece of music with a particular dance rhythm.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有特定舞蹈节奏的音乐作品。

definitions.definition: A battle of wits, especially one commonly fought between two rivals.
definitions.example: So how much longer are we gonna do this dance?
definitions.definitionCn: 智斗，尤其常见于两个对手之间的较量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们还要这样周旋多久？

definitions.definition: To move with rhythmic steps or movements, especially in time to music.
definitions.example: I danced with her all night long.
definitions.definitionCn: 以有节奏的舞步或动作移动，尤其跟随音乐节拍。
definitions.exampleCn: 我和她跳了一整晚的舞。

definitions.definition: To leap or move lightly and rapidly.
definitions.example: His eyes danced with pleasure as he spoke.   She accused her political opponent of dancing around the issue instead of confronting it.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻快迅速地跳跃或移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他说话时双眼因愉悦而闪烁。她指责政治对手回避问题而非直面应对。

definitions.definition: To perform the steps to.
definitions.example: Have you ever danced the tango?
definitions.definitionCn: 表演（舞蹈的）步骤。
definitions.exampleCn: 你跳过探戈吗？

definitions.definition: To cause to dance, or move nimbly or merrily about.
definitions.definitionCn: 使跳舞，或轻快欢快地移动。

definitions.definition: To make love or have sex.
definitions.example: You make me feel like dancing.
definitions.definitionCn: 做爱或发生性关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 你让我感觉想跳舞。

definitions.definition: Water in frozen (solid) form.
definitions.definitionCn: 水以冻结（固态）形式存在。

definitions.definition: Any frozen volatile chemical, such as ammonia or carbon dioxide.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何冻结的挥发性化学物质，如氨或二氧化碳。

definitions.definition: Any volatile chemical, such as water, ammonia, or carbon dioxide, not necessarily in solid form.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何挥发性化学物质，如氨或二氧化碳，不一定是固态。

definitions.definition: A frozen dessert made of fruit juice, water and sugar.
definitions.definitionCn: 由果汁、水和糖制成的冷冻甜点。

definitions.definition: An ice cream.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种冰淇淋。

definitions.definition: Any substance having the appearance of ice.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何具有冰外观的物质。

definitions.definition: One or more diamonds and jewelry.
definitions.definitionCn: 一颗或多颗钻石及珠宝。

definitions.definition: Crystal form of amphetamine-based drugs.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于安非他命的药物的晶体形态。

definitions.definition: The area where a game of ice hockey is played.
definitions.definitionCn: 冰球比赛进行的区域。

definitions.definition: Money paid as a bribe.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为贿赂支付的金钱。

definitions.definition: To cool with ice, as a beverage.
definitions.definitionCn: 用冰冷却，如饮料。

definitions.definition: To become ice; to freeze.
definitions.definitionCn: 变成冰；冻结。

definitions.definition: To make icy; to freeze.
definitions.definitionCn: 使冰冷；冻结。

definitions.definition: To murder.
definitions.definitionCn: 谋杀。

definitions.definition: To cover with icing (frosting made of sugar and milk or white of egg); to frost; as cakes, tarts, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖糖霜（由糖和牛奶或蛋白制成的糖衣）；如蛋糕、馅饼等。

definitions.definition: To put out a team for a match.
definitions.example: Milton Keynes have yet to ice a team this season
definitions.definitionCn: 派出队伍参加比赛。
definitions.exampleCn: 米尔顿凯恩斯队本赛季尚未派出冰球队。

definitions.definition: To shoot the puck the length of the playing surface, causing a stoppage in play called icing.
definitions.example: If the Bruins ice the puck, the faceoff will be in their own zone.
definitions.definitionCn: 将冰球击打至比赛场地全长，导致比赛暂停，称为“冰球违例”。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果棕熊队将冰球击出界，争球将在他们自己的区域进行。

definitions.definition: (gerund) The act of persons or things that meet.
definitions.example: Meeting him will be exciting. I enjoy meeting new people.
definitions.definitionCn: (动名词) 人或物相遇的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 与他见面将会令人兴奋。 我喜欢结识新朋友。

definitions.definition: A gathering of persons for a purpose; an assembly.
definitions.example: We need to have a meeting about that soon.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定目的而聚集的人群；集会。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们很快需要就此开个会。

definitions.definition: (collective) The people at such a gathering.
definitions.example: What has the meeting decided.
definitions.definitionCn: (集合名词) 此类集会中的人们。
definitions.exampleCn: 会议决定了什么。

definitions.definition: An encounter between people, even accidental.
definitions.example: They came together in a chance meeting on the way home from work.
definitions.definitionCn: 人与人之间的相遇，甚至是偶然的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们在下班回家的路上偶然相遇。

definitions.definition: A place or instance of junction or intersection; a confluence.
definitions.example: Earthquakes occur at the meeting of tectonic plates.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接或交叉的地点或实例；汇合处。
definitions.exampleCn: 地震发生在地质板块交汇处。

definitions.definition: A religious service held by a charismatic preacher in small towns in the United States.
definitions.definitionCn: 美国小镇中由魅力型传教士主持的宗教仪式。

definitions.definition: An administrative unit in the Religious Society of Friends (Quakers).
definitions.example: Denver meeting is a part of Intermountain yearly meeting.
definitions.definitionCn: 贵格会（公谊会）中的一个行政单位。
definitions.exampleCn: 丹佛聚会是落基山间年会的一部分。

definitions.definition: To make contact (with) while in proximity.
(Of groups) To come together.
To make physical or perceptual contact.
To satisfy; to comply with.
definitions.example: This proposal meets my requirements. The company agrees to meet the cost of any repairs.

definitions.definition: To balance or come out correct.
To perceive; to come to a knowledge of; to have personal acquaintance with; to experience; to suffer.
definitions.example: The eye met a horrid sight. He met his fate.

definitions.definition: To be mixed with, to be combined with aspects of.
A person or group of people constituting a particular side in a contract or legal action.
definitions.example: The contract requires that the party of the first part pay the fee.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成合同或法律诉讼中特定一方的一个或多个个人。
definitions.exampleCn: 合同要求第一方支付费用。

definitions.definition: A person.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人。

definitions.definition: A group of people forming one side in a given dispute, contest etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定争议、竞赛等中形成一方的一群人。

definitions.definition: A political group considered as a formal whole, united under one specific political platform of issues and campaigning to take part in government.
definitions.example: The green party took 12% of the vote.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为正式整体的政治团体，在特定政治议题纲领下团结一致，并参与竞选以进入政府。
definitions.exampleCn: 绿党获得了12%的选票。

definitions.definition: A discrete detachment of troops, especially for a particular purpose.
definitions.example: The settlers were attacked early next morning by a scouting party.
definitions.definitionCn: 一支独立的部队分队，尤其为特定目的而设。
definitions.exampleCn: 次日清晨，定居者遭到一支侦察队的袭击。

definitions.definition: A group of persons collected or gathered together for some particular purpose.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定目的而聚集的一群人。

definitions.definition: A part or division.
definitions.definitionCn: 一部分或一个分支。

definitions.definition: To celebrate at a party, to have fun, to enjoy oneself.
definitions.example: We partied until the early hours.
definitions.definitionCn: 在派对上庆祝、玩乐、享受。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们聚会直到凌晨。

definitions.definition: To take recreational drugs.
definitions.definitionCn: 服用娱乐性药物。

definitions.definition: To engage in flings, to have one-night stands, to sow one's wild oats.
definitions.definitionCn: 参与短暂恋情、一夜情、放纵青春。

definitions.definition: To form a party (with).
definitions.example: If you want to beat that monster, you should party with a healer.
definitions.definitionCn: （与某人）组成队伍。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你想打败那个怪物，你应该和一个治疗者组队。

definitions.definition: (except in compounds) Divided; in part.
Parted or divided, as in the direction or form of one of the ordinaries.
definitions.example: an escutcheon party per pale

definitions.definition: The left side or direction.
definitions.definitionCn: 左侧或方向。

definitions.definition: The ensemble of left-wing political parties. Those holding left-wing views as a group.
definitions.example: The political left is holding too much power.
definitions.definitionCn: 左翼政党的集合。持左翼观点的人群。
definitions.exampleCn: 政治左派掌握过多权力。

definitions.definition: The left hand or fist.
definitions.definitionCn: 左手或左拳。

definitions.definition: A punch delivered with the left fist.
definitions.definitionCn: 用左拳击出的一拳。

definitions.definition: A wave breaking from left to right (viewed from the shore).
definitions.definitionCn: 从左向右破碎的波浪（从岸边观看）。

definitions.definition: The opposite of right; toward the west when one is facing north.
definitions.example: The left side.
definitions.definitionCn: 与右相对；面朝北时朝向西方。
definitions.exampleCn: 左侧。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to the political left.
definitions.definitionCn: 与政治左派相关的。

definitions.definition: On the left side.
definitions.definitionCn: 在左侧。

definitions.definition: Towards the left side.
definitions.example: Turn left at the corner.
definitions.definitionCn: 朝向左方。
definitions.exampleCn: 在拐角处左转。

definitions.definition: Towards the political left.
definitions.example: The East Coast of the US leans left in elections.
definitions.definitionCn: 朝向政治左派。
definitions.exampleCn: 美国东海岸在选举中倾向左派。

definitions.definition: To have a consequence or remnant.
To depart; to separate from.
To transfer something.
To remain (behind); to stay.
To stop, desist from; to "leave off" (+ noun / gerund).
To give leave to; allow; permit; let; grant.
definitions.example: We were not left go to the beach after school except on a weekend.

definitions.definition: To have a consequence or remnant.
To depart; to separate from.
To transfer something.
To remain (behind); to stay.
To stop, desist from; to "leave off" (+ noun / gerund).
To give leave to; allow; permit; let; grant.
definitions.example: We were not left go to the beach after school except on a weekend.

definitions.definition: Something to be sat upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 可坐之物。

definitions.definition: A location or site.
definitions.definitionCn: 地点或场所。

definitions.definition: The starting point of a fire.
definitions.definitionCn: 火源起点。

definitions.definition: Posture, or way of sitting, on horseback.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑马时的姿势或坐姿。

definitions.definition: To put an object into a place where it will rest; to fix; to set firm.
definitions.example: Be sure to seat the gasket properly before attaching the cover.
definitions.definitionCn: 将物体放入其静止之处；固定；安放。
definitions.exampleCn: 安装盖子前务必正确放置垫圈。

definitions.definition: To provide with places to sit.
definitions.example: The waiter seated us and asked what we would like to drink.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供座位。
definitions.exampleCn: 服务员安排我们就座，并询问想喝什么。

definitions.definition: To request or direct one or more persons to sit.
definitions.example: Please seat the audience after the anthem and then introduce the first speaker.
definitions.definitionCn: 请某人或多人就座。
definitions.exampleCn: 奏国歌后请引导观众入座，然后介绍第一位发言人。

definitions.definition: (legislature) To recognize the standing of a person or persons by providing them with one or more seats which would allow them to participate fully in a meeting or session.
definitions.example: Only half the delegates from the state were seated at the convention because the state held its primary too early.
definitions.definitionCn: （立法机构）通过提供席位承认某人或某些人的资格，使其能充分参与会议。
definitions.exampleCn: 该州因初选过早，仅半数代表获准参会。

definitions.definition: To assign the seats of.
definitions.example: to seat a church
definitions.definitionCn: 分配座位。
definitions.exampleCn: 为教堂配备座位。

definitions.definition: To cause to occupy a post, site, or situation; to station; to establish; to fix; to settle.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某人担任职位、驻扎或就位；安置；确立；固定；定居。

definitions.definition: To rest; to lie down.
definitions.definitionCn: 休息；躺下。

definitions.definition: To settle; to plant with inhabitants.
definitions.example: to seat a country
definitions.definitionCn: 定居；移民垦殖。
definitions.exampleCn: 向某国移民定居。

definitions.definition: To put a seat or bottom in.
definitions.example: to seat a chair
definitions.definitionCn: 安装座部或底部。
definitions.exampleCn: 为椅子安装座面。

definitions.definition: To be alive; to have life.
definitions.example: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.
definitions.definitionCn: 活着；拥有生命。
definitions.exampleCn: 他预计活不过几个月。

definitions.definition: To have permanent residence somewhere, to inhabit, to reside.
definitions.example: I live at 2a Acacia Avenue.  He lives in LA, but he's staying here over the summer.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某地永久居住，栖息，定居。
definitions.exampleCn: 我住在阿卡西亚大道2a号。他住在洛杉矶，但整个夏天都会待在这里。

definitions.definition: To survive; to persevere; to continue.
definitions.example: Her memory lives in that song.
definitions.definitionCn: 幸存；坚持；延续。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的记忆永存于那首歌中。

definitions.definition: To cope.
definitions.example: You'll just have to live with it!  I can't live in a world without you.
definitions.definitionCn: 应对；忍受。
definitions.exampleCn: 你只能接受它！没有你，我活不下去。

definitions.definition: To pass life in a specified manner.
definitions.example: It is difficult to live in poverty.   And they lived happily ever after.
definitions.definitionCn: 以特定方式度过一生。
definitions.exampleCn: 在贫困中生活很艰难。从此他们幸福地生活在一起。

definitions.definition: To spend, as one's life; to pass; to maintain; to continue in, constantly or habitually.
definitions.example: To live an idle or a useful life.
definitions.definitionCn: 度过（生命）；消磨；维持；持续（常或习惯性地）。
definitions.exampleCn: 过着懒散或有益的生活。

definitions.definition: To act habitually in conformity with; to practice; to exemplify in one's way of life.
definitions.definitionCn: 习惯性地遵循；实践；以身作则。

definitions.definition: To outlast danger; to float (said of a ship, boat, etc).
definitions.example: No ship could live in such a storm.
definitions.definitionCn: 幸存于危险；（船等）漂浮。
definitions.exampleCn: 没有船能在这样的风暴中幸存。

definitions.definition: (followed by "on" or "upon") To maintain or support one's existence; to provide for oneself; to feed; to subsist.
definitions.example: It is hard to live on the minimum wage.   They lived on stale bread.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接"on"或"upon"）维持生存；自给自足；进食；糊口。
definitions.exampleCn: 靠最低工资生活很难。他们靠陈面包为生。

definitions.definition: To make the most of life; to experience a full, rich life.
definitions.example: I'm sick of spending every day studying at home: I want to go out there and live!
definitions.definitionCn: 充分体验生活；享受丰富的人生。
definitions.exampleCn: 我厌倦了每天在家学习：我想走出去真正地生活！

definitions.definition: The state of being alive.
definitions.definitionCn: 生命的状态。

definitions.definition: (plural, with "the", a demonstrative, or a possessive) Those who are alive.
definitions.example: Respect for the dead does not preclude respect for the living.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数，与"the"、指示词或所有格连用）活着的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 对死者的尊重并不妨碍对生者的尊重。

definitions.definition: Financial means; a means of maintaining life; livelihood
definitions.example: What do you do for a living?
definitions.definitionCn: 生计；维持生活的手段。
definitions.exampleCn: 你靠什么谋生？

definitions.definition: A style of life.
definitions.example: plain living
definitions.definitionCn: 生活方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 简朴的生活。

definitions.definition: (canon law) A position in a church (usually the Church of England) that has attached to it a source of income; an ecclesiastical benefice.
definitions.definitionCn: （教会法）有固定收入来源的教会职位（通常指英国圣公会）；圣职俸禄。

definitions.definition: Having life.
definitions.definitionCn: 有生命的。

definitions.definition: In use or existing.
definitions.example: Hunanese is a living language.
definitions.definitionCn: 在使用中或存在的。
definitions.exampleCn: 湖南话是一种活语言。

definitions.definition: Of everyday life.
definitions.example: These living conditions are deplorable.
definitions.definitionCn: 日常生活的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些生活条件糟透了。

definitions.definition: True to life.
definitions.example: This is the living image of Fidel Castro.
definitions.definitionCn: 逼真的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是菲德尔·卡斯特罗的活肖像。

definitions.definition: Used as an intensifier.
definitions.example: He almost beat the living daylights out of me.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作强调词。
definitions.exampleCn: 他差点把我打得半死。

definitions.definition: The point in the interior of a circle that is equidistant from all points on the circumference.
definitions.definitionCn: 圆内与圆周上所有点等距的点。

definitions.definition: The point in the interior of a sphere that is equidistant from all points on the circumference.
definitions.definitionCn: 球体内与球面上所有点等距的点。

definitions.definition: The middle portion of something; the part well away from the edges.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的中间部分；远离边缘的部分。

definitions.definition: The point on a line that is midway between the ends.
definitions.definitionCn: 线段上两端点正中间的点。

definitions.definition: The point in the interior of any figure of any number of dimensions that has as its coordinates the arithmetic mean of the coordinates of all points on the perimeter of the figure (or of all points in the interior for a center of volume).
definitions.definitionCn: 任意维度图形内部的一点，其坐标为图形边界上所有点（或体积中心情况下内部所有点）坐标的算术平均值。

definitions.definition: The subgroup (respectively, subring), denoted Z(G), of those elements of a given group (respectively, ring) G that commute with every element of G.
definitions.definitionCn: 给定群（或环）G中与G中所有元素可交换的元素构成的子群（或子环），记作Z(G)。

definitions.definition: A place where the greater part of some function or activity occurs.
definitions.example: shopping center, convention center, civic center, garment center, Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Rockefeller Center
definitions.definitionCn: 某些功能或活动主要发生的地点。
definitions.exampleCn: 购物中心、会议中心、市民中心、服装中心、林肯表演艺术中心、洛克菲勒中心。

definitions.definition: A topic that is particularly important in a given context.
definitions.example: the center of attention
definitions.definitionCn: 特定语境下特别重要的主题。
definitions.exampleCn: 关注的焦点。

definitions.definition: A player in the middle of the playing area
definitions.definitionCn: 比赛场地中央的球员。

definitions.definition: A player who can go all over the court, except the shooting circles.
definitions.definitionCn: 除射门圈外可覆盖全场的球员。

definitions.definition: A pass played into the centre of the pitch.
definitions.definitionCn: 传入球场中央的传球。

definitions.definition: One of the backs operating in a central area of the pitch, either the inside centre or outside centre.
definitions.definitionCn: 在球场中央区域活动的后卫之一，包括内中卫或外中卫。

definitions.definition: A temporary structure upon which the materials of a vault or arch are supported in position until the work becomes self-supporting.
definitions.definitionCn: 在拱顶或拱形结构材料就位至自承重前用于支撑的临时结构。

definitions.definition: One of the two conical steel pins in a lathe, etc., upon which the work is held, and about which it revolves.
definitions.definitionCn: 车床等设备上用于固定工件并使其绕其旋转的两个锥形钢销之一。

definitions.definition: A conical recess or indentation in the end of a shaft or other work, to receive the point of a center, on which the work can turn, as in a lathe.
definitions.definitionCn: 轴或其他工件端部的锥形凹槽或凹陷，用于容纳中心点，使工件可绕其旋转（如车床中）。

definitions.definition: The ensemble of moderate or centrist political parties.
definitions.definitionCn: 温和派或中间派政党的集合。

definitions.definition: To cause (an object) to occupy the center of an area.
definitions.example: He centered the heading of the document.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（物体）占据某个区域的中心。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将文档标题居中。

definitions.definition: To cause (some attribute, such as a mood or voltage) to be adjusted to a value which is midway between the extremes.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某种属性，如情绪或电压）调整至两极之间的中间值。

definitions.definition: To give (something) a central basis.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（某事物）提供中心基础。

definitions.definition: To concentrate on (something), to pay close attention to (something).
definitions.example: The discussion centered around the recent issues.
definitions.definitionCn: 专注于（某事物），密切关注（某事物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 讨论围绕近期问题展开。

definitions.definition: To form a recess or indentation for the reception of a center.
definitions.definitionCn: 为容纳中心点而制作凹槽或凹陷。

definitions.definition: Of, at, or related to a center.
definitions.definitionCn: 中心的、位于中心的或与中心相关的。

definitions.definition: The foremost side of something or the end that faces the direction it normally moves.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的最前面或通常移动方向所朝的一端。

definitions.definition: The side of a building with the main entrance.
definitions.definitionCn: 带有主入口的建筑侧面。

definitions.definition: A field of activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 活动领域。

definitions.definition: A person or institution acting as the public face of some other, covert group.
definitions.example: Officially it's a dry-cleaning shop, but everyone knows it's a front for the mafia.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为其他秘密团体公开代表的人或机构。
definitions.exampleCn: 名义上是干洗店，但大家都知道它是黑手党的掩护。

definitions.definition: The interface or transition zone between two airmasses of different density, often resulting in precipitation. Since the temperature distribution is the most important regulator of atmospheric density, a front almost invariably separates airmasses of different temperature.
definitions.definitionCn: 两种不同密度气团之间的界面或过渡区，常导致降水。由于温度分布是大气密度最重要的调节因素，锋面几乎总是分隔不同温度的气团。

definitions.definition: An area where armies are engaged in conflict, especially the line of contact.
definitions.definitionCn: 军队交战区域，尤指接触线。

definitions.definition: The lateral space occupied by an element measured from the extremity of one flank to the extremity of the other flank.
definitions.definitionCn: 某元素占据的横向空间，从一侧末端到另一侧末端测量。

definitions.definition: The direction of the enemy.
definitions.definitionCn: 敌人的方向。

definitions.definition: When a combat situation does not exist or is not assumed, the direction toward which the command is faced.
definitions.definitionCn: 当不存在或未假设战斗情况时，指挥所面对的方向。

definitions.definition: A major military subdivision of the Soviet Army.
definitions.definitionCn: 苏联陆军的主要军事编制。

definitions.definition: Cheek; boldness; impudence.
definitions.definitionCn: 厚颜；大胆；无礼。

definitions.definition: An act, show, façade, persona: an intentional and false impression of oneself.
definitions.example: He says he likes hip-hop, but I think it's just a front.
definitions.definitionCn: 行为、表象、伪装：对自我的故意虚假印象。
definitions.exampleCn: 他说他喜欢嘻哈，但我认为这只是伪装。

definitions.definition: That which covers the foremost part of the head: a front piece of false hair worn by women.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖头部最前部分的东西：女性佩戴的前额假发。

definitions.definition: The most conspicuous part.
definitions.definitionCn: 最显眼的部分。

definitions.definition: The beginning.
definitions.definitionCn: 开端。

definitions.definition: A seafront or coastal promenade.
definitions.definitionCn: 海滨或沿海步道。

definitions.definition: The forehead or brow, the part of the face above the eyes; sometimes, also, the whole face.
definitions.definitionCn: 前额或眉骨，眼睛上方的面部区域；有时也指整张脸。

definitions.definition: (hotels) The bellhop whose turn it is to answer a client's call, which is often the word "front" used as an exclamation.
definitions.definitionCn: （酒店）轮值应答客人呼叫的行李员，常以“front”一词作为感叹词使用。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) A grill (jewellery worn on front teeth).
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）牙饰（戴在门牙上的珠宝）。

definitions.definition: To face (on, to); to be pointed in a given direction.
definitions.definitionCn: 面向（某方向）；指向给定方向。

definitions.definition: To face, be opposite to.
definitions.definitionCn: 面对，与……相对。

definitions.definition: To face up to, to meet head-on, to confront.
definitions.definitionCn: 勇敢面对，迎头应对，对抗。

definitions.definition: To adorn the front of; to put on the front.
definitions.definitionCn: 装饰……的前部；放在前面。

definitions.definition: To pronounce with the tongue in a front position.
definitions.definitionCn: 用舌前部发音。

definitions.definition: To move (a word or clause) to the start of a sentence.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（单词或从句）移至句首。

definitions.definition: To act as a front (for); to cover (for).
definitions.definitionCn: 充当（……的）掩护；为……打掩护。

definitions.definition: To lead or be the spokesperson of (a campaign, organisation etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 领导或担任（运动、组织等的）发言人。

definitions.definition: To provide money or financial assistance in advance to.
definitions.definitionCn: 预先提供资金或财务援助。

definitions.definition: To assume false or disingenuous appearances.
definitions.definitionCn: 装出虚假或不真诚的样子。

definitions.definition: To deceive or attempt to deceive someone with false or disingenuous appearances (on).
definitions.definitionCn: 用虚假或不真诚的外表欺骗（某人）或试图欺骗（某人）。

definitions.definition: To appear before.
definitions.example: to front court
definitions.definitionCn: 出现在……面前。
definitions.exampleCn: 上前庭。

definitions.definition: Located at or near the front.
definitions.example: The front runner was thirty meters ahead of her nearest competitor.
definitions.definitionCn: 位于或靠近前部的。
definitions.exampleCn: 领先的选手比她最近的竞争对手领先三十米。

definitions.definition: Pronounced with the highest part of the body of the tongue toward the front of the mouth, near the hard palate (most often describing a vowel).
definitions.example: The English word dress has a front vowel in most dialects.
definitions.definitionCn: 用舌体最高部分靠近口腔前部、硬腭附近发音（多用于描述元音）。
definitions.exampleCn: 英语单词“dress”在大多数方言中具有前元音。

definitions.definition: A bounding straight edge of a two-dimensional shape.
definitions.example: A square has four sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 二维形状的边界直线。
definitions.exampleCn: 正方形有四条边。

definitions.definition: A flat surface of a three-dimensional object; a face.
definitions.example: A cube has six sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 三维物体的平坦表面；一个面。
definitions.exampleCn: 立方体有六个面。

definitions.definition: One half (left or right, top or bottom, front or back, etc.) of something or someone.
definitions.example: Which side of the tray shall I put it on?  The patient was bleeding on the right side.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物或某人的一半（左或右、上或下、前或后等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我应该把托盘放在哪一边？ 病人右侧在流血。

definitions.definition: A region in a specified position with respect to something.
definitions.example: Meet me on the north side of the monument.
definitions.definitionCn: 相对于某物在指定位置的区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 在纪念碑北侧与我见面。

definitions.definition: The portion of the human torso usually covered by the arms when they are not raised; the areas on the left and right between the belly or chest and the back.
definitions.example: I generally sleep on my side.
definitions.definitionCn: 人体躯干通常被手臂覆盖的部分（当手臂未抬起时）；腹部或胸部与背部之间的左右区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 我通常侧着睡。

definitions.definition: One surface of a sheet of paper (used instead of "page", which can mean one or both surfaces.)
definitions.example: John wrote 15 sides for his essay!
definitions.definitionCn: 一张纸的一个表面（用于替代“页”，后者可指单面或双面）。
definitions.exampleCn: 约翰为他的论文写了15面！

definitions.definition: One possible aspect of a concept, person or thing.
definitions.example: Look on the bright side.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个概念、人或事物的一个可能方面。
definitions.exampleCn: 往好的方面看。

definitions.definition: One set of competitors in a game.
definitions.example: Which side has kick-off?
definitions.definitionCn: 比赛中的一组竞争者。
definitions.exampleCn: 哪一方开球？

definitions.definition: A sports team.
definitions.definitionCn: 一支运动队。

definitions.definition: A group having a particular allegiance in a conflict or competition.
definitions.example: In the second world war, the Italians were on the side of the Germans.
definitions.definitionCn: 在冲突或竞争中具有特定忠诚度的群体。
definitions.exampleCn: 二战中，意大利人站在德国人一边。

definitions.definition: A recorded piece of music; a record, especially in jazz.
definitions.definitionCn: 一段录制的音乐；一张唱片，尤指爵士乐。

definitions.definition: Sidespin; english
definitions.example: He had to put a bit of side on to hit the pink ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 侧旋；英语
definitions.exampleCn: 他得加一点侧旋才能击中粉球。

definitions.definition: A television channel, usually as opposed to the one currently being watched (from when there were only two channels).
definitions.example: I just want to see what's on the other side — James said there was a good film on tonight.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个电视频道，通常与当前正在观看的频道相对（源自只有两个频道的时代）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我只想看看另一边有什么——詹姆斯说今晚有一部好电影。

definitions.definition: A dish that accompanies the main course; a side dish.
definitions.example: Do you want a side of cole-slaw with that?
definitions.definitionCn: 搭配主菜的菜肴；配菜。
definitions.exampleCn: 你要配一份凉拌卷心菜吗？

definitions.definition: A line of descent traced through one parent as distinguished from that traced through another.
definitions.example: his mother's side of the family
definitions.definitionCn: 通过一方父母追溯的血统，区别于通过另一方追溯的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他母亲那边的家族

definitions.definition: The batters faced in an inning by a particular pitcher
definitions.example: Clayton Kershaw struck out the side in the 6th inning.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定投手在一局中面对的击球员
definitions.exampleCn: 克莱顿·克肖在第六局三振了所有击球员。

definitions.definition: An unjustified air of self-importance.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种无根据的自负态度。

definitions.definition: A written monologue or part of a scene to be read by an actor at an audition.
definitions.definitionCn: 演员试镜时需朗读的书面独白或场景部分。

definitions.definition: A man who prefers not to engage in anal sex during homosexual intercourse.
definitions.example: My boyfriend and I are both sides, so we prefer to do oral on each other.
definitions.definitionCn: 在同性性行为中不愿进行肛交的男性。
definitions.exampleCn: 我和男友都是侧位者，所以我们更喜欢互相口交。

definitions.definition: To ally oneself, be in an alliance, usually with "with" or rarely "in with"
definitions.example: Which will you side with, good or evil?
definitions.definitionCn: 结盟，通常与“with”或罕见地“in with”连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 你会站在哪一边，善还是恶？

definitions.definition: To lean on one side.
definitions.definitionCn: 向一侧倾斜。

definitions.definition: To be or stand at the side of; to be on the side toward.
definitions.definitionCn: 位于或站在……的侧面；朝向……的一侧。

definitions.definition: To suit; to pair; to match.
definitions.definitionCn: 适合；配对；匹配。

definitions.definition: To work (a timber or rib) to a certain thickness by trimming the sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过修整侧面将（木材或肋材）加工到一定厚度。

definitions.definition: To furnish with a siding.
definitions.example: to side a house
definitions.definitionCn: 安装侧板。
definitions.exampleCn: 给房子装侧板

definitions.definition: To provide with, as a side or accompaniment.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供作为侧面或配菜。

definitions.definition: Being on the left or right, or toward the left or right; lateral.
definitions.definitionCn: 位于左侧或右侧，或朝向左侧或右侧；侧面的。

definitions.definition: Indirect; oblique; incidental.
definitions.example: a side issue; a side view or remark
definitions.definitionCn: 间接的；斜向的；附带的。
definitions.exampleCn: 次要问题；侧视图或旁白

definitions.definition: To clear, tidy or sort.
Wide; large; long, pendulous, hanging low, trailing; far-reaching.
Far; distant.
Widely; wide; far.
The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.
definitions.example: Could you please scratch my back?
definitions.definitionCn: 身体后部，尤指颈部至脊柱末端、与胸腹相对的部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能帮我挠一下背吗？

definitions.definition: That which is farthest away from the front.
definitions.example: He sat in the back of the room.
definitions.definitionCn: 离前面最远的部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 他坐在房间的后部。

definitions.definition: Upper part of a natural object which is considered to resemble an animal's back.
definitions.example: The small boat raced over the backs of the waves.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为类似动物背部的自然物体上部。
definitions.exampleCn: 小船在浪脊上飞驰。

definitions.definition: A support or resource in reserve.
definitions.definitionCn: 储备的支持或资源。

definitions.definition: The keel and keelson of a ship.
definitions.example: The ship's back broke in the pounding surf.
definitions.definitionCn: 船的龙骨和内龙骨。
definitions.exampleCn: 船身在汹涌的浪涛中断裂。

definitions.definition: The roof of a horizontal underground passage.
definitions.definitionCn: 水平地下通道的顶部。

definitions.definition: Effort, usually physical.
definitions.example: Put some back into it!
definitions.definitionCn: 通常指体力上的努力。
definitions.exampleCn: 再加把劲！

definitions.definition: A non-alcoholic drink (often water or a soft drink), to go with hard liquor or a cocktail.
definitions.example: Could I get a martini with a water back?
definitions.definitionCn: 搭配烈酒或鸡尾酒的非酒精饮料（通常是水或软饮）。
definitions.exampleCn: 能给我一杯马提尼配一杯水吗？

definitions.definition: Among leather dealers, one of the thickest and stoutest tanned hides.
definitions.definitionCn: 皮革行业中，最厚最结实的鞣制皮革之一。

definitions.definition: To go in the reverse direction.
definitions.example: the train backed into the station;  the horse refuses to back
definitions.definitionCn: 向相反方向移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 火车倒进了车站；马不肯后退。

definitions.definition: To support.
definitions.example: I back you all the way;  which horse are you backing in this race?
definitions.definitionCn: 支持。
definitions.exampleCn: 我全力支持你；这场比赛你押哪匹马？

definitions.definition: (of the wind) To change direction contrary to the normal pattern; that is, to shift anticlockwise in the northern hemisphere, or clockwise in the southern hemisphere.
definitions.definitionCn: （指风）逆常规方向改变；即北半球逆时针转向，南半球顺时针转向。

definitions.definition: (of a square sail) To brace the yards so that the wind presses on the front of the sail, to slow the ship.
definitions.definitionCn: （指横帆）调整帆桁使风压向帆面，以减慢船速。

definitions.definition: (of an anchor) To lay out a second, smaller anchor to provide additional holding power.
definitions.definitionCn: （指锚）再抛一个较小的锚以增加抓力。

definitions.definition: (of a hunting dog) To stand still behind another dog which has pointed.
definitions.definitionCn: （指猎犬）在另一只已示踪的猎犬身后静止不动。

definitions.definition: To push or force backwards.
definitions.example: The mugger backed her into a corner and demanded her wallet.
definitions.definitionCn: 推或迫使后退。
definitions.exampleCn: 劫匪把她逼到角落，索要钱包。

definitions.definition: To get upon the back of; to mount.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑上……的背；登上。

definitions.definition: To place or seat upon the back.
definitions.definitionCn: 放在背上或使就座于背上。

definitions.definition: To make a back for; to furnish with a back.
definitions.example: to back books
definitions.definitionCn: 为……制作背部；给……装上背衬。
definitions.exampleCn: 给书装背衬。

definitions.definition: To adjoin behind; to be at the back of.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧邻……的后方；位于……的后面。

definitions.definition: To write upon the back of, possibly as an endorsement.
definitions.example: to back a letter;  to back a note or legal document
definitions.definitionCn: 在……背面书写，可能作为背书。
definitions.exampleCn: 在信件背面签名；在票据或法律文件背面背书。

definitions.definition: (of a justice of the peace) To sign or endorse (a warrant, issued in another county, to apprehend an offender).
definitions.definitionCn: （指治安法官）签署或背书（在其他郡签发的逮捕令）以逮捕罪犯。

definitions.definition: To row backward with (oars).
definitions.example: to back the oars
definitions.definitionCn: 用桨向后划。
definitions.exampleCn: 倒划桨。

definitions.definition: Near the rear.
definitions.example: Go in the back door of the house.
definitions.definitionCn: 靠近后部。
definitions.exampleCn: 从房子的后门进去。

definitions.definition: Not current.
definitions.example: I’d like to find a back issue of that magazine.
definitions.definitionCn: 非当前的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想找那本杂志的过刊。

definitions.definition: Far from the main area.
definitions.example: They took a back road.
definitions.definitionCn: 远离主要区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们走了一条偏僻的小路。

definitions.definition: In arrear; overdue.
definitions.example: They still owe three months' back rent.
definitions.definitionCn: 拖欠的；逾期的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们还欠三个月的欠租。

definitions.definition: Moving or operating backward.
definitions.example: back action
definitions.definitionCn: 向后移动或运作的。
definitions.exampleCn: 反向动作。

definitions.definition: Pronounced with the highest part of the body of the tongue toward the back of the mouth, near the soft palate (most often describing a vowel).
definitions.example: The vowel of lot has a back vowel in most dialects of England.
definitions.definitionCn: 发音时舌体最高部位靠近口腔后部、软腭附近（多用于描述元音）。
definitions.exampleCn: 在英格兰大部分方言中，"lot"的元音是后元音。

definitions.definition: To or in a previous condition or place.
definitions.example: He gave back the money.   He needs his money back.   He was on vacation, but now he’s back.   The office fell into chaos when you left, but now order is back.
definitions.definitionCn: 回到先前的状态或位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 他把钱还了回来。他需要拿回他的钱。他之前度假，但现在回来了。你离开时办公室陷入混乱，但现在秩序恢复了。

definitions.definition: Away from the front or from an edge.
definitions.example: Sit all the way back in your chair.
definitions.definitionCn: 远离前面或边缘。
definitions.exampleCn: 在椅子上尽量往后坐。

definitions.definition: In a manner that impedes.
definitions.example: Fear held him back.
definitions.definitionCn: 以阻碍的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 恐惧让他退缩。

definitions.definition: In a reciprocal manner; in return.
definitions.example: If you hurt me, I'll hurt you back.
definitions.definitionCn: 以互惠的方式；作为回报。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你伤害我，我也会伤害你。

definitions.definition: Earlier, ago.
definitions.example: I last saw him a day or two back.
definitions.definitionCn: 更早以前。
definitions.exampleCn: 我最后一次见到他是一两天前。

definitions.definition: A large shallow vat; a cistern, tub, or trough, used by brewers, distillers, dyers, picklers, gluemakers, and others, for mixing or cooling wort, holding water, hot glue, etc.
A ferryboat.
The keeper, manager of a library.
definitions.definitionCn: 图书馆的管理员、负责人。

definitions.definition: One who cares for the publications, files etc. in a library, whether staff or volunteer.
definitions.definitionCn: 照料图书馆内出版物、档案等的人，无论是工作人员还是志愿者。

definitions.definition: A person who processes and organizes information.
definitions.definitionCn: 处理和组织信息的人。

definitions.definition: Relating to literature.

definitions.definitionCn: 棕榈科或槟榔科的各种常绿树木，主要生长于热带地区。

definitions.definition: A branch or leaf of the palm, anciently borne or worn as a symbol of victory or rejoicing.
definitions.definitionCn: 棕榈的枝条或叶片，古时被手持或佩戴作为胜利或欢庆的象征。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Triumph; victory.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）胜利；凯旋。

definitions.definition: Any of 23 awards that can be earned after obtaining the Eagle Scout rank, but generally only before turning 18 years old.

The flat inner face of an anchor fluke.

definitions.definition: A potter's shop or workshop, where pottery is made.

definitions.definitionCn: 陶匠的店铺或作坊，即制作陶器的地方。

definitions.definition: The potter's craft or art: making vessels from clay.
definitions.definitionCn: 陶匠的工艺或艺术：用粘土制作器皿。

definitions.definition: Having, or capable of exerting power, potency or influence.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有或能够施加力量、效力或影响力。

definitions.definition: Large; capacious; said of veins of ore.
definitions.definitionCn: 大的；容量大的；用于描述矿脉。

definitions.definition: To a great extent or degree.

definitions.definitionCn: 在很大程度上或程度上。
definitions.exampleCn: 它们中受损的并不多。

definitions.definition: Conforming to fact, reality or rule; true.
definitions.definitionCn: 符合事实、现实或规则；真实的。

definitions.definition: (with superlatives) Used to firmly establish that nothing else surpasses in some respect.
definitions.example: He was the very best runner there.
definitions.definitionCn: （与最高级连用）用于坚定地确立在某方面没有其他事物能超越。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是那里最好的跑步者。

definitions.definition: The act of performing; carrying into execution or action; execution; achievement; accomplishment; representation by action.

definitions.definitionCn: 表演的行为；执行或付诸行动；实施；成就；完成；通过行动表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 履行一项任务或职责。

definitions.definition: That which is performed or accomplished; a thing done or carried through; an achievement; a deed; an act; a feat; especially, an action of an elaborate or public character.
definitions.definitionCn: 被表演或完成的事物；已完成或贯彻的事情；成就；行为；举动；事迹；尤指精心策划或公开性质的行为。

definitions.definition: A live show or concert.
definitions.definitionCn: 现场演出或音乐会。

definitions.definition: The amount of useful work accomplished estimated in terms of time needed, resources used, etc.
definitions.example: Better performance means more work accomplished in shorter time and/or using fewer resources.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据所需时间、所用资源等估算的有效工作量。
definitions.exampleCn: 更佳表现意味着在更短时间内和/或使用更少资源完成更多工作。

definitions.definition: The actual use of language in concrete situations by native speakers of a language, as opposed to the system of linguistic knowledge they possess (competence), cf. :w:linguistic performance.
definitions.definitionCn: 母语者在具体情境中对语言的实际使用，与其所具备的语言知识系统（能力）相对，参见：语言表现。

definitions.definition: A collection of interlinked web pages on the World Wide Web that are typically accessible from the same base URL and reside on the same server.
definitions.definitionCn: 万维网上相互链接的网页集合，通常可通过同一基础URL访问并位于同一服务器上。

definitions.definition: Grief, sorrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 悲伤，哀痛。

definitions.definition: Close attention; concern; responsibility.
definitions.example: Care should be taken when holding babies.
definitions.definitionCn: 密切关注；关心；责任。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱婴儿时要小心。

definitions.definition: Worry.

definitions.definitionCn: 担忧。
definitions.exampleCn: 我无忧无虑。

definitions.definition: Maintenance, upkeep.

definitions.definitionCn: 维护，保养。
definitions.exampleCn: 牙齿护理。

definitions.definition: The treatment of those in need (especially as a profession).
definitions.definitionCn: 对需要帮助者的照料（尤指作为职业）。

definitions.definition: The state of being cared for by others.

definitions.definitionCn: 被他人照顾的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 由他人监护。

definitions.definition: The object of watchful attention or anxiety.
definitions.definitionCn: 被密切关注或担忧的对象。

definitions.definition: To be concerned (about), to have an interest (in); to feel concern (about).

definitions.definition: (polite) To want, to desire; to like; to be inclined towards.

definitions.definition: (with for) To look after or look out for.

definitions.definition: To mind; to object.

definitions.definitionCn: 正式属于某个群体的人。

definitions.definition: A part of a whole.

definitions.definitionCn: 整体的一部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 工字钢将成为人行天桥的结构构件。

definitions.definition: Part of an animal capable of performing a distinct office; an organ; a limb.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物体内能执行特定功能的部位；器官；肢体。

definitions.definition: One of the propositions making up a syllogism.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成三段论的一个命题。

definitions.definition: An element of a set.
definitions.definitionCn: 集合中的一个元素。

definitions.definition: A function or piece of data associated with each separate instance of a class.
definitions.definitionCn: 与类的每个独立实例相关联的函数或数据项。

definitions.definition: The judge or adjudicator in a consumer court.
definitions.definitionCn: 消费者法庭中的法官或裁决者。

definitions.definition: A part of a discourse or of a period, sentence, or verse; a clause.
definitions.definitionCn: 话语、句段、句子或诗句的一部分；分句。

definitions.definitionCn: 代数方程中由等号连接的两个部分之一。

definitions.definitionCn: 存储在归档文件中的文件。
definitions.exampleCn: 包含此应用程序源代码的压缩文件有245个成员。

definitions.definition: One of the four major compass points, specifically 180°, directed toward the South Pole, and conventionally downwards on a map, abbreviated as S.
definitions.definitionCn: 四大基本方位之一，特指180度方向，指向南极，在地图上通常表示为下方，缩写为S。

definitions.definition: The side of a church on the right hand of a person facing the altar.
definitions.definitionCn: 教堂中面向祭坛者右手一侧。

definitions.definition: To turn or move toward the south; to veer toward the south.
definitions.definitionCn: 转向或朝南移动；偏向南方。

definitions.definition: To come to the meridian; to cross the north and south line.

definitions.definitionCn: 到达子午线；穿过南北线。
definitions.exampleCn: 月亮在九点到达南中天。

definitions.definition: Toward the south; southward.
definitions.definitionCn: 向南；朝南方向。

definitions.definition: (of wind) from the south.
definitions.definitionCn: （指风）来自南方。

definitions.definition: Of or pertaining to the south; southern.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于南方的；南部的。

definitions.definitionCn: 属于南向交通使用的走廊部分。

definitions.definitionCn: 向南；朝南方向。

definitions.definition: Of wind, from the south.
definitions.definitionCn: 指风来自南方。

definitions.definitionCn: （有时也用作不可数名词）可见的指示。

definitions.definition: Physical evidence left by an animal.

definitions.definitionCn: 动物留下的物理痕迹。
definitions.exampleCn: 猎人在小径尽头发现了鹿的踪迹。

definitions.definition: A clearly visible object, generally flat, bearing a short message in words or pictures.

definitions.definitionCn: 一个清晰可见的物体，通常是扁平的，上面有简短的文字或图片信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 我错过了拐角处的标志，所以走错了路。

definitions.definition: A wonder; miracle; prodigy.
definitions.definitionCn: 奇迹；神迹；奇观。

definitions.definition: An astrological sign.

definitions.definitionCn: 星座标志。

definitions.definitionCn: 正负极性，用+或-符号表示。
definitions.exampleCn: 我算对了大小，但符号错了。

definitions.definition: A specific gesture or motion used to communicate by those with speaking or hearing difficulties; now specifically, a linguistic unit in sign language equivalent to word in spoken languages.
definitions.definitionCn: 有语言或听力障碍者用来交流的特定手势或动作；现在特指手语中相当于口语中单词的语言单位。

definitions.definitionCn: 手语总称。

definitions.exampleCn: “这是世界末日的征兆，”末日预言者说道。

definitions.definitionCn: 身体上指示疾病的特征，与症状不同，患者通常不易察觉。

definitions.definition: As long as.

definitions.definitionCn: 只要。

definitions.definitionCn: 以描述性的方式讲述。

definitions.definitionCn: 存在关联。

definitions.definitionCn: 处于关系或联系中。

definitions.definitionCn: 实现一种关系。

definitions.definitionCn: 与某事物相关或依赖于它；相对的。

definitions.exampleCn: 相对URL /images/pic.jpg，在http://example.com/docs/pic.html的上下文中解析时，对应绝对URL http://example.com/images/pic.jpg。

definitions.definition: (grammar) That relates to an antecedent.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）指代先行词的。

definitions.definition: Having the same key but differing in being major or minor.

definitions.definitionCn: 纸张的一面，上面写有或印有内容。

definitions.definitionCn: 任何记录或文字；集体记忆。

definitions.definition: A block of contiguous memory of a fixed length.
definitions.definitionCn: 一段固定长度的连续内存块。

definitions.definitionCn: 为书籍或手稿等标记或编号页码。

definitions.definitionCn: 受雇跑腿、看门或在家庭中做类似服务的年轻人。

definitions.definition: A boy or girl employed to wait upon the members of a legislative body.
definitions.definitionCn: 受雇在立法机构中侍奉议员的男孩或女孩。

definitions.definition: (in libraries) The common name given to an employee whose main purpose is to replace materials that have either been checked out or otherwise moved, back to their shelves.
definitions.definitionCn: （图书馆中）主要职责是将已借出或移动过的资料放回书架的员工的通用名称。

definitions.definition: A boy child.
definitions.definitionCn: 男孩。

definitions.definition: A contrivance, as a band, pin, snap, or the like, to hold the skirt of a woman’s dress from the ground.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种装置，如带子、别针、按扣等，用于将女裙裙摆提离地面。

definitions.definition: A track along which pallets carrying newly molded bricks are conveyed to the hack.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条轨道，承载新制砖块的托盘沿此被运送到晒砖场。

definitions.definitionCn: 发送到某人寻呼机上的消息。

definitions.definitionCn: 几种色彩鲜艳的南美尺蛾属蛾类中的任何一种。

definitions.definitionCn: 作为侍从侍奉（某人）。

definitions.definitionCn: 呼叫或召唤（某人）。

definitions.definitionCn: 通过寻呼机或其他移动设备联系（某人）。

definitions.definition: A person who exhibits either good or bad sportsmanship.

definitions.definitionCn: 表现出良好或不良体育精神的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 珍可能赢了，但她绝对是个输不起的人；她嘲笑失败者。

definitions.definition: Somebody who behaves or reacts in an admirably good-natured manner, e.g. to being teased or to losing a game; a good sport.
