definitions.definition: (of a wind) Blowing in the direction of travel.
definitions.example: The following wind sped us on our way.
definitions.definitionCn: （指风）顺风方向吹的。
definitions.exampleCn: 顺风加速了我们的行程。

definitions.definition: After, subsequent to.
definitions.example: Following the meeting, we all had a chat.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……之后。
definitions.exampleCn: 会议结束后，我们都聊了一会儿。

definitions.definition: A long dowel or plank protruding from the ground; a fencepost; a lightpost.
definitions.example: ram a post into the ground
definitions.definitionCn: 一根从地面伸出的长木钉或木板；栅栏柱；灯柱。
definitions.exampleCn: 将柱子打入地面。

definitions.definition: A stud; a two-by-four.
definitions.definitionCn: 一根螺柱；一块二乘四英寸的木料。

definitions.definition: A pole in a battery.
definitions.definitionCn: 电池中的电极。

definitions.definition: A long, narrow piece inserted into a root canal to provide retention for a crown.
definitions.definitionCn: 插入根管中用于固定牙冠的细长条。

definitions.definition: (chiefly a cappella) A prolonged final melody note, among moving harmony notes.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要指无伴奏合唱）在移动的和声音符中，一个延长的最终旋律音符。

definitions.definition: A printing paper size measuring 19.25 inches x 15.5 inches.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种印刷纸张尺寸，为19.25英寸×15.5英寸。

definitions.definition: A goalpost.
definitions.definitionCn: 球门柱。

definitions.definition: A location on a basketball court near the basket.
definitions.definitionCn: 篮球场上靠近篮筐的位置。

definitions.definition: The doorpost of a victualler's shop or inn, on which were chalked the scores of customers; hence, a score; a debt.
definitions.definitionCn: 小酒馆或旅店的门柱，上面用粉笔记录顾客的赊账；因此引申为欠款或债务。

definitions.definition: To hang (a notice) in a conspicuous manner for general review.
definitions.example: Post no bills.
definitions.definitionCn: 以显眼方式张贴（通知）供公众查看。
definitions.exampleCn: 禁止张贴。

definitions.definition: To hold up to public blame or reproach; to advertise opprobriously; to denounce by public proclamation.
definitions.example: to post someone for cowardice
definitions.definitionCn: 公开指责或谴责；通过公告进行抨击。
definitions.exampleCn: 因懦弱而公开谴责某人。

definitions.definition: To carry (an account) from the journal to the ledger.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（账目）从日记账过到分类账。

definitions.definition: To inform; to give the news to; to make acquainted with the details of a subject; often with up.
definitions.definitionCn: 告知；传递消息；使某人了解某事的细节；常与up连用。

definitions.definition: To pay (a blind).
definitions.example: Since Jim was new to the game, he had to post $4 in order to receive a hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 支付（盲注）。
definitions.exampleCn: 由于吉姆是新手，他必须支付4美元才能拿到一手牌。

definitions.definition: To put content online, usually through a publicly accessible mean, such as a video channel, gallery, message board, blog etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 将内容发布到网上，通常通过公开可访问的渠道，如视频频道、画廊、留言板、博客等。

definitions.definition: Each of a series of men stationed at specific places along a postroad, with responsibility for relaying letters and dispatches of the monarch (and later others) along the route.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿邮路特定地点驻扎的一系列人员，负责沿途传递君主（后来也包括其他人）的信件和公文。

definitions.definition: A station, or one of a series of stations, established for the refreshment and accommodation of travellers on some recognized route.
definitions.example: a stage or railway post
definitions.definitionCn: 为旅行者在某条公认路线上提供休息和住宿而设立的站点或一系列站点之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个驿站或铁路站。

definitions.definition: A military base; the place at which a soldier or a body of troops is stationed; also, the troops at such a station.
definitions.definitionCn: 军事基地；士兵或部队驻扎的地方；也指该驻地的部队。

definitions.definition: Someone who travels express along a set route carrying letters and dispatches; a courier.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿固定路线快速旅行以传递信件和公文的人；信使。

definitions.definition: An organisation for delivering letters, parcels etc., or the service provided by such an organisation.
definitions.example: sent via post; parcel post
definitions.definitionCn: 负责递送信件、包裹等的组织，或该组织提供的服务。
definitions.exampleCn: 通过邮政寄送；包裹邮寄。

definitions.definition: A single delivery of letters; the letters or deliveries that make up a single batch delivered to one person or one address.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次信件投递；构成一次投递到一个人或一个地址的一批信件或包裹。

definitions.definition: A message posted in an electronic or Internet forum, or on a blog, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 在电子或互联网论坛、博客等上发布的消息。

definitions.definition: A moderate to deep passing route in which a receiver runs 10-20 yards from the line of scrimmage straight down the field, then cuts toward the middle of the field (towards the facing goalposts) at a 45-degree angle.
definitions.example: Two of the receivers ran post patterns.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种中到深度的传球路线，接球手从开球线直下球场10-20码，然后以45度角切向球场中央（朝向对面球门柱）。
definitions.exampleCn: 两名接球手跑了“柱”路线。

definitions.definition: Haste or speed, like that of a messenger or mail carrier.
definitions.definitionCn: 像信使或邮递员那样的匆忙或速度。

definitions.definition: One who has charge of a station, especially a postal station.
definitions.definitionCn: 负责管理站点的人，尤其是邮政站点。

definitions.definition: To travel with relays of horses; to travel by post horses, originally as a courier.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用接力马匹旅行；最初作为信使通过驿站马匹旅行。

definitions.definition: To travel quickly; to hurry.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速旅行；匆忙。

definitions.definition: To send (an item of mail etc.) through the postal service.
definitions.example: Mail items posted before 7.00pm within the Central Business District and before 5.00pm outside the Central Business District will be delivered the next working day.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过邮政服务发送（邮件等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 在中央商务区下午7点前、中央商务区以外下午5点前邮寄的邮件将在下一个工作日送达。

definitions.definition: (horse-riding) To rise and sink in the saddle, in accordance with the motion of the horse, especially in trotting.
definitions.definitionCn: （骑马）随着马的动作（尤其是小跑时）在马鞍上起伏。

definitions.definition: To publish (a message) to a newsgroup, forum, blog, etc.
definitions.example: I couldn't figure it out, so I posted a question on the mailing list.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（消息）发布到新闻组、论坛、博客等。
definitions.exampleCn: 我搞不明白，于是在邮件列表上发了个问题。

definitions.definition: An assigned station; a guard post.
definitions.definitionCn: 指定的岗位；警卫哨。

definitions.definition: An appointed position in an organization, job.
definitions.definitionCn: 组织中的指定职位或工作。

definitions.definition: To enter (a name) on a list, as for service, promotion, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（名字）列入名单，如用于服役、晋升等。

definitions.definition: To assign to a station; to set; to place.
definitions.example: Post a sentinel in front of the door.
definitions.definitionCn: 指派到某个岗位；设置；放置。
definitions.exampleCn: 在门前设置一名哨兵。

definitions.definition: A post mortem (investigation of body's cause of death).
definitions.definitionCn: 尸检（调查尸体死因）。

definitions.definition: A person who studies or learns about a particular subject.
definitions.example: He is a student of life.
definitions.definitionCn: 研究或学习某一特定学科的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是生活的学生。

definitions.definition: A person who is formally enrolled at a school, a college or university, or another educational institution.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式注册于学校、学院、大学或其他教育机构的人。

definitions.definition: A list of names, addresses etc, of specific classes of people or organizations, often in alphabetical order or in some classification.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定类别人员或组织的名称、地址等列表，通常按字母顺序或某种分类排列。

definitions.definition: A structured listing of the names and characteristics of the files on a storage device.
definitions.definitionCn: 存储设备上文件名称及特征的结构化列表。

definitions.definition: A virtual container in a computer's file system, in which files and other directories may be stored. The files and subdirectories in a directory are usually related.
definitions.definitionCn: 计算机文件系统中的虚拟容器，可存储文件及其他目录。目录中的文件和子目录通常相互关联。

definitions.definition: Containing directions; instructing; directorial.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含指示的；指导性的；指导的。

definitions.definition: A particular point or place in physical space.
definitions.definitionCn: 物理空间中的特定点或位置。

definitions.definition: An act of locating.
definitions.definitionCn: 定位的行为。

definitions.definition: An apartheid-era urban area populated by non-white people; township.
definitions.definitionCn: 种族隔离时期非白人居住的城市区域；乡镇。

definitions.definition: A leasing on rent.
definitions.definitionCn: 租赁合同。

definitions.definition: A contract for the use of a thing, or service of a person, for hire.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用某物或某人服务的雇佣合同。

definitions.definition: The marking out of the boundaries, or identifying the place or site of, a piece of land, according to the description given in an entry, plan, map, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据条目、平面图、地图等描述，标出土地边界或确定其位置或场地。

definitions.definition: To visit stores or shops to browse or explore merchandise, especially with the intention of buying such merchandise.
definitions.example: He’s shopping for clothes.
definitions.definitionCn: 逛商店或店铺浏览或探索商品，尤其是打算购买这些商品。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正在逛街买衣服。

definitions.definition: To purchase products from (a range or catalogue, etc.).
definitions.example: Shop our new arrivals.
definitions.definitionCn: 从（系列或目录等）中购买产品。
definitions.exampleCn: 选购我们的新品。

definitions.definition: To report the criminal activities or whereabouts of someone to an authority.
definitions.example: He shopped his mates in to the police.
definitions.definitionCn: 向当局举报某人的犯罪活动或行踪。
definitions.exampleCn: 他向警察举报了他的同伙。

definitions.definition: To imprison.
definitions.definitionCn: 监禁。

definitions.definition: To photoshop; to digitally edit a picture or photograph.
definitions.definitionCn: 用Photoshop处理；对图片或照片进行数字编辑。

definitions.definition: The process of buying goods or services, or searching for those suitable to buy.
definitions.example: On Saturdays we usually do the shopping.
definitions.definitionCn: 购买商品或服务，或寻找适合购买的商品的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 星期六我们通常去购物。

definitions.definition: Recently bought goods.
definitions.example: I carried three heavy bags of shopping up the stairs.
definitions.definitionCn: 最近购买的商品。
definitions.exampleCn: 我提着三袋沉重的购物物品上了楼梯。

definitions.definition: An area's combination of stores and other infrastructure and products available for people who want to shop.
definitions.example: Boston has good shopping.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个地区为购物者提供的商店、基础设施和商品的组合。
definitions.exampleCn: 波士顿购物环境很好。

definitions.definition: To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.
definitions.example: I will purchase the vacation package if you will include car rental.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为（新的）部分或成员加入某个群体、类别、集合或整体。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你包含租车服务，我会购买度假套餐。

definitions.definition: To contain, as parts of a whole; to comprehend.
definitions.example: Does this volume of Shakespeare include his sonnets?
definitions.definitionCn: 包含，作为整体的组成部分；理解。
definitions.exampleCn: 这本莎士比亚全集包含他的十四行诗吗？

definitions.definition: To enclose, confine.
definitions.definitionCn: 包围，限制。

definitions.definition: To conclude; to terminate.
definitions.definitionCn: 结束；终止。

definitions.definition: To use a directive that allows the use of source code from another file.
definitions.example: You have to include the strings library to use this function.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用允许从另一个文件引用源代码的指令。
definitions.exampleCn: 你必须包含字符串库才能使用这个函数。

definitions.definition: Such as, among which; introducing one or more parts of the group or topic just mentioned.
definitions.example: All you have to do is to fill in the details, including your name and address and the amount you wish to give.
definitions.definitionCn: 例如，其中；引入刚才提到的群体或主题的一个或多个部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 你只需填写详细信息，包括你的姓名、地址以及你希望捐赠的金额。

definitions.definition: A writing consisting of multiple glyphs, characters, symbols or sentences.
definitions.definitionCn: 由多个字形、字符、符号或句子组成的文字作品。

definitions.definition: A book, tome or other set of writings.
definitions.definitionCn: 一本书、一卷或其他文字集合。

definitions.definition: A brief written message transmitted between mobile phones.
definitions.definitionCn: 手机间传输的简短文字信息。

definitions.definition: Data which can be interpreted as human-readable text.
definitions.definitionCn: 可解读为人类可读文本的数据。

definitions.definition: A verse or passage of Scripture, especially one chosen as the subject of a sermon, or in proof of a doctrine.
definitions.definitionCn: 经文中的一节或一段，尤指选作布道主题或证明教义的段落。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Anything chosen as the subject of an argument, literary composition, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）被选为论点、文学作品等主题的任何内容。

definitions.definition: A style of writing in large characters; also, a kind of type used in printing.
definitions.example: German text
definitions.definitionCn: 大字书写风格；亦指印刷中使用的一种字体。
definitions.exampleCn: 德语文本。

definitions.definition: To send a text message to; i.e. to transmit text using the Short Message Service (SMS), or a similar service, between communications devices, particularly mobile phones.
definitions.example: I'll text the address to you as soon as I find it.
definitions.definitionCn: 发送短信；即在通信设备（尤其是手机）之间通过短信服务（SMS）或类似服务传输文字。
definitions.exampleCn: 我一找到地址就发短信给你。

definitions.definition: To send and receive text messages.
definitions.example: Have you been texting all afternoon?
definitions.definitionCn: 发送和接收短信。
definitions.exampleCn: 你整个下午都在发短信吗？

definitions.definition: To write in large characters, as in text hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 以手写大字风格书写。

definitions.definition: The conscious production or arrangement of sounds, colours, forms, movements, or other elements in a manner that affects the senses and emotions, usually specifically the production of the beautiful in a graphic or plastic medium.
definitions.example: There is a debate as to whether graffiti is art or vandalism.
definitions.definitionCn: 有意识地创作或安排声音、色彩、形态、动作或其他元素，以影响感官和情感的方式，通常特指在图形或立体媒介中创造美。
definitions.exampleCn: 关于涂鸦是艺术还是破坏行为，存在争议。

definitions.definition: The creative and emotional expression of mental imagery, such as visual, auditory, social, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 对心理意象（如视觉、听觉、社会性等）的创造性及情感表达。

definitions.definition: Skillful creative activity, usually with an aesthetic focus.
definitions.example: She's mastered the art of programming.
definitions.definitionCn: 熟练的创造性活动，通常以审美为核心。
definitions.exampleCn: 她掌握了编程的艺术。

definitions.definition: The study and the product of these processes.
definitions.example: He's at university to study art.
definitions.definitionCn: 对这些过程的研究及其产物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在大学学习艺术。

definitions.definition: Aesthetic value.
definitions.example: Her photographs are nice, but there's no art in them.
definitions.definitionCn: 审美价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的照片不错，但缺乏艺术性。

definitions.definition: Artwork.
definitions.example: Sotheby's regularly auctions art for millions.
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术作品。
definitions.exampleCn: 苏富比定期拍卖价值数百万的艺术品。

definitions.definition: A field or category of art, such as painting, sculpture, music, ballet, or literature.
definitions.example: I'm a great supporter of the arts.
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术的一个领域或类别，如绘画、雕塑、音乐、芭蕾或文学。
definitions.exampleCn: 我是艺术的大力支持者。

definitions.definition: A nonscientific branch of learning; one of the liberal arts.
definitions.definitionCn: 非科学的学习分支；人文学科之一。

definitions.definition: Skill that is attained by study, practice, or observation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过学习、实践或观察获得的技能。

definitions.definition: Contrivance, scheming, manipulation.
definitions.definitionCn: 计谋、策划、操纵。

definitions.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.
definitions.example: Time stops for nobody.   the ebb and flow of time
definitions.definitionCn: 随着现在和过去事件的流逝，未来不可避免地向我们走来。
definitions.exampleCn: 时间不为任何人停留。时间的潮起潮落

definitions.definition: A duration of time.
definitions.definitionCn: 一段时间。

definitions.definition: An instant of time.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个瞬间。

definitions.definition: The measurement under some system of region of day or moment.
definitions.example: Let's synchronize our watches so we're not on different time.
definitions.definitionCn: 按某种系统对一天或某一时刻的测量。
definitions.exampleCn: 让我们对一下表，这样时间就不会有差异。

definitions.definition: Ratio of comparison.
definitions.example: your car runs three times faster than mine;  that is four times as heavy as this
definitions.definitionCn: 比较的比率。
definitions.exampleCn: 你的车跑得比我的快三倍；那个是这的四倍重。

definitions.definition: (grammar) Tense.
definitions.example: the time of a verb
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）时态。
definitions.exampleCn: 动词的时态。

definitions.definition: The measured duration of sounds; measure; tempo; rate of movement; rhythmical division.
definitions.example: common or triple time;   the musician keeps good time.
definitions.definitionCn: 声音的测量时长；节拍；速度；节奏划分。
definitions.exampleCn: 普通拍或三拍子；这位音乐家节奏感很好。

definitions.definition: To measure or record the time, duration, or rate of.
definitions.example: I used a stopwatch to time myself running around the block.
definitions.definitionCn: 测量或记录时间、时长或速率。
definitions.exampleCn: 我用秒表计时自己绕街区跑一圈。

definitions.definition: To choose when something begins or how long it lasts.
definitions.example: The President timed his speech badly, coinciding with the Super Bowl.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择某事开始的时间或持续多久。
definitions.exampleCn: 总统的演讲时机选得很糟，与超级碗撞期。

definitions.definition: To keep or beat time; to proceed or move in time.
definitions.definitionCn: 保持或打拍子；按节奏进行或移动。

definitions.definition: To pass time; to delay.
definitions.definitionCn: 消磨时间；拖延。

definitions.definition: To regulate as to time; to accompany, or agree with, in time of movement.
definitions.definitionCn: 按时间调整；在运动时间上伴随或一致。

definitions.definition: To measure, as in music or harmony.
definitions.definitionCn: 测量，如在音乐或和声中。

definitions.definition: The circumstances of a certain time.
definitions.example: Modern times are so very different from the past.
definitions.definitionCn: 某一特定时间的情况。
definitions.exampleCn: 现代与过去截然不同。

definitions.definition: A person's experiences or biography.
definitions.example: The Life and Times of Rosie the Riveter.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人的经历或传记。
definitions.exampleCn: 《铆工罗茜的生活与时代》。

definitions.definition: To multiply.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘以。

definitions.definition: Multiplied by
definitions.example: Four times five is twenty.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘以
definitions.exampleCn: 四乘以五等于二十。

definitions.definition: A relatively long, wide and thin piece of any material, usually wood or similar, often for use in construction or furniture-making.
definitions.definitionCn: 一块相对长、宽且薄的任何材料，通常是木材或类似物，常用于建筑或家具制造。

definitions.definition: A device (e.g., switchboard) containing electrical switches and other controls and designed to control lights, sound, telephone connections, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含电气开关和其他控制装置、用于控制灯光、音响、电话连接等的设备（如配电盘）。

definitions.definition: A flat surface with markings for playing a board game.
definitions.example: Each player starts the game with four counters on the board.
definitions.definitionCn: 带有标记的平面，用于玩棋盘游戏。
definitions.exampleCn: 每位玩家开始时在棋盘上有四个棋子。

definitions.definition: Short for blackboard, whiteboard, chessboard, surfboard, message board (on the Internet), etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 黑板、白板、棋盘、冲浪板、互联网留言板等的简称。

definitions.definition: A committee that manages the business of an organization, e.g., a board of directors.
definitions.example: We have to wait to hear back from the board.
definitions.definitionCn: 管理组织业务的委员会，例如董事会。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们必须等待董事会的回复。

definitions.definition: Regular meals or the amount paid for them in a place of lodging.
definitions.example: Room and board
definitions.definitionCn: 在住宿场所提供的固定餐食或为此支付的费用。

definitions.definition: To receive meals and lodging in exchange for money.
definitions.definitionCn: 以金钱交换为条件接受食宿。

definitions.definition: To capture an enemy ship by going alongside and grappling her, then invading her with a boarding party
definitions.definitionCn: 通过靠近并钩住敌船，然后派登船队入侵来俘获敌船。

definitions.definition: To obtain meals, or meals and lodgings, statedly for compensation
definitions.definitionCn: 定期以报酬换取餐食，或餐食和住宿。

definitions.definition: To approach (someone); to make advances to, accost.
definitions.definitionCn: 接近（某人）；主动搭讪。

definitions.definition: To cover with boards or boarding.

definitions.definition: To hit (someone) with a wooden board.

definitions.definition: To write something on a board, especially a blackboard or whiteboard.
definitions.definitionCn: 在板子上写字，尤其是黑板或白板。

definitions.definition: A Western man traveling in East Asia.
definitions.definitionCn: 在东亚旅行的西方男性。

definitions.definition: A male mule.

definitions.definition: (except in phrases) Satisfaction, contentment; pleasure.
definitions.definitionCn: （短语除外）满足，满意；愉悦。

definitions.definition: To give contentment or satisfaction; to satisfy; to make happy.
definitions.example: You can't have any more - you'll have to content yourself with what you already have.
definitions.definitionCn: 给予满足或满意；使满足；使快乐。
definitions.exampleCn: 你不能再要了——你得满足于已有的。

definitions.definition: To satisfy the expectations of; to pay; to requite
definitions.definitionCn: 满足……的期望；支付；回报。

definitions.definition: Satisfied
definitions.definitionCn: 感到满意的。

definitions.definition: Alright, agreed
definitions.definitionCn: 好的，同意。

Subject matter; that which is contained in writing or speech.
The amount of material contained; contents
Capacity for holding
The n-dimensional space contained by an n-dimensional polytope (called volume in the case of a polyhedron and area in the case of a polygon)

(of a polynomial with coefficients in a GCD domain) the greatest common divisor of the coefficients; (of a polynomial with coefficients in an integral domain) the common factor of the coefficients which, when removed, leaves the adjusted coefficients with no common factor that is noninvertible
Satisfaction; contentment.

That which contents or satisfies; that which if attained would make one happy.
(House of Lords) an expression of assent to a bill or motion; an affirmate vote
(House of Lords) a member who votes in assent
Contained.
(modal, auxiliary verb, defective) Used before a verb to indicate the simple future tense in the first person singular or plural.
definitions.example: I hope that we shall win the game.
definitions.definitionCn: （情态动词、助动词、缺陷动词）用于动词前，表示第一人称单数或复数的简单将来时。
definitions.exampleCn: 我希望我们将赢得比赛。

definitions.definition: Used similarly to indicate determination or obligation in the second and third persons singular or plural.
definitions.example: (determination): You shall go to the ball!
definitions.definitionCn: 类似地用于第二、三人称单数或复数，表示决心或义务。
definitions.exampleCn: （决心）：你一定要去参加舞会！

definitions.definition: Used in questions with the first person singular or plural to suggest a possible future action.
definitions.example: Let us examine that, shall we?
definitions.definitionCn: 用于第一人称单数或复数的疑问句中，暗示可能的未来动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 让我们检查一下，好吗？

definitions.definition: To owe.
definitions.definitionCn: 欠（债）。

definitions.definition: To no extent, in no way.
definitions.example: I felt none the worse for my recent illness.
definitions.definitionCn: 绝不，无论如何也不。
definitions.exampleCn: 我最近生病后感觉一点也不差。

definitions.definition: Not at all, not very.
definitions.example: He was none too pleased with the delays in the program that was supposed to be his legacy.
definitions.definitionCn: 一点也不，不太。
definitions.exampleCn: 他对这个本应是他遗产的项目的延误感到很不高兴。

definitions.definition: No, not.
definitions.definitionCn: 不，不是。

definitions.definition: A time period of sixty minutes; one twenty-fourth of a day.
definitions.example: I spent an hour at lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 六十分钟的时间段；一天的二十四分之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 我花了一小时吃午饭。

definitions.definition: A season, moment, or time.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个季节、时刻或时间。

definitions.definition: The time.
definitions.example: The hour grows late and I must go home.
definitions.definitionCn: 时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 时间已晚，我必须回家了。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Used after a two-digit hour and a two-digit minute to indicate time.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）用于两位小时数和两位分钟数之后表示时间。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The set times of prayer, the canonical hours, the offices or services prescribed for these, or a book containing them.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）指定的祈祷时间、教规时辰、为此规定的礼拜或仪式，或包含这些内容的书。

definitions.definition: A distance that can be traveled in one hour.
definitions.example: This place is an hour away from where I live.
definitions.definitionCn: 一小时能走完的距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个地方离我住的地方有一小时路程。

definitions.definition: A sketch or account of anything in words; a portraiture or representation in language; an enumeration of the essential qualities of a thing or species.
definitions.definitionCn: 用言语对任何事物的勾勒或叙述；以语言进行的肖像描绘或再现；对事物或物种本质特征的列举。

definitions.definition: The act of describing; a delineation by marks or signs.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述的行为；通过标记或符号进行的勾勒。

definitions.definition: A set of characteristics by which someone or something can be recognized.
definitions.example: The zoo had no lions, tigers, or cats of any description.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组可识别某人或某物的特征。
definitions.exampleCn: 动物园里没有狮子、老虎或任何种类的猫。

definitions.definition: A scientific documentation of a taxon for the purpose of introducing it to science.
definitions.example: The type description of the fungus was written by a botanist.
definitions.definitionCn: 为向科学界介绍某个分类单元而撰写的科学文献。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种真菌的类型描述由一位植物学家撰写。

definitions.definition: The act or practice of recording and describing actual language usage in a given speech community, as opposed to prescription, i.e. laying down norms of language usage.
definitions.definitionCn: 记录并描述特定言语社区中实际语言用法的行为或实践，与规定（即制定语言使用规范）相对。

definitions.definition: A descriptive linguistic survey.
definitions.definitionCn: 描述性语言学调查。

definitions.definition: An occurrence; something that happens.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个事件；发生的事情。

definitions.definition: A prearranged social activity (function, etc.)
definitions.example: I went to an event in San Francisco last week.
definitions.definitionCn: 预先安排好的社交活动（如聚会等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 上周我去旧金山参加了一个活动。

definitions.definition: One of several contests that combine to make up a competition.
definitions.definitionCn: 组成一场比赛的多个竞赛之一。

definitions.definition: An end result; an outcome (now chiefly in phrases).
definitions.example: In the event, he turned out to have what I needed anyway.
definitions.definitionCn: 最终结果；结局（现主要用于短语中）。
definitions.exampleCn: 结果，他恰好有我需要的东西。

definitions.definition: A point in spacetime having three spatial coordinates and one temporal coordinate.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有三个空间坐标和一个时间坐标的时空点。

definitions.definition: A possible action that the user can perform that is monitored by an application or the operating system (event listener). When an event occurs an event handler is called which performs a specific task.
definitions.definitionCn: 用户可执行的、由应用程序或操作系统监控的可能的操作（事件监听器）。当事件发生时，会调用执行特定任务的事件处理程序。

definitions.definition: A set of some of the possible outcomes; a subset of the sample space.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组可能结果的集合；样本空间的子集。

definitions.definition: An affair in hand; business; enterprise.

definitions.definition: An episode of severe health conditions.

definitions.definition: To occur, take place.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生；进行。

definitions.definition: To be emitted or breathed out; to evaporate.

definitions.definition: To expose to the air, ventilate.

definitions.definition: Sorrow, grief.
definitions.definitionCn: 悲伤，哀痛。

definitions.definition: The place where anything is fixed; situation; local position

definitions.definitionCn: 任何固定之物的位置；情境；局部方位。
definitions.exampleCn: 城市或房屋的选址。

definitions.definition: A place fitted or chosen for any certain permanent use or occupation

definitions.exampleCn: 教堂的选址。

definitions.definition: The posture or position of a thing.

definitions.definition: A website.

definitions.definition: A part of the body which has been operated on.

definitions.definition: To enclose (a field, etc.) for combat.
definitions.definitionCn: 为战斗围起（田地等）。

definitions.definitionCn: 列表中单个项目的物理表现。

definitions.definitionCn: 用开沟犁耕作的行为。

definitions.definition: A telephone conversation.

definitions.definitionCn: 一次电话交谈。

definitions.definition: A short visit, usually for social purposes.

definitions.definitionCn: 一次短暂的拜访，通常出于社交目的。

definitions.definition: A visit by a ship or boat to a port.

definitions.definitionCn: 船只或轮船停靠港口。

definitions.definition: A cry or shout.

definitions.definitionCn: 一声呼喊或叫喊。

definitions.definition: A decision or judgement.

definitions.definitionCn: 一个决定或判断。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是个明智的决定。

definitions.definition: The characteristic cry of a bird or other animal.
definitions.example: That sound is the distinctive call of the cuckoo bird.
definitions.definitionCn: 鸟类或其他动物特有的叫声。
definitions.exampleCn: 那声音是布谷鸟独特的啼鸣。

definitions.definition: A beckoning or summoning.

definitions.definitionCn: 一种召唤或召集。

definitions.definition: The right to speak at a given time during a debate or other public event; the floor.

definitions.definitionCn: 在辩论或其他公共活动中特定时间发言的权利；发言权。

definitions.definition: An option to buy stock at a specified price during or at a specified time.
definitions.definitionCn: 在指定时间或期间以指定价格购买股票的选择权。

definitions.definition: The act of calling to the other batsman.
definitions.definitionCn: 呼叫另一名击球手的动作。

definitions.definition: The state of being the batsman whose role it is to call (depends on where the ball goes.)
definitions.definitionCn: 作为负责呼叫的击球手的状态（取决于球的方向）。

definitions.definition: The act of jumping to a subprogram, saving the means to return to the original point.
definitions.definitionCn: 跳转到子程序并保存返回原点的操作。

definitions.definition: The act of matching a bet made by a player who has previously bet in the same round of betting.
definitions.definitionCn: 匹配同一轮下注中先前下注玩家赌注的行为。

definitions.definition: A note blown on the horn to encourage the dogs in a hunt.
definitions.definitionCn: 狩猎时吹响号角鼓励猎犬的声音。

definitions.definition: A whistle or pipe, used by the boatswain and his mate to summon the sailors to duty.
definitions.definitionCn: 水手长及其助手用来召唤水手执勤的口哨或哨子。

definitions.definitionCn: 邀请担任或服务某教会牧师的职务。

definitions.definition: Vocation; employment; calling.
definitions.definitionCn: 天职；职业；使命。

definitions.definition: A reference to, or statement of, an object, course, distance, or other matter of description in a survey or grant requiring or calling for a corresponding object, etc., on the land.
definitions.definitionCn: 在测量或土地授予中提及或陈述物体、路线、距离或其他描述事项，要求或呼唤土地上相应物体等。

definitions.definitionCn: （卖淫）与客户进行有偿性行为的会面；接客；工作。

definitions.definitionCn: （标题）使用声音。

definitions.definition: (heading) To visit.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）拜访。

definitions.definition: (heading) To name, identify or describe.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）命名、识别或描述。

definitions.definition: (heading) Direct or indirect use of the voice.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）直接或间接使用声音。

definitions.definition: (sometimes with for) To require, demand.

definitions.definitionCn: （有时与for连用）要求、需求。

definitions.definition: To demand repayment of a loan.

definitions.definitionCn: 跳转到（程序的另一部分）执行某些操作，完成后返回原点。
definitions.exampleCn: 递归函数是调用自身的函数。

definitions.definition: A recorded sequence of images displayed on a screen at a rate sufficiently fast to create the appearance of motion.
definitions.definitionCn: 以足够快的速度在屏幕上显示的一系列记录图像，从而产生运动效果。

definitions.definition: (usually plural) A cinema.
definitions.example: Let's go to the movies.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）电影院。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们去看电影吧。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The cinema
definitions.example: We are going to the movies for our anniversary.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）电影业
definitions.exampleCn: 我们打算在结婚纪念日去看电影。

definitions.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.
definitions.definitionCn: 向击球手投掷一个约克球，尤指以此方式使击球手出局。

definitions.definition: To vomit.
A teenager.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个青少年。

definitions.definition: Of or having to do with teenagers; teenage
definitions.example: teen fashion
definitions.definitionCn: 与青少年有关的；青少年的
definitions.exampleCn: 青少年时尚

definitions.definition: Grief; sorrow; trouble.
Vexation; anger; hate.
To excite; to provoke; to vex; to afflict; to injure.
To become angry or distressed.
(provincial) To hedge or fence in; to enclose.
A device used to apply pressure to an item.
definitions.example: a flower press
definitions.definitionCn: 用于对物品施加压力的装置。
definitions.exampleCn: 压花机

definitions.definition: A printing machine.
definitions.example: Stop the presses!
definitions.definitionCn: 印刷机。
definitions.exampleCn: 停印！

definitions.definition: (collective) The print-based media (both the people and the newspapers).
definitions.example: This article appeared in the press.
definitions.definitionCn: （集合名词）印刷媒体（包括从业人员和报纸）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这篇文章出现在报刊上。

definitions.definition: A publisher.
definitions.definitionCn: 出版商。

definitions.definition: An enclosed storage space (e.g. closet, cupboard).
definitions.example: Put the cups in the press.
definitions.definitionCn: 封闭式储物空间（如壁橱、橱柜）。
definitions.exampleCn: 把杯子放进柜子里。

definitions.definition: An exercise in which weight is forced away from the body by extension of the arms or legs.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过手臂或腿的伸展将重物推离身体的锻炼动作。

definitions.definition: (wagering) An additional bet in a golf match that duplicates an existing (usually losing) wager in value, but begins even at the time of the bet.
definitions.example: He can even the match with a press.
definitions.definitionCn: （博彩）高尔夫比赛中追加的赌注，复制现有（通常是输掉的）赌注金额，但从下注时起重新开始计算。
definitions.exampleCn: 他可以通过追加赌注扳平比赛。

definitions.definition: Pure, unfermented grape juice.
definitions.example: I would like some Concord press with my meal tonight.
definitions.definitionCn: 纯的、未发酵的葡萄汁。
definitions.exampleCn: 今晚用餐时我想来点康科德葡萄汁。

definitions.definition: A commission to force men into public service, particularly into the navy.
definitions.definitionCn: 强制征召人员进入公共服务（尤其是海军）的委员会。

definitions.definition: A crowd.
definitions.definitionCn: 人群。

definitions.definition: To exert weight or force against, to act upon with force or weight; to exert pressure upon.
To activate a button or key by exerting a downward or forward force on it, and then releasing it.
To compress, squeeze.
definitions.example: to press fruit for the purpose of extracting the juice

definitions.definition: To clasp, hold in an embrace.
To reduce to a particular shape or form by pressure, especially flatten or smooth.
definitions.example: to press a hat

definitions.definition: To flatten a selected area of fabric using an iron with an up-and-down, not sliding, motion, so as to avoid disturbing adjacent areas.
To drive or thrust by pressure, to force in a certain direction.
definitions.example: to press a crowd back

definitions.definition: To weigh upon, oppress, trouble.
To force to a certain end or result; to urge strongly.
To try to force (something upon someone).
definitions.example: to press the Bible on an audience

definitions.definition: To hasten, urge onward.
definitions.example: to press a horse in a race

definitions.definition: To urge, beseech, entreat.
To lay stress upon.
To throng, crowd.
To print.
To force into service, particularly into naval service.
A small amount.
definitions.example: Can I try a little of that sauce?
definitions.definitionCn: 少量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能尝一点那个酱吗？

definitions.definition: Small in size.
definitions.example: This is a little table.
definitions.definitionCn: 尺寸小。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是一张小桌子。

definitions.definition: Insignificant, trivial.
definitions.example: It's of little importance.
definitions.definitionCn: 微不足道，琐碎。
definitions.exampleCn: 这不太重要。

definitions.definition: Very young.
definitions.example: Did he tell you any embarrassing stories about when she was little?
definitions.definitionCn: 非常年轻。
definitions.exampleCn: 他有没有告诉你她小时候的尴尬事？

definitions.definition: (of a sibling) Younger.
definitions.example: This is my little sister.
definitions.definitionCn: （指兄弟姐妹）年纪较小的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是我妹妹。

definitions.definition: (also Little) Used with the name of a place, especially of a country or its capital, to denote a neighborhood whose residents or storekeepers are from that place.
definitions.definitionCn: （也作Little）与地名（尤指国家或其首都）连用，指代居民或店主来自该地的街区。

definitions.definition: Small in amount or number, having few members.
definitions.example: little money;  little herd
definitions.definitionCn: 数量或数目少，成员少。
definitions.exampleCn: 少量金钱；小群牲畜

definitions.definition: Short in duration; brief.
definitions.example: I feel better after my little sleep.
definitions.definitionCn: 持续时间短；短暂。
definitions.exampleCn: 小睡之后我感觉好多了。

definitions.definition: Small in extent of views or sympathies; narrow; shallow; contracted; mean; illiberal; ungenerous.
definitions.definitionCn: 视野或同情心狭窄；狭隘；肤浅；拘谨；刻薄；吝啬；不慷慨。

definitions.definition: Not much.
definitions.example: This is a little known fact.  She spoke little and listened less.
definitions.definitionCn: 不多。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是一个鲜为人知的事实。她话很少，听得更少。

definitions.definition: Not at all.
definitions.example: I was speaking ill of Fred; little did I know that he was right behind me, listening in.
definitions.definitionCn: 一点也不。
definitions.exampleCn: 我刚才在说弗雷德的坏话；我完全不知道他就在我身后偷听。

definitions.definition: Not much; not a large amount.
definitions.example: Little is known about his early life.
definitions.definitionCn: 不多；少量。
definitions.exampleCn: 关于他的早年生活，人们所知甚少。

definitions.definition: A task.
definitions.example: A job half done is hardly done at all.
definitions.definitionCn: 一项任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 半途而废的工作几乎等于没做。

definitions.definition: An economic role for which a person is paid.
definitions.example: He's been out of a job since being made redundant in January.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人因经济角色而获得报酬。
definitions.exampleCn: 自一月份被裁员以来，他一直失业。

definitions.definition: (in noun compounds) Plastic surgery.
definitions.example: He had had a nose job.
definitions.definitionCn: （名词复合词中）整形手术。
definitions.exampleCn: 他做过鼻子整形手术。

definitions.definition: A task, or series of tasks, carried out in batch mode (especially on a mainframe computer).
definitions.definitionCn: 以批处理模式执行的一项或一系列任务（尤其在大型计算机上）。

definitions.definition: A sudden thrust or stab; a jab.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然的刺或戳；一刺。

definitions.definition: A public transaction done for private profit; something performed ostensibly as a part of official duty, but really for private gain; a corrupt official business.
definitions.definitionCn: 为私利进行的公开交易；表面上作为公务一部分、实则谋私的行为；腐败的官方事务。

definitions.definition: Any affair or event which affects one, whether fortunately or unfortunately.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何影响个人的事件，无论幸运与否。

definitions.definition: A thing (often used in a vague way to refer to something whose name one cannot recall).
definitions.example: Pass me that little job with the screw thread on it.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物（常含糊地指代记不起名称的东西）。
definitions.exampleCn: 把那个带螺纹的小玩意儿递给我。

definitions.definition: To do odd jobs or occasional work for hire.
definitions.definitionCn: 做零工或按需受雇的临时工作。

definitions.definition: To work as a jobber.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为中间商工作。

definitions.definition: To take the loss.
definitions.definitionCn: 承担损失。

definitions.definition: To buy and sell for profit, as securities; to speculate in.
definitions.definitionCn: 为盈利买卖证券；投机。

definitions.definition: (often with out) To subcontract a project or delivery in small portions to a number of contractors.
definitions.example: We wanted to sell a turnkey plant, but they jobbed out the contract to small firms.
definitions.definitionCn: （常与out连用）将项目或交付物分包给多个承包商。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们想出售交钥匙工厂，但他们把合同分包给了小公司。

definitions.definition: To seek private gain under pretence of public service; to turn public matters to private advantage.
definitions.definitionCn: 假公济私；将公共事务转为私人利益。

definitions.definition: To strike or stab with a pointed instrument.
definitions.definitionCn: 用尖物刺或戳。

definitions.definition: To thrust in, as a pointed instrument.
definitions.definitionCn: 插入，如尖物。

definitions.definition: To hire or let in periods of service.
definitions.example: to job a carriage
definitions.definitionCn: 按服务期雇佣或出租。
definitions.exampleCn: 租用一辆马车。

definitions.definition: A mechanical device intended to make a task easier.
definitions.example: Hand me that tool, would you?   I don't have the right tools to start fiddling around with the engine.
definitions.definitionCn: 旨在使任务更轻松的机械装置。
definitions.exampleCn: 把那个工具递给我好吗？我没有合适的工具来捣鼓这台发动机。

definitions.definition: Equipment used in a profession, e.g., tools of the trade.
definitions.example: These are the tools of the trade.
definitions.definitionCn: 职业中使用的设备，例如行业工具。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些就是行业工具。

definitions.definition: Something to perform an operation; an instrument; a means.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于执行操作的东西；一种器具；一种手段。

definitions.definition: A piece of software used to develop software or hardware, or to perform low-level operations.
definitions.example: The software engineer had been developing lots of EDA tools.   a tool for recovering deleted files from a disk
definitions.definitionCn: 用于开发软件或硬件，或执行低级操作的软件。
definitions.exampleCn: 这位软件工程师开发了许多EDA工具。一个用于从磁盘恢复已删除文件的工具。

definitions.definition: A person or group which is used or controlled, usually unwittingly, by another person or group.
definitions.example: He was a tool, no more than a pawn to her.
definitions.definitionCn: 被另一个人或群体利用或控制的人或群体，通常是不知不觉地。
definitions.exampleCn: 他只是一个工具，对她来说不过是个棋子。

definitions.definition: Penis.
definitions.definitionCn: 阴茎。

definitions.definition: (by extension) An obnoxious or uptight person.
definitions.example: He won't sell us tickets because it's 3:01, and they went off sale at 3. That guy's such a tool.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）令人讨厌或古板的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他不会卖给我们票，因为现在是3:01，而票在3点就停售了。那家伙真是个讨厌鬼。

definitions.definition: To work on or shape with tools, e.g., hand-tooled leather.
definitions.definitionCn: 用工具加工或塑形，例如手工加工的皮革。

definitions.definition: To equip with tools.
definitions.definitionCn: 配备工具。

definitions.definition: To work very hard.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常努力地工作。

definitions.definition: To put down another person (possibly in a subtle, hidden way), and in that way to use him or her to meet a goal.
definitions.example: Dude, he's not your friend. He's just tooling you.
definitions.definitionCn: （可能以微妙、隐蔽的方式）贬低另一个人，并以此利用他或她达到目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 老兄，他不是你的朋友。他只是在利用你。

definitions.definition: To intentionally attack the ball so that it deflects off a blocker out of bounds.
definitions.definitionCn: 故意击球使其从拦网者身上弹出界外。

definitions.definition: To drive (a coach or other vehicle).
definitions.definitionCn: 驾驶（马车或其他车辆）。

definitions.definition: To carry or convey in a coach or other vehicle.
definitions.definitionCn: 用马车或其他车辆运送或运输。

definitions.definition: To travel in a vehicle; to ride or drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘坐车辆旅行；骑马或开车。

definitions.definition: To bring (a thing) up to date.
definitions.example: I need to update my records to take account of the most recent transaction.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某事物）更新。
definitions.exampleCn: 我需要更新我的记录以反映最近的交易。

definitions.definition: To bring (a person) up to date: to inform (a person) about recent developments.
definitions.example: Update me on what happened while I was away.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）了解最新情况：告知（某人）最近的发展。
definitions.exampleCn: 告诉我我不在时发生了什么。

definitions.definition: A period into which a year is divided, historically based on the phases of the moon.
definitions.example: July is my favourite month.
definitions.definitionCn: 一年被划分成的时段，历史上基于月相。
definitions.exampleCn: 七月是我最喜欢的月份。

definitions.definition: A period of 30 days, 31 days, or some alternation thereof.
definitions.example: We went on holiday for two months.
definitions.definitionCn: 30天、31天或两者交替的时段。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们度假了两个月。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) A woman's period; menstrual discharge.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）女性的经期；月经。

definitions.definition: A woman's period; menstrual discharge.
definitions.definitionCn: 女性的经期；月经。

definitions.definition: Something of the smallest possible extent; an indivisible unit.
definitions.definitionCn: 最小可能范围的事物；不可分割的单位。

definitions.definition: Used for forming superlatives of adjectives, especially those that do not form the superlative by adding -est.
definitions.example: It was the least surprising thing.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于构成形容词的最高级，尤其是那些不能通过加-est构成最高级的形容词。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是最不令人惊讶的事情。

definitions.definition: In the smallest or lowest degree; in a degree below all others.
definitions.example: They travel the least of all.
definitions.definitionCn: 以最小或最低的程度；低于所有其他程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们旅行最少。

definitions.definition: The act of associating.
definitions.definitionCn: 关联的行为。

definitions.definition: The state of being associated; a connection to or an affiliation with something.
definitions.definitionCn: 被关联的状态；与某事物的联系或隶属关系。

definitions.definition: Any relationship between two measured quantities that renders them statistically dependent (but not necessarily causal or a correlation).
definitions.definitionCn: 两个测量量之间的任何关系，使它们在统计上相互依赖（但不一定是因果关系或相关性）。

definitions.definition: A group of persons associated for a common purpose; an organization; society.
definitions.definitionCn: 为共同目的而联合的一群人；一个组织；社团。

definitions.definition: Relationship between classes of objects that allows one object instance to cause another to perform an action on its behalf.
definitions.definitionCn: 对象类之间的关系，允许一个对象实例促使另一个对象代表其执行操作。

data.chinese: n.公司 ,会,联合体,联系,社团,协会

definitions.definition: A list of questions said to be frequently asked, and their answers.
definitions.example: This site's FAQ says you should log in to access some pages.
definitions.definitionCn: 一份据称是常见问题列表及其答案。
definitions.exampleCn: 该网站的常见问题解答说明您应登录以访问某些页面。

definitions.definition: To make (products or services) available for sale and promote them.
definitions.example: We plan to market an ecology model by next quarter.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（产品或服务）可供销售并进行推广。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们计划在下个季度推广一种生态模式。

definitions.definition: To sell
definitions.example: We marketed more this quarter already than all last year!
definitions.definitionCn: 销售
definitions.exampleCn: 本季度我们的销售额已经超过去年全年！

definitions.definition: To deal in a market; to buy or sell; to make bargains for provisions or goods.
definitions.definitionCn: 在市场上进行交易；买卖；为物资或商品讨价还价。

definitions.definition: Buying and selling in a market.
definitions.definitionCn: 在市场上进行买卖。

definitions.definition: The promotion, distribution and selling of a product or service; the work of a marketer; includes market research and advertising.
definitions.definitionCn: 产品或服务的推广、分销和销售；营销人员的工作；包括市场调研和广告。

definitions.definition: (up to the 1920s) Shopping, going to market.
definitions.definitionCn: （直至20世纪20年代）购物，去市场。

definitions.definition: A communication, or what is communicated; any concept or information conveyed.
definitions.example: We've just received an urgent message from the President.
definitions.definitionCn: 通信，或所传达的内容；任何被传递的概念或信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们刚刚收到总统的紧急消息。

definitions.definition: An underlying theme or conclusion to be drawn from something.
definitions.example: The main message of the novel is that time heals all wounds.
definitions.definitionCn: 从某事物中得出的潜在主题或结论。
definitions.exampleCn: 这部小说的主旨是时间能治愈一切创伤。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) An errand.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用复数形式）差事。

definitions.definition: See messages.
definitions.definitionCn: 参见“messages”。

definitions.definition: To send a message to; to transmit a message to, e.g. as text via a cell phone.
definitions.example: I messaged her about the concert.
definitions.definitionCn: 向某人发送消息；通过手机等以文本形式传递信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 我给她发了关于音乐会的消息。

definitions.definition: To send (something) as a message; usually refers to electronic messaging.
definitions.example: Please message the final report by fax.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）作为消息发送；通常指电子消息传递。
definitions.exampleCn: 请通过传真发送最终报告。

definitions.definition: To send a message or messages; to be capable of sending messages.
definitions.example: The runaway computer program was messaging non-stop.
definitions.definitionCn: 发送消息或能够发送消息。
definitions.exampleCn: 失控的计算机程序不停地发送消息。

definitions.definition: To bear as a message.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为消息传达。

definitions.definition: Shopping, groceries, errands.
definitions.definitionCn: 购物、杂货、差事。

definitions.definition: Physically secure and certain, non-failing, reliable.
definitions.example: This investment is a sure thing.   The bailiff had a sure grip on the prisoner's arm.
definitions.definitionCn: 物理上安全且确定，不会失败，可靠。
definitions.exampleCn: 这项投资是稳赚不赔的。法警牢牢抓住了囚犯的手臂。

definitions.definition: Certain in one's knowledge or belief.
definitions.example: He was sure she was lying.   I am sure of my eventual death.   John was acting sure of himself but in truth had doubts.
definitions.definitionCn: 在知识或信念上确定。
definitions.exampleCn: 他确信她在撒谎。我确信自己终有一死。约翰表现得自信满满，但实际上心存疑虑。

definitions.definition: Certain to act or be a specified way.
definitions.example: Be sure to lock the door when you leave.
definitions.definitionCn: 一定会以特定方式行动或成为特定状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 离开时务必锁门。

definitions.definition: Free from danger; safe; secure.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有危险；安全；稳固。

definitions.definition: Betrothed; engaged to marry.
definitions.definitionCn: 已订婚；约定结婚。

definitions.definition: (modal adverb) Without doubt, certainly.
definitions.example: "Did you kill that bear yourself?" ―"I sure did!"
definitions.definitionCn: （语气副词）毫无疑问，当然。
definitions.exampleCn: “那只熊是你自己杀的吗？”——“当然是我！”

definitions.definition: Yes. (Expresses noncommittal agreement or consent.)
definitions.example: "Do you want me to put this in the garage?" "Sure, go ahead."
definitions.definitionCn: 是的。（表示非承诺性的同意或认可。）
definitions.exampleCn: “你想让我把这个放进车库吗？”“当然，去吧。”

definitions.definition: Yes; of course.
definitions.example: "Could you tell me where the washrooms are?" "Sure, they're in the corner over there."
definitions.definitionCn: 是的；当然。
definitions.exampleCn: “你能告诉我洗手间在哪里吗？”“当然，就在那边的角落。”

definitions.definition: A person other than a family member, spouse or lover whose company one enjoys and towards whom one feels affection.
definitions.example: John and I have been friends ever since we were roommates at college.   Trust is important between friends.   I used to find it hard to make friends when I was shy.
definitions.definitionCn: 除了家人、配偶或恋人之外，你乐于与之相处并对其怀有感情的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 约翰和我从大学室友起就是朋友。朋友之间信任很重要。我过去害羞时很难交到朋友。

definitions.definition: An associate who provides assistance.
definitions.example: The Automobile Association is every motorist's friend.   The police is every law-abiding citizen's friend.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供帮助的伙伴。
definitions.exampleCn: 汽车协会是每位驾驶者的朋友。警察是每位守法公民的朋友。

definitions.definition: A person with whom one is vaguely or indirectly acquainted.
definitions.example: a friend of a friend;  I added him as a friend on Facebook, but I hardly know him.
definitions.definitionCn: 与自己关系模糊或间接认识的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 朋友的朋友；我在脸书上加他为好友，但几乎不认识他。

definitions.definition: A person who backs or supports something.
definitions.example: I’m not a friend of cheap wine.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持或拥护某事的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不是廉价葡萄酒的爱好者。

definitions.definition: An object or idea that can be used for good.
definitions.example: Wiktionary is your friend.
definitions.definitionCn: 能带来好处的物品或想法。
definitions.exampleCn: 维基词典是你的好帮手。

definitions.definition: (used only in the vocative) Used as a form of address when warning someone.
definitions.example: You’d better watch it, friend.
definitions.definitionCn: （仅用于呼语）警告某人时的称呼形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 你最好小心点，朋友。

definitions.definition: A function or class granted special access to the private and protected members of another class.
definitions.definitionCn: 被授予访问另一个类私有和保护成员特殊权限的函数或类。

definitions.definition: A spring-loaded camming device.
definitions.definitionCn: 弹簧加载的凸轮装置。

definitions.definition: A lover; a boyfriend or girlfriend.
definitions.definitionCn: 恋人；男朋友或女朋友。

definitions.definition: A relative, a relation by blood or marriage.
definitions.example: Friends agree best at a distance.
definitions.definitionCn: 亲属，血缘或婚姻关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 朋友之间保持距离最和睦。

definitions.definition: To act as a friend to, to befriend; to be friendly to, to help.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某人友善，成为朋友；友好相待，提供帮助。

definitions.definition: To add (a person) to a list of friends on a social networking site; to officially designate (someone) as a friend.
definitions.definitionCn: 在社交网站上添加（某人）为好友；正式指定（某人）为朋友。

definitions.definition: A wheeled vehicle that moves independently, with at least three wheels, powered mechanically, steered by a driver and mostly for personal transportation.
definitions.example: She drove her car to the mall.
definitions.definitionCn: 独立移动的轮式车辆，至少有三个轮子，由机械驱动，由驾驶员操控，主要用于个人交通。
definitions.exampleCn: 她开车去了商场。

definitions.definition: A wheeled vehicle, drawn by a horse or other animal; a chariot.
definitions.definitionCn: 由马或其他动物牵引的轮式车辆；战车。

definitions.definition: An unpowered unit in a railroad train.
definitions.example: The conductor coupled the cars to the locomotive.
definitions.definitionCn: 铁路列车中无动力的单元。
definitions.exampleCn: 列车员将车厢连接到机车上。

definitions.definition: An individual vehicle, powered or unpowered, in a multiple unit.
definitions.example: The 11:10 to London was operated by a 4-car diesel multiple unit.
definitions.definitionCn: 多单元列车中的单个车辆，无论有无动力。
definitions.exampleCn: 11:10开往伦敦的列车由一列四节车厢的内燃动车组运营。

definitions.definition: A passenger-carrying unit in a subway or elevated train, whether powered or not.
definitions.example: From the frontmost car of the subway, he filmed the progress through the tunnel.
definitions.definitionCn: 地铁或高架列车中载客的单元，无论有无动力。
definitions.exampleCn: 从地铁最前端的车厢，他拍摄了穿越隧道的全过程。

definitions.definition: A rough unit of quantity approximating the amount which would fill a railroad car.
definitions.example: We ordered five hundred cars of gypsum.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种粗略的数量单位，约等于装满一节铁路车厢的量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们订购了五百车石膏。

definitions.definition: The moving, load-carrying component of an elevator or other cable-drawn transport mechanism.
definitions.example: Fix the car of the express elevator - the door is sticking.
definitions.definitionCn: 电梯或其他缆索牵引运输机械中移动的载重部件。
definitions.exampleCn: 修理高速电梯的轿厢——门卡住了。

definitions.definition: The passenger-carrying portion of certain amusement park rides, such as Ferris wheels.
definitions.example: The most exciting part of riding a Ferris wheel is when your car goes over the top.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些游乐园设施（如摩天轮）的载客部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 乘坐摩天轮最刺激的部分是当你的车厢越过顶端时。

definitions.definition: The part of an airship, such as a balloon or dirigible, which houses the passengers and control apparatus.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞艇（如气球或可操纵飞艇）中容纳乘客和控制装置的部分。

definitions.definition: A sliding fitting that runs along a track.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿轨道滑动的配件。

definitions.definition: The aggregate of desirable characteristics of a car.
definitions.example: Buy now! You can get more car for your money.
definitions.definitionCn: 一辆汽车理想特性的总和。
definitions.exampleCn: 立即购买！您可以用更少的钱买到更好的车。

definitions.definition: A floating perforated box for living fish.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于存放活鱼的带孔浮动箱。

definitions.definition: A turn.
definitions.definitionCn: 转弯。

definitions.definition: The first part of a cons in LISP. The first element of a list
definitions.definitionCn: LISP中cons的第一个部分。列表的第一个元素。

definitions.definition: An area of land in private ownership (as opposed to common land).
definitions.definitionCn: 私有土地（与公共土地相对）。

definitions.definition: Each particular taken singly; an item; a detail; an individual.
definitions.definitionCn: 单独取出的每一个；一项；一个细节；一个个体。

definitions.definition: An enclosed or separate place; enclosure.
definitions.definitionCn: 封闭或独立的地方；围场。

definitions.definition: A woman's loose outer garment, capable of being worn as a shawl, or in other forms.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种宽松的女式外衣，可作披肩或其他形式穿着。

definitions.definition: By itself; severally.
definitions.definitionCn: 各自地；分别地。

definitions.definition: Amusement, enjoyment or pleasure
definitions.definitionCn: 娱乐、享受或快乐

definitions.definition: Playful, often noisy, activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 嬉戏的、常带喧闹的活动。

definitions.definition: To tease, kid, poke fun at, make fun of.
definitions.example: Hey, don't get bent out of shape over it; I was just funning you.
definitions.definitionCn: 取笑、逗弄、开玩笑、嘲弄。
definitions.exampleCn: 嘿，别为这事生气；我只是在逗你玩。

definitions.definition: Enjoyable, amusing
definitions.example: He is such a fun person to be with.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人愉快的、有趣的
definitions.exampleCn: 和他在一起真是有趣。

definitions.definition: Whimsical, flamboyant
definitions.example: This year's fashion style is much more fun than recent seasons.
definitions.definitionCn: 异想天开的、花哨的
definitions.exampleCn: 今年的时尚风格比近几季有趣多了。

definitions.definition: A set of items or amount of material procured or gathered together.
definitions.example: The asteroid belt consists of a collection of dust, rubble, and minor planets.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组被采购或聚集在一起的物品或材料。
definitions.exampleCn: 小行星带由尘埃、碎石和矮行星的集合构成。

definitions.definition: Multiple related objects associated as a group.
definitions.example: He has a superb coin collection.
definitions.definitionCn: 多个相关对象作为一组关联在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 他拥有一套极好的硬币收藏。

definitions.definition: The activity of collecting.
definitions.example: Collection of trash will occur every Thursday.
definitions.definitionCn: 收集的活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 垃圾收集将在每周四进行。

definitions.definition: A set of sets.
definitions.definitionCn: 集合的集合。

definitions.definition: A gathering of money for charitable or other purposes, as by passing a contribution box for donations.
definitions.definitionCn: 为慈善或其他目的筹集资金，例如传递捐款箱进行捐赠。

definitions.definition: Debt collection.
definitions.definitionCn: 债务催收。

definitions.definition: The act of inferring or concluding from premises or observed facts; also, that which is inferred.
definitions.definitionCn: 从前提或观察到的事实中推断或得出结论的行为；也指被推断出的结论。

definitions.definition: The jurisdiction of a collector of excise.
definitions.definitionCn: 税务征收员的管辖范围。

definitions.definition: (in the plural, Oxford University) A set of college exams generally taken at the start of the term.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式，牛津大学）通常在学期开始时进行的一组大学考试。

definitions.definition: The quality of being collected; calm composure.
definitions.definitionCn: 沉着冷静的品质；镇定自若。

definitions.definition: To make a living; earn money for necessities.
definitions.example: It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.
definitions.definitionCn: 谋生；赚取生活必需品。
definitions.exampleCn: 靠最低工资难以养家糊口。

definitions.definition: To act to prepare for something.
definitions.example: Provide against disaster.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某事做准备。
definitions.exampleCn: 防备灾难。

definitions.definition: To establish as a previous condition; to stipulate.
definitions.example: I'll lend you the money, provided that you pay it back by Monday.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为前提条件；规定。
definitions.exampleCn: 只要你周一还钱，我就借给你。

definitions.definition: To give what is needed or desired, especially basic needs.
definitions.example: Don't bother bringing equipment, as we will provide it.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供所需或所求，尤其是基本需求。
definitions.exampleCn: 别费心带设备了，我们会提供。

definitions.definition: To furnish (with), cause to be present.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供（给），使存在。

definitions.definition: To make possible or attainable.
definitions.example: He provides us with an alternative option.
definitions.definitionCn: 使可能或可实现。
definitions.exampleCn: 他为我们提供了另一种选择。

definitions.definition: (Latinism) To foresee.
definitions.definitionCn: （拉丁语用法）预见。

definitions.definition: To appoint to an ecclesiastical benefice before it is vacant. See provisor.
definitions.definitionCn: 在教职空缺前预先任命。参见“provisor”。

definitions.definition: An academic field of study concerning the given subject.
definitions.definitionCn: 关于该主题的学术研究领域。

definitions.definition: (usually academic) To review materials already learned in order to make sure one does not forget them, usually in preparation for an examination.
definitions.example: I need to study my biology notes.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常指学术）复习已学材料以确保不遗忘，通常是为考试做准备。
definitions.exampleCn: 我需要复习我的生物学笔记。

definitions.definition: (academic) To take a course or courses on a subject.
definitions.example: I study medicine at the university.
definitions.definitionCn: （学术）修读某学科的一门或多门课程。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在大学攻读医学。

definitions.definition: To acquire knowledge on a subject with the intention of applying it in practice.
definitions.example: Biologists study living things.
definitions.definitionCn: 以实践应用为目的获取某学科知识。
definitions.exampleCn: 生物学家研究生物体。

definitions.definition: To look at minutely.
definitions.example: He studied the map in preparation for the hike.
definitions.definitionCn: 仔细审视。
definitions.exampleCn: 他仔细研究地图为徒步做准备。

definitions.definition: To fix the mind closely upon a subject; to dwell upon anything in thought; to muse; to ponder.
definitions.definitionCn: 将思维紧密集中于某一主题；在思考中沉浸于任何事物；沉思；思索。

definitions.definition: To endeavor diligently; to be zealous.
definitions.definitionCn: 勤奋努力；充满热忱。

definitions.definition: Mental effort to acquire knowledge or learning.
definitions.example: The study of languages is fascinating.
definitions.definitionCn: 为获取知识或学习付出的脑力劳动。
definitions.exampleCn: 语言研究令人着迷。

definitions.definition: The act of studying or examining; examination.
definitions.example: I made a careful study of his sister.
definitions.definitionCn: 研究或审视的行为；检查。
definitions.exampleCn: 我仔细研究了他的妹妹。

definitions.definition: Any particular branch of learning that is studied; any object of attentive consideration.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何被研究的特定学科分支；任何被专注思考的对象。

definitions.definition: A room in a house intended for reading and writing; traditionally the private room of the male head of household.
definitions.example: Father spends all his time in the study poring over manuscripts.
definitions.definitionCn: 房屋中用于阅读和写作的房间；传统上为男性户主的私人空间。
definitions.exampleCn: 父亲整日待在书房里研读手稿。

definitions.definition: An artwork made in order to practise or demonstrate a subject or technique.
definitions.example: a study of heads or of hands for a figure picture
definitions.definitionCn: 为练习或展示某个主题或技法而创作的艺术品。
definitions.exampleCn: 一幅人物画中头部或手部的习作。

definitions.definition: The human face, bearing an expression which the observer finds amusingly typical of a particular emotion or state of mind.
definitions.example: Geoffrey's face was a study in amazement [or in bewilderment, irritation, distress etc.]
definitions.definitionCn: 人类面部呈现的某种表情，观察者觉得该表情典型地体现了某种特定情绪或心境。
definitions.exampleCn: 杰弗里脸上满是惊愕（或困惑、恼怒、痛苦等）的表情。

definitions.definition: A piece for special practice; an étude.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于特殊练习的乐曲；练习曲。

definitions.definition: (academic) An academic publication.
definitions.example: That new study on noncommutative symmetries looks promising.
definitions.definitionCn: （学术）学术出版物。
definitions.exampleCn: 那篇关于非交换对称性的新研究看起来很有前景。

definitions.definition: One who commits a theatrical part to memory.
definitions.definitionCn: 背诵戏剧台词的人。

definitions.definition: A state of mental perplexity or worried thought.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神困惑或忧虑思考的状态。

definitions.definition: Thought, as directed to a specific purpose; one's concern.
definitions.example: My study was to avoid disturbing her.
definitions.definitionCn: 针对特定目的的思考；某人的关注点。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的目标是避免打扰她。

definitions.definition: To possess, own.
definitions.example: I have a house and a car.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有，持有。
definitions.exampleCn: 我有一所房子和一辆车。

definitions.definition: To hold, as something at someone's disposal.
definitions.example: Do you have the key? (not necessarily one's own key)
definitions.definitionCn: 持有，如供某人支配之物。
definitions.exampleCn: 你有钥匙吗？（不一定指自己的钥匙）

definitions.definition: Used to state the existence or presence of someone in a specified relationship with the subject.
definitions.example: I have a really mean boss.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于说明某人与主语存在特定关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 我有一个非常刻薄的老板。

definitions.definition: To partake of (a particular substance, especially food or drink, or action or activity).
definitions.example: Can I have a look at that?
definitions.definitionCn: 享用（特定物质，尤指食物、饮料，或行动、活动）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能看看那个吗？

definitions.definition: To be scheduled to attend, undertake or participate in.
definitions.example: Fred won't be able to come to the party; he has a meeting that day.
definitions.definitionCn: 预定要参加、承担或参与。
definitions.exampleCn: 弗雷德无法来参加派对；他那天有个会议。

definitions.definition: To experience, go through, undergo.
definitions.example: He had surgery on his hip yesterday.
definitions.definitionCn: 经历、体验、经受。
definitions.exampleCn: 他昨天做了髋部手术。

definitions.definition: To be afflicted with, suffer from.
definitions.example: He had a cold last week.
definitions.definitionCn: 受……困扰，患……病。
definitions.exampleCn: 他上周感冒了。

definitions.definition: (auxiliary verb, taking a past participle) Used in forming the perfect aspect.
definitions.example: I had already eaten.
definitions.definitionCn: （助动词，接过去分词）用于构成完成时态。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已经吃过了。

definitions.definition: Used as an interrogative verb before a pronoun to form a tag question, echoing a previous use of 'have' as an auxiliary verb or, in certain cases, main verb. (For further discussion, see the appendix English tag questions.)
definitions.example: They haven't eaten dinner yet, have they?
definitions.definitionCn: 用作疑问动词，置于代词前构成附加疑问句，呼应之前作为助动词或（特定情况下）主要动词的“have”。（进一步讨论见附录英语附加疑问句。）
definitions.exampleCn: 他们还没吃晚饭，是吗？

definitions.definition: (auxiliary verb, taking a to-infinitive) See have to.
definitions.example: I have to go.
definitions.definitionCn: （助动词，接带to的不定式）参见“have to”。
definitions.exampleCn: 我必须走了。

definitions.definition: To give birth to.
definitions.example: My mother had me when she was 25.
definitions.definitionCn: 分娩，生育。
definitions.exampleCn: 我母亲25岁时生下了我。

definitions.definition: To engage in sexual intercourse with.
definitions.example: He's always bragging about how many women he's had.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……发生性关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 他总是吹嘘自己有过多少女人。

definitions.definition: To accept as a romantic partner.
definitions.example: Despite my protestations of love, she would not have me.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受……作为恋爱伴侣。
definitions.exampleCn: 尽管我表白爱意，她仍不愿接受我。

definitions.definition: (transitive with bare infinitive) To cause to, by a command, request or invitation.
definitions.example: They had me feed their dog while they were out of town.
definitions.definitionCn: （及物动词，接不带to的不定式）通过命令、请求或邀请使……做……。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们让我在他们出城期间喂狗。

definitions.definition: (transitive with adjective or adjective-phrase complement) To cause to be.
definitions.example: He had him arrested for trespassing.
definitions.definitionCn: （及物动词，接形容词或形容词短语补语）使……处于某种状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 他因非法侵入而被捕。

definitions.definition: (transitive with bare infinitive) To be affected by an occurrence. (Used in supplying a topic that is not a verb argument.)
definitions.example: I've had three people today tell me my hair looks nice.
definitions.definitionCn: （及物动词，接不带to的不定式）受某事影响（用于提供非动词论元的主题）。
definitions.exampleCn: 今天已有三个人告诉我我的头发看起来不错。

definitions.definition: (transitive with adjective or adjective-phrase complement) To depict as being.
definitions.example: Their stories differed; he said he'd been at work when the incident occurred, but her statement had him at home that entire evening.
definitions.definitionCn: （及物动词，接形容词或形容词短语补语）描述为……。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们的说法不同；他说事发时他在工作，但她的陈述称他整晚都在家。

definitions.definition: To defeat in a fight; take.
definitions.example: I could have him!
definitions.definitionCn: 在打斗中击败；夺取。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能打败他！

definitions.definition: (obsolete outside Ireland) To be able to speak (a language).
definitions.example: I have no German.
definitions.definitionCn: （除爱尔兰外已过时）能说（某种语言）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不会德语。

definitions.definition: To feel or be (especially painfully) aware of.
definitions.example: Dan certainly has arms today, probably from scraping paint off four columns the day before.
definitions.definitionCn: 感觉到或意识到（尤指痛苦地）。
definitions.exampleCn: 丹今天肯定胳膊酸痛，可能是前一天从四根柱子上刮油漆所致。

definitions.definition: To trick, to deceive.
definitions.example: You had me alright! I never would have thought that was just a joke.
definitions.definitionCn: 欺骗，蒙骗。
definitions.exampleCn: 你骗到我了！我绝没想到那只是个玩笑。

definitions.definition: (often with present participle) To allow; to tolerate.
definitions.example: I asked my dad if I could go to the concert this Thursday, but he wouldn't have it since it's a school night.
definitions.definitionCn: （常接现在分词）允许；容忍。
definitions.exampleCn: 我问爸爸这周四能否去听音乐会，但他不同意，因为第二天要上学。

definitions.definition: (often used in the negative) To believe, buy, be taken in by.
definitions.example: I made up an excuse as to why I was out so late, but my wife wasn't having any of it.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用于否定句）相信，接受，上当。
definitions.exampleCn: 我编了个借口解释为何深夜未归，但我妻子根本不信。

definitions.definition: To host someone; to take in as a guest.
definitions.example: Thank you for having me!
definitions.definitionCn: 招待某人；作为客人接待。
definitions.exampleCn: 感谢您的款待！

definitions.definition: To get a reading, measurement, or result from an instrument or calculation.
definitions.example: I have two contacts on my scope.
definitions.definitionCn: 从仪器或计算中获得读数、测量值或结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的瞄准镜上有两个接触点。

definitions.definition: (of a jury) To consider a court proceeding that has been completed; to begin deliberations on a case.
definitions.example: We'll schedule closing arguments for Thursday, and the jury will have the case by that afternoon.
definitions.definitionCn: （指陪审团）考虑已完成的法庭程序；开始对案件进行审议。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们将在周四安排结案陈词，陪审团当天下午将开始审议此案。

definitions.definition: To make an observation of (a bird species).
definitions.definitionCn: 观察（一种鸟类）。

definitions.definition: The act of possessing; ownership.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有的行为；所有权。

definitions.definition: Something owned; possession; goods; estate.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有的东西；财产；货物；地产。

definitions.definition: A person's behaviour.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的行为。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) Good manners.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）礼貌，礼节。

definitions.definition: Grasping; greedy.
definitions.definitionCn: 贪婪的；贪心的。

definitions.definition: Motivation to do or achieve something; ability coupled with ambition.
definitions.example: Crassus had wealth and wit, but Pompey had drive and Caesar as much again.
definitions.definitionCn: 做或达成某事的动力；能力与抱负的结合。
definitions.exampleCn: 克拉苏拥有财富与智慧，但庞培有干劲，而凯撒则两者兼备。

definitions.definition: Violent or rapid motion; a rushing onward or away; especially, a forced or hurried dispatch of business.
definitions.definitionCn: 猛烈或急速的运动；向前或向外的冲势；尤指被迫或匆忙处理事务。

definitions.definition: An act of driving animals forward, as to be captured, hunted etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 驱赶动物前进的行为，如为了捕获或狩猎。

definitions.definition: A sustained advance in the face of the enemy to take a strategic objective.
definitions.example: Napoleon's drive on Moscow was as determined as it was disastrous.
definitions.definitionCn: 面对敌人持续前进以夺取战略目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 拿破仑向莫斯科的进军既坚决又灾难性。

definitions.definition: A mechanism used to power or give motion to a vehicle or other machine or machine part.
definitions.example: Some old model trains have clockwork drives.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于为车辆或其他机器或机器部件提供动力或运动的机械装置。
definitions.exampleCn: 一些老式模型火车装有发条驱动。

definitions.definition: A trip made in a vehicle (now generally in a motor vehicle).
definitions.example: It was a long drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘坐车辆（现在通常指机动车）的行程。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是一段很长的车程。

definitions.definition: A driveway.
definitions.example: The mansion had a long, tree-lined drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 私家车道。
definitions.exampleCn: 那座豪宅有一条绿树成荫的长车道。

definitions.definition: A type of public roadway.
definitions.example: Beverly Hills’ most famous street is Rodeo Drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种公共道路类型。
definitions.exampleCn: 比弗利山庄最著名的街道是罗迪欧大道。

definitions.definition: A place suitable or agreeable for driving; a road prepared for driving.
definitions.definitionCn: 适合或宜于驾驶的地方；为驾驶而准备的道路。

definitions.definition: Desire or interest.
definitions.definitionCn: 欲望或兴趣。

definitions.definition: An apparatus for reading and writing data to or from a mass storage device such as a disk, as a floppy drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于从磁盘等大容量存储设备读写数据的装置，如软盘驱动器。

definitions.definition: A mass storage device in which the mechanism for reading and writing data is integrated with the mechanism for storing data, as a hard drive, a flash drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种大容量存储设备，其读写数据的机制与存储数据的机制集成在一起，如硬盘驱动器、闪存驱动器。

definitions.definition: A stroke made with a driver.
definitions.definitionCn: 用球杆击出的一杆。

definitions.definition: A ball struck in a flat trajectory.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿平直轨迹击出的球。

definitions.definition: A type of shot played by swinging the bat in a vertical arc, through the line of the ball, and hitting it along the ground, normally between cover and midwicket.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种击球方式，球棒沿垂直弧线挥动，穿过球线，沿地面击球，通常位于覆盖区和中门柱之间。

definitions.definition: A straight level shot or pass.
definitions.definitionCn: 直线平击或传球。

definitions.definition: An offensive possession, generally one consisting of several plays and/ or first downs, often leading to a scoring opportunity.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次进攻控球，通常由多次进攻和/或首攻组成，常导致得分机会。

definitions.definition: A charity event such as a fundraiser, bake sale, or toy drive.
definitions.example: a whist drive; a beetle drive
definitions.definitionCn: 慈善活动，如筹款活动、烘焙义卖或玩具募捐。
definitions.exampleCn: 惠斯特牌会；甲虫牌会

definitions.definition: (retail) A campaign aimed at selling more of a certain product, e.g. by offering a discount.
definitions.definitionCn: （零售）旨在增加某种产品销量的活动，例如通过提供折扣。

definitions.definition: An impression or matrix formed by a punch drift.
definitions.definitionCn: 由冲头形成的印痕或模具。

definitions.definition: A collection of objects that are driven; a mass of logs to be floated down a river.
definitions.definitionCn: 被驱赶的物体集合；准备顺流而下的一堆原木。

definitions.definition: To provide an impetus for motion or other physical change, to move an object by means of the provision of force thereto.
definitions.example: You drive nails into wood with a hammer.
definitions.definitionCn: 为运动或其他物理变化提供动力，通过施加力来移动物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 你用锤子把钉子钉进木头。

definitions.definition: To provide an impetus for a non-physical change, especially a change in one's state of mind.
definitions.example: My wife's constant harping about the condition of the house threatens to drive me to distraction.
definitions.definitionCn: 为非物理变化提供动力，尤其是心态的变化。
definitions.exampleCn: 我妻子对房子状况的不断唠叨快要把我逼疯了。

definitions.definition: To displace either physically or non-physically, through the application of force.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过施加力进行物理或非物理的位移。

definitions.definition: To cause intrinsic motivation through the application or demonstration of force: to impel or urge onward thusly, to compel to move on, to coerce, intimidate or threaten.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过施加或展示力量引发内在动机：以此推动或敦促前进，迫使移动，胁迫、恐吓或威胁。

definitions.definition: (especially of animals) To impel or urge onward by force; to push forward; to compel to move on.
definitions.example: to drive twenty thousand head of cattle from Texas to the Kansas railheads; to drive sheep out of a field
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指动物）用力量推动或敦促前进；向前推；迫使移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 将两万头牛从得克萨斯州赶到堪萨斯州的铁路终点站；把羊赶出田地。

definitions.definition: To direct a vehicle powered by a horse, ox or similar animal.
definitions.definitionCn: 驾驶由马、牛或类似动物驱动的车辆。

definitions.definition: To cause animals to flee out of.
definitions.example: The beaters drove the brambles, causing a great rush of rabbits and other creatures.
definitions.definitionCn: 使动物逃出。
definitions.exampleCn: 驱赶者拨开荆棘，惊起一大群兔子和其他生物。

definitions.definition: To move (something) by hitting it with great force.
definitions.example: You drive nails into wood with a hammer.
definitions.definitionCn: 用大力击打移动（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 你用锤子把钉子钉进木头。

definitions.definition: To cause (a mechanism) to operate.
definitions.example: The pistons drive the crankshaft.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（机械装置）运转。
definitions.exampleCn: 活塞驱动曲轴。

definitions.definition: To operate (a wheeled motorized vehicle).
definitions.example: drive a car
definitions.definitionCn: 操作（轮式机动车辆）。
definitions.exampleCn: 开车

definitions.definition: To motivate; to provide an incentive for.
definitions.example: What drives a person to run a marathon?
definitions.definitionCn: 激发；提供动机。
definitions.exampleCn: 是什么驱使一个人跑马拉松？

definitions.definition: To compel (to do something).
definitions.example: Their debts finally drove them to sell the business.
definitions.definitionCn: 强迫（做某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们的债务最终迫使他们卖掉了生意。

definitions.definition: To cause to become.
definitions.example: This constant complaining is going to drive me to insanity.   You are driving me crazy!
definitions.definitionCn: 使变成某种状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 这不断的抱怨快要把我逼疯了。你把我逼疯了！

definitions.definition: To hit the ball with a drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 用击球方式击球。

definitions.definition: To travel by operating a wheeled motorized vehicle.
definitions.example: I drive to work every day.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过驾驶轮式机动车辆旅行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每天开车上班。

definitions.definition: To convey (a person, etc) in a wheeled motorized vehicle.
definitions.example: My wife drove me to the airport.
definitions.definitionCn: 用轮式机动车辆运送（某人等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我妻子开车送我去机场。

definitions.definition: To move forcefully.
definitions.definitionCn: 猛烈移动。

definitions.definition: To be moved or propelled forcefully (especially of a ship).
definitions.definitionCn: 被猛烈移动或推进（尤指船只）。

definitions.definition: To urge, press, or bring to a point or state.
definitions.definitionCn: 敦促、逼迫或使达到某一点或状态。

definitions.definition: To carry or to keep in motion; to conduct; to prosecute.
definitions.definitionCn: 保持或使持续运动；进行；执行。

definitions.definition: To clear, by forcing away what is contained.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过驱赶内含物来清理。

definitions.definition: To dig horizontally; to cut a horizontal gallery or tunnel.
definitions.definitionCn: 水平挖掘；挖掘水平巷道或隧道。

definitions.definition: To put together a drive (n.): to string together offensive plays and advance the ball down the field.
definitions.definitionCn: 组织一次进攻（名词）：串联进攻动作，将球推进到前场。

definitions.definition: To distrain for rent.
definitions.definitionCn: 为租金扣押财物。

definitions.definition: To separate the lighter (feathers or down) from the heavier, by exposing them to a current of air.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过暴露在气流中，将较轻的（羽毛或绒毛）与较重的分离。

definitions.definition: To be the dominant party in a sex act.
definitions.definitionCn: 在性行为中成为主导方。

definitions.definition: A homogeneous mixture, which may be liquid, gas or solid, formed by dissolving one or more substances.
definitions.definitionCn: 由一种或多种物质溶解形成的均匀混合物，可为液体、气体或固体。

definitions.definition: An act, plan or other means, used or proposed, to solve a problem.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于或提议解决某个问题的行动、计划或其他手段。

definitions.definition: The answer to a problem.
definitions.definitionCn: 问题的答案。

definitions.definition: A product, service or suite thereof, especially software.
definitions.definitionCn: 产品、服务或其组合，尤指软件。

definitions.definition: Satisfaction of a claim or debt.
definitions.definitionCn: 对索赔或债务的清偿。

definitions.definition: The act of dissolving, especially of a solid by a fluid; dissolution.
definitions.definitionCn: 溶解的行为，尤指固体被流体溶解；溶解过程。
