definitions.definitionCn: 斧头沿切削刃的斜面前端边缘。

definitions.definition: To put a bridle upon; to put the bit in the mouth of (a horse).
definitions.definitionCn: 给（马）戴上笼头；把嚼子放入（马）口中。

definitions.definition: Bitten.
definitions.example: Even though he's bit, of course the zombies would still chase him.

definitions.definition: (only in combination) Having been bitten.
To cut into something by clamping the teeth.
definitions.example: As soon as you bite that sandwich, you'll know how good it is.

definitions.definition: To hold something by clamping one's teeth.
To attack with the teeth.
definitions.example: That dog is about to bite!

definitions.definition: To behave aggressively; to reject advances.
definitions.example: If you see me, come and say hello. I don't bite.

definitions.definition: To take hold; to establish firm contact with.
definitions.example: I needed snow chains to make the tires bite.

definitions.definition: To have significant effect, often negative.
definitions.example: For homeowners with adjustable rate mortgages, rising interest will really bite.

definitions.definition: (of a fish) To bite a baited hook or other lure and thus be caught.
definitions.example: Are the fish biting today?

definitions.definition: To accept something offered, often secretly or deceptively, to cause some action by the acceptor.
definitions.example: I've planted the story. Do you think they'll bite?

definitions.definition: (of an insect) To sting.
definitions.example: These mosquitoes are really biting today!

definitions.definition: To cause a smarting sensation; to have a property which causes such a sensation; to be pungent.
definitions.example: It bites like pepper or mustard.

definitions.definition: (sometimes figurative) To cause sharp pain or damage to; to hurt or injure.
definitions.example: Pepper bites the mouth.

definitions.definition: To cause sharp pain; to produce anguish; to hurt or injure; to have the property of so doing.
To take or keep a firm hold.
definitions.example: The anchor bites.

definitions.definition: To take hold of; to hold fast; to adhere to.
definitions.example: The anchor bites the ground.

definitions.definition: To lack quality; to be worthy of derision; to suck.
definitions.example: This music really bites.

definitions.definition: To perform oral sex on. Used in invective.
definitions.example: You don't like that I sat on your car? Bite me.

definitions.definition: To plagiarize, to imitate.
definitions.example: He always be biting my moves.

definitions.definition: To deceive or defraud; to take in.
A binary digit, generally represented as a 1 or 0.
The smallest unit of storage in a digital computer, consisting of a binary digit.
Any datum that may take on one of exactly two values.
definitions.example: permission bits in a file system

definitions.definition: A unit of measure for information entropy.
A microbitcoin, or a millionth of a bitcoin (0.000001 BTC).
Very elevated; extending or being far above a base; tall; lofty.
definitions.example: The balloon rose high in the sky.   The wall was high.   a high mountain
definitions.definitionCn: 非常高；延伸或远高于基底；高的；巍峨的。
definitions.exampleCn: 气球升到高空。墙很高。一座高山。

definitions.definition: Relatively elevated; rising or raised above the average or normal level from which elevation is measured.
definitions.definitionCn: 相对较高；高于平均水平或正常水平。

definitions.definition: Having a specified elevation or height; tall.
definitions.example: three feet high   three Mount Everests high
definitions.definitionCn: 有特定高度或身高的；高的。
definitions.exampleCn: 三英尺高。三个珠穆朗玛峰高。

definitions.definition: Elevated in status, esteem, prestige; exalted in rank, station, or character.
definitions.example: The oldest of the elves' royal family still conversed in High Elvish.
definitions.definitionCn: 地位、声望、威望高的；等级、职位或品格崇高的。
definitions.exampleCn: 精灵王室中最年长的成员仍用高等精灵语交谈。

definitions.definition: Of great importance and consequence: grave (if negative) or solemn (if positive).
definitions.example: high crimes, the high festival of the sun
definitions.definitionCn: 非常重要且后果严重的：严重的（如负面）或庄严的（如正面）。
definitions.exampleCn: 重罪，太阳的盛大节日。

definitions.definition: Consummate; advanced (e.g. in development) to the utmost extent or culmination, or possessing a quality in its supreme degree, at its zenith.
definitions.example: high (i.e. intense) heat; high (i.e. full or quite) noon; high (i.e. rich or spicy) seasoning; high (i.e. complete) pleasure; high (i.e. deep or vivid) colour; high (i.e. extensive, thorough) scholarship; high tide; high [tourism] season; the High Middle Ages
definitions.definitionCn: 极致的；高级的（如发展）达到最大程度或顶点，或拥有最高程度的品质。
definitions.exampleCn: 高温（即强烈）；正午（即完全或正好）；浓味（即丰富或辛辣）调料；极乐（即完全）；深色（即浓郁或生动）；渊博（即广泛、透彻）学识；高潮；旅游旺季；中古盛期。

definitions.definition: (in several set phrases) Remote in distance or time.
definitions.example: high latitude, high antiquity
definitions.definitionCn: （在几个固定短语中）距离或时间遥远的。
definitions.exampleCn: 高纬度，远古。

definitions.definition: (in several set phrases) Very traditionalist and conservative, especially in favoring older ways of doing things; see e.g. high church, High Tory.
definitions.definitionCn: （在几个固定短语中）非常传统和保守，尤其偏好旧方式；例如高教会派、极端保守派。

definitions.definition: Elevated in mood; marked by great merriment, excitement, etc.
definitions.example: in high spirits
definitions.definitionCn: 情绪高涨的；充满欢乐、兴奋等的。
definitions.exampleCn: 兴高采烈。

definitions.definition: (of a lifestyle) Luxurious; rich.
definitions.example: high living, the high life
definitions.definitionCn: （生活方式）奢侈的；富有的。
definitions.exampleCn: 奢华生活，上流生活。

definitions.definition: Lofty, often to the point of arrogant, haughty, boastful, proud.
definitions.example: a high tone
definitions.definitionCn: 高傲的，常到傲慢、自大、自负、骄傲的程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 高傲的语气。

definitions.definition: (with "on" or "about") Keen, enthused.
definitions.definitionCn: （与“on”或“about”连用）热衷的，兴奋的。

definitions.definition: (of a body of water) With tall waves.
definitions.definitionCn: （水体）波涛汹涌的。

definitions.definition: Large, great (in amount or quantity, value, force, energy, etc).
definitions.example: My bank charges me a high interest rate.   I was running a high temperature and had high cholesterol.   high voltage   high prices   high winds   a high number
definitions.definitionCn: 大的，巨大的（数量、价值、力量、能量等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的银行收取高利率。我发高烧且胆固醇高。高压电。高价。大风。大量。

definitions.definition: (acoustics) Acute or shrill in pitch, due to being of greater frequency, i.e. produced by more rapid vibrations (wave oscillations).
definitions.example: The note was too high for her to sing.
definitions.definitionCn: （声学）音调尖锐或刺耳的，因频率更高，即由更快的振动（波振荡）产生。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个音符太高，她唱不上去。

definitions.definition: Made with some part of the tongue positioned high in the mouth, relatively close to the palate.
definitions.definitionCn: 用舌头部分抬高在口中、靠近上颚发出的音。

definitions.definition: Greater in value than other cards, denominations, suits, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 比其他牌、面值、花色等价值更高的。

definitions.definition: (of meat, especially venison) Strong-scented; slightly tainted/spoiled; beginning to decompose.
definitions.example: Epicures do not cook game before it is high.
definitions.definitionCn: （肉，尤其是鹿肉）气味浓烈的；轻微变质/腐坏的；开始分解的。
definitions.exampleCn: 美食家不会在鹿肉未变质前烹饪。

definitions.definition: Intoxicated; under the influence of a mood-altering drug, formerly usually alcohol, but now (from the mid-20th century) usually not alcohol but rather marijuana, cocaine, heroin, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 醉酒的；受情绪改变药物影响的，以前通常是酒精，但现在（从20世纪中期起）通常不是酒精而是大麻、可卡因、海洛因等。

definitions.definition: (of a sailing ship) Near, in its direction of travel, to the (direction of the) wind.
definitions.definitionCn: （帆船）在航行方向上接近风向的。

definitions.definition: In or to an elevated position.
definitions.example: How high above land did you fly?
definitions.definitionCn: 处于或到高处位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 你飞得离地面多高？

definitions.definition: In or at a great value.
definitions.example: Costs have grown higher this year again.
definitions.definitionCn: 以高价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 今年成本又上涨了。

definitions.definition: At a pitch of great frequency.
definitions.example: I certainly can't sing that high.
definitions.definitionCn: 以高频率的音调。
definitions.exampleCn: 我当然唱不了那么高。

definitions.definition: A national school-leaving examination and university entrance qualification.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种全国性的中学毕业考试和大学入学资格。

definitions.definition: To make higher; to raise or increase in amount or quantity.
definitions.definitionCn: 使更高；提高或增加数量。

definitions.definition: To ascend.
definitions.definitionCn: 上升。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to the environment.
definitions.definitionCn: 与环境相关的。

definitions.definition: A hard black enamel varnish containing asphalt.
definitions.definitionCn: 含有沥青的硬质黑色珐琅清漆。

definitions.definition: Lacquerware.
definitions.definitionCn: 漆器。

definitions.definition: To varnish with japan.
definitions.definitionCn: 用日本漆涂饰。

definitions.definition: The quality of being available.
definitions.example: What is your availability this week?
definitions.definitionCn: 可用性。
definitions.exampleCn: 这周你什么时候有空？

definitions.definition: That which is available.
definitions.example: We have several availabilities.
definitions.definitionCn: 可用的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们有几个可用的选项。

definitions.definition: An act or instance of lending, an act or instance of granting something for temporary use.
definitions.example: Because of the loan that John made to me, I was able to pay my tuition for the upcoming semester.
definitions.definitionCn: 借贷的行为或实例，即暂时授予某物使用的行为或实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 由于约翰借给我的贷款，我得以支付下学期的学费。

definitions.definition: A sum of money or other property that a natural or legal person borrows from another with the condition that it be returned or repaid over time or at a later date (sometimes with interest).
definitions.example: All loans from the library, whether books or audio material, must be returned within two weeks.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然人或法人从他人处借入的一笔金钱或其他财产，条件是在一段时间内或日后归还或偿还（有时附带利息）。
definitions.exampleCn: 图书馆的所有借出物品，无论是书籍还是音频资料，都必须在两周内归还。

definitions.definition: The contract and array of legal or ethical obligations surrounding a loan.
definitions.example: He made a payment on his loan.
definitions.definitionCn: 围绕贷款产生的合同及一系列法律或道德义务。
definitions.exampleCn: 他支付了一笔贷款。

definitions.definition: The permission to borrow any item.
definitions.example: Thank you for the loan of your lawn mower.
definitions.definitionCn: 借用任何物品的许可。
definitions.exampleCn: 感谢你借给我割草机。

definitions.definition: To lend (something) to (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）借给（某人）。

definitions.definition: A lonnen.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条小巷。

definitions.definition: To prepare food by cutting it into strips.
definitions.definitionCn: 将食物切成条状来准备。

definitions.definition: To kiss (another person) while inserting one’s tongue into the other person's mouth.
definitions.definitionCn: 亲吻（另一个人）时将舌头伸入对方口中。

definitions.definition: To kiss in this manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 以这种方式接吻。

definitions.definition: To French trim; to stylishly expose bone by removing the fat and meat covering it (as done to a rack of lamb or bone-in rib-eye steak).
definitions.definitionCn: 法式修整；通过去除覆盖在骨头上的脂肪和肉来时尚地露出骨头（如对羊排或带骨肋眼牛排的做法）。

definitions.definition: A protective covering for the foot, with a bottom part composed of thick leather or plastic sole and often a thicker heel, and a softer upper part made of leather or synthetic material. Shoes generally do not extend above the ankle, as opposed to boots, which do.
definitions.example: Get your shoes on now, or you'll be late for school.
definitions.definitionCn: 鞋是一种保护脚部的覆盖物，底部由厚皮革或塑料鞋底构成，通常带有较厚的鞋跟，上部则采用皮革或合成材料制成，较为柔软。鞋子一般不超过脚踝，与靴子不同，靴子会覆盖脚踝以上部位。
definitions.exampleCn: 现在穿上鞋，否则上学要迟到了。

definitions.definition: A piece of metal designed to be attached to a horse's foot as a means of protection; a horseshoe.
definitions.example: Throw the shoe from behind the line, and try to get it to land circling (a ringer) or touching the far stake.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种设计用于保护马蹄的金属片，即马蹄铁。
definitions.exampleCn: 从线后扔出鞋子，尝试让它落地时环绕（套环）或触碰远处的桩子。

definitions.definition: A device for holding multiple decks of playing cards, allowing more games to be played by reducing the time between shuffles.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于放置多副扑克牌的装置，通过减少洗牌间隔时间，使更多游戏得以进行。

definitions.definition: Something resembling a shoe in form, position, or function, such as a brake shoe.
definitions.example: Remember to turn the rotors when replacing the brake shoes, or they will wear out unevenly.
definitions.definitionCn: 形状、位置或功能类似鞋子的物品，例如刹车蹄片。
definitions.exampleCn: 更换刹车蹄片时记得转动转子，否则它们会磨损不均。

definitions.definition: The outer cover or tread of a pneumatic tire, especially for an automobile.
definitions.definitionCn: 充气轮胎的外层覆盖物或胎面，尤其指汽车轮胎。

definitions.definition: To put shoes on one's feet.
definitions.definitionCn: 给脚穿上鞋子。

definitions.definition: To put horseshoes on a horse.
definitions.definitionCn: 给马钉上马蹄铁。

definitions.definition: To equip an object with a protection against wear.
definitions.example: The billiard cue stick was shod in silver.
definitions.definitionCn: 为物体配备防磨损保护装置。
definitions.exampleCn: 台球球杆的末端包有银质保护套。

definitions.definition: The left side of a horse or of a team of horses pulling a carriage etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 马或拉车马队的左侧。

definitions.definition: To come closer to; to approach.
definitions.example: The ship nears the land.
definitions.definitionCn: 靠近；接近。
definitions.exampleCn: 船靠近陆地。

definitions.definition: Physically close.
definitions.example: I can't see near objects very clearly without my glasses.
definitions.definitionCn: 空间上接近。
definitions.exampleCn: 不戴眼镜我看不清近处的物体。

definitions.definition: Close in time.
definitions.example: The end is near.
definitions.definitionCn: 时间上接近。
definitions.exampleCn: 终点临近。

definitions.definition: Closely connected or related.
definitions.example: The deceased man had no near relatives.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧密相连或相关。
definitions.exampleCn: 死者没有近亲。

definitions.definition: Close to one's interests, affection, etc.; intimate; dear.
definitions.example: a near friend
definitions.definitionCn: 与个人兴趣、情感等密切相关的；亲密的；亲爱的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位亲近的朋友。

definitions.definition: Close to anything followed or imitated; not free, loose, or rambling.
definitions.example: a version near to the original
definitions.definitionCn: 接近所遵循或模仿的对象；不自由、松散或散漫。
definitions.exampleCn: 接近原著的版本。

definitions.definition: So as barely to avoid or pass injury or loss; close; narrow.
definitions.example: a near escape
definitions.definitionCn: 勉强避免或逃脱伤害或损失；惊险的；狭窄的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一次侥幸逃脱。

definitions.definition: Approximate, almost.
definitions.example: The two words are near synonyms.
definitions.definitionCn: 近似的，几乎。
definitions.exampleCn: 这两个词是近义词。

definitions.definition: (in relation to a vehicle) On the side nearest to the kerb (the left-hand side if one drives on the left).
definitions.example: The near front wheel came loose.
definitions.definitionCn: （指车辆）靠近路缘的一侧（若靠左行驶则为左侧）。
definitions.exampleCn: 左前轮松了。

definitions.definition: Next to the driver, when he is on foot; on the left of an animal or a team.
definitions.example: the near ox; the near leg
definitions.definitionCn: 当驾驶员步行时，靠近他的一侧；动物或马队的左侧。
definitions.exampleCn: 左侧的牛；左腿。

definitions.definition: Immediate; direct; close; short.
definitions.definitionCn: 直接的；直接的；紧密的；短的。

definitions.definition: Stingy; parsimonious.
definitions.definitionCn: 吝啬的；小气的。

definitions.definition: At or towards a position close in space or time.
definitions.definitionCn: 在空间或时间上接近的位置。

definitions.definition: Nearly; almost.
definitions.example: He was near unconscious when I found him.
definitions.definitionCn: 几乎；差不多。
definitions.exampleCn: 我发现他时，他几乎不省人事。

definitions.definition: Physically close to, in close proximity to.
definitions.example: There are habitable planets orbiting many of the stars near our Sun.
definitions.definitionCn: 空间上靠近，紧邻。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们太阳附近有许多恒星拥有宜居行星。

definitions.definition: Close to in time.
definitions.example: The voyage was near completion.
definitions.definitionCn: 时间上接近。
definitions.exampleCn: 航行接近完成。

definitions.definition: Close to in nature or degree.
definitions.example: His opinions are near the limit of what is acceptable.
definitions.definitionCn: 性质或程度上接近。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的观点接近可接受的极限。

definitions.definition: Continuance or a period of time spent in a place; abode for an indefinite time; sojourn.
definitions.example: I hope you enjoyed your stay in Hawaii.
definitions.definitionCn: 停留或在一处度过的一段时间；不定期的居所；暂住。
definitions.exampleCn: 希望你在夏威夷过得愉快。

definitions.definition: A postponement, especially of an execution or other punishment.
definitions.example: The governor granted a stay of execution.
definitions.definitionCn: 延期，尤指处决或其他惩罚的推迟。
definitions.exampleCn: 州长批准了缓刑。

definitions.definition: A stop; a halt; a break or cessation of action, motion, or progress.
definitions.example: stand at a stay
definitions.definitionCn: 停止；停顿；行动、运动或进程的中断或终止。
definitions.exampleCn: 处于停滞状态

definitions.definition: A fixed state; fixedness; stability; permanence.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定状态；固定性；稳定性；持久性。

definitions.definition: A station or fixed anchorage for vessels.
definitions.definitionCn: 船只的停泊处或固定锚地。

definitions.definition: Restraint of passion; prudence; moderation; caution; steadiness; sobriety.
definitions.definitionCn: 抑制激情；谨慎；节制；小心；稳健；清醒。

definitions.definition: Hindrance; let; check.
definitions.definitionCn: 阻碍；妨碍；制止。

definitions.definition: To prop; support; sustain; hold up; steady.
definitions.definitionCn: 支撑；支持；维持；托住；稳住。

definitions.definition: To support from sinking; to sustain with strength; to satisfy in part or for the time.
definitions.definitionCn: 防止下沉；用力支撑；部分或暂时满足。

definitions.definition: To stop; detain; keep back; delay; hinder.
definitions.definitionCn: 阻止；扣留；保留；延迟；妨碍。

definitions.definition: To restrain; withhold; check; stop.
definitions.definitionCn: 约束；抑制；制止；停止。

definitions.definition: To cause to cease; to put an end to.
definitions.definitionCn: 使终止；结束。

definitions.definition: To put off; defer; postpone; delay; keep back.
definitions.example: The governor stayed the execution until the appeal could be heard.
definitions.definitionCn: 推迟；延期；延缓；延迟；保留。
definitions.exampleCn: 州长暂停了处决，等待上诉审理。

definitions.definition: To hold the attention of.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸引注意力。

definitions.definition: To bear up under; to endure; to hold out against; to resist.
definitions.definitionCn: 承受；忍耐；抵抗；对抗。

definitions.definition: To wait for; await.
definitions.definitionCn: 等待；等候。

definitions.definition: To remain for the purpose of; to stay to take part in or be present at (a meal, ceremony etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 为了……而留下；留下来参加或出席（餐宴、仪式等）。

definitions.definition: To rest; depend; rely.
definitions.definitionCn: 依靠；依赖；信赖。

definitions.definition: To stop; come to a stand or standstill.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止；陷入停顿或静止。

definitions.definition: To come to an end; cease.
definitions.example: That day the storm stayed.
definitions.definitionCn: 结束；终止。
definitions.exampleCn: 那天暴风雨停了。

definitions.definition: To dwell; linger; tarry; wait.
definitions.definitionCn: 逗留；徘徊；拖延；等待。

definitions.definition: To make a stand; to stand firm.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚守立场；坚定不移。

definitions.definition: To hold out, as in a race or contest; last or persevere to the end.
definitions.example: That horse stays well.
definitions.definitionCn: 坚持到底，如在比赛或竞争中；持续或坚持到最后。
definitions.exampleCn: 那匹马耐力很好。

definitions.definition: To remain in a particular place, especially for a definite or short period of time; sojourn; abide.
definitions.example: We stayed in Hawaii for a week.  I can only stay for an hour.
definitions.definitionCn: 留在特定地方，尤指确定或短时间；暂住；居住。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在夏威夷待了一周。我只能待一小时。

definitions.definition: To wait; rest in patience or expectation.
definitions.definitionCn: 等待；耐心或期待地休息。

definitions.definition: (used with on or upon) To wait as an attendant; give ceremonious or submissive attendance.
definitions.definitionCn: （与on或upon连用）作为侍者等候；给予礼节性或顺从的侍奉。

definitions.definition: To continue to have a particular quality.
definitions.example: Wear gloves so your hands stay warm.
definitions.definitionCn: 继续保持某种特质。
definitions.exampleCn: 戴手套，这样你的手就能保持温暖。

definitions.definition: To live; reside
definitions.example: Hey, where do you stay at?
definitions.definitionCn: 居住；定居
definitions.exampleCn: 嘿，你住在哪里？

definitions.definition: A prop; a support.
A piece of stiff material, such as plastic or whalebone, used to stiffen a piece of clothing.
definitions.example: Where are the stays for my collar?

definitions.definition: (in the plural) A corset.
A fastening for a garment; a hook; a clasp; anything to hang another thing on.
A strong rope or wire supporting a mast, and leading from one masthead down to some other, or other part of the vessel.
A guy, rope, or wire supporting or stabilizing a platform, such as a bridge, a pole, such as a tentpole, the mast of a derrick, or other structural element.
definitions.example: The engineer insisted on using stays for the scaffolding.

definitions.definition: The transverse piece in a chain-cable link.
To brace or support with a stay or stays
definitions.example: stay a mast

definitions.definition: To incline forward, aft, or to one side by means of stays.
To tack; put on the other tack.
definitions.example: to stay ship

definitions.definition: To change; tack; go about; be in stays, as a ship.
Steep; ascending.
(of a roof) Steeply pitched.
Difficult to negotiate; not easy to access; sheer.
Stiff; upright; unbending; reserved; haughty; proud.
Steeply.
(auxiliary) A syntactic marker.
definitions.definitionCn: (助动词) 一种句法标记。

definitions.definition: To perform; to execute.
definitions.example: All you ever do is surf the Internet. What will you do this afternoon?
definitions.definitionCn: 执行；实施。
definitions.exampleCn: 你整天就知道上网。今天下午你打算做什么？

definitions.definition: To cause, make (someone) (do something).
definitions.definitionCn: 使、让（某人）做某事。

definitions.definition: To suffice.
definitions.example: it’s not the best broom, but it will have to do;  this will do me, thanks.
definitions.definitionCn: 足够。
definitions.exampleCn: 这不是最好的扫帚，但只能凑合用了；这个对我来说就够了，谢谢。

definitions.definition: To be reasonable or acceptable.
definitions.example: It simply will not do to have dozens of children running around such a quiet event.
definitions.definitionCn: 合理或可接受。
definitions.exampleCn: 让几十个孩子在如此安静的活动中到处乱跑是绝对不行的。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To have (as an effect).
definitions.example: The fresh air did him some good.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）产生（某种效果）。
definitions.exampleCn: 新鲜空气对他有些好处。

definitions.definition: To fare, perform (well or poorly).
definitions.example: Our relationship isn't doing very well;  how do you do?
definitions.definitionCn: 进展、表现（好或坏）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的关系不太顺利；你好吗？

definitions.definition: (chiefly in questions) To have as one's job.
definitions.example: What does Bob do? — He's a plumber.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于疑问句）从事什么职业。
definitions.exampleCn: 鲍勃是做什么的？——他是水管工。

definitions.definition: To perform the tasks or actions associated with (something).
definitions.example: "Don't forget to do your report" means something quite different depending on whether you're a student or a programmer.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行与（某事）相关的任务或行动。
definitions.exampleCn: “别忘了做你的报告”这句话，取决于你是学生还是程序员，意思截然不同。

definitions.definition: To cook.
definitions.example: I'll just do some eggs.
definitions.definitionCn: 烹饪。
definitions.exampleCn: 我就做几个鸡蛋。

definitions.definition: To travel in, to tour, to make a circuit of.
definitions.example: Let’s do New York also.
definitions.definitionCn: 旅行、游览、绕行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们也去纽约转转吧。

definitions.definition: To treat in a certain way.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式对待。

definitions.definition: To work for or on, by way of caring for, looking after, preparing, cleaning, keeping in order, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过照料、照顾、准备、清洁、整理等方式为……工作或服务。

definitions.definition: To act or behave in a certain manner; to conduct oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式行动或表现；举止。

definitions.definition: To spend (time) in jail. (See also do time)
definitions.example: I did five years for armed robbery.
definitions.definitionCn: 在监狱里度过（时间）。（参见 do time）
definitions.exampleCn: 我因持械抢劫坐了五年牢。

definitions.definition: To impersonate or depict.
definitions.example: They really laughed when he did Clinton, with a perfect accent and a leer.
definitions.definitionCn: 模仿或扮演。
definitions.exampleCn: 当他模仿克林顿，带着完美的口音和色眯眯的眼神时，他们真的笑了。

definitions.definition: (with 'a' and the name of a person, place, event, etc.) To copy or emulate the actions or behaviour that is associated with the person or thing mentioned.
definitions.example: He did a Henry VIII and got married six times.
definitions.definitionCn: （与“a”及人名、地名、事件名等连用）模仿或效仿所提及的人或事物的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 他学亨利八世，结了六次婚。

definitions.definition: To kill.
definitions.definitionCn: 杀死。

definitions.definition: To deal with for good and all; to finish up; to undo; to ruin; to do for.
definitions.definitionCn: 彻底处理；了结；破坏；毁灭；干掉。

definitions.definition: To punish for a misdemeanor.
definitions.example: He got done for speeding.
definitions.definitionCn: 因轻罪惩罚。
definitions.exampleCn: 他因超速被罚了。

definitions.definition: To have sex with. (See also do it)
definitions.definitionCn: 与……发生性关系。（参见 do it）

definitions.definition: To cheat or swindle.
definitions.example: That guy just did me out of two hundred bucks!
definitions.definitionCn: 欺骗或诈骗。
definitions.exampleCn: 那家伙刚刚骗了我两百美元！

definitions.definition: To convert into a certain form; especially, to translate.
definitions.example: the novel has just been done into English;  I'm going to do this play into a movie
definitions.definitionCn: 转换成某种形式；尤指翻译。
definitions.exampleCn: 这部小说刚被译成英文；我打算把这个剧本改编成电影。

definitions.definition: To finish.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成。

definitions.definition: To work as a domestic servant (with for).
definitions.definitionCn: 做家庭佣工（与 for 连用）。

definitions.definition: (auxiliary) Used to form the present progressive of verbs.
definitions.definitionCn: （助动词）用于构成动词的现在进行时。

definitions.definition: To cash or to advance money for, as a bill or note.
definitions.definitionCn: 兑现或预付（如汇票或票据）的款项。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To make or provide.
definitions.example: Could you do me a burger with mayonnaise instead of ketchup?
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）制作或提供。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能给我做一个加蛋黄酱而不是番茄酱的汉堡吗？

definitions.definition: To injure (one's own body part).
definitions.definitionCn: 伤害（自己的身体部位）。

definitions.definition: To take drugs.
definitions.example: I do cocaine.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸毒。
definitions.exampleCn: 我吸可卡因。

definitions.definition: (in the form be doing [somewhere]) To exist with a purpose or for a reason.
definitions.example: What's that car doing in our swimming pool?
definitions.definitionCn: （以 be doing [某处] 的形式）因某种目的或原因存在。
definitions.exampleCn: 那辆车在我们的游泳池里干什么？

definitions.definition: A deed or action, especially when somebody is held responsible for it.
definitions.example: This is his doing. (= "He did it.")
definitions.definitionCn: 行为或行动，尤指某人对此负责时。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是他干的。（=“他做了这件事。”）

definitions.definition: The sound made by an elastic object when struck by or striking a hard object.
Arrangement, disposition, or sequence.
definitions.definitionCn: 排列、配置或顺序。

definitions.definition: A position in an arrangement, disposition, or sequence.
definitions.definitionCn: 在排列、配置或顺序中的位置。

definitions.definition: The state of being well arranged.
definitions.example: The house is in order; the machinery is out of order.
definitions.definitionCn: 良好排列的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 房子井然有序；机器出了故障。

definitions.definition: Conformity with law or decorum; freedom from disturbance; general tranquillity; public quiet.
definitions.example: to preserve order in a community or an assembly
definitions.definitionCn: 符合法律或礼仪；不受干扰；总体安宁；公共平静。
definitions.exampleCn: 在社区或集会中维持秩序。

definitions.definition: A command.
definitions.definitionCn: 命令。

definitions.definition: A request for some product or service; a commission to purchase, sell, or supply goods.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某种产品或服务的请求；购买、销售或供应商品的委托。

definitions.definition: A group of religious adherents, especially monks or nuns, set apart within their religion by adherence to a particular rule or set of principles.
definitions.example: St. Ignatius Loyola founded the Jesuit order in 1537.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群宗教信徒，尤其是僧侣或修女，因遵守特定规则或原则而在其宗教内自成一体。
definitions.exampleCn: 圣依纳爵·罗耀拉于1537年创立了耶稣会。

definitions.definition: An association of knights.
definitions.example: the Order of the Garter, the Order of the Bath.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑士的协会。
definitions.exampleCn: 嘉德勋章、巴斯勋章。

definitions.definition: Any group of people with common interests.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何有共同兴趣的群体。

definitions.definition: A decoration, awarded by a government, a dynastic house, or a religious body to an individual, usually for distinguished service to a nation or to humanity.
definitions.definitionCn: 由政府、王朝或宗教机构授予个人的勋章，通常用于表彰对国家或人类的杰出贡献。

definitions.definition: A rank in the classification of organisms, below class and above family; a taxon at that rank.
definitions.example: Magnolias belong to the order Magnoliales.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物分类中的等级，位于纲之下、科之上；该等级的分类单元。
definitions.exampleCn: 木兰属于木兰目。

definitions.definition: A number of things or persons arranged in a fixed or suitable place, or relative position; a rank; a row; a grade; especially, a rank or class in society; a distinct character, kind, or sort.
definitions.example: talent of a high order
definitions.definitionCn: 按固定或合适位置或相对位置排列的若干事物或人；等级；行；级别；尤指社会中的等级或阶层；独特的性质、种类或类型。
definitions.exampleCn: 高级人才

definitions.definition: (chiefly plural) An ecclesiastical grade or rank, as of deacon, priest, or bishop; the office of the Christian ministry.
definitions.example: to take orders, or to take holy orders, that is, to enter some grade of the ministry
definitions.definitionCn: （主要为复数）教会等级或级别，如执事、牧师或主教；基督教圣职。
definitions.exampleCn: 接受圣职，或接受神圣圣职，即进入某种圣职级别。

definitions.definition: The disposition of a column and its component parts, and of the entablature resting upon it, in classical architecture; hence (since the column and entablature are the characteristic features of classical architecture) a style or manner of architectural design.
definitions.definitionCn: 古典建筑中柱式及其组成部分以及其上檐部的配置；因此（由于柱式和檐部是古典建筑的特征）一种建筑设计风格或方式。

definitions.definition: The sequence in which a side’s batsmen bat; the batting order.
definitions.definitionCn: 一方击球手的击球顺序；击球顺序。

definitions.definition: A power of polynomial function in an electronic circuit’s block, such as a filter, an amplifier, etc.
definitions.example: a 3-stage cascade of a 2nd-order bandpass Butterworth filter
definitions.definitionCn: 电子电路模块（如滤波器、放大器等）中多项式函数的幂次。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个3级级联的二阶带通巴特沃斯滤波器。

definitions.definition: The overall power of the rate law of a chemical reaction, expressed as a polynomial function of concentrations of reactants and products.
definitions.definitionCn: 化学反应速率定律的总幂次，表示为反应物和产物浓度的多项式函数。

definitions.definition: The cardinality, or number of elements in a set, group, or other structure regardable as a set.
definitions.definitionCn: 基数，或集合、群或其他可视为集合的结构中的元素数量。

definitions.definition: (of an element of a group) For given group G and element g ∈ G, the smallest positive natural number n, if it exists, such that (using multiplicative notation), gn = e, where e is the identity element of G; if no such number exists, the element is said to be of infinite order (or sometimes zero order).
definitions.definitionCn: （关于群的元素）对于给定群G和元素g∈G，存在的最小正整数n（如果存在），使得（使用乘法符号）g^n = e，其中e是G的单位元；如果不存在这样的数，则该元素称为无限阶（或有时为零阶）。

definitions.definition: The number of vertices in a graph.
definitions.definitionCn: 图中的顶点数量。

definitions.definition: A partially ordered set.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏序集。

definitions.definition: The relation on a partially ordered set that determines that it is, in fact, a partially ordered set.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏序集上确定其实际为偏序集的关系。

definitions.definition: The sum of the exponents on the variables in a monomial, or the highest such among all monomials in a polynomial.
definitions.example: A quadratic polynomial, a x^2 + b x + c, is said to be of order (or degree) 2.
definitions.definitionCn: 单项式中变量的指数之和，或多项式中所有单项式中的最高指数。
definitions.exampleCn: 二次多项式a x^2 + b x + c被称为阶（或次数）为2。

definitions.definition: A written direction to furnish someone with money or property; compare money order, postal order.
definitions.definitionCn: 向某人提供金钱或财产的书面指示；比较汇票、邮政汇票。

definitions.definition: To set in some sort of order.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种顺序排列。

definitions.definition: To arrange, set in proper order.
definitions.definitionCn: 整理，按适当顺序排列。

definitions.definition: To issue a command to.
definitions.example: He ordered me to leave.
definitions.definitionCn: 发出命令。
definitions.exampleCn: 他命令我离开。

definitions.definition: To request some product or service; to secure by placing an order.
definitions.example: to order groceries
definitions.definitionCn: 请求某种产品或服务；通过下订单获得。
definitions.exampleCn: 订购杂货。

definitions.definition: To admit to holy orders; to ordain; to receive into the ranks of the ministry.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予圣职；任命；接纳进入圣职行列。

definitions.definition: A picture, especially a photographic image.
definitions.definitionCn: 一张图片，尤其是摄影图像。

definitions.definition: A film.
definitions.definitionCn: 一部电影。

definitions.definition: A Turkish cloth measure, varying from 18 to 28 inches.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种土耳其布料度量单位，长度在18到28英寸之间不等。

definitions.definition: The state or quality of being active; activeness.
definitions.example: Pit row was abuzz with activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 活跃的状态或品质；活跃性。
definitions.exampleCn: 赛坑区一片喧闹，活动频繁。

definitions.definition: Something done as an action or a movement.
definitions.example: The activity for the morning was a walk to the store.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为行动或运动所做的事情。
definitions.exampleCn: 早上的活动是步行去商店。

definitions.definition: Something done for pleasure or entertainment, especially one involving movement or an excursion.
definitions.example: An increasing number of sports activities are on offer at the university.
definitions.definitionCn: 为娱乐或消遣而做的事情，尤指涉及运动或远足的活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 大学里提供的体育活动越来越多。

definitions.definition: (grammar) The lexical aspect (aktionsart) of verbs or predicates that change over time and have no natural end point.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）动词或谓词随时间变化且无自然终点的词汇体（aktionsart）。

definitions.definition: The capacity, condition, or state of acting or of exerting power.
definitions.definitionCn: 行动或施加力量的能力、条件或状态。

definitions.definition: The capacity of individuals to act independently and to make their own free choices.
definitions.example: individual agency
definitions.definitionCn: 个体独立行动并做出自由选择的能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 个体能动性

definitions.definition: A medium through which power is exerted or an end is achieved.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加权力或达成目的的中介。

definitions.definition: The office or function of an agent; also, the relationship between a principal and that person's agent.
definitions.example: authority of agency
definitions.definitionCn: 代理人的职务或职能；亦指委托人与代理人之间的关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 代理权

definitions.definition: An establishment engaged in doing business for another; also, the place of business or the district of such an agency.
definitions.definitionCn: 为他人从事商业活动的机构；亦指该机构的营业场所或管辖区域。

definitions.definition: A department or other administrative unit of a government; also, the office or headquarters of, or the district administered by such unit of government.
definitions.example: Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry
definitions.definitionCn: 政府的部门或其他行政单位；亦指该政府单位的办公室、总部或所辖区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 有毒物质与疾病登记署

definitions.definition: (heading) A symbol or annotation.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 一种符号或注释。

definitions.definition: (heading) A written or printed communication or commitment.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 一份书面或印刷的通信或承诺。

definitions.definition: (heading) A sound.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 一种声音。

definitions.definition: Observation; notice; heed.
definitions.definitionCn: 观察；注意；留意。

definitions.definition: Reputation; distinction.
definitions.example: a poet of note
definitions.definitionCn: 声誉；卓越。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位著名的诗人。

definitions.definition: Notification; information; intelligence.
definitions.definitionCn: 通知；信息；情报。

definitions.definition: Mark of disgrace.
definitions.definitionCn: 耻辱的标记。

definitions.definition: To notice with care; to observe; to remark; to heed.
definitions.example: If you look to the left, you can note the old cathedral.
definitions.definitionCn: 仔细注意；观察；评论；留意。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你向左看，你可以注意到那座古老的大教堂。

definitions.definition: To record in writing; to make a memorandum of.
definitions.example: We noted his speech.
definitions.definitionCn: 以书面形式记录；做备忘录。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们记录了他的演讲。

definitions.definition: To denote; to designate.
definitions.example: The modular multiplicative inverse of x may be noted x-1.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示；指定。
definitions.exampleCn: x的模逆元可以记为x⁻¹。

definitions.definition: To annotate.
definitions.definitionCn: 作注释。

definitions.definition: To set down in musical characters.
definitions.definitionCn: 用音乐符号记录。

definitions.definition: To record on the back of (a bill, draft, etc.) a refusal of acceptance, as the ground of a protest, which is done officially by a notary.
definitions.definitionCn: 在（票据、汇票等）背面记录拒绝承兑，作为抗议的依据，由公证人正式执行。

definitions.definition: That which is needed or necessary; business; duty; work.
definitions.definitionCn: 所需或必要的事物；事务；职责；工作。

definitions.definition: The giving of milk by a cow or sow; the period following calving or farrowing during which a cow or sow is at her most useful (i.e. gives milk); the milk given by a cow or sow during such a period.
definitions.definitionCn: 母牛或母猪产奶；产犊或产仔后母牛或母猪最有用（即产奶）的时期；在此期间母牛或母猪所产的奶。

definitions.definition: A substance used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.
definitions.example: Aspirin is a drug that reduces pain, acts against inflammation and lowers body temperature.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于治疗疾病、缓解症状或为特定目的改变体内化学过程的物质。
definitions.exampleCn: 阿司匹林是一种能减轻疼痛、抗炎并降低体温的药物。

definitions.definition: A psychoactive substance, especially one which is illegal and addictive, ingested for recreational use, such as cocaine.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种精神活性物质，尤其是非法且易成瘾的，用于娱乐性摄入，如可卡因。

definitions.definition: Anything, such as a substance, emotion or action, to which one is addicted.
definitions.example: 2010, Kesha Rose Sebert (Ke$ha), with Pebe Sebert and Joshua Coleman (Ammo), Your Love is My Drug
definitions.definitionCn: 任何使人上瘾的东西，如物质、情绪或行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 2010年，凯莎·罗斯·塞伯特（Ke$ha）与佩贝·塞伯特和约书亚·科尔曼（Ammo）合作，《你的爱是我的毒药》

definitions.definition: Any commodity that lies on hand, or is not salable; an article of slow sale, or in no demand.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何滞销或无法出售的商品；销售缓慢或无人问津的物品。

definitions.definition: To administer intoxicating drugs to, generally without the recipient's knowledge or consent.
definitions.example: She suddenly felt strange, and only then realized she'd been drugged.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常未经接收者知情或同意而向其施用麻醉药物。
definitions.exampleCn: 她突然感到奇怪，这才意识到自己被下了药。

definitions.definition: To add intoxicating drugs to with the intention of drugging someone.
definitions.example: She suddenly felt strange. She realized her drink must have been drugged.
definitions.definitionCn: 为了使人昏迷而向其中添加麻醉药物。
definitions.exampleCn: 她突然感到奇怪，意识到自己的饮料一定被下了药。

definitions.definition: To prescribe or administer drugs or medicines.
definitions.definitionCn: 开药或施用药物。

definitions.definitionCn: 目录，书中章节列表及其起始页码。
definitions.exampleCn: 我读书时总是先看护封和目录，再深入阅读内容本身。

definitions.definition: To be a sponsor for.
definitions.definitionCn: 赞助。

definitions.definition: One who makes prints.
definitions.definitionCn: 印刷工。

definitions.definition: The operator of a printing press, or the owner of a printing business.
definitions.definitionCn: 印刷机操作者，或印刷企业主。

definitions.definition: A device, usually attached to a computer, used to print text or images onto paper; an analogous device capable of producing three-dimensional objects.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种通常连接计算机的设备，用于将文本或图像打印到纸上；能够制造三维物体的类似设备。

definitions.definition: Short in length of time from the present.
definitions.example: I need the soonest date you have available.
definitions.definitionCn: 从当前算起时间短。
definitions.exampleCn: 我需要你提供最早的可用日期。

definitions.definition: Early
definitions.definitionCn: 早。

definitions.definition: Immediately, instantly.
definitions.definitionCn: 立即，马上。

definitions.definition: Within a short time; quickly.
definitions.definitionCn: 短时间内；迅速。

definitions.definition: Early.
definitions.definitionCn: 早。

definitions.definition: Readily; willingly; used with would, or some other word expressing will.
definitions.definitionCn: 乐意地；情愿地；与would或其他表达意愿的词连用。

definitions.definition: To have an absolute requirement for.
definitions.example: Living things need water to survive.
definitions.definitionCn: 绝对需要。
definitions.exampleCn: 生物需要水才能生存。

definitions.definition: To want strongly; to feel that one must have something.
definitions.example: After ten days of hiking, I needed a shower and a shave.
definitions.definitionCn: 强烈渴望；感觉必须拥有某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 徒步十天后，我需要洗个澡、刮个胡子。

definitions.definition: (modal verb) To be obliged or required (to do something).
definitions.example: You need not go if you don't want to.
definitions.definitionCn: （情态动词）必须或需要（做某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你不想去，就不必去。

definitions.definition: To be required; to be necessary.
definitions.definitionCn: 被要求；是必要的。

definitions.definition: To be necessary (to someone).
definitions.definitionCn: （对某人）是必要的。

definitions.definition: Necessary; being required.
definitions.example: A much-needed rest.
definitions.definitionCn: 必需的；被要求的。
definitions.exampleCn: 急需的休息。

definitions.definition: An advantage; help or aid from something.
definitions.example: It was for her benefit.   His benefit was free beer.
definitions.definitionCn: 优势；来自某物的帮助或援助。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是为了她的利益。他的福利是免费啤酒。

definitions.definition: A payment made in accordance with an insurance policy or a public assistance scheme.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据保险单或公共援助计划支付的款项。

definitions.definition: An event such as a performance, given to raise funds for some cause.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某项事业筹集资金而举办的活动，如演出。

definitions.definition: Beneficence; liberality
definitions.definitionCn: 善行；慷慨。

definitions.definition: To be or to provide a benefit to.
definitions.definitionCn: 对……有益或提供益处。

definitions.definition: To receive a benefit (from); to be a beneficiary.
definitions.definitionCn: （从……）受益；成为受益人。

definitions.definition: To grasp or grip.
definitions.example: Hold the pencil like this.
definitions.definitionCn: 握住或抓牢。
definitions.exampleCn: 像这样握笔。

definitions.definition: To contain or store.
definitions.example: This package holds six bottles.
definitions.definitionCn: 容纳或储存。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个包装盒能装六瓶。

definitions.definition: (heading) To maintain or keep to a position or state.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）维持或保持某一位置或状态。

definitions.definition: (heading) To maintain or keep to particular opinions, promises, actions.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）坚持特定的观点、承诺或行动。

definitions.definition: To win one's own service game.
definitions.definitionCn: 赢得自己的发球局。

definitions.definition: To take place, to occur.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生，进行。

definitions.definition: To organise an event or meeting (usually in passive voice).
definitions.example: Elections will be held on the first Sunday of next month.
definitions.definitionCn: 组织活动或会议（通常用被动语态）。
definitions.exampleCn: 选举将于下个月第一个星期日举行。

definitions.definition: To derive right or title.
definitions.definitionCn: 获得权利或所有权。

definitions.definition: In a food or drink order at an informal restaurant etc., requesting that a component normally included in that order be omitted.
definitions.example: A martini, please, and hold the olive.
definitions.definitionCn: 在非正式餐厅点餐时，要求省略通常包含的某种配料。
definitions.exampleCn: 请来杯马提尼，不要橄榄。

definitions.definition: To be in possession of illicit drugs for sale.
definitions.definitionCn: 持有待售的违禁药物。

definitions.definition: A drawing showing technical details of a building, machine, etc., with unwanted details omitted, and often using symbols rather than detailed drawing to represent doors, valves, etc.
definitions.example: The plans for many important buildings were once publicly available.
definitions.definitionCn: 展示建筑、机器等技术细节的图纸，省略不必要的细节，常使用符号而非详细绘图来表示门、阀门等。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多重要建筑的图纸曾一度公开。

definitions.definition: A set of intended actions, usually mutually related, through which one expects to achieve a goal.
definitions.example: He didn't really have a plan; he had a goal and a habit of control.
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列预期的行动，通常相互关联，通过它们期望实现某个目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 他其实没有计划；他只有一个目标和控制习惯。

definitions.definition: A two-dimensional drawing of a building as seen from above with obscuring or irrelevant details such as roof removed, or of a floor of a building, revealing the internal layout; as distinct from the elevation.
definitions.example: Seen in plan, the building had numerous passageways not apparent to visitors.
definitions.definitionCn: 从上方俯视建筑的二维图纸，移除屋顶等遮挡或无关细节，或展示建筑某一楼层，揭示内部布局；与立面图不同。
definitions.exampleCn: 从平面图看，该建筑有许多游客不易察觉的通道。

definitions.definition: A method; a way of procedure; a custom.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种方法；一种程序方式；一种惯例。

definitions.definition: A subscription to a service.
definitions.example: a phone plan
definitions.definitionCn: 对某项服务的订阅。
definitions.exampleCn: 手机套餐。

definitions.definition: To design (a building, machine, etc.).
definitions.example: The architect planned the building for the client.
definitions.definitionCn: 设计（建筑、机器等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 建筑师为客户设计了这座建筑。

definitions.definition: To create a plan for.
definitions.example: They jointly planned the project in phases, with good detail for the first month.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……制定计划。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们共同分阶段规划了项目，第一个月细节详尽。

definitions.definition: To intend.
definitions.example: He planned to go, but work intervened.
definitions.definitionCn: 打算。
definitions.exampleCn: 他本打算去，但工作打断了。

definitions.definition: To make a plan.
definitions.example: They planned for the worst, bringing lots of emergency supplies.
definitions.definitionCn: 制定计划。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们做了最坏的打算，带了许多应急物资。

definitions.definition: A grouping based on shared characteristics; a class.
definitions.example: This type of plane can handle rough weather more easily than that type of plane.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于共同特征的分组；一个类别。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种类型的飞机比那种类型的飞机更能轻松应对恶劣天气。

definitions.definition: An individual considered typical of its class, one regarded as typifying a certain profession, environment, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为其类别典型个体的某人，被认为代表某种职业、环境等的人。

definitions.definition: An individual that represents the ideal for its class; an embodiment.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表其类别理想的个体；化身。

definitions.definition: A letter or character used for printing, historically a cast or engraved block.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于印刷的字母或字符，历史上为铸造或雕刻的印版。

definitions.definition: Something, often a specimen, selected as an objective anchor to connect a scientific name to a taxon; this need not be representative or typical.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为客观锚点将科学名称与分类单元联系起来的某物（常为标本）；这不一定具有代表性或典型性。

definitions.definition: Preferred sort of person; sort of person that one is attracted to.
definitions.example: He was exactly her type.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏好类型的人；吸引某人的那种人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正是她喜欢的类型。

definitions.definition: A blood group.
definitions.definitionCn: 血型。

definitions.definition: (corpus linguistics) A word that occurs in a text or corpus irrespective of how many times it occurs, as opposed to a token.
definitions.definitionCn: （语料库语言学）文本或语料库中出现的词，无论出现多少次，与词例相对。

definitions.definition: An event or person that prefigures or foreshadows a later event - commonly an Old Testament event linked to Christian times.
definitions.definitionCn: 预示或预兆后续事件的事件或人物——通常指与基督教时代相关的旧约事件。

definitions.definition: A tag attached to variables and values used in determining which kinds of value can be used in which situations; a data type.
definitions.definitionCn: 附加在变量和值上的标签，用于确定哪些类型的值可在哪些情境中使用；数据类型。

definitions.definition: The original object, or class of objects, scene, face, or conception, which becomes the subject of a copy; especially, the design on the face of a medal or a coin.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为复制对象的原始物体、物体类别、场景、面孔或概念；尤指奖章或硬币正面的设计。

definitions.definition: A simple compound, used as a mode or pattern to which other compounds are conveniently regarded as being related, and from which they may be actually or theoretically derived.
definitions.example: The fundamental types used to express the simplest and most essential chemical relations are hydrochloric acid, water, ammonia, and methane.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作模式或样式的简单化合物，其他化合物可方便地视为与其相关，并可能实际或理论上由其衍生。
definitions.exampleCn: 用于表达最简单、最本质化学关系的基本类型是盐酸、水、氨和甲烷。

definitions.definition: A part of the partition of the object domain of a logical theory (which due to the existence of such partition, would be called a typed theory). (Note: this corresponds to the notion of "data type" in computing theory.)
definitions.example: Categorial grammar is like a combination of context-free grammar and types.
definitions.definitionCn: 逻辑理论对象域划分的一部分（由于这种划分的存在，该理论称为类型化理论）。（注：这对应计算理论中的“数据类型”概念。）
definitions.exampleCn: 范畴语法类似于上下文无关语法与类型的结合。

definitions.definition: To put text on paper using a typewriter.
definitions.definitionCn: 用打字机将文本印在纸上。

definitions.definition: To enter text or commands into a computer using a keyboard.
definitions.definitionCn: 用键盘将文本或命令输入计算机。

definitions.definition: To determine the blood type of.
definitions.example: The doctor ordered the lab to type the patient for a blood transfusion.
definitions.definitionCn: 测定血型。
definitions.exampleCn: 医生命令实验室为患者输血前测定血型。

definitions.definition: To represent by a type, model, or symbol beforehand; to prefigure.
definitions.definitionCn: 事先用类型、模型或符号表示；预示。

definitions.definition: To furnish an expression or copy of; to represent; to typify.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供表达或复制；代表；象征。

definitions.definition: To categorize into types.
definitions.definitionCn: 按类型分类。

definitions.definition: A path through two or more points (compare ‘segment’); a continuous mark, including as made by a pen; any path, curved or straight.
definitions.example: The arrow descended in a curved line.
definitions.definitionCn: 经过两个或多个点的路径（对比“线段”）；连续的痕迹，包括用笔画的；任何弯曲或笔直的路径。
definitions.exampleCn: 箭头沿曲线下降。

definitions.definition: A rope, cord, string, or thread, of any thickness.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何粗细的绳索、线、细绳或线。

definitions.definition: A hose or pipe, of any size.
definitions.example: a brake line
definitions.definitionCn: 任何尺寸的软管或管道。
definitions.exampleCn: 刹车管。

definitions.definition: Direction, path.
definitions.example: the line of sight
definitions.definitionCn: 方向，路径。
definitions.exampleCn: 视线。

definitions.definition: The wire connecting one telegraphic station with another, a telephone or internet cable between two points: a telephone or network connection.
definitions.example: I tried to make a call, but the line was dead.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接两个电报站的电线，两点间的电话或网络电缆：电话或网络连接。
definitions.exampleCn: 我试着打电话，但线路不通。

definitions.definition: A clothesline.
definitions.definitionCn: 晾衣绳。

definitions.definition: A letter, a written form of communication.
definitions.example: Drop me a line.
definitions.definitionCn: 信件，书面交流形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 给我写封信。

definitions.definition: A connected series of public conveyances, as a roadbed or railway track; and hence, an established arrangement for forwarding merchandise, etc.
definitions.example: a line of stages
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列公共交通工具的连接，如路基或铁路轨道；因此，用于转运货物的既定安排。
definitions.exampleCn: 驿马车的线路。

definitions.definition: A trench or rampart, or the non-physical demarcation of the extent of the territory occupied by specified forces.
definitions.definitionCn: 战壕或壁垒，或特定部队占领区域范围的非物理分界线。

definitions.definition: The exterior limit of a figure or territory: a boundary, contour, or outline; a demarcation.
definitions.definitionCn: 图形或领土的外部界限：边界、轮廓或外形；分界线。

definitions.definition: A long tape or ribbon marked with units for measuring; a tape measure.
definitions.definitionCn: 标有测量单位的长带或带子；卷尺。

definitions.definition: A measuring line or cord.
definitions.definitionCn: 测量线或绳。

definitions.definition: That which was measured by a line, such as a field or any piece of land set apart; hence, allotted place of abode.
definitions.definitionCn: 用线测量的东西，如田地或任何划分的土地；因此，分配居住地。

definitions.definition: A threadlike crease or wrinkle marking the face, hand, or body; hence, a characteristic mark.
definitions.definitionCn: 面部、手或身体上的线状皱纹或褶皱；因此，特征性标记。

definitions.definition: Lineament; feature; figure (of one's body).
definitions.definitionCn: 轮廓；特征；体型。

definitions.definition: A more-or-less straight sequence of people, objects, etc., either arranged as a queue or column and often waiting to be processed or dealt with, or arranged abreast of one another in a row (and contrasted with a column), as in a military formation.
definitions.example: The line forms on the right.
definitions.definitionCn: 大致直线排列的人、物体等，要么排成队列或纵队等待处理，要么排成横排（与纵队相对），如军事编队。
definitions.exampleCn: 队伍在右边排好。

definitions.definition: The regular infantry of an army, as distinguished from militia, guards, volunteer corps, cavalry, artillery etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 正规步兵，区别于民兵、卫队、志愿军、骑兵、炮兵等。

definitions.definition: A series or succession of ancestors or descendants of a given person; a family or race; compare lineage.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的祖先或后代系列；家族或种族；对比“血统”。

definitions.definition: A small amount of text. Specifically:
definitions.definitionCn: 少量文本。具体指：

definitions.definition: Course of conduct, thought, occupation, or policy; method of argument; department of industry, trade, or intellectual activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 行为、思想、职业或政策的路线；论证方法；工业、贸易或智力活动的部门。

definitions.definition: The official, stated position (or set of positions) of an individual or group, particularly a political or religious faction.
definitions.example: Remember, your answers must match the party line.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人或团体（尤其是政治或宗教派别）的官方既定立场（或一系列立场）。
definitions.exampleCn: 记住，你的回答必须符合党的路线。

definitions.definition: A set of products or services sold by a business, or by extension, the business itself.
definitions.example: How many buses does the line have?
definitions.definitionCn: 企业销售的一系列产品或服务，或延伸指企业本身。
definitions.exampleCn: 这条线路有多少辆公交车？

definitions.definition: A number of shares taken by a jobber.
definitions.definitionCn: 股票经纪人持有的股份数量。

definitions.definition: A measure of length:
definitions.definitionCn: 长度单位：

definitions.definition: A maxwell, a unit of magnetic flux.
definitions.definitionCn: 麦克斯韦，磁通量单位。

definitions.definition: (1800s, with "the") The batter’s box.
definitions.definitionCn: （19世纪，与“the”连用）击球区。

definitions.definition: The position in which the fencers hold their swords.
definitions.definitionCn: 击剑手持剑的位置。

definitions.definition: Proper relative position or adjustment (of parts, not as to design or proportion, but with reference to smooth working).
definitions.example: the engine is in line / out of line
definitions.definitionCn: （部件）适当的相对位置或调整（不是指设计或比例，而是指平稳运行）。
definitions.exampleCn: 发动机运转正常/不正常。

definitions.definition: A small path-shaped portion or serving of a powdery illegal drug, especially cocaine.
definitions.definitionCn: 小路径形状的粉末状非法药物（尤其是可卡因）的一份。

definitions.definition: Instruction; doctrine.
definitions.definitionCn: 教导；教义。

definitions.definition: Population of cells derived from a single cell and containing the same genetic makeup.
definitions.definitionCn: 源自单个细胞且具有相同基因组成的细胞群。

definitions.definition: (perfusion line) a set composed of a spike, a drip chamber, a clamp, a Y-injection site, a three-way stopcock and a catheter.
definitions.definitionCn: （灌注线）由插管、滴注室、夹子、Y型注射口、三通旋塞和导管组成的套件。

definitions.definition: A group of forwards that play together.
definitions.definitionCn: 一起比赛的前锋组。

definitions.definition: A vascular catheter.
definitions.example: line sepsis
definitions.definitionCn: 血管导管。
definitions.exampleCn: 线败血症。

definitions.definition: To place (objects) into a line (usually used with "up"); to form into a line; to align.
definitions.example: to line troops
definitions.definitionCn: 将（物体）排成一条线（通常与“up”连用）；形成一条线；对齐。
definitions.exampleCn: 整队士兵。

definitions.definition: To place persons or things along the side of for security or defense; to strengthen by adding; to fortify.
definitions.example: to line works with soldiers
definitions.definitionCn: 为安全或防御而沿边放置人员或物品；通过添加来加强；加固。
definitions.exampleCn: 用士兵加强工事。

definitions.definition: To form a line along.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿……形成一条线。

definitions.definition: To mark with a line or lines, to cover with lines.
definitions.example: to line a copy book
definitions.definitionCn: 用线或线条标记，覆盖线条。
definitions.exampleCn: 在抄写本上划线。

definitions.definition: To represent by lines; to delineate; to portray.
definitions.definitionCn: 用线条表示；描绘；刻画。

definitions.definition: To read or repeat line by line.
definitions.example: to line out a hymn
definitions.definitionCn: 逐行阅读或重复。
definitions.exampleCn: 唱出赞美诗。

definitions.definition: To hit a line drive; to hit a line drive which is caught for an out. Compare fly and ground.
definitions.example: Jones lined to left in his last at-bat.
definitions.definitionCn: 击出平直球；击出被接杀出局的平直球。对比“高飞球”和“地滚球”。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯在最后一次击球中向左击出平直球。

definitions.definition: To track (wild bees) to their nest by following their line of flight.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过跟踪飞行路线追踪（野生蜜蜂）到它们的巢穴。

definitions.definition: To measure.
definitions.definitionCn: 测量。

definitions.definition: To cover the inner surface of (something), originally especially with linen.
definitions.example: The bird lines its nest with soft grass.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖（某物）的内表面，最初尤指用亚麻布。
definitions.exampleCn: 鸟用软草铺垫巢穴。

definitions.definition: To reinforce (the back of a book) with glue and glued scrap material such as fabric or paper.
definitions.definitionCn: 用胶水和胶粘的废弃材料（如织物或纸张）加固（书的书脊）。

definitions.definition: To fill or supply (something), as a purse with money.
definitions.example: to line the shelves
definitions.definitionCn: 填充或供应（某物），如用钱装满钱包。
definitions.exampleCn: 装满书架。

definitions.definition: (of a dog) To copulate with, to impregnate.
definitions.definitionCn: （指狗）交配，使受孕。

definitions.definition: Words spoken by the actors.
definitions.example: I have yet to learn my lines.
definitions.definitionCn: 演员说的台词。
definitions.exampleCn: 我还没学会我的台词。

definitions.definition: (fortifications) Dispositions made to cover extended positions, and presenting a front in but one direction to an enemy.
definitions.definitionCn: （防御工事）为覆盖广阔阵地而做的部署，只向一个方向面对敌人。

definitions.definition: Form of a vessel as shown by the outlines of vertical, horizontal, and oblique sections.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过垂直、水平和斜向截面的轮廓显示的船体形状。

definitions.definition: A school punishment in which a student must repeatedly write out a line of text related to the offence (e.g. "I must be quiet in class") a specified number of times; the lines of text so written out.
definitions.example: I had to write out 200 lines
definitions.definitionCn: 学校惩罚，学生必须重复写出与过错相关的文本行（如“我必须在课堂上保持安静”）指定次数；这样写出的文本行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不得不写200行。

definitions.definition: The reins with which a horse is guided by its driver.
definitions.definitionCn: 驾驶员用来引导马匹的缰绳。

definitions.definition: Twice the number, amount, size, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 两倍的数量、金额、尺寸等。

definitions.definition: A person who resembles and stands in for another person, often for safety purposes
definitions.example: Saddam Hussein was rumored to have many doubles.
definitions.definitionCn: 代替他人且与之相似的人，常出于安全目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 据传萨达姆·侯赛因有许多替身。

definitions.definition: A drink with two portions of alcohol.
definitions.example: On second thought, make that a double.
definitions.definitionCn: 含有双份酒精的饮料。
definitions.exampleCn: 再想想，还是来双份吧。

definitions.definition: A ghostly apparition of a living person; doppelgänger.
definitions.definitionCn: 活人的幽灵幻影；二重身。

definitions.definition: A sharp turn, especially a return on one's own tracks.
definitions.definitionCn: 急转弯，尤指折返原路。

definitions.definition: A redundant item for which an identical item already exists.
definitions.example: Before printing the photos, Liam deleted the doubles.
definitions.definitionCn: 已存在相同物品的多余物件。
definitions.exampleCn: 打印照片前，利亚姆删除了重复项。

definitions.definition: A two-base hit.
definitions.example: The catcher hit a double to lead off the ninth.
definitions.definitionCn: 二垒安打。
definitions.exampleCn: 捕手在第九局率先击出二垒安打。

definitions.definition: A call that increases certain scoring points if the last preceding bid becomes the contract.
definitions.definitionCn: 若上一叫牌成为定约则增加特定得分的叫牌。

definitions.definition: A strike in which the object ball is struck so as to make it rebound against the cushion to an opposite pocket.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种击球方式，使目标球撞击 cushion 后反弹至对面袋口。

definitions.definition: A bet on two horses in different races in which any winnings from the first race are placed on the horse in the later race.
definitions.definitionCn: 在不同赛马中下注两匹马，第一场赢得的奖金全部押在后续赛马上。

definitions.definition: The narrow outermost ring on a dartboard.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞镖盘最窄的外圈。

definitions.definition: A hit on this ring.
definitions.definitionCn: 击中此环的得分。

definitions.definition: A tile that has the same value (i.e., the same number of pips) on both sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 两面点数相同的牌（即相同点数）。

definitions.definition: A double-precision floating-point number.
definitions.definitionCn: 双精度浮点数。

definitions.definition: Two competitions, usually one league and one cup, won by the same team in a single season.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一赛季由同一队伍赢得的两个赛事，通常为一个联赛和一个杯赛。

definitions.definition: A boat for two scullers.
definitions.definitionCn: 双人双桨赛艇。

definitions.definition: The feat of scoring twice in one game.
definitions.definitionCn: 单场比赛中两次得分的壮举。

definitions.definition: (chiefly swimming and track) The feat of winning two events in a single meet or competition.
definitions.example: In 1996, Michael Johnson achieved a double by winning both the 200 and 400 meter dashes.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要为游泳和田径）在同一赛事中赢得两个项目的成就。
definitions.exampleCn: 1996年，迈克尔·约翰逊赢得200米和400米短跑双料冠军。

definitions.definition: A former French coin worth one-sixth of a sou.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种旧法国硬币，价值六分之一苏。

definitions.definition: (Guernsey) A copper coin worth one-eighth of a penny.
definitions.definitionCn: （根西岛）一种铜币，价值八分之一便士。

definitions.definition: Playing the same part on two instruments, alternately.
definitions.definitionCn: 交替在两件乐器上演奏同一部分。

definitions.definition: A double feast.
definitions.definitionCn: 双重盛宴。

definitions.definition: To multiply by two.
definitions.example: The company doubled their earnings per share over last quarter.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘以二。
definitions.exampleCn: 公司每股收益较上季度翻倍。

definitions.definition: To fold over so as to make two folds.
definitions.example: To make a pleat, double the material at the waist.
definitions.definitionCn: 折叠使形成两层。
definitions.exampleCn: 打褶时，将腰部布料对折。

definitions.definition: To be the double of; to exceed by twofold; to contain or be worth twice as much as.
definitions.definitionCn: 是……的两倍；超过两倍；包含或价值两倍于。

definitions.definition: To increase by 100%, to become twice as large in size.
definitions.example: Our earnings have doubled in the last year.
definitions.definitionCn: 增加100%，尺寸变为两倍大。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们去年收益翻倍。

definitions.definition: To get a two-base hit.

definitions.definitionCn: 击出二垒安打。
definitions.exampleCn: 击球员将球击向角落形成二垒安打。

definitions.definition: (sometimes followed by up) To clench (a fist).
definitions.definitionCn: （有时后接 up）握紧（拳头）。

definitions.definition: (often followed by together or up) To join or couple.
definitions.definitionCn: （常后接 together 或 up）连接或结合。

definitions.definition: To repeat exactly; copy.
definitions.definitionCn: 精确重复；复制。

definitions.definition: (often followed by as) To play a second part or serve a second role.
definitions.example: A spork is a kind of fork that doubles as a spoon.
definitions.definitionCn: （常后接 as）扮演第二个角色或起第二个作用。
definitions.exampleCn: 叉勺是一种兼作勺子的叉子。

definitions.definition: To turn sharply, following a winding course.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿蜿蜒路线急转弯。

definitions.definition: To sail around (a headland or other point).
definitions.definitionCn: 绕行（海岬或其他地点）。

definitions.definition: To duplicate (a part) either in unison or at the octave above or below it.
definitions.definitionCn: 以同度或高/低八度重复（某声部）。

definitions.definition: (usually followed by "on") To be capable of performing (upon an additional instrument).
definitions.definitionCn: （通常后接 "on"）能够演奏（额外乐器）。

definitions.definition: To make a call that will double certain scoring points if the preceding bid becomes the contract.

definitions.definition: To double down.

definitions.definition: To cause (a ball) to rebound from a cushion before entering the pocket.

definitions.definition: (followed by for) To act as substitute.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接 for）担任替补。

definitions.definition: To go or march at twice the normal speed.

definitions.definition: To multiply the strength or effect of by two.

definitions.definition: To unite, as ranks or files, so as to form one from each two.

definitions.example: Could you please repeat your last transmission? Another station was doubling with you.
definitions.definitionCn: （电台）无意或故意在同一频道与其他电台同时发射，造成干扰。
definitions.exampleCn: 请重复您上次的传输？另一电台与您同时发射。

definitions.definition: Made up of two matching or complementary elements.
definitions.example: The closet has double doors.
definitions.definitionCn: 由两个匹配或互补元素组成。
definitions.exampleCn: 壁橱有双开门。

definitions.definition: Of twice the quantity.
definitions.example: Give me a double serving of mashed potatoes.
definitions.definitionCn: 两倍的数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 给我双份土豆泥。

definitions.definition: Of a family relationship, related on both the maternal and paternal sides of a family.
definitions.example: He's my double cousin as my mother's sister married my father's brother.
definitions.definitionCn: 家族关系上，同时来自父母双方亲属的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是我双重表亲，因为我母亲的姐姐嫁给了我父亲的兄弟。

definitions.definition: Designed for two users.

definitions.definitionCn: 为双人设计。
definitions.exampleCn: 双人房。

definitions.definition: Folded in two; composed of two layers.
definitions.definitionCn: 折叠成两层；由两层构成。

definitions.definition: Stooping; bent over.
definitions.definitionCn: 弯腰的；弯曲的。

definitions.definition: Having two aspects; ambiguous.
definitions.example: a double meaning
definitions.definitionCn: 具有两面性；模棱两可的。
definitions.exampleCn: 双重含义。

definitions.definition: False, deceitful, or hypocritical.
definitions.example: a double life
definitions.definitionCn: 虚假、欺骗或虚伪的。
definitions.exampleCn: 双重生活。

definitions.definition: Of flowers, having more than the normal number of petals.

definitions.definition: Of an instrument, sounding an octave lower.

definitions.definition: Of time, twice as fast.
definitions.definitionCn: （节拍）两倍快的。

definitions.definition: Twice over; twofold; doubly.
definitions.definitionCn: 双倍地；双重地。

definitions.definition: Two together; two at a time. (especially in see double)
definitions.example: There are only a few beds, so some of the children will have to sleep double for the night.
definitions.definitionCn: 两人一起；一次两个。（尤用于“看东西重影”）
definitions.exampleCn: 只有几张床，所以有些孩子今晚得两人挤一张床。

definitions.definition: The double time, a marching cadence (pace) approaching running speed.
definitions.definitionCn: 双倍时间，接近跑步速度的行进节奏。

definitions.definition: A public building or room for entertainment, especially gambling.
definitions.definitionCn: 公共建筑或娱乐场所，尤指赌博场所。

definitions.definition: A card game for two to four players.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种供二至四人玩的纸牌游戏。

definitions.definition: Portable Document Format
definitions.definitionCn: 便携式文档格式

definitions.definition: Any function whose integral over a set gives the probability that a random variable has a value in that set
definitions.definitionCn: 任何函数，其在一个集合上的积分给出随机变量取值在该集合内的概率

definitions.definition: A soldier fit for duty
definitions.definitionCn: 适合服役的士兵

definitions.definition: Having the power to produce a required effect or effects.
definitions.example: The pill is an effective method of birth control.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有产生所需效果的能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种药丸是一种有效的避孕方法。

definitions.definition: Producing a decided or decisive effect.
definitions.example: The president delivered an effective speech!
definitions.definitionCn: 产生明确或决定性效果的。
definitions.exampleCn: 总统发表了一场有力的演讲！

definitions.definition: Efficient, serviceable, or operative, available for useful work.
definitions.example: How long does it take to make a bunch of civilians an effective military force?
definitions.definitionCn: 高效、实用或可操作，可用于有用工作。
definitions.exampleCn: 将一群平民变成有效的军事力量需要多长时间？

definitions.definition: Actually in effect.
definitions.example: The curfew is effective at midnight.
definitions.definitionCn: 实际上已生效。
definitions.exampleCn: 宵禁在午夜生效。

definitions.definition: (of a cycle or divisor) Having no negative coefficients.
definitions.definitionCn: （指循环或除数）没有负系数。

definitions.definition: (for any effective theory) approximate; Not describing the fundamental dynamic changes in some system as they happen.
definitions.definitionCn: （对任何有效理论而言）近似的；不描述某些系统发生时的基本动态变化。

definitions.definition: Any period of seven consecutive days.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何连续七天的时段。

definitions.definition: A period of seven days beginning with Sunday or Monday.
definitions.definitionCn: 从星期日或星期一开始的七天时段。

definitions.definition: A period of five days beginning with Monday.
definitions.definitionCn: 从星期一开始的五天时段。

definitions.definition: A subdivision of the month into longer periods of work days punctuated by shorter weekend periods of days for markets, rest, or religious observation such as a sabbath.
definitions.example: A 4-day week consists of Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
definitions.definitionCn: 将一个月划分为较长的工作日时段，中间穿插较短的周末时段，用于市场、休息或宗教活动如安息日。
definitions.exampleCn: 四天工作周包括星期一、星期二、星期三和星期四。

definitions.definition: Seven days after (sometimes before) a specified date.
definitions.example: I'll see you Thursday week.
definitions.definitionCn: 指定日期之后（有时之前）的七天。
definitions.exampleCn: 我将在下周四见你。

definitions.definition: The act of adding anything.
definitions.example: The addition of five more items to the agenda will make the meeting unbearably long.
definitions.definitionCn: 添加任何事物的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 在议程上再增加五项内容将使会议变得难以忍受地冗长。

definitions.definition: Anything that is added.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何被添加的事物。

definitions.definition: The arithmetic operation of adding.
definitions.definitionCn: 加法的算术运算。

definitions.definition: A dot at the right side of a note as an indication that its sound is to be lengthened one half.
definitions.definitionCn: 音符右侧的一个点，表示其音长需延长一半。

definitions.definition: A title annexed to a person's name to identify him or her more precisely, as in "John Doe, Esq.", "Robert Dale, Mason", "Thomas Way, of New York".
definitions.definitionCn: 附在人名后的头衔，用以更精确地标识其身份，如“约翰·多伊，先生”、“罗伯特·戴尔，石匠”、“托马斯·韦，纽约人”。

definitions.definition: Something added to a coat of arms, as a mark of honour; opposed to abatement.
definitions.definitionCn: 加在盾徽上的标记，作为荣誉标志；与“减损”相对。

definitions.definition: To request (information, or an answer to a question).

definitions.definitionCn: 请求（信息或问题的答案）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我问了她的年龄。

definitions.definition: To put forward (a question) to be answered.
definitions.example: to ask a question
definitions.definitionCn: 提出（问题）要求回答。
definitions.exampleCn: 问一个问题

definitions.definition: To interrogate or enquire of (a person).
definitions.example: I'm going to ask this lady for directions.
definitions.definitionCn: 审问或询问（某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我打算向这位女士问路。

definitions.definition: To request or petition; usually with for.
definitions.example: to ask for a second helping at dinner
definitions.definitionCn: 请求或恳求；通常与for连用。

definitions.definition: To request permission to do something.
definitions.example: Did you ask to use the car?
definitions.definitionCn: 请求允许做某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 你问过能否用车吗？

definitions.definition: To require, demand, claim, or expect, whether by way of remuneration or return, or as a matter of necessity.
definitions.example: What price are you asking for the house?
definitions.definitionCn: 要求、索取、主张或期望，无论是作为报酬、回报，还是出于必要。
definitions.exampleCn: 这房子你要价多少？

definitions.definition: To invite.
definitions.example: Don't ask them to the wedding.
definitions.definitionCn: 邀请。
definitions.exampleCn: 别邀请他们参加婚礼。

definitions.definition: To publish in church for marriage; said of both the banns and the persons.
definitions.definitionCn: 在教堂发布结婚公告；既指结婚预告也指当事人。

definitions.definition: To take (a person's situation) as an example.
definitions.definitionCn: 以（某人的情况）为例。

definitions.definition: Used to indicate that the following event, period, or change in state occurred in the past, after a time of waiting, enduring, or anticipation
definitions.definitionCn: 用于表示以下事件、时期或状态变化发生在过去，经过一段等待、忍耐或期盼之后

definitions.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.

definitions.definitionCn: 从远处向近处移动

definitions.definition: To appear, to manifest itself.

definitions.definitionCn: 出现，显现

definitions.definition: (with an infinitive) To begin to have an opinion or feeling.

definitions.definitionCn: （后接不定式）开始持有某种观点或感受
definitions.exampleCn: 她逐渐把那个国家视为自己的家

definitions.definition: (with an infinitive) To do something by chance, without intending to do it.
definitions.example: Could you tell me how the document came to be discovered?
definitions.definitionCn: （后接不定式）偶然做某事，并非有意为之
definitions.exampleCn: 你能告诉我这份文件是如何被发现的吗？

definitions.definitionCn: 达到性高潮；射精

definitions.definitionCn: （与close连用）接近某种状态或成就

definitions.definition: (fossil word) To become, to turn out to be.

definitions.definition: To be supplied, or made available; to exist.

definitions.definitionCn: 被提供或可获得；存在
definitions.exampleCn: 一辆新跑车可不便宜

definitions.definition: To carry through; to succeed in.
definitions.example: You can't come any tricks here.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成；成功做到
definitions.exampleCn: 你在这里耍不了花招
