definitions.definition: To cause (somebody) to be unable to follow or trace one any longer.
definitions.example: We managed to lose our pursuers in the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）无法再跟随或追踪自己。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们设法在森林里甩掉了追踪者。

definitions.definition: To cease exhibiting; to overcome (a behavior or emotion).
definitions.definitionCn: 不再表现出；克服（某种行为或情绪）。

definitions.definition: To shed, remove, discard, or eliminate.
definitions.example: When we get into the building, please lose the hat.
definitions.definitionCn: 脱落、移除、丢弃或消除。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们进入大楼后，请脱掉帽子。

definitions.definition: Of a clock, to run slower than expected.
definitions.example: It's already 5:30? My watch must have lost a few minutes.
definitions.definitionCn: （指钟表）走得比预期慢。
definitions.exampleCn: 已经5:30了？我的表肯定慢了几分钟。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To cause (someone) the loss of something; to deprive of.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）使（某人）失去某物；剥夺。

definitions.definition: To fail to catch with the mind or senses; to miss.
definitions.example: I lost a part of what he said.
definitions.definitionCn: 未能用头脑或感官理解；错过。
definitions.exampleCn: 他说的有一部分我没听清。

definitions.definition: To cause to part with; to deprive of.
definitions.definitionCn: 使失去；剥夺。

definitions.definition: Having wandered from, or unable to find, the way.
definitions.example: The children were soon lost in the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 已经偏离或找不到路。
definitions.exampleCn: 孩子们很快在森林里迷路了。

definitions.definition: In an unknown location; unable to be found.
definitions.example: Deep beneath the ocean, the Titanic was lost to the world.
definitions.definitionCn: 在未知地点；无法找到。
definitions.exampleCn: 在深海之下，泰坦尼克号已从世人眼中消失。

definitions.definition: Not perceptible to the senses; no longer visible.
definitions.example: an island lost in a fog; a person lost in a crowd
definitions.definitionCn: 感官无法察觉；不再可见。
definitions.exampleCn: 雾中迷失的岛屿；人群中迷失的人

definitions.definition: Parted with; no longer held or possessed.
definitions.example: a lost limb; lost honour
definitions.definitionCn: 失去的；不再拥有或持有的。
definitions.exampleCn: 失去的肢体；失去的荣誉

definitions.definition: Not employed or enjoyed; thrown away; employed ineffectually; wasted; squandered.
definitions.example: a lost day; a lost opportunity or benefit
definitions.definitionCn: 未被使用或享受；被抛弃；无效使用；浪费；挥霍。
definitions.exampleCn: 虚度的一天；错失的机会或利益

definitions.definition: Ruined or destroyed, either physically or morally; past help or hope.
definitions.example: a ship lost at sea; a woman lost to virtue; a lost soul
definitions.definitionCn: （身体或道德上）毁灭或破坏；无可救药或希望。
definitions.exampleCn: 海上失事的船只；失去贞操的女人；迷失的灵魂

definitions.definition: Hardened beyond sensibility or recovery; alienated; insensible.
definitions.example: lost to shame; lost to all sense of honour
definitions.definitionCn: 变得麻木不仁或无法挽回；疏远；无感觉。
definitions.exampleCn: 不知羞耻；丧失所有荣誉感

definitions.definition: Occupied with, or under the influence of, something, so as not to notice external things.
definitions.example: to be lost in thought
definitions.definitionCn: 沉浸于某事或受其影响，以致未注意外界事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 陷入沉思

definitions.definition: Collectively, personal ornamentation such as rings, necklaces, brooches and bracelets, made of precious metals and sometimes set with gemstones.
definitions.example: She had more jewellery ornamented about her than any three ladies needed.
definitions.definitionCn: 集体而言，个人装饰品如戒指、项链、胸针和手镯，由贵金属制成，有时镶嵌宝石。她身上的珠宝装饰比任何三位女士所需的还要多。

definitions.definition: The former currency of Japan until 1870, before the yen.
definitions.definitionCn: 1870年之前，日元诞生前日本的旧货币。

definitions.definition: The badge or emblem a Japanese family, especially a family of the ancient feudal nobility; typically circular and consists of conventionalized forms from nature.
definitions.definitionCn: 日本家族，尤其是古代封建贵族家族的徽章或标志；通常呈圆形，由自然界的程式化形态构成。

definitions.definition: (used in the vocative) A colloquial means of address of man in places such as Jamaica and Shropshire in England.
A creature in a video game, usually one which is captured, trained up and used in battles.
A video game or anime in which catching and battling creatures is an important element.
The main or first page of a web site or set of hyperlinked documents.
definitions.definitionCn: 网站或超链接文档集合的主页或首页。

definitions.definition: The page set to open in a web browser or hypertext system when it starts up, or when its home function is invoked.
definitions.definitionCn: 在网页浏览器或超文本系统启动时，或调用其主页功能时默认打开的页面。

definitions.definition: To adorn or cover with clothing; to dress; to supply clothes or clothing.
definitions.example: to feed and clothe a family; to clothe oneself extravagantly
definitions.definitionCn: 用衣物装饰或覆盖；给……穿衣；提供衣物。
definitions.exampleCn: 供养一家人的衣食；奢侈地打扮自己。

definitions.definition: To cover or invest, as if with a garment.
definitions.example: to clothe somebody with authority or power
definitions.definitionCn: 像披上外衣一样覆盖或赋予。
definitions.exampleCn: 授予某人权力或权威。

definitions.definition: Any of a wide variety of articles, usually made of fabrics, animal hair, animal skin, or some combination thereof, used to cover the human body for warmth, to preserve modesty, or for fashion.
definitions.definitionCn: 种类繁多的物品，通常由织物、动物毛发、动物皮或它们的组合制成，用于覆盖人体以保暖、保持端庄或追求时尚。

definitions.definition: An act or instance of putting clothes on.
definitions.example: The clothing and unclothing of the idols was of special significance.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿衣服的行为或实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 给神像穿衣和脱衣具有特殊意义。

definitions.definition: The art or process of making cloth.
definitions.definitionCn: 织布的艺术或过程。

definitions.definition: A covering of non-conducting material on the outside of a boiler, or steam chamber, to prevent radiation of heat.
definitions.definitionCn: 锅炉或蒸汽室外部的非导热材料覆盖层，用于防止热量辐射。

definitions.definition: Any nounal word or phrase which indicates a particular person, place, class, or thing.
definitions.example: I've never liked the name my parents gave me so I changed it at the age of twenty.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何表示特定人物、地点、类别或事物的名词性词语或短语。
definitions.exampleCn: 我从未喜欢过父母给我取的名字，所以二十岁时改了名。

definitions.definition: Reputation.
definitions.definitionCn: 名声。

definitions.definition: An abusive or insulting epithet.
definitions.example: Stop calling me names!
definitions.definitionCn: 辱骂性或侮辱性的称呼。
definitions.exampleCn: 别再骂我了！

definitions.definition: A person (or legal person).
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人（或法人）。

definitions.definition: Those of a certain name; a race; a family.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定名称的一群人；种族；家族。

definitions.definition: A unique identifier, generally a string of characters.
definitions.definitionCn: 唯一标识符，通常是一串字符。

definitions.definition: An investor in Lloyds of London bearing unlimited liability.
definitions.definitionCn: 劳合社中承担无限责任的投资者。

definitions.definition: Authority.
definitions.example: Halt in the name of the law!
definitions.definitionCn: 权威。
definitions.exampleCn: 以法律的名义停下！

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To give a name to.

definitions.definitionCn: （及物动词）给……命名。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位名叫侯玉刚的访客表示，他不太担心气候变化和白水的融化。

definitions.definition: To mention, specify.
definitions.example: He named his demands.
definitions.definitionCn: 提及，具体说明。
definitions.exampleCn: 他提出了自己的要求。

definitions.definition: To identify as relevant or important

definitions.definitionCn: 识别为相关或重要。
definitions.exampleCn: 指出问题所在。

definitions.definition: To publicly implicate.
definitions.example: The painter was named as an accomplice.
definitions.definitionCn: 公开牵连。
definitions.exampleCn: 该画家被指认为同谋。

definitions.definition: To designate for a role.
definitions.example: My neighbor was named to the steering committee.
definitions.definitionCn: 指定担任某个角色。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的邻居被任命为指导委员会成员。

definitions.definition: (Westminster system politics) To initiate a process to temporarily remove a member of parliament who is breaking the rules of conduct.
definitions.definitionCn: （威斯敏斯特体系政治）启动程序，暂时驱逐违反行为准则的议员。

definitions.definition: Any of several types of true yam (Dioscorea) used in Caribbean Spanish cooking.
definitions.definitionCn: 加勒比西班牙语烹饪中使用的几种真薯蓣（Dioscorea）之一。

definitions.definition: A chief officer or administrator, especially one who can make significant decisions on their own authority.
definitions.definitionCn: 首席官员或管理者，尤指能自主做出重大决策者。

definitions.definition: The branch of government that is responsible for enforcing laws and judicial decisions, and for the day-to-day administration of the state.
definitions.definitionCn: 负责执行法律与司法判决、并承担国家日常行政管理的政府部门。

definitions.definition: A process that coordinates and governs the action of other processes or threads; supervisor.
definitions.definitionCn: 协调并管理其他进程或线程运作的进程；监管程序。

definitions.definition: Designed or fitted for execution, or carrying into effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 为执行或付诸实施而设计或配备的。

definitions.definition: Of, pertaining to, or having responsibility for the day-to-day running of an organisation, business, country, etc.
definitions.example: an executive officer
definitions.definitionCn: 对组织、企业、国家等日常运营负有责任的或与之相关的。
definitions.exampleCn: 执行官

definitions.definition: Exclusive.
definitions.example: an executive bathroom
definitions.definitionCn: 专属的。
definitions.exampleCn: 专用浴室

definitions.definition: To move swiftly.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动。

definitions.definition: (fluids) To flow.
definitions.definitionCn: （流体）流动。

definitions.definition: (of a vessel) To sail before the wind, in distinction from reaching or sailing close-hauled.
definitions.definitionCn: （船只）顺风航行，区别于横风或抢风行驶。

definitions.definition: To control or manage, be in charge of.
definitions.example: He is running the candidate's expensive campaign.
definitions.definitionCn: 控制或管理，负责。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正在为这位候选人管理昂贵的竞选活动。

definitions.definition: To be a candidate in an election.
definitions.example: I have decided to run for governor of California.
definitions.definitionCn: 在选举中成为候选人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已决定竞选加利福尼亚州州长。

definitions.definition: To make run in a race or an election.
definitions.example: He ran his best horse in the Derby.
definitions.definitionCn: 使参加赛跑或竞选。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在德比马赛中让最好的马参赛。

definitions.definition: To exert continuous activity; to proceed.
definitions.example: to run through life; to run in a circle
definitions.definitionCn: 持续活动；进行。
definitions.exampleCn: 度过一生；循环往复。

definitions.definition: To be presented in the media.
definitions.example: Her picture ran on the front page of the newspaper.
definitions.definitionCn: 在媒体上出现。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的照片登上了报纸头版。

definitions.definition: To print or broadcast in the media.
definitions.example: run a story; run an ad
definitions.definitionCn: 在媒体上印刷或播出。
definitions.exampleCn: 刊登报道；播放广告。

definitions.definition: To smuggle (illegal goods).
definitions.example: to run guns; to run rum
definitions.definitionCn: 走私（非法货物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 走私枪支；走私朗姆酒。

definitions.definition: To sort through a large volume of produce in quality control.
definitions.example: Looks like we're gonna have to run the tomatoes again.
definitions.definitionCn: 在质量控制中筛选大量产品。
definitions.exampleCn: 看来我们得再筛选一遍西红柿了。

definitions.definition: To extend or persist, statically or dynamically, through space or time.
definitions.definitionCn: 在空间或时间上静态或动态地延伸或持续。

definitions.definition: To execute or carry out a plan, procedure or program.
definitions.example: Don't run that software unless you have permission.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行或实施计划、程序或项目。
definitions.exampleCn: 未经许可不要运行那个软件。

definitions.definition: To pass or go quickly in thought or conversation.
definitions.example: to run from one subject to another
definitions.definitionCn: 在思想或谈话中快速掠过。
definitions.exampleCn: 从一个话题跳到另一个话题。

definitions.definition: To become different in a way mentioned (usually to become worse).
definitions.example: Our supplies are running low.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式变得不同（通常变差）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的补给快用完了。

definitions.definition: To cost a large amount of money.
definitions.example: Buying a new laptop will run you a thousand dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: 花费大量金钱。
definitions.exampleCn: 买一台新笔记本电脑要花你一千美元。

definitions.definition: Of stitches or stitched clothing, to unravel.
definitions.example: My stocking is running.
definitions.definitionCn: （针脚或缝制衣物）脱线。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的长袜在脱线。

definitions.definition: To pursue in thought; to carry in contemplation.
definitions.definitionCn: 在思考中追寻；在心中沉思。

definitions.definition: To cause to enter; to thrust.
definitions.example: to run a sword into or through the body; to run a nail into one's foot
definitions.definitionCn: 使进入；刺入。
definitions.exampleCn: 将剑刺入或穿过身体；钉子扎进某人的脚。

definitions.definition: To drive or force; to cause, or permit, to be driven.
definitions.definitionCn: 驱使或强迫；导致或允许被驱使。

definitions.definition: To cause to be drawn; to mark out; to indicate; to determine.
definitions.example: to run a line
definitions.definitionCn: 使被画出；标出；指示；确定。
definitions.exampleCn: 画一条线。

definitions.definition: To encounter or incur (a danger or risk).
definitions.example: to run the risk of losing one's life
definitions.definitionCn: 遭遇或招致（危险或风险）。
definitions.exampleCn: 冒生命危险。

definitions.definition: To put at hazard; to venture; to risk.
definitions.definitionCn: 使处于危险中；冒险；赌注。

definitions.definition: To tease with sarcasms and ridicule.
definitions.definitionCn: 用讽刺和嘲笑取笑。

definitions.definition: To sew (a seam) by passing the needle through material in a continuous line, generally taking a series of stitches on the needle at the same time.
definitions.definitionCn: 用针线连续穿过布料缝制（一条缝），通常同时将多针穿在针上。

definitions.definition: To control or have precedence in a card game.
definitions.example: Every three or four hands he would run the table.
definitions.definitionCn: 在纸牌游戏中控制或优先。
definitions.exampleCn: 每三四局他就会赢下整桌。

definitions.definition: To be in form thus, as a combination of words.
definitions.definitionCn: 以这种形式存在，如词语组合。

definitions.definition: To be popularly known; to be generally received.
definitions.definitionCn: 被大众所知；被普遍接受。

definitions.definition: To have growth or development.
definitions.example: Boys and girls run up rapidly.
definitions.definitionCn: 生长或发展。
definitions.exampleCn: 男孩女孩们长得很快。

definitions.definition: To tend, as to an effect or consequence; to incline.
definitions.definitionCn: 倾向于某种效果或结果；有倾向。

definitions.definition: To have a legal course; to be attached; to continue in force, effect, or operation; to follow; to go in company.
definitions.example: Certain covenants run with the land.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有法律程序；被附加；继续有效、生效或运作；跟随；伴随。
definitions.exampleCn: 某些契约随土地转移。

definitions.definition: To encounter or suffer (a particular, usually bad, fate or misfortune).
definitions.definitionCn: 遭遇或承受（特定的，通常是坏的命运或不幸）。

definitions.definition: To strike (the ball) in such a way as to cause it to run along the ground, as when approaching a hole.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球使其沿地面滚动，如接近球洞时。

definitions.definition: To speedrun.
definitions.definitionCn: 速通。

definitions.definition: The action of the verb to run.
definitions.example: His running of the business leaves something to be desired.
definitions.definitionCn: 动词“跑”的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 他经营业务的方式有待改进。

definitions.definition: The activity of running as a form of exercise, as a sport, or for any other reason
definitions.example: Running is good exercise.
definitions.definitionCn: 跑步作为一种锻炼、运动或其他原因的活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 跑步是很好的锻炼。

definitions.definition: That which runs or flows; the quantity of a liquid which flows in a certain time or during a certain operation.

definitions.definitionCn: 流动的东西；一定时间或操作中流出的液体量。

definitions.definition: The discharge from an ulcer or other sore.
definitions.definitionCn: 溃疡或其他疮口的分泌物。

definitions.definition: Moving or advancing at a run.
definitions.definitionCn: 以跑步方式移动或前进。

definitions.definition: Present, current.

definitions.definitionCn: 当前的，现时的。
definitions.exampleCn: 本月。

definitions.definition: Flowing; easy; cursive.
definitions.example: running handwriting
definitions.definitionCn: 流畅的；易写的；草书的。
definitions.exampleCn: 手写体。

definitions.definition: Continuous; ongoing; keeping along step by step.
definitions.example: a running explanation
definitions.definitionCn: 连续的；持续的；一步步保持。
definitions.exampleCn: 连续的解释。

definitions.definition: Having a continuous design or pattern.

definitions.definitionCn: 具有连续的设计或图案。
definitions.exampleCn: 连续砌合；连续装饰。

definitions.definition: Consecutive.
definitions.definitionCn: 连续的。

definitions.definition: Extending by a slender climbing or trailing stem.

definitions.definitionCn: 通过细长的攀爬或匍匐茎延伸。
definitions.exampleCn: 攀缘藤蔓。

definitions.definition: Discharging pus.
definitions.example: a running sore
definitions.definitionCn: 流脓的。
definitions.exampleCn: 流脓的疮口。

definitions.definition: (of a nose) Discharging snot or mucus.
definitions.example: a running nose
definitions.definitionCn: （鼻子）流鼻涕或黏液。
definitions.exampleCn: 流鼻涕的鼻子。

definitions.definition: Consecutively; in a row

definitions.definitionCn: 连续地；接连地。

definitions.definition: Approaching; about; roughly.

definitions.definitionCn: 在（某重要事情）之前。

A preparty.

definitions.definition: To remain (behind); to stay.

definitions.definitionCn: 出现，显现。
definitions.exampleCn: 他腿上的疼痛时有时无。

definitions.definition: (with an infinitive) To begin to have an opinion or feeling.
definitions.example: She came to think of that country as her home.
definitions.definitionCn: （与不定式连用）开始持有某种观点或感觉。
definitions.exampleCn: 她开始把那个国家当作自己的家。

definitions.definition: (with an infinitive) To do something by chance, without intending to do it.
definitions.example: Could you tell me how the document came to be discovered?
definitions.definitionCn: （与不定式连用）偶然做某事，并非有意为之。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能告诉我这份文件是如何被发现的吗？

definitions.definition: To take a position relative to something else in a sequence.
definitions.example: Which letter comes before Y?   Winter comes after autumn.
definitions.definitionCn: 在序列中相对于其他事物占据某个位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 哪个字母在Y之前？冬天在秋天之后。

definitions.definition: To achieve orgasm; to cum; to ejaculate.
definitions.example: He came after a few minutes.
definitions.definitionCn: 达到性高潮；射精。
definitions.exampleCn: 几分钟后他达到了高潮。

definitions.definition: (with close) To approach a state of being or accomplishment.
definitions.example: One of the screws came loose, and the skateboard fell apart.
definitions.definitionCn: （与close连用）接近某种状态或成就。
definitions.exampleCn: 其中一个螺丝松了，滑板散架了。

definitions.definition: (with to) To take a particular approach or point of view in regard to something.
definitions.example: He came to SF literature a confirmed technophile, and nothing made him happier than to read a manuscript thick with imaginary gizmos and whatzits.
definitions.definitionCn: （与to连用）对某事采取特定的方法或观点。
definitions.exampleCn: 他接触科幻文学时是个坚定的技术爱好者，没有什么比读一本充满虚构小玩意和装置的手稿更让他开心的了。

definitions.definition: (fossil word) To become, to turn out to be.
definitions.example: He was a dream come true.
definitions.definitionCn: （古语）变成，结果是。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是一个梦想成真的人。

definitions.definition: To be supplied, or made available; to exist.
definitions.example: A new sports car doesn't come cheap.
definitions.definitionCn: 被提供或可用；存在。
definitions.exampleCn: 一辆新跑车可不便宜。

definitions.definition: To carry through; to succeed in.
definitions.example: You can't come any tricks here.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成；成功做到。
definitions.exampleCn: 你在这里耍不了任何花招。

definitions.definition: Happen.
definitions.example: This kind of accident comes when you are careless.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种事故在你粗心时会发生。

definitions.definition: (with from or sometimes of) To have as an origin, originate.
definitions.definitionCn: （与from或有时of连用）起源于，源自。

definitions.definition: (of grain) To germinate.
definitions.definitionCn: （指谷物）发芽。

definitions.definition: To pretend to be; to behave in the manner of.
definitions.example: Don't come the innocent victim. We all know who's to blame here.
definitions.definitionCn: 假装成；以……的方式行事。
definitions.exampleCn: 别装无辜的受害者。我们都知道该怪谁。

definitions.definition: The act of arriving; an arrival
Approaching; of the future, especially the near future; the next.
definitions.example: She will have two or three paintings in the coming exhibition.

definitions.definition: Newly in fashion; advancing into maturity or achievement.
definitions.example: Ergonomic wallets are the coming thing.

definitions.definition: Ready to come; complaisant; fond.
The quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable.
definitions.example: The Shakespearean Shylock is of dubious value in the modern world.
definitions.definitionCn: 质量（正面或负面）使某物具有可取性或价值性。
definitions.exampleCn: 莎士比亚笔下的夏洛克在现代世界中价值存疑。

definitions.definition: The degree of importance given to something.
definitions.example: The value of my children's happiness is second only to that of my wife.
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物被赋予的重要程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 我孩子的幸福价值仅次于我的妻子。

definitions.definition: That which is valued or highly esteemed, such as one's morals, morality, or belief system.
definitions.example: He does not share his parents' values.
definitions.definitionCn: 被珍视或高度推崇的事物，如道德准则、伦理或信仰体系。
definitions.exampleCn: 他与父母价值观不同。

definitions.definition: The amount (of money or goods or services) that is considered to be a fair equivalent for something else.
definitions.definitionCn: 被认为与某物等值的（金钱、商品或服务）数量。

definitions.definition: The relative duration of a musical note.
definitions.example: The value of a crotchet is twice that of a quaver.
definitions.definitionCn: 音符的相对时值。
definitions.exampleCn: 四分音符的时值是八分音符的两倍。

definitions.definition: The relative darkness or lightness of a color in (a specific area of) a painting etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 绘画等（特定区域）中颜色的相对明暗度。

definitions.definition: Any definite numerical quantity or other mathematical object, determined by being measured, computed, or otherwise defined.
definitions.example: The exact value of pi cannot be represented in decimal notation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过测量、计算或其他方式确定的任何具体数值或其他数学对象。
definitions.exampleCn: π的精确值无法用十进制表示。

definitions.definition: Precise meaning; import.
definitions.example: the value of a word; the value of a legal instrument
definitions.definitionCn: 精确含义；意义。
definitions.exampleCn: 词语的价值；法律文书的效力

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The valuable ingredients to be obtained by treating a mass or compound; specifically, the precious metals contained in rock, gravel, etc.
definitions.example: The vein carries good values.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）通过处理大量物质或化合物获得的有价值成分；特指岩石、砾石等中含有的贵金属。
definitions.exampleCn: 矿脉含有高品位矿藏。

definitions.definition: Esteem; regard.
definitions.definitionCn: 尊重；重视。

definitions.definition: Valour; also spelled valew.
definitions.definitionCn: 勇气；亦拼写为valew。

definitions.definition: To estimate the value of; judge the worth of something.
definitions.example: I will have the family jewels valued by a professional.
definitions.definitionCn: 评估某物的价值；判断其价值。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会请专业人士评估家族珠宝的价值。

definitions.definition: To fix or determine the value of; assign a value to, as of jewelry or art work.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定或规定价值；为珠宝或艺术品等赋值。

definitions.definition: To regard highly; think much of; place importance upon.
definitions.example: Gold was valued highly among the Romans.
definitions.definitionCn: 高度重视；看重；强调重要性。
definitions.exampleCn: 黄金在罗马人中备受珍视。

definitions.definition: To hold dear.
definitions.example: I value these old photographs.
definitions.definitionCn: 珍爱。
definitions.exampleCn: 我珍视这些老照片。

definitions.definition: The act of moving; a movement.
definitions.example: A slight move of the tiller, and the boat will go off course.
definitions.definitionCn: 移动的行为；一次移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 舵柄稍微一动，船就会偏离航线。

definitions.definition: An act for the attainment of an object; a step in the execution of a plan or purpose.
definitions.example: He made another move towards becoming a naturalized citizen.
definitions.definitionCn: 为达成目标而采取的行动；执行计划或目的的一步。
definitions.exampleCn: 他朝着成为归化公民又迈进了一步。

definitions.definition: A formalized or practiced action used in athletics, dance, physical exercise, self-defense, hand-to-hand combat, etc.
definitions.example: She always gets spontaneous applause for that one move.
definitions.definitionCn: 在体育、舞蹈、体育锻炼、自卫、徒手格斗等中使用的规范化或练习过的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 她总是因为那个动作获得自发的掌声。

definitions.definition: The event of changing one's residence.
definitions.example: The move into my fiancé's house took two long days.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变住所的事件。
definitions.exampleCn: 搬进我未婚夫的家花了整整两天。

definitions.definition: A change in strategy.
definitions.example: I am worried about our boss's move.
definitions.definitionCn: 策略上的改变。
definitions.exampleCn: 我担心老板的动向。

definitions.definition: A transfer, a change from one employer to another.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次调动，从一个雇主换到另一个雇主。

definitions.definition: The act of moving a token on a gameboard from one position to another according to the rules of the game.
definitions.example: If you roll a six, you can make two moves.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据游戏规则，将棋子从棋盘上一个位置移动到另一个位置的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你掷出六点，你可以走两步。

definitions.definition: To change place or posture; to go, in any manner, from one place or position to another.
definitions.example: A ship moves rapidly.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变位置或姿势；以任何方式从一个地方或位置到另一个地方或位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 船快速移动。

definitions.definition: To act; to take action; to begin to act
definitions.example: Come on guys, let's move: there's work to do!
definitions.definitionCn: 行动；采取行动；开始行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 来吧，伙计们，我们行动吧：有工作要做！

definitions.definition: To change residence, for example from one house, town, or state, to another; to go and live at another place. See also move out and move in.
definitions.example: I decided to move to the country for a more peaceful life.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变住所，例如从一所房子、城镇或州搬到另一个；去另一个地方居住。另见“搬出”和“搬入”。
definitions.exampleCn: 我决定搬到乡下过更平静的生活。

definitions.definition: (and other games) To change the place of a piece in accordance with the rules of the game.
definitions.example: My opponent's counter was moving much quicker round the board than mine.
definitions.definitionCn: （以及其他游戏）根据游戏规则改变棋子的位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 我对手的棋子在棋盘上移动得比我的快得多。

definitions.definition: To cause to change place or posture in any manner; to set in motion; to carry, convey, draw, or push from one place to another
definitions.example: The horse moves a carriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 以任何方式使改变位置或姿势；使开始运动；从一个地方搬运、输送、拖拽或推到另一个地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 马拉着马车。

definitions.definition: To transfer (a piece or man) from one space or position to another, according to the rules of the game
definitions.example: She moved the queen closer to the centre of the board.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据游戏规则，将（棋子或人）从一个空格或位置转移到另一个。
definitions.exampleCn: 她把皇后移到了棋盘中央附近。

definitions.definition: To excite to action by the presentation of motives; to rouse by representation, persuasion, or appeal; to influence.
definitions.example: This song moves me to dance.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过提出动机来激发行动；通过描述、说服或呼吁来唤醒；影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 这首歌让我想跳舞。

definitions.definition: To arouse the feelings or passions of; especially, to excite to tenderness or compassion, to excite (for example, an emotion).
definitions.example: That book really moved me.
definitions.definitionCn: 激发感情或激情；特别是，激发温柔或同情，激发（例如，一种情感）。
definitions.exampleCn: 那本书真的感动了我。

definitions.definition: To propose; to recommend; specifically, to propose formally for consideration and determination, in a deliberative assembly; to submit
definitions.example: I move to repeal the rule regarding obligatory school uniform.
definitions.definitionCn: 提议；推荐；具体来说，在审议会议上正式提出供考虑和决定；提交。
definitions.exampleCn: 我提议废除关于强制穿校服的规定。

definitions.definition: To mention; to raise (a question); to suggest (a course of action); to lodge (a complaint).
definitions.definitionCn: 提及；提出（问题）；建议（行动方案）；提出（投诉）。

definitions.definition: To incite, urge (someone to do something); to solicit (someone for or of an issue); to make a proposal to.
definitions.definitionCn: 激励、敦促（某人做某事）；向（某人）请求（某问题）；向……提出建议。

definitions.definition: To apply to, as for aid.
definitions.definitionCn: 向……求助，例如寻求援助。

definitions.definition: To request an action from the court.
definitions.example: An attorney moved the court to issue a restraining order.
definitions.definitionCn: 请求法院采取行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 一名律师请求法院发出限制令。

definitions.definition: To bow or salute upon meeting.
definitions.definitionCn: 见面时鞠躬或致意。

definitions.definition: To sell, to market (especially, but not exclusively, illegal products)
definitions.definitionCn: 销售，推销（尤其是，但不限于非法产品）。

definitions.definition: To get into one's hands, possession or control, with or without force.
definitions.example: I'll take that plate off the table.
definitions.definitionCn: 用手或不用手获取、占有或控制某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我要把那个盘子从桌上拿走。

definitions.definition: To receive or accept (something) (especially something given or bestowed, awarded, etc).
definitions.example: The camera takes 35mm film.
definitions.definitionCn: 接收或接受（某物）（尤指给予、授予、奖励等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这台相机使用35毫米胶卷。

definitions.definition: To remove.
definitions.example: take two eggs from the carton
definitions.definitionCn: 移除。
definitions.exampleCn: 从纸盒里拿出两个鸡蛋。

definitions.definition: To have sex with.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……发生性关系。

definitions.definition: To defeat (someone or something) in a fight.
definitions.example: Don't try to take that guy. He's bigger than you.
definitions.definitionCn: 在打斗中击败（某人或某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 别试图跟那家伙打，他比你壮。

definitions.definition: To grasp or grip.
definitions.example: He took her hand in his.
definitions.definitionCn: 抓住或握紧。
definitions.exampleCn: 他握住她的手。

definitions.definition: To select or choose; to pick.
definitions.example: I'll take the blue plates.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择或挑选。
definitions.exampleCn: 我选蓝色盘子。

definitions.definition: To adopt (select) as one's own.
definitions.example: She took his side in every argument.
definitions.definitionCn: 采纳（选择）作为自己的。
definitions.exampleCn: 每次争论她都站在他那边。

definitions.definition: To carry or lead (something or someone).
definitions.example: I'll take the plate with me.
definitions.definitionCn: 携带或带领（某物或某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会把盘子带走。

definitions.definition: To use as a means of transportation.
definitions.example: He took the bus to London, and then took a train to Manchester.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作交通工具。
definitions.exampleCn: 他乘巴士去伦敦，然后坐火车去曼彻斯特。

definitions.definition: To visit; to include in a course of travel.
definitions.definitionCn: 参观；纳入旅行路线。

definitions.definition: To obtain for use by payment or lease.
definitions.example: He took a full-page ad in the Times.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过付款或租赁获得使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在《泰晤士报》上登了整版广告。

definitions.definition: To consume.
definitions.definitionCn: 消耗。

definitions.definition: To experience, undergo, or endure.
definitions.definitionCn: 体验、经历或忍受。

definitions.definition: To cause to change to a specified state or condition.
definitions.example: He had to take it apart to fix it.
definitions.definitionCn: 使变成特定状态或条件。
definitions.exampleCn: 他不得不把它拆开修理。

definitions.definition: To regard in a specified way.
definitions.example: He took the news badly.
definitions.definitionCn: 以特定方式看待。
definitions.exampleCn: 他听到这消息后反应很糟。

definitions.definition: To conclude or form (a decision or an opinion) in the mind.
definitions.example: took a dim view of city officials
definitions.definitionCn: 在脑海中形成（决定或意见）。
definitions.exampleCn: 对市政官员持悲观看法

definitions.definition: To understand (especially in a specified way).
definitions.example: Don't take my comments as an insult.
definitions.definitionCn: 理解（尤指以特定方式）。
definitions.exampleCn: 别把我的评论当作侮辱。

definitions.definition: To accept or be given (rightly or wrongly); assume (especially as if by right).
definitions.example: He took all the credit for the project, although he had done almost none of the work.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受或被给予（无论对错）；假定（尤指像有权这样做）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他把项目的所有功劳都揽在自己身上，尽管他几乎没做什么工作。

definitions.definition: To believe, to accept the statements of.
definitions.example: take her word for it
definitions.definitionCn: 相信，接受某人的话。
definitions.exampleCn: 相信她的话

definitions.definition: To assume or suppose; to reckon; to regard or consider.
definitions.example: Do you take me for a fool?
definitions.definitionCn: 假设或推测；认为；看待或考虑。
definitions.exampleCn: 你把我当傻瓜吗？

definitions.definition: To draw, derive, or deduce (a meaning from something).
definitions.example: I'm not sure what moral to take from that story.
definitions.definitionCn: 从某物中得出、推导或推断（含义）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不确定从那故事中能得出什么寓意。

definitions.definition: To derive (as a title); to obtain from a source.
definitions.example: "As I Lay Dying" takes its title from Book XI of Homer's "Odyssey"
definitions.definitionCn: （作为标题）源自；从来源获得。
definitions.exampleCn: 《我弥留之际》的标题取自荷马《奥德赛》第十一卷

definitions.definition: To catch or contract (an illness, etc).
definitions.example: took a chill
definitions.definitionCn: 感染或患上（疾病等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 着凉了

definitions.definition: To come upon or catch (in a particular state or situation).
definitions.definitionCn: 撞见或发现（处于特定状态或情况）。

definitions.definition: To captivate or charm; to gain or secure the interest or affection of.
definitions.example: took her attention
definitions.definitionCn: 迷住或吸引；赢得或确保某人的兴趣或感情。
definitions.exampleCn: 吸引了她的注意

definitions.definition: (of a material) To absorb or be impregnated by (dye, ink, etc); to be susceptible to being treated by (polish, etc).
definitions.example: cloth that takes dye well
definitions.definitionCn: （指材料）吸收或浸透（染料、墨水等）；易受（抛光等）处理。
definitions.exampleCn: 容易上色的布料

definitions.definition: (of a ship) To let in (water).
definitions.definitionCn: （指船）进水。

definitions.definition: To require.
definitions.example: Finishing this on schedule will take a lot of overtime.
definitions.definitionCn: 需要。
definitions.exampleCn: 按时完成这个需要大量加班。

definitions.definition: To proceed to fill.
definitions.example: He took a seat in the front row.
definitions.definitionCn: 去占据。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在前排坐下。

definitions.definition: To fill, to use up (time or space).
definitions.example: His collection takes a lot of space.
definitions.definitionCn: 填满，用尽（时间或空间）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的收藏占了很多空间。

definitions.definition: To avail oneself of.
definitions.example: He took that opportunity to leave France.
definitions.definitionCn: 利用。
definitions.exampleCn: 他利用那个机会离开了法国。

definitions.definition: To practice; perform; execute; carry out; do.
definitions.example: Pirès ran in to take the kick.
definitions.definitionCn: 实践；执行；实施；进行；做。
definitions.exampleCn: 皮雷跑上前踢球。

definitions.definition: To assume or perform (a form or role).
definitions.definitionCn: 承担或扮演（形式或角色）。

definitions.definition: To bind oneself by.
definitions.example: he took the oath of office last night
definitions.definitionCn: 以……约束自己。
definitions.exampleCn: 他昨晚宣誓就职

definitions.definition: To move into.
definitions.example: the next team took the field
definitions.definitionCn: 进入。
definitions.exampleCn: 下一队上场

definitions.definition: To go into, through, or along.
definitions.example: go down two blocks and take the next left
definitions.definitionCn: 进入、穿过或沿着。
definitions.exampleCn: 走两个街区，然后下一个路口左转

definitions.definition: To have and use one's recourse to.
definitions.example: take cover/shelter/refuge
definitions.definitionCn: 诉诸于。
definitions.exampleCn: 躲避/掩护/避难

definitions.definition: To ascertain or determine by measurement, examination or inquiry.
definitions.example: take a census
definitions.definitionCn: 通过测量、检查或询问确定。
definitions.exampleCn: 进行人口普查

definitions.definition: To write down; to get in, or as if in, writing.
definitions.example: He took a mental inventory of his supplies.
definitions.definitionCn: 写下；以书面形式记录。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在心里清点了他的补给品。

definitions.definition: To make (a photograph, film, or other reproduction of something).
definitions.example: Could you take a picture of us?
definitions.definitionCn: 制作（照片、电影或其他复制品）。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能给我们拍张照吗？

definitions.definition: To take a picture, photograph, etc of (a person, scene, etc).
definitions.example: The photographer will take you sitting down.
definitions.definitionCn: 拍摄（人物、场景等）的照片。
definitions.exampleCn: 摄影师会拍你坐着的照片。

definitions.definition: To obtain money from, especially by swindling.
definitions.example: took me for ten grand
definitions.definitionCn: 从……获取钱财，尤指通过诈骗。
definitions.exampleCn: 骗了我一万美元

definitions.definition: (now chiefly by enrolling in a class or course) To apply oneself to the study of.
definitions.example: As a child, she took ballet.
definitions.definitionCn: （现在主要通过报名课程）致力于学习。
definitions.exampleCn: 她小时候学过芭蕾。

definitions.definition: To deal with.
definitions.example: take matters as they arise
definitions.definitionCn: 处理。
definitions.exampleCn: 随遇而安

definitions.definition: To consider in a particular way, or to consider as an example.
definitions.example: I've had a lot of problems recently: take last Monday, for example. My car broke down on the way to work. Then ... etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 以特定方式考虑，或作为例子考虑。
definitions.exampleCn: 我最近遇到很多问题：就拿上周一来说吧，我的车在上班路上坏了。然后……等等。

definitions.definition: To decline to swing at (a pitched ball); to refrain from hitting at, and allow to pass.
definitions.example: He'll probably take this one.
definitions.definitionCn: （棒球中）放弃挥棒（击球）；不击打，让球通过。
definitions.exampleCn: 他可能会放过这一球。

definitions.definition: To accept as an input to a relation.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受作为关系的输入。

definitions.definition: To get or accept (something) into one's possession.
definitions.example: My husband and I have a dysfunctional marriage. He just takes and takes; he never gives.
definitions.definitionCn: 获取或接受（某物）进入自己的占有。
definitions.exampleCn: 我和丈夫的婚姻不幸福。他只索取不付出。

definitions.definition: To engage, take hold or have effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 生效、抓住或产生影响。

definitions.definition: To become; to be affected in a specified way.
definitions.example: She took sick with the flu.
definitions.definitionCn: 变成；以特定方式受影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 她患流感病倒了。

definitions.definition: (possibly obsolete) To be able to be accurately or beautifully photographed.
definitions.definitionCn: （可能已过时）能准确或美观地拍照。

definitions.definition: An intensifier.
definitions.definitionCn: 强调词。

definitions.definition: To deliver, bring, give (something) to (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 递送、带来、给予（某物）给（某人）。

definitions.definition: (obsolete outside dialectal and slang) To give or deliver (a blow, to someone); to strike or hit.
definitions.example: He took me a blow on the head.
definitions.definitionCn: （方言和俚语外已过时）给予或施加（打击）；击打。
definitions.exampleCn: 他打了我头一下。

definitions.definition: The act by which something is taken.
definitions.definitionCn: 被拿取的行为。

definitions.definition: A seizure of someone's goods or possessions.
definitions.definitionCn: 没收某人的货物或财产。

definitions.definition: A state of mental distress, resulting in excited or erratic behavior (in the expression in a taking).
definitions.definitionCn: 精神痛苦的状态，导致兴奋或古怪行为（用于短语in a taking中）。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Cash or money received (by a shop or other business, for example).
definitions.example: Count the shop's takings.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）现金或收入（如商店或其他业务）。
definitions.exampleCn: 清点商店的收入。

definitions.definition: Alluring; attractive.
definitions.definitionCn: 迷人的；吸引人的。

definitions.definition: Infectious; contagious.
definitions.definitionCn: 传染性的；有传染性的。

definitions.definition: A mathematical science concerned with data collection, presentation, analysis, and interpretation.
definitions.example: Statistics is the only mathematical field required for many social sciences.
definitions.definitionCn: 一门涉及数据收集、呈现、分析和解释的数学科学。
definitions.exampleCn: 统计学是许多社会科学领域唯一需要的数学学科。

definitions.definition: A systematic collection of data on measurements or observations, often related to demographic information such as population counts, incomes, population counts at different ages, etc.
definitions.example: The statistics from the Census for apportionment are available.

definitions.definition: A single item in a statistical study.
A quantity calculated from the data in a sample, which characterises an important aspect in the sample (such as mean or standard deviation).
A person, or personal event, reduced to being an item of statistical information.
definitions.example: By dying from an overdose, he became just another statistic.

definitions.definition: (modal) In act or in fact; really; in truth; positively.
definitions.example: Actually, I had nothing to do with that incident.
definitions.definitionCn: （情态）在行动上或事实上；真正地；真实地；肯定地。
definitions.exampleCn: 实际上，我与那件事毫无关系。

definitions.definition: Actively.
definitions.definitionCn: 积极地。

definitions.definition: A subdivision of currency, equal to one hundredth of an Estonian kroon.
definitions.definitionCn: 货币的细分单位，等于爱沙尼亚克朗的百分之一。

definitions.definition: A distinctive odour or smell.
definitions.example: the scent of a skunk

definitions.definition: An odour left by an animal that may be used for tracing.
definitions.example: The dogs lost the scent.

definitions.definition: The sense of smell.
definitions.example: I believe the bloodhound has the best scent of all dogs.

definitions.definition: A perfume.
Any trail or trace that can be followed to find something or someone, such as the paper left behind in a paperchase.
Sense, perception.
A visual symbol or emblem that acts as a trademark or a means of identification of a company or organization.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为公司或组织商标或识别标志的视觉符号或徽章。

definitions.definition: (by extension) An audio recording for the same purpose; a jingle.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）用于相同目的的音频录音；一段广告短曲。

definitions.definition: A single graphic which contains one or more separate elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含一个或多个独立元素的单一图形。

definitions.definition: An ensign, a badge of office, rank, or power.
definitions.definitionCn: 象征职务、等级或权力的旗帜或徽章。

definitions.definition: Niceness.
definitions.definitionCn: 美好。

definitions.definition: Pleasant, satisfactory.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人愉快、满意的。

definitions.definition: Of a person: friendly, attractive.
definitions.definitionCn: 指人：友善、有吸引力。

definitions.definition: Respectable; virtuous.
definitions.example: What is a nice person like you doing in a place like this?
definitions.definitionCn: 可敬的；有道德的。
definitions.exampleCn: 像你这样的好人怎么会出现在这种地方？

definitions.definition: (with and) Shows that the given adjective is desirable, or acts as a mild intensifier; pleasantly, quite.
definitions.example: The soup is nice and hot.
definitions.definitionCn: （与and连用）表示所描述的形容词是令人满意的，或作为温和的强调词；令人愉快地，相当。
definitions.exampleCn: 这汤又热又好。

definitions.definition: Silly, ignorant; foolish.
definitions.definitionCn: 愚蠢的，无知的；傻的。

definitions.definition: Particular in one's conduct; scrupulous, painstaking; choosy.
definitions.definitionCn: 行为上挑剔的；一丝不苟的，费心的；讲究的。

definitions.definition: Particular as regards rules or qualities; strict.
definitions.definitionCn: 对规则或品质特别在意的；严格的。

definitions.definition: Showing or requiring great precision or sensitive discernment; subtle.
definitions.definitionCn: 显示或需要高度精确或敏锐辨别的；微妙的。

definitions.definition: Easily injured; delicate; dainty.
definitions.definitionCn: 易受伤的；娇嫩的；精致的。

definitions.definition: Doubtful, as to the outcome; risky.
definitions.definitionCn: 结果不确定的；有风险的。

definitions.definition: Nicely.
definitions.example: Children, play nice.
definitions.definitionCn: 很好地。
definitions.exampleCn: 孩子们，好好玩。

definitions.definition: Used to signify a job well done.
definitions.example: Nice! I couldn't have done better.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于表示工作完成得好。
definitions.exampleCn: 太棒了！我做不到更好。

definitions.definition: Used to signify approval.
definitions.example: Is that your new car? Nice!
definitions.definitionCn: 用于表示赞同。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是你的新车吗？真棒！

definitions.definition: To run a process with a specified (usually lower) priority.
To display, to have somebody see (something).
definitions.example: All he had to show for four years of attendance at college was a framed piece of paper.
definitions.definitionCn: 展示，让某人看见（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他四年大学的所有收获，不过是一张裱好的纸。

definitions.definition: To bestow; to confer.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予；赐予。

definitions.definition: To indicate (a fact) to be true; to demonstrate.
definitions.definitionCn: 表明（事实）为真；证明。

definitions.definition: To guide or escort.
definitions.example: Could you please show him on his way. He has overstayed his welcome.
definitions.definitionCn: 引导或陪同。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能送他上路吗？他待得太久不受欢迎了。

definitions.definition: To be visible; to be seen; to appear.
definitions.example: At length, his gloom showed.
definitions.definitionCn: 可见；被看见；出现。
definitions.exampleCn: 终于，他的阴郁显露出来。

definitions.definition: To put in an appearance; show up.
definitions.example: We waited for an hour, but they never showed.
definitions.definitionCn: 露面；出现。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们等了一小时，但他们始终没出现。

definitions.definition: To have an enlarged belly and thus be recognizable as pregnant.
definitions.definitionCn: 腹部隆起，因而可辨认出怀孕。

definitions.definition: (racing) To finish third, especially of horses or dogs.
definitions.example: In the third race: Aces Up won, paying eight dollars; Blarney Stone placed, paying three dollars; and Cinnamon showed, paying five dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: （赛马/赛狗）获得第三名。
definitions.exampleCn: 第三场比赛中：Aces Up获胜，赔付8美元；Blarney Stone获得第二名，赔付3美元；Cinnamon获得第三名，赔付5美元。

definitions.definition: To have a certain appearance, such as well or ill, fit or unfit; to become or suit; to appear.
definitions.definitionCn: 呈现某种外观（如好或坏、合适或不合适）；适合；显得。

definitions.definition: The act of returning.
definitions.example: I expect the house to be spotless upon my return.
definitions.definitionCn: 返回的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 我期望回家时房子一尘不染。

definitions.definition: A return ticket.
definitions.example: Do you want a one-way or a return?
definitions.definitionCn: 一张返程票。
definitions.exampleCn: 你想要单程票还是往返票？

definitions.definition: An item that is returned, e.g. due to a defect, or the act of returning it.
definitions.example: Last year there were 250 returns of this product, an improvement on the 500 returns the year before.
definitions.definitionCn: 因缺陷等原因被退回的物品，或退回该物品的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 去年该产品有250件退货，相比前年的500件有所改善。

definitions.definition: An answer.
definitions.example: a return to one's question
definitions.definitionCn: 一个回答。
definitions.exampleCn: 对某人问题的回应。

definitions.definition: An account, or formal report, of an action performed, of a duty discharged, of facts or statistics, etc.; especially, in the plural, a set of tabulated statistics prepared for general information.
definitions.example: election returns; a return of the amount of goods produced or sold
definitions.definitionCn: 对已执行行动、已履行职责、事实或统计数据等的说明或正式报告；尤指复数形式下，为一般信息而编制的一套表格化统计数据。
definitions.exampleCn: 选举结果报告；产品生产或销售数量的报告。

definitions.definition: Gain or loss from an investment.
definitions.example: It yielded a return of 5%.
definitions.definitionCn: 投资的收益或亏损。
definitions.exampleCn: 它产生了5%的回报率。

definitions.definition: : A report of income submitted to a government for purposes of specifying exact tax payment amounts. A tax return.
definitions.example: Hand in your return by the end of the tax year.
definitions.definitionCn: 向政府提交的用于确定具体纳税金额的收入报告。即纳税申报单。
definitions.exampleCn: 请在纳税年度结束前提交你的申报单。

definitions.definition: A carriage return character.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个回车字符。

definitions.definition: The act of relinquishing control to the calling procedure.
definitions.definitionCn: 将控制权交还给调用程序的行为。

definitions.definition: A return value: the data passed back from a called procedure.
definitions.definitionCn: 返回值：从被调用程序传回的数据。

definitions.definition: A return pipe, returning fluid to a boiler or other central plant (compare with flow pipe, which carries liquid away from central plant).
definitions.example: The boiler technician had to cut out the heating return to access the safety valve.
definitions.definitionCn: 回水管，将流体送回锅炉或其他中央设备（与将液体从中央设备送出的供水管相对）。
definitions.exampleCn: 锅炉技术员不得不切断供暖回水管以检修安全阀。

definitions.definition: A short perpendicular extension of a desk, usually slightly lower.
definitions.definitionCn: 书桌的一个短垂直延伸部分，通常略低。

definitions.definition: Catching a ball after a punt and running it back towards the opposing team.
definitions.definitionCn: 接住弃踢球后向对方球队方向回跑。

definitions.definition: A throw from a fielder to the wicket-keeper or to another fielder at the wicket.
definitions.definitionCn: 外场手向守门员或守门员位置的其他外场手的传球。

definitions.definition: The continuation in a different direction, most often at a right angle, of a building, face of a building, or any member, such as a moulding; applied to the shorter in contradistinction to the longer.
definitions.example: A facade of sixty feet east and west has a return of twenty feet north and south.
definitions.definitionCn: 建筑物、建筑立面或任何构件（如线脚）在不同方向上的延续，通常呈直角；用于较短部分以区别于较长部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 一座东西长六十英尺的立面，南北有二十英尺的延伸部分。

definitions.definition: To come or go back (to a place or person).
definitions.example: Although the birds fly north for the summer, they return here in winter.
definitions.definitionCn: 回来或返回（某地或某人处）。
definitions.exampleCn: 虽然鸟儿夏天飞往北方，但它们冬天会回到这里。

definitions.definition: To go back in thought, narration, or argument.
definitions.example: To return to my story [...]
definitions.definitionCn: 在思想、叙述或论证中回溯。
definitions.exampleCn: 回到我的故事……

definitions.definition: To turn back, retreat.
definitions.definitionCn: 转身、撤退。

definitions.definition: To turn (something) round.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）转过来。

definitions.definition: To place or put back something where it had been.
definitions.example: Please return your hands to your lap.
definitions.definitionCn: 把某物放回原处。
definitions.exampleCn: 请把你的手放回膝盖上。

definitions.definition: To give something back to its original holder or owner.
definitions.example: You should return the library book within one month.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物归还给其原持有人或所有者。
definitions.exampleCn: 你应该在一个月内归还图书馆的书。

definitions.definition: To take back something to a vendor for a refund.
definitions.example: If the goods don't work, you can return them.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物退回给供应商以退款。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果商品无法使用，你可以退货。

definitions.definition: To give in requital or recompense; to requite.
definitions.definitionCn: 以回报或补偿的方式给予；报答。

definitions.definition: To bat the ball back over the net in response to a serve.
definitions.example: The player couldn't return the serve because it was so fast.
definitions.definitionCn: 回应发球，将球击回网对面。
definitions.exampleCn: 球员无法回击发球，因为它太快了。

definitions.definition: To play a card as a result of another player's lead.
definitions.example: If one players plays a trump, the others must return a trump.
definitions.definitionCn: 因另一名玩家的出牌而打出一张牌。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果一名玩家打出王牌，其他人必须回一张王牌。

definitions.definition: To throw a ball back to the wicket-keeper (or a fielder at that position) from somewhere in the field.
definitions.definitionCn: 从场上的某处将球扔回给守门员（或该位置的外场手）。

definitions.definition: To say in reply; to respond.
definitions.example: to return an answer;  to return thanks;  "Do it yourself!" she returned.
definitions.definitionCn: 以回答的方式说；回应。
definitions.exampleCn: 给出回答；表示感谢；“你自己做！”她回答道。

definitions.definition: To relinquish control to the calling procedure.
definitions.definitionCn: 将控制权交还给调用程序。

definitions.definition: To pass (data) back to the calling procedure.
definitions.example: This function returns the number of files in the directory.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（数据）传回给调用程序。
definitions.exampleCn: 此函数返回目录中的文件数量。

definitions.definition: To retort; to throw back.
definitions.example: to return the lie
definitions.definitionCn: 反驳；顶回去。
definitions.exampleCn: 回击谎言。

definitions.definition: To report, or bring back and make known.
definitions.example: to return the result of an election
definitions.definitionCn: 报告，或带回并告知。
definitions.exampleCn: 公布选举结果。

definitions.definition: (by extension) To elect according to the official report of the election officers.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）根据选举官员的正式报告选出。

definitions.definition: Merchandise returned to the retailer, wholesaler or supplier.
definitions.definitionCn: 退还给零售商、批发商或供应商的商品。

definitions.definition: A mild, light-coloured kind of tobacco.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种温和、浅色的烟草。

definitions.definition: The rendering back of a writ to the proper officer.
definitions.definitionCn: 将令状交还给相关官员。

definitions.definition: The return of the soldiers fit for duty.
definitions.definitionCn: 适合执勤的士兵的归队。

definitions.definition: One who, or that which, consumes.
definitions.definitionCn: 消耗者（指消耗某物的人或物）。

definitions.definition: Someone who trades money for goods or services as an individual.
definitions.example: This new system favours the consumer over the producer.
definitions.definitionCn: 以个人身份用金钱换取商品或服务的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 这一新体系更有利于消费者而非生产者。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The consumer base of a product, service or business.
definitions.example: Our consumers are upwardly mobile and middle-class.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）某一产品、服务或企业的消费群体。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的消费者属于中产阶级且社会地位上升。

definitions.definition: An organism (heterotroph) that uses other organisms for food in order to gain energy.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种利用其他生物作为食物以获取能量的生物（异养生物）。

definitions.definition: To begin, commence, initiate.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始，着手，启动。

definitions.definition: To begin an activity.
definitions.example: The rain started at 9:00.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始一项活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 雨在9点开始下。

definitions.definition: To have its origin (at), begin.
definitions.example: The blue line starts one foot away from the wall.
definitions.definitionCn: 起源于，开始。
definitions.exampleCn: 蓝线从离墙一英尺处开始。

definitions.definition: To startle or be startled; to move or be moved suddenly.
definitions.definitionCn: 使惊动或受惊；突然移动或被移动。

definitions.definition: To break away, to come loose.
definitions.definitionCn: 挣脱，松开。

definitions.definition: To put into play.
definitions.definitionCn: 投入运行。

definitions.definition: To pour out; to empty; to tap and begin drawing from.
definitions.example: to start a water cask
definitions.definitionCn: 倒出；清空；打开并开始汲取。
definitions.exampleCn: 打开水桶取水。

definitions.definition: To start one's periods (menstruation).
definitions.example: Have you started yet?
definitions.definitionCn: 开始月经。
definitions.exampleCn: 你开始了吗？

definitions.definition: The act of something that starts.
definitions.example: constant startings and stoppings
definitions.definitionCn: 开始的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 频繁的启动与停止。

definitions.definition: The act of signing up or registering for something.
definitions.example: Complete the registration process.
definitions.definitionCn: 注册或登记某事物的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 完成注册流程。

definitions.definition: That which registers or makes something official, e.g. the form or paper that registers.
definitions.example: Did you submit your car registration yet?
definitions.definitionCn: 使某事物正式生效的凭证，例如注册表格或文件。
definitions.exampleCn: 你提交车辆登记了吗？

definitions.definition: Alignment, e.g. of colors or other elements in a printing process.
definitions.definitionCn: 对齐，例如印刷过程中颜色或其他元素的对齐。

definitions.definition: The location where guests register, especially with a hotel.
definitions.example: The elevators are just past registration.
definitions.definitionCn: 客人登记的地点，尤指酒店前台。
definitions.exampleCn: 电梯就在登记处旁边。

definitions.definition: The art of selecting and combining the stops or registers of an organ.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择和组合管风琴音栓或音区的艺术。

definitions.definition: A sequence of events.
definitions.example: The normal course of events seems to be just one damned thing after another.
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列事件。
definitions.exampleCn: 事件的正常进程似乎总是一波未平一波又起。

definitions.definition: A path that something or someone moves along.
definitions.example: His illness ran its course.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物或某人移动的路径。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的疾病经历了完整的过程。

definitions.definition: The lowest square sail in a fully rigged mast, often named according to the mast.
definitions.example: Main course and mainsail are the same thing in a sailing ship.
definitions.definitionCn: 全帆桅杆上最低的方形帆，通常根据桅杆命名。
definitions.exampleCn: 在帆船中，主帆与主桅帆是同一事物。

definitions.definition: (in the plural, courses) Menses.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式，courses）月经。

definitions.definition: A row or file of objects.

definitions.definition: One or more strings on some musical instruments (such as the guitar, lute or vihuela): if multiple, then closely spaced, tuned in unison or octaves and intended to played together.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些乐器（如吉他、鲁特琴或比维拉琴）上的一根或多根琴弦：若为多根，则紧密排列，调至同度或八度音，旨在同时弹奏。

definitions.definition: To run or flow (especially of liquids and more particularly blood).
definitions.example: Blood pumped around the human body courses throughout all its veins and arteries.
definitions.definitionCn: 流动（尤指液体，更特指血液）。
definitions.exampleCn: 泵送人体全身的血液流经所有静脉和动脉。

definitions.definition: To run through or over.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿过或掠过。

definitions.definition: To pursue by tracking or estimating the course taken by one's prey; to follow or chase after.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过追踪或估算猎物所经路线来追捕；跟随或追逐。

definitions.definition: To cause to chase after or pursue game.
definitions.example: to course greyhounds after deer

definitions.definition: Menses.

definitions.definition: A tool for finding whether a surface is level, or for creating a horizontal or vertical line of reference.
definitions.example: Hand me the level so I can tell if this is correctly installed.

definitions.definition: A distance relative to a given reference elevation.
definitions.example: By the end of the day, we'd dug down to the level of the old basement floor.
definitions.definitionCn: 相对于给定参考高程的距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 到一天结束时，我们已经挖到了旧地下室地板的高度。

definitions.definition: Degree or amount.
definitions.example: The sound level is much too high; this hurts my ears.   We've reached a new level of success.
definitions.definitionCn: 程度或数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 音量太高了，震得我耳朵疼。我们达到了新的成功高度。

definitions.definition: Achievement or qualification.
definitions.example: She achieved a high level of distinction.
definitions.definitionCn: 成就或资格。
definitions.exampleCn: 她获得了极高的荣誉。

definitions.definition: Distance from the root node of a tree structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 从树结构根节点算起的距离。

definitions.definition: One of several discrete segments of a game, generally increasing in difficulty and representing different locations in the game world.
definitions.example: It took me weeks to get to level seven.   Watch out for the next level; the bad guys there are really overpowered.

definitions.exampleCn: 我花了好几周才打到第七关。小心下一关，那里的敌人实力超强。

definitions.definition: A numeric value that quantifies a character's experience and power.
definitions.example: My half-orc barbarian reached fifth level before he was squashed by a troll.
definitions.definitionCn: 量化角色经验与力量的数值。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的半兽人野蛮人在被巨魔压扁前升到了第五级。

definitions.definition: A floor of a multi-storey building.
definitions.example: Take the elevator and get off at the promenade level.
definitions.definitionCn: 多层建筑的楼层。
definitions.exampleCn: 乘电梯到海滨长廊层下车。

definitions.definition: An area of almost perfectly flat land.

definitions.definition: A school grade or year.
definitions.definitionCn: 学校的年级或学年。

definitions.definition: To adjust so as to make as flat or perpendicular to the ground as possible.
definitions.example: You can level the table by turning the pads that screw into the feet.
definitions.definitionCn: 调整至尽可能平坦或垂直于地面。
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以通过旋转拧入桌脚的垫片来调平桌子。

definitions.definition: To destroy by reducing to ground level; to raze.
definitions.example: The hurricane leveled the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 夷为平地以摧毁。
definitions.exampleCn: 飓风将森林夷为平地。

definitions.definition: To progress to the next level.
definitions.example: I levelled after defeating the dragon.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入下一级别。
definitions.exampleCn: 击败巨龙后我升级了。

definitions.definition: To aim or direct (a weapon, a stare, an accusation, etc).
definitions.example: He levelled an accusation of fraud at the directors.  The hunter levels the gun before taking a shot.
definitions.definitionCn: 瞄准或指向（武器、目光、指控等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他向董事们提出了欺诈指控。猎人开枪前先瞄准了枪。

definitions.definition: To direct or impose (a penalty, fine, etc) at or upon (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 对（某人）施加（处罚、罚款等）。

definitions.definition: To make the score of a game equal.
definitions.definitionCn: 使比赛得分持平。

definitions.definition: To bring to a common level or plane, in respect of rank, condition, character, privilege, etc.
definitions.example: to level all the ranks and conditions of men
definitions.definitionCn: 在等级、条件、性格、特权等方面达到共同水平。
definitions.exampleCn: 使所有等级和条件的人平等。

definitions.definition: To adjust or adapt to a certain level.

definitions.definitionCn: 调整或适应特定水平。
definitions.exampleCn: 使言论适应儿童的理解能力。

definitions.definition: (usually with "with") To speak honestly and openly with.

definitions.definition: A device that produces a short flash of light to help illuminate a scene, mostly for night-time or indoors photography.

definitions.definition: A sudden, short, temporary burst of light.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然、短暂、瞬间的光亮。

definitions.definition: A very short amount of time.
definitions.definitionCn: 极短的时间。

definitions.definition: A flashlight; an electric torch.
definitions.definitionCn: 手电筒；电筒。

definitions.definition: A sudden and brilliant burst, as of genius or wit.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然而灿烂的迸发，如天才或机智的火花。

definitions.definition: Material left around the edge of a moulded part at the parting line of the mould.
definitions.definitionCn: 模具分型线处模塑件边缘残留的材料。

definitions.definition: (Cockney) The strips of bright cloth or buttons worn around the collars of market traders.

definitions.definition: A pattern where each prop is thrown and caught only once.
definitions.definitionCn: 每个道具只投掷并接住一次的模式。

definitions.definition: A language, created by a minority to maintain cultural identity, that cannot be understood by the ruling class.
definitions.definitionCn: 由少数群体为维护文化认同而创造、统治阶级无法理解的语言。

definitions.definition: A preparation of capsicum, burnt sugar, etc., for colouring liquor to make it look stronger.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于给酒液着色以显得更浓烈的辣椒、焦糖等制剂。

definitions.definition: Any of various lycaenid butterflies of the genera Artipe, Deudorix and Rapala.

definitions.definition: A tattoo flash.

definitions.definition: The sudden sensation of being "high" after taking a recreational drug.

definitions.definition: A newsflash.

definitions.definition: To cause to shine briefly or intermittently.

definitions.definitionCn: 使短暂或间歇地发光。

definitions.definition: To show or expose an "inappropriate" part of the body to someone for humorous reasons or as an act of contempt.
definitions.definitionCn: 为幽默或表示轻蔑而向他人展示身体“不恰当”部位。

definitions.definition: To break forth like a sudden flood of light; to show a momentary brilliance.
definitions.definitionCn: 如突然涌出的光芒般迸发；展现瞬间的光彩。

definitions.definition: To flaunt; to display in a showy manner.

definitions.definitionCn: 快速传达。
definitions.exampleCn: 新闻机构将战争结束的消息迅速传遍全球。

definitions.definition: To move, or cause to move, suddenly.

definitions.definitionCn: 突然移动或使移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 快进到现在。

definitions.example: Susan flashed Jessica, and then Jessica called her back, because Susan didn't have enough credit on her phone to make the call.
definitions.definitionCn: 只让电话响一声以请求回拨。

definitions.definition: (of liquid) To evaporate suddenly. (See flash evaporation.)

definitions.definition: To climb (a route) successfully on the first attempt.

definitions.definition: To write to the memory of (an updatable component such as a BIOS chip or games cartridge).

definitions.definition: To trick up in a showy manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 以招摇的方式装饰。

definitions.definition: To strike and throw up large bodies of water from the surface; to splash.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打水面并溅起大量水花。

definitions.definition: Expensive-looking and demanding attention; stylish; showy.
definitions.definitionCn: 看起来昂贵且引人注目；时髦；花哨。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Having plenty of ready money.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）手头宽裕。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Liable to show off expensive possessions or money.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）爱炫耀昂贵物品或钱财。

definitions.definition: Occurring very rapidly, almost instantaneously.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生极快，几乎瞬间。

definitions.definition: To start; to begin (an action or process).

definitions.definition: To attend.

definitions.definitionCn: 进行：

definitions.definitionCn: 进入（某种条件或状态）。

definitions.definition: To change (from one value to another) in the meaning of wend.

definitions.definitionCn: 结果如何；导致（某种结果）。

definitions.definition: To tend (toward a result).

definitions.definitionCn: 倾向于（某个结果）。

definitions.definition: To be given, especially to be assigned or allotted.

definitions.definitionCn: 具有权威性、被接受或有效：

definitions.definitionCn: 说（某事），发出声音：

definitions.definition: To resort (to).

definitions.definition: To apply or subject oneself to:
definitions.definitionCn: 应用或使自己经受：

definitions.definitionCn: 约会。

definitions.definition: To attack:
definitions.definitionCn: 攻击：

definitions.definitionCn: 总体上；通常。
definitions.exampleCn: 就句子而言，这个相当无聊。

definitions.definition: To take (a particular part or share); to participate in to the extent of.

definitions.definitionCn: 承担（特定部分或份额）；参与至某种程度。

definitions.definition: To yield or weigh.
definitions.example: Those babies go five tons apiece.
definitions.definitionCn: 产出或重量为。

definitions.definition: To offer, bid or bet an amount; to pay.

definitions.definitionCn: 出价、投标或下注一定金额；支付。

definitions.definition: To enjoy. (Compare go for.)

definitions.definition: To urinate or defecate.

definitions.definitionCn: 小便或大便。

definitions.definition: To turn; make a turn; go round; veer.

definitions.definition: To pass away; disappear; depart; vanish.
