definitions.definitionCn: 前肢前臂或手腕以下的部分，以及许多其他动物对应的部位。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的手真的很强壮。

definitions.definition: That which resembles, or to some extent performs the office of, a human hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 类似人手或在一定程度上执行人手功能的东西。

definitions.definition: In linear measurement:
definitions.definitionCn: 在线性测量中：

definitions.definition: A side; part, camp; direction, either right or left.
definitions.definitionCn: 一侧；部分；阵营；方向，左或右。

definitions.definition: Power of performance; means of execution; ability; skill; dexterity.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行能力；实施手段；能力；技能；灵巧。

definitions.definition: An agent; a servant, or manual laborer, especially in compounds; a workman, trained or competent for special service or duty; a performer more or less skillful.
definitions.example: an old hand at speaking;  large farms need many farm hands
definitions.definitionCn: 代理人；仆人，或体力劳动者，尤用于复合词；受过训练或胜任特殊服务或职责的工人；或多或少熟练的表演者。
definitions.exampleCn: 演讲的老手；大型农场需要许多农场工人。

definitions.definition: An instance of helping.
definitions.example: Bob gave Alice a hand to move the furniture.
definitions.definitionCn: 帮助的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 鲍勃帮爱丽丝搬家具。

definitions.definition: Handwriting; style of penmanship.
definitions.example: a good hand
definitions.definitionCn: 笔迹；书法风格。
definitions.exampleCn: 一手好字。

definitions.definition: A person's autograph or signature.
definitions.example: Given under my Hand and Seal of the State this 1st Day of January, 2010.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的亲笔签名或署名。
definitions.exampleCn: 经我亲笔签名并加盖州印章，于2010年1月1日签署。

definitions.definition: Personal possession; ownership.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人所有；所有权。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural, hands) Management, domain, control.
definitions.example: in safe hands;  in good hands;  He lost his job when the factory changed hands.  With the business back in the founder's hands, there is new hope for the company.  With John in charge of the project, it's in good hands.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数形式hands）管理；领域；控制。
definitions.exampleCn: 在可靠的人手中；在行家手里；工厂易主后他失去了工作。随着企业回到创始人手中，公司有了新的希望。由约翰负责这个项目，一切尽在掌握。

definitions.definition: That which is, or may be, held in a hand at once.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次能握在手中的东西。

definitions.definition: Applause.
definitions.example: Give him a hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 掌声。
definitions.exampleCn: 给他鼓掌。

definitions.definition: A Native American gambling game, involving guessing the whereabouts of bits of ivory or similar, which are passed rapidly from hand to hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种美洲原住民的赌博游戏，涉及猜测象牙片或类似物品的藏匿位置，这些物品快速从一手传到另一手。

definitions.definition: The small part of a gunstock near the lock, which is grasped by the hand in taking aim.
definitions.definitionCn: 枪托靠近枪机的小部分，瞄准时用手握住。

definitions.definition: A whole rhizome of ginger.
definitions.definitionCn: 一整块生姜根茎。

definitions.definition: The feel of a fabric; the impression or quality of the fabric as judged qualitatively by the sense of touch.
definitions.example: This fabric has a smooth, soft hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 织物的手感；通过触觉定性判断的织物印象或品质。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种织物手感光滑柔软。

definitions.definition: Actual performance; deed; act; workmanship; agency; hence, manner of performance.
definitions.definitionCn: 实际表现；行为；行动；工艺；作用；因此，表现方式。

definitions.definition: Agency in transmission from one person to another.
definitions.example: to buy at first hand (from the producer, or when new);  to buy at second hand (when no longer in the producer’s hand, or when not new);  It's not a rumor. I heard it at first hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 从一个人传递到另一个人的中介作用。
definitions.exampleCn: 直接购买（从生产者处或新品时）；二手购买（不再在生产者手中或非新品时）；这不是谣言。我是直接听到的。

definitions.definition: Rate; price.
definitions.definitionCn: 比率；价格。

definitions.definition: To give, pass, or transmit with the hand, literally or figuratively.
definitions.example: He handed them the letter.   She handed responsibility over to her deputy.
definitions.definitionCn: 用手给予、传递或传送，字面或比喻意义上。
definitions.exampleCn: 他把信递给了他们。她把责任交给了副手。

definitions.definition: To lead, guide, or assist with the hand; to conduct.
definitions.example: to hand a lady into a carriage
definitions.definitionCn: 用手引导、带领或协助；引导。
definitions.exampleCn: 扶女士上马车。

definitions.definition: To manage.
definitions.definitionCn: 管理。

definitions.definition: To seize; to lay hands on.
definitions.definitionCn: 抓住；用手抓住。

definitions.definition: To pledge by the hand; to handfast.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过握手承诺；订婚。

definitions.definition: (said of a sail) To furl.
definitions.definitionCn: （指帆）收帆。

definitions.definition: To cooperate.
definitions.definitionCn: 合作。

definitions.definition: To ask (someone) for something; to request.
definitions.definitionCn: 向（某人）请求某物；要求。

definitions.definition: To demand, to insist upon (having); to call for authoritatively.
definitions.definitionCn: 要求，坚持（拥有）；权威性地呼吁。

definitions.definition: Naturally to demand (something) as indispensable; to need, to call for as necessary.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然要求（某物）为不可或缺；需要，作为必要而呼吁。

definitions.definition: To demand of (someone) to do something.
definitions.definitionCn: 要求（某人）做某事。

definitions.definition: A garment knitted from wool, worn over the upper body.
definitions.definitionCn: 用羊毛编织的衣物，穿在上半身。

definitions.definition: A shirt worn by a member of an athletic team, usually oversized, typically depicting the athlete's name and team number as well as the team's logotype.
definitions.definitionCn: 运动队成员穿着的衬衫，通常尺码偏大，印有运动员姓名、队号及队徽。

definitions.definition: A type of fabric knit
definitions.definitionCn: 一种针织面料。

definitions.definition: A specialized animal tissue with a high oil content, used for long-term storage of energy.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种含油量高的特化动物组织，用于长期储存能量。

definitions.definition: A refined substance chemically resembling the oils in animal fat.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种精炼物质，化学性质类似动物脂肪中的油脂。

definitions.definition: That part of an organization deemed wasteful.
definitions.example: We need to trim the fat in this company
definitions.definitionCn: 组织中被视为浪费的部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们需要削减这家公司的冗余。

definitions.definition: An erection.
definitions.example: I saw Daniel crack a fat.
definitions.definitionCn: 勃起。
definitions.exampleCn: 我看到丹尼尔勃起了。

definitions.definition: A poorly played shot where the ball is struck by the top part of the club head. (see also thin, shank, toe)
definitions.definitionCn: 击球失误，球被杆头顶部击中的情况。（另见薄击、偏击、趾击）

definitions.definition: The best or richest productions; the best part.
definitions.example: to live on the fat of the land
definitions.definitionCn: 最优质或最丰富的产物；精华部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 过着养尊处优的生活。

definitions.definition: Work containing much blank, or its equivalent, and therefore profitable to the compositor.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含大量空白或类似内容的排版工作，因此对排字工有利可图。

definitions.definition: A fat person.
definitions.definitionCn: 肥胖的人。

definitions.definition: A beef cattle fattened for sale.
definitions.definitionCn: 为出售而育肥的肉牛。

definitions.definition: To make fat; to fatten.
definitions.example: kill the fatted calf
definitions.definitionCn: 使变胖；育肥。
definitions.exampleCn: 宰杀肥牛犊（设宴庆祝）。

definitions.definition: To become fat; to fatten.
definitions.definitionCn: 变胖；长胖。

definitions.definition: Carrying more fat than usual on one's body; plump; not lean or thin.
definitions.example: The fat man had trouble getting through the door.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体比平时携带更多脂肪；丰满；不瘦不柴。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个胖子费了好大劲才穿过门。

definitions.definition: Thick.
definitions.example: The fat wallets of the men from the city brought joy to the peddlers.
definitions.definitionCn: 厚的。
definitions.exampleCn: 城里人鼓鼓的钱包给小贩们带来了欢乐。

definitions.definition: Bountiful.
definitions.definitionCn: 丰盛的。

definitions.definition: Oily; greasy; unctuous; rich (said of food).
definitions.definitionCn: 油腻的；多脂的；滑腻的；味厚的（指食物）。

definitions.definition: Exhibiting the qualities of a fat animal; coarse; heavy; gross; dull; stupid.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出肥壮动物的特性；粗糙的；沉重的；粗俗的；迟钝的；愚笨的。

definitions.definition: Fertile; productive.
definitions.example: a fat soil;  a fat pasture
definitions.definitionCn: 肥沃的；多产的。
definitions.exampleCn: 肥沃的土壤；肥沃的牧场。

definitions.definition: Rich; producing a large income; desirable.
definitions.example: a fat benefice;  a fat office;  a fat job
definitions.definitionCn: 富足的；产生丰厚收入的；令人向往的。
definitions.exampleCn: 肥缺；肥差；美差。

definitions.definition: Abounding in riches; affluent; fortunate.
definitions.definitionCn: 财富充裕的；富有的；幸运的。

definitions.definition: Of a character which enables the compositor to make large wages; said of matter containing blank, cuts, or many leads, etc.
definitions.example: a fat take;  a fat page
definitions.definitionCn: 指能让排字工赚取高薪的排版内容；包含空白、插图或大量铅条等。
definitions.exampleCn: 肥活（指排版量大的任务）；肥页（指排版量大的页面）。

definitions.definition: (originally African American Vernacular English) Excellent; cool; very good.
definitions.definitionCn: （原为非裔美国英语）极好的；酷的；非常棒的。

definitions.definition: Sexy.
definitions.definitionCn: 性感的。

definitions.definition: Rich in texture; prominent.
definitions.example: The song has a phat bass line.
definitions.definitionCn: 质地丰富的；突出的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这首歌有很棒的贝斯线。

definitions.definition: A large tub or vessel for water, wine, or other liquids; a cistern.
A dry measure, generally equal to nine bushels.
A group, collection, category or set sharing characteristics or attributes.
definitions.example: Often used to imply membership of a large class.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组、集合、类别或具有共同特征或属性的群体。
definitions.exampleCn: 常用来暗示属于某个大类。

definitions.definition: A social grouping, based on job, wealth, etc. In Britain, society is commonly split into three main classes; upper class, middle class and working class.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于职业、财富等的社会群体。在英国，社会通常分为三个主要阶级：上层阶级、中产阶级和工人阶级。

definitions.definition: The division of society into classes.
definitions.example: Jane Austen's works deal with class in 18th-century England.
definitions.definitionCn: 社会划分为阶级。
definitions.exampleCn: 简·奥斯汀的作品涉及18世纪英国的阶级问题。

definitions.definition: Admirable behavior; elegance.
definitions.example: Apologizing for losing your temper, even though you were badly provoked, showed real class.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人钦佩的行为；优雅。
definitions.exampleCn: 即使你被严重激怒，为发脾气道歉也展现了真正的风度。

definitions.definition: A group of students in a regularly scheduled meeting with a teacher.
definitions.example: The class was noisy, but the teacher was able to get their attention with a story.
definitions.definitionCn: 定期与教师会面的学生群体。
definitions.exampleCn: 班级很吵闹，但老师用一个故事吸引了他们的注意力。

definitions.definition: A series of lessons covering a single subject.
definitions.example: I took the cooking class for enjoyment, but I also learned a lot.
definitions.definitionCn: 涵盖单一主题的一系列课程。
definitions.exampleCn: 我上烹饪课是为了乐趣，但也学到了很多。

definitions.definition: A group of students who commenced or completed their education during a particular year. A school class.
definitions.example: The class of 1982 was particularly noteworthy.
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定年份开始或完成学业的学生群体。学校班级。
definitions.exampleCn: 1982届毕业生尤其引人注目。

definitions.definition: A category of seats in an airplane, train or other means of mass transportation.
definitions.example: I used to fly business class, but now my company can only afford economy.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞机、火车或其他公共交通工具中的座位类别。
definitions.exampleCn: 我以前坐商务舱，但现在公司只能负担经济舱。

definitions.definition: A rank in the classification of organisms, below phylum and above order; a taxon of that rank.
definitions.example: Magnolias belong to the class Magnoliopsida.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物分类中的等级，位于门以下、目以上；该等级的分类单元。
definitions.exampleCn: 木兰属于木兰纲。

definitions.definition: Best of its kind.
definitions.example: It is the class of Italian bottled waters.
definitions.definitionCn: 同类中最好的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是意大利瓶装水中的顶级品牌。

definitions.definition: A grouping of data values in an interval, often used for computation of a frequency distribution.
definitions.definitionCn: 区间内数据值的分组，常用于计算频率分布。

definitions.definition: A collection of sets definable by a shared property.
definitions.example: Every set is a class, but classes are not generally sets. A class that is not a set is called a proper class.
definitions.definitionCn: 由共同属性定义的可集合的集合。
definitions.exampleCn: 每个集合都是一个类，但类通常不是集合。不是集合的类称为真类。

definitions.definition: A group of people subject to be conscripted in the same military draft, or more narrowly those persons actually conscripted in a particular draft.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一征兵令下应征入伍的人群，或更狭义地指特定征兵中实际被征召的人。

definitions.definition: A set of objects having the same behavior (but typically differing in state), or a template defining such a set.
definitions.example: an abstract base class
definitions.definitionCn: 具有相同行为（但通常状态不同）的一组对象，或定义此类集合的模板。
definitions.exampleCn: 抽象基类。

definitions.definition: One of the sections into which a Methodist church or congregation is divided, supervised by a class leader.
definitions.definitionCn: 卫理公会教堂或会众划分的部门之一，由班级领袖监督。

definitions.definition: To assign to a class; to classify.
definitions.example: I would class this with most of the other mediocre works of the period.
definitions.definitionCn: 将……分类；归类。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会把这归入该时期其他平庸作品之列。

definitions.definition: To be grouped or classed.
definitions.definitionCn: 被分组或分类。

definitions.definition: To divide into classes, as students; to form into, or place in, a class or classes.
definitions.definitionCn: 将学生分成班级；形成或置于某个班级中。

definitions.definition: A class or order; sort; kind.
definitions.definitionCn: 类别或顺序；种类；类型。

definitions.definition: An ecclesiastical body or judicatory in certain churches, such as the Reformed Dutch. It is intermediate between the consistory and the synod, and corresponds to the presbytery in the Presbyterian church.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些教会中的教会机构或司法机构，如荷兰归正会。它介于教会会议和宗教会议之间，相当于长老会中的长老制。

definitions.definition: Offspring.
definitions.definitionCn: 后代。

definitions.definition: Lineage.
definitions.definitionCn: 血统。

definitions.definition: A difficult return or block of a shot.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次艰难的回归或一次封盖。

definitions.definition: Something gained; an acquisition.
definitions.definitionCn: 获得的东西；收获。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
definitions.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
definitions.definitionCn: （及物动词）获得；获取。
definitions.exampleCn: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

definitions.definition: To receive.
definitions.example: He got a severe reprimand for that.
definitions.definitionCn: 收到。
definitions.exampleCn: 他因此受到了严厉的训斥。

definitions.definition: (in a perfect construction, with present-tense meaning) To have. See usage notes.
definitions.example: I've got a concert ticket for you.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于完成式，表示现在时意义）拥有。参见用法说明。
definitions.exampleCn: 我有一张给你的音乐会门票。

definitions.definition: To fetch, bring, take.
definitions.example: Can you get my bag from the living-room, please?
definitions.definitionCn: 去取、带来、拿走。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能帮我把包从客厅拿来吗？

definitions.definition: To become, or cause oneself to become.
definitions.example: I'm getting hungry; how about you?
definitions.definitionCn: 变得，或使自己变得。
definitions.exampleCn: 我饿了；你呢？

definitions.definition: To cause to become; to bring about.
definitions.example: I can't get these boots off (or on).
definitions.definitionCn: 使变得；导致。
definitions.exampleCn: 我脱不下（或穿不上）这双靴子。

definitions.definition: To cause to do.
definitions.example: I can't get it to work.
definitions.definitionCn: 使做某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 我无法让它工作。

definitions.definition: To cause to come or go or move.
definitions.example: I got him to his room.
definitions.definitionCn: 使来、去或移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我把他带到了他的房间。

definitions.definition: To cause to be in a certain status or position.
definitions.example: Get him here at once.
definitions.definitionCn: 使处于某种状态或位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 立刻让他到这里来。

definitions.definition: (with various prepositions, such as into, over, or behind; for specific idiomatic senses see individual entries get into, get over, etc.) To adopt, assume, arrive at, or progress towards (a certain position, location, state).
definitions.example: I'm getting into a muddle.
definitions.definitionCn: （与各种介词搭配，如 into、over 或 behind；特定习语含义见各词条 get into、get over 等）采取、假定、到达或朝向（某个位置、地点、状态）前进。
definitions.exampleCn: 我正陷入一团混乱。

definitions.definition: To cover (a certain distance) while travelling.
definitions.example: to get a mile
definitions.definitionCn: （旅行中）覆盖（一定距离）。
definitions.exampleCn: 走一英里。

definitions.definition: To begin (doing something or to do something).
definitions.example: After lunch we got chatting.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始（做某事或要做某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 午饭后我们开始聊天。

definitions.definition: To take or catch (a scheduled transportation service).
definitions.example: I normally get the 7:45 train.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘坐或赶上（定时交通工具）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我通常坐7:45的火车。

definitions.definition: To respond to (a telephone call, a doorbell, etc).
definitions.example: Can you get that call, please? I'm busy.
definitions.definitionCn: 接听（电话、门铃等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能接那个电话吗？我很忙。

definitions.definition: (followed by infinitive) To be able, be permitted, or have the opportunity (to do something desirable or ironically implied to be desirable).
definitions.example: Great. I get to clean the toilets today.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接不定式）能够、被允许或有机会（做某事，或讽刺地暗示是好事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 太好了。我今天得打扫厕所。

definitions.definition: To understand. (compare get it)
definitions.example: I don't get what you mean by "fun". This place sucks!
definitions.definitionCn: 理解。（比较 get it）
definitions.exampleCn: 我不明白你说的“有趣”是什么意思。这地方糟透了！

definitions.definition: To be told; be the recipient of (a question, comparison, opinion, etc.).
definitions.example: "You look just like Helen Mirren." / "I get that a lot."
definitions.definitionCn: 被告知；收到（问题、比较、意见等）。
definitions.exampleCn: “你看起来真像海伦·米伦。”/“我常听到这种话。”

definitions.definition: To be. Used to form the passive of verbs.
definitions.example: He got bitten by a dog.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于构成动词的被动语态。
definitions.exampleCn: 他被狗咬了。

definitions.definition: To become ill with or catch (a disease).
definitions.example: I went on holiday and got malaria.
definitions.definitionCn: 患上或感染（疾病）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我去度假时得了疟疾。

definitions.definition: To catch out, trick successfully.
definitions.example: He keeps calling pretending to be my boss—it gets me every time.
definitions.definitionCn: 抓住、成功欺骗。
definitions.exampleCn: 他不停地假装是我老板打电话——每次都能骗到我。

definitions.definition: To perplex, stump.
definitions.example: That question's really got me.
definitions.definitionCn: 使困惑、难住。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个问题真把我难住了。

definitions.definition: To find as an answer.
definitions.example: What did you get for question four?
definitions.definitionCn: 找到答案。
definitions.exampleCn: 第四题你得了什么答案？

definitions.definition: To bring to reckoning; to catch (as a criminal); to effect retribution.
definitions.example: I'm gonna get him for that.
definitions.definitionCn: 使算账；抓住（如罪犯）；实施报复。
definitions.exampleCn: 我会为那事找他算账的。

definitions.definition: To hear completely; catch.
definitions.example: Sorry, I didn't get that. Could you repeat it?
definitions.definitionCn: 完全听清；听明白。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱歉，我没听清。你能重复一下吗？

definitions.definition: To getter.
definitions.example: I put the getter into the container to get the gases.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸气剂处理。
definitions.exampleCn: 我把吸气剂放入容器中以吸收气体。

definitions.definition: To beget (of a father).
definitions.definitionCn: （父亲）生育。

definitions.definition: To learn; to commit to memory; to memorize; sometimes with out.
definitions.example: to get a lesson;  to get out one's Greek lesson
definitions.definitionCn: 学习；记住；背诵；有时与 out 连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 背一课；背出希腊语课文。

definitions.definition: Used with a personal pronoun to indicate that someone is being pretentious or grandiose.
definitions.example: Get her with her new hairdo.
definitions.definitionCn: 与个人代词连用，表示某人装腔作势或自命不凡。
definitions.exampleCn: 看她那新发型，真够显摆的。

definitions.definition: To go, to leave; to scram.
definitions.definitionCn: 离开；走开。

definitions.definition: To kill.
definitions.example: They’re coming to get you, Barbara.
definitions.definitionCn: 杀死。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们来抓你了，芭芭拉。

definitions.definition: To make acquisitions; to gain; to profit.
definitions.definitionCn: 获取收益；获利；赚钱。

definitions.definition: To measure.
definitions.example: Did you get her temperature?
definitions.definitionCn: 测量。
definitions.exampleCn: 你量过她的体温了吗？

definitions.definition: A git.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个无用的人。

definitions.definition: A person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people.
definitions.example: He is an unusual individual.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为单独个体，而非群体成员的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是一个独特的个体。

definitions.definition: A single physical human being as a legal subject, as opposed to a legal person such as a corporation.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为法律主体的单个自然人，区别于公司等法人实体。

definitions.definition: An object, be it a thing or an agent, as contrasted to a class.
definitions.definitionCn: 与类别相对的具体对象，无论是事物还是行为者。

definitions.definition: An element belonging to a population.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于总体的一个元素。

definitions.definition: A non-specific rule or principle that provides direction to action or behaviour.
definitions.example: He considered the Ten Commandments more a guideline than a requirement.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供行动或行为方向的非特定规则或原则。
definitions.exampleCn: 他认为十诫更多是指导方针而非强制要求。

definitions.definition: A plan or explanation to guide one in setting standards or determining a course of action.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于指导设定标准或确定行动计划的方案或说明。

definitions.definition: A light line, used in lettering, to help align the text.
definitions.definitionCn: 字体设计中用于帮助对齐文本的浅色线条。

definitions.definition: Of considerable or relatively great size or extent.
definitions.example: Russia is a large country.   The fruit-fly has large eyes for its body size.   He has a large collection of stamps.
definitions.definitionCn: 相当大的或相对较大的尺寸或范围。
definitions.exampleCn: 俄罗斯是一个大国。果蝇相对于其体型有较大的眼睛。他收藏了大量邮票。

definitions.definition: Abundant; ample.
definitions.definitionCn: 丰富的；充足的。

definitions.definition: Full in statement; diffuse; profuse.
definitions.definitionCn: 叙述详尽的；冗长的；过多的。

definitions.definition: Free; unencumbered.
definitions.definitionCn: 自由的；无负担的。

definitions.definition: Unrestrained by decorum; said of language.
definitions.definitionCn: 不受礼仪约束的；指语言而言。

definitions.definition: Crossing the line of a ship's course in a favorable direction; said of the wind when it is abeam, or between the beam and the quarter.
definitions.definitionCn: 顺船航向方向横越的；指风在正横方向或正横与船尾之间时。

definitions.definition: A prefix (honorific) or suffix (post-nominal) added to a person's name to signify either veneration, official position or a professional or academic qualification. See also
definitions.definitionCn: 前缀（敬称）或后缀（名后称谓）加于人名之后，用以表示尊敬、官职、专业或学术资格。参见

definitions.definition: Legal right to ownership of a property; a deed or other certificate proving this.
definitions.example: a good title to an estate, or an imperfect title
definitions.definitionCn: 财产所有权的合法权利；证明此权利的地契或其他证书。
definitions.exampleCn: 对地产的完整所有权或不完整所有权

definitions.definition: In canon law, that by which a beneficiary holds a benefice.
definitions.definitionCn: 在教会法中，指受俸人持有圣职的依据。

definitions.definition: A church to which a priest was ordained, and where he was to reside.
definitions.definitionCn: 牧师被授予圣职并需居住的教堂。

definitions.definition: The name of a book, film, musical piece, painting, or other work of art.
definitions.example: I know the singer's name, but not the title of the song.
definitions.definitionCn: 书籍、电影、音乐作品、绘画或其他艺术作品的名称。
definitions.exampleCn: 我知道歌手的名字，但不知道那首歌的标题。

definitions.definition: A publication.
definitions.example: Buyers of the new video game console can choose from three bundled titles.
definitions.definitionCn: 出版物。
definitions.exampleCn: 新款游戏主机的购买者可以从三款捆绑发行的游戏中挑选。

definitions.definition: A section or division of a subject, as of a law or a book.
definitions.definitionCn: 法律或书籍等主题的章节或分部。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) A written title, credit, or caption shown with a film, video, or performance.
definitions.example: The titles scrolled by too quickly to read.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用复数形式）电影、视频或表演中显示的文字标题、演职员表或字幕。
definitions.exampleCn: 字幕滚动得太快，无法阅读。

definitions.definition: The panel for the name, between the bands of the back of a book.
definitions.definitionCn: 书籍封脊装饰带之间的书名标签栏。

definitions.definition: The subject of a writing; a short phrase that summarizes the entire topic.
definitions.definitionCn: 写作的主题；概括整个主题的简短短语。

definitions.definition: A division of an act of law
definitions.example: Title II of the USA PATRIOT Act
definitions.definitionCn: 法律条款的划分
definitions.exampleCn: 《美国爱国者法案》第二章

definitions.definition: The recognition given to the winner of a championship in sports.
definitions.definitionCn: 体育赛事中授予冠军的荣誉称号。

definitions.definition: A lightweight container, generally round, open at the top, and tapering toward the bottom.
definitions.example: A basket of fake fruit adorned the table.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种轻便容器，通常为圆形，顶部开口，底部渐窄。
definitions.exampleCn: 桌上装饰着一篮假水果。

definitions.definition: A wire or plastic container similar in shape to a basket, used for carrying articles for purchase in a shop.
definitions.definitionCn: 类似篮子形状的金属或塑料容器，用于在商店中携带选购商品。

definitions.definition: In an online shop, a notional place to store items before ordering them.
definitions.definitionCn: 在线商店中，下单前存放商品的虚拟空间。

definitions.definition: A circular hoop, from which a net is suspended, which is the goal through which the players try to throw the ball.
definitions.example: The point guard drove toward the basket.
definitions.definitionCn: 悬挂着网的圆形铁圈，是球员试图投球入内的球框。
definitions.exampleCn: 控球后卫向篮下突破。

definitions.definition: The act of putting the ball through the basket, thereby scoring points.
definitions.example: The last-second basket sealed the victory.
definitions.definitionCn: 将球投入篮筐从而得分的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 最后一秒的投篮锁定了胜局。

definitions.definition: The game of basketball.
definitions.example: Let's play some basket.
definitions.definitionCn: 篮球运动。
definitions.exampleCn: 咱们打会儿篮球吧。

definitions.definition: (mildly, short for piece of crap/piece of shit) A shoddy or worthless object (usually applied to consumer products like vehicles or appliances).

definitions.definitionCn: （轻蔑语，为"piece of crap/piece of shit"的简称）劣质或无价值的物品（通常用于汽车或电器等消费品）。
definitions.exampleCn: 唉，我的新电脑真是个破烂。我明天要把它退回商店。

definitions.definition: A cannabis pipe.

definitions.example: he got a piece of that one;  she got a piece of the ball [...] and it's going foul.

definitions.definition: (sometimes derogatory) An individual; a person.

definitions.definition: A castle; a fortified building.
definitions.definitionCn: 城堡；防御性建筑。

definitions.definition: A pacifier; a dummy.
definitions.definitionCn: 安抚奶嘴；假奶嘴。

definitions.definition: A distance.

definitions.definitionCn: 一段距离。

definitions.definition: A structured practice row, often used for performance evaluation.
definitions.example: At practice we rowed four 5,000 meter pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: 结构化的练习划船，常用于表现评估。
definitions.exampleCn: 训练时我们划了四段5000米。

definitions.definition: An amount of work to be done at one time; a unit of piece work.

definitions.definition: (usually with together) To assemble (something real or figurative).

definitions.definitionCn: （常与"together"连用）组装（实物或比喻物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些线索让我们拼凑出谜团的答案。

definitions.definition: To make, enlarge, or repair, by the addition of a piece or pieces; to patch; often with out.
definitions.example: to piece a garment
definitions.definitionCn: 通过添加一块或多块来制作、扩大或修补；常与"out"连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 修补一件衣服。

definitions.definition: To produce a work of graffiti more complex than a tag.
definitions.definitionCn: 创作比标签更复杂的涂鸦作品。

definitions.definition: A single-room dwelling for a hermit.
definitions.definitionCn: 隐士独居的单间住所。

definitions.definition: A small monastery or nunnery dependent on a larger religious establishment.
definitions.definitionCn: 依附于大型宗教机构的小型修道院或女修道院。

definitions.definition: A small room in a monastery or nunnery accommodating one person.

definitions.definitionCn: 修道院或女修道院中供一人居住的小房间。
definitions.exampleCn: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔一定在他的小室之外度过了不少时间。

definitions.definition: A room in a prison or jail for one or more inmates.
definitions.example: The combatants spent the night in separate cells.
definitions.definitionCn: 监狱或看守所中关押一名或多名囚犯的房间。
definitions.exampleCn: 战斗人员分住在不同的牢房里过夜。

definitions.definition: Each of the small hexagonal compartments in a honeycomb.
definitions.definitionCn: 蜂巢中每个六边形的小蜂房。

definitions.definition: Any of various chambers in a tissue or organism having specific functions.

definitions.definition: The discal cell of the wing of a lepidopteran insect.
definitions.definitionCn: 鳞翅目昆虫翅膀上的中室。

definitions.definition: Specifically, any of the supposed compartments of the brain, formerly thought to be the source of specific mental capacities, knowledge, or memories.
definitions.definitionCn: 特指大脑中假想的隔室，曾被认为是个别心智能力、知识或记忆的来源。

definitions.definition: A section or compartment of a larger structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 较大结构中的一部分或隔间。

definitions.definition: Any small dwelling; a remote nook, a den.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何小型住所；偏僻角落，巢穴。

definitions.definition: A device which stores electrical power; used either singly or together in batteries; the basic unit of a battery.
definitions.example: This MP3 player runs on 2 AAA cells.
definitions.definitionCn: 储存电能的装置；可单独使用或组合成电池；电池的基本单元。
definitions.exampleCn: 这款MP3播放器使用两节AAA电池。

definitions.definition: The basic unit of a living organism, consisting of a quantity of protoplasm surrounded by a cell membrane, which is able to synthesize proteins and replicate itself.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物体的基本单位，由细胞膜包围的原生质构成，能够合成蛋白质并自我复制。

definitions.definition: A small thunderstorm, caused by convection, that forms ahead of a storm front.
definitions.example: There is a powerful storm cell headed our way.

definitions.exampleCn: 一场强大的风暴单体正朝我们袭来。

definitions.definition: The minimal unit of a cellular automaton that can change state and has an associated behavior.
definitions.example: The upper right cell always starts with the color green.
definitions.definitionCn: 元胞自动机中可改变状态并具有相关行为的最小单元。
definitions.exampleCn: 右上角的单元格始终以绿色开始。

definitions.definition: In FreeCell-type games, a space where one card can be placed.
definitions.definitionCn: 在空当接龙类游戏中，可放置一张卡牌的空位。

definitions.definition: A small group of people forming part of a larger organization, often an outlawed one.
definitions.example: Those three fellows are the local cell of that organization.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成较大组织的一小群人，常指非法组织。
definitions.exampleCn: 那三个人是该组织在当地的小组。

definitions.definition: (communication) A short, fixed-length packet as in asynchronous transfer mode.
definitions.example: Virtual Channel number 5 received 170 cells.
definitions.definitionCn: （通信）异步传输模式中的短固定长度数据包。

definitions.definition: (communication) A region of radio reception that is a part of a larger radio network.

definitions.definitionCn: （通信）作为更大无线电网络一部分的无线电接收区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在家信号很好，因为附近有信号塔。

definitions.definition: A three-dimensional facet of a polytope.
definitions.definitionCn: 多面体的三维面。

definitions.definition: The unit in a statistical array (a spreadsheet, for example) where a row and a column intersect.
definitions.definitionCn: 统计数组（如电子表格）中行与列相交的单元格。

definitions.definition: The space between the ribs of a vaulted roof.
definitions.definitionCn: 拱形屋顶肋条之间的空间。

definitions.definition: A cella.

definitions.definition: An area of an insect wing bounded by veins

definitions.definition: A cellular phone.

An act of delegating.

A contract whereby the original debtor substitutes a new debtor in his stead, with the creditor’s permission.

definitions.definitionCn: 开始，启动或迈出某事的第一步。

definitions.definition: To be in the first stage of some situation
definitions.example: The program begins at 9 o'clock on the dot.    I rushed to get to class on time, but the lesson had already begun.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于某种情况的第一阶段。

definitions.definition: To fix the foot of (a mast) in its step; to erect.

definitions.definition: In an immediate manner; instantly or without delay.

definitions.definition: Form created in the mind, rather than the forms perceived through the five senses; an instance of thinking.
definitions.example: The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
definitions.definitionCn: 思维在心灵中形成的形态，而非通过五感感知的形态；思考的实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 对抗压力最强大的武器，是我们选择一种想法而非另一种的能力。

definitions.definition: The operation by which such forms arise or are manipulated; the process of thinking; the agency by which thinking is accomplished.
definitions.example: Without freedom of thought there can be no such thing as wisdom, and no such thing as public liberty without freedom of speech.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类形态产生或被操控的过程；思考的过程；完成思考的媒介。
definitions.exampleCn: 没有思想自由，便不可能有智慧；没有言论自由，便不可能有公共自由。

definitions.definition: A way of thinking (associated with a group, nation or region).
definitions.example: Traditional eastern thought differs markedly from that of the west.
definitions.definitionCn: （与某个群体、民族或地区相关的）思维方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 东方传统思维与西方截然不同。

definitions.definition: To instruct, train (usually in matters of knowledge).
definitions.definitionCn: 教导、培训（通常指知识方面）。

definitions.definition: To communicate knowledge to.
definitions.definitionCn: 传授知识给某人。

definitions.definition: To impart information or knowledge.
definitions.definitionCn: 传递信息或知识。

definitions.definition: To act as an informer; denounce.
definitions.definitionCn: 充当告密者；揭发。

definitions.definition: To give form or character to; to inspire (with a given quality); to affect, influence (with a pervading principle, idea etc.).
definitions.example: His sense of religion informs everything he writes.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予形式或特质；以某种品质激励；以普遍原则、思想等影响、感染。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的宗教感贯穿于他所有的作品。

definitions.definition: To make known, wisely and/or knowledgeably.
definitions.definitionCn: 明智且/或博学地告知。

definitions.definition: To direct, guide.
definitions.definitionCn: 指导、引导。

definitions.definition: To take form; to become visible or manifest; to appear.
definitions.definitionCn: 成形；变得可见或显现；出现。

definitions.definition: Instructed; having knowledge of a fact or area of education.
definitions.example: An informed young man delivered a lecture on the history of modern art.
definitions.definitionCn: 受过教导的；了解某一事实或教育领域的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位见多识广的年轻人就现代艺术史发表了演讲。

definitions.definition: Based on knowledge; founded on due understanding of a situation.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于知识的；建立在对情况充分理解之上的。

definitions.definition: Created, given form.
Unformed or ill-formed; deformed; shapeless
Not included within the figures of any of the ancient constellations.
definitions.example: the informed stars

definitions.definition: Someone or something, especially, a television station, that is associated with a larger, related organization, such as a television network; a member of a group of associated things.
definitions.example: Our local TV channel is an affiliate of NBC.
definitions.definitionCn: 附属机构或附属者，尤指与大型相关组织（如电视网）关联的电视台；关联事物群体中的一员。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们当地的电视台是NBC的附属机构。

definitions.definition: To adopt; to receive into a family as one's offspring
definitions.definitionCn: 收养；将某人作为后代纳入家庭。

definitions.definition: To bring or receive into close connection; to ally.
definitions.definitionCn: 使建立密切联系；结盟。

definitions.definition: (said of an illegitimate child) To fix the paternity of
definitions.example: to affiliate the child to (or on or upon) one man rather than another
definitions.definitionCn: （指非婚生子女）确定生父身份。
definitions.exampleCn: 将孩子的生父确定为某一人而非另一人。

definitions.definition: To connect in the way of descent; to trace origin to.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过血统建立联系；追溯起源至。

definitions.definition: (followed by "to" or "with") To attach (to) or unite (with); to receive into a society as a member, and initiate into its mysteries, plans, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接"to"或"with"）使依附（于）或联合（与）；接纳为社团成员，并使其了解内部秘密、计划等。

definitions.definition: A small inlet or bay, often saltwater, narrower and extending farther into the land than a cove; a recess in the shore of the sea, or of a river; the inner part of a port that is used as a dock for small boats.
definitions.definitionCn: 小水湾或海湾，常为咸水，比小海湾更窄且更深入陆地；海岸或河岸的凹入处；港口内部用作小船码头的水域。

definitions.definition: A stream of water (often freshwater) smaller than a river and larger than a brook.
definitions.definitionCn: 比河流小、比溪流大的水流（常为淡水）。

definitions.definition: Any turn or winding.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何转弯或蜿蜒处。

definitions.definition: A journey through a particular building, estate, country, etc.
definitions.example: On our last holiday to Spain we took a tour of the wine-growing regions.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿越特定建筑、庄园、国家等的旅程。
definitions.exampleCn: 上次去西班牙度假时，我们游览了葡萄酒产区。

definitions.definition: A guided visit to a particular place, or virtual place.
definitions.example: On the company's website, you can take a virtual tour of the headquarters.
definitions.definitionCn: 对特定地点或虚拟地点的导览参观。
definitions.exampleCn: 在公司网站上，你可以虚拟参观总部。

definitions.definition: A journey through a given list of places, such as by an entertainer performing concerts.
definitions.example: Metallica's tour of Europe
definitions.definitionCn: 按既定地点列表进行的旅程，例如表演者举办音乐会。
definitions.exampleCn: 金属乐队的欧洲巡演

definitions.definition: A trip taken to another country in which several matches are played.
definitions.definitionCn: 前往另一国家进行多场比赛的旅行。

definitions.definition: A street and road race, frequently multiday.
definitions.definitionCn: 街道和公路比赛，通常持续多日。

definitions.definition: A set of competitions which make up a championship.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成锦标赛的一系列比赛。

definitions.definition: A tour of duty.
definitions.definitionCn: 执勤期。

definitions.definition: A closed trail.
definitions.definitionCn: 闭合路径。

definitions.definition: A going round; a circuit.
definitions.definitionCn: 绕行；环行。

definitions.definition: A turn; a revolution.
definitions.example: the tours of the heavenly bodies
definitions.definitionCn: 转动；旋转。
definitions.exampleCn: 天体的运行

definitions.definition: To make a journey
definitions.example: The Rolling Stones were still touring when they were in their seventies.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行旅行
definitions.exampleCn: 滚石乐队七十多岁时仍在巡演。

definitions.definition: To make a circuit of a place
definitions.example: The circuses have been touring Europe for the last few weeks.
definitions.definitionCn: 绕行某地
definitions.exampleCn: 马戏团过去几周一直在欧洲巡演。

definitions.definition: A tower.
definitions.definitionCn: 塔楼。

definitions.definition: To toot a horn.
definitions.definitionCn: 按喇叭。

definitions.definition: To separate items into different categories according to certain criteria that determine their sorts.
definitions.example: Sort the letters in those bags into a separate pile for each language.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据特定标准将物品分类到不同类别中。
definitions.exampleCn: 将那些袋子里的信件按每种语言分别堆放。

definitions.definition: To arrange into some sequence, usually numerically, alphabetically or chronologically.
definitions.example: Sort those bells into a row in ascending sequence of pitch.
definitions.definitionCn: 按某种顺序排列，通常是数字、字母或时间顺序。
definitions.exampleCn: 按音高升序将这些铃铛排成一排。

definitions.definition: To conjoin; to put together in distribution; to class.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接；分配归类。

definitions.definition: To conform; to adapt; to accommodate.
definitions.definitionCn: 使一致；适应；调节。

definitions.definition: To choose from a number; to select; to cull.
definitions.definitionCn: 从多个中挑选；选择；筛选。

definitions.definition: To join or associate with others, especially with others of the same kind or species; to agree.
definitions.definitionCn: 与他人联合或交往，尤指与同类或同种者；达成一致。

definitions.definition: To suit; to fit; to be in accord; to harmonize.
definitions.definitionCn: 适合；匹配；协调；和谐。

definitions.definition: To fix (a problem) or handle (a task).
definitions.definitionCn: 解决（问题）或处理（任务）。

definitions.definition: To attack physically.
definitions.example: If he comes nosing around here again I'll sort him!
definitions.definitionCn: 进行物理攻击。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果他再来这里探头探脑，我就收拾他！

definitions.definition: Put into some order by sorting.
definitions.example: a sorted list of numbers
definitions.definitionCn: 通过排序整理成某种顺序。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个已排序的数字列表。

definitions.definition: (usually with out) In good order, under control.
definitions.example: I have to get my life sorted.
definitions.definitionCn: （常与out连用）井然有序，处于掌控中。
definitions.exampleCn: 我得把我的生活理顺。

definitions.definition: In possession of a sufficient supply, especially of narcotics.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有充足供应，尤指毒品。

definitions.definition: A general expression of approval.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种普遍的赞许表达。

definitions.definition: To relate details of (an event or incident); to recount, describe (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 详细叙述（某事件或事故）；讲述、描述（某事）。

definitions.definition: To repeat (something one has heard), to retell; to pass on, convey (a message, information etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 复述（听到的事情），转述；传递（消息、信息等）。

definitions.definition: To take oneself (to someone or something) for guidance or support; to appeal.
definitions.definitionCn: 向（某人或某物）寻求指导或支持；求助。

definitions.definition: To notify someone of (particular intelligence, suspicions, illegality, misconduct etc.); to make notification to relevant authorities; to submit a formal report of.
definitions.example: For insurance reasons, I had to report the theft to the local police station.
definitions.definitionCn: 通知某人（特定情报、怀疑、违法行为、不当行为等）；向相关当局报告；提交正式报告。
definitions.exampleCn: 出于保险原因，我不得不向当地警察局报告了这起盗窃案。

definitions.definition: To make a formal statement, especially of complaint, about (someone).
definitions.example: If you do that again I'll report you to the boss.
definitions.definitionCn: 就（某人）做出正式陈述，尤其是投诉。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你再那样做，我就向老板告发你。

definitions.definition: To show up or appear at an appointed time; to present oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 在约定时间出现或到场；报到。

definitions.definition: To write news reports (for); to cover as a journalist or reporter.
definitions.example: Andrew Marr reports now on more in-fighting at Westminster.
definitions.definitionCn: 撰写新闻报道（关于……）；以记者或通讯员身份报道。
definitions.exampleCn: 安德鲁·马尔现在报道威斯敏斯特更多的内斗。

definitions.definition: To be accountable to or subordinate to (someone) in a hierarchy; to receive orders from (someone); to give official updates to (someone who is above oneself in a hierarchy).
definitions.example: Now that I've been promoted, I report to Benjamin, whom I loathe.
definitions.definitionCn: 在层级中向（某人）负责或从属于（某人）；接受（某人）的命令；向（上级）提供正式汇报。
definitions.exampleCn: 既然我升职了，我就向本杰明汇报，我讨厌他。

definitions.definition: To return or present as the result of an examination or consideration of any matter officially referred.
definitions.example: The committee reported the bill with amendments, or reported a new bill, or reported the results of an inquiry.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为对任何正式提交事项的审查或考虑的结果，返回或提交。
definitions.exampleCn: 委员会报告了修正后的法案，或报告了新法案，或报告了调查结果。

definitions.definition: To take minutes of (a speech, the doings of a public body, etc.); to write down from the lips of a speaker.
definitions.definitionCn: 记录（演讲、公共机构的活动等）；从发言人口中记下内容。

definitions.definition: To refer.
definitions.definitionCn: 参考；提及。

definitions.definition: To return or repeat, as sound; to echo.
definitions.definitionCn: 返回或重复（如声音）；回响。

definitions.definition: The creation of reports, as for a business or a journal.
definitions.definitionCn: 创建报告，例如为企业或期刊。

definitions.definition: Repetition of an activity to improve a skill.
definitions.example: He will need lots of practice with the lines before he performs them.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复某项活动以提高技能。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在表演前需要大量练习台词。

definitions.definition: An organized event for the purpose of performing such repetition.
definitions.example: Being on a team is hard: you're always having to go to practice while everyone else is taking it easy.
definitions.definitionCn: 为进行此类重复而组织的活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 加入团队很辛苦：别人都在放松时，你总得去训练。

definitions.definition: The ongoing pursuit of a craft or profession, particularly in medicine or the fine arts.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某项技艺或职业的持续追求，尤指医学或美术领域。

definitions.definition: A place where a professional service is provided, such as a general practice.
definitions.example: She ran a thriving medical practice.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供专业服务的地方，如普通诊所。
definitions.exampleCn: 她经营着一家兴旺的医疗诊所。

definitions.definition: The observance of religious duties that a church requires of its members.
definitions.definitionCn: 遵守教会要求其成员履行的宗教义务。

definitions.definition: A customary action, habit, or behaviour; a manner or routine.
definitions.example: It is good practice to check each door and window before leaving.
definitions.definitionCn: 习惯性的行为、习惯或举止；方式或常规。
definitions.exampleCn: 离开前检查每扇门窗是良好的做法。

definitions.definition: Actual operation or experiment, in contrast to theory.
definitions.example: That may work in theory, but will it work in practice?
definitions.definitionCn: 实际运作或实验，与理论相对。
definitions.exampleCn: 这在理论上可行，但实践中能行得通吗？

definitions.definition: The form, manner, and order of conducting and carrying on suits and prosecutions through their various stages, according to the principles of law and the rules laid down by the courts.
definitions.example: This firm of solicitors is involved in family law practice.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据法律原则和法院制定的规则，进行诉讼和起诉各阶段的形式、方式和顺序。
definitions.exampleCn: 这家律师事务所从事家庭法律业务。

definitions.definition: Skilful or artful management; dexterity in contrivance or the use of means; stratagem; artifice.
definitions.definitionCn: 巧妙或艺术性的管理；策划或运用手段的灵巧；策略；诡计。

definitions.definition: A easy and concise method of applying the rules of arithmetic to questions which occur in trade and business.
definitions.definitionCn: 将算术规则应用于贸易和商业中问题的简便方法。

definitions.definition: To repeat (an activity) as a way of improving one's skill in that activity.
definitions.example: You should practise playing piano every day.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复（某项活动）以提高在该活动中的技能。
definitions.exampleCn: 你应该每天练习弹钢琴。

definitions.definition: To repeat an activity in this way.
definitions.example: If you want to speak French well, you need to practise.
definitions.definitionCn: 以这种方式重复活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你想讲好法语，就需要练习。

definitions.definition: To perform or observe in a habitual fashion.
definitions.example: They gather to practise religion every Saturday.
definitions.definitionCn: 以习惯的方式执行或遵守。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们每周六聚集进行宗教活动。

definitions.definition: To pursue (a career, especially law, fine art or medicine).
definitions.example: She practised law for forty years before retiring.
definitions.definitionCn: 从事（职业，尤其是法律、美术或医学）。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在退休前从事法律工作四十年。

definitions.definition: To conspire.
definitions.definitionCn: 密谋。

definitions.definition: To put into practice; to carry out; to act upon; to commit; to execute; to do.
definitions.definitionCn: 付诸实践；执行；行动；实施；完成；做。

definitions.definition: To make use of; to employ.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用；运用。

definitions.definition: To teach or accustom by practice; to train.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过实践教导或使习惯；训练。

definitions.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.
definitions.example: He’s working in a bar.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过运用体力或脑力完成特定任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在酒吧工作。

definitions.definition: To effect by gradual degrees.
definitions.example: he worked his way through the crowd
definitions.definitionCn: 逐步实现。
definitions.exampleCn: 他挤过人群。

definitions.definition: To embroider with thread.
definitions.definitionCn: 用线刺绣。

definitions.definition: To set into action.
definitions.example: He worked the levers.
definitions.definitionCn: 启动。
definitions.exampleCn: 他操作了杠杆。

definitions.definition: To cause to ferment.
definitions.definitionCn: 使发酵。

definitions.definition: To ferment.
definitions.definitionCn: 发酵。

definitions.definition: To exhaust, by working.
definitions.example: The mine was worked until the last scrap of ore had been extracted.
definitions.definitionCn: 因工作而耗尽。
definitions.exampleCn: 这座矿被开采到最后一丁点矿石都被提取出来。

definitions.definition: To shape, form, or improve a material.
definitions.example: He used pliers to work the wire into shape.
definitions.definitionCn: 塑造、成型或改进材料。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用钳子把铁丝弯成形状。

definitions.definition: To operate in a certain place, area, or speciality.
definitions.example: she works the night clubs
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定地点、区域或专业领域工作。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在夜总会表演。

definitions.definition: To operate in or through; as, to work the phones.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过……操作；例如，打电话。

definitions.definition: To provoke or excite; to influence.
definitions.example: The rock musician worked the crowd of young girls into a frenzy.
definitions.definitionCn: 激发或煽动；影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 摇滚乐手把年轻女孩们煽动得疯狂起来。

definitions.definition: To use or manipulate to one’s advantage.
definitions.example: She knows how to work the system.
definitions.definitionCn: 利用或操纵以谋取利益。
definitions.exampleCn: 她知道如何钻制度的空子。

definitions.definition: To cause to happen or to occur as a consequence.
definitions.example: I cannot work a miracle.
definitions.definitionCn: 导致发生或作为结果出现。
definitions.exampleCn: 我无法创造奇迹。

definitions.definition: To cause to work.
definitions.example: He is working his servants hard.
definitions.definitionCn: 使工作。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正让仆人们拼命干活。

definitions.definition: To function correctly; to act as intended; to achieve the goal designed for.
definitions.example: he pointed at the car and asked, "Does it work"?;  he looked at the bottle of pain pills, wondering if they would work;  my plan didn’t work
definitions.definitionCn: 正常运转；按预期运作；达到设计目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 他指着车问：“它能用吗？”；他看着止痛药瓶，想知道它们是否有效；我的计划没成功。

definitions.definition: To influence.
definitions.example: They worked on her to join the group.
definitions.definitionCn: 影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们劝说她加入团体。

definitions.definition: To effect by gradual degrees; as, to work into the earth.
definitions.definitionCn: 逐步实现；例如，渗入泥土。

definitions.definition: To move in an agitated manner.
definitions.example: A ship works in a heavy sea.
definitions.definitionCn: 剧烈地移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 船在汹涌的海面上颠簸。

definitions.definition: To behave in a certain way when handled
definitions.example: this dough does not work easily;  the soft metal works well
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式被处理时表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 这块面团不好揉；这种软金属容易加工。

definitions.definition: (with two objects) To cause (someone) to feel (something); to do unto somebody (something, whether good or bad).
definitions.definitionCn: （带双宾语）使（某人）感受到（某事）；对某人做（某事，无论好坏）。

definitions.definition: To hurt; to ache.
definitions.definitionCn: 疼痛；酸痛。

definitions.definition: Designed or executed in a particular manner or to a particular degree.
definitions.definitionCn: 以特定方式或程度设计或制作的。

definitions.definition: Wrought.
definitions.definitionCn: 精制的。

definitions.definition: Prepared so as to demonstrate the steps required.
definitions.definitionCn: 为演示所需步骤而准备的。

definitions.definition: A male; a guy; a fellow.
definitions.example: I'm just an ordinary joe.
definitions.definitionCn: 男性；家伙；小伙子。
definitions.exampleCn: 我只是个普通人。

definitions.definition: Coffee.
Darling, sweetheart.
The action of defending or protecting from attack, danger, or injury.
definitions.definitionCn: 防御或保护免受攻击、危险或伤害的行为。

definitions.definition: Anything employed to oppose attack(s).
definitions.definitionCn: 用于对抗攻击的任何事物。

definitions.definition: An argument in support or justification of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持或证明某事的论点。

definitions.definition: Government policy or (infra)structure related to the military.
definitions.example: Department of Defense
definitions.definitionCn: 与军事相关的政府政策或（基础）设施。
definitions.exampleCn: 国防部

definitions.definition: A prohibition; a prohibitory ordinance.
definitions.definitionCn: 禁令；禁止性法令。

definitions.definition: To mark out and make known; to point out; to indicate; to show; to distinguish by marks or description
definitions.example: to designate the boundaries of a country
definitions.definitionCn: 标出并告知；指出；指示；显示；通过标记或描述来区分
definitions.exampleCn: 划定国家的边界

definitions.definition: To call by a distinctive title; to name.
definitions.definitionCn: 用独特的称号称呼；命名

definitions.definition: To indicate or set apart for a purpose or duty; — with to or for; to designate an officer for or to the command of a post or station.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某一目的或职责而指定或分出——与to或for连用；指定一名军官担任或指挥某个岗位或驻地

definitions.definition: Having a specified designation
definitions.definitionCn: 具有特定的指定名称

definitions.definition: Administration, or administrative work.
definitions.example: There's a lot of admin involved in the birth of a child.
definitions.definitionCn: 行政，或行政工作。
definitions.exampleCn: 生孩子涉及大量行政事务。

definitions.definition: A systems administrator; one who maintains a computer system or network.
definitions.example: Our admin has upgraded the server in our office, so we can exchange files faster.
definitions.definitionCn: 系统管理员；负责维护计算机系统或网络的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的管理员升级了办公室的服务器，这样我们可以更快地交换文件。

definitions.definition: A user of a discussion forum, web site, etc. with privileges allowing them to control or restrict the activity of other uses.
definitions.example: The admin changed the forum settings to enable the use of emoticons.
definitions.definitionCn: 论坛、网站等的用户，拥有控制或限制其他用户活动的权限。
definitions.exampleCn: 管理员更改了论坛设置，允许使用表情符号。

definitions.definition: To serve as an administrator for or of.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任……的管理员。

definitions.definition: To form into one whole; to make entire; to complete; to renew; to restore; to perfect.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成整体；使完整；完成；更新；恢复；完善。

definitions.definition: To include as a constituent part or functionality.
definitions.example: They were keen to integrate their new skills into the performance.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为组成部分或功能包含在内。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们渴望将新技能融入表演中。

definitions.definition: To indicate the whole of; to give the sum or total of; as, an integrating anemometer, one that indicates or registers the entire action of the wind in a given time.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示整体；给出总和或总数；例如，积分风速计，指示或记录给定时间内风的全部作用。

definitions.definition: To subject to the operation of integration; to find the integral of.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行积分运算；求积分。

definitions.definition: To desegregate, as a school or neighborhood.
definitions.example: The refugees were well integrated into the community.
definitions.definitionCn: 废除种族隔离，如学校或社区。
definitions.exampleCn: 难民很好地融入了社区。

definitions.definition: To combine compatible elements in order to incorporate them.
definitions.definitionCn: 结合兼容的元素以便纳入。

definitions.definition: Composed and coordinated to form a whole
definitions.definitionCn: 组成并协调以形成整体

definitions.definition: Characterized by racial integration
definitions.definitionCn: 以种族融合为特征

definitions.definition: To breastfeed: to feed (a baby) at the breast; to suckle.
definitions.example: She believes that nursing her baby will make him strong and healthy.
definitions.definitionCn: 哺乳：指在乳房喂养（婴儿）；给婴儿喂奶。
definitions.exampleCn: 她相信哺乳会使她的宝宝强壮健康。

definitions.definition: To breastfeed: to be fed at the breast.
definitions.definitionCn: 哺乳：指在乳房被喂养。

definitions.definition: To care for (someone), especially in sickness; to tend to.
definitions.example: She nursed him back to health.
definitions.definitionCn: 照顾（某人），尤指在生病时；照料。
definitions.exampleCn: 她通过护理使他恢复了健康。

definitions.definition: To treat kindly and with extra care
definitions.example: She nursed the rosebush and that season it bloomed.
definitions.definitionCn: 以善意和额外关怀对待。
definitions.exampleCn: 她精心照料那丛玫瑰，那个季节它开花了。

definitions.definition: To manage with care and economy
definitions.definitionCn: 以细心和节约的方式管理。

definitions.definition: To drink slowly
definitions.definitionCn: 慢慢饮用。

definitions.definition: To foster, to nourish
definitions.definitionCn: 培养，滋养。

definitions.definition: To hold closely to one's chest
definitions.example: Would you like to nurse the puppy?
definitions.definitionCn: 紧紧抱在胸前。
definitions.exampleCn: 你想抱抱这只小狗吗？

definitions.definition: To strike (billiard balls) gently, so as to keep them in good position during a series of shots.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻轻击打（台球），使其在一系列击球中保持良好位置。

definitions.definition: Suckling, such as breastfeeding.
definitions.definitionCn: 哺乳，如母乳喂养。

definitions.definition: The process or profession of caring for patients as a nurse.
definitions.example: She went into nursing as a career.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为护士照顾病人的过程或职业。
definitions.exampleCn: 她选择了护理作为职业。

definitions.definition: In the state of suckling young, lactating.
definitions.example: The nursing bear wouldn't move far until her cubs were older.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于哺乳幼崽的状态，泌乳。
definitions.exampleCn: 那只哺乳的熊在幼崽长大前不会走远。

definitions.definition: Referring to nurses.
definitions.example: The nursing staff worked overtime at the hospital.
definitions.definitionCn: 指护士的。
definitions.exampleCn: 医院的护理人员加班工作。

definitions.definition: An effigy of a man burned on a bonfire on the anniversary of the Gunpowder Plot (5th November).
definitions.definitionCn: 在火药阴谋纪念日（11月5日）的篝火上焚烧的人形模拟像。

definitions.definition: A person of eccentric appearance or dress; a "fright".
definitions.definitionCn: 外表或着装古怪的人；令人害怕的人。

definitions.definition: A man, fellow.
definitions.definitionCn: 男人，家伙。

definitions.definition: (especially in the plural) A person (see usage notes).
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指复数）人（参见用法说明）。

definitions.definition: (of animals and sometimes objects) Thing, creature.
definitions.example: The dog's left foreleg was broken, poor little guy.
definitions.definitionCn: （指动物，有时也指物体）东西，生物。
definitions.exampleCn: 这只狗的左前腿断了，可怜的小家伙。

definitions.definition: Thing, unit.
definitions.example: This guy is the partial derivative of that guy with respect to x.
definitions.definitionCn: 东西，单位。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个变量是那个变量对x的偏导数。

definitions.definition: (term of address) Buster, Mack, fella, bud, man.
definitions.example: Hey, guy, give a man a break, would ya?
definitions.definitionCn: （称呼用语）小子，老兄，伙计，朋友，兄弟。
definitions.exampleCn: 嘿，老兄，行行好行吗？

definitions.definition: To exhibit an effigy of Guy Fawkes around the 5th November.
definitions.definitionCn: 在11月5日前后展示盖伊·福克斯的模拟像。

definitions.definition: To make fun of, to ridicule with wit or innuendo.
definitions.definitionCn: 取笑，用机智或影射的方式嘲弄。

definitions.definition: To play in a comedic manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 以喜剧方式表演。

definitions.definition: A guide; a leader or conductor.
definitions.definitionCn: 向导；领导者或指挥者。

definitions.definition: A support rope or cable used to guide, steady or secure something which is being hoisted or lowered.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于引导、稳定或固定正在升降物体的支撑绳或缆绳。

definitions.definition: A support to secure or steady something prone to shift its position or be carried away (e.g. the mast of a ship or a suspension-bridge).
definitions.definitionCn: 用于固定或稳定易移位或被带走的物体（如船桅或吊桥）的支撑物。

definitions.definition: To equip with a support cable.
definitions.definitionCn: 配备支撑缆绳。

definitions.definition: A device that directs and controls energy, often in the form of movement or electricity, to produce a certain effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种引导和控制能量（通常以运动或电力形式）以产生特定效果的装置。

definitions.definition: A vehicle operated mechanically, such as an automobile or an airplane.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过机械方式运行的交通工具，如汽车或飞机。

definitions.definition: (abbreviation) An answering machine or, by extension, voice mail.
definitions.example: I called you earlier, but all I got was the machine.
definitions.definitionCn: （缩写）电话答录机，或引申为语音邮件。
definitions.exampleCn: 我之前给你打过电话，但只听到了机器应答。

definitions.definition: A computer.
definitions.example: Game developers assume they're pushing the limits of the machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 一台计算机。
definitions.exampleCn: 游戏开发者认为他们正在突破机器的极限。

definitions.definition: A person or organisation that seemingly acts like a machine, being particularly efficient, single-minded, or unemotional.
definitions.example: Bruce Campbell was a "demon-killing machine" because he made quick work of killing demons.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个看似像机器一样高效、专注或冷漠的人或组织。
definitions.exampleCn: 布鲁斯·坎贝尔是个“杀恶魔机器”，因为他能迅速消灭恶魔。

definitions.definition: Especially, the group that controls a political or similar organization; a combination of persons acting together for a common purpose, with the agencies which they use.
definitions.definitionCn: 特指控制政治或类似组织的团体；为共同目标而行动的一群人及其使用的机构。

definitions.definition: Supernatural agency in a poem, or a superhuman being introduced to perform some exploit.
definitions.definitionCn: 诗歌中的超自然媒介，或为完成某项壮举而引入的超人存在。

definitions.definition: The system of special interest groups that supports a political party, especially in urban areas.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持政党的特殊利益集团体系，尤其在城区。

definitions.definition: Penis.
definitions.definitionCn: 阴茎。

definitions.definition: A contrivance in the Ancient Greek theatre for indicating a change of scene, by means of which a god might cross the stage or deliver a divine message; the deus ex machina.
definitions.definitionCn: 古希腊戏剧中用于指示场景变换的装置，通过它神祇可以穿越舞台或传达神谕；即“机械降神”。

definitions.definition: A bathing machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种沐浴机。

definitions.definition: To make by machinery.
definitions.definitionCn: 用机器制造。

definitions.definition: To shape or finish by machinery.
definitions.definitionCn: 用机器成型或精加工。

definitions.definition: To place something over or upon, as to conceal or protect.
definitions.example: He covered the baby with a blanket.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物覆盖或置于某物之上，以隐藏或保护。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用毯子盖住婴儿。

definitions.definition: To be over or upon, as to conceal or protect.
definitions.example: The blanket covered the baby.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖或置于某物之上，以隐藏或保护。
definitions.exampleCn: 毯子盖住了婴儿。

definitions.definition: To be upon all of, so as to completely conceal.
definitions.example: Regular hexagons can cover the plane.
definitions.definitionCn: 完全覆盖所有表面，以彻底隐藏。
definitions.exampleCn: 正六边形可以覆盖平面。

definitions.definition: To set upon all of, so as to completely conceal.
definitions.example: You can cover the plane with regular hexagons.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物完全覆盖所有表面。
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以用正六边形覆盖平面。

definitions.definition: To put on one's hat.
definitions.definitionCn: 戴上帽子。

definitions.definition: To invest (oneself with something); to bring upon (oneself).
definitions.example: The heroic soldier covered himself with glory.
definitions.definitionCn: （使自己）沉浸于（某事物）；招致（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 英勇的士兵赢得了荣耀。

definitions.definition: (of a publication) To discuss thoroughly; to provide coverage of.
definitions.example: The magazine covers such diverse topics as politics, news from the world of science, and the economy.
definitions.definitionCn: （指出版物）详细讨论；提供报道。
definitions.exampleCn: 这本杂志涵盖政治、科学新闻和经济等多样主题。

definitions.definition: To deal with or include someone or something.
definitions.definitionCn: 处理或包括某人或某事。

definitions.definition: To be enough money for.
definitions.example: Ten dollars should cover lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 足够支付某物的钱。
definitions.exampleCn: 十美元应该够付午餐。

definitions.definition: To act as a replacement.
definitions.example: I need to take off Tuesday. Can you cover for me?
definitions.definitionCn: 作为替代者。
definitions.exampleCn: 我周二需要请假。你能替我顶班吗？

definitions.definition: To have as an assignment or responsibility.
definitions.example: Can you cover the morning shift tomorrow? I'll give you off next Monday instead.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为任务或责任。
definitions.exampleCn: 你明天能值早班吗？我下周一给你放假。

definitions.definition: To make a cover version of (a song that was originally recorded by another artist).
definitions.definitionCn: 翻唱（最初由其他艺术家录制的歌曲）。

definitions.definition: (law enforcement) To protect using an aimed firearm and the threat of firing; or to protect using continuous, heaving fire at or in the direction of the enemy so as to force the enemy to remain in cover; or to threaten using an aimed firearm.
definitions.definitionCn: （执法）用瞄准的枪支和开火威胁进行保护；或用持续猛烈的火力向敌人方向射击，迫使敌人保持隐蔽；或用瞄准的枪支进行威胁。

definitions.definition: To provide insurance coverage for.
definitions.example: Does my policy cover accidental loss?
definitions.definitionCn: 提供保险覆盖。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的保单涵盖意外损失吗？

definitions.definition: To copulate with (said of certain male animals such as dogs and horses).
definitions.example: I would like to have my bitch covered next spring.
definitions.definitionCn: （指某些雄性动物如狗和马）与雌性交配。
definitions.exampleCn: 我希望明年春天让我的母狗配种。

definitions.definition: To protect or control (a piece or square).
definitions.example: In order to checkmate a king on the side of the board, the five squares adjacent to the king must all be covered.
definitions.definitionCn: 保护或控制（一个棋子或格子）。
definitions.exampleCn: 要将棋盘边上的王将死，王相邻的五个格子必须全部被控制。

definitions.definition: To extend over a given period of time or range, to occupy, to stretch over a given area.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖特定时间段或范围；占据；延伸至特定区域。

definitions.definition: To defend a particular player or area.
definitions.definitionCn: 防守特定球员或区域。

definitions.definition: Overlaid (with) or enclosed (within something).
definitions.definitionCn: 被覆盖（于某物之下）或包含（于某物之内）。

definitions.definition: Prepared for, or having dealt with, some matter
definitions.example: With my insurance, I am covered for earthquake damage.
definitions.definitionCn: 已准备好处理或已处理某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 有了我的保险，我就能覆盖地震损失。

definitions.definition: Than whom another player has more money available for betting.
definitions.example: John has $100 on the table, while Jill only has $75. John has Jill covered.
definitions.definitionCn: 比另一玩家有更多可下注的钱。
definitions.exampleCn: 约翰桌上有100美元，而吉尔只有75美元。约翰的筹码覆盖了吉尔。

definitions.definition: Wearing one's hat.
definitions.definitionCn: 戴着帽子。

definitions.definition: A small label.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个小标签。

definitions.definition: A children's chasing game in which one player (known as "it") attempts to touch another, who then becomes "it".
definitions.definitionCn: 一种儿童追逐游戏，其中一名玩家（称为“它”）试图触碰另一名玩家，被触碰者随即成为“它”。

definitions.definition: A skin tag, an excrescence of skin.
definitions.definitionCn: 皮赘，皮肤上的赘生物。

definitions.definition: A type of cardboard.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种纸板。

definitions.definition: Graffiti in the form of a stylized signature particular to the artist.
definitions.definitionCn: 以艺术家特有的风格化签名形式呈现的涂鸦。

definitions.definition: A dangling lock of sheep's wool, matted with dung; a dung tag.
definitions.definitionCn: 一绺垂下的羊毛，沾有粪便；粪块标签。

definitions.definition: (authorship) An attribution in narrated dialogue (eg, "he said") or attributed words (e.g. "he thought").
definitions.definitionCn: （作者身份）叙述对话中的归属标注（例如，“他说”）或归因词语（例如，“他想”）。

definitions.definition: The last line (or last two lines) of a song's chorus that is repeated to indicate the end of the song.
definitions.definitionCn: 歌曲副歌的最后一行（或最后两行），重复以表示歌曲结束。

definitions.definition: The last scene of a TV program that often focuses on the program's subplot.
definitions.definitionCn: 电视节目的最后一个场景，通常聚焦于节目的次要情节。

definitions.definition: A vehicle number plate; a medal bearing identification data (animals, soldiers).
definitions.example: The subwoofer in the trunk was so loud, it vibrated the tag like an aluminum can.
definitions.definitionCn: 车辆牌照；带有识别数据的徽章（动物、士兵）。
definitions.exampleCn: 后备箱里的低音炮声音太大，震得标签像铝罐一样抖动。

definitions.definition: An instance of touching the baserunner with the ball or the ball in a gloved hand to rule him "out."
definitions.example: The tag was applied at second for the final out.
definitions.definitionCn: 用球或戴手套的手触碰跑垒员以判其“出局”的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 在二垒处触杀完成最后一出局。

definitions.definition: A piece of markup representing an element in a markup language.
definitions.example: The  tag conveys sarcasm in Internet slang.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示标记语言中元素的标记。
definitions.exampleCn: <讽刺>标签在网络俚语中传达讽刺意味。

definitions.definition: A keyword, term, or phrase associated with or assigned to data, media, and/or information enabling keyword-based classification; often used to categorize content.
definitions.example: I want to add genre and artist tags to the files in my music collection.
definitions.definitionCn: 与数据、媒体和/或信息关联或分配的关键词、术语或短语，支持基于关键词的分类；常用于对内容进行分类。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想给我音乐收藏中的文件添加流派和艺术家标签。

definitions.definition: Any slight appendage, as to an article of dress; something slight hanging loosely.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何轻微的附属物，如衣物上的装饰；松散悬挂的小物件。

definitions.definition: A metallic binding, tube, or point, at the end of a string, or lace, to stiffen it.
definitions.definitionCn: 绳子或鞋带末端的金属绑带、管状物或尖端，用于使其变硬。

definitions.definition: The end, or catchword, of an actor's speech; cue.
definitions.definitionCn: 演员台词的结尾或提示词；提示。

definitions.definition: Something mean and paltry; the rabble.
definitions.definitionCn: 卑劣琐碎的事物；乌合之众。

definitions.definition: A sheep in its first year.
definitions.definitionCn: 一岁大的羊。

definitions.definition: Any short peptide sequence artificially attached to proteins mostly in order to help purify, solubilize or visualize these proteins.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何人工附着在蛋白质上的短肽序列，主要用于帮助纯化、溶解或可视化这些蛋白质。

definitions.definition: A person's name.
definitions.example: What's your tag?
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人的名字。
definitions.exampleCn: 你的标签是什么？

definitions.definition: To label (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 给（某物）贴标签。

definitions.definition: (graffiti) To mark (something) with one’s tag.
definitions.definitionCn: （涂鸦）用某人的标签标记（某物）。

definitions.definition: To remove dung tags from a sheep.
definitions.example: Regularly tag the rear ends of your sheep.
definitions.definitionCn: 从羊身上去除粪块标签。
definitions.exampleCn: 定期清理你羊群后部的粪块。

definitions.definition: To hit the ball hard.
definitions.example: He really tagged that ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 用力击球。
definitions.exampleCn: 他狠狠地击中了那个球。

definitions.definition: To put a runner out by touching them with the ball or the ball in a gloved hand.
definitions.example: He tagged the runner for the out.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过用球或戴手套的手触碰跑垒员使其出局。
definitions.exampleCn: 他触杀跑垒员使其出局。

definitions.definition: To mark with a tag (metadata for classification).
definitions.example: I am tagging my music files by artist and genre.
definitions.definitionCn: 用标签标记（用于分类的元数据）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我正在按艺术家和流派标记我的音乐文件。

definitions.definition: To follow closely, accompany, tag along.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧跟、陪伴、跟随。

definitions.definition: To catch and touch (a player in the game of tag).
definitions.definitionCn: 抓住并触碰（标签游戏中的玩家）。

definitions.definition: To fit with, or as if with, a tag or tags.
definitions.definitionCn: 用标签或类似标签的东西装配。

definitions.definition: To fasten; to attach.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定；附着。

definitions.definition: An act of complying.
definitions.definitionCn: 遵从的行为。
