definitions.definition: To divide into portions and dispense.
definitions.example: He distributed the bread amongst his followers.
definitions.definitionCn: 分成若干份并分发。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将面包分给了他的追随者。

definitions.definition: To supply to retail outlets.
definitions.example: The agency distributes newspapers to local shops.
definitions.definitionCn: 供应给零售店。
definitions.exampleCn: 该机构将报纸分发给当地商店。

definitions.definition: To deliver or pass out.
definitions.example: A network of children distributes flyers to every house.
definitions.definitionCn: 递送或分发。
definitions.exampleCn: 一群孩子将传单分发给每户人家。

definitions.definition: To scatter or spread.
definitions.example: I raked the soil then distributed grass seed.
definitions.definitionCn: 散布或撒播。
definitions.exampleCn: 我耙平土壤后撒下了草籽。

definitions.definition: To apportion (more or less evenly).
definitions.example: The robot's six legs distributed its weight over a wide area.
definitions.definitionCn: （大致均匀地）分配。
definitions.exampleCn: 机器人的六条腿将其重量分散在较大面积上。

definitions.definition: To classify or separate into categories.
definitions.example: The database distributed verbs into transitive and intransitive segments.
definitions.definitionCn: 分类或按类别区分。
definitions.exampleCn: 数据库将动词分为及物和不及物两类。

definitions.definition: To be distributive.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有分配性质。

definitions.definition: To separate (type which has been used) and return it to the proper boxes in the cases.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（用过的铅字）分开并放回字盒中相应的格子。

definitions.definition: To spread (ink) evenly, as upon a roller or a table.
definitions.definitionCn: 均匀地涂抹（油墨），例如在滚筒或台面上。

definitions.definition: To employ (a term) in its whole extent; to take as universal in one premise.
definitions.definitionCn: 在前提中（将术语）作周延使用；即视为全称。

definitions.definition: The fourth letter of the modern Greek alphabet Δ, δ.
definitions.definitionCn: 现代希腊字母表中的第四个字母Δ, δ。

definitions.definition: A landform at the mouth of a river where it empties into a body of water.
definitions.example: Nile Delta
definitions.definitionCn: 河流入海口处形成的地貌。
definitions.exampleCn: 尼罗河三角洲

definitions.definition: The letter D in the ICAO spelling alphabet, which assigns words to letters of the alphabet.
definitions.definitionCn: 国际民航组织拼写字母表中代表字母D的单词，该表为字母表中的字母分配单词。

definitions.definition: The symbol Δ.
definitions.definitionCn: 符号Δ。

definitions.definition: A small but noticeable effect. Compare epsilon.
definitions.example: This will slow the main code path down, but only by delta.
definitions.definitionCn: 微小但可察觉的影响。比较epsilon。
definitions.exampleCn: 这会减慢主代码路径的速度，但仅减慢delta量。

definitions.definition: The set of differences between two versions of a file.
definitions.example: When you update the file, the system will only save the deltas.
definitions.definitionCn: 文件两个版本之间的差异集合。
definitions.exampleCn: 当你更新文件时，系统只会保存差异部分。

definitions.definition: A change in a quantity, likely from "d" for "difference".
definitions.example: ΔV - "delta vee"(change in velocity, used in rocketry and orbital mechanics)
definitions.definitionCn: 量的变化，可能源自表示“差异”的“d”。
definitions.exampleCn: ΔV - “delta vee”（速度变化量，用于火箭学和轨道力学）

definitions.definition: The angle subtended at the center of a circular arc.
definitions.definitionCn: 圆弧中心所对的角。

definitions.definition: A type of cargo bike that has one wheel in front and two in back.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种前一轮后两轮的货运自行车。

definitions.definition: The closed figure produced by connecting three coils or circuits successively, end for end, especially in a three-phase system.
definitions.example: delta winding; delta connection; delta current
definitions.definitionCn: 将三个线圈或电路首尾相连形成的闭合图形，尤其在三相系统中。
definitions.exampleCn: 三角形绕组；三角形接法；三角形电流

definitions.definition: The rate of change in an option value with respect to the underlying asset's price.
definitions.definitionCn: 期权价值相对于标的资产价格的变化率。

definitions.definition: A value in delta notation indicating the relative abundances of isotopes.
definitions.definitionCn: delta符号中表示同位素相对丰度的值。

definitions.definition: (U.S. Space Force) A military unit, nominally headed by a colonel, equivalent to a USAF operations wing, or an army regiment.
definitions.definitionCn: （美国太空军）一个军事单位，名义上由上校领导，相当于美国空军作战联队或陆军团。

definitions.definition: The guinea fowl (family Numididae).
definitions.definitionCn: 珍珠鸡（珠鸡科）。

definitions.definition: A bird in the genus Meleagris with a fan-shaped tail and wattled neck, especially the wild turkey (Meleagris gallopavo, now domesticated).
definitions.definitionCn: 火鸡属鸟类，具有扇形尾羽和肉垂颈，尤指野生火鸡（Meleagris gallopavo，现已驯化）。

definitions.definition: The flesh or meat of this bird eaten as food.
definitions.example: All week after Thanksgiving, I had turkey sandwiches for lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 这种鸟的肉作为食物食用。
definitions.exampleCn: 感恩节后整整一周，我午餐都吃火鸡三明治。

definitions.definition: With a distinguishing word: a bird resembling the Meleagris gallopavo (for example, the bush turkey or brush turkey (Alectura lathami), and the water turkey (Anhinga anhinga)).
definitions.definitionCn: 带修饰词时：类似野生火鸡的鸟类（例如丛林火鸡或灌木火鸡（Alectura lathami），以及水火鸡（Anhinga anhinga））。

definitions.definition: An act of throwing three strikes in a row.
definitions.definitionCn: 连续投出三次好球的行为。

definitions.definition: A patient feigning symptoms; a person faking illness or injury; a malingerer.
definitions.definitionCn: 假装症状的病人；装病或装伤的人；诈病者。

definitions.definition: A pack carried by a lumberman; a bindle; also, a large travel bag, a suitcase.
definitions.definitionCn: 伐木工携带的背包；行囊；也指大型旅行袋、手提箱。

definitions.definition: A failure.
definitions.example: That film was a turkey.
definitions.definitionCn: 失败。
definitions.exampleCn: 那部电影是个失败之作。

definitions.definition: (usually mildly) A foolish or inept person.
definitions.example: The turkey cut in front of me and then berated me for running into him.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常略带贬义）愚蠢或无能的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个笨蛋插队到我前面，还责怪我撞到了他。

definitions.definition: A stage of proficiency or qualification in a course of study, now especially an award bestowed by a university or, in some countries, a college, as a certification of academic achievement. (In the United States, can include secondary schools.)
definitions.example: She has two bachelor's degrees and is studying towards a master's degree.
definitions.definitionCn: 学业阶段中的熟练程度或资格证明，现特指大学（某些国家也包括学院）授予的学术成就认证，如学位证书。（在美国可涵盖中学教育。）
definitions.exampleCn: 她已获得两个学士学位，目前正在攻读硕士学位。

definitions.definition: A unit of measurement of angle equal to 1/360 of a circle's circumference.
definitions.example: A right angle is a ninety-degree angle.
definitions.definitionCn: 角度测量单位，等于圆周的1/360。
definitions.exampleCn: 直角为九十度角。

definitions.definition: A unit of measurement of temperature on any of several scales, such as Celsius or Fahrenheit.
definitions.example: 180 degrees Fahrenheit is equivalent to 100 degrees Celsius.
definitions.definitionCn: 温度测量单位，适用于摄氏或华氏等多种温标。
definitions.exampleCn: 华氏180度相当于摄氏100度。

definitions.definition: The sum of the exponents of a term; the order of a polynomial.
definitions.example: A quadratic polynomial is a polynomial of degree 2.
definitions.definitionCn: 项中指数的总和；多项式的阶数。
definitions.exampleCn: 二次多项式是二阶多项式。

definitions.definition: The dimensionality of a field extension.
definitions.example: The Galois field \operatorname{GF}(125) = \operatorname{GF}(5^3) has degree 3 over its subfield \operatorname{GF}(5).
definitions.definitionCn: 域扩张的维度。
definitions.exampleCn: 伽罗瓦域 \operatorname{GF}(125) = \operatorname{GF}(5^3) 在其子域 \operatorname{GF}(5) 上的阶数为3。

definitions.definition: The number of edges that a vertex takes part in; a valency.
definitions.definitionCn: 顶点参与的边数；价数。

definitions.definition: The number of logical connectives in a formula.
definitions.definitionCn: 公式中逻辑连接词的数量。

definitions.definition: The curvature of a circular arc, expressed as the angle subtended by a fixed length of arc or chord.
definitions.definitionCn: 圆弧的曲率，表示为固定长度弧或弦所对的圆心角。

definitions.definition: A unit of measurement of latitude and longitude which together identify a location on the Earth's surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 经纬度测量单位，共同确定地球表面位置。

definitions.definition: (grammar) Any of the three stages (positive, comparative, superlative) in the comparison of an adjective or an adverb.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）形容词或副词比较级中的三个等级（原级、比较级、最高级）。

definitions.definition: (obsolete outside heraldry) A step on a set of stairs; the rung of a ladder.
definitions.definitionCn: （除纹章学外已过时）楼梯的一级台阶；梯子的横档。

definitions.definition: An individual step, or stage, in any process or scale of values.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何过程或价值尺度中的单个步骤或阶段。

definitions.definition: A stage of rank or privilege; social standing.
definitions.definitionCn: 等级或特权的阶段；社会地位。

definitions.definition: (genealogy) A ‘step’ in genealogical descent.
definitions.definitionCn: （谱系学）世系传承中的“一代”。

definitions.definition: One's relative state or experience; way, manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人的相对状态或经验；方式、方法。

definitions.definition: The amount that an entity possesses a certain property; relative intensity, extent.
definitions.example: To what degree do the two accounts of the accident concur?
definitions.definitionCn: 实体拥有某种属性的程度；相对强度、范围。
definitions.exampleCn: 关于事故的两份描述在多大程度上一致？

definitions.definition: Any North American freshwater fish of certain species of the genus Coregonus that live in cold-water lakes.
definitions.definitionCn: 白鲑属某些种类的北美淡水鱼，生活在冷水湖泊中。

definitions.definition: A person who derives sexual pleasure from secretly observing other people, especially when such people are engaged in some sexual activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 偷窥者：指通过秘密观察他人，尤其是他人从事性行为时获得性快感的人。

definitions.definition: An obsessive observer of sensational or sordid subjects.
definitions.definitionCn: 对耸人听闻或肮脏话题有强迫性观察癖好的人。

definitions.definition: A unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot, or exactly 2.54 centimetres.
definitions.definitionCn: 一英尺的十二分之一，即精确等于2.54厘米的长度单位。

definitions.definition: The amount of water which would cover a surface to the depth of an inch, used as a measurement of rainfall.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖地表至一英寸深的水量，用于测量降雨量。

definitions.definition: The amount of an alcoholic beverage which would fill a glass or bottle to the depth of an inch.
definitions.definitionCn: 装满玻璃杯或瓶子至一英寸深的酒精饮料量。

definitions.definition: A very short distance.
definitions.example: "Don't move an inch!"
definitions.definitionCn: 极短的距离。
definitions.exampleCn: “别动一英寸！”

definitions.definition: (followed by a preposition) To advance very slowly, or by a small amount (in a particular direction).
definitions.example: Fearful of falling, he inched along the window ledge.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接介词）非常缓慢地或少量地（朝特定方向）前进。
definitions.exampleCn: 因害怕坠落，他沿着窗台一寸一寸地挪动。

definitions.definition: To drive by inches, or small degrees.
definitions.definitionCn: 以英寸或微小幅度驱动。

definitions.definition: To deal out by inches; to give sparingly.
definitions.definitionCn: 按英寸分配；吝啬地给予。

definitions.definition: A small island
definitions.definitionCn: 小岛。

definitions.definition: Contentment, ease.
definitions.example: Sleep in comfort with our new mattress.
definitions.definitionCn: 满足，安逸。
definitions.exampleCn: 使用我们的新床垫，舒适入眠。

definitions.definition: Something that offers comfort.
definitions.example: the comforts of home
definitions.definitionCn: 提供舒适之物。
definitions.exampleCn: 家的舒适感。

definitions.definition: A consolation; something relieving suffering or worry.
definitions.example: We still have the spare tire? That's a comfort at least.
definitions.definitionCn: 安慰；缓解痛苦或忧虑的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们还有备胎？这至少是个安慰。

definitions.definition: A cause of relief or satisfaction.
definitions.example: The outcome of the peace negotiations in Moscow in 1940 was a heavy blow to the young nation, but in the same time a great comfort: at least the independency was preserved.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人宽慰或满意之事。
definitions.exampleCn: 1940年莫斯科和平谈判的结果对这个年轻国家是沉重打击，但同时也是莫大的安慰：至少独立得以保全。

definitions.definition: To relieve the distress or suffering of; to provide comfort to.
definitions.example: Rob comforted Aaron because he was lost and very sad.
definitions.definitionCn: 缓解痛苦或苦难；给予安慰。
definitions.exampleCn: 罗布安慰了亚伦，因为他迷路了，非常难过。

definitions.definition: To make comfortable.
definitions.definitionCn: 使舒适。

definitions.definition: To make strong; to invigorate; to fortify; to corroborate.
definitions.definitionCn: 使坚强；使充满活力；使坚固；确证。

definitions.definition: To assist or help; to aid.
definitions.definitionCn: 协助或帮助；援助。

definitions.definition: Organized, large-scale, armed conflict between countries or between national, ethnic, or other sizeable groups, usually involving the engagement of military forces.
definitions.example: The war was largely between Sunni and Shia militants.
definitions.definitionCn: 有组织的、大规模的、国家之间或民族、种族及其他大型群体之间的武装冲突，通常涉及军事力量的参与。
definitions.exampleCn: 这场战争主要发生在逊尼派和什叶派武装分子之间。

definitions.definition: A particular conflict of this kind.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类特定冲突。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Any conflict, or anything resembling a conflict.
definitions.example: You look like you've been through the wars.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）任何冲突，或类似冲突的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 你看起来像是经历了一场大战。

definitions.definition: Instruments of war.
definitions.definitionCn: 战争工具。

definitions.definition: Armed forces.
definitions.definitionCn: 武装力量。

definitions.definition: A particular card game for two players, notable for having its outcome predetermined by how the cards are dealt.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种两人玩的特定纸牌游戏，其特点在于结果由发牌方式预先决定。

definitions.definition: To engage in conflict (may be followed by "with" to specify the foe).
definitions.definitionCn: 参与冲突（后可接"with"指明对手）。

definitions.definition: To carry on, as a contest; to wage.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行（如竞赛）；发动。

definitions.definition: A mythological bird, said to be the only one of its kind, which lives for 500 years and then dies by burning to ashes on a pyre of its own making, ignited by the sun. It then arises anew from the ashes.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种神话中的鸟类，据说是其同类中唯一的存在，寿命长达500年，随后在自建的柴堆上被太阳点燃而焚化成灰，再从灰烬中重生。

definitions.definition: Anything that is reborn after apparently being destroyed.
definitions.example: Astronomers believe planets might form in this dead star's disk, like the mythical Phoenix rising up out of the ashes.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何看似被摧毁后重获新生的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 天文学家认为，行星可能在这颗死亡恒星的星盘中形成，如同神话中的凤凰从灰烬中升起。

definitions.definition: A mythological Chinese chimerical bird whose physical body symbolizes the six celestial bodies.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种神话中的中国幻想鸟类，其身体象征六种天体。

definitions.definition: A Greek silver coin used briefly from 1828 to 1832, divided into 100 lepta.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种希腊银币，于1828年至1832年间短暂流通，分为100雷普塔。

definitions.definition: (heading) To position or be positioned physically.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 物理上定位或处于某位置。

definitions.definition: (heading) To position or be positioned mentally.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 心理上定位或处于某状态。

definitions.definition: (heading) To position or be positioned socially.
definitions.definitionCn: (标题) 社会层面定位或处于某地位。

definitions.definition: Of a ship or its captain, to steer, sail (in a specified direction, for a specified destination etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 指船只或船长，按指定方向、目的地等航行。

definitions.definition: To remain without ruin or injury.
definitions.definitionCn: 保持完好无损。

definitions.definition: To stop asking for more cards; to keep one's hand as it has been dealt so far.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止要牌；保持已发到的手牌。

definitions.definition: Erect, not cut down.
definitions.definitionCn: 直立的，未被砍倒的。

definitions.definition: Performed from an erect position.
definitions.example: standing ovation
definitions.definitionCn: 以直立姿势进行的。
definitions.exampleCn: 起立鼓掌。

definitions.definition: Remaining in force or status.
definitions.example: standing committee
definitions.definitionCn: 持续有效或保持地位的。
definitions.exampleCn: 常务委员会。

definitions.definition: Stagnant; not moving or flowing.
definitions.example: standing water
definitions.definitionCn: 停滞的；不流动的。
definitions.exampleCn: 死水。

definitions.definition: Not transitory; not liable to fade or vanish; lasting.
definitions.example: a standing colour
definitions.definitionCn: 非暂时的；不易褪色或消失的；持久的。
definitions.exampleCn: 不褪色的颜色。

definitions.definition: Not movable; fixed.
definitions.example: a standing bed, distinguished from a trundle-bed
definitions.definitionCn: 不可移动的；固定的。
definitions.exampleCn: 固定床（区别于折叠床）。

definitions.definition: Position or reputation in society or a profession.
definitions.example: He does not have much of a standing as a chemist.

definitions.definition: Duration.
definitions.example: a member of long standing

definitions.definition: The act of a person who stands, or a place where someone stands.
definitions.example: I think in deep mire, where there is no standing. — Psalms lxix. 2.

definitions.definition: The position of a team in a league or of a player in a list.
definitions.example: After their last win, their standing went up three places.

definitions.definition: Room in which to park a vehicle or vehicles
The right of a party to bring a legal action, based on the relationship between that party and the matter to which the action relates.
definitions.example: He may be insulting, a miserable rotter and a fool, but unless he slanders or libels you, or damages your property, you do not have standing to sue him.

definitions.definition: A portion of something, especially a portion given or allotted to someone.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的一部分，尤指分配或分给某人的部分。

definitions.definition: A financial instrument that shows that one owns a part of a company that provides the benefit of limited liability.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种金融工具，表明某人拥有一家公司的部分所有权，并享有有限责任的益处。

definitions.definition: A configuration enabling a resource to be shared over a network.
definitions.example: Upload media from the browser or directly to the file share.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种配置，使资源能够通过网络共享。
definitions.exampleCn: 从浏览器或直接上传媒体到文件共享。

definitions.definition: The action of sharing something with other people via social media.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过社交媒体与他人分享某物的行为。

definitions.definition: The sharebone or pubis.
definitions.definitionCn: 耻骨或耻骨联合。

definitions.definition: To give part of what one has to somebody else to use or consume.
definitions.definitionCn: 将自己拥有的部分给予他人使用或消费。

definitions.definition: To have or use in common.
definitions.example: to share a shelter with another;  They share a language.
definitions.definitionCn: 共同拥有或使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 与他人共享住所；他们共享一种语言。

definitions.definition: To divide and distribute.
definitions.definitionCn: 分割并分配。

definitions.definition: To tell to another.
definitions.example: He shared his story with the press.
definitions.definitionCn: 告知他人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他向媒体分享了他的故事。

definitions.definition: The cutting blade of an agricultural machine like a plough, a cultivator or a seeding-machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 农业机械（如犁、中耕机或播种机）的切割刀片。

definitions.definition: To cut; to shear; to cleave; to divide.
definitions.definitionCn: 切割；剪断；劈开；分割。

definitions.definition: To try to find; to look for; to search for.
definitions.example: I seek wisdom.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图找到；寻找；搜寻。
definitions.exampleCn: 我寻求智慧。

definitions.definition: To ask for; to solicit; to beseech.
definitions.example: I seek forgiveness through prayer.
definitions.definitionCn: 请求；恳求；哀求。
definitions.exampleCn: 我通过祈祷寻求宽恕。

definitions.definition: To try to acquire or gain; to strive after; to aim at.
definitions.example: I sought my fortune on the goldfields.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图获得或争取；努力追求；以……为目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在金矿上寻求财富。

definitions.definition: To go, move, travel (in a given direction).
definitions.definitionCn: 向（特定方向）移动、行进、旅行。

definitions.definition: To try to reach or come to; to go to; to resort to.
definitions.example: When the alarm went off I sought the exit in a panic.

definitions.definition: The act of one who seeks; a search or quest to find something.

definitions.definition: A standard, flag, or insignia:

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The morning ceremony of raising the flag.

definitions.definition: The relative lightness or darkness of a mass of written or printed text on a page. (See type color.)

definitions.definition: Any of the colored balls excluding the reds.
definitions.definitionCn: 除红球外的任何彩色球。

definitions.definition: A front or facade; an ostensible truth actually false; pretext.
definitions.definitionCn: 表面或假象；看似真实实则虚假的托词；借口。

definitions.definition: An appearance of right or authority; color of law.

definitions.definitionCn: 权利或权威的表象；法律上的表面依据。

definitions.definition: To give something color.
definitions.example: We could color the walls red.
definitions.definitionCn: 给某物上色。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们可以把墙壁涂成红色。

definitions.definition: To apply colors to the areas within the boundaries of a line drawing using colored markers or crayons.
definitions.example: My kindergartener loves to color.
definitions.definitionCn: 用彩色马克笔或蜡笔在线稿边界内涂色。
definitions.exampleCn: 我上幼儿园的孩子喜欢涂色。

definitions.definition: (of a person or their face) To become red through increased blood flow.

definitions.definitionCn: （指人或其面部）因血流增加而变红。
definitions.exampleCn: 她意识到自己的错误时，脸红了。

definitions.definition: To affect without completely changing.
definitions.example: That interpretation certainly colors my perception of the book.
definitions.definitionCn: 影响但不完全改变。
definitions.exampleCn: 那种解读无疑影响了我对这本书的看法。

definitions.definition: To attribute a quality to; to portray (as).
definitions.example: Color me confused.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予某种特质；描绘成（某种样子）。
definitions.exampleCn: 把我当成困惑的人吧。

definitions.definition: To assign colors to the vertices of a graph (or the regions of a map) so that no two vertices connected by an edge (regions sharing a border) have the same color.

definitions.definition: (with present-tense constructions) First; beforehand, in advance.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于现在时结构）首先；预先，提前。

definitions.definition: (with past-tense constructions) At an earlier time.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于过去时结构）在更早的时候。

definitions.definition: The act or process by which something is built; construction.

definitions.definitionCn: 建造某物的行为或过程；施工。

definitions.definition: A closed structure with walls and a roof.

definitions.exampleCn: 我姐姐住在那栋公寓楼里。

definitions.definition: The act of certifying.
definitions.definitionCn: 认证的行为。

definitions.definition: The granting of a certificate.
definitions.definitionCn: 证书的授予。

definitions.definition: A professional qualification that certifies a person's ability.
definitions.definitionCn: 证明个人能力的专业资格。

definitions.definition: A strip of material used to mark a place in a book.

definitions.definition: A record of the address of a file or Internet page serving as a shortcut to it.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为快捷方式的文件或互联网页面地址的记录。

definitions.definition: A pointer found in a nonclustered index to a row in a clustered index or a table heap
definitions.definitionCn: 非聚集索引中指向聚集索引或表堆中某行的指针。

definitions.definition: To create a bookmark.
definitions.definitionCn: 创建书签。

definitions.definition: Something extra that is good; an added benefit.
definitions.definitionCn: 额外的好东西；附加的好处。

definitions.definition: An extra sum given as a premium, e.g. to an employee or to a shareholder.
definitions.example: The employee of the week receives a bonus for his excellent work.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为额外奖励的金额，例如给员工或股东的。
definitions.exampleCn: 本周最佳员工因其出色工作获得奖金。

definitions.definition: An addition to the player's score based on performance, e.g. for time remaining.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据表现（如剩余时间）给玩家增加的分数。

definitions.definition: One or more free throws awarded to a team when the opposing team has accumulated enough fouls.
definitions.definitionCn: 当对方球队累计犯规达到一定次数时，判给该队的一次或多次罚球。

definitions.definition: To pay a bonus, premium
definitions.definitionCn: 支付奖金、额外津贴。

definitions.definition: To set in some sort of order.
definitions.definitionCn: 按某种顺序排列。

definitions.definition: To arrange, set in proper order.
definitions.definitionCn: 整理，安排妥当。

definitions.definition: To issue a command to.

definitions.definitionCn: 向某人下达命令。
definitions.exampleCn: 他命令我离开。

definitions.definition: To request some product or service; to secure by placing an order.

definitions.exampleCn: 订购杂货。

definitions.definition: To admit to holy orders; to ordain; to receive into the ranks of the ministry.

definitions.definition: Arrangement in a sequence.

definitions.definitionCn: 按顺序排列。
definitions.exampleCn: 她对学生的表演进行了排名排序。

definitions.definition: The act or ceremony of ordaining, as priests or deacons.

definitions.definition: An exclamation to get attention.

definitions.definition: A request for repetition or explanation; an expression of confusion.

definitions.definition: Designates the first in an order of precedence.

definitions.definition: Designates some bright star, usually the brightest star, of a constellation.

definitions.definition: One of a rotation of meals systematically offered for a lower price at a restaurant.

definitions.definition: A light that illuminates a specific person or thing on the stage.

definitions.definitionCn: 用土坯砖建造的房子。

definitions.definition: An elevated platform on which cannon could be placed.
definitions.definitionCn: 可放置大炮的高架平台。

definitions.definition: An array of similar things.

definitions.definition: A set of small cages where hens are kept for the purpose of farming their eggs.

definitions.definitionCn: 接球手和投手共同组成。

definitions.definition: Two or more major pieces on the same rank, file, or diagonal

definitions.definition: A marching percussion ensemble; a drumline.
definitions.definitionCn: 行进打击乐合奏团；鼓乐队。

definitions.definition: The state of a firearm when it is possible to be fired.
definitions.definitionCn: 枪支处于可击发状态。

definitions.definition: Apparatus for preparing or serving meals.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于准备或供应餐食的器具。

definitions.definition: The portion of the upper human appendage, from the shoulder to the wrist and sometimes including the hand.

definitions.definitionCn: 人体上肢从肩部到手腕的部分，有时也包括手部。

definitions.definition: The extended portion of the upper limb, from the shoulder to the elbow.

definitions.example: The robot arm reached out and placed the part on the assembly line.
definitions.definitionCn: 从物体主体或中心延伸出的细长、或多或少刚硬的部分，例如扶手椅的扶手、起重机臂、眼镜腿或圆规臂。
definitions.exampleCn: 机器人手臂伸出，将零件放在装配线上。

definitions.definition: A bay or inlet off a main body of water.
definitions.example: Shelburne Bay is an arm of Lake Champlain.
definitions.definitionCn: 主水体的海湾或水湾。
definitions.exampleCn: 谢尔本湾是尚普兰湖的一个湖湾。

definitions.definition: A branch of an organization.
definitions.example: the cavalry arm of the military service
definitions.definitionCn: 组织的分支。
definitions.exampleCn: 军种中的骑兵部队。

definitions.definition: Power; might; strength; support.
definitions.example: the arm of the law
definitions.definitionCn: 力量；威力；实力；支持。
definitions.exampleCn: 法律的力量。

definitions.definition: A pitcher
definitions.example: The team needs to sign another arm in the offseason.
definitions.definitionCn: 投手。
definitions.exampleCn: 球队需要在休赛期再签下一名投手。

definitions.definition: One of the two parts of a chromosome.
definitions.definitionCn: 染色体的两个部分之一。

definitions.definition: A group of patients in a medical trial.
definitions.definitionCn: 医学试验中的一组患者。

definitions.definition: (usually used in the plural) A weapon.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）武器。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Heraldic bearings or insignia.
definitions.example: The Duke's arms were a sable gryphon rampant on an argent field.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）纹章图案或徽章。
definitions.exampleCn: 公爵的纹章是银色底色上一只直立的黑狮鹫。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) War; hostilities; deeds or exploits of war.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）战争；敌对行动；战事或战功。

definitions.definition: To take by the arm; to take up in one's arms.
To supply with armour or (later especially) weapons.
definitions.example: The king armed his knights with swords and shields.

definitions.definition: To prepare a tool or a weapon for action; to activate.
definitions.example: Remember to arm the alarm system before leaving for work.

definitions.definition: To cover or furnish with a plate, or with whatever will add strength, force, security, or efficiency.
definitions.example: to arm the hit of a sword; to arm a hook in angling

definitions.definition: To furnish with means of defence; to prepare for resistance; to fortify, in a moral sense.
To take up weapons; to arm oneself.
To fit (a magnet) with an armature.

Hereditary designs and symbols depicted on an escutcheon, sometimes accompanied by other elements of a heraldic achievement, such as a helm, crest, crest coronet, torse, mantling and supporters; described by a blazon.
A stroke; a blow.
definitions.definitionCn: 一击；一打。

definitions.definition: A pulsation or throb.
definitions.example: a beat of the heart; the beat of the pulse
definitions.definitionCn: 一次搏动或跳动。
definitions.exampleCn: 心脏的一次跳动；脉搏的一次跳动。

definitions.definition: A pulse on the beat level, the metric level at which pulses are heard as the basic unit. Thus a beat is the basic time unit of a piece.
definitions.definitionCn: 节拍层级上的一个脉冲，即被感知为基本单位的节拍层级。因此，节拍是一首作品的基本时间单位。

definitions.definition: A rhythm.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种节奏。

definitions.definition: The interference between two tones of almost equal frequency
definitions.definitionCn: 两个频率几乎相同的音调之间的干涉。

definitions.definition: (authorship) A short pause in a play, screenplay, or teleplay, for dramatic or comedic effect; a plot point or story development.
definitions.definitionCn: （创作）戏剧、剧本或电视剧中为戏剧或喜剧效果而设置的短暂停顿；情节要点或故事发展。

definitions.definition: The route patrolled by a police officer or a guard.
definitions.definitionCn: 警察或警卫巡逻的路线。

definitions.definition: (by extension) An area of a person's responsibility, especially
definitions.definitionCn: （引申）某人的职责范围，尤指。

definitions.definition: An act of reporting news or scientific results before a rival; a scoop.
definitions.definitionCn: 在对手之前报道新闻或科学成果的行为；独家新闻。

definitions.definition: That which beats, or surpasses, another or others.
definitions.example: the beat of him
definitions.definitionCn: 胜过或超越他人或他物的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的节奏。

definitions.definition: A precinct.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个辖区。

definitions.definition: A place of habitual or frequent resort.
definitions.definitionCn: 习惯性或频繁光顾的地方。

definitions.definition: A low cheat or swindler.
definitions.example: a dead beat
definitions.definitionCn: 一个低级的骗子或欺诈者。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个彻底疲惫的人。

definitions.definition: The instrumental portion of a piece of hip-hop music.
definitions.definitionCn: 嘻哈音乐中的器乐部分。

definitions.definition: The act of scouring, or ranging over, a tract of land to rouse or drive out game; also, those so engaged, collectively.
definitions.definitionCn: 在土地上搜寻或驱赶猎物的行为；也指从事此活动的人的总称。

definitions.definition: A smart tap on the adversary's blade.
definitions.definitionCn: 对对手剑刃的巧妙轻击。

definitions.definition: To hit; strike
definitions.example: As soon as she heard that her father had died, she went into a rage and beat the wall with her fists until her knuckles bled.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打；打击。
definitions.exampleCn: 她一听说父亲去世，就勃然大怒，用拳头猛击墙壁，直到指关节流血。

definitions.definition: To strike or pound repeatedly, usually in some sort of rhythm.
definitions.example: He danced hypnotically while she beat the atabaque.
definitions.definitionCn: 反复击打或敲打，通常带有某种节奏。
definitions.exampleCn: 她敲打着阿塔巴克鼓，他催眠般地舞动。

definitions.definition: To strike repeatedly; to inflict repeated blows; to knock vigorously or loudly.
definitions.definitionCn: 反复击打；施加连续打击；用力或大声敲击。

definitions.definition: To move with pulsation or throbbing.
definitions.definitionCn: 以搏动或跳动的方式移动。

definitions.definition: To win against; to defeat or overcome; to do better than, outdo, or excel (someone) in a particular, competitive event.
definitions.example: I just can't seem to beat the last level of this video game.
definitions.definitionCn: 战胜；击败或克服；在特定的竞争性事件中比某人做得更好、胜过或超越（某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我似乎就是打不过这个电子游戏的最后一关。

definitions.definition: To sail to windward using a series of alternate tacks across the wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过一系列交替的迎风转向来逆风航行。

definitions.definition: To strike (water, foliage etc.) in order to drive out game; to travel through (a forest etc.) for hunting.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打（水面、树叶等）以驱赶猎物；穿越（森林等）进行狩猎。

definitions.definition: To mix food in a rapid fashion. Compare whip.
definitions.example: Beat the eggs and whip the cream.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速搅拌食物。比较“搅打”。
definitions.exampleCn: 打鸡蛋，搅打奶油。

definitions.definition: (In haggling for a price) of a buyer, to persuade the seller to reduce a price
definitions.example: He wanted $50 for it, but I managed to beat him down to $35.
definitions.definitionCn: （讨价还价时）买方说服卖方降低价格。
definitions.exampleCn: 他想要50美元，但我设法把价格砍到了35美元。

definitions.definition: To indicate by beating or drumming.
definitions.example: to beat a retreat; to beat to quarters
definitions.definitionCn: 通过敲击或击鼓来指示。
definitions.exampleCn: 敲击撤退鼓；敲击集合鼓。

definitions.definition: To tread, as a path.
definitions.definitionCn: 踩踏出（如一条路）。

definitions.definition: To exercise severely; to perplex; to trouble.
definitions.definitionCn: 剧烈锻炼；使困惑；使烦恼。

definitions.definition: To be in agitation or doubt.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于激动或怀疑状态。

definitions.definition: To make a sound when struck.
definitions.example: The drums beat.
definitions.definitionCn: 被击打时发出声音。
definitions.exampleCn: 鼓声响起。

definitions.definition: To make a succession of strokes on a drum.
definitions.example: The drummers beat to call soldiers to their quarters.
definitions.definitionCn: 在鼓上连续敲击。
definitions.exampleCn: 鼓手们击鼓召集士兵到营房。

definitions.definition: To sound with more or less rapid alternations of greater and less intensity, so as to produce a pulsating effect; said of instruments, tones, or vibrations, not perfectly in unison.
definitions.definitionCn: 以快慢交替的强度发出声音，产生脉动效果；指不完全合拍的乐器、音调或振动。

definitions.definition: To arrive at a place before someone.
definitions.example: He beat me there.
definitions.definitionCn: 比某人先到达某个地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 他比我先到那里。

definitions.definition: To have sexual intercourse.
definitions.example: Bruv, she came in just as we started to beat.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生性关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 兄弟，我们刚开始做，她就进来了。

definitions.definition: To rob.
definitions.example: He beat me out of 12 bucks last night.
definitions.definitionCn: 抢劫。
definitions.exampleCn: 他昨晚骗了我12块钱。

definitions.definition: Exhausted
definitions.example: After the long day, she was feeling completely beat.
definitions.definitionCn: 筋疲力尽的。
definitions.exampleCn: 漫长的一天后，她感到完全累垮了。

definitions.definition: Dilapidated, beat up
definitions.example: Dude, you drive a beat car like that and you ain’t gonna get no honeys.
definitions.definitionCn: 破旧的，损坏的。
definitions.exampleCn: 老兄，你开这么破的车，是泡不到妞的。

definitions.definition: Fabulous
definitions.example: Her makeup was beat!
definitions.definitionCn: 极好的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的妆容太棒了！

definitions.definition: Boring
definitions.definitionCn: 无聊的。

definitions.definition: (of a person) ugly
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）丑陋的。

definitions.definition: A beatnik.
In a specific manner, applying to or naming a particular thing or things, expressly, explicitly
definitions.definitionCn: 特定地，适用于或命名某一特定事物，明确地，清晰地

definitions.definition: For a specific purpose or reason
definitions.definitionCn: 出于特定目的或理由

definitions.definition: The act of preserving, guarding, or protecting; the keeping (of a thing) in a safe or entire state; preservation.
definitions.definitionCn: 保存、守卫或保护的行为；使某物处于安全或完整状态；保存。

definitions.definition: Wise use of natural resources.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然资源的明智利用。

definitions.definition: The discipline concerned with protection of biodiversity, the environment, and natural resources
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及保护生物多样性、环境和自然资源的学科。

definitions.definition: Genes and associated characteristics of biological organisms that are unchanged by evolution, for example similar or identical nucleic acid sequences or proteins in different species descended from a common ancestor
definitions.definitionCn: 生物体未受进化改变的基因及相关特征，例如源自共同祖先的不同物种中相似或相同的核酸序列或蛋白质。

definitions.definition: (culture) The protection and care of cultural heritage, including artwork and architecture, as well as historical and archaeological artifacts
definitions.definitionCn: （文化）对文化遗产的保护与照管，包括艺术品、建筑以及历史和考古文物。

definitions.definition: Lack of change in a measurable property of an isolated physical system (conservation of energy, mass, momentum, electric charge, subatomic particles, and fundamental symmetries)
definitions.definitionCn: 孤立物理系统可测量属性的不变性（能量、质量、动量、电荷、亚原子粒子及基本对称性的守恒）。

definitions.definition: To give a formal (usually written) authorization.
definitions.example: It was decided to license Wikipedia under the GFDL.
definitions.definitionCn: 给予正式（通常为书面）授权。
definitions.exampleCn: 决定将维基百科以GFDL协议授权。

definitions.definition: Authorize officially.
definitions.example: I am licensed to practice law in this state.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式批准。
definitions.exampleCn: 我获准在本州执业法律。

definitions.definition: (of a person or enterprise) having been issued with a licence (by the required authority)
definitions.example: Only licensed exterminators can purchase rat poison in this state.
definitions.definitionCn: （个人或企业）已获得（相关机构颁发的）许可证。
definitions.exampleCn: 只有持证灭虫人员才能在本州购买鼠药。

definitions.definition: (of an activity) authorized by licence
definitions.example: Even licensed fishing has a major effect on the fish population in the river.
definitions.definitionCn: （活动）经许可证授权。
definitions.exampleCn: 即使是持证捕鱼也对河流中的鱼类种群产生重大影响。

definitions.definition: An animal kept as a companion.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为伴侣饲养的动物。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Something kept as a companion, including inanimate objects. (pet rock, pet plant, etc.)
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）作为伴侣饲养的事物，包括无生命物体（如宠物石、宠物植物等）。

definitions.definition: One who is excessively loyal to a superior.
definitions.definitionCn: 对上级过度忠诚的人。

definitions.definition: Any person or animal especially cherished and indulged; a darling.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何特别受宠爱和纵容的人或动物；心爱之人。

definitions.definition: To stroke or fondle (an animal).
definitions.definitionCn: 抚摸或爱抚（动物）。

definitions.definition: To stroke or fondle (another person) amorously.
definitions.definitionCn: 以爱抚方式抚摸或爱抚（他人）。

definitions.definition: Of two or more people, to stroke and fondle one another amorously.
definitions.definitionCn: 两人或多人之间以爱抚方式相互抚摸。

definitions.definition: To treat as a pet; to fondle; to indulge.
definitions.example: His daughter was petted and spoiled.
definitions.definitionCn: 像对待宠物一样对待；爱抚；纵容。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的女儿被溺爱宠坏了。

definitions.definition: To be a pet.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为宠物。

definitions.definition: To be peevish; to sulk.
definitions.definitionCn: 闹别扭；生闷气。

definitions.definition: A fit of petulance, a sulk, arising from the impression that one has been offended or slighted.
definitions.definitionCn: 因感到被冒犯或轻视而产生的一阵愠怒、赌气。

definitions.definition: A term of endearment usually applied to women and children.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常用于称呼妇女和儿童的爱称。

definitions.definition: A formal, written request made to an official person or organized body, often containing many signatures.
definitions.definitionCn: 向官员或组织提交的正式书面请求，常附有许多签名。

definitions.definition: A compilation of signatures built in order to exert moral authority in support of a specific cause.
definitions.definitionCn: 为支持特定事业而收集的签名汇编，以施加道德权威。

definitions.definition: A formal written request for judicial action.
definitions.definitionCn: 请求司法行动的正式书面申请。

definitions.definition: A prayer; a supplication; an entreaty.
definitions.definitionCn: 祈祷；恳求；哀求。

definitions.definition: An instance of riding.
definitions.example: Can I have a ride on your bike?
definitions.definitionCn: 骑行的一个实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能借用你的自行车吗？

definitions.definition: A vehicle.
definitions.example: That's a nice ride; what did it cost?
definitions.definitionCn: 一种交通工具。
definitions.exampleCn: 那辆车真不错；花了多少钱？

definitions.definition: An amusement ridden at a fair or amusement park.
definitions.definitionCn: 游乐场或主题公园里的游乐设施。

definitions.definition: A lift given to someone in another person's vehicle.
definitions.example: Can you give me a ride?
definitions.definitionCn: 搭乘他人车辆的机会。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能载我一程吗？

definitions.definition: A road or avenue cut in a wood, for riding; a bridleway or other wide country path.
definitions.definitionCn: 林中供骑行的道路或小径；马道或其他宽阔的乡间小路。

definitions.definition: A saddle horse.
definitions.definitionCn: 一匹供骑乘的马。

definitions.definition: A person (or sometimes a thing or a place) that is visually attractive.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个（有时指事物或地方）视觉上吸引人的人。

definitions.definition: In jazz, to play in a steady rhythmical style.
definitions.definitionCn: 在爵士乐中，以稳定的节奏风格演奏。

definitions.definition: To transport oneself by sitting on and directing a horse, later also a bicycle etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过骑坐并驾驭马匹来移动自身，后来也指自行车等。

definitions.definition: To be transported in a vehicle; to travel as a passenger.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘坐车辆；作为乘客旅行。

definitions.definition: (chiefly US and South Africa) To transport (someone) in a vehicle.
definitions.example: The cab rode him downtown.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于美国和南非）用车运送（某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 出租车把他送到了市中心。

definitions.definition: Of a ship: to sail, to float on the water.
definitions.definitionCn: 指船：航行，漂浮在水面上。

definitions.definition: To be carried or supported by something lightly and quickly; to travel in such a way, as though on horseback.
definitions.example: The witch cackled and rode away on her broomstick.
definitions.definitionCn: 被某物轻盈快速地承载或支撑；以这种方式旅行，如同骑马一般。
definitions.exampleCn: 女巫咯咯笑着，骑着扫帚飞走了。

definitions.definition: To traverse by riding.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过骑行穿越。

definitions.definition: To convey, as by riding; to make or do by riding.
definitions.example: How many races have you ridden this year?
definitions.definitionCn: 通过骑行来运送；通过骑行完成或实现。
definitions.exampleCn: 你今年参加了多少场比赛？

definitions.definition: To support a rider, as a horse; to move under the saddle.
definitions.example: A horse rides easy or hard, slow or fast.
definitions.definitionCn: 指马：支撑骑手；在马鞍下移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 马骑起来或轻松或费力，或慢或快。

definitions.definition: To mount (someone) to have sex with them; to have sexual intercourse with.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑上（某人）与之发生性关系；进行性交。

definitions.definition: To nag or criticize; to annoy (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 唠叨或批评；惹恼（某人）。

definitions.definition: Of clothing: to gradually move (up) and crease; to ruckle.
definitions.definitionCn: 指衣物：逐渐上移并起皱；形成褶皱。

definitions.definition: To rely, depend (on).
definitions.definitionCn: 依赖，依靠（于）。

definitions.definition: Of clothing: to rest (in a given way on a part of the body).
definitions.definitionCn: 指衣物：以特定方式贴合在身体某部位。

definitions.definition: To play defense on the defensemen or midfielders, as an attackman.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为攻击手，防守后卫或中场球员。

definitions.definition: To manage insolently at will; to domineer over.
definitions.definitionCn: 傲慢地随意支配；专横地对待。

definitions.definition: To overlap (each other); said of bones or fractured fragments.
definitions.definitionCn: （指骨头或骨折碎片）相互重叠。

definitions.definition: To monitor (some component of an audiovisual signal) in order to keep it within acceptable bounds.
definitions.definitionCn: 监控（音视频信号的某个部分）以使其保持在可接受范围内。

definitions.definition: In jazz, a steady rhythmical style.
definitions.definitionCn: 在爵士乐中，一种稳定的节奏风格。

definitions.definition: Two similar or identical things taken together; often followed by of.
definitions.example: I couldn't decide which of the pair of designer shirts I preferred, so I bought the pair.
definitions.definitionCn: 两个相似或相同的事物放在一起；常接of。
definitions.exampleCn: 我无法决定两件设计师衬衫中更喜欢哪一件，于是两件都买了。

definitions.definition: Two people in a relationship, partnership or friendship.
definitions.example: Spouses should make a great pair.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于恋爱、合作或友谊关系中的两个人。
definitions.exampleCn: 夫妻应该是一对佳偶。

definitions.definition: Used with binary nouns (often in the plural to indicate multiple instances, since such nouns are plural only, except in some technical contexts)
definitions.example: a pair of scissors; two pairs of spectacles; several pairs of jeans
definitions.definitionCn: 用于二元名词（通常用复数表示多个实例，因为这类名词除某些技术语境中外只有复数形式）。
definitions.exampleCn: 一把剪刀；两副眼镜；几条牛仔裤。

definitions.definition: A couple of working animals attached to work together, as by a yoke.
definitions.example: A pair is harder to drive than two mounts with separate riders.
definitions.definitionCn: 一对被套在一起共同工作的役畜，如用轭连接。
definitions.exampleCn: 一对牲口比两个单独骑手驾驭的马更难驱赶。

definitions.definition: A poker hand that contains two cards of identical rank, which cannot also count as a better hand.
definitions.definitionCn: 一手扑克牌中包含两张相同点数的牌，且不能算作更大的牌型。

definitions.definition: A score of zero runs (a duck) in both innings of a two-innings match.
definitions.definitionCn: 在两局制比赛中，两局均得零分（鸭蛋）。

definitions.definition: A double play, two outs recorded in one play.
definitions.example: They turned a pair to end the fifth.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次双杀，在一次防守中完成两次出局。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们在第五局完成了一次双杀。

definitions.definition: A doubleheader, two games played on the same day between the same teams
definitions.example: The Pirates took a pair from the Phillies.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一球队在同一天进行的两场比赛。
definitions.exampleCn: 海盗队从费城人队手中赢得了一组双赛。

definitions.definition: A boat for two sweep rowers.
definitions.definitionCn: 供两名桨手划的船。

definitions.definition: A pair of breasts
definitions.example: She's got a gorgeous pair.
definitions.definitionCn: 一对乳房。
definitions.exampleCn: 她有一对漂亮的乳房。

definitions.definition: The exclusion of one member of a parliamentary party from a vote, if a member of the other party is absent for important personal reasons.
definitions.definitionCn: 因对方议员因重要个人原因缺席时，本方一名议员放弃投票。

definitions.definition: Two members of opposite parties or opinion, as in a parliamentary body, who mutually agree not to vote on a given question, or on issues of a party nature during a specified time.
definitions.example: There were two pairs on the final vote.
definitions.definitionCn: 议会中对立政党或意见的两名成员，在特定时间内相互同意不投票表决某一问题或党派性质议题。
definitions.exampleCn: 最终投票中有两对议员达成了配对。

definitions.definition: A number of things resembling one another, or belonging together; a set.
definitions.definitionCn: 若干相似或属于同一类的事物；一组。

definitions.definition: (kinematics) In a mechanism, two elements, or bodies, which are so applied to each other as to mutually constrain relative motion; named in accordance with the motion it permits, as in turning pair, sliding pair, twisting pair.
definitions.definitionCn: （运动学）机构中两个相互约束相对运动的构件；根据允许的运动类型命名，如转动副、滑动副、螺旋副。

definitions.definition: A special place (for hiding or viewing)
definitions.definitionCn: 一个特殊的地方（用于隐藏或观看）。

definitions.definition: A spectacular mark (catch) in Australian rules football.
definitions.definitionCn: 澳式足球中一次精彩的接球。

definitions.definition: A reduction in consumer cost (usually for a limited time) for items or services rendered.
definitions.example: We're running a special on turkey for Thanksgiving.
definitions.definitionCn: 为商品或服务提供的（通常限时）消费者优惠。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们正在为感恩节推出火鸡特价。

definitions.definition: One of a rotation of meals systematically offered for a lower price at a restaurant.
definitions.example: Today's special is our tuna melt on rye.
definitions.definitionCn: 餐厅定期以低价轮换供应的餐品之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 今日特供是黑麦金枪鱼融化三明治。

definitions.definition: Unusual or exceptional episode of a series.
definitions.example: Did you see the Christmas special?
definitions.definitionCn: 系列剧中不寻常或特别的单集。
definitions.exampleCn: 你看了圣诞特辑吗？

definitions.definition: A special constable.
definitions.definitionCn: 特别警察。

definitions.definition: Anything that is not according to normal practice, plan, or schedule, as an unscheduled run of transportation that is normally scheduled.
definitions.example: Thousands came to see the special that carried the President's coffin.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何不符合常规做法、计划或安排的事物，如通常有固定班次的交通线路的临时加车。
definitions.exampleCn: 数千人前来观看运送总统灵柩的专列。

definitions.definition: Any unlicensed medicine produced or obtained for a specific individual patient.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定患者生产或获取的未经许可的药物。

definitions.definition: A correspondent; a journalist sent to the scene of an event to report back.
definitions.definitionCn: 记者；被派往事件现场进行报道的新闻工作者。

definitions.definition: A dispatch sent back by a special correspondent.
definitions.definitionCn: 特派记者发回的报道。

definitions.definition: A light that illuminates a specific person or thing on the stage.
definitions.definitionCn: 舞台上照亮特定人物或物体的灯光。

definitions.definition: Someone who is an expert in, or devoted to, some specific branch of study or research.
definitions.definitionCn: 专注于某一特定学科或研究领域的专家。

definitions.definition: A physician whose practice is limited to a particular branch of medicine or surgery.
definitions.definitionCn: 执业范围限于某一医学或外科分支的医生。

definitions.definition: Any of several non-commissioned ranks corresponding to that of corporal.
definitions.definitionCn: 与下士对应的若干军士军衔之一。

definitions.definition: An organism that is specialized for a particular environment.
definitions.example: The tree Lepidothamnus laxifolius is a high alpine specialist found in high-altitude bog communities and in scrub.
definitions.definitionCn: 适应特定环境的生物。
definitions.exampleCn: 树状植物Lepidothamnus laxifolius是一种高海拔沼泽群落和灌木丛中的高山特化种。

definitions.definition: The act or process of specializing.
definitions.definitionCn: 专门化的行为或过程。

definitions.definition: The area in which someone specializes.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人专攻的领域。

definitions.definition: The adaptation of an organism to a specific environment, or adaptation of an organ to a particular function.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物对特定环境的适应，或器官对特定功能的适应。

definitions.definition: A proof, axiom, problem, or definition whose cases are completely covered by another, broader concept.
definitions.example: A triangle is a specialization of a polygon to one with exactly three sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 其情形完全被另一个更广泛概念涵盖的证明、公理、问题或定义。
definitions.exampleCn: 三角形是多边形的一种特化，特指恰好有三条边的多边形。

definitions.definition: An explicit set of requirements to be satisfied by a material, product, or service.
definitions.definitionCn: 对材料、产品或服务需满足的明确要求集。

definitions.definition: An act of specifying.
definitions.definitionCn: 指定的行为。

definitions.definition: A person or thing that specifies.
definitions.definitionCn: 指定的人或事物。

definitions.definition: A component of a phrase that is non-recursive and not found as a sister of the head of the phrase, but rather as a daughter of the maximal projection of the phrase.
definitions.definitionCn: 短语中非递归且不位于短语中心语姐妹位置，而是位于短语最大投射子节点位置的成分。

definitions.definition: A pair of lenses set in a frame worn on the nose and ears in order to correct deficiencies in eyesight or to ornament the face.
definitions.definitionCn: 一副装在镜架中、佩戴于鼻梁和耳朵上以矫正视力缺陷或装饰面部的镜片。

definitions.definition: The process of thinking or meditating on a subject.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某一主题进行思考或沉思的过程。

definitions.definition: The act or process of reasoning a priori from premises given or assumed.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据给定或假定的前提进行先验推理的行为或过程。

definitions.definition: A conclusion to which the mind comes by speculating; mere theory; notion; conjecture.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过推测得出的结论；纯理论；想法；猜想。

definitions.definition: An investment involving higher-than-normal risk in order to obtain a higher-than-normal return.
definitions.definitionCn: 为获得高于正常回报而承担高于正常风险的投资。

definitions.definition: The act or practice of buying land, goods, shares, etc., in expectation of selling at a higher price, or of selling with the expectation of repurchasing at a lower price; a trading on anticipated fluctuations in price, as distinguished from trading in which the profit expected is the difference between the retail and wholesale prices, or the difference of price in different markets.
definitions.definitionCn: 购买土地、商品、股票等以期高价卖出，或卖出以期低价回购的行为或实践；基于预期价格波动的交易，区别于预期利润为零售与批发价差或不同市场价格差的交易。

definitions.definition: Examination by the eye; view.
definitions.definitionCn: 用眼睛检查；观看。

definitions.definition: Power of sight.
definitions.definitionCn: 视力。

definitions.definition: A card game in which the players buy from one another trumps or whole hands, upon a chance of getting the highest trump dealt, which entitles the holder to the pool of stakes.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种纸牌游戏，玩家根据可能获得最大王牌的机会互相购买王牌或整手牌，持有最大王牌者赢得全部赌注。

definitions.definition: The process of anticipating which branch of code will be chosen and executing it in advance.
definitions.definitionCn: 预测将执行哪条代码分支并提前执行的过程。

definitions.definition: A university professor, particularly one at Oxford or Cambridge.
definitions.definitionCn: 一位大学教授，尤其是牛津或剑桥的教授。

definitions.definition: An employee of a university residence who lives among the student residents.
definitions.definitionCn: 大学宿舍中与学生同住的员工。

definitions.definition: A mafia boss.
definitions.definitionCn: 黑手党头目。

definitions.definition: Any man, bloke, dude.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何男人，家伙，哥们。

definitions.definition: (clothing) To put on, to dress in.
definitions.example: To don one's clothes.

definitions.definition: To make a record of information.
definitions.example: I wanted to record every detail of what happened, for the benefit of future generations.
definitions.definitionCn: 记录信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 为了后代，我想记录下所发生的一切细节。

definitions.definition: To make an audio or video recording of.
definitions.example: Within a week they had recorded both the song and the video for it.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行音频或视频录制。
definitions.exampleCn: 一周内，他们录制了这首歌及其音乐视频。

definitions.definition: To give legal status to by making an official public record.
definitions.example: When the deed was recorded, we officially owned the house.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过制作官方公开记录赋予法律地位。
definitions.exampleCn: 当契约被记录后，我们就正式拥有了这栋房子。

definitions.definition: To fix in a medium, usually in a tangible medium.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定在某种介质中，通常是有形介质。

definitions.definition: To make an audio, video, or multimedia recording.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作音频、视频或多媒体录音。

definitions.definition: To repeat; to practice.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复；练习。

definitions.definition: To sing or repeat a tune.
definitions.definitionCn: 哼唱或重复一段曲调。

definitions.definition: To reflect; to ponder.
definitions.definitionCn: 反思；思考。

definitions.definition: That has been fixed into a physical medium (for example, a book, compact disc or videotape).
definitions.example: Recorded music comes in many forms.
definitions.definitionCn: 已被固定到物理介质中（例如书籍、光盘或录像带）。
definitions.exampleCn: 录制的音乐有多种形式。

definitions.definition: A midday meal (in a context in which the evening meal is called supper or tea).
definitions.definitionCn: 午餐（在晚餐被称为supper或tea的语境中）。

definitions.definition: The main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening.
definitions.definitionCn: 一天中的主餐，通常在晚上食用。

definitions.definition: An evening meal.
definitions.definitionCn: 晚餐。

definitions.definition: A meal given to an animal.
definitions.example: Give the dog its dinner.
definitions.definitionCn: 给动物的一餐。
definitions.exampleCn: 给狗喂食。

definitions.definition: A formal meal for many people eaten for a special occasion.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特殊场合举办的多人正式餐宴。

definitions.definition: The food provided or consumed at any such meal.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何此类餐食中提供或消耗的食物。

definitions.definition: To eat a dinner.
definitions.definitionCn: 吃一顿正餐。

definitions.definition: To provide (someone) with a dinner.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（某人）提供正餐。

definitions.definition: To complete (something).
definitions.example: Be sure to finish your homework before you go to bed!
definitions.definitionCn: 完成（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 睡觉前一定要完成作业！

definitions.definition: To apply a treatment to (a surface or similar).
definitions.example: The furniture was finished in teak veneer.
definitions.definitionCn: 对（表面或类似物）进行涂饰处理。
definitions.exampleCn: 这件家具是用柚木贴面涂饰的。

definitions.definition: To change an animal's food supply in the months before it is due for slaughter, with the intention of fattening the animal.
definitions.example: Due to BSE, cows in the United Kingdom must be finished and slaughtered before 30 months of age.
definitions.definitionCn: 在动物预定屠宰前的几个月内改变其饲料供应，以使其增肥。
definitions.exampleCn: 由于疯牛病，英国的牛必须在30个月大之前完成育肥并屠宰。

definitions.definition: To come to an end.
definitions.example: We had to leave before the concert had finished.
definitions.definitionCn: 结束。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们不得不在音乐会结束前离开。

definitions.definition: To put an end to; to destroy.
definitions.example: These rumours could finish your career.
definitions.definitionCn: 终结；摧毁。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些谣言可能毁掉你的事业。

definitions.definition: Processed or perfected.
definitions.example: He gave a very finished, but uninspired performance.
definitions.definitionCn: 精制的；完美的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他表演得很精致，但缺乏灵感。

definitions.definition: Completed; concluded; done.
definitions.example: He wasn't finished cleaning up until nearly noon.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成的；结束的；做完了的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他直到将近中午才清理完毕。

definitions.definition: Done for; doomed; used up.
definitions.definitionCn: 完蛋了；注定失败；用光了。

definitions.definition: A professional person qualified (as by a law degree or bar exam) and authorized to practice law, i.e. represent parties in lawsuits or trials and give legal advice.
definitions.example: A lawyer's time and advice are his stock in trade. - aphorism often credited to Abraham Lincoln, but without attestation
definitions.definitionCn: 具备法律学位或通过律师资格考试的专业人士，被授权从事法律实务，即在诉讼或审判中代表当事人并提供法律咨询。
definitions.exampleCn: 律师的时间和建议是他的谋生资本。——这句常被归于亚伯拉罕·林肯的格言，但缺乏确凿证据。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A legal layman who argues points of law.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）指非法律专业人士却就法律要点进行辩论的人。

definitions.definition: The burbot.
definitions.definitionCn: 江鳕。

definitions.definition: The stem of a bramble.
definitions.definitionCn: 荆棘的茎干。

definitions.definition: To practice law.
definitions.definitionCn: 从事法律实务。

definitions.definition: To perform, or attempt to perform, the work of a lawyer.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行或尝试执行律师的工作。

definitions.definition: To make legalistic arguments.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行法律条文式的辩论。

definitions.definition: To barrage (a person) with questions in order to get them to admit something.
definitions.example: You've been lawyered!
definitions.definitionCn: 用连番提问迫使某人承认某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 你被律师套路了！

definitions.definition: An inclination in a particular direction.
definitions.example: the trend of a coastline
definitions.definitionCn: 特定方向的倾向。
definitions.exampleCn: 海岸线的走向。

definitions.definition: A tendency.
definitions.example: There is a trend, these days, for people in films not to smoke.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种趋势。
definitions.exampleCn: 如今，电影中的人物不吸烟成了一种趋势。

definitions.definition: A fad or fashion style.
definitions.example: Miniskirts were one of the biggest trends of the 1960s.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种时尚或流行风格。
definitions.exampleCn: 迷你裙是20世纪60年代最大的潮流之一。

definitions.definition: A line drawn on a graph that approximates the trend of a number of disparate points.
definitions.definitionCn: 在图表上绘制的一条线，近似于多个离散点的趋势。

definitions.definition: The lower end of the shank of an anchor, being the same distance on the shank from the throat that the arm measures from the throat to the bill.
definitions.definitionCn: 锚杆的下端，从锚喉到锚杆的距离与锚臂从锚喉到锚尖的距离相同。

definitions.definition: The angle made by the line of a vessel's keel and the direction of the anchor cable, when she is swinging at anchor.
definitions.definitionCn: 当船只抛锚摆动时，船体龙骨线与锚链方向所形成的角度。

definitions.definition: To have a particular direction; to run; to stretch; to tend.
definitions.example: The shore of the sea trends to the southwest.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有特定方向；延伸；伸展；趋向。
definitions.exampleCn: 海岸线向西南方向延伸。

definitions.definition: To cause to turn; to bend.
definitions.definitionCn: 使转向；弯曲。

definitions.definition: To be the subject of a trend; to be currently popular, relevant or interesting.
definitions.example: What topics have been trending on social networks this week?
definitions.definitionCn: 成为趋势的主题；当前流行、相关或有趣。
definitions.exampleCn: 本周社交网络上哪些话题是热门？

definitions.definition: To cleanse or clean (something, usually wool).
definitions.definitionCn: 清洗或清洁（某物，通常是羊毛）。

definitions.definition: An area of land set aside for environment preservation or recreation.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片为环境保护或休闲娱乐而划定的土地。

definitions.definition: A wide, flat-bottomed valley in a mountainous region.
definitions.definitionCn: 山区中宽阔平坦的谷地。

definitions.definition: An area used for specific purposes.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于特定用途的区域。

definitions.definition: An inventory of matériel.
definitions.example: A country's tank park or artillery park.
definitions.definitionCn: 物资清单。
definitions.exampleCn: 国家的坦克停放场或炮兵停放场。

definitions.definition: A space in which to leave a car; a parking space.
definitions.definitionCn: 停放汽车的空间；停车位。

definitions.definition: To bring (something such as a vehicle) to a halt or store in a specified place.
definitions.example: I parked the drive heads of my hard disk before travelling with my laptop.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（车辆等）停下或存放在指定地点。
definitions.exampleCn: 携带笔记本电脑旅行前，我停用了硬盘的磁头。

definitions.definition: To defer (a matter) until a later date.
definitions.example: Let's park that until next week's meeting.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某事项）推迟到以后处理。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们把那件事留到下周会议再议。

definitions.definition: To bring together in a park, or compact body.
definitions.example: to park artillery, wagons, automobiles, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 在公园或紧凑的群体中聚集。
definitions.exampleCn: 停放火炮、马车、汽车等。

definitions.definition: To enclose in a park, or as in a park.
definitions.definitionCn: 围入公园或类似公园的区域。

definitions.definition: To hit a home run, to hit the ball out of the park.
definitions.example: He really parked that one.
definitions.definitionCn: 击出本垒打，将球击出公园。
definitions.exampleCn: 他那一球真打远了。

definitions.definition: To engage in romantic or sexual activities inside a nonmoving vehicle.
definitions.example: They stopped at a romantic overlook, shut off the engine, and parked.
definitions.definitionCn: 在停驻的车辆内进行浪漫或性行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们在浪漫的观景点停下，熄火，停车。

definitions.definition: (sometimes reflexive) To sit, recline, or put, especially in a manner suggesting an intent to remain for some time.
definitions.example: He came in and parked himself in our living room.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时用反身形式）坐下、躺下或放置，尤指以打算停留一段时间的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 他进来后就在我们客厅里坐下了。

definitions.definition: To invest money temporarily in an investment instrument considered to relatively free of risk, especially while awaiting other opportunities.
definitions.example: We decided to park our money in a safe, stable, low-yield bond fund until market conditions improve.
definitions.definitionCn: 将资金暂时投资于被认为风险较低的金融工具，尤其等待其他机会时。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们决定将资金投入安全、稳定、低收益的债券基金，直到市场状况改善。

definitions.definition: To register a domain name, but make no use of it (See domain parking)
definitions.definitionCn: 注册域名但不使用（参见域名停放）。

definitions.definition: (oyster culture) To enclose in a park, or partially enclosed basin.
definitions.definitionCn: （牡蛎养殖）围入公园或部分封闭的水池。

definitions.definition: To promenade or drive in a park.
definitions.definitionCn: 在公园里散步或驾车。

definitions.definition: (of horses) To display style or gait on a park drive.
definitions.definitionCn: （指马匹）在公园车道上展示步态或步伐。

definitions.definition: A part of a larger whole, usually in such a form that it is able to be separated from other parts.
definitions.example: I’d like another piece of pie.
definitions.definitionCn: 整体的一部分，通常以可与其他部分分离的形式存在。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想再来一块馅饼。

definitions.definition: A single item belonging to a class of similar items
definitions.example: a piece of machinery
definitions.definitionCn: 属于同类物品中的单个项目。
definitions.exampleCn: 一台机器。

definitions.definition: One of the figures used in playing chess, specifically a higher-value figure as distinguished from a pawn; by extension, a similar counter etc. in other games.
definitions.definitionCn: 国际象棋中使用的棋子之一，特指比兵价值更高的棋子；引申义，其他游戏中类似的筹码等。

definitions.definition: A coin, especially one valued at less than the principal unit of currency.
definitions.example: a sixpenny piece
definitions.definitionCn: 一枚硬币，尤其是价值低于主要货币单位的硬币。
definitions.exampleCn: 一枚六便士硬币。

definitions.definition: An artistic creation, such as a painting, sculpture, musical composition, literary work, etc.
definitions.example: She played two beautiful pieces on the piano.
definitions.definitionCn: 一件艺术作品，如绘画、雕塑、音乐作品、文学作品等。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在钢琴上弹奏了两首优美的曲子。

definitions.definition: An article published in the press.
definitions.example: Today's paper has an interesting piece on medical research.
definitions.definitionCn: 报刊上发表的一篇文章。
definitions.exampleCn: 今天的报纸上有一篇关于医学研究的有趣文章。

definitions.definition: An artillery gun.
definitions.definitionCn: 一门火炮。

definitions.definition: A gun.
definitions.example: He's packin' a piece!
definitions.definitionCn: 一把枪。
definitions.exampleCn: 他带着家伙！

definitions.definition: (short for hairpiece) A toupee or wig, especially when worn by a man.
definitions.example: The announcer is wearing a new piece.
definitions.definitionCn: （假发的简称）假发或发套，尤指男性佩戴的。
definitions.exampleCn: 播音员戴着一顶新假发。

definitions.definition: A slice or other quantity of bread, eaten on its own; a sandwich or light snack.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片或一定量的面包，单独食用；三明治或轻便小吃。

definitions.definition: A sexual encounter; from piece of ass or piece of tail

definitions.definitionCn: 一次性行为；源自"piece of ass"或"piece of tail"。
definitions.exampleCn: 我午饭时搞了一次。

definitions.definition: (mildly, short for piece of crap/piece of shit) A shoddy or worthless object (usually applied to consumer products like vehicles or appliances).
definitions.example: Ugh, my new computer is such a piece. I'm taking it back to the store tomorrow.
definitions.definitionCn: （略贬义，为"piece of crap/piece of shit"的简称）劣质或无价值的物品（通常用于车辆或电器等消费品）。
definitions.exampleCn: 唉，我的新电脑真是个破烂货。我明天要把它退回商店。

definitions.definition: A cannabis pipe.
definitions.definitionCn: 一支大麻烟斗。

definitions.definition: Used to describe a pitch that has been hit but not well, usually either being caught by the opposing team or going foul. Usually used in the past tense with got.
definitions.example: he got a piece of that one;  she got a piece of the ball [...] and it's going foul.

definitions.exampleCn: 他打中了那个球；她碰到了球……然后球出界了。

definitions.definition: (sometimes derogatory) An individual; a person.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时带贬义）一个人；个体。

definitions.definition: A castle; a fortified building.
definitions.definitionCn: 一座城堡；一座防御工事。

definitions.definition: A pacifier; a dummy.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个安抚奶嘴；一个假奶嘴。

definitions.definition: A distance.
definitions.example: a fair piece off
definitions.definitionCn: 一段距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 相当远的一段距离。

definitions.definition: A structured practice row, often used for performance evaluation.
definitions.example: At practice we rowed four 5,000 meter pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次结构化的划船练习，常用于表现评估。
definitions.exampleCn: 训练时我们划了四次5000米。

definitions.definition: An amount of work to be done at one time; a unit of piece work.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次要完成的工作量；计件工作单位。

definitions.definition: (usually with together) To assemble (something real or figurative).

definitions.definitionCn: （常与"together"连用）组装（实物或抽象事物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些线索使我们能够拼凑出谜团的答案。

definitions.definition: To make, enlarge, or repair, by the addition of a piece or pieces; to patch; often with out.
definitions.example: to piece a garment
definitions.definitionCn: 通过添加一块或多块来制作、扩大或修补；常与"out"连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 修补一件衣服。

definitions.definition: To produce a work of graffiti more complex than a tag.
definitions.definitionCn: 创作比标签更复杂的涂鸦作品。

definitions.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
definitions.example: I just got back from my morning run.
definitions.definitionCn: 奔跑的行为或实例，即用脚快速移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我刚结束晨跑回来。

definitions.definition: Act or instance of hurrying (to or from a place) (not necessarily by foot); dash or errand, trip.
definitions.example: I need to make a run to the store.
definitions.definitionCn: 匆忙（前往或离开某地）的行为或实例（不一定靠脚）；短途差事或行程。
definitions.exampleCn: 我需要去商店跑一趟。

definitions.definition: A pleasure trip.
definitions.example: Let's go for a run in the car.
definitions.definitionCn: 休闲之旅。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们开车兜风去吧。

definitions.definition: Flight, instance or period of fleeing.
definitions.definitionCn: 逃跑，逃离的实例或时期。

definitions.definition: Migration (of fish).
definitions.definitionCn: （鱼类的）洄游。

definitions.definition: A group of fish that migrate, or ascend a river for the purpose of spawning.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群为产卵而迁徙或溯河而上的鱼。

definitions.definition: A path taken by literal movement or figuratively
definitions.definitionCn: 字面或比喻意义上的路径。

definitions.definition: An enclosure for an animal; a track or path along which something can travel.
definitions.example: He set up a rabbit run.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物的围场；某物可沿其移动的轨道或路径。
definitions.exampleCn: 他建了一个兔子围场。

definitions.definition: Rural landholding for farming, usually for running sheep, and operated by a runholder.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于 farming 的农村土地持有，通常用于牧羊，由牧场主经营。

definitions.definition: State of being current; currency; popularity.
definitions.definitionCn: 当前的状态；流通；流行。

definitions.definition: Continuous or sequential
definitions.definitionCn: 连续或顺序的。

definitions.definition: A flow of liquid; a leak.
definitions.example: The constant run of water from the faucet annoys me.
definitions.definitionCn: 液体的流动；泄漏。
definitions.exampleCn: 水龙头不断流水让我很烦。

definitions.definition: (West Virginia) A small creek or part thereof. (Compare Southern US branch and New York and New England brook.)

definitions.definitionCn: （西弗吉尼亚）一条小溪或其部分。（比较美国南部的 branch 和纽约及新英格兰的 brook。）
definitions.exampleCn: 那条小溪附近的军事战役被称为“公牛溪战役”。

definitions.definition: A quick pace, faster than a walk.
definitions.example: He broke into a run.
definitions.definitionCn: 比步行更快的步伐。
definitions.exampleCn: 他突然跑了起来。

definitions.definition: A sudden series of demands on a bank or other financial institution, especially characterised by great withdrawals.
definitions.example: Financial insecurity led to a run on the banks, as customers feared for the security of their savings.
definitions.definitionCn: 对银行或其他金融机构的突然系列需求，尤其以大量提款为特征。
definitions.exampleCn: 金融不稳定导致银行挤兑，因为客户担心储蓄安全。

definitions.definition: Any sudden large demand for something.
definitions.example: There was a run on Christmas presents.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某物的任何突然大量需求。
definitions.exampleCn: 圣诞礼物出现了抢购潮。

definitions.definition: Various horizontal dimensions or surfaces
definitions.definitionCn: 各种水平尺寸或表面。

definitions.definition: A standard or unexceptional group or category.
definitions.example: He stood out from the usual run of applicants.
definitions.definitionCn: 标准或普通的群体或类别。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在通常的申请者中脱颖而出。

definitions.definition: In sports
definitions.definitionCn: 在体育中。

definitions.definition: A line of knit stitches that have unravelled, particularly in a nylon stocking.

definitions.definitionCn: 一排已脱线的针织线圈，尤其在尼龙袜中。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的袜子脱线了。

definitions.definition: The stern of the underwater body of a ship from where it begins to curve upward and inward.
definitions.definitionCn: 船体水下部分的船尾，从那里开始向上向内弯曲。

definitions.definition: The horizontal distance to which a drift may be carried, either by licence of the proprietor of a mine or by the nature of the formation; also, the direction which a vein of ore or other substance takes.
definitions.definitionCn: 矿脉可被延伸的水平距离，由矿主许可或地层性质决定；也指矿脉或其他物质所取的方向。

definitions.definition: A pair or set of millstones.
definitions.definitionCn: 一对或一套磨石。

definitions.definition: To move swiftly.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动。

definitions.definition: (fluids) To flow.
definitions.definitionCn: （流体）流动。

definitions.definition: (of a vessel) To sail before the wind, in distinction from reaching or sailing close-hauled.
definitions.definitionCn: （船只）顺风航行，区别于横风或抢风航行。

definitions.definition: To control or manage, be in charge of.
definitions.example: He is running the candidate's expensive campaign.
definitions.definitionCn: 控制或管理，负责。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正在管理候选人昂贵的竞选活动。

definitions.definition: To be a candidate in an election.
definitions.example: I have decided to run for governor of California.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为选举中的候选人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我决定竞选加利福尼亚州州长。

definitions.definition: To make run in a race or an election.
definitions.example: He ran his best horse in the Derby.
definitions.definitionCn: 让某人参加赛跑或选举。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在德比马赛中派出了最好的马。

definitions.definition: To exert continuous activity; to proceed.
definitions.example: to run through life; to run in a circle
definitions.definitionCn: 进行持续活动；继续。
definitions.exampleCn: 经历人生；循环运行。

definitions.definition: To be presented in the media.
definitions.example: Her picture ran on the front page of the newspaper.
definitions.definitionCn: 在媒体中呈现。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的照片登上了报纸头版。

definitions.definition: To print or broadcast in the media.
definitions.example: run a story; run an ad
definitions.definitionCn: 在媒体中印刷或播放。
definitions.exampleCn: 播放故事；播放广告。

definitions.definition: To smuggle (illegal goods).

definitions.definitionCn: 走私（非法货物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 走私枪支；走私朗姆酒。

definitions.definition: To sort through a large volume of produce in quality control.

definitions.definitionCn: 在质量控制中筛选大量产品。
definitions.exampleCn: 看来我们得重新检查西红柿了。

definitions.definition: To extend or persist, statically or dynamically, through space or time.
definitions.definitionCn: 在空间或时间上静态或动态地延伸或持续。

definitions.definition: To execute or carry out a plan, procedure or program.
definitions.example: Don't run that software unless you have permission.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行或实施计划、程序或项目。
definitions.exampleCn: 未经许可不要运行那个软件。

definitions.definition: To pass or go quickly in thought or conversation.

definitions.definitionCn: 在思想或对话中快速掠过。
definitions.exampleCn: 从一个话题跳到另一个话题。

definitions.definition: To become different in a way mentioned (usually to become worse).

definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式变得不同（通常变得更糟）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的补给快用完了。

definitions.definition: To cost a large amount of money.
definitions.example: Buying a new laptop will run you a thousand dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: 花费大量金钱。
definitions.exampleCn: 买一台新笔记本电脑要花你一千美元。

definitions.definition: Of stitches or stitched clothing, to unravel.
definitions.example: My stocking is running.
definitions.definitionCn: （针脚或针织衣物）脱线。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的袜子正在脱线。

definitions.definition: To pursue in thought; to carry in contemplation.
definitions.definitionCn: 在思考中追寻；在沉思中携带。

definitions.definition: To cause to enter; to thrust.

definitions.definitionCn: 使进入；刺入。
definitions.exampleCn: 将剑刺入或穿过身体；将钉子钉入某人的脚。

definitions.definition: To drive or force; to cause, or permit, to be driven.
definitions.definitionCn: 驱使或强迫；导致或允许被驱使。

definitions.definition: To cause to be drawn; to mark out; to indicate; to determine.
definitions.example: to run a line
definitions.definitionCn: 使被绘制；标出；指示；确定。
definitions.exampleCn: 画一条线。

definitions.definition: To encounter or incur (a danger or risk).
definitions.example: to run the risk of losing one's life
definitions.definitionCn: 遭遇或招致（危险或风险）。
definitions.exampleCn: 冒生命危险。

definitions.definition: To put at hazard; to venture; to risk.
definitions.definitionCn: 置于危险中；冒险；赌博。

definitions.definition: To tease with sarcasms and ridicule.
definitions.definitionCn: 用讽刺和嘲笑戏弄。

definitions.definition: To sew (a seam) by passing the needle through material in a continuous line, generally taking a series of stitches on the needle at the same time.
definitions.definitionCn: 用连续针脚缝制（接缝），通常同时将一系列针脚穿在针上。

definitions.definition: To control or have precedence in a card game.

definitions.definitionCn: 在纸牌游戏中控制或优先。
definitions.exampleCn: 每三四手牌他就能清台。

definitions.definition: To be in form thus, as a combination of words.
definitions.definitionCn: 以这种形式存在，如词语组合。

definitions.definition: To be popularly known; to be generally received.
definitions.definitionCn: 广为人知；被普遍接受。

definitions.definition: To have growth or development.
definitions.example: Boys and girls run up rapidly.
definitions.definitionCn: 生长或发展。
definitions.exampleCn: 男孩女孩们迅速成长。

definitions.definition: To tend, as to an effect or consequence; to incline.
definitions.definitionCn: 倾向于某种效果或结果；有倾向。

definitions.definition: To have a legal course; to be attached; to continue in force, effect, or operation; to follow; to go in company.
definitions.example: Certain covenants run with the land.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有法律过程；被附加；继续有效、生效或运作；跟随；结伴而行。
definitions.exampleCn: 某些契约随土地转移。

definitions.definition: To encounter or suffer (a particular, usually bad, fate or misfortune).
definitions.definitionCn: 遭遇或承受（特定，通常不好的命运或不幸）。

definitions.definition: To strike (the ball) in such a way as to cause it to run along the ground, as when approaching a hole.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球使其沿地面滚动，如接近球洞时。

definitions.definition: To speedrun.
definitions.definitionCn: 速通。

definitions.definition: Expressing joy, celebration, glee, etc.
definitions.example: Yeah! We did it!
definitions.definitionCn: 表达喜悦、庆祝、欢欣等。
definitions.exampleCn: 耶！我们做到了！

definitions.definition: A solar year, the time it takes the Earth to complete one revolution of the Sun (between 365.24 and 365.26 days depending on the point of reference).
definitions.example: we moved to this town a year ago;  I quit smoking exactly one year ago
