definitions.example: Mars goes around the sun once in a Martian year, or 1.88 Earth years.

definitions.definition: A period between set dates that mark a year, from January 1 to December 31 by the Gregorian calendar, from Tishiri 1 to Elul 29 by the Jewish calendar, and from Muharram 1 to Dhu al-Hijjah 29 or 30 by the Islamic calendar.
definitions.example: A normal year has 365 full days, but there are 366 days in a leap year.

definitions.definition: A scheduled part of a calendar year spent in a specific activity.
definitions.example: During this school year I have to get up at 6:30 to catch the bus.

definitions.definition: A Julian year, exactly 365.25 days, represented by "a".
A level or grade in school or college.
definitions.example: Every second-year student must select an area of specialization.

definitions.definition: The proportion of a creature's lifespan equivalent to one year of an average human lifespan (see also dog year).
definitions.example: Geneticists have created baker's yeast that can live to 800 in yeast years.

definitions.definition: (not used in the plural) The person or thing in the fourth position.
definitions.definitionCn: （不用复数）处于第四位的人或事物。

definitions.definition: (chiefly American) A quarter, one of four equal parts of a whole.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于美国）四分之一，整体的四个等份之一。

definitions.definition: (not used in the plural) The fourth gear of an engine.
definitions.definitionCn: （不用复数）发动机的第四档。

definitions.definition: A musical interval which spans four degrees of the diatonic scale, for example C to F (C D E F).
definitions.definitionCn: 跨越自然音阶四个音级的音程，例如C到F（C D E F）。

definitions.definition: The ordinal form of the number four.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字四的序数形式。

definitions.definition: One who offers advice.
definitions.definitionCn: 进谏者。

definitions.definition: An open area in a town housing a public market.
definitions.definitionCn: 城镇中设有公共市场的开放区域。

definitions.definition: The space, actual or metaphorical, in which a market operates.
definitions.example: Some high-street retailers were slow to enter the new digital marketplace of the Internet.
definitions.definitionCn: 市场运作的空间，无论是实际的还是隐喻的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一些高街零售商迟迟未能进入互联网的新数字市场。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The world of commerce and trade.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）商业与贸易的世界。

definitions.definition: A place or sphere for the exchange of anything, such as ideas or fashions.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何事物（如思想或时尚）交流的场所或领域。

definitions.definition: An elevated location smaller than a mountain.
definitions.example: The park is sheltered from the wind by a hill to the east.
definitions.definitionCn: 比山小的隆起地形。
definitions.exampleCn: 公园东边有座小山遮挡风。

definitions.definition: A sloping road.

definitions.definitionCn: 一条斜坡路。
definitions.exampleCn: 你需要加速才能爬上前面那个坡。

definitions.definition: A heap of earth surrounding a plant.
definitions.definitionCn: 植物周围堆起的土堆。

definitions.definition: A single cluster or group of plants growing close together, and having the earth heaped up about them.
definitions.example: a hill of corn or potatoes
definitions.definitionCn: 紧密生长在一起的一丛或一群植物，周围堆着土。

definitions.definition: The pitcher’s mound.
definitions.definitionCn: 投手丘。

definitions.definition: To form into a heap or mound.
definitions.definitionCn: 堆成堆或土丘。

definitions.definition: To heap or draw earth around plants.
definitions.definitionCn: 在植物周围堆土或培土。

definitions.definition: Model, example.
definitions.definitionCn: 模型，范例。

definitions.definition: A design, motif or decoration, especially formed from regular repeated elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种设计、图案或装饰，尤指由规则重复元素构成的形式。

definitions.definition: A naturally-occurring or random arrangement of shapes, colours etc. which have a regular or decorative effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然形成或随机排列的形状、颜色等，具有规则或装饰性效果。

definitions.definition: The given spread, range etc. of shot fired from a gun.
definitions.definitionCn: 枪械射击时产生的特定散布范围。

definitions.definition: A particular sequence of events, facts etc. which can be understood, used to predict the future, or seen to have a mathematical, geometric, statistical etc. relationship.
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列可理解的事件、事实等，可用于预测未来，或呈现数学、几何、统计等关系。

definitions.definition: An intelligible arrangement in a given area of language.
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定语言区域内可理解的排列方式。

definitions.definition: A sequence of notes, percussion etc. in a tracker module, usable once or many times within the song.
definitions.definitionCn: 追踪器模块中的音符、打击乐等序列，可在歌曲中单次或多次使用。

definitions.definition: To apply a pattern.
definitions.definitionCn: 应用一种模式。

definitions.definition: To make or design (anything) by, from, or after, something that serves as a pattern; to copy; to model; to imitate.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据、源自或仿照某物作为模式来制作或设计（任何事物）；复制；塑造；模仿。

definitions.definition: To follow an example.
definitions.definitionCn: 效仿一个榜样。

definitions.definition: To fit into a pattern.
definitions.definitionCn: 符合某种模式。

definitions.definition: To serve as an example for.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为……的榜样。

definitions.definition: Senses relating to a three-dimensional object or space.
definitions.definitionCn: 与三维物体或空间相关的感官。

definitions.definition: Senses relating to a two-dimensional object or space
definitions.definitionCn: 与二维物体或空间相关的感官。

definitions.definition: To place inside a box; to pack in one or more boxes.
definitions.definitionCn: 放入盒子内；装入一个或多个盒子中。

definitions.definition: Usually followed by in: to surround and enclose in a way that restricts movement; to corner, to hem in.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常后接in：以限制活动的方式包围并封闭；使陷入困境，围困。

definitions.definition: To mix two containers of paint of similar colour to ensure that the color is identical.
definitions.definitionCn: 混合两罐颜色相近的油漆以确保颜色一致。

definitions.definition: To make an incision or hole in (a tree) for the purpose of procuring the sap.
definitions.definitionCn: 在（树）上切开口或钻孔以获取树液。

definitions.definition: To enclose with boarding, lathing, etc., so as to conceal (for example, pipes) or to bring to a required form.
definitions.definitionCn: 用木板、板条等包裹以隐藏（例如管道）或使其达到所需形状。

definitions.definition: To furnish (for example, the axle of a wheel) with a box.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（例如车轮轴）配备盒子。

definitions.definition: To enclose (images, text, etc.) in a box.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（图像、文本等）框入盒子中。

definitions.definition: To place a value of a primitive type into a corresponding object.
definitions.definitionCn: 将原始类型的值放入对应的对象中。

definitions.definition: Any of various evergreen shrubs or trees of the genus Buxus, especially the common box, European box, or boxwood (Buxus sempervirens) which is often used for making hedges and topiary.
definitions.definitionCn: 黄杨属的各种常绿灌木或树木，尤其是常用于制作树篱和修剪造型的普通黄杨、欧洲黄杨或黄杨木（Buxus sempervirens）。

definitions.definition: The wood from a box tree: boxwood.
definitions.definitionCn: 黄杨树的木材：黄杨木。

definitions.definition: A musical instrument, especially one made from boxwood.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种乐器，尤指用黄杨木制成的乐器。

definitions.definition: An evergreen tree of the genus Lophostemon (for example, the box scrub, Brisbane box, brush box, pink box, or Queensland box, Lophostemon confertus).
definitions.definitionCn: 水翁属的常绿树木（例如灌木箱木、布里斯班箱木、刷子箱木、粉红箱木或昆士兰箱木，Lophostemon confertus）。

definitions.definition: Various species of Eucalyptus trees are popularly called various kinds of boxes, on the basis of the nature of their wood, bark, or appearance for example, the drooping (Eucalyptus bicolor), shiny-leaved (Eucalyptus tereticornis), black, or ironbark box trees.
definitions.definitionCn: 各种桉树因其木材、树皮或外观的特性而被俗称为各种箱木，例如垂枝箱木（Eucalyptus bicolor）、亮叶箱木（Eucalyptus tereticornis）、黑箱木或铁皮箱木。

definitions.definition: A blow with the fist.
definitions.definitionCn: 用拳头击打。

definitions.definition: To strike with the fists; to punch.
definitions.example: Leave this place before I box you!
definitions.definitionCn: 用拳头打击；猛击。
definitions.exampleCn: 在我揍你之前离开这里！

definitions.definition: To fight against (a person) in a boxing match.
definitions.definitionCn: 在拳击比赛中与（某人）对抗。

definitions.definition: To participate in boxing; to be a boxer.
definitions.definitionCn: 参与拳击运动；成为拳击手。

definitions.definition: A Mediterranean food fish of the genus Boops, which is a variety of sea bream; a bogue or oxeye.
definitions.definitionCn: 地中海食用鱼，属于眼斑鲷属（Boops），是鲷鱼的一种；博格鱼或牛眼鱼。

definitions.definition: To imply but stop short of saying explicitly.
definitions.example: Are you suggesting that I killed my wife?
definitions.definitionCn: 暗示但未明确说出。
definitions.exampleCn: 你是在暗示我杀了我的妻子吗？

definitions.definition: To make one suppose; cause one to suppose (something).
definitions.example: The name "hamburger" suggests that hamburgers originated from Hamburg.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某人认为；使某人推测（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: "汉堡"这个名字暗示汉堡包起源于汉堡。

definitions.definition: To mention something as an idea, typically in order to recommend it
definitions.example: I’d like to suggest that we go out to lunch.   I’d like to suggest going out to lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 提出某事作为建议，通常是为了推荐它。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想建议我们出去吃午饭。我想建议出去吃午饭。

definitions.definition: To seduce; to prompt to evil; to tempt.
definitions.definitionCn: 引诱；唆使作恶；诱惑。

definitions.definition: A material object that physically exists.
definitions.definitionCn: 实际存在的物质对象。

definitions.definition: A goal that is striven for.
definitions.definitionCn: 努力追求的目标。

definitions.definition: (grammar) The objective case.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）宾格。

definitions.definition: (grammar) a noun or pronoun in the objective case.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）宾格中的名词或代词。

definitions.definition: The lens or lenses of a camera, microscope, or other optical device closest to the object being examined.
definitions.definitionCn: 相机、显微镜或其他光学设备中最靠近被观察物体的透镜。

definitions.definition: A document containing a certified statement.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含认证声明的文件。

definitions.definition: A document evidencing ownership or debt.
definitions.definitionCn: 证明所有权或债务的文件。

definitions.definition: A document serving as evidence as a person has completed an educational course, issued either by an institution not authorised to grant diplomas, or to a student not qualifying for a diploma.
definitions.definitionCn: 证明某人已完成教育课程的文件，由无权授予文凭的机构颁发，或颁发给不符合文凭资格的学生。

definitions.definition: The information needed in order to verify a positive answer to a problem.
definitions.definitionCn: 验证问题肯定答案所需的信息。

definitions.definition: A motion picture age rating.
definitions.example: The film is certificate 15.
definitions.definitionCn: 电影年龄分级。
definitions.exampleCn: 该影片为15级证书。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) That which is left; relic; remainder.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用复数）留下的东西；遗物；剩余部分。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) That which is left of a human being after the life is gone; relics; a dead body.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）生命消逝后留下的部分；遗骸；尸体。

definitions.definition: Posthumous works or productions, especially literary works.
definitions.definitionCn: 死后出版的作品，尤指文学作品。

definitions.definition: State of remaining; stay.
definitions.definitionCn: 停留的状态；逗留。

definitions.definition: To stay behind while others withdraw; to be left after others have been removed or destroyed; to be left after a number or quantity has been subtracted or cut off; to be left as not included or comprised.
definitions.definitionCn: 当他人撤退时留在后面；在他人或他物被移除或摧毁后留下；在数量被减去或截断后剩余；未被包含或包括而留下。

definitions.definition: To continue unchanged in place, form, or condition, or undiminished in quantity; to abide; to stay; to endure; to last.
definitions.example: There was no food in the house, so I had to remain hungry.
definitions.definitionCn: 在位置、形式或条件上保持不变，或数量不减；持续存在；停留；忍耐；持久。
definitions.exampleCn: 房子里没有食物，所以我不得不继续挨饿。

definitions.definition: To await; to be left to.
definitions.definitionCn: 等待；留给。

definitions.definition: To continue in a state of being.
definitions.example: The light remained red for two full minutes.
definitions.definitionCn: 继续处于某种状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 红灯持续亮了两分钟整。

definitions.definition: What is left after a person (or any organism) dies; a corpse.
definitions.example: The victim's remains were one small piece of bone.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人（或任何生物）死后留下的东西；尸体。
definitions.exampleCn: 受害者的遗骸是一小块骨头。

definitions.definition: Historical or archaeological relics.
definitions.definitionCn: 历史或考古遗迹。

definitions.definition: The extant writings of a deceased person.
definitions.example: To his great intellectual powers his published remains bear abundant witness.
definitions.definitionCn: 已故者现存的作品。
definitions.exampleCn: 他已出版的作品充分证明了他卓越的智力。

definitions.definition: All that is left of the stock of some things; remnants.
definitions.example: He couldn't bring himself to eat the remains of the chicken dinner.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些物品库存中剩下的所有东西；残余。
definitions.exampleCn: 他无法让自己吃掉那顿鸡肉晚餐的剩菜。

definitions.definition: A stopping place.
definitions.definitionCn: 一处停留地。

definitions.definition: A place where workers are stationed.
definitions.definitionCn: 工人驻扎的场所。

definitions.definition: Any of the Stations of the Cross.
definitions.definitionCn: 苦路十四站中的任何一站。

definitions.definition: The Roman Catholic fast of the fourth and sixth days of the week, Wednesday and Friday, in memory of the council which condemned Christ, and of his passion.
definitions.definitionCn: 罗马天主教每周第四日和第六日（周三与周五）的斋戒，以纪念审判基督的公议会及其受难。

definitions.definition: A church in which the procession of the clergy halts on stated days to say stated prayers.
definitions.definitionCn: 神职人员在指定日期列队停留并诵念特定祷文的教堂。

definitions.definition: Standing; rank; position.
definitions.example: She had ambitions beyond her station.
definitions.definitionCn: 站立；等级；地位。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的野心超越了自身地位。

definitions.definition: A broadcasting entity.
definitions.example: I used to listen to that radio station.
definitions.definitionCn: 广播机构。
definitions.exampleCn: 我曾收听那个广播电台。

definitions.definition: A harbour or cove with a foreshore suitable for a facility to support nearby fishing.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有适合支持附近渔业设施的前滩的港口或小海湾。

definitions.definition: Any of a sequence of equally spaced points along a path.
definitions.definitionCn: 路径上等距排列的一系列点中的任意一点。

definitions.definition: The particular place, or kind of situation, in which a species naturally occurs; a habitat.
definitions.definitionCn: 某一物种自然出现的特定地点或环境类型；栖息地。

definitions.definition: An enlargement in a shaft or galley, used as a landing, or passing place, or for the accommodation of a pump, tank, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 竖井或坑道中的扩大部分，用作平台、交会处，或安置水泵、水箱等设备。

definitions.definition: Post assigned; office; the part or department of public duty which a person is appointed to perform; sphere of duty or occupation; employment.
definitions.definitionCn: 被指派的岗位；职务；个人被任命履行的公共职责部分或部门；职责或职业范围；工作。

definitions.definition: The position of the foetal head in relation to the distance from the ischial spines, measured in centimetres.
definitions.definitionCn: 胎头相对于坐骨棘距离的位置，以厘米测量。

definitions.definition: The fact of standing still; motionlessness, stasis.
definitions.definitionCn: 静止状态；不动，停滞。

definitions.definition: The apparent standing still of a superior planet just before it begins or ends its retrograde motion.
definitions.definitionCn: 外行星在开始或结束逆行前看似静止的状态。

definitions.definition: (usually passive) To put in place to perform a task.
definitions.example: I was stationed on the pier.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常被动语态）安置以执行任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 我被派驻在码头上。

definitions.definition: To put in place to perform military duty.
definitions.example: I was stationed at Fort Richie.
definitions.definitionCn: 部署以执行军事任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 我被派驻在里奇堡。

definitions.definition: (sometimes capitalised) An infrequent religious gathering of family and friends spread over a few days, where Mass and the Rosary will be said in the home.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时首字母大写）家庭与亲友间持续数日的非频繁宗教聚会，在家中举行弥撒并诵念玫瑰经。

definitions.definition: Relatively large in scale, size, extent, number (i.e. having many parts or members) or duration (i.e. relatively long); very big.
definitions.example: A great storm is approaching our shores.
definitions.definitionCn: 规模、尺寸、范围、数量（即拥有许多部分或成员）或持续时间（即相对较长）都较大；非常大。
definitions.exampleCn: 一场巨大的风暴正在逼近我们的海岸。

definitions.definition: Of larger size or more importance than others of its kind.
definitions.example: the great auk
definitions.definitionCn: 比其他同类更大或更重要。
definitions.exampleCn: 大海雀

definitions.definition: (qualifying nouns of family relationship) Involving more generations than the qualified word implies — as many extra generations as repetitions of the word great (from 1510s). [see Derived terms]
definitions.example: great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, great-great-great-grandfather
definitions.definitionCn: （修饰家庭关系名词）比所修饰的词隐含更多代——每重复一次“great”就增加一代（源自16世纪10年代）。[参见派生词]
definitions.exampleCn: 曾祖父、高祖父、天祖

definitions.definition: (followed by 'with') Pregnant; large with young; full of.
definitions.example: great with child
definitions.definitionCn: （后接“with”）怀孕的；怀着幼崽的；充满的。
definitions.exampleCn: 身怀六甲

definitions.definition: (except with 'friend' and similar words such as 'mate','buddy') Intimate; familiar.
definitions.definitionCn: （除与“friend”及类似词如“mate”、“buddy”连用外）亲密的；熟悉的。

definitions.definition: Extreme or more than usual.
definitions.example: great worry
definitions.definitionCn: 极端的或超乎寻常的。
definitions.exampleCn: 极大的忧虑

definitions.definition: Of significant importance or consequence; important.
definitions.example: a great decision
definitions.definitionCn: 具有重大意义或后果的；重要的。
definitions.exampleCn: 重大决定

definitions.definition: (applied to actions, thoughts and feelings) Arising from or possessing idealism; admirable; superior; commanding; heroic; illustrious; eminent.
definitions.example: a great deed
definitions.definitionCn: （用于行动、思想和情感）源于或拥有理想主义的；令人钦佩的；卓越的；威严的；英勇的；杰出的；显赫的。
definitions.exampleCn: 伟大事迹

definitions.definition: Impressive or striking.
definitions.example: a great show of wealth
definitions.definitionCn: 令人印象深刻的或引人注目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 盛大的财富展示

definitions.definition: Much in use; favoured.
definitions.example: Poetry was a great convention of the Romantic era.
definitions.definitionCn: 广泛使用的；受欢迎的。
definitions.exampleCn: 诗歌是浪漫主义时代的重要惯例。

definitions.definition: (applied to persons) Endowed with extraordinary powers; of exceptional talents or achievements; uncommonly gifted; able to accomplish vast results; remarkable; strong; powerful; mighty; noble.
definitions.example: a great hero, scholar, genius, philosopher, writer etc.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于人）拥有非凡能力的；具有杰出才能或成就的；天赋异禀的；能成就巨大成果的；卓越的；强大的；有力的；崇高的。
definitions.exampleCn: 伟大的英雄、学者、天才、哲学家、作家等。

definitions.definition: Title referring to an important leader.
definitions.example: Alexander the Great
definitions.definitionCn: 指重要领袖的头衔。
definitions.exampleCn: 亚历山大大帝

definitions.definition: Doing or exemplifying (a characteristic or pursuit) on a large scale; active or enthusiastic.
definitions.example: He's not a great one for reading.
definitions.definitionCn: 大规模地从事或体现（某种特征或追求）；活跃的或热心的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他不太喜欢读书。

definitions.definition: (often followed by 'at') Skilful or adroit.
definitions.example: You are great at singing.
definitions.definitionCn: （常后接“at”）熟练的；灵巧的。
definitions.exampleCn: 你唱歌很棒。

definitions.definition: Very good; excellent; wonderful; fantastic (from 1848).
definitions.example: Dinner was great.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常好的；极好的；精彩的；绝妙的（源自1848年）。
definitions.exampleCn: 晚餐棒极了。

definitions.definition: Intensifying a word or expression, used in mild oaths.
definitions.example: Great Scott!
definitions.definitionCn: 用于加强词语或表达的语气，用于温和的咒骂中。
definitions.exampleCn: 天哪！

definitions.definition: Person living or originating from Europe
definitions.definitionCn: 居住或源自欧洲的人

definitions.definition: Person who resides within the European Union
definitions.definitionCn: 居住在欧洲联盟内的人

definitions.definition: The currency unit of the European Monetary Union. Symbol: €
definitions.definitionCn: 欧洲货币联盟的货币单位。符号：€

definitions.definition: A coin with a face value of 1 euro.
definitions.definitionCn: 面值为1欧元的硬币

definitions.definition: Macropus robustus, a wallaroo (macropod species).
To relate or belong to; to have reference to or connection with; to affect the interest of; to be of importance to.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及或属于；与...有关或关联；影响...的利益；对...重要。

definitions.definition: To engage by feeling or sentiment; to interest.
definitions.example: A good prince concerns himself in the happiness of his subjects.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过情感或情绪吸引；使感兴趣。
definitions.exampleCn: 一位贤明的君主关心臣民的幸福。

definitions.definition: To make somebody worried.
definitions.example: I’m concerned that she’s becoming an alcoholic.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某人担忧。
definitions.exampleCn: 我担心她正在变成酒鬼。

definitions.definition: Showing concern.
definitions.example: There was a concerned expression on her face as I told her the news.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出关切。
definitions.exampleCn: 当我告诉她这个消息时，她脸上露出关切的表情。

definitions.definition: Involved or responsible.
definitions.example: The people concerned have been punished.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及或负有责任。
definitions.exampleCn: 相关人士已受到惩罚。

definitions.definition: A map.
definitions.definitionCn: 一张地图。

definitions.definition: A systematic non-narrative presentation of data.
definitions.definitionCn: 数据的系统性非叙事呈现。

definitions.definition: A written deed; a charter.
definitions.definitionCn: 书面契约；特许状。

definitions.definition: A subspace of a manifold used as part of an atlas
definitions.definitionCn: 用作地图集一部分的流形子空间。

definitions.definition: To draw a chart or map of.
definitions.definitionCn: 绘制图表或地图。

definitions.definition: To draw or figure out (a route or plan).
definitions.example: Let's chart how we're going to get from here to there.
definitions.definitionCn: 绘制或规划（路线或计划）。
definitions.exampleCn: 让我们规划一下如何从这里到那里。

definitions.definition: To record systematically.
definitions.definitionCn: 系统性地记录。

definitions.definition: (of a record or artist) To appear on a hit-recording chart.
definitions.example: The band first charted in 1994.
definitions.definitionCn: （指唱片或艺人）登上热门唱片排行榜。
definitions.exampleCn: 该乐队于1994年首次登上排行榜。

definitions.definition: A comprehensive reference work (often spanning several printed volumes) with articles (usually arranged in alphabetical order, or sometimes arranged by category) on a range of subjects, sometimes general, sometimes limited to a particular field.
definitions.example: His life's work was a four-volume encyclopedia of aviation topics.
definitions.definitionCn: 一部综合性的参考著作（通常涵盖数卷印刷本），包含按字母顺序（或有时按类别排列）排列的文章，涉及一系列主题，有时是综合性的，有时仅限于特定领域。
definitions.exampleCn: 他毕生的心血是一部四卷本的航空主题百科全书。

definitions.definition: The circle of arts and sciences; a comprehensive summary of knowledge, or of a branch of knowledge.
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术与科学的范畴；对知识或某一知识分支的全面总结。

definitions.definition: A pigment (or dye)-based fluid used for writing, printing etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于书写、印刷等的颜料（或染料）基液体。

definitions.definition: A particular type, color or container of this fluid.
definitions.definitionCn: 这种液体的特定类型、颜色或容器。

definitions.definition: The black or dark-colored fluid ejected by squid, octopus etc, as a protective strategy.
definitions.definitionCn: 乌贼、章鱼等喷出的黑色或深色液体，作为保护策略。

definitions.definition: Publicity.
definitions.example: The TSA has been getting a lot of ink lately.
definitions.definitionCn: 宣传。
definitions.exampleCn: 美国运输安全管理局最近备受关注。

definitions.definition: Tattoo work.
definitions.definitionCn: 纹身作品。

definitions.definition: Cheap red wine.
definitions.definitionCn: 廉价红酒。

definitions.definition: To apply ink to; to cover or smear with ink.
definitions.definitionCn: 涂墨水于；用墨水覆盖或涂抹。

definitions.definition: To sign (a contract or similar document).
definitions.definitionCn: 签署（合同或类似文件）。

definitions.definition: To apply a tattoo to (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 给（某人）纹身。

definitions.definition: (of a squid or octopus) to eject ink (sense 3)
definitions.definitionCn: （乌贼或章鱼）喷出墨水（第3义项）。

definitions.definition: A business partnership; the name under which it trades.
definitions.definitionCn: 商业合伙关系；其经营所用的名称。

definitions.definition: A business enterprise, however organized.
definitions.definitionCn: 企业实体，无论其组织形式如何。

definitions.definition: A criminal gang, especially based around football hooliganism.
definitions.definitionCn: 犯罪团伙，尤指以足球流氓行为为基础的。

definitions.definition: To make firm or strong; fix securely.
definitions.definitionCn: 使坚固或强壮；牢固固定。

definitions.definition: To make compact or resistant to pressure; solidify.
definitions.definitionCn: 使密实或抗压；固化。

definitions.definition: To become firm; stabilise.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得坚固；稳定。

definitions.definition: To improve after decline.
definitions.definitionCn: 衰退后好转。

definitions.definition: To shorten (of betting odds).

To lighten; to ease of a burden; to take off.
To find by chance.
definitions.example: I lit upon a rare book in a second-hand bookseller's.

definitions.definition: To stop upon (of eyes or a glance); to notice
To alight; to land or come down.
definitions.example: She fell out of the window but luckily lit on her feet.

definitions.definition: Agreement; harmony; conformity; compliance.
definitions.definitionCn: 同意；和谐；一致；遵从。

definitions.definition: The act of granting something.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予某物的行为。

definitions.definition: To lose remembrance of.
definitions.example: I have forgotten most of the things I learned in school.
definitions.definitionCn: 忘记记忆。
definitions.exampleCn: 我忘记了在学校学到的大部分东西。

definitions.definition: To unintentionally not do, neglect.
definitions.example: I forgot to buy flowers for my wife at our 14th wedding anniversary.
definitions.definitionCn: 无意中未做某事，疏忽。
definitions.exampleCn: 在我们结婚14周年纪念日时，我忘了给妻子买花。

definitions.definition: To unintentionally leave something behind.
definitions.example: I forgot my car keys.
definitions.definitionCn: 无意中遗落某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我忘了我的车钥匙。

definitions.definition: To cease remembering.
definitions.example: Let's just forget about it.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止记起。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们就忘了这件事吧。

definitions.definition: Euphemism for fuck, screw (a mild oath).
definitions.example: Forget you!
definitions.definitionCn: 操、去你的（温和咒骂的委婉说法）。
definitions.exampleCn: 去你的！

definitions.definition: To converse or debate concerning a particular topic.
definitions.example: I don't wish to discuss this further. Let's talk about something else.
definitions.definitionCn: 就某一特定话题进行交谈或辩论。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不想再讨论这个了。我们聊点别的吧。

definitions.definition: To communicate, tell, or disclose (information, a message, etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 交流、告知或透露（信息、消息等）。

definitions.definition: To break to pieces; to shatter.
definitions.definitionCn: 打碎成碎片；使粉碎。

definitions.definition: To deal with, in eating or drinking; consume.
definitions.definitionCn: 在饮食方面处理；消耗。

definitions.definition: To examine or search thoroughly; to exhaust a remedy against, as against a principal debtor before proceeding against the surety.
definitions.definitionCn: 彻底检查或搜寻；在向担保人追索前，先穷尽对主债务人的救济手段。

definitions.definition: To drive away, disperse, shake off; said especially of tumors.
definitions.definitionCn: 驱散、消散、摆脱；尤指肿瘤。

definitions.definition: To take, as something that is offered, given, committed, sent, paid, etc.; to accept; to be given something.
definitions.example: She received many presents for her birthday.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受某物，如被提供、给予、委托、发送、支付等；接纳；被给予某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 她收到了许多生日礼物。

definitions.definition: To take goods knowing them to be stolen.
definitions.definitionCn: 明知是赃物仍接收货物。

definitions.definition: To act as a host for guests; to give admittance to; to permit to enter, as into one's house, presence, company, etc.
definitions.example: to receive a lodger, visitor, ambassador, messenger, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为主人接待客人；允许进入；准许进入某人的房屋、面前、公司等。
definitions.exampleCn: 接待房客、访客、大使、信使等。

definitions.definition: To incur (an injury).
definitions.example: I received a bloody nose from the collision.
definitions.definitionCn: 遭受（伤害）。
definitions.exampleCn: 碰撞中我的鼻子流血了。

definitions.definition: To allow (a custom, tradition, etc.); to give credence or acceptance to.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许（习俗、传统等）；给予信任或接受。

definitions.definition: To detect a signal from a transmitter.
definitions.definitionCn: 检测到发射器发出的信号。

definitions.definition: To be in a position to take possession, or hit back the ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于接球或回球的位置。

definitions.definition: To accept into the mind; to understand.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受于心中；理解。

definitions.definition: The act by which something is received; reception.
definitions.definitionCn: 接收某物的行为；接收。

definitions.definition: The act of reserving, withholding or keeping back.
definitions.example: The committee authorised the reservation of funds.
definitions.definitionCn: 保留、扣留或阻止的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 委员会授权保留资金。

definitions.definition: Something that is withheld or kept back.
definitions.definitionCn: 被扣留或保留的东西。

definitions.definition: (often in the plural) A limiting qualification; a doubt.
definitions.example: I have reservations about your intentions.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）限制性条件；疑虑。
definitions.exampleCn: 我对你的意图有所保留。

definitions.definition: A tract of land set apart by the US government for the use of a Native American people; Indian reservation (compare Canadian reserve).
definitions.definitionCn: 美国政府为美洲原住民划定的专用土地；印第安保留地（与加拿大的“保留地”相对）。

definitions.definition: An arrangement by which accommodation or transport arrangements are secured in advance.
definitions.example: I have a hotel reservation in the name of Mr Smith.
definitions.definitionCn: 提前确保住宿或交通安排的约定。
definitions.exampleCn: 我以史密斯先生的名义预订了酒店。

definitions.definition: The area which separates opposing lanes of traffic on a divided motorway or dual carriageway; see also central reservation.
definitions.example: A vehicle crashed through the central reservation into the path of oncoming traffic.
definitions.definitionCn: 分隔高速公路或双向车道对向车流的区域；参见“中央分隔带”。
definitions.exampleCn: 一辆车冲过中央分隔带，驶入对向车道。

definitions.definition: The setting aside of a certain percentage of vacancies in government institutions for members of backward and underrepresented communities (defined primarily by caste and tribe).
definitions.definitionCn: 为落后及代表性不足群体（主要按种姓和部落界定）在政府机构中保留一定比例职位空缺的做法。

definitions.definition: Clothing and ornamentation.
definitions.definitionCn: 服装与装饰。

definitions.definition: A collection laid out to be viewed in full.
definitions.definitionCn: 为完整展示而布置的收藏品。

definitions.definition: An orderly series, arrangement or sequence.
definitions.definitionCn: 有序的系列、排列或顺序。

definitions.definition: Order; a regular and imposing arrangement; disposition in regular lines; hence, order of battle.
definitions.example: drawn up in battle array
definitions.definitionCn: 秩序；规则而庄严的布局；排成整齐行列；因此，战斗序列。
definitions.exampleCn: 列阵以待。

definitions.definition: A large collection.
definitions.example: We offer a dazzling array of choices.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量收藏。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们提供令人眼花缭乱的选择。

definitions.definition: Common name for matrix.
definitions.definitionCn: 矩阵的通用名称。

definitions.definition: Any of various data structures designed to hold multiple elements of the same type; especially, a data structure that holds these elements in adjacent memory locations so that they may be retrieved using numeric indices.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何设计用于容纳多个相同类型元素的数据结构；尤其是将元素存储在相邻内存位置以便通过数字索引检索的数据结构。

definitions.definition: A ranking or setting forth in order, by the proper officer, of a jury as impanelled in a cause; the panel itself; or the whole body of jurors summoned to attend the court.
definitions.definitionCn: 由主管官员按顺序排列并呈报的陪审团名单；陪审团本身；或所有被传唤到庭的陪审员群体。

definitions.definition: A militia.
definitions.definitionCn: 民兵组织。

definitions.definition: A group of hedgehogs.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群刺猬。

definitions.definition: A microarray.
definitions.definitionCn: 微阵列。

definitions.definition: To clothe and ornament; to adorn or attire.
definitions.example: He was arrayed in his finest robes and jewels.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿衣打扮；装饰或着装。
definitions.exampleCn: 他身着最华丽的袍服和珠宝。

definitions.definition: To lay out in an orderly arrangement; to deploy or marshal.
definitions.definitionCn: 以有序方式布置；部署或调度。

definitions.definition: To set in order, as a jury, for the trial of a cause; that is, to call them one at a time.
definitions.definitionCn: 为审判案件而排列（如陪审团）；即逐一传唤他们。

definitions.definition: A large construction used in warfare, such as a battering ram, catapult etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 战争中使用的巨型器械，如攻城槌、投石机等。

definitions.definition: A tool; a utensil or implement.
definitions.definitionCn: 工具；器皿或器具。

definitions.definition: A complex mechanical device which converts energy into useful motion or physical effects.
definitions.definitionCn: 将能量转化为有用运动或物理效应的复杂机械装置。

definitions.definition: A person or group of people which influence a larger group; a driving force.
definitions.definitionCn: 影响更大群体的人或群体；驱动力。

definitions.definition: The part of a car or other vehicle which provides the force for motion, now especially one powered by internal combustion.
definitions.definitionCn: 汽车或其他车辆中提供动力的部件，尤指内燃机驱动的部分。

definitions.definition: A self-powered vehicle, especially a locomotive, used for pulling cars along a track.
definitions.definitionCn: 自带动力的车辆，尤指用于沿轨道牵引车厢的机车。

definitions.definition: A software or hardware system responsible for a specific technical task (usually with qualifying word).
definitions.example: a graphics engine
definitions.definitionCn: 负责特定技术任务的软件或硬件系统（通常带限定词）。
definitions.exampleCn: 图形引擎。

definitions.definition: Ingenuity; cunning, trickery, guile.
definitions.definitionCn: 机巧；狡诈、诡计、欺诈。

definitions.definition: The result of cunning; something ingenious, a contrivance; (in negative senses) a plot, a scheme.
definitions.definitionCn: 机巧的产物；精巧的装置；（负面含义）阴谋、诡计。

definitions.definition: Natural talent; genius.
definitions.definitionCn: 天赋；天才。

definitions.definition: Anything used to effect a purpose; any device or contrivance; an agent.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于达成目的的任何事物；任何装置或设计；媒介。

definitions.definition: To equip with an engine; said especially of steam vessels.
definitions.example: Vessels are often built by one firm and engined by another.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……装备引擎，尤指蒸汽船只。
definitions.exampleCn: 船只常由一家公司建造，另一家公司安装引擎。

definitions.definition: To assault with an engine.
definitions.definitionCn: 用攻城器械攻击。

definitions.definition: To contrive; to put into action.
definitions.definitionCn: 策划；付诸实施。

definitions.definition: To rack; to torture.
definitions.definitionCn: 折磨；拷问。

definitions.definition: A competitive sporting event such as a boxing meet, a baseball game, or a cricket match.
definitions.example: My local team are playing in a match against their arch-rivals today.
definitions.definitionCn: 拳击赛、棒球赛或板球赛等竞技体育赛事。
definitions.exampleCn: 我当地的球队今天将与他们的宿敌进行一场比赛。

definitions.definition: Any contest or trial of strength or skill, or to determine superiority.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何力量或技巧的较量，或决定优劣的竞赛。

definitions.definition: Someone with a measure of an attribute equaling or exceeding the object of comparison.
definitions.example: He knew he had met his match.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人在某项属性上达到或超过比较对象。
definitions.exampleCn: 他知道自己遇到了旗鼓相当的对手。

definitions.definition: A marriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 婚姻。

definitions.definition: A candidate for matrimony; one to be gained in marriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 适婚对象；通过婚姻获得的人。

definitions.definition: Suitability.
definitions.definitionCn: 适宜性。

definitions.definition: Equivalence; a state of correspondence.
definitions.definitionCn: 对等；一致的状态。

definitions.definition: Equality of conditions in contest or competition.
definitions.definitionCn: 竞赛或竞争中条件的平等。

definitions.definition: A pair of items or entities with mutually suitable characteristics.
definitions.example: The carpet and curtains are a match.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有相互合适特性的一对物品或实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 地毯和窗帘很相配。

definitions.definition: An agreement or compact.
definitions.definitionCn: 协议或契约。

definitions.definition: A perforated board, block of plaster, hardened sand, etc., in which a pattern is partly embedded when a mould is made, for giving shape to the surfaces of separation between the parts of the mould.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种带孔板、石膏块、硬化砂等，在制作模具时部分嵌入模型，用于塑造模具各部分之间的分离面。

definitions.definition: To agree; to be equal; to correspond.
definitions.example: Their interests didn't match, so it took a long time to agree what to do together.
definitions.definitionCn: 一致；相等；对应。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们的兴趣不匹配，所以花了很长时间才就共同行动达成一致。

definitions.definition: To agree with; to be equal to; to correspond to.
definitions.example: His interests didn't match her interests.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……一致；等于；对应。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的兴趣与她的兴趣不符。

definitions.definition: To make a successful match or pairing.
definitions.example: They found out about his color-blindness when he couldn't match socks properly.
definitions.definitionCn: 成功配对或搭配。
definitions.exampleCn: 当他无法正确配对袜子时，他们发现了他有色盲。

definitions.definition: To equal or exceed in achievement.
definitions.example: She matched him at every turn: anything he could do, she could do as well or better.
definitions.definitionCn: 在成就上相等或超过。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在每个方面都与他匹敌：他能做的任何事，她都能做得一样好或更好。

definitions.definition: To unite in marriage, to mate.
definitions.definitionCn: 使结合为婚姻，配对。

definitions.definition: To fit together, or make suitable for fitting together; specifically, to furnish with a tongue and groove at the edges.
definitions.example: to match boards
definitions.definitionCn: 使契合，或使适合契合；特指在边缘设置榫槽。
definitions.exampleCn: 拼接木板。

definitions.definition: A device made of wood or paper, at the tip coated with chemicals that ignite with the friction of being dragged (struck) against a rough dry surface.
definitions.example: He struck a match and lit his cigarette.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种木制或纸制装置，顶端涂有化学物质，通过与粗糙干燥表面摩擦（划擦）而点燃。
definitions.exampleCn: 他划了一根火柴，点燃了香烟。

definitions.definition: The act of instructing, teaching, or furnishing with information or knowledge.
definitions.example: Instruction will be provided on how to handle difficult customers.
definitions.definitionCn: 指导、教学或提供信息或知识的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 将提供关于如何处理难缠客户的指导。

definitions.definition: An instance of the information or knowledge so furnished.
definitions.definitionCn: 所提供的信息或知识的一个实例。

definitions.definition: An order or command.
definitions.definitionCn: 一项命令或指令。

definitions.definition: A single operation of a processor defined by an instruction set architecture.
definitions.definitionCn: 由指令集架构定义的处理器的一次单一操作。

definitions.definition: A set of directions provided by a manufacturer for the users of a product or service.
definitions.definitionCn: 制造商为其产品或服务的用户提供的一套说明。

definitions.definition: To direct or be in charge of.
definitions.definitionCn: 指挥或负责。

definitions.definition: To handle or control (a situation, job).
definitions.definitionCn: 处理或控制（局面、工作）。

definitions.definition: To handle with skill, wield (a tool, weapon etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 熟练使用，挥舞（工具、武器等）。

definitions.definition: To succeed at an attempt.
definitions.example: He managed to climb the tower.
definitions.definitionCn: 成功完成尝试。
definitions.exampleCn: 他设法爬上了塔楼。

definitions.definition: To achieve (something) without fuss, or without outside help.
definitions.example: It's a tough job, but I'll manage.
definitions.definitionCn: 不费周折或无需外界帮助而达成（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这工作很棘手，但我会应付过去。

definitions.definition: To train (a horse) in the manège; to exercise in graceful or artful action.
definitions.definitionCn: 训练（马匹）进行马术动作；进行优雅或灵巧的动作练习。

definitions.definition: To treat with care; to husband.
definitions.definitionCn: 小心对待；妥善管理。

definitions.definition: To bring about; to contrive.
definitions.definitionCn: 促成；设法做到。

definitions.definition: Management
definitions.definitionCn: 管理

definitions.definition: Not large or big; insignificant; few in number.
definitions.example: A small group.
definitions.definitionCn: 不大或不小；微不足道；数量少。
definitions.exampleCn: 一小群人。

definitions.definition: Young, as a child.
definitions.example: Remember when the children were small?
definitions.definitionCn: 年幼的，如孩子。
definitions.exampleCn: 还记得孩子们小时候吗？

definitions.definition: (writing, incomparable) Minuscule or lowercase, referring to written or printed letters.
definitions.definitionCn: （书写，无比较级）小写的，指书写或印刷字母。

definitions.definition: Envincing little worth or ability; not large-minded; paltry; mean.
definitions.definitionCn: 显示价值或能力不足；心胸狭窄；微不足道；卑鄙。

definitions.definition: Not prolonged in duration; not extended in time; short.
definitions.example: a small space of time
definitions.definitionCn: 持续时间不长；时间短暂；短。
definitions.exampleCn: 一小段时间。

definitions.definition: Slender, gracefully slim.
definitions.definitionCn: 纤细，优雅苗条。

definitions.definition: In a small fashion.
definitions.definitionCn: 以小的方式。

definitions.definition: In or into small pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: 成小块地。

definitions.definition: To a small extent.
definitions.definitionCn: 到小程度。

definitions.definition: In a low tone; softly.
definitions.definitionCn: 低声地；轻柔地。

definitions.definition: An inhabitant, resident, or person of descent from Greece.
definitions.definitionCn: 希腊的居民、居民或后裔。

definitions.definition: Unintelligible speech or text, such as foreign speech or text, or regarding subjects the listener is not familiar with, such as mathematics or technical jargon; or statements that the listener does not understand or agree with.
definitions.definitionCn: 难以理解的言语或文本，例如外语或陌生领域的表述，或涉及听众不熟悉的主题（如数学或专业术语）；或听众无法理解或不认同的陈述。

definitions.definition: A member of a college fraternity or sorority, which are characterised by being named after Greek letters. (See also Greek system.)
definitions.example: Was Joe a Greek in college?
definitions.definitionCn: 大学兄弟会或姐妹会的成员，其特点是以希腊字母命名。（另见希腊体系。）
definitions.exampleCn: 乔在大学时是兄弟会成员吗？

definitions.definition: A cunning rogue; a merry fellow.
definitions.definitionCn: 狡猾的恶棍；快活的家伙。

definitions.definition: Anal sex.
definitions.definitionCn: 肛交。

definitions.definition: Greek cuisine; traditional Greek food.
definitions.definitionCn: 希腊菜；传统希腊食物。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) One of the Greeks, measures of derivative price sensitivity.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用复数）希腊字母，衍生价格敏感度指标。

definitions.definition: To display a placeholder (instead of text), especially to optimize speed in displaying text that would be too small to read.
definitions.definitionCn: 显示占位符（而非文本），尤其为优化显示过小难以阅读的文本速度。

definitions.definition: To fill a template with nonsense text (particularly the Lorem ipsum), so that form can be focused on instead of content.
definitions.definitionCn: 用无意义文本（特别是Lorem ipsum）填充模板，以便专注于形式而非内容。

definitions.definition: The quality of being different.
definitions.example: You need to learn to be more tolerant of difference.
definitions.definitionCn: 不同的特质。
definitions.exampleCn: 你需要学会更加包容差异。

definitions.definition: A characteristic of something that makes it different from something else.
definitions.example: There are three differences between these two pictures.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某物区别于他物的特征。
definitions.exampleCn: 这两幅图有三个不同之处。

definitions.definition: A disagreement or argument.
definitions.example: We have our little differences, but we are firm friends.
definitions.definitionCn: 分歧或争论。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们有些小分歧，但仍是坚定的朋友。

definitions.definition: Significant change in or effect on a situation or state.
definitions.example: It just won't make much difference to me.
definitions.definitionCn: 对情况或状态的显著改变或影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 这对我来说没什么大区别。

definitions.definition: The result of a subtraction; sometimes the absolute value of this result.
definitions.example: The difference between 3 and 21 is 18.
definitions.definitionCn: 减法的结果；有时指该结果的绝对值。
definitions.exampleCn: 3和21的差是18。

definitions.definition: Choice; preference.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择；偏好。

definitions.definition: An addition to a coat of arms to distinguish two people's bearings which would otherwise be the same. See augmentation and cadency.
definitions.definitionCn: 在纹章上添加的标记，用以区分两人原本相同的纹章。参见“增章”和“幼支标记”。

definitions.definition: The quality or attribute which is added to those of the genus to constitute a species; a differentia.
definitions.definitionCn: 加于属以构成种的品质或属性；种差。

definitions.definition: (logic circuits) A Boolean operation which is TRUE when the two input variables are different but is otherwise FALSE; the XOR operation (\scriptstyle A \overline B + \overline A B).
definitions.definitionCn: （逻辑电路）一种布尔运算，当两个输入变量不同时为真，否则为假；异或运算（\scriptstyle A \overline B + \overline A B）。

definitions.definition: (relational algebra) the set of elements that are in one set but not another (\scriptstyle A \overline B).
definitions.definitionCn: （关系代数）属于一个集合但不属于另一个集合的元素集合（\scriptstyle A \overline B）。

definitions.definition: To distinguish or differentiate.
definitions.definitionCn: 区分或辨别。

definitions.definition: A daughter of the same parents as another person; a female sibling.
definitions.example: My sister is always driving me crazy.
definitions.definitionCn: 同父母所生的女性后代；女性兄弟姐妹。
definitions.exampleCn: 我姐姐总是让我抓狂。

definitions.definition: A female member of a religious order; especially one devoted to more active service; (informally) a nun.
definitions.example: Michelle left behind her bank job and became a sister at the local convent.
definitions.definitionCn: 宗教团体中的女性成员；尤指致力于更积极服务者；（非正式）修女。
definitions.exampleCn: 米歇尔辞去银行工作，成为当地修道院的修女。

definitions.definition: Any butterfly in the genus Adelpha, so named for the resemblance of the dark-colored wings to the black habit traditionally worn by nuns.
definitions.definitionCn: 阿德福属的任何蝴蝶，因其深色翅膀类似修女传统穿着的黑色服装而得名。

definitions.definition: A senior or supervisory nurse, often in a hospital.
definitions.definitionCn: 高级或督导护士，通常在医院工作。

definitions.definition: Any woman or girl with whom a bond is felt through common membership of a race, profession, religion or organization, such as feminism.
definitions.example: Connie was very close to her friend Judy and considered her to be her sister.
definitions.definitionCn: 因共同种族、职业、宗教或组织（如女权主义）而感受到纽带关系的任何女性。
definitions.exampleCn: 康妮与她的朋友朱迪关系非常亲密，视她为姐妹。

definitions.definition: (sometimes capitalized) A black woman.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时大写）黑人女性。

definitions.definition: A form of address to a woman.
definitions.example: What’s up, sister?
definitions.definitionCn: 对女性的称呼形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 怎么了，姐妹？

definitions.definition: A woman, in certain labour or socialist circles; also as a form of address.
definitions.example: Thank you, sister. I would like to thank the sister who just spoke.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某些劳工或社会主义圈子中的女性；也用作称呼形式。
definitions.exampleCn: 谢谢你，姐妹。我想感谢刚才发言的那位姐妹。

definitions.definition: An entity that has a special or affectionate, non-hierarchical relationship with another.
definitions.example: sister city
definitions.definitionCn: 与另一个实体有特殊或亲密的、非等级关系的实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 姐妹城市

definitions.definition: A node in a data structure that shares its parent with another node.
definitions.definitionCn: 数据结构中与另一节点共享父节点的节点。

definitions.definition: (usually attributively) Something in the same class.
definitions.example: sister facility
definitions.definitionCn: （通常作定语）同一类别中的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 姐妹设施

definitions.definition: To strengthen (a supporting beam) by fastening a second beam alongside it.
definitions.example: I’m trying to correct my sagging floor by sistering the joists.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过将第二根梁固定在其旁边来加固（支撑梁）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我正试图通过加固托梁来纠正地板的下陷。

definitions.definition: To be sister to; to resemble closely.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为……的姐妹；与……极为相似。

definitions.definition: Recently made, or created.
definitions.example: This is a new scratch on my car!   The band just released a new album.
definitions.definitionCn: 最近制作或创造的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的车上有一道新划痕！乐队刚发行了一张新专辑。

definitions.definition: Additional; recently discovered.
definitions.example: We turned up some new evidence from the old files.
definitions.definitionCn: 额外的；最近发现的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们从旧档案中翻出了一些新证据。

definitions.definition: Current or later, as opposed to former.
definitions.example: My new car is much better than my previous one, even though it is older.   We had been in our new house for five years by then.
definitions.definitionCn: 当前的或之后的，与之前的相对。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的新车比旧车好得多，尽管它更旧。那时我们住进新房子已经五年了。

definitions.definition: Used to distinguish something established more recently, named after something or some place previously existing.
definitions.example: New Bond Street is an extension of Bond Street.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于区分较新建立的事物，以先前存在的事物或地点命名。
definitions.exampleCn: 新邦德街是邦德街的延伸。

definitions.definition: In original condition; pristine; not previously worn or used.
definitions.example: Are you going to buy a new car or a second-hand one?
definitions.definitionCn: 原始状态的；未使用的；未穿过或未用过的。
definitions.exampleCn: 你打算买新车还是二手车？

definitions.definition: Refreshed, reinvigorated, reformed.
definitions.example: That shirt is dirty. Go and put on a new one.   I feel like a new person after a good night's sleep.   After the accident, I saw the world with new eyes.
definitions.definitionCn: 精神焕发的；重获活力的；改过自新的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那件衬衫脏了，去换件新的。睡了一夜好觉后，我感觉像换了个人。事故之后，我用新的眼光看世界。

definitions.definition: Newborn.
definitions.example: My sister has a new baby, and our mother is excited to finally have a grandchild.
definitions.definitionCn: 新生的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我姐姐生了个新生儿，妈妈很高兴终于有了孙子。

definitions.definition: Of recent origin; having taken place recently.
definitions.example: I can't see you for a while; the pain is still too new.   Did you see the new King Lear at the theatre?
definitions.definitionCn: 最近的；刚发生的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我暂时不能见你，伤痛还太新。你在剧院看了新版的《李尔王》吗？

definitions.definition: Strange, unfamiliar or not previously known.
definitions.example: The idea was new to me.   I need to meet new people.
definitions.definitionCn: 陌生的；不熟悉的；以前不知道的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个想法对我来说很新鲜。我需要结识新朋友。

definitions.definition: Recently arrived or appeared.
definitions.example: Have you met the new guy in town?   He is the new kid at school.
definitions.definitionCn: 新来的；新出现的。
definitions.exampleCn: 你见过镇上那个新来的人吗？他是学校的新生。

definitions.definition: Inexperienced or unaccustomed at some task.
definitions.example: Don't worry that you're new at this job; you'll get better with time.   I'm new at this business.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某项任务上缺乏经验或不习惯。
definitions.exampleCn: 别担心你对这份工作不熟悉；时间久了你会做得更好。我对这行还不熟。

definitions.definition: (of a period of time) Next; about to begin or recently begun.
definitions.example: We expect to grow at 10% annually in the new decade.
definitions.definitionCn: （指一段时间）接下来的；即将开始的或刚刚开始的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们期望在新十年里每年增长10%。

definitions.definition: To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.
definitions.example: To walk briskly for an hour every day is to keep fit.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过交替将每只脚（或对于四足及更多足的动物，每对或每组脚）向前移动，且始终至少有一只脚接触地面。比较“跑”。
definitions.exampleCn: 每天快走一小时是为了保持健康。

definitions.definition: To "walk free", i.e. to win, or avoid, a criminal court case, particularly when actually guilty.
definitions.example: If you can’t present a better case, that robber is going to walk.
definitions.definitionCn: “无罪释放”，即在刑事案件中获胜或避免定罪，尤其当实际有罪时。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你不能提出更有力的论据，那个抢劫犯就会逍遥法外。

definitions.definition: Of an object, to go missing or be stolen.
definitions.example: If you leave your wallet lying around, it’s going to walk.
definitions.definitionCn: （指物品）丢失或被偷。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你把钱包乱放，它很可能会不翼而飞。

definitions.definition: (of a batsman) To walk off the field, as if given out, after the fielding side appeals and before the umpire has ruled; done as a matter of sportsmanship when the batsman believes he is out.
definitions.definitionCn: （板球击球员）在防守方申诉后、裁判裁决前主动离场，仿佛被判出局；这是击球员自认出局时出于体育精神的行为。

definitions.definition: To travel (a distance) by walking.
definitions.example: I walk two miles to school every day.  The museum’s not far from here – you can walk it.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过行走移动（一段距离）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每天步行两英里上学。博物馆离这儿不远——你可以走过去。

definitions.definition: To take for a walk or accompany on a walk.
definitions.example: I walk the dog every morning.  Will you walk me home?
definitions.definitionCn: 带某人或某物散步，或陪同散步。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每天早上遛狗。你能陪我走回家吗？

definitions.definition: To allow a batter to reach base by pitching four balls.
definitions.definitionCn: （棒球）通过投出四个坏球让击球员上垒。

definitions.definition: To move something by shifting between two positions, as if it were walking.
definitions.example: I carefully walked the ladder along the wall.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过在两位置间交替移动某物，仿佛它在行走。
definitions.exampleCn: 我小心地沿着墙移动梯子。

definitions.definition: To full; to beat cloth to give it the consistency of felt.
definitions.definitionCn: （纺织）使布料变厚，赋予其毡状质地。

definitions.definition: To traverse by walking (or analogous gradual movement).
definitions.example: I walked the streets aimlessly.   Debugging this computer program involved walking the heap.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过行走（或类似渐进移动）穿越。
definitions.exampleCn: 我漫无目的地走在街上。调试这个计算机程序涉及遍历堆内存。

definitions.definition: To operate the left and right throttles of (an aircraft) in alternation.
definitions.definitionCn: 交替操作（飞机的）左右油门。

definitions.definition: To leave, resign.
definitions.example: If we don't offer him more money he'll walk.
definitions.definitionCn: 离开，辞职。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果我们不给他更多钱，他会走人。

definitions.definition: To push (a vehicle) alongside oneself as one walks.
definitions.definitionCn: 行走时（将车辆）推在身边。

definitions.definition: To behave; to pursue a course of life; to conduct oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现；遵循某种生活方式；为人处世。

definitions.definition: To be stirring; to be abroad; to go restlessly about; said of things or persons expected to remain quiet, such as a sleeping person, or the spirit of a dead person.
definitions.definitionCn: （指本应保持安静的人或物，如睡眠者或死者灵魂）骚动；外出；不安地游荡。

definitions.definition: To be in motion; to act; to move.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于运动中；行动；移动。

definitions.definition: To put, keep, or train (a puppy) in a walk, or training area for dogfighting.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（小狗）置于行走区或斗狗训练区进行训练。

definitions.definition: (hotel) To move a guest to another hotel if their confirmed reservation is not available on day of check-in.
definitions.definitionCn: （酒店）如果客人确认的预订在入住当天无法提供，将其转至其他酒店。

definitions.definition: Incarnate as a human; living.
definitions.example: Elizabeth knows so many words that they call her the walking dictionary.
definitions.definitionCn: 化身为人类；活着的。
definitions.exampleCn: 伊丽莎白认识那么多单词，大家都叫她活字典。

definitions.definition: Able to walk in spite of injury or sickness.
definitions.definitionCn: 尽管受伤或生病仍能行走。

definitions.definition: Characterized by or suitable for walking.
definitions.example: a walking tour
definitions.definitionCn: 以行走为特点或适合行走的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一次徒步旅行。

definitions.definition: Present participle of walk.
That which attends, or relates to, or in some way affects, a fact or event; an attendant thing or state of things.
definitions.definitionCn: 伴随、关联或以某种方式影响某一事实或事件的事物；伴随的事物或状态。

definitions.definition: An event; a fact; a particular incident.
definitions.definitionCn: 事件；事实；特定的事例。

definitions.definition: Circumlocution; detail.
definitions.definitionCn: 迂回的说法；细节。

definitions.definition: Condition in regard to worldly estate; state of property; situation; surroundings.
definitions.definitionCn: 关于世俗财产的状况；财产状态；处境；环境。

definitions.definition: A warning.
definitions.example: The Coast Guard issued a small craft advisory, warning little boats to watch out for bad weather.
definitions.definitionCn: 一则警告。
definitions.exampleCn: 海岸警卫队发布了小型船只预警，提醒小船注意恶劣天气。

definitions.definition: Able to give advice.
definitions.example: The advisory committee could only offer advice, but since that was almost always accepted they had real power.
definitions.definitionCn: 能够提供建议。
definitions.exampleCn: 咨询委员会只能提供建议，但由于这些建议几乎总是被采纳，他们拥有实际权力。

definitions.definition: Containing advice; advising.
definitions.example: The consultant's advisory recommendations were selectively adopted.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含建议的；提供咨询的。
definitions.exampleCn: 顾问的建议被有选择地采纳了。

definitions.definition: A physical object whose shape is used as a guide to make other objects.
definitions.definitionCn: 形状被用作制作其他物体指南的实体物体。

definitions.definition: A generic model or pattern from which other objects are based or derived.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为其他物体基础或衍生的通用模型或模式。

definitions.definition: A macromolecule which provides a pattern for the synthesis of another molecule.
definitions.definitionCn: 为另一种分子合成提供模板的大分子。

definitions.definition: A partially defined class or function, that can be instantiated in a variety of ways depending on the instantiation arguments.
definitions.definitionCn: 部分定义的类或函数，可根据实例化参数以多种方式实例化。

definitions.definition: To set up or mark off using a template.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用模板设置或标记。

definitions.definition: To provide a template or pattern for.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……提供模板或模式。

definitions.definition: A turning or sliding piece which imparts motion to a rod, lever or block brought into sliding or rolling contact with it.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种转动或滑动的部件，通过与杆、杠杆或滑块产生滑动或滚动接触来传递运动。

definitions.definition: A curved wedge, movable about an axis, used for forcing or clamping two pieces together.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种可绕轴转动的弧形楔块，用于将两个部件强制或夹紧在一起。

definitions.definition: A ridge or mound of earth.
definitions.definitionCn: 一道土脊或土丘。

definitions.definition: A camming device, a spring-loaded device for effecting a temporary belay in a rock crevice.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种凸轮装置，一种弹簧加载装置，用于在岩石裂缝中实现临时保护点。

definitions.definition: Camera.
To go on webcam with someone.
Alternative form of kam
An answer or reply, or something in the nature of an answer or reply.
definitions.definitionCn: 回答或答复，或具有回答或答复性质的事物。

definitions.definition: The act of responding or replying; reply: as, to speak in response to a question.
definitions.definitionCn: 回应或答复的行为；答复：例如，针对问题作出回应。

definitions.definition: An oracular answer.
definitions.definitionCn: 神谕式的回答。

definitions.definition: (liturgics) A verse, sentence, phrase, or word said or sung by the choir or congregation in sequence or reply to the priest or officiant.
definitions.definitionCn: （礼拜仪式）由唱诗班或会众在神职人员或主礼人之后依次或回应而说或唱的经文、句子、短语或词语。

definitions.definition: (liturgics) A versicle or anthem said or sung during or after a lection; a respond or responsory.
definitions.definitionCn: （礼拜仪式）在诵读经文期间或之后说或唱的短诗或颂歌；应答或应答圣歌。

definitions.definition: A reply to an objection in formal disputation.
definitions.definitionCn: 在正式辩论中对反对意见的回应。

definitions.definition: An online advertising performance metric representing one click-through from an online ad to its destination URL.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种在线广告效果指标，代表从在线广告到其目标网址的一次点击。

definitions.definition: A reaction to a stimulus or provocation.
definitions.definitionCn: 对刺激或挑衅的反应。

definitions.definition: The act of granting; a bestowing or conferring; concession; allowance; permission.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予的行为；给予或赐予；让步；允许；许可。

definitions.definition: The yielding or admission of something in dispute.
definitions.definitionCn: 对争议事项的让步或承认。

definitions.definition: The thing or property granted; a gift; a boon.
definitions.example: I got a grant from the government to study archeology in Egypt.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予的事物或财产；礼物；恩惠。
definitions.exampleCn: 我获得政府资助，前往埃及研究考古学。

definitions.definition: A transfer of property by deed or writing; especially, an appropriation or conveyance made by the government.
definitions.example: a grant of land or of money
definitions.definitionCn: 通过契约或书面文件进行的财产转让；尤指政府进行的拨款或划拨。
definitions.exampleCn: 土地或金钱的授予。

definitions.definition: The deed or writing by which such a transfer is made.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行此类转让的契约或书面文件。

definitions.definition: An application for a grant (monetary boon to aid research or the like).
definitions.definitionCn: 资助申请（用于支持研究等的金钱补助）。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) to give (permission or wish)
definitions.example: He was granted permission to attend the meeting.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）给予（许可或愿望）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他被允许参加会议。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To bestow or confer, with or without compensation, particularly in answer to prayer or request; to give.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）赐予或授予，无论是否有补偿，尤指回应祈祷或请求；给予。

definitions.definition: To agree with (someone) on (something); to accept (something) for the sake of argument; to admit to (someone) that (something) is true.
definitions.definitionCn: （就某事）同意（某人）；为论证而接受（某事）；向（某人）承认（某事）属实。

definitions.definition: To assent; to consent.
definitions.definitionCn: 同意；应允。

definitions.definition: A mark left by something that has passed along.
definitions.example: Can you see any tracks in the snow?
definitions.definitionCn: 某物经过后留下的痕迹。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能看到雪地上的踪迹吗？

definitions.definition: A mark or impression left by the foot, either of man or animal.
definitions.example: The fox tracks were still visible in the snow.
definitions.definitionCn: 人或动物脚留下的印记或压痕。
definitions.exampleCn: 狐狸的足迹在雪中依然可见。

definitions.definition: The entire lower surface of the foot; said of birds, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 脚掌的整个下表面；用于鸟类等。

definitions.definition: A road or other similar beaten path.
definitions.example: Follow the track for a hundred metres.
definitions.definitionCn: 道路或其他类似的踏平小径。
definitions.exampleCn: 沿着这条小路走一百米。

definitions.definition: Physical course; way.
definitions.example: Astronomers predicted the track of the comet.
definitions.definitionCn: 物理路径；路线。
definitions.exampleCn: 天文学家预测了彗星的轨迹。

definitions.definition: A path or course laid out for a race, for exercise, etc.
definitions.example: The athletes ran round the track.
definitions.definitionCn: 为赛跑、锻炼等铺设的路径或路线。
definitions.exampleCn: 运动员们绕着跑道奔跑。

definitions.definition: The direction and progress of someone or something; path.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人或某物的方向和进程；路径。

definitions.definition: The way or rails along which a train moves.
definitions.example: They briefly closed the railway to remove debris found on the track.
definitions.definitionCn: 火车行驶的轨道或铁轨。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们短暂关闭铁路以清除轨道上发现的碎片。

definitions.definition: A tract or area, such as of land.
definitions.definitionCn: 一片区域或地带，如土地。

definitions.definition: The street, as a prostitute's place of work.
definitions.definitionCn: 街道，作为妓女的工作场所。

definitions.definition: Awareness of something, especially when arising from close monitoring.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某事的察觉，尤指通过密切监控而获得。

definitions.definition: The distance between two opposite wheels on a same axletree.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一车轴上两个相对车轮之间的距离。

definitions.definition: Short for caterpillar track.
definitions.definitionCn: 履带的简称。

definitions.definition: The pitch.
definitions.definitionCn: 音高。

definitions.definition: Sound stored on a record.
definitions.definitionCn: 唱片上存储的声音。

definitions.definition: The physical track on a record.
definitions.definitionCn: 唱片上的物理音轨。
