definitions.example: Enter your user name and password.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）输入电脑；输入。
definitions.exampleCn: 输入你的用户名和密码。

definitions.definition: To record (something) in an account, ledger, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 在账户、分类账等中记录（某物）。

definitions.definition: To become a party to an agreement, treaty, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为协议、条约等的一方。

definitions.definition: To become effective; to come into effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 生效；开始实施。

definitions.definition: To go into or upon, as lands, and take actual possession of them.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入或踏上（如土地），并实际占有它们。

definitions.definition: To place in regular form before the court, usually in writing; to put upon record in proper from and order.
definitions.example: to enter a writ, appearance, rule, or judgment
definitions.definitionCn: 以规范形式提交法庭，通常为书面形式；以适当形式和顺序记录在案。
definitions.exampleCn: 提交令状、出庭、规则或判决。

definitions.definition: To make report of (a vessel or its cargo) at the custom house; to submit a statement of (imported goods), with the original invoices, to the proper customs officer for estimating the duties. See entry.
definitions.definitionCn: 在海关申报（船只或其货物）；向海关官员提交（进口货物）的声明及原始发票以估算关税。参见“entry”。

definitions.definition: To file, or register with the land office, the required particulars concerning (a quantity of public land) in order to entitle a person to a right of preemption.
definitions.definitionCn: 向土地管理局提交并登记（一定数量公共土地）的必要细节，以赋予某人优先购买权。

definitions.definition: To deposit for copyright the title or description of (a book, picture, map, etc.).
definitions.example: entered according to act of Congress
definitions.definitionCn: 为版权登记（书籍、图片、地图等）的标题或描述。
definitions.exampleCn: 根据国会法案登记。

definitions.definition: To initiate; to introduce favourably.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始；有利地引入。

definitions.definition: Something done, a deed.
definitions.example: an act of goodwill
definitions.definitionCn: 完成之事，一桩行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 善意的举动。

definitions.definition: Actuality.
definitions.definitionCn: 现实。

definitions.definition: Something done once and for all, as distinguished from a work.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次性完成之事，区别于作品。

definitions.definition: A product of a legislative body, a statute.
definitions.definitionCn: 立法机构的产物，一项法规。

definitions.definition: The process of doing something.
definitions.example: He was caught in the act of stealing.
definitions.definitionCn: 做某事的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 他偷窃时被当场抓住。

definitions.definition: A formal or official record of something done.
definitions.definitionCn: 对已完成之事的正式或官方记录。

definitions.definition: A division of a theatrical performance.
definitions.example: The pivotal moment in the play was in the first scene of the second act.
definitions.definitionCn: 戏剧表演的一个部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 剧中的关键时刻在第二幕第一场。

definitions.definition: A performer or performers in a show.
definitions.example: Which act did you prefer? The soloist or the band?
definitions.definitionCn: 演出中的表演者或表演团体。
definitions.exampleCn: 你更喜欢哪个表演？独奏者还是乐队？

definitions.definition: Any organized activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何有组织的活动。

definitions.definition: A display of behaviour.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种行为表现。

definitions.definition: A thesis maintained in public, in some English universities, by a candidate for a degree, or to show the proficiency of a student.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某些英国大学中，学位候选人公开维护的论点，或展示学生能力的行为。

definitions.definition: A display of behaviour meant to deceive.
definitions.example: to put on an act
definitions.definitionCn: 旨在欺骗的行为表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 装模作样。

definitions.definition: To do something.
definitions.example: If you don't act soon, you will be in trouble.
definitions.definitionCn: 去做某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你不尽快行动，就会有麻烦。

definitions.definition: To do (something); to perform.
definitions.definitionCn: 做（某事）；执行。

definitions.definition: To perform a theatrical role.
definitions.example: I started acting at the age of eleven in my local theatre.
definitions.definitionCn: 扮演戏剧角色。
definitions.exampleCn: 我十一岁时开始在本地剧院表演。

definitions.definition: Of a play: to be acted out (well or badly).
definitions.definitionCn: 关于戏剧：被（好或坏地）演绎。

definitions.definition: To behave in a certain manner for an indefinite length of time.
definitions.example: A dog which acts aggressively is likely to bite.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式行为持续不定时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 具有攻击性的狗可能会咬人。

definitions.definition: To convey an appearance of being.
definitions.example: He acted unconcerned so the others wouldn't worry.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出某种样子。
definitions.exampleCn: 他装作若无其事，以免他人担心。

definitions.definition: To do something that causes a change binding on the doer.
definitions.example: act on behalf of John
definitions.definitionCn: 做导致对行为者产生约束性改变的事。
definitions.exampleCn: 代表约翰行事。

definitions.definition: (construed with on or upon) To have an effect (on).
definitions.example: Gravitational force acts on heavy bodies.
definitions.definitionCn: （与on或upon连用）对……产生影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 引力作用于重物。

definitions.definition: To play (a role).
definitions.example: He's been acting Shakespearean leads since he was twelve.
definitions.definitionCn: 扮演（一个角色）。
definitions.exampleCn: 他十二岁起就扮演莎士比亚剧的主角。

definitions.definition: To feign.
definitions.example: He acted the angry parent, but was secretly amused.
definitions.definitionCn: 假装。
definitions.exampleCn: 他假装生气的家长，但暗地里觉得好笑。

definitions.definition: (construed with on or upon, of a group) To map via a homomorphism to a group of automorphisms (of).
definitions.example: This group acts on the circle, so it can't be left-orderable!
definitions.definitionCn: （与on或upon连用，指群体）通过同态映射到自同构群。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个群作用于圆上，因此它不能是左序的！

definitions.definition: To move to action; to actuate; to animate.
definitions.definitionCn: 促使行动；激励；赋予活力。

definitions.definition: A red fox, small carnivore (Vulpes vulpes), related to dogs and wolves, with red or silver fur and a bushy tail.
definitions.example: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
definitions.definitionCn: 红狐，一种小型食肉动物（学名Vulpes vulpes），与狗和狼有亲缘关系，毛色呈红色或银色，尾巴蓬松。
definitions.exampleCn: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跃过懒狗。

definitions.definition: Any of numerous species of small wild canids resembling the red fox. In the taxonomy they form the tribe Vulpini within the family Canidae, consisting of nine genera (see the Wikipedia article on the fox).
definitions.definitionCn: 众多类似红狐的小型野生犬科动物物种。在分类学上，它们构成犬科下的狐族（Vulpini），包含九个属（参见维基百科关于狐狸的文章）。

definitions.definition: The fur of a fox.
definitions.definitionCn: 狐狸的毛皮。

definitions.definition: A fox terrier.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种狐狸梗犬。

definitions.definition: The gemmeous dragonet, a fish, Callionymus lyra, so called from its yellow color.
definitions.definitionCn: 宝石龙鱼，一种鱼类（Callionymus lyra），因其黄色而得名。

definitions.definition: A cunning person.
definitions.definitionCn: 狡猾的人。

definitions.definition: A physically attractive man or woman.
definitions.definitionCn: 外表迷人的男性或女性。

definitions.definition: A small strand of rope made by twisting several rope-yarns together. Used for seizings, mats, sennits, and gaskets.
definitions.definitionCn: 将多股绳索搓合而成的小绳股，用于捆扎、垫子、编绳和密封垫。

definitions.definition: A wedge driven into the split end of a bolt to tighten it.
definitions.definitionCn: 打入螺栓裂端以紧固的楔子。

definitions.definition: A hidden radio transmitter, finding which is the goal of radiosport.
definitions.definitionCn: 隐藏的无线电发射器，寻找它是无线电运动的目标。

definitions.definition: The fourteenth Lenormand card.
definitions.definitionCn: 第十四张雷诺曼牌。

definitions.definition: A sword; so called from the stamp of a fox on the blade, or perhaps of a wolf taken for a fox.
definitions.definitionCn: 剑；因剑刃上刻有狐狸图案而得名，或可能将狼误认为狐狸。

definitions.definition: To trick, fool or outwit (someone) by cunning or ingenuity.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过狡猾或机敏欺骗、愚弄或智胜（某人）。

definitions.definition: To confuse or baffle (someone).
definitions.example: This crossword puzzle has completely foxed me.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）困惑或难倒。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个填字游戏完全难住了我。

definitions.definition: To act slyly or craftily.
definitions.definitionCn: 行为狡猾或诡诈。

definitions.definition: To discolour paper. Fox marks are spots on paper caused by humidity. (See foxing.)
definitions.example: The pages of the book show distinct foxing.
definitions.definitionCn: 使纸张变色。狐斑是纸张因潮湿产生的斑点。（参见foxing。）
definitions.exampleCn: 这本书的书页有明显的狐斑。

definitions.definition: To make sour, as beer, by causing it to ferment.
definitions.definitionCn: 使啤酒变酸，通过促使其发酵。

definitions.definition: To turn sour; said of beer, etc., when it sours in fermenting.
definitions.definitionCn: 变酸；指啤酒等在发酵时变酸。

definitions.definition: To intoxicate; to stupefy with drink.
definitions.definitionCn: 使醉；用酒灌醉。

definitions.definition: To repair (boots) with new front upper leather, or to piece the upper fronts of.
definitions.definitionCn: 用新的前帮皮革修补（靴子），或拼接前帮上部。

definitions.definition: To inspect; to examine.
definitions.example: Check the oil in your car once a month.
definitions.definitionCn: 检查；检验。
definitions.exampleCn: 每月检查一次汽车的机油。

definitions.definition: To verify the accuracy of a text or translation, usually making some corrections (proofread) or many (copyedit).
definitions.definitionCn: 验证文本或译文的准确性，通常进行少量修正（校对）或大量修改（编辑）。

definitions.definition: (often used with "off") To mark items on a list (with a checkmark or by crossing them out) that have been chosen for keeping or removal or that have been dealt with (for example, completed or verified as correct or satisfactory).
definitions.example: Check off the items that you've checked (inspected).
definitions.definitionCn: （常与"off"连用）在清单上标记项目（用勾号或划掉），表示已选定保留或移除，或已处理完毕（例如完成或确认为正确或满意）。
definitions.exampleCn: 勾选你已经检查过的项目。

definitions.definition: To control, limit, or halt.
definitions.example: Check your enthusiasm during a negotiation.
definitions.definitionCn: 控制、限制或阻止。
definitions.exampleCn: 谈判时要控制你的热情。

definitions.definition: To verify or compare with a source of information.
definitions.example: Check your data against known values.
definitions.definitionCn: 与信息来源进行核实或比对。
definitions.exampleCn: 将你的数据与已知数值进行核对。

definitions.definition: To leave in safekeeping.
definitions.example: Check your hat and coat at the door.
definitions.definitionCn: 寄存保管。
definitions.exampleCn: 在门口寄存你的帽子和外套。

definitions.definition: To leave with a shipping agent for shipping.
definitions.example: Check your bags at the ticket counter before the flight.
definitions.definitionCn: 交给货运代理进行运输。
definitions.exampleCn: 在登机前在售票柜台托运你的行李。

definitions.definition: To pass or bounce the ball to an opponent from behind the three-point line and have the opponent pass or bounce it back to start play.
definitions.example: He checked the ball and then proceeded to perform a perfect layup.
definitions.definitionCn: 从三分线后将球传给或反弹给对手，再由对手传回或反弹回来开始比赛。
definitions.exampleCn: 他传了球，然后完成了一次完美的上篮。

definitions.definition: To disrupt another player with the stick or body to obtain possession of the ball or puck.
definitions.example: The hockey player checked the defenceman to obtain the puck.
definitions.definitionCn: 用球杆或身体干扰其他球员以抢到球或冰球。
definitions.exampleCn: 冰球运动员拦截了后卫以抢到冰球。

definitions.definition: To remain in a hand without betting. Only legal if no one has yet bet.
definitions.example: Tom didn't think he could win, so he checked.
definitions.definitionCn: 不下注而留在牌局中。只有在无人下注时才合法。
definitions.exampleCn: 汤姆认为自己赢不了，所以他选择了过牌。

definitions.definition: To make a move which puts an adversary's king in check; to put in check.
definitions.definitionCn: 走一步棋使对手的王处于被将军状态；将军。

definitions.definition: To chide, rebuke, or reprove.
definitions.definitionCn: 责备、斥责或训斥。

definitions.definition: To slack or ease off, as a brace which is too stiffly extended.
definitions.definitionCn: 放松或松开，如过于紧绷的绳索。

definitions.definition: To crack or gape open, as wood in drying; or to crack in small checks, as varnish, paint, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 开裂或裂开，如木材干燥时；或产生细小裂纹，如清漆、油漆等。

definitions.definition: To make checks or chinks in; to cause to crack.
definitions.example: The sun checks timber.
definitions.definitionCn: 使产生裂缝或裂口；导致开裂。
definitions.exampleCn: 太阳晒裂了木材。

definitions.definition: To make a stop; to pause; with at.
definitions.definitionCn: 停下；暂停；与at连用。

definitions.definition: To clash or interfere.
definitions.definitionCn: 冲突或干扰。

definitions.definition: To act as a curb or restraint.
definitions.definitionCn: 起抑制或约束作用。

definitions.definition: To turn, when in pursuit of proper game, and fly after other birds.
definitions.definitionCn: 在追逐合适猎物时转向，去追其他鸟。

definitions.definition: To mark with a check pattern.
definitions.definitionCn: 用格子图案标记。

definitions.definition: The act of physically keeping an opposing player in check.
definitions.definitionCn: 实际阻止对方球员的动作。

definitions.definition: A checking account.
definitions.example: Withdraw $5000 from checking and put it into savings.
definitions.definitionCn: 支票账户。
definitions.exampleCn: 从支票账户中取出5000美元存入储蓄账户。

definitions.definition: An object designed to open and close a lock.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于开锁和关锁的物体。

definitions.definition: An object designed to fit between two other objects (such as a shaft and a wheel) in a mechanism and maintain their relative orientation.
definitions.definitionCn: 设计用于在机械装置中插入两个物体（如轴和轮）之间并保持它们相对方向的物体。

definitions.definition: A crucial step or requirement.
definitions.example: The key to solving this problem is persistence.
definitions.definitionCn: 关键步骤或要求。
definitions.exampleCn: 解决这个问题的关键是坚持不懈。

definitions.definition: A guide explaining the symbols or terminology of a map or chart; a legend.
definitions.example: The key says that A stands for the accounting department.
definitions.definitionCn: 解释地图或图表符号或术语的指南；图例。
definitions.exampleCn: 图例说明A代表会计部门。

definitions.definition: A guide to the correct answers of a worksheet or test.
definitions.example: Some students cheated by using the answer key.
definitions.definitionCn: 工作表或测试正确答案的指南。
definitions.exampleCn: 有些学生通过使用答案指南作弊。

definitions.definition: One of several small, usually square buttons on a typewriter or computer keyboard, mostly corresponding to text characters.
definitions.example: Press the Escape key.
definitions.definitionCn: 打字机或电脑键盘上多个通常为方形的小按钮之一，大多对应文本字符。
definitions.exampleCn: 按Escape键。

definitions.definition: In musical instruments, one of the valve levers used to select notes, such as a lever opening a hole on a woodwind.
definitions.definitionCn: 在乐器中，用于选择音符的阀杆之一，如木管乐器上打开音孔的杠杆。

definitions.definition: In instruments with a keyboard such as an organ or piano, one of the levers, or especially the exposed front end of it, which are depressed to cause a particular sound or note to be produced.
definitions.definitionCn: 在键盘乐器如管风琴或钢琴中，用于按下以产生特定声音或音符的杠杆之一，尤其是其外露前端。

definitions.definition: The lowest note of a scale; keynote.
definitions.definitionCn: 音阶的最低音；主音。

definitions.definition: In musical theory, the total melodic and harmonic relations, which exist between the tones of an ideal scale, major or minor; tonality.
definitions.definitionCn: 在音乐理论中，理想音阶（大调或小调）各音之间存在的整体旋律与和声关系；调性。

definitions.definition: In musical theory and notation, the tonality centering in a given tone, or the several tones taken collectively, of a given scale, major or minor.
definitions.definitionCn: 在音乐理论与记谱法中，以给定音为中心的调性，或给定大调或小调音阶的多个音的总和。

definitions.definition: In musical notation, a sign at the head of a staff indicating the musical key.
definitions.definitionCn: 在乐谱中，谱表开头的调号标记。

definitions.definition: The general pitch or tone of a sentence or utterance.
definitions.definitionCn: 句子或话语的整体音高或语调。

definitions.definition: A modification of an advertisement so as to target a particular group or demographic.
definitions.definitionCn: 为针对特定群体或人群而修改的广告。

definitions.definition: An indehiscent, one-seeded fruit furnished with a wing, such as the fruit of the ash and maple; a samara.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种不开裂、单籽、带翅的果实，如白蜡树和枫树的果实；翅果。

definitions.definition: A manual electrical switching device primarily used for the transmission of Morse code.
definitions.definitionCn: 主要用于发送摩尔斯电码的手动电气开关装置。

definitions.definition: A piece of information (e.g. a passphrase) used to encode or decode a message or messages.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于编码或解码一条或多条消息的信息（如口令）。

definitions.definition: A password restricting access to an IRC channel.
definitions.definitionCn: 限制访问IRC频道的密码。

definitions.definition: In a relational database, a field used as an index into another table (not necessarily unique).
definitions.definitionCn: 在关系数据库中，用作另一表索引的字段（不一定唯一）。

definitions.definition: A value that uniquely identifies an entry in a container.
definitions.definitionCn: 唯一标识容器中条目的值。

definitions.definition: The free-throw lane together with the circle surrounding the free-throw line, the free-throw lane having formerly been narrower, giving the area the shape of a skeleton key hole.
definitions.example: He shoots from the top of the key.
definitions.definitionCn: 罚球区及其周围的罚球圈，罚球区以前较窄，使该区域呈钥匙孔形状。
definitions.exampleCn: 他从罚球区顶部投篮。

definitions.definition: A series of logically organized groups of discriminating information which aims to allow the user to correctly identify a taxon.
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列逻辑组织的鉴别信息组，旨在帮助用户正确识别分类单元。

definitions.definition: A piece of wood used as a wedge.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作楔子的木块。

definitions.definition: The last board of a floor when laid down.
definitions.definitionCn: 铺设地板时的最后一块板。

definitions.definition: A keystone.
definitions.definitionCn: 拱顶石。

definitions.definition: That part of the plastering which is forced through between the laths and holds the rest in place.
definitions.definitionCn: 抹灰中穿过板条并固定其余部分的部分。

definitions.definition: A wooden support for a rail on the bullhead rail system.
definitions.definitionCn: 双头钢轨系统中用于支撑轨道的木制支架。

definitions.definition: The degree of roughness, or retention ability of a surface to have applied a liquid such as paint, or glue.
definitions.example: The door panel should be sanded down carefully to provide a good key for the new paint.
definitions.definitionCn: 表面粗糙度或保持液体（如油漆或胶水）附着的能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 门板应仔细打磨，为新漆提供良好的附着力。

definitions.definition: The thirty-third card of the Lenormand deck.
definitions.definitionCn: 雷诺曼牌组中的第三十三张牌。

definitions.definition: (print and film) The black ink layer, especially in relation to the three color layers of cyan, magenta, and yellow. See also CMYK.
definitions.definitionCn: （印刷和胶片）黑色油墨层，尤其相对于青色、品红和黄色三层。另见CMYK。

definitions.definition: A color to be masked or made transparent.
definitions.definitionCn: 要遮罩或变为透明的颜色。

definitions.definition: To fit (a lock) with a key.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（锁）配钥匙。

definitions.definition: To fit (pieces of a mechanical assembly) with a key to maintain the orientation between them.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（机械组件的零件）安装键以保持它们之间的方向。

definitions.definition: To mark or indicate with a symbol indicating membership in a class.
definitions.definitionCn: 用表示类属的符号标记或指示。

definitions.definition: (telegraphy and radio telegraphy) To depress (a telegraph key).
definitions.definitionCn: （电报和无线电电报）按下（电报键）。

definitions.definition: To operate (the transmitter switch of a two-way radio).
definitions.definitionCn: 操作（双向无线电的发射开关）。

definitions.definition: (more usually to key in) To enter (information) by typing on a keyboard or keypad.
definitions.example: Our instructor told us to key in our user IDs.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常为“键入”）通过键盘或小键盘输入（信息）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的指导老师告诉我们输入用户ID。

definitions.definition: To vandalize (a car, etc.) by scratching with an implement such as a key.
definitions.example: He keyed the car that had taken his parking spot.
definitions.definitionCn: 用钥匙等工具刮擦（汽车等）以破坏。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用钥匙刮了那辆占了他停车位的车。

definitions.definition: To link (as one might do with a key or legend).
definitions.definitionCn: （如图例或图注）连接。

definitions.definition: To be identified as a certain taxon when using a key.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用检索表时被识别为特定分类单元。

definitions.definition: To modify (an advertisement) so as to target a particular group or demographic.
definitions.definitionCn: 修改（广告）以针对特定群体或人群。

definitions.definition: To attune to; to set at; to pitch.
definitions.definitionCn: 使协调；设定；定调。

definitions.definition: To fasten or secure firmly; to fasten or tighten with keys or wedges.
definitions.definitionCn: 牢固固定或紧固；用键或楔子固定或拧紧。

definitions.definition: One of a string of small islands.
definitions.example: the Florida Keys
definitions.definitionCn: 一串小岛中的一个。
definitions.exampleCn: 佛罗里达群岛。

definitions.definition: In the International System of Units, the base unit of mass; conceived of as the mass of one litre of water, but now defined by taking the fixed numerical value of the Planck constant h to be 6.626 070 15 × 10-34 when expressed in units of kg⋅m2⋅s−1. Symbol: kg
definitions.definitionCn: 在国际单位制中，质量的基本单位；原定义为1升水的质量，现通过将普朗克常数h的固定数值取为6.626 070 15 × 10⁻³⁴（以kg·m²·s⁻¹为单位）来定义。符号：kg。

definitions.definition: The unit of weight such that a one-kilogram mass is also a one-kilogram weight.
definitions.definitionCn: 重量单位，使得1千克质量也是1千克重量。

definitions.definition: A stone or concrete structure on navigable water used for loading and unloading vessels; a wharf.
definitions.definitionCn: 通航水域上用于装卸船只的石质或混凝土结构；码头。

definitions.definition: A list of terms in a particular domain of knowledge with their definitions.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定知识领域中的术语列表及其定义。

definitions.definition: The act of enforcing; compulsion.
definitions.definitionCn: 强制执行的行为；强制。

definitions.definition: A giving force to; a putting in execution.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予效力；付诸实施。

definitions.definition: That which enforces, constraints, gives force, authority, or effect to; constraint; force applied.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予力量、约束力、权威或效力的东西；约束；施加的力量。

definitions.definition: A book with a rigid binding, often of cardboard or leather.
definitions.definitionCn: 硬皮书，通常用纸板或皮革装订。

definitions.definition: (of a book) Having a rigid binding.
definitions.definitionCn: （指书籍）具有硬质封面的。

definitions.definition: A friend or casual acquaintance.
definitions.example: They have been buddies since they were in school.
definitions.definitionCn: 朋友或泛泛之交。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们从上学起就是好哥们。

definitions.definition: A partner for a particular activity.
definitions.example: drinking buddies
definitions.definitionCn: 特定活动的搭档。
definitions.exampleCn: 酒友。

definitions.definition: An informal and friendly address to a stranger; a friendly (or occasionally antagonistic) placeholder name for a person one does not know.
definitions.example: Hey, buddy, I think you dropped this.
definitions.definitionCn: 对陌生人的非正式友好称呼；对不认识的人使用的友好（或偶尔带敌意的）代称。
definitions.exampleCn: 嘿，哥们，我觉得你掉了这个。

definitions.definition: To assign a buddy, or partner, to.
definitions.definitionCn: 指派伙伴或搭档。

definitions.definition: Resembling a bud.
To notice or view, especially carefully or with attention to detail.
definitions.example: From this vantage point we can observe the behavior of the animals in their natural habitat.
definitions.definitionCn: 观察或注意，尤指仔细或关注细节地。
definitions.exampleCn: 从这个有利位置，我们可以观察动物在自然栖息地的行为。

definitions.definition: To follow or obey the custom, practice, or rules (especially of a religion).
definitions.example: Please observe all posted speed limits.
definitions.definitionCn: 遵守或服从习俗、惯例或规则（尤指宗教的）。
definitions.exampleCn: 请遵守所有张贴的限速标志。

definitions.definition: To take note of and celebrate (a holiday or similar occurrence).
definitions.definitionCn: 留意并庆祝（节日或类似事件）。

definitions.definition: To comment on something; to make an observation.
definitions.example: The senator observed that the bill would be detrimental to his constituents.
definitions.definitionCn: 评论某事；发表观察意见。
definitions.exampleCn: 参议员评论说，该法案将对其选民不利。

definitions.definition: A public official in certain countries having control of public revenue.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些国家负责公共收入的公职人员。

definitions.definition: Procurator fiscal, a public prosecutor.
definitions.definitionCn: 财政检察官，即公诉人。

definitions.definition: In certain countries, including Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, and former colonies of these countries and certain British colonies, solicitor or attorney general.
definitions.definitionCn: 在包括西班牙、葡萄牙、荷兰及其前殖民地以及某些英国殖民地在内的国家中，指事务律师或总检察长。

definitions.definition: Related to the treasury of a country, company, region or city, particularly to government spending and revenue.
definitions.definitionCn: 与国家、公司、地区或城市的财政相关，尤其涉及政府支出与收入。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to finance and money in general; financial.
definitions.definitionCn: 泛指与金融和货币相关的；财政的。

definitions.definition: Any of various African shrikes of the genus Lanius.
A structure made of connected strands of metal, fiber, or other flexible/ductile material, with evenly spaced openings between them.
definitions.definitionCn: 由金属、纤维或其他柔性/延展性材料连接而成的结构，其间均匀分布着开口。

definitions.definition: The opening or space enclosed by the threads of a net between knot and knot, or the threads enclosing such a space.
definitions.definitionCn: 网线在结与结之间围成的开口或空间，或围成该空间的网线。

definitions.definition: The engagement of the teeth of wheels, or of a wheel and rack.
definitions.definitionCn: 齿轮齿的啮合，或齿轮与齿条的啮合。

definitions.definition: A measure of fineness (particle size) of ground material. A powder that passes through a sieve having 300 openings per linear inch but does not pass 400 openings per linear inch is said to be -300 +400 mesh.
definitions.definitionCn: 研磨材料细度（颗粒尺寸）的度量。能通过每线性英寸300目筛网但无法通过400目筛网的粉末，称为-300目+400目。

definitions.definition: A polygon mesh.
definitions.definitionCn: 多边形网格。

definitions.definition: To connect together by interlocking, as gears do.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过互锁连接在一起，如齿轮啮合。

definitions.definition: (by extension) To fit in; to come together harmoniously.
definitions.example: The music meshed well with the visuals in that film.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）契合；和谐地结合。
definitions.exampleCn: 那部电影中音乐与画面配合得很好。

definitions.definition: To catch in a mesh.
definitions.definitionCn: 用网捕捉。

definitions.definition: Equipment designed for a particular purpose; an apparatus.
definitions.example: The laboratory included an elaborate setup for measuring the energy.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定目的设计的设备；器械。
definitions.exampleCn: 实验室配备了一套精密的能量测量装置。

definitions.definition: The fashion in which something is organized or arranged.
definitions.example: The classroom setup was simple and efficient.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物被组织或安排的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 教室的布置简单而高效。

definitions.definition: A situation orchestrated to frame someone; a covert effort to place the blame on somebody.
definitions.example: Trust me, that was a setup!
definitions.definitionCn: 为陷害某人而策划的局面；暗中将责任推给某人的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 相信我，那是个圈套！

definitions.definition: An installer.
definitions.example: After inserting the disk, run the setup.
definitions.definitionCn: 安装程序。
definitions.exampleCn: 插入光盘后，运行安装程序。

definitions.definition: (operations) The process of arranging resources for performing a specific operation, as a run of a particular product.
definitions.example: A simple setup on the bottling line involves reloading bottles and labels; emptying, cleaning, and reloading the tanks; and a test run.
definitions.definitionCn: （操作）为执行特定操作（如生产特定产品）而安排资源的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 装瓶线上简单的设置包括重新装载瓶子和标签；清空、清洁并重新装载储罐；以及一次试运行。

definitions.definition: The tendency of persistent wind to produce higher water levels at the downwind shore of a body of water and lower at the upwind shore.
definitions.example: There was a strong wind setup at the south end of the lake after a day of northerly gales.
definitions.definitionCn: 持续风导致水体下风岸水位升高、上风岸水位降低的趋势。
definitions.exampleCn: 经过一天的北风后，湖的南端出现了强烈的风增水现象。

definitions.definition: To reserve (something) for future use.
definitions.example: I can book tickets for the concert next week.
definitions.definitionCn: 预留（某物）以备将来使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 我可以预订下周音乐会的门票。

definitions.definition: To write down, to register or record in a book or as in a book.
definitions.example: They booked that message from the hill
definitions.definitionCn: 写下、登记或记录在书中或像书中一样记录。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们从山上记下了那条信息。

definitions.definition: (law enforcement) To record the name and other details of a suspected offender and the offence for later judicial action.
definitions.example: The police booked him for driving too fast.
definitions.definitionCn: （执法）记录嫌疑犯的姓名、其他细节及罪行，以便后续司法处理。
definitions.exampleCn: 警察因他超速驾驶而记录了他的信息。

definitions.definition: To issue with a caution, usually a yellow card, or a red card if a yellow card has already been issued.
definitions.definitionCn: 发出警告，通常是黄牌，若已出示黄牌则可能出示红牌。

definitions.definition: To travel very fast.
definitions.example: He was really booking, until he passed the speed trap.
definitions.definitionCn: 极速行驶。
definitions.exampleCn: 他之前开得飞快，直到经过测速点。

definitions.definition: To record bets as bookmaker.
definitions.definitionCn: （作为庄家）记录赌注。

definitions.definition: (law student slang) To receive the highest grade in a class.
definitions.example: The top three students had a bet on which one was going to book their intellectual property class.
definitions.definitionCn: （法学院学生俚语）在班级中获得最高分。
definitions.exampleCn: 前三名学生打赌谁能拿下知识产权课的最高分。

definitions.definition: To leave.
definitions.example: He was here earlier, but he booked.
definitions.definitionCn: 离开。
definitions.exampleCn: 他之前在这里，但已经走了。

definitions.definition: The act or process of writing something down in a book or books, e.g. in accounting.
definitions.definitionCn: 在书或账簿中记录某事的动作或过程，例如会计记账。

definitions.definition: A reservation for a service, such as accommodation in an hotel.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某项服务（如酒店住宿）进行的预订。

definitions.definition: The engagement of a performer for a particular performance.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定演出聘用表演者。

definitions.definition: The issuing of a caution which is usually written down in a book, and results in a yellow card or (after two bookings) a red card, that is to say, the player is sent from the field of play.
definitions.definitionCn: 发出警告，通常记录在册，导致黄牌或（两次警告后）红牌，即球员被罚下场。

definitions.definition: The process of photographing, fingerprinting and recording the identifying data of a suspect following arrest.
definitions.definitionCn: 逮捕后对嫌疑人进行拍照、指纹采集及身份信息记录的过程。

definitions.definition: Strength; power; might; force .
definitions.definitionCn: 力量；权力；威力；武力。

definitions.definition: Intellectual power; skill; art.
definitions.definitionCn: 智力；技能；技艺。

definitions.definition: (obsolete in the general sense) A work or product of art .
definitions.definitionCn: （旧时泛指）艺术品或艺术作品。

definitions.definition: A device, a means; a magical device, spell or enchantment .
definitions.definitionCn: 装置；手段；魔法装置、咒语或魔法。

definitions.definition: Learning of the schools, scholarship; a branch of learning or knowledge, a science, especially one of the ‘seven liberal arts’ of the medieval universities .
definitions.definitionCn: 学校学问，学识；学科或知识分支，科学，尤指中世纪大学的“七艺”之一。

definitions.definition: Skill, skilfulness, art, especially the skill needed for a particular profession .
definitions.example: The craft of writing plays.
definitions.definitionCn: 技能，熟练，艺术，特别是特定职业所需的技能。
definitions.exampleCn: 戏剧创作技艺。

definitions.definition: (plural crafts) A branch of skilled work or trade, especially one requiring manual dexterity or artistic skill, but sometimes applied equally to any business, calling or profession; the skilled practice of a practical occupation .
definitions.example: He learned his craft as an apprentice.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数crafts）需要手工灵巧或艺术技巧的技术工作或行业分支，有时也适用于任何业务、职业或专业；实际职业的熟练实践。
definitions.exampleCn: 他作为学徒学习了自己的手艺。

definitions.definition: A trade or profession as embodied in its practitioners collectively; the members of a trade or handicraft as a body; an association of these; a trade's union, guild, or ‘company’ .
definitions.example: She represented the craft of brewers.
definitions.definitionCn: 以从业者集体体现的行业或职业；作为整体的手工艺行业成员；这些成员的协会；工会、行会或“公司”。
definitions.exampleCn: 她代表了酿酒行业。

definitions.definition: (plural craft) A vehicle designed for navigation in or on water or air or through outer space .
definitions.definitionCn: （复数craft）设计用于在水上、水中、空中或外层空间航行的交通工具。

definitions.definition: Implements used in catching fish, such as net, line, or hook. Modern use primarily in whaling, as in harpoons, hand-lances, etc. .
definitions.definitionCn: 捕鱼工具，如网、线或钩。现代主要用于捕鲸，如鱼叉、手矛等。

definitions.definition: To make by hand and with much skill.
definitions.definitionCn: 用手工和大量技巧制作。

definitions.definition: To construct, develop something (like a skilled craftsman).
definitions.example: state crafting; the process of crafting global policing
definitions.definitionCn: 构建、发展某物（如熟练工匠）。
definitions.exampleCn: 国家构建；构建全球警务的过程。

definitions.definition: To combine multiple items to form a new item, such as armour or medicine.
definitions.definitionCn: 组合多个物品以形成新物品，如盔甲或药物。

definitions.definition: One who supplies; a provider.
definitions.definitionCn: 供应者；提供者。

definitions.definition: Someone who assists (sets up) a goal.
definitions.definitionCn: 协助（设定）目标的人。

definitions.definition: Any Unix-like operating system, including Unix.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何类Unix操作系统，包括Unix。

definitions.definition: Collectively, Unix and unix-like operating systems.
definitions.definitionCn: 统称为Unix及类Unix操作系统。

definitions.definition: A rite or ceremony.
definitions.definitionCn: 仪式或典礼。

definitions.definition: Fame, renown; the state of being famous or talked-about.
definitions.definitionCn: 名声、声誉；出名或被谈论的状态。

definitions.definition: A person who has a high degree of recognition by the general population for his or her success or accomplishments; a famous person.
definitions.definitionCn: 因其成功或成就而受到大众高度认可的人；名人。

definitions.definition: Senses relating to a thin, pointed object.
definitions.definitionCn: 与细长尖锐物体相关的感官。

definitions.definition: (by extension from sense 1.1) A particular manner of expression in writing or speech, especially one regarded as good.
definitions.definitionCn: （由1.1义引申）写作或言语中特定的表达方式，尤指被视为优良者。

definitions.definition: A particular manner of creating, doing, or presenting something, especially a work of architecture or art.
definitions.definitionCn: 创作、制作或呈现某事物的特定方式，尤指建筑或艺术作品。

definitions.definition: To design, fashion, make, or arrange in a certain way or form (style)
definitions.definitionCn: 以特定方式或形式设计、塑造、制作或安排（风格）。

definitions.definition: To call or give a name or title to.
definitions.definitionCn: 称呼或赋予名称或头衔。

definitions.definition: To create for, or give to, someone a style, fashion, or image, particularly one which is regarded as attractive, tasteful, or trendy.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某人创造或赋予某种风格、时尚或形象，尤指被视为迷人、高雅或新潮者。

definitions.definition: To act in a way which seeks to show that one possesses style.
definitions.definitionCn: 以试图展示自身拥有风格的方式行事。

definitions.definition: To occupy fully, to take up all of.
definitions.definitionCn: 完全占据，占满所有空间。

definitions.definition: To add contents to (a container, cavity or the like) so that it is full.
definitions.definitionCn: 向（容器、空腔等）中添加内容物使其满。

definitions.definition: To enter (something), making it full.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入（某物）使其充满。

definitions.definition: To become full.
definitions.example: the bucket filled with rain;  the sails fill with wind
definitions.definitionCn: 变得充满。
definitions.exampleCn: 桶里装满了雨水；船帆灌满了风。

definitions.definition: To become pervaded with something.
definitions.example: My heart filled with joy.
definitions.definitionCn: 被某物弥漫。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的心充满了喜悦。

definitions.definition: To satisfy or obey (an order, request or requirement).
definitions.example: The pharmacist filled my prescription for penicillin.
definitions.definitionCn: 满足或遵从（命令、请求或要求）。
definitions.exampleCn: 药剂师按我的处方配了青霉素。

definitions.definition: To install someone, or be installed, in (a position or office), eliminating a vacancy.
definitions.example: Sorry, no more applicants. The position has been filled.
definitions.definitionCn: 任命某人或自己被任命到（职位或职务），填补空缺。
definitions.exampleCn: 抱歉，没有更多申请人了。这个职位已经有人了。

definitions.definition: To treat (a tooth) by adding a dental filling to it.
definitions.example: Dr. Smith filled Jim's cavity with silver amalgam.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过添加牙科填充物治疗（牙齿）。
definitions.exampleCn: 史密斯医生用银汞合金填充了吉姆的蛀牙。

definitions.definition: To fill or supply fully with food; to feed; to satisfy.
definitions.definitionCn: 用食物填满或充分供应；喂食；满足。

definitions.definition: To trim (a yard) so that the wind blows on the after side of the sails.
definitions.definitionCn: 调整（帆桁）使风吹到帆的后侧。

definitions.definition: (of a male) To have sexual intercourse with (a female).
definitions.example: Did you fill that girl last night?
definitions.definitionCn: （指男性）与（女性）发生性关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 你昨晚上了那个女孩吗？

definitions.definition: (followed by with) That is now full.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接with）现在已满。

definitions.definition: The colour of the clear sky or the deep sea, between green and violet in the visible spectrum, and one of the primary additive colours for transmitted light; the colour obtained by subtracting red and green from white light using magenta and cyan filters; or any colour resembling this.
definitions.definitionCn: 晴朗天空或深海的色彩，在可见光谱中介于绿色与紫色之间，是透射光的三原色之一；通过品红和青色滤镜从白光中减去红色和绿色所得的颜色；或任何类似此色的颜色。

definitions.definition: A blue dye or pigment.
definitions.definitionCn: 蓝色染料或颜料。

definitions.definition: Any of several processes to protect metal against rust.
definitions.definitionCn: 多种防金属生锈的工艺。

definitions.definition: Blue clothing
definitions.example: The boys in blue marched to the pipers.
definitions.definitionCn: 蓝色衣物。
definitions.exampleCn: 穿蓝衣的队伍随着风笛手行进。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) A blue uniform. See blues.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）蓝色制服。参见blues。

definitions.definition: A member of law enforcement
definitions.definitionCn: 执法人员。

definitions.definition: The sky, literally or figuratively.
definitions.example: His request for leave came out of the blue.
definitions.definitionCn: 天空，字面或比喻义。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的请假请求来得突然。

definitions.definition: The ocean; deep waters.
definitions.definitionCn: 海洋；深水区。

definitions.definition: The far distance; a remote or distant place.
definitions.definitionCn: 远方；遥远或偏僻之地。

definitions.definition: Anything blue, especially to distinguish it from similar objects differing only in color.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何蓝色的物体，尤指用于区分仅颜色不同的相似物品。

definitions.definition: A dog or cat with a slaty gray coat.
definitions.definitionCn: 毛色呈石板灰的狗或猫。

definitions.definition: One of the colour balls used in snooker, with a value of five points.
definitions.definitionCn: 斯诺克台球中的彩色球之一，分值五分。

definitions.definition: Any of the butterflies of the subfamily Polyommatinae in the family Lycaenidae, most of which have blue on their wings.
definitions.definitionCn: 灰蝶科眼灰蝶亚科的蝴蝶，多数翅膀带有蓝色。

definitions.definition: A bluefish.
definitions.definitionCn: 蓝鱼。

definitions.definition: An argument.
definitions.definitionCn: 争论。

definitions.definition: A liquid with an intense blue colour, added to a laundry wash to prevent yellowing of white clothes.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种深蓝色液体，加入洗衣水中防止白衣发黄。

definitions.definition: A type of firecracker.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种爆竹。

definitions.definition: A bluestocking.
definitions.definitionCn: 女学者。

definitions.definition: One of the three color charges for quarks.
definitions.definitionCn: 夸克的三种色荷之一。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) A feeling of sadness or depression.
definitions.example: I've got the blues today.

definitions.definition: A musical form, African-American in origin, generally featuring an eight-bar or twelve-bar blues structure and using the blues scale.
definitions.example: A large portion of modern popular music is influenced by the blues.

definitions.definition: A uniform made principally of a blue fabric.
definitions.example: The marched in their dress blues.

definitions.definition: Any of a number of sports teams which wear blue kit.
To make or become blue.
To treat the surface of steel so that it is passivated chemically and becomes more resistant to rust.
(laundry) To brighten by treating with blue (laundry aid)
To spend (money) extravagantly; to blow.
The physical confine of a river or slough, consisting of a bed and banks.
definitions.example: The water coming out of the waterwheel created a standing wave in the channel.
definitions.definitionCn: 河流或水道的物理界限，由河床和河岸构成。
definitions.exampleCn: 水车流出的水在渠道中形成了驻波。

definitions.definition: The natural or man-made deeper course through a reef, bar, bay, or any shallow body of water.
definitions.example: A channel was dredged to allow ocean-going vessels to reach the city.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过礁石、沙洲、海湾或任何浅水区的天然或人工深水航道。
definitions.exampleCn: 为让远洋船只抵达城市，人们疏浚了一条航道。

definitions.definition: The navigable part of a river.
definitions.example: We were careful to keep our boat in the channel.
definitions.definitionCn: 河流的可航行部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们小心地让船保持在航道内。

definitions.definition: A narrow body of water between two land masses.
definitions.example: The English Channel lies between France and England.
definitions.definitionCn: 两块陆地之间的狭窄水域。
definitions.exampleCn: 英吉利海峡位于法国和英格兰之间。

definitions.definition: Something through which another thing passes; a means of conveying or transmitting.
definitions.example: The news was conveyed to us by different channels.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物通过的另一物体；传递或传输的媒介。
definitions.exampleCn: 消息通过不同渠道传达给了我们。

definitions.definition: A gutter; a groove, as in a fluted column.
definitions.definitionCn: 沟槽；凹槽，如带凹槽的柱子上。

definitions.definition: A connection between initiating and terminating nodes of a circuit.
definitions.example: The guard-rail provided the channel between the downed wire and the tree.
definitions.definitionCn: 电路起始节点与终止节点之间的连接。
definitions.exampleCn: 护栏在垂落的电线和树木之间形成了通道。

definitions.definition: The narrow conducting portion of a MOSFET transistor.
definitions.definitionCn: MOSFET晶体管的窄导电部分。

definitions.definition: (communication) The part that connects a data source to a data sink.
definitions.example: A channel stretches between them.
definitions.definitionCn: （通信）连接数据源与数据接收器的部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 一条通道延伸在它们之间。

definitions.definition: (communication) A path for conveying electrical or electromagnetic signals, usually distinguished from other parallel paths.
definitions.example: We are using one of the 24 channels.
definitions.definitionCn: （通信）用于传输电信号或电磁信号的路径，通常与其他并行路径区分。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们正在使用24个信道中的一个。

definitions.definition: (communication) A single path provided by a transmission medium via physical separation, such as by multipair cable.
definitions.example: The channel is created by bonding the signals from these four pairs.
definitions.definitionCn: （通信）通过物理分离（如多对电缆）由传输介质提供的单一路径。
definitions.exampleCn: 该信道通过绑定这四对线路的信号创建。

definitions.definition: (communication) A single path provided by a transmission medium via spectral or protocol separation, such as by frequency or time-division multiplexing.
definitions.example: Their call is being carried on channel 6 of the T-1 line.
definitions.definitionCn: （通信）通过频谱或协议分离（如频分或时分复用）由传输介质提供的单一路径。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们的通话正在T-1线路的6号信道上进行。

definitions.definition: A specific radio frequency or band of frequencies, usually in conjunction with a predetermined letter, number, or codeword, and allocated by international agreement.
definitions.example: KNDD is the channel at 107.7 MHz in Seattle.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定的无线电频率或频段，通常与预定的字母、数字或代码结合，并由国际协议分配。
definitions.exampleCn: KNDD是西雅图107.7兆赫的频道。

definitions.definition: A specific radio frequency or band of frequencies used for transmitting television.
definitions.example: NBC is on channel 11 in San Jose.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于传输电视的特定无线电频率或频段。
definitions.exampleCn: NBC在圣何塞的11频道播出。

definitions.definition: (storage) The portion of a storage medium, such as a track or a band, that is accessible to a given reading or writing station or head.
definitions.example: This chip in this disk drive is the channel device.
definitions.definitionCn: （存储）存储介质的一部分（如磁道或带区），可被特定读写站或磁头访问。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个磁盘驱动器中的芯片就是通道设备。

definitions.definition: (technic) The way in a turbine pump where the pressure is built up.
definitions.example: The liquid is pressurized in the lateral channel.
definitions.definitionCn: （技术）涡轮泵中压力建立的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 液体在侧向通道中被加压。

definitions.definition: A distribution channel
definitions.definitionCn: 分销渠道。

definitions.definition: A particular area for conversations on an IRC network, analogous to a chat room and often dedicated to a specific topic.
definitions.definitionCn: IRC网络上用于对话的特定区域，类似于聊天室，常专注于特定话题。

definitions.definition: An obsolete means of delivering up-to-date Internet content.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种过时的传递最新互联网内容的方式。

definitions.definition: A psychic or medium who temporarily takes on the personality of somebody else.
definitions.definitionCn: 暂时扮演他人性格的通灵者或灵媒。

definitions.definition: To make or cut a channel or groove in.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……中制造或切割沟槽。

definitions.definition: To direct or guide along a desired course.
definitions.example: We will channel the traffic to the left with these cones.
definitions.definitionCn: 沿着预定路线引导或指引。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们将用这些锥形桶将交通引导至左侧。

definitions.definition: (of a spirit, as of a dead person) To serve as a medium for.
definitions.example: She was channeling the spirit of her late husband, Seth.
definitions.definitionCn: （指灵魂，如死者灵魂）充当媒介。
definitions.exampleCn: 她正在通灵她已故丈夫塞思的灵魂。

definitions.definition: To follow as a model, especially in a performance.
definitions.example: He was trying to channel President Reagan, but the audience wasn't buying it.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为榜样效仿，尤其在表演中。
definitions.exampleCn: 他试图模仿里根总统，但观众并不买账。

definitions.definition: The wale of a sailing ship which projects beyond the gunwale and to which the shrouds attach via the chains. One of the flat ledges of heavy plank bolted edgewise to the outside of a vessel, to increase the spread of the shrouds and carry them clear of the bulwarks.
definitions.definitionCn: 帆船上的舷侧板，突出于舷缘之外，通过链条连接支索。用螺栓垂直固定在船体外侧的厚重木板平缘，用于增加支索的展开范围并使其远离舷墙。

definitions.definition: Formal lines of command and procedure.
definitions.example: I'd love to be able to help you, but you'll have put that request through channels.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式的指挥和程序层级。
definitions.exampleCn: 我很乐意帮助你，但你必须通过正式渠道提交这个请求。

definitions.definition: To exercise influence over; to suggest or dictate the behavior of.
definitions.example: With a simple remote, he could control the toy truck.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加影响；建议或支配行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 只需一个简单的遥控器，他就能控制玩具卡车。

definitions.definition: (construed with for) To design (an experiment) so that the effects of one or more variables are reduced or eliminated.
definitions.definitionCn: （与for连用）设计（实验）以减少或消除一个或多个变量的影响。

definitions.definition: Inhibited or restrained in one's words and actions.
definitions.definitionCn: 言行受到抑制或约束。

definitions.definition: Resulting from a comparison with control samples.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过与对照样本比较得出的结果。

definitions.definition: (in combination) Under the control of the specified entity.
definitions.definitionCn: （用于复合词）受指定实体控制。

definitions.definition: A delegate.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个代表。

definitions.definition: Something standing for something else.
definitions.definitionCn: 某种代表其他事物的事物。

data.chinese: 印度尼西亚共和国林业部长M.S. Kaban先生阁下宣布会议开幕。

definitions.definition: Cleaning and polishing of an animal's teeth.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物牙齿的清洁与抛光。

definitions.definition: A dental sound.
definitions.definitionCn: 牙齿发出的声音。

definitions.definition: Of or concerning the teeth, as in dental care.
definitions.definitionCn: 与牙齿相关的，如牙齿护理。

definitions.definition: Of or concerning dentistry.
definitions.definitionCn: 与牙科学相关的。

definitions.definition: Made with the tongue touching the teeth, as in dental fricative.
definitions.definitionCn: 用舌头触碰牙齿发出的音，如齿擦音。

definitions.definition: The bodies that have political or administrative power and control in a particular sphere
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定领域拥有政治或行政权力及控制权的机构

definitions.definition: The bodies that enforce law and order or provide a public service
definitions.definitionCn: 执行法律、维护秩序或提供公共服务的机构

definitions.definition: The power to enforce rules or give orders.

definitions.definitionCn: 执行规则或下达命令的权力

definitions.definition: (used in singular or plural form) Persons in command; specifically, government.
definitions.definitionCn: （单数或复数形式）掌权者；特指政府

definitions.definition: A person accepted as a source of reliable information on a subject.

definitions.definitionCn: 被公认为某领域可靠信息来源的人

definitions.definition: Government-owned agency which runs a revenue-generating activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 经营创收活动的政府所属机构

definitions.definition: Gossypium, a genus of plant used as a source of cotton fiber.
definitions.definitionCn: 棉属，一种用作棉花纤维来源的植物属。

definitions.definition: Any plant that encases its seed in a thin fiber that is harvested and used as a fabric or cloth.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何将其种子包裹在薄纤维中，收获后用作织物或布料的植物。

definitions.definitionCn: 由棉花制成的。

definitions.definition: To get on with someone or something; to have a good relationship with someone.

A necessity or prerequisite; something required or obligatory. Its adpositions are generally of in relation to who or what has given it, on in relation to whom or what it is given to, and for in relation to what is required.
definitions.example: There was a requirement of the government on citizens for paying taxes.
definitions.definitionCn: 必需品或前提条件；被要求或必须的事物。其介词搭配通常为：of 表示由谁或什么提出要求，on 表示对谁或什么提出要求，for 表示要求的内容。
definitions.exampleCn: 政府曾对公民提出纳税要求。

definitions.definition: Something asked.
definitions.definitionCn: 被询问的事项。

definitions.definition: A statement (in domain specific terms) which specifies a verifiable constraint on an implementation that it shall undeniably meet or (a) be deemed unacceptable, or (b) result in implementation failure, or (c) result in system failure.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种（在特定领域术语中的）陈述，它规定了实现过程中可验证的约束条件，该条件必须无可争议地满足，否则将被视为不可接受，或导致实现失败，或导致系统故障。

definitions.definition: (material) A long object used to make a physical connection.
definitions.definitionCn: (材料) 用于建立物理连接的长形物体。

definitions.definition: (communications) A system for transmitting television or Internet services over a network of coaxial or fibreoptic cables.

definitions.definitionCn: (通信) 通过同轴或光纤电缆网络传输电视或互联网服务的系统。
definitions.exampleCn: 昨晚我试图看电影，但我的有线电视坏了。

definitions.definition: A telegram, notably when sent by (submarine) telegraph cable.
definitions.definitionCn: 电报，尤指通过（海底）电报电缆发送的电报。

definitions.definition: A unit of length equal to one tenth of a nautical mile.
definitions.definitionCn: 长度单位，等于十分之一海里。

definitions.definition: (unit, chiefly nautical) 100 fathoms, 600 imperial feet, approximately 185 m.
definitions.definitionCn: （单位，主要用于航海）100英寻，600英制英尺，约185米。

definitions.definition: The currency pair British Pound against United States Dollar.
definitions.definitionCn: 货币对：英镑兑美元。

definitions.definition: A moulding, shaft of a column, or any other member of convex, rounded section, made to resemble the spiral twist of a rope.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种线脚、柱身或任何其他凸起圆形截面的构件，模仿绳索的螺旋扭曲。

definitions.definition: A textural pattern achieved by passing groups of stitches over one another.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过将一组针迹相互交叉形成的纹理图案。

definitions.definition: To provide with cable(s)
definitions.definitionCn: 用电缆提供（设备）。

definitions.definition: To fasten (as if) with cable(s)
definitions.definitionCn: （像）用电缆固定。

definitions.definition: To wrap wires to form a cable
definitions.definitionCn: 将电线缠绕成电缆。

definitions.definition: To send a telegram by cable
definitions.definitionCn: 通过电缆发送电报。

definitions.definition: To communicate by cable
definitions.definitionCn: 通过电缆通信。

definitions.definition: To ornament with cabling.
definitions.definitionCn: 用电缆装饰。

definitions.definition: To create cable stitches.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作电缆针迹。

definitions.definition: The beginning of an activity.
definitions.example: The movie was entertaining from start to finish.
definitions.definitionCn: 活动的开始。
definitions.exampleCn: 这部电影从头到尾都很有趣。

definitions.definition: A sudden involuntary movement.
definitions.example: He woke with a start.
definitions.definitionCn: 突然的不自主动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 他惊醒过来。

definitions.definition: The beginning point of a race, a board game, etc.
definitions.example: Captured pieces are returned to the start of the board.
definitions.definitionCn: 比赛、棋盘游戏等的起点。
definitions.exampleCn: 被吃掉的棋子放回棋盘起点。

definitions.definition: An appearance in a sports game, horserace, etc., from the beginning of the event.
definitions.example: Jones has been a substitute before, but made his first start for the team last Sunday.
definitions.definitionCn: 从赛事开始就参与体育比赛、赛马等。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯之前一直是替补，但上周日首次代表球队首发。

definitions.definition: A young plant germinated in a pot to be transplanted later.
definitions.definitionCn: 在花盆中发芽、待移植的幼苗。

definitions.definition: An initial advantage over somebody else; a head start.
definitions.example: to get, or have, the start
definitions.definitionCn: 相对于他人的初始优势；领先起步。
definitions.exampleCn: 获得或拥有先机。

definitions.definition: To begin, commence, initiate.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始、着手、启动。

definitions.definition: To begin an activity.
definitions.example: The rain started at 9:00.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始一项活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 雨在9点开始下。

definitions.definition: To have its origin (at), begin.
definitions.example: The blue line starts one foot away from the wall.
definitions.definitionCn: 起源于（某处），开始。
definitions.exampleCn: 蓝线从离墙一英尺处开始。

definitions.definition: To startle or be startled; to move or be moved suddenly.
definitions.definitionCn: 使惊吓或受惊；突然移动或被移动。

definitions.definition: To break away, to come loose.
definitions.definitionCn: 脱离，松开。

definitions.definition: To put into play.
definitions.definitionCn: 投入游戏。

definitions.definition: To pour out; to empty; to tap and begin drawing from.
definitions.example: to start a water cask
definitions.definitionCn: 倒出；清空；打开并开始汲取。
definitions.exampleCn: 打开水桶开始放水。

definitions.definition: To start one's periods (menstruation).
definitions.example: Have you started yet?
definitions.definitionCn: 开始月经。
definitions.exampleCn: 你开始了吗？

definitions.definition: A tail, or anything projecting like a tail.
definitions.definitionCn: 尾巴，或任何像尾巴一样突出的东西。

definitions.definition: A handle, especially that of a plough.
definitions.definitionCn: 把手，尤指犁的把手。

definitions.definition: The curved or inclined front and bottom of a water wheel bucket.
definitions.definitionCn: 水车斗弯曲或倾斜的前部和底部。

definitions.definition: The arm, or level, of a gin, drawn around by a horse.
definitions.definitionCn: 由马牵引的轧棉机的臂杆或杠杆。

definitions.definition: To put to death; to extinguish the life of.
definitions.example: Smoking kills more people each year than alcohol and drugs combined.
definitions.definitionCn: 处死；夺去生命。
definitions.exampleCn: 每年因吸烟致死的人数超过酒精和毒品致死人数的总和。

definitions.definition: To render inoperative.
definitions.example: He killed the engine and turned off the headlights, but remained in the car, waiting.
definitions.definitionCn: 使失效。
definitions.exampleCn: 他熄灭了引擎，关掉车头灯，但仍留在车内等待。

definitions.definition: To stop, cease or render void; to terminate.
definitions.example: My computer wouldn't respond until I killed some of the running processes.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止、终止或使无效；终结。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的电脑一直没反应，直到我终止了一些正在运行的进程。

definitions.definition: To amaze, exceed, stun or otherwise incapacitate.
definitions.example: That joke always kills me.
definitions.definitionCn: 使惊叹、超越、震惊或以其他方式使无法应对。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个笑话总是让我笑翻。

definitions.definition: To cause great pain, discomfort or distress to.
definitions.example: These tight shoes are killing my feet.
definitions.definitionCn: 引起剧痛、不适或痛苦。
definitions.exampleCn: 这双紧鞋把我的脚折磨得够呛。

definitions.definition: To produce feelings of dissatisfaction or revulsion in.
definitions.example: It kills me to learn how many poor people are practically starving in this country while rich moguls spend such outrageous amounts on useless luxuries.
definitions.definitionCn: 引发不满或厌恶的情绪。
definitions.exampleCn: 得知在这个国家有那么多穷人几乎在挨饿，而富豪们却在无用的奢侈品上挥霍巨款，这让我痛心不已。

definitions.definition: To use up or to waste.
definitions.example: He told the bartender, pointing at the bottle of scotch he planned to consume, "Leave it, I'm going to kill the bottle."
definitions.definitionCn: 用尽或浪费。
definitions.exampleCn: 他指着打算喝掉的那瓶苏格兰威士忌对酒保说：“别拿走，我要干掉这瓶酒。”

definitions.definition: To exert an overwhelming effect on.
definitions.example: Between the two of us, we killed the rest of the case of beer.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生压倒性的效果。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们俩一起喝光了剩下的那箱啤酒。

definitions.definition: To overpower, overwhelm or defeat.
definitions.example: The team had absolutely killed their traditional rivals, and the local sports bars were raucous with celebrations.
definitions.definitionCn: 压倒、击溃或击败。
definitions.exampleCn: 这支队伍彻底击败了他们的传统对手，当地的体育酒吧里一片喧闹的庆祝声。

definitions.definition: To force a company out of business.
definitions.definitionCn: 迫使公司倒闭。

definitions.definition: To produce intense pain.

definitions.definition: To cause to assume the value zero.

definitions.definition: The feeling of being attracted.

definitions.definition: An event, location, or business that has a tendency to draw interest from visitors, and in many cases, local residents.

definitions.definition: A goal, aim or principle, especially one which transcends purely selfish ends.

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To actively produce as a result, by means of force or authority.

definitions.definition: To assign or show cause; to give a reason; to make excuse.

definitions.definition: A history, a non-fiction account of the past.

definitions.definition: Old-fashioned, untouched by modernity.

definitions.definition: Of, concerning, or in accordance with the past generally.

definitions.definition: Of, concerning, or in accordance with the scholarly discipline of history.
