definitions.example: Learning is the door to wisdom.
definitions.definitionCn: 接近或进入的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 学习是通往智慧之门。

definitions.definition: A barrier.
definitions.example: Keep a door on your anger.
definitions.definitionCn: 障碍物。
definitions.exampleCn: 控制你的愤怒。

definitions.definition: A software mechanism by which a user can interact with a program running remotely on a bulletin board system. See BBS door.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种软件机制，用户可通过它与远程运行在公告板系统上的程序交互。参见BBS门。

definitions.definition: To cause a collision by opening the door of a vehicle in front of an oncoming cyclist or pedestrian.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过打开车辆门导致与迎面而来的骑行者或行人发生碰撞。

definitions.definition: A length of time.
definitions.example: There was a period of confusion following the announcement.
definitions.definitionCn: 一段时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 公告发布后出现了一段混乱期。

definitions.definition: A period of time in history seen as a single coherent entity; an epoch, era.
definitions.example: Food rationing continued in the post-war period.
definitions.definitionCn: 历史上被视为单一连贯实体的时间段；一个时代、纪元。
definitions.exampleCn: 战后时期继续实行食物配给制。

definitions.definition: The punctuation mark “.” (indicating the ending of a sentence or marking an abbreviation).
definitions.definitionCn: 标点符号“.”（表示句子结束或标记缩写）。

definitions.definition: The length of time during which the same characteristics of a periodic phenomenon recur, such as the repetition of a wave or the rotation of a planet.
definitions.definitionCn: 周期性现象中相同特征重复出现的时间长度，例如波的重复或行星的自转。

definitions.definition: Female menstruation.
definitions.example: When she is on her period, she prefers not to go swimming.
definitions.definitionCn: 女性月经。
definitions.exampleCn: 她来月经时，更愿意不去游泳。

definitions.definition: A section of an artist's, writer's (etc.) career distinguished by a given quality, preoccupation etc.
definitions.example: This is one of the last paintings Picasso created during his Blue Period.
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术家、作家等职业生涯中因特定品质、关注点等而区分的一个阶段。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是毕加索在其蓝色时期创作的最后一幅画作之一。

definitions.definition: Each of the divisions into which a school day is split, allocated to a given subject or activity.
definitions.example: I have math class in second period.
definitions.definitionCn: 学校一天被划分成的各个时段，分配给特定科目或活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我第二节课有数学课。

definitions.definition: Each of the intervals into which various sporting events are divided.
definitions.example: Gretzky scored in the last minute of the second period.
definitions.definitionCn: 各种体育赛事被划分成的间隔之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 格雷茨基在第二节最后一分钟得分。

definitions.definition: The length of time for a disease to run its course.
definitions.definitionCn: 疾病完成其病程所需的时间长度。

definitions.definition: An end or conclusion; the final point of a process etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 结束或结论；一个过程等的最终点。

definitions.definition: A complete sentence, especially one expressing a single thought or making a balanced, rhythmic whole.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个完整的句子，尤其是表达单一思想或形成平衡、有节奏的整体。

definitions.definition: A specific moment during a given process; a point, a stage.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定过程中的一个具体时刻；一个点、一个阶段。

definitions.definition: A row in the periodic table of the elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 元素周期表中的一行。

definitions.definition: A subdivision of an era, typically lasting from tens to hundreds of millions of years, see Appendix: Geologic timescale.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个时代的下属划分，通常持续数千万到数亿年，参见附录：地质年代尺度。

definitions.definition: A Drosophila gene, the gene product of which is involved in regulation of the circadian rhythm.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个果蝇基因，其基因产物参与昼夜节律的调节。

definitions.definition: Two phrases (an antecedent and a consequent phrase).
definitions.definitionCn: 两个乐句（一个前句和一个后句）。

definitions.definition: The length of an interval over which a periodic function, periodic sequence or repeating decimal repeats; often the least such length.
definitions.definitionCn: 周期函数、周期序列或循环小数重复的区间长度；通常是最小这样的长度。

definitions.definition: End point, conclusion.
definitions.definitionCn: 终点，结论。

definitions.definition: An attempt to cause damage, injury to, or death of opponent or enemy.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图对对手或敌人造成伤害、损伤或死亡。

definitions.definition: An attempt to detract from the worth or credibility of, a person, position, idea, object, or thing, by physical, verbal, emotional, or other assault.
definitions.example: They claimed the censorship of the article was an attack on free speech.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过身体、言语、情感或其他攻击，贬低某人、立场、想法、物体或事物的价值或可信度。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们声称对文章的审查是对言论自由的攻击。

definitions.definition: A time in which one attacks; the offence of a battle.
definitions.example: The army timed their attack to coincide with the local celebrations.
definitions.definitionCn: 发动攻击的时刻；战斗中的进攻阶段。
definitions.exampleCn: 军队将攻击时间安排在当地的庆祝活动期间。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The beginning of active operations on anything.
definitions.example: Having washed the plates from dinner, I made an attack on the laundry.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）对任何事物的积极行动的开始。
definitions.exampleCn: 洗完晚餐的盘子后，我开始处理洗衣任务。

definitions.definition: An attempt to exploit a vulnerability in a computer system.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图利用计算机系统中的漏洞。

definitions.definition: Collectively, the bowlers of a cricket side.
definitions.definitionCn: （板球）集体指一方的投球手。

definitions.definition: Any contact with the ball other than a serve or block which sends the ball across the plane of the net.
definitions.definitionCn: 除发球或拦网外，任何将球击过球网平面的接触。

definitions.definition: The three attackmen on the field or all the attackmen of a team.
definitions.definitionCn: 场上三名攻击手或一支球队的所有攻击手。

definitions.definition: The sudden onset of a disease or condition.
definitions.example: I've had an attack of the flu.
definitions.definitionCn: 疾病或状况的突然发作。
definitions.exampleCn: 我得了流感。

definitions.definition: An active episode of a chronic or recurrent disease.
definitions.definitionCn: 慢性或复发性疾病的活跃期。

definitions.definition: The onset of a musical note, particularly with respect to the strength (and duration) of that onset.
definitions.definitionCn: 音符的起始，尤其指其强度（和持续时间）。

definitions.definition: (audio) The amount of time it takes for the volume of an audio signal to go from zero to maximum level (e.g. an audio waveform representing a snare drum hit would feature a very fast attack, whereas that of a wave washing to shore would feature a slow attack).
definitions.definitionCn: （音频）音频信号音量从零升至最大水平所需的时间（例如，代表军鼓击打的音频波形具有非常快的起音，而海浪拍岸的波形则起音较慢）。

definitions.definition: To apply violent force to someone or something.
definitions.example: This species of snake will only attack humans if it feels threatened.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某人或某物施加暴力。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种蛇只有在感到威胁时才会攻击人类。

definitions.definition: To aggressively challenge a person, idea, etc., with words (particularly in newspaper headlines, because it typesets into less space than "criticize" or similar).
definitions.example: She published an article attacking the recent pay cuts.
definitions.definitionCn: 用言语激烈挑战某人、观点等（尤其在报纸标题中，因其排版空间比“批评”等词更小）。
definitions.exampleCn: 她发表了一篇文章，抨击近期的减薪措施。

definitions.definition: To begin to affect; to act upon injuriously or destructively; to begin to decompose or waste.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始产生影响；以有害或破坏性的方式作用；开始分解或损耗。

definitions.definition: To deal with something in a direct way; to set to work upon.
definitions.example: I attacked the meal with a hearty appetite.
definitions.definitionCn: 以直接方式处理某事；着手进行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我胃口大开地对付这顿饭。

definitions.definition: To aim balls at the batsman’s wicket.
definitions.definitionCn: 将球投向击球手的球门。

definitions.definition: To set a field, or bowl in a manner designed to get wickets.
definitions.definitionCn: 布置场地或投球，旨在取得出局数。

definitions.definition: To bat aggressively, so as to score runs quickly.
definitions.definitionCn: 积极击球以快速得分。

definitions.definition: To move forward in an active attempt to score a point, as opposed to trying not to concede.
definitions.definitionCn: 向前移动积极尝试得分，而非试图避免失分。

definitions.definition: To accelerate quickly in an attempt to get ahead of the other riders.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速加速以试图领先其他车手。

definitions.definition: A person who is running in an election.
definitions.definitionCn: 竞选者。

definitions.definition: A person who is applying for a job.
definitions.definitionCn: 求职者。

definitions.definition: A participant in an examination.
definitions.definitionCn: 应试者。

definitions.definition: Something or somebody that may be suitable.
definitions.definitionCn: 可能合适的人或物。

definitions.definition: A gene which may play a role in a given disease.
definitions.definitionCn: 可能在某种疾病中起作用的基因。

definitions.definition: An individual alumnus or alumna.
definitions.definitionCn: 一位校友（男性或女性）。

definitions.definition: A male pupil or student.
definitions.definitionCn: 一名男学生。

definitions.definition: A male graduate.
definitions.definitionCn: 一名男性毕业生。

definitions.definition: A student of any gender.
definitions.definitionCn: 一名任何性别的学生。

definitions.definition: A graduate of any gender.
definitions.definitionCn: 一名任何性别的毕业生。

definitions.definition: A perceived change in some function, sensation or appearance of a person that indicates a disease or disorder, such as fever, headache or rash.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人在某些功能、感觉或外观上感知到的变化，表明存在疾病或失调，例如发烧、头痛或皮疹。

definitions.definition: A signal; anything that indicates, or is characteristic of, the presence of something else, especially of something undesirable.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种信号；任何表明或具有其他事物（尤其是不受欢迎的事物）存在特征的东西。

definitions.definition: Someone who visits someone else; someone staying as a guest.
definitions.definitionCn: 拜访他人者；作为客人暂住的人。

definitions.definition: Someone who pays a visit to a specific place or event; a sightseer or tourist.
definitions.definitionCn: 前往特定地点或活动参观的人；观光客或游客。

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) Someone, or a team, that is playing away from home.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）在客场参赛的人或团队。

definitions.definition: A person authorized to visit an institution to see that it is being managed properly.
definitions.definitionCn: 被授权视察机构以确保其管理得当的人。

definitions.definition: An extraterrestrial being on Earth for any reason.
definitions.definitionCn: 因任何原因来到地球的外星生物。

definitions.definition: An object which lands or passes by Earth or its orbit.
definitions.definitionCn: 降落或经过地球或其轨道的物体。

definitions.definition: A head or overseer of an institution such as a college (in which case, equivalent to the university's chancellor) or cathedral or hospital, who resolves disputes, gives ceremonial speeches, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 学院（相当于大学校长）、大教堂或医院等机构的负责人或监督者，负责解决争端、发表典礼演讲等。

definitions.definition: The object in the visitor pattern that performs an operation on the elements of a structure one by one.
definitions.definitionCn: 访问者模式中，逐一对结构中的元素执行操作的对象。

definitions.definition: An entrance capable of being blocked by use of a gate.
definitions.definitionCn: 可通过大门封闭的入口。

definitions.definition: Any point that represents the beginning of a transition from one place or phase to another.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表从一个地点或阶段向另一个过渡起点的任何点。

definitions.definition: A point at which freight moving from one territory to another is interchanged between transportation lines.
definitions.definitionCn: 货物从一个区域运往另一个区域时，在运输线路之间进行交换的点。

definitions.definition: (digital communications) In wireless internet, an access point with additional software capabilities such as providing NAT and DHCP, which may also provide VPN support, roaming, firewalls, various levels of security, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: （数字通信）在无线互联网中，具备额外软件功能的接入点，例如提供NAT和DHCP，还可能支持VPN、漫游、防火墙、不同级别的安全等。

definitions.definition: (digital communications) To make available via a gateway, or access point.
definitions.definitionCn: （数字通信）通过网关或接入点提供可用性。

definitions.definition: A place where people go for recreation, especially one with facilities such as lodgings, entertainment, and a relaxing environment.
definitions.definitionCn: 人们去休闲的地方，尤其是有住宿、娱乐和放松环境等设施的地方。

definitions.definition: Recourse, refuge (something or someone turned to for safety).
definitions.example: to have resort to violence
definitions.definitionCn: 求助、避难（为寻求安全而求助的人或事物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 诉诸暴力

definitions.definition: A place where one goes habitually; a haunt.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人常去的地方；出没处。

definitions.definition: To have recourse (to), now especially from necessity or frustration.
definitions.definitionCn: 求助于（尤指出于必要或挫败时）。

definitions.definition: To fall back; to revert.
definitions.definitionCn: 退而求其次；恢复原状。

definitions.definition: To make one's way, go (to).
definitions.definitionCn: 前往（某处）。

definitions.definition: An act of sorting again.
definitions.definitionCn: 再次分类的行为。

definitions.definition: To repeat a sorting process; sort again.
definitions.definitionCn: 重复分类过程；重新分类。

definitions.definition: Active power or movement; spring.
definitions.definitionCn: 主动的力量或运动；弹簧。

definitions.definition: To move or develop something.
definitions.definitionCn: 移动或发展某物。

definitions.definition: To exert or experience force.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加或承受力。

definitions.definition: (fluidic) To remove or separate or displace.
definitions.definitionCn: （流体）移除、分离或移位。

definitions.definition: To change in size or shape.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变大小或形状。

definitions.definition: To attract or be attracted.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸引或被吸引。

definitions.definition: (usually as draw on or draw upon) To rely on; utilize as a source.
definitions.example: She had to draw upon her experience to solve the problem.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常作draw on或draw upon）依赖；利用为来源。
definitions.exampleCn: 她不得不依靠自己的经验来解决问题。

definitions.definition: To disembowel.
definitions.definitionCn: 开膛破肚。

definitions.definition: To end a game in a draw (with neither side winning).
definitions.example: We drew last time we played.  I drew him last time I played him.  I drew my last game against him.
definitions.definitionCn: 以平局结束比赛（双方均未获胜）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们上次比赛打平了。 我上次和他比赛打平了。 我上次与他对局打成平手。

definitions.definition: To choose by means of a random selection process.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过随机选择过程来挑选。

definitions.definition: To make a shot that lands gently in the house (the circular target) without knocking out other stones.
definitions.definitionCn: 打出轻轻落在圆形目标区域（冰壶）而不撞出其他石头的投掷。

definitions.definition: To play (a short-length ball directed at the leg stump) with an inclined bat so as to deflect the ball between the legs and the wicket.
definitions.definitionCn: 用倾斜的球棒击打（投向腿柱的短球），使球在腿和三柱门之间偏转。

definitions.definition: To hit (the ball) with the toe of the club so that it is deflected toward the left.
definitions.definitionCn: 用球杆尖端击打（球）使其向左偏转。

definitions.definition: To strike (the cue ball) below the center so as to give it a backward rotation which causes it to take a backward direction on striking another ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打（母球）中心以下部位，使其产生向后旋转，从而在撞击另一球时向后运动。

definitions.definition: A picture, likeness, diagram or representation, usually drawn on paper.
(uncountable) The act of producing such a picture.
Such acts practiced as a graphic art form.
The process of drawing or pulling something.
definitions.example: Proverb: An official is great in his office as a well is rich in drawings of water.

definitions.definition: An act or event in which the outcome (e.g., designating a winner) is selected by chance in the form of a blind draw, notably of lots; especially such a contest in which a winning name or number is selected randomly by removing (or drawing) it from a container, popularly a hat.
A small portion of tea for steeping.
Of great size, large.
definitions.example: Elephants are big animals, and they eat a lot.
definitions.definitionCn: 体型巨大，庞大。
definitions.exampleCn: 大象是大型动物，食量也很大。

definitions.definition: (of an industry or other field, often capitalized) Thought to have undue influence.
definitions.example: Big Tech
definitions.definitionCn: （常大写，指行业或其他领域）被认为具有过度影响力的。
definitions.exampleCn: 大型科技公司。

definitions.definition: Popular.
definitions.example: That style is very big right now in Europe, especially among teenagers.
definitions.definitionCn: 流行的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那种风格目前在欧洲非常流行，尤其在青少年中。

definitions.definition: Adult.
definitions.example: Kids should get help from big people if they want to use the kitchen.
definitions.definitionCn: 成年的。
definitions.exampleCn: 孩子们如果想用厨房，应该找大人帮忙。

definitions.definition: Fat.
definitions.example: Gosh, she is big!
definitions.definitionCn: 肥胖的。
definitions.exampleCn: 天哪，她真胖！

definitions.definition: Important or significant.
definitions.example: What's so big about that? I do it all the time.
definitions.definitionCn: 重要的或重大的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那有什么大不了的？我经常做。

definitions.definition: (with on) Enthusiastic (about).
definitions.example: I'm not big on the idea, but if you want to go ahead with it, I won't stop you.
definitions.definitionCn: （与on连用）热衷于（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不太热衷这个主意，但如果你想继续，我不会阻止你。

definitions.definition: Mature, conscientious, principled; generous.
definitions.example: I tried to be the bigger person and just let it go, but I couldn't help myself.
definitions.definitionCn: 成熟的、有责任心的、有原则的；宽宏大量的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我试图做个更大度的人，就此放手，但我还是忍不住。

definitions.definition: Well-endowed, possessing large breasts in the case of a woman or a large penis in the case of a man.
definitions.example: Whoa, Nadia has gotten pretty big since she hit puberty.
definitions.definitionCn: （指女性）胸部丰满的，（指男性）阴茎粗大的。
definitions.exampleCn: 哇，娜迪亚进入青春期后变得相当丰满了。

definitions.definition: (sometimes figurative) Large with young; pregnant; swelling; ready to give birth or produce.
definitions.example: She was big with child.
definitions.definitionCn: （有时比喻）怀有身孕的；肿胀的；即将分娩或生产的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她身怀六甲。

definitions.definition: Used as an intensifier, especially of negative-valence nouns
definitions.example: You are a big liar.  Why are you in such a big hurry?
definitions.definitionCn: 用作强调词，尤其用于负面含义的名词前。
definitions.exampleCn: 你是个大骗子。 你为什么这么急匆匆的？

definitions.definition: (of a city) populous
definitions.definitionCn: （指城市）人口众多的。

definitions.definition: (of somebody's age) old, mature. Used to imply that somebody is too old for something, or acting immaturely.
definitions.definitionCn: （指某人的年龄）年长的，成熟的。用于暗示某人因年龄太大不适合某事，或行为幼稚。

definitions.definition: A dessert consisting of sponge cake filled with fruit, and cream or custard.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种由海绵蛋糕夹水果、奶油或蛋奶沙司制成的甜点。

definitions.definition: A biological product.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种生物制品。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to biology.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或与生物学相关的。

definitions.definition: Related by consanguinity, especially as to parents and children.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过血缘关系相连，尤指父母与子女之间。

definitions.definition: (an error in NNES) Organic (grown without agrochemicals).
definitions.definitionCn: （非英语母语者的错误用法）有机的（指未使用农用化学品种植的）。

definitions.definition: To set in some sort of order.
definitions.definitionCn: 整理成某种顺序。

definitions.definition: To arrange, set in proper order.
definitions.definitionCn: 安排，摆放整齐。

definitions.definition: To issue a command to.
definitions.example: He ordered me to leave.
definitions.definitionCn: 下达命令。
definitions.exampleCn: 他命令我离开。

definitions.definition: To request some product or service; to secure by placing an order.
definitions.example: to order groceries
definitions.definitionCn: 订购某种产品或服务；通过下订单获得。
definitions.exampleCn: 订购杂货。

definitions.definition: To admit to holy orders; to ordain; to receive into the ranks of the ministry.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予圣职；任命；接纳为神职人员行列。

definitions.definition: In order, not messy, tidy.
definitions.definitionCn: 有序，不凌乱，整洁。

data.chinese: 类似于将符合和值联系起来的字典，但数字树中的符号是整数，并且是有序的。

definitions.definition: A person who secretly watches and examines the actions of other individuals or organizations and gathers information on them (usually to gain an advantage).
definitions.definitionCn: 秘密监视并检查他人或组织行为并收集其信息的人（通常是为了获取优势）。

definitions.definition: To act as a spy.
definitions.example: During the Cold War, Russia and America would each spy on each other for recon.
definitions.definitionCn: 充当间谍。
definitions.exampleCn: 冷战期间，俄罗斯和美国会互相进行侦察间谍活动。

definitions.definition: To spot; to catch sight of.
definitions.example: I think I can spy that hot guy coming over here.
definitions.definitionCn: 发现；瞥见。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想我能看到那个帅哥正朝这边走来。

definitions.definition: To search narrowly; to scrutinize.
definitions.definitionCn: 仔细搜索；仔细审视。

definitions.definition: To explore; to see; to view; inspect and examine secretly, as a country.
definitions.definitionCn: 探索；观察；查看；秘密检查，如对一个国家。

definitions.definition: To occur or take place.
definitions.example: Let me tell you how it happened.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生或进行。
definitions.exampleCn: 让我告诉你事情是如何发生的。

definitions.definition: To happen to; to befall.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生在……身上；降临到……头上。

definitions.definition: (with infinitive) To do or occur by chance or unexpectedly.
definitions.example: Do you happen to have an umbrella?
definitions.definitionCn: （后接不定式）偶然或意外地做某事或发生某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 你碰巧有伞吗？

definitions.definition: (followed by on or upon) To encounter by chance.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接on或upon）偶然遇到。

definitions.definition: The selection of one thing or person over others (with the main adposition being "for" in relation to the thing or person, but possibly also "of")
definitions.example: He has a preference for crisp wines.
definitions.definitionCn: 选择某物或某人而非其他（主要介词为"for"，与所选对象相关，但也可用"of"）
definitions.exampleCn: 他偏爱清爽的葡萄酒。

definitions.definition: The option to so select, and the one selected.
definitions.example: Can I keep my preferences when I upgrade to the new version of this application?
definitions.definitionCn: 进行这种选择的权利，以及被选中的对象。
definitions.exampleCn: 升级到本应用程序的新版本时，能否保留我的偏好设置？

definitions.definition: The state of being preferred over others.
definitions.definitionCn: 被优先选择的状态。

definitions.definition: A strong liking or personal valuation.
definitions.definitionCn: 强烈的喜好或个人评价。

definitions.definition: A preferential bias; partiality; discrimination.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏好性偏见；偏袒；歧视。

definitions.definition: To give preferential treatment to; to give a preference to.
definitions.definitionCn: 给予优待；给予优先权。

definitions.definition: The user-specified settings of parameters in interactive computer software
definitions.definitionCn: 交互式计算机软件中用户指定的参数设置。

definitions.definition: A subject of a talk or an artistic piece; a topic.
definitions.definitionCn: 谈话或艺术作品的主题；话题。

definitions.definition: A recurring idea; a motif.
definitions.definitionCn: 反复出现的想法；母题。

definitions.definition: An essay written for school.
definitions.definitionCn: 为学校写的文章。

definitions.definition: The main melody of a piece of music, especially one that is the source of variations.
definitions.definitionCn: 一首音乐作品的主旋律，尤其是作为变奏来源的旋律。

definitions.definition: A song, or a snippet of a song, that identifies a film, a TV program, a character, etc. by playing at the appropriate time.
definitions.definitionCn: 一首歌曲或歌曲片段，通过在适当时间播放来标识电影、电视节目、角色等。

definitions.definition: The collection of color schemes, sounds, artwork etc., that "skin" an environment towards a particular motif.
definitions.definitionCn: 将色彩方案、声音、艺术作品等集合起来，使环境围绕特定主题“换肤”。

definitions.definition: (grammar) The stem of a word.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）词干。

definitions.definition: Thematic relation of a noun phrase to a verb.
definitions.definitionCn: 名词短语与动词的题元关系。

definitions.definition: Theta role in generative grammar and government and binding theory.
definitions.definitionCn: 生成语法和管辖与约束理论中的θ角色。

definitions.definition: Topic, what is generally being talked about, as opposed to rheme.
definitions.definitionCn: 话题，即通常谈论的内容，与述位相对。

definitions.definition: A regional unit of organisation in the Byzantine empire.
definitions.definitionCn: 拜占庭帝国中的区域行政单位。

definitions.definition: To give a theme to.
definitions.example: We themed the birthday party around superheroes.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予主题。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们以超级英雄为主题举办了生日派对。

definitions.definition: To apply a theme to; to change the visual appearance and/or layout of (software).
definitions.definitionCn: 应用主题；改变（软件的）视觉外观和/或布局。

definitions.definition: To contend in physical conflict, either singly or in war, battle etc.
definitions.example: A wounded animal will fight like a maniac, relentless, savage and murderous.
definitions.definitionCn: 在单独或战争、战斗等身体冲突中争斗。
definitions.exampleCn: 受伤的动物会像疯子一样战斗，无情、野蛮且凶残。

definitions.definition: To contend in physical conflict with each other, either singly or in war, battle etc.
definitions.example: The two boxers have been fighting for more than half an hour.
definitions.definitionCn: 彼此进行身体冲突，无论是单独还是战争、战斗等。
definitions.exampleCn: 两位拳击手已经打了半个多小时。

definitions.definition: To strive for something; to campaign or contend for success.
definitions.example: He fought for the Democrats in the last election.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某事物奋斗；为成功而竞选或抗争。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在上次选举中为民主党而战。

definitions.definition: To conduct or engage in (battle, warfare etc.).
definitions.example: The battle was fought just over that hill.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行或参与（战斗、战争等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 那场战斗就在那座山丘上进行。

definitions.definition: To engage in combat with; to oppose physically, to contest with.
definitions.example: My grandfather fought the Nazis in World War II.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……交战；身体对抗，与……竞争。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的祖父在第二次世界大战中与纳粹作战。

definitions.definition: To try to overpower; to fiercely counteract.
definitions.example: The government pledged to fight corruption.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图压倒；激烈对抗。
definitions.exampleCn: 政府承诺打击腐败。

definitions.definition: To cause to fight; to manage or manoeuvre in a fight.
definitions.example: to fight cocks; to fight one's ship
definitions.definitionCn: 导致战斗；在战斗中操控或指挥。
definitions.exampleCn: 斗鸡；指挥自己的战舰作战

definitions.definition: Of colours or other design elements: to clash; to fail to harmonize.
definitions.definitionCn: （颜色或其他设计元素）冲突；不协调。

definitions.definition: Engaged in war or other conflict.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于战争或其他冲突中。

definitions.definition: Apt to provoke a fight.
definitions.definitionCn: 容易引发争斗的。

definitions.definition: The act or process of contending; violence or conflict.
A fight or battle; an occasion on which people fight
Ability to do or undergo something.
definitions.definitionCn: 做某事或经历某事的能力。

definitions.definition: (social) Ability to coerce, influence or control.
definitions.definitionCn: （社会）强制、影响或控制的能力。

definitions.definition: (physical) Effectiveness.
definitions.definitionCn: （物理）效力。

definitions.definition: A large amount or number.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量或众多。

definitions.definition: Any of the elementary forms or parts of machines: three primary (the lever, inclined plane, and pulley) and three secondary (the wheel-and-axle, wedge, and screw).
definitions.example: the mechanical powers
definitions.definitionCn: 机器的任何基本形式或部件：三种主要形式（杠杆、斜面、滑轮）和三种次要形式（轮轴、楔、螺旋）。
definitions.exampleCn: 机械力。

definitions.definition: A measure of the effectiveness that a force producing a physical effect has over time. If linear, the quotient of: (force multiplied by the displacement of or in an object) ÷ time. If rotational, the quotient of: (force multiplied by the angle of displacement) ÷ time.
definitions.definitionCn: 衡量产生物理效应的力随时间作用的有效性。如果是线性力，则为：（力乘以物体位移）÷时间。如果是旋转力，则为：（力乘以位移角度）÷时间。

definitions.definition: A product of equal factors (and generalizations of this notion): x^n, read as "x to the power of n" or the like, is called a power and denotes the product x \times x \times \cdots \times x, where x appears n times in the product; x is called the base and n the exponent.
definitions.definitionCn: 相等因子的乘积（以及此概念的推广）：x^n，读作“x的n次方”等，称为幂，表示乘积x × x × ⋯ × x，其中x在乘积中出现n次；x称为底数，n称为指数。

definitions.definition: Cardinality.
definitions.definitionCn: 基数。

definitions.definition: The probability that a statistical test will reject the null hypothesis when the alternative hypothesis is true.
definitions.definitionCn: 统计检验在备择假设为真时拒绝原假设的概率。

definitions.definition: (in plural) In Christian angelology, an intermediate level of angels, ranked above archangels, but exact position varies by classification scheme.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）在基督教天使学中，天使的中间等级，位于大天使之上，但具体位置因分类方案而异。

definitions.definition: To provide power for (a mechanical or electronic device).
definitions.example: This CD player is powered by batteries.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（机械或电子设备）提供动力。
definitions.exampleCn: 这台CD播放器由电池供电。

definitions.definition: To hit or kick something forcefully.
definitions.definitionCn: 用力击打或踢某物。

definitions.definition: To enable or provide the impetus for.
definitions.definitionCn: 使能够或提供推动力。

definitions.definition: A cellular phone (mobile phone).
definitions.definitionCn: 手机（移动电话）。

definitions.definition: Of, relating to, consisting of, or resembling a cell or cells.
definitions.definitionCn: 细胞的，与细胞相关的，由细胞构成的，或类似细胞的。

definitions.definition: Two times.
definitions.definitionCn: 两次。

definitions.definition: (usually with "as", of a specified quality) Doubled in quantity, intensity, or degree.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与"as"连用，指特定性质）在数量、强度或程度上加倍。

definitions.definition: The act of forming into a class or classes; a distribution into groups, as classes, orders, families, etc., according to some common relations or attributes.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成类别或等级的行为；根据某些共同关系或属性，将事物划分为组别，如纲、目、科等。

definitions.definition: (followed by on or upon) To concentrate one's attention.
definitions.example: I have to focus on my work.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接on或upon）集中注意力。
definitions.exampleCn: 我必须专注于我的工作。

definitions.definition: To cause (rays of light, etc) to converge at a single point.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（光线等）汇聚于一点。

definitions.definition: To adjust (a lens, an optical instrument) in order to position an image with respect to the focal plane.
definitions.example: You'll need to focus the microscope carefully in order to capture the full detail of this surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 调整（镜头、光学仪器）以使图像相对于焦平面定位。
definitions.exampleCn: 你需要仔细调焦显微镜，才能捕捉到这一表面的全部细节。

definitions.definition: To concentrate one’s attention.
definitions.example: If you're going to beat your competitors, you need to focus.
definitions.definitionCn: 集中注意力。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你想击败竞争对手，就需要专注。

definitions.definition: To transfer the input focus to (a visual element), so that it receives subsequent input.
definitions.example: The text box won't receive the user's keystrokes unless you explicitly focus it.
definitions.definitionCn: 将输入焦点转移到（某个视觉元素）上，使其接收后续输入。
definitions.exampleCn: 除非你明确聚焦该文本框，否则它不会接收用户的按键输入。

definitions.definition: Directing all one's efforts towards achieving a particular goal.
definitions.definitionCn: 将全部精力用于实现某个特定目标。

definitions.definition: Dealing with some narrowly defined aspects of a broader phenomenon.
definitions.definitionCn: 处理更广泛现象中某些狭义界定的方面。

definitions.definition: A piece of metal placed in a horse's mouth and connected to the reins to direct the animal.
definitions.example: A horse hates having a bit put in its mouth.
definitions.definitionCn: 一块放在马嘴里、连接缰绳以引导马匹的金属片。
definitions.exampleCn: 马讨厌嘴里含着嚼子。

definitions.definition: A rotary cutting tool fitted to a drill, used to bore holes.
definitions.definitionCn: 装在钻头上用于钻孔的旋转切割工具。

definitions.definition: A coin of a specified value.
definitions.example: a threepenny bit
definitions.definitionCn: 特定面值的硬币。
definitions.exampleCn: 一枚三便士硬币。

definitions.definition: A ten-cent piece, dime.
definitions.definitionCn: 一枚十分硬币，即十美分。

definitions.definition: A unit of currency or coin in the Americas worth a fraction of a Spanish dollar; now specifically, an eighth of a US dollar.
definitions.example: A quarter is two bits.
definitions.definitionCn: 美洲的一种货币单位或硬币，价值相当于西班牙银元的一小部分；现在特指一美元的八分之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 四分之一美元是两比特。

definitions.definition: In the southern and southwestern states, a small silver coin (such as the real) formerly current; commonly, one worth about 12½ cents; also, the sum of 12½ cents.
definitions.definitionCn: 在美国南部和西南部各州，一种以前流通的小银币（如里亚尔）；通常价值约12.5美分；也指12.5美分的金额。

definitions.definition: A small amount of something.
definitions.example: There were bits of paper all over the floor.   Does your leg still hurt? / Just a bit now.   I've done my bit; I expect you to do yours.
definitions.definitionCn: 少量某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 地板上到处是纸屑。你的腿还疼吗？/ 现在只有一点点疼。我尽了我的本分；我希望你也尽你的本分。

definitions.definition: Specifically, a small amount of time.
definitions.example: I'll be there in a bit; I need to take care of something first.   He was here just a bit ago, but it looks like he's stepped out.
definitions.definitionCn: 特指一小段时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 我一会儿就到；我需要先处理点事。他刚才还在这儿，但看起来他出去了。

definitions.definition: (plural) Fractions of a second.
definitions.example: The 400 metres race was won in 47 seconds and bits.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）几分之一秒。
definitions.exampleCn: 400米赛跑以47秒多获胜。

definitions.definition: A portion of something.
definitions.example: I'd like a big bit of cake, please.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的一部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 请给我一大块蛋糕。

definitions.definition: Somewhat; something, but not very great; also used like jot and whit to express the smallest degree. See also a bit.
definitions.example: Am I bored? Not a bit of it!
definitions.definitionCn: 有点；某种程度，但不太大；也像"jot"和"whit"一样用来表示最小程度。参见"a bit"。
definitions.exampleCn: 我无聊吗？一点也不！

definitions.definition: A prison sentence, especially a short one.
definitions.definitionCn: 一段刑期，尤其是短刑期。

definitions.definition: An excerpt of material making up part of a show, comedy routine, etc.
definitions.example: His bit about video games was not nearly as entertaining as the other segments of his show.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成节目、喜剧段子等的一部分素材。
definitions.exampleCn: 他关于电子游戏的那段表演远不如他节目中的其他部分有趣。

definitions.definition: A small part or role, sometimes with spoken lines, in a theatrical performance.
definitions.example: She acted her bit in the opening scene.
definitions.definitionCn: 戏剧表演中的一个小部分或小角色，有时有台词。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在开场戏中扮演了她的小角色。

definitions.definition: The part of a key which enters the lock and acts upon the bolt and tumblers.
definitions.definitionCn: 钥匙进入锁芯并作用于锁舌和弹子的部分。

definitions.definition: The cutting iron of a plane.
definitions.definitionCn: 刨子的刨刃。

definitions.definition: The bevelled front edge of an axehead along which the cutting edge runs.
definitions.definitionCn: 斧头沿切割刃的斜面边缘。

definitions.definition: A binary digit, generally represented as a 1 or 0.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个二进制数字，通常表示为1或0。

definitions.definition: The smallest unit of storage in a digital computer, consisting of a binary digit.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字计算机中最小的存储单位，由一个二进制数字组成。

definitions.definition: Any datum that may take on one of exactly two values.
definitions.example: permission bits in a file system
definitions.definitionCn: 任何可能取两个值之一的数据。
definitions.exampleCn: 文件系统中的权限位。

definitions.definition: A unit of measure for information entropy.
definitions.definitionCn: 信息熵的度量单位。

definitions.definition: A microbitcoin, or a millionth of a bitcoin (0.000001 BTC).
definitions.definitionCn: 一个微比特币，即比特币的百万分之一（0.000001 BTC）。

definitions.definition: Such a file transfer.
definitions.definitionCn: 这样的文件传输。

definitions.definition: To transfer data to a computer on a network, especially to a server on the Internet.
definitions.example: You will have to convert your photograph to a jpg format if you wish to upload it.
definitions.definitionCn: 将数据传输到网络上的计算机，尤其是互联网上的服务器。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你想上传照片，必须将其转换为jpg格式。

definitions.definition: Institution of higher education (typically accepting students from the age of about 17 or 18, depending on country, but in some exceptional cases able to take younger students) where subjects are studied and researched in depth and degrees are offered.
definitions.example: The only reason why I haven't gone to university is because I can't afford it.
definitions.definitionCn: 高等教育机构（通常接收约17或18岁的学生，具体视国家而定，但在某些特殊情况下也可招收更年轻的学生），在此深入学习与研究学科，并授予学位。
definitions.exampleCn: 我未上大学唯一的原因是我负担不起。

definitions.definition: The act or state of being or making something complete; conclusion, accomplishment.
definitions.definitionCn: 完成某事物或使其完整的行为或状态；结束，成就。

definitions.definition: The conclusion of an act of conveyancing concerning the sale of a property.
definitions.definitionCn: 关于财产销售的产权转让行为的完成。

definitions.definition: A forward pass that is successfully caught by the intended receiver.
definitions.definitionCn: 被预期接球手成功接住的前传球。

definitions.definition: The act of making a metric space complete by adding points.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过添加点使度量空间完备的行为。

definitions.definition: The space resulting from such an act.
definitions.definitionCn: 由此行为产生的空间。

definitions.definition: An organizer that papers are kept in, usually with an index tab, to be stored as a single unit in a filing cabinet.
definitions.example: I keep all my schoolwork in a yellow folder.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常带有索引标签的纸张收纳工具，作为独立单元存放在文件柜中。
definitions.exampleCn: 我把所有学校作业都放在一个黄色文件夹里。

definitions.definition: A virtual container in a computer's file system, in which files and other folders may be stored. The files and subfolders in a folder are usually related.
definitions.example: My essays are in the folder named "Essays".
definitions.definitionCn: 计算机文件系统中的虚拟容器，可存储文件和其他文件夹。文件夹中的文件和子文件夹通常相互关联。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的论文存放在名为"论文"的文件夹中。

definitions.definition: A machine or person that folds things.
definitions.definitionCn: 折叠物品的机器或人。

definitions.definition: A folding knife.
definitions.definitionCn: 折叠刀。

definitions.definition: To change a text, or a document.
definitions.definitionCn: 修改文本或文档。

definitions.definition: To be the editor of a publication.
definitions.example: He edits the Chronicle.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任出版物的编辑。
definitions.exampleCn: 他编辑《纪事报》。

definitions.definition: To change the contents of a file, website, etc.
definitions.example: Wikipedia is an interactive encyclopedia which allows anybody to edit and improve articles.
definitions.definitionCn: 修改文件、网站等内容。
definitions.exampleCn: 维基百科是一个互动式百科全书，允许任何人编辑和改进文章。

definitions.definition: To alter the DNA sequence of a chromosome; to perform gene splicing.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变染色体的DNA序列；进行基因剪接。

definitions.definition: To alter a film by cutting and splicing frames.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过剪切和拼接帧来修改影片。

definitions.definition: To cut short or otherwise alter an improvised scene.
definitions.definitionCn: 缩短或以其他方式修改即兴场景。

definitions.definition: To lend itself to editing in a certain way.
definitions.definitionCn: 以某种方式适合编辑。

definitions.definition: An act or instance of something being edited.
definitions.definitionCn: 被编辑的行为或实例。

definitions.definition: Someone who routes or directs items from one location to another.
definitions.example: The router directed the movement of the company's trucks.
definitions.definitionCn: 将物品从一个地点路由或引导至另一地点的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 调度员指挥了公司卡车的运行路线。

definitions.definition: Any device that directs packets of information using the equivalent of Open Systems Interconnection layer 3 (network layer) information. Most commonly used in reference to Internet Protocol routers.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何使用相当于开放系统互连第三层（网络层）信息来引导信息包的设备。最常用于指代互联网协议路由器。

definitions.definition: A device that connects local area networks to form a larger internet by, at minimum, selectively passing those datagrams having a destination IP address to the network which is able to deliver them to their destination; a network gateway.

definitions.definition: (electronic design automation) In integrated circuit or printed circuit board design, an algorithm for adding all wires needed to properly connect all of the placed components while obeying all design rules.

definitions.definition: A power tool used in carpentry for cutting grooves.

definitions.definition: A plane made like a spokeshave, for working the inside edges of circular sashes.

definitions.definition: To grasp or grip.

definitions.definitionCn: 易于接近或到达。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个易于到达的城镇或山脉。

definitions.definition: (specifically) Built or designed as to be usable by people with disabilities.
definitions.example: accessible public transport
definitions.definitionCn: （特指）为残疾人设计或建造的。
definitions.exampleCn: 无障碍公共交通。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Easy to get along with.
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）容易相处的。

definitions.definition: (followed by to) Open to the influence of.
definitions.definitionCn: （后接to）易受影响的。

definitions.definition: Obtainable; to be got at.
definitions.definitionCn: 可获得的；能得到的。

definitions.definition: Easily understood or appreciated.
definitions.definitionCn: 易于理解或欣赏的。

definitions.definition: Capable of being used or seen.
definitions.definitionCn: 可供使用或观看的。

definitions.definition: (modifying a clause or predicate) Perhaps; indicates that the proposition may be true (is not certainly false) regardless of any facts or circumstances known to, stated by or implied by the speaker.
definitions.example: It was possibly the costliest mistake in the organization's history.
definitions.definitionCn: (修饰从句或谓语) 也许；表示该命题可能为真（并非绝对为假），无论说话者已知、陈述或暗示的任何事实或情况如何。
definitions.exampleCn: 这可能是该组织历史上代价最惨重的错误。

definitions.definition: (modifying a verb) In the realm of possibility; indicates that the action may successfully be performed (is not impossible) regardless of any facts or circumstances known to, stated by or implied by the speaker that might limit the performance.
definitions.example: I couldn't possibly be there on time.
definitions.definitionCn: (修饰动词) 在可能的范围内；表示该动作可能成功完成（并非不可能），无论说话者已知、陈述或暗示的任何可能限制该动作的事实或情况如何。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不可能准时到达那里。

definitions.definition: A small cut in a surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 表面上的小切口。

definitions.definition: Senses connoting something small.
definitions.definitionCn: 暗示微小事物的感官。

definitions.definition: Often in the expressions in bad nick and in good nick: condition, state.
definitions.example: The car I bought was cheap and in good nick.
definitions.definitionCn: 常用于"in bad nick"和"in good nick"短语中：状况、状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 我买的这辆车很便宜，而且状况良好。

definitions.definition: (law enforcement) A police station or prison.
definitions.example: He was arrested and taken down to Sun Hill nick [police station] to be charged.
definitions.definitionCn: （执法）警察局或监狱。
definitions.exampleCn: 他被捕并被带到桑希尔警察局接受指控。

definitions.definition: To make a nick or notch in; to cut or scratch in a minor way.
definitions.example: I nicked myself while I was shaving.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……上刻痕或开槽；轻微切割或划伤。
definitions.exampleCn: 我刮胡子时划伤了自己。

definitions.definition: To fit into or suit, as by a correspondence of nicks; to tally with.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过刻痕的对应而契合或适应；与……相符。

definitions.definition: To make a cut at the side of the face.
definitions.definitionCn: 在脸侧切一刀。

definitions.definition: To steal.
definitions.example: Someone’s nicked my bike!
definitions.definitionCn: 偷窃。
definitions.exampleCn: 有人偷了我的自行车！

definitions.definition: (law enforcement) To arrest.
definitions.example: The police nicked him climbing over the fence of the house he’d broken into.
definitions.definitionCn: （执法）逮捕。
definitions.exampleCn: 警察在他翻越闯入房屋的围栏时逮捕了他。

definitions.definition: To give or call (someone) by a nickname; to style.
A familiar, invented given name for a person or thing used instead of the actual name of the person or thing.
A kind of byname that describes a person by a characteristic of that person.
A nix or nixie.
That which represents something else.
definitions.example: The Venus of Willendorf was an early representation of the female body.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表某物的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 威伦多夫的维纳斯是女性身体的早期表现形式。

definitions.definition: The act of representing.
definitions.example: We are no longer happy with your representation of our company at trade events.
definitions.definitionCn: 代表的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们对你在贸易活动中代表我公司的表现不再满意。

definitions.definition: The lawyers and staff who argue on behalf of another in court.
definitions.example: People who cannot afford representation are eligible for government assistance.
definitions.definitionCn: 在法庭上为他人辩护的律师和工作人员。
definitions.exampleCn: 无力支付代理费用的人有资格获得政府援助。

definitions.definition: The ability to elect a representative to speak on one's behalf in government; the role of this representative in government.
definitions.example: The lack of representation in the British parliament was one of the main factors behind the American Revolution.
definitions.definitionCn: 选举代表在政府中为自己发言的能力；该代表在政府中的角色。
definitions.exampleCn: 英国议会中缺乏代表权是美国革命背后的主要因素之一。

definitions.definition: An object that describes an abstract group in terms of linear transformations of vector spaces; (more formally) a homomorphism from a group on a vector space to the general linear group (group of all bijective linear transformations) on the space.
definitions.definitionCn: 用向量空间的线性变换描述抽象群的对象；（更正式地说）从群到向量空间上的一般线性群（该空间上所有双射线性变换的群）的同态。

definitions.definition: A figure, image or idea that substitutes reality.
definitions.definitionCn: 替代现实的图形、图像或观念。

definitions.definition: A theatrical performance.
definitions.definitionCn: 一场戏剧表演。

data.chinese: n.代表身份 ,代表权,代表制度,代理?

definitions.definition: (stative) to be; have existence; have being or reality
definitions.definitionCn: （静态）存在；有存在；具有存在或现实

definitions.definition: A period during which one is seated for a specific purpose.
definitions.example: Due to the sheer volume of guests, we had to have two sittings for the meal.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定目的而坐的一段时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 由于宾客众多，我们不得不分两批用餐。

definitions.definition: A special seat allotted to a seat-holder, at church, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 在教堂等场所分配给座位持有者的专座。

definitions.definition: The part of the year in which judicial business is transacted.
definitions.definitionCn: 一年中处理司法事务的时期。

definitions.definition: A legislative session (in the sense of "meeting", not "period").
definitions.definitionCn: 立法会议（指“会议”而非“会期”）。

definitions.definition: The incubation of eggs by a bird.
definitions.definitionCn: 鸟类孵蛋的过程。

definitions.definition: A clutch of eggs laid by a brooding bird.
definitions.example: we have thirty-four chicks from eight sittings of eggs
definitions.definitionCn: 一窝由孵蛋鸟产下的蛋。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们从八批蛋中孵出了三十四只小鸡。

definitions.definition: Uninterrupted application to anything for a time; the period during which one continues at anything.
definitions.definitionCn: 在一段时间内不间断地专注于某事；持续做某事的期间。

definitions.definition: (of a person) To be in a position in which the upper body is upright and supported by the buttocks.
definitions.example: After a long day of walking, it was good just to sit and relax.

definitions.definition: (of a person) To move oneself into such a position.
definitions.example: I asked him to sit.

definitions.definition: (of an object) To occupy a given position permanently.
definitions.example: The temple has sat atop that hill for centuries.

definitions.definition: To remain in a state of repose; to rest; to abide; to rest in any position or condition.
To be a member of a deliberative body.
definitions.example: I currently sit on a standards committee.

definitions.definition: Of a legislative or, especially, a judicial body such as a court, to be in session.
definitions.example: In what city is the circuit court sitting for this session.

definitions.definition: To lie, rest, or bear; to press or weigh.
To be adjusted; to fit.
definitions.example: Your new coat sits well.

definitions.definition: (of an agreement or arrangement) To be accepted or acceptable; to work.
definitions.example: How will this new contract sit with the workers?

definitions.definition: (causative) To cause to be seated or in a sitting posture; to furnish a seat to.
definitions.example: Sit him in front of the TV and he might watch for hours.

definitions.definition: To accommodate in seats; to seat.
definitions.example: The dining room table sits eight comfortably.

definitions.definition: To babysit.
definitions.example: I need to find someone to sit my kids on Friday evening for four hours.

definitions.definition: To take, to undergo or complete (an examination or test).
To cover and warm eggs for hatching, as a fowl; to brood; to incubate.
To take a position for the purpose of having some artistic representation of oneself made, such as a picture or a bust.
definitions.example: I'm sitting for a painter this evening.

definitions.definition: To have position, as at the point blown from; to hold a relative position; to have direction.
Executed from a sitting position.
Occupying a specific official or legal position; incumbent.
The act of arranging.
definitions.definitionCn: 安排的行为。

definitions.definition: The manner of being arranged.
definitions.definitionCn: 被安排的方式。

definitions.definition: A collection of things that have been arranged.
definitions.definitionCn: 已安排好的事物集合。

definitions.definition: A particular way in which items are organized.
definitions.definitionCn: 物品组织的特定方式。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Preparations for some undertaking.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）为某项任务所做的准备。

definitions.definition: An agreement.
definitions.definitionCn: 协议。

definitions.definition: An adaptation of a piece of music for other instruments, or in another style.
definitions.definitionCn: 为其他乐器或另一种风格改编的音乐作品。

definitions.definition: The act of consulting together formally; serious conversation or discussion; interchange of views.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式协商的行为；严肃的对话或讨论；交换意见。

definitions.definition: A multilateral diplomatic negotiation.
definitions.definitionCn: 多边外交谈判。

definitions.definition: A formal event where scientists present their research results in speeches, workshops, posters or by other means.
definitions.definitionCn: 科学家通过演讲、研讨会、海报或其他方式展示研究成果的正式活动。

definitions.definition: An event organized by a for-profit or non-profit organization to discuss a pressing issue, such as a new product, market trend or government regulation, with a range of speakers.
definitions.definitionCn: 由营利或非营利组织组织的活动，邀请多位演讲者讨论紧迫议题，如新产品、市场趋势或政府法规。

definitions.definition: A group of sports teams that play each other on a regular basis.
definitions.definitionCn: 定期相互比赛的体育队伍团体。

definitions.definition: A constituent tournament of a sports league in a given season.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定赛季中体育联赛的组成赛事。

definitions.definition: The act of comparing two or more things together; comparison.
definitions.definitionCn: 比较两个或多个事物的行为；对比。

definitions.definition: (Methodist Church) A stated meeting of preachers and others, invested with authority to take cognizance of ecclesiastical matters.
definitions.definitionCn: （卫理公会）牧师及其他人员举行的既定会议，被授权处理教会事务。

definitions.definition: A voluntary association of Congregational churches of a district; the district in which such churches are.
definitions.definitionCn: 某地区公理会教会的自愿协会；该协会所在的地区。

definitions.definition: To assess (a student) by one-on-one conversation, rather than an examination.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过一对一对话而非考试来评估（学生）。

definitions.definition: The act of surveying; a general view.
definitions.definitionCn: 测量行为；概览。

definitions.definition: A particular view; an examination, especially an official examination, of a particular group of items, in order to ascertain the condition, quantity, or quality.
definitions.example: A survey of the stores of a ship; a survey of roads and bridges; a survey of buildings.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定审视；对特定项目组的检查（尤指官方检查），以确定状况、数量或质量。
definitions.exampleCn: 船舶物资检查；道路桥梁检查；建筑检查。

definitions.definition: The operation of finding the contour, dimensions, position, or other particulars of any part of the Earth's surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过测量确定地球表面任何部分的轮廓、尺寸、位置或其他细节的操作。

definitions.definition: A measured plan and description of any portion of country.
definitions.example: The owners of the adjoining plots had conflicting surveys.
definitions.definitionCn: 对任何区域进行测量并绘制平面图及描述。
definitions.exampleCn: 相邻地块的所有者持有相互矛盾的测量结果。

definitions.definition: An examination of the opinions of a group of people.
definitions.example: The local council conducted a survey of its residents to help it decide whether to go ahead with the roadside waste collection service.
definitions.definitionCn: 对群体意见的调查。
definitions.exampleCn: 地方议会对其居民进行了一项调查，以帮助决定是否推行路边垃圾收集服务。

definitions.definition: A questionnaire or similar instrument used for examining the opinions of a group of people.
definitions.example: I just filled out that survey on roadside waste pick-up.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于调查群体意见的问卷或类似工具。
definitions.exampleCn: 我刚填完那份关于路边垃圾收集的调查问卷。

definitions.definition: An auction at which a farm is let for three lives.
definitions.definitionCn: 以三代租期出租农场的拍卖。

definitions.definition: A district for the collection of customs under a particular officer.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定官员管辖下的海关征收区域。

definitions.definition: To inspect, or take a view of; to view with attention, as from a high place; to overlook
definitions.example: He stood on a hill, and surveyed the surrounding country.
definitions.definitionCn: 检查或观察；从高处仔细观看；俯瞰。
definitions.exampleCn: 他站在山上，俯瞰周围的乡村。

definitions.definition: To view with a scrutinizing eye; to examine.
definitions.definitionCn: 用审视的目光观察；检查。

definitions.definition: To examine with reference to condition, situation, value, etc.; to examine and ascertain the state of
definitions.example: It was his job to survey buildings in order to determine their value and risks.
definitions.definitionCn: 针对状况、情况、价值等进行检验；检查并确定状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的工作是检查建筑以确定其价值和风险。

definitions.definition: To determine the form, extent, position, etc., of, as a tract of land, a coast, harbor, or the like, by means of linear and angular measurements, and the application of the principles of geometry and trigonometry
definitions.example: to survey land or a coast
definitions.definitionCn: 通过线性与角度测量，并运用几何与三角学原理，确定土地、海岸、港口等地块的形状、范围、位置等。
definitions.exampleCn: 测量土地或海岸。

definitions.definition: To examine and ascertain, as the boundaries and royalties of a manor, the tenure of the tenants, and the rent and value of the same.
definitions.definitionCn: 检查并确定庄园的边界与权益、佃户的租期以及相应的租金与价值。

definitions.definition: To investigate the opinions, experiences, etc., of people by asking them questions; to conduct a survey; to administer a questionnaire.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过提问调查人们的意见、经历等；进行问卷调查；发放问卷。

definitions.definition: The power or ability to generate an outcome
definitions.definitionCn: 产生结果的力量或能力

definitions.definition: In a successful manner; with success; without failing.
definitions.example: He successfully climbed the mountain.
definitions.definitionCn: 以成功的方式；成功地；没有失败。
definitions.exampleCn: 他成功地爬上了那座山。

definitions.definition: In conformance to, or in agreement with.
definitions.definitionCn: 符合，或与……一致。

definitions.definition: Accordingly; consequently.
definitions.definitionCn: 因此；所以。

definitions.definition: A single act of visiting.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次拜访的行为。

definitions.definition: A meeting with a doctor at their surgery or the doctor's at one's home.
definitions.definitionCn: 在诊所或医生家中与医生会面。

definitions.definition: To habitually go to (someone in distress, sickness etc.) to comfort them. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)
definitions.definitionCn: 习惯性地去探望（处于困境、病痛等中的人）以安慰他们。（现通常并入以下后续义项。）

definitions.definition: To go and meet (a person) as an act of friendliness or sociability.
definitions.definitionCn: 以友好或社交的方式去会见（某人）。

definitions.definition: Of God: to appear to (someone) to comfort, bless, or chastise or punish them. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)
definitions.definitionCn: 指上帝：显现于（某人）以安慰、赐福或惩戒他们。（现通常并入以下后续义项。）

definitions.definition: To punish, to inflict harm upon (someone or something).
definitions.definitionCn: 惩罚，对（某人或某物）施加伤害。

definitions.definition: Of a sickness, misfortune etc.: to afflict (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 指疾病、不幸等：折磨（某人）。

definitions.definition: To inflict punishment, vengeance for (an offense) on or upon someone.
definitions.definitionCn: 因（某过错）对某人施加惩罚或报复。

definitions.definition: To go to (a shrine, temple etc.) for worship. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)
definitions.definitionCn: 前往（圣地、寺庙等）进行礼拜。（现通常并入以下后续义项。）

definitions.definition: To go to (a place) for pleasure, on an errand, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 为了娱乐、办事等目的前往（某地）。

definitions.definition: To hit a fly ball; to hit a fly ball that is caught for an out. Compare ground (verb) and line (verb).
definitions.example: Jones flied to right in his last at-bat.
definitions.definitionCn: 击出高飞球；击出被接杀的高飞球。比较ground（动词）和line（动词）。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯最后一次击球时击出右外野高飞球。

definitions.definition: To travel through the air, another gas or a vacuum, without being in contact with a grounded surface.
definitions.example: Birds of passage fly to warmer regions as it gets colder in winter.
definitions.definitionCn: 在空中、其他气体或真空中移动，不与地面接触。
definitions.exampleCn: 候鸟在冬季寒冷时飞往更温暖的地区。

definitions.definition: To flee, to escape (from).
definitions.example: Fly, my lord! The enemy are upon us!
definitions.definitionCn: 逃跑，逃离。
definitions.exampleCn: 快逃，大人！敌人逼近我们了！

definitions.definition: To cause to fly (travel or float in the air): to transport via air or the like.
definitions.example: Birds fly their prey to their nest to feed it to their young.
definitions.definitionCn: 使飞行（在空中移动或漂浮）：通过空中等方式运输。
definitions.exampleCn: 鸟类将猎物叼回巢穴喂养幼鸟。

definitions.definition: (of a proposal, project or idea) To be accepted, come about or work out.
definitions.example: Let's see if that idea flies.
definitions.definitionCn: （指提议、项目或想法）被接受、实现或成功。
definitions.exampleCn: 看看那个想法是否行得通。

definitions.definition: To travel very fast, hasten.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动，疾行。

definitions.definition: To move suddenly, or with violence; to do an act suddenly or swiftly.
definitions.example: a door flies open;  a bomb flies apart
definitions.definitionCn: 突然或猛烈地移动；突然或迅速地做某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 门猛地打开；炸弹炸裂。

definitions.definition: To display (a flag) on a flagpole.
definitions.definitionCn: 在旗杆上展示（旗帜）。

definitions.definition: To hunt with a hawk.
definitions.definitionCn: 用鹰狩猎。

definitions.definition: That flies or can fly.
definitions.example: a flying rumour
definitions.definitionCn: 会飞的或能飞的。
definitions.exampleCn: 飞传的谣言。

definitions.definition: Brief or hurried.
definitions.definitionCn: 短暂的或匆忙的。

definitions.definition: (of a sail) Not secured by yards.
definitions.definitionCn: （指船帆）未被帆桁固定的。

definitions.definition: An act of flight.
The action or process of sustained motion through the air.
A geographic area owned or controlled by a single person or organization.
definitions.example: The king ruled his domain harshly.
definitions.definitionCn: 由单一个人或组织拥有或控制的地理区域。
definitions.exampleCn: 国王严苛地统治着他的领地。

definitions.definition: A field or sphere of activity, influence or expertise.
definitions.example: Dealing with complaints isn't really my domain: get in touch with customer services.
definitions.definitionCn: 活动、影响或专业知识的领域或范围。
definitions.exampleCn: 处理投诉并非我的专长：请联系客服部门。

definitions.definition: A group of related items, topics, or subjects.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组相关的项目、主题或科目。

definitions.definition: The set of all possible mathematical entities (points) where a given function is defined.
definitions.definitionCn: 给定函数定义的所有可能数学实体（点）的集合。

definitions.definition: The set of input (argument) values for which a function is defined.
definitions.definitionCn: 函数定义的输入（自变量）值的集合。

definitions.definition: A ring with no zero divisors; that is, in which no product of nonzero elements is zero.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有零因子的环；即其中非零元素的乘积不为零。

definitions.definition: An open and connected set in some topology. For example, the interval (0,1) as a subset of the real numbers.
definitions.definitionCn: 某种拓扑中的开连通集。例如，作为实数子集的区间(0,1)。

definitions.definition: Any DNS domain name, particularly one which has been delegated and has become representative of the delegated domain name and its subdomains.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何DNS域名，特别是已被委派并代表委派域名及其子域名的域名。

definitions.definition: A collection of DNS or DNS-like domain names consisting of a delegated domain name and all its subdomains.
definitions.definitionCn: 由委派域名及其所有子域名组成的DNS或类DNS域名集合。

definitions.definition: A collection of information having to do with a domain, the computers named in the domain, and the network on which the computers named in the domain reside.
definitions.definitionCn: 与域名、域名中命名的计算机以及这些计算机所在的网络相关的信息集合。

definitions.definition: The collection of computers identified by a domain's domain names.
definitions.definitionCn: 由域名的域名标识的计算机集合。

definitions.definition: A small region of a magnetic material with a consistent magnetization direction.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有一致磁化方向的磁性材料的小区域。

definitions.definition: Such a region used as a data storage element in a bubble memory.
definitions.definitionCn: 在磁泡存储器中用作数据存储元件的此类区域。
