definitions.exampleCn: 本书的组织结构如下。

definitions.definition: A group of people or other legal entities with an explicit purpose and written rules.
definitions.example: In response to the crisis, the nations in the region formed an organization.   If you want to be part of this organization, you have to follow its rules.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群具有明确目标和书面规则的人或其他法律实体。
definitions.exampleCn: 为应对危机，该地区各国成立了一个组织。如果你想加入这个组织，就必须遵守其规则。

definitions.definition: A group of people consciously cooperating.
definitions.example: Over time, the spontaneous movement had become an organization.
definitions.definitionCn: 一群有意识合作的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 随着时间的推移，这场自发的运动已发展成一个组织。

definitions.definition: A major league club and all its farm teams.
definitions.example: He's been in the Dodgers' organization since 2003.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个主要联盟俱乐部及其所有附属球队。
definitions.exampleCn: 自2003年以来，他一直在道奇队体系内。

definitions.definition: A set of structured activities.
definitions.example: Our program for today’s exercise class includes swimming and jogging.
definitions.definitionCn: 一套结构化的活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们今天的健身课项目包括游泳和慢跑。

definitions.definition: A leaflet listing information about a play, game or other activity.
definitions.example: The program consisted of ads for restaurants and the credits of everyone connected with the play.
definitions.definitionCn: 一份介绍戏剧、游戏或其他活动信息的传单。
definitions.exampleCn: 节目单包括餐厅广告以及与演出相关所有人员的致谢名单。

definitions.definition: A performance of a show or other broadcast on radio or television.
definitions.example: Tonight’s program was hosted by Johnny Carson.
definitions.definitionCn: 一场在广播或电视上播出的表演或其他节目。
definitions.exampleCn: 今晚的节目由约翰尼·卡森主持。

definitions.definition: A software application, or a collection of software applications, designed to perform a specific task.
definitions.example: The program runs on both Linux and Microsoft Windows.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个软件应用程序或一组软件应用程序，旨在执行特定任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 该程序可在Linux和Microsoft Windows上运行。

definitions.definition: (especially in the phrase "get with the program") A particular mindset or method of doing things.
definitions.definitionCn: （尤用于短语“跟上节奏”）一种特定的思维方式或做事方法。

definitions.definition: To enter a program or other instructions into (a computer or other electronic device) to instruct it to do a particular task.
definitions.example: He programmed the DVR to record his favorite show.
definitions.definitionCn: 将程序或其他指令输入（计算机或其他电子设备）以指示其执行特定任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 他给数字录像机编程，录下他最喜欢的节目。

definitions.definition: To develop (software) by writing program code.
definitions.example: I programmed a small game as a demonstration.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过编写程序代码来开发（软件）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我编写了一个小游戏作为演示。

definitions.definition: To put together the schedule of an event.
definitions.example: Mary will program Tuesday’s festivities.
definitions.definitionCn: 安排活动的日程。
definitions.exampleCn: 玛丽将策划周二的庆祝活动。

definitions.definition: To cause to automatically behave in a particular way.
definitions.example: The lab rat was programmed to press the lever when the bell rang.
definitions.definitionCn: 使自动以特定方式行事。
definitions.exampleCn: 实验室老鼠被设定为在铃响时按压杠杆。

definitions.definition: A sports competition, especially for track and field (a track meet) or swimming (a swim meet).
definitions.definitionCn: 体育比赛，尤指田径（田径赛）或游泳（游泳赛）。

definitions.definition: A gathering of riders, horses and hounds for foxhunting; a field meet for hunting.
definitions.definitionCn: 猎狐活动中骑手、马匹和猎犬的集合；狩猎的野外集会。

definitions.definition: A meeting of two trains in opposite directions on a single track, when one is put into a siding to let the other cross.
definitions.definitionCn: 单轨上两列相反方向行驶的火车相遇，其中一列进入侧线让另一列通过。

definitions.definition: A meeting.
definitions.example: OK, let's arrange a meet with Tyler and ask him.
definitions.definitionCn: 会议。
definitions.exampleCn: 好的，我们安排和泰勒见个面问问他。

definitions.definition: The greatest lower bound, an operation between pairs of elements in a lattice, denoted by the symbol ∧.
definitions.definitionCn: 最大下界，格中元素对之间的运算，用符号∧表示。

definitions.definition: An act of French kissing someone.
definitions.definitionCn: 与某人法式接吻的行为。

definitions.definition: To make contact (with) while in proximity.
definitions.definitionCn: 在接近时与（某人）接触。

definitions.definition: (Of groups) To come together.
definitions.definitionCn: （指群体）聚集。

definitions.definition: To make physical or perceptual contact.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行物理或感知上的接触。

definitions.definition: To satisfy; to comply with.
definitions.example: This proposal meets my requirements. The company agrees to meet the cost of any repairs.
definitions.definitionCn: 满足；遵从。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个提案满足我的要求。公司同意承担所有维修费用。

definitions.definition: To balance or come out correct.
definitions.definitionCn: 平衡或结果正确。

definitions.definition: To perceive; to come to a knowledge of; to have personal acquaintance with; to experience; to suffer.
definitions.example: The eye met a horrid sight. He met his fate.
definitions.definitionCn: 感知；得知；亲身了解；经历；遭受。
definitions.exampleCn: 眼前出现可怕的景象。他遭遇了命运。

definitions.definition: To be mixed with, to be combined with aspects of.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……混合，与……的方面结合。

definitions.definition: Forming a combination or nexus of.
definitions.example: The concept of the movie was Fantastic Voyage meets The Devil Wears Prada.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成组合或关联。
definitions.exampleCn: 这部电影的概念是《神奇旅程》遇上《穿普拉达的女王》。

definitions.definition: Characterized by the creation of new ideas or inventions.
definitions.definitionCn: 以创造新思想或发明为特征。

definitions.definition: Forward-looking; ahead of current thinking.
definitions.definitionCn: 前瞻性的；超越当前思维的。

definitions.definition: An understanding between entities to follow a specific course of conduct.
definitions.example: to enter an agreement;  the UK and US negotiators nearing agreement;  he nodded his agreement.
definitions.definitionCn: 实体之间遵循特定行为准则的共识。
definitions.exampleCn: 达成协议；英美谈判代表接近达成协议；他点头表示同意。

definitions.definition: A state whereby several parties share a view or opinion; the state of not contradicting one another.
definitions.example: The results of my experiment are in agreement with those of Michelson and with the law of General Relativity.
definitions.definitionCn: 多方持有相同观点或意见的状态；彼此不矛盾的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的实验结果与迈克尔逊的结果以及广义相对论定律一致。

definitions.definition: A legally binding contract enforceable in a court of law.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有法律约束力、可在法庭上强制执行的合同。

definitions.definition: (grammar) Rules that exist in many languages that force some parts of a sentence to be used or inflected differently depending on certain attributes of other parts.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）许多语言中存在的规则，要求句子某些部分根据其他部分的特定属性使用或变位。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the plural) An agreeable quality.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于复数）令人愉快的品质。

definitions.definition: (physical) To remove a gap.
definitions.definitionCn: (物理) 消除间隙。

definitions.definition: (social) To finish, to terminate.
definitions.definitionCn: (社交) 结束，终止。

definitions.definition: To come or gather around; to enclose; to encompass; to confine.
definitions.definitionCn: 聚集或围绕；包围；环绕；限制。

definitions.definition: To have a vector sum of 0; that is, to form a closed polygon.
definitions.definitionCn: 向量和为零；即形成闭合多边形。

definitions.definition: The act by which something is closed.
definitions.example: openings and closings of doors
definitions.definitionCn: 使某物闭合的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 门的开与关。

definitions.definition: The end or conclusion of something.
definitions.example: the closing of a popular play
definitions.definitionCn: 某事的结束或结论。
definitions.exampleCn: 一部热门戏剧的落幕。

definitions.definition: The final procedure in a house sale, when documents are signed and recorded.
definitions.definitionCn: 房屋销售中的最后程序，即签署并记录文件时。

definitions.definition: In morphology, the erosion of the dilation of a set.
definitions.definitionCn: 在形态学中，指对集合进行膨胀后的腐蚀。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to the finish or ending of a series of events; occurring at the end or after all others.
definitions.example: I'd like to add some closing words.
definitions.definitionCn: 与一系列事件的结束或终结相关的；发生在最后或所有其他之后。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想补充一些结束语。

definitions.definition: The action of rubbing, kneading or hitting someone's body, to help the person relax, prepare for muscular action (as in contact sports) or to relieve aches.
definitions.example: Having a massage can have many beneficial effects.
definitions.definitionCn: 按摩是指通过摩擦、揉捏或敲击他人身体，帮助其放松、为肌肉活动（如接触性运动）做准备或缓解疼痛的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 进行按摩可带来诸多益处。

definitions.definition: To rub and knead (someone's body or a part of a body), to perform a massage on (somebody).
definitions.definitionCn: 对（某人的身体或身体部位）进行摩擦和揉捏，为（某人）实施按摩。

definitions.definition: To manipulate (data, a document etc.) to make it more presentable or more convenient to work with.
definitions.definitionCn: 对（数据、文件等）进行处理，使其更易呈现或更便于操作。

definitions.definition: To falsify (data or accounts).
definitions.definitionCn: 篡改（数据或账目）。

definitions.definition: Pliable material derived from the sap of the rubber tree; a hydrocarbon polymer of isoprene.
definitions.definitionCn: 从橡胶树汁液中提取的柔韧材料；异戊二烯的碳氢聚合物。

definitions.definition: Synthetic materials with the same properties as natural rubber.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有与天然橡胶相同特性的合成材料。

definitions.definition: An eraser.
definitions.definitionCn: 橡皮擦。

definitions.definition: A condom.
definitions.definitionCn: 避孕套。

definitions.definition: Someone or something which rubs.
definitions.definitionCn: 摩擦的人或物。

definitions.definition: The cushion of an electric machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 电机的缓冲垫。

definitions.definition: The rectangular pad on the pitcher's mound from which the pitcher must pitch.
definitions.example: Jones toes the rubber and then fires to the plate.
definitions.definitionCn: 投手丘上投手必须踩踏的矩形垫板。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯踩上投手板后向本垒投球。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Water-resistant shoe covers, galoshes, overshoes.
definitions.example: Johnny, don't forget your rubbers today.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）防水鞋套、橡胶套鞋、套鞋。
definitions.exampleCn: 约翰尼，今天别忘了带你的橡胶套鞋。

definitions.definition: Tires, particularly racing tires.
definitions.example: Jones enters the pits to get new rubber.
definitions.definitionCn: 轮胎，尤其是赛车轮胎。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯进站更换新轮胎。

definitions.definition: A hardship or misfortune.
definitions.definitionCn: 困难或不幸。

definitions.definition: (of a draft/check) Not covered by funds on account.
definitions.definitionCn: （指支票）因账户资金不足而无法兑付的。

definitions.definition: In relation to a series of games or matches between two competitors where the overall winner of the series is the competitor which wins a majority of the individual games or matches:
A rubber match; a game or match played to break a tie.
The game of rubber bridge.
To eavesdrop on a telephone call
To rubberneck; to observe with unseemly curiosity.
To ascertain the quantity of a unit of material via calculated comparison with respect to a standard.
definitions.example: We measured the temperature with a thermometer.   You should measure the angle with a spirit level.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过计算与标准进行比较来确定某种材料的数量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们用温度计测量了温度。你应该用水平仪测量角度。

definitions.definition: To be of (a certain size), to have (a certain measurement)
definitions.example: The window measured two square feet.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有（某种尺寸），拥有（某种度量）。
definitions.exampleCn: 这扇窗户的尺寸是两平方英尺。

definitions.definition: To estimate the unit size of something.
definitions.example: I measure that at 10 centimetres.
definitions.definitionCn: 估算某物的单位大小。
definitions.exampleCn: 我估计那是10厘米。

definitions.definition: To judge, value, or appraise.
definitions.definitionCn: 判断、评价或评估。

definitions.definition: To obtain or set apart; to mark in even increments.
definitions.definitionCn: 获取或划分；以均匀的增量标记。

definitions.definition: To traverse, cross, pass along; to travel over.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿越、横跨、经过；旅行经过。

definitions.definition: To adjust by a rule or standard.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据规则或标准进行调整。

definitions.definition: To allot or distribute by measure; to set off or apart by measure; often with out or off.
definitions.definitionCn: 按度量分配或分发；按度量划分或分开；常与out或off连用。

definitions.definition: That has been determined by measurement.
definitions.example: He ran over a measured mile.
definitions.definitionCn: 已经通过测量确定的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他跑过了一英里的测量距离。

definitions.definition: Deliberate but restrained.
definitions.example: He argued in measured tones.
definitions.definitionCn: 深思熟虑但有所克制。
definitions.exampleCn: 他以克制的语气争论。

definitions.definition: (of poetry etc.) Rhythmically written in meter; metrical.
definitions.definitionCn: （指诗歌等）按韵律写成；有格律的。

definitions.definition: To think about seriously.
definitions.example: Consider that we’ve had three major events and the year has hardly begun.
definitions.definitionCn: 认真思考。
definitions.exampleCn: 想想看，今年才刚开始，我们已经经历了三件大事。

definitions.definition: To think about something seriously or carefully: to deliberate.
definitions.definitionCn: 仔细或慎重地思考某事：深思熟虑。

definitions.definition: To think of doing.
definitions.example: I’m considering going to the beach tomorrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 考虑做某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在考虑明天去海滩。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To assign some quality to.
definitions.example: Consider yourself lucky, but consider your opponent skillful.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）赋予某种特质。
definitions.exampleCn: 算你幸运，但也要承认对手的技艺高超。

definitions.definition: To look at attentively.
definitions.example: She sat there for a moment, considering him.
definitions.definitionCn: 专注地观察。
definitions.exampleCn: 她坐在那里片刻，端详着他。

definitions.definition: To take up as an example.
definitions.example: Consider a triangle having three equal sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 以……为例。
definitions.exampleCn: 考虑一个等边三角形。

definitions.definition: (parliamentary procedure) To debate (or dispose of) a motion.
definitions.example: This body will now consider the proposed amendments to Section 453 of the zoning code.
definitions.definitionCn: （议会程序）辩论（或处理）一项动议。
definitions.exampleCn: 本机构现在将审议对分区法规第453条提出的修正案。

definitions.definition: To have regard to; to take into view or account; to pay due attention to; to respect.
definitions.example: He never seems to consider the feelings of others.
definitions.definitionCn: 顾及；考虑到；予以重视；尊重。
definitions.exampleCn: 他似乎从不考虑他人的感受。

definitions.definition: Consideration.
definitions.definitionCn: 考虑。

definitions.definition: Given the circumstances.
definitions.example: Your wound doesn't look that bad, considering.
definitions.definitionCn: 考虑到实际情况。
definitions.exampleCn: 考虑到情况，你的伤口看起来没那么严重。

definitions.definition: Taking into account.
definitions.example: Considering the extent of his crimes, he was given a surprisingly short sentence.
definitions.definitionCn: 鉴于。
definitions.exampleCn: 鉴于他所犯罪行的严重程度，他得到的刑期短得惊人。

definitions.definition: To provide an impetus for motion or other physical change, to move an object by means of the provision of force thereto.
definitions.example: You drive nails into wood with a hammer.
definitions.definitionCn: 为运动或其他物理变化提供动力，通过施加力来移动物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 你用锤子把钉子钉进木头。

definitions.definition: To provide an impetus for a non-physical change, especially a change in one's state of mind.
definitions.example: My wife's constant harping about the condition of the house threatens to drive me to distraction.
definitions.definitionCn: 为非物理变化提供动力，尤其是心态的改变。
definitions.exampleCn: 妻子不断唠叨房子状况，几乎要把我逼疯。

definitions.definition: To displace either physically or non-physically, through the application of force.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过施加力来物理或非物理地移动。

definitions.definition: To cause intrinsic motivation through the application or demonstration of force: to impel or urge onward thusly, to compel to move on, to coerce, intimidate or threaten.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过施加或展示力量引发内在动机：以此推动或催促前进，强迫移动，胁迫、恐吓或威胁。

definitions.definition: (especially of animals) To impel or urge onward by force; to push forward; to compel to move on.
definitions.example: to drive twenty thousand head of cattle from Texas to the Kansas railheads; to drive sheep out of a field
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指动物）用力量驱赶或催促前进；向前推；强迫移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 将两万头牛从得克萨斯州赶到堪萨斯州的铁路终点站；把羊赶出田地。

definitions.definition: To direct a vehicle powered by a horse, ox or similar animal.
definitions.definitionCn: 驾驶由马、牛或类似动物驱动的车辆。

definitions.definition: To cause animals to flee out of.
definitions.example: The beaters drove the brambles, causing a great rush of rabbits and other creatures.
definitions.definitionCn: 使动物逃出。
definitions.exampleCn: 驱赶者拨开荆棘，惊起大量兔子和其它生物。

definitions.definition: To move (something) by hitting it with great force.
definitions.example: You drive nails into wood with a hammer.
definitions.definitionCn: 用大力击打移动（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 你用锤子把钉子钉进木头。

definitions.definition: To cause (a mechanism) to operate.
definitions.example: The pistons drive the crankshaft.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（机械）运转。
definitions.exampleCn: 活塞驱动曲轴。

definitions.definition: To operate (a wheeled motorized vehicle).
definitions.example: drive a car
definitions.definitionCn: 操作（轮式机动车辆）。
definitions.exampleCn: 开车。

definitions.definition: To motivate; to provide an incentive for.
definitions.example: What drives a person to run a marathon?
definitions.definitionCn: 激励；提供动力。
definitions.exampleCn: 是什么驱使一个人跑马拉松？

definitions.definition: To compel (to do something).
definitions.example: Their debts finally drove them to sell the business.
definitions.definitionCn: 强迫（做某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 债务最终迫使他们卖掉生意。

definitions.definition: To cause to become.
definitions.example: This constant complaining is going to drive me to insanity.   You are driving me crazy!
definitions.definitionCn: 导致变成某种状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 这无休止的抱怨快把我逼疯了。你让我抓狂！

definitions.definition: To hit the ball with a drive.
definitions.definitionCn: 用大力击球。

definitions.definition: To travel by operating a wheeled motorized vehicle.
definitions.example: I drive to work every day.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过驾驶轮式机动车辆出行。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每天开车上班。

definitions.definition: To convey (a person, etc) in a wheeled motorized vehicle.
definitions.example: My wife drove me to the airport.
definitions.definitionCn: 用轮式机动车辆运送（人等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我妻子开车送我去机场。

definitions.definition: To move forcefully.
definitions.definitionCn: 猛烈移动。

definitions.definition: To be moved or propelled forcefully (especially of a ship).
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指船）被强力推动或推进。

definitions.definition: To urge, press, or bring to a point or state.
definitions.definitionCn: 催促、施压或使达到某点或状态。

definitions.definition: To carry or to keep in motion; to conduct; to prosecute.
definitions.definitionCn: 保持或持续运动；进行；执行。

definitions.definition: To clear, by forcing away what is contained.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过驱赶内容物来清理。

definitions.definition: To dig horizontally; to cut a horizontal gallery or tunnel.
definitions.definitionCn: 水平挖掘；开凿水平通道或隧道。

definitions.definition: To put together a drive (n.): to string together offensive plays and advance the ball down the field.
definitions.definitionCn: 组织一次进攻（名词）：串联进攻战术并带球推进。

definitions.definition: To distrain for rent.
definitions.definitionCn: 为租金扣押财物。

definitions.definition: To separate the lighter (feathers or down) from the heavier, by exposing them to a current of air.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过气流将较轻的（羽毛或绒毛）与较重的分离。

definitions.definition: To be the dominant party in a sex act.
definitions.definitionCn: 在性行为中成为主导方。

definitions.definition: Obsessed; passionately motivated to achieve goals.
definitions.definitionCn: 痴迷；充满激情地追求目标。

definitions.definition: (of snow) Formed into snowdrifts by wind.
definitions.definitionCn: （指雪）被风吹成雪堆。

definitions.definition: A type of large constricting snake.

definitions.definition: A thing that holds.
definitions.example: Put your umbrella in the umbrella holder.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个用来容纳物品的东西。
definitions.exampleCn: 把你的伞放进伞架里。

definitions.definition: A person who temporarily or permanently possesses something.
definitions.example: He's been an account holder with us since 2004.
definitions.definitionCn: 暂时或永久拥有某物的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 自2004年以来，他一直是我们这里的账户持有人。

definitions.definition: One who is employed in the hold of a vessel.
definitions.definitionCn: 在船舱里工作的人。

definitions.definition: The defending champion.
definitions.definitionCn: 卫冕冠军。

definitions.definition: Something which is proposed, or offered for consideration or acceptance
definitions.definitionCn: 提议或提供以供考虑或接受的事物

definitions.definition: A self-paced learning exercise; a lesson prepared so that a student can learn at their own speed, at their convenience.
definitions.definitionCn: 自主学习练习；一种让学生按自身节奏、在方便时学习的课程。

definitions.definition: An interactive class taught by a tutor to students at university or college, individually or in small groups.
definitions.definitionCn: 由导师在大学或学院对学生进行的一对一或小组互动教学。

definitions.definition: That which one is morally or legally obligated to do.
definitions.example: We don't have a duty to keep you here.
definitions.definitionCn: 道德或法律上应尽的责任。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们没有义务把你留在这里。

definitions.definition: The state of being at work and responsible for or doing a particular task.
definitions.example: I’m on duty from 6 pm to 6 am.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于工作状态并负责或执行特定任务的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 我从下午6点到早上6点值班。

definitions.definition: A tax placed on imports or exports; a tariff.
definitions.definitionCn: 对进口或出口商品征收的税；关税。

definitions.definition: One's due, something one is owed; a debt or fee.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人应得之物，所欠之物；债务或费用。

definitions.definition: Respect; reverence; regard; act of respect; homage.
definitions.definitionCn: 尊敬；敬畏；关注；表示敬意的行为；敬意。

definitions.definition: The efficiency of an engine, especially a steam pumping engine, as measured by work done by a certain quantity of fuel; usually, the number of pounds of water lifted one foot by one bushel of coal (94 lbs. old standard), or by 1 cwt. (112 lbs., England, or 100 lbs., United States).
definitions.definitionCn: 发动机的效率，尤指蒸汽泵发动机，以一定量燃料完成的工作量来衡量；通常指一蒲式耳煤（旧标准94磅）或1英担（英国112磅，美国100磅）能将一磅水提升一英尺的磅数。

definitions.definition: Someone who moderates
definitions.definitionCn: 主持者

definitions.definition: The person who presides over a synod of a Presbyterian Church
definitions.definitionCn: 长老会会议的主持人

definitions.definition: A substance (often water or graphite) used to decrease the speed of fast neutrons in a nuclear reactor and hence increase likelihood of fission
definitions.definitionCn: 用于降低核反应堆中快中子速度以增加裂变可能性的物质（通常是水或石墨）

definitions.definition: A device used to deaden some of the noise from a firearm, although not to the same extent as a suppressor or silencer.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于减弱枪械噪音的装置，但效果不如抑制器或消音器

definitions.definition: An examiner at Oxford and Cambridge universities.
definitions.definitionCn: 牛津大学和剑桥大学的考官

definitions.definition: At the University of Dublin, either the first (senior) or second (junior) in rank in an examination for the degree of Bachelor of Arts.
definitions.definitionCn: 在都柏林大学，文学士学位考试中排名第一（高级）或第二（初级）的人

definitions.definition: Someone who supervises and monitors the setting and marking of examinations by different people to ensure consistency of standards.
definitions.definitionCn: 监督并监控不同人员出题和阅卷过程以确保标准一致的人

definitions.definition: A mechanical arrangement for regulating motion in a machine, or producing equality of effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 机器中用于调节运动或产生均衡效果的机械装置

definitions.definition: A kind of lamp in which the flow of the oil to the wick is regulated.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种通过调节灯芯油流来控制亮度的灯具

definitions.definition: A sea or lake voyage, especially one taken for pleasure.
definitions.definitionCn: 海上或湖上的航行，尤指为娱乐而进行的航行。

definitions.definition: Portion of aircraft travel at a constant airspeed and altitude between ascent and descent phases.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞机在爬升和下降阶段之间以恒定空速和高度飞行的部分。

definitions.definition: A period spent in the Marine Corps.
definitions.definitionCn: 在海军陆战队服役的一段时间。

definitions.definition: To sail about, especially for pleasure.
definitions.definitionCn: 驾船巡游，尤指为娱乐。

definitions.definition: To travel at constant speed for maximum operating efficiency.
definitions.definitionCn: 以恒定速度行驶以达到最大运行效率。

definitions.definition: To move about an area leisurely in the hope of discovering something, or looking for custom.
definitions.definitionCn: 悠闲地在某个区域移动，希望发现某物或寻找顾客。

definitions.definition: To inspect (forest land) for the purpose of estimating the quantity of lumber it will yield.
definitions.definitionCn: 检查（林地）以估算其可产出的木材量。

definitions.definition: To actively seek a romantic partner or casual sexual partner by moving about a particular area; to troll.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过在特定区域走动来积极寻找恋爱对象或临时性伴侣；即“钓鱼”。

definitions.definition: (child development) To walk while holding on to an object (stage in development of ambulation, typically occurring at 10 months).
definitions.definitionCn: （儿童发展）扶着物体行走（行走发展阶段的典型表现，通常出现在10个月大时）。

definitions.definition: To win easily and convincingly.
definitions.example: Germany cruised to a World Cup victory over the short-handed Australians.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻松且令人信服地获胜。
definitions.exampleCn: 德国队轻松击败了人手不足的澳大利亚队，赢得了世界杯胜利。

definitions.definition: Anything that someone might want to collect.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何可能有人想要收集的东西。

definitions.definition: The study of principles relating to right and wrong conduct.
definitions.definitionCn: 研究关于正确与错误行为的原则。

definitions.definition: Morality.
definitions.definitionCn: 道德。

definitions.definition: The standards that govern the conduct of a person, especially a member of a profession.
definitions.definitionCn: 规范个人行为的标准，尤其是职业人士的行为准则。

definitions.definition: The body with the power to make and/or enforce laws to control a country, land area, people or organization.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有制定和/或执行法律以控制国家、地区、人民或组织的权力机构。

definitions.definition: (grammar) The relationship between a word and its dependents.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）词语与其从属成分之间的关系。

definitions.definition: The state and its administration viewed as the ruling political power.
definitions.example: If the citizens must follow the law, then the government must follow the constitution.
definitions.definitionCn: 被视为统治政治权力的国家及其行政机构。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果公民必须遵守法律，那么政府必须遵守宪法。

definitions.definition: The management or control of a system.
definitions.definitionCn: 对系统的管理或控制。

definitions.definition: The tenure of a chief of state.
definitions.definitionCn: 国家元首的任期。

definitions.definition: To cause an increase in temperature of (an object or space); to cause to become hot (often with "up").
definitions.example: I'll heat up the water.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（物体或空间）温度升高；使变热（常与"up"连用）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我要把水加热。

definitions.definition: To become hotter.
definitions.example: There's a pot of soup heating on the stove.
definitions.definitionCn: 变得更热。
definitions.exampleCn: 炉子上有一锅汤正在加热。

definitions.definition: To excite or make hot by action or emotion; to make feverish.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过动作或情感使兴奋或发热；使狂热。

definitions.definition: To excite ardour in; to rouse to action; to excite to excess; to inflame, as the passions.
definitions.definitionCn: 激发热情；促使行动；过度刺激；煽动激情。

definitions.definition: To arouse, to excite (sexually).
definitions.example: The massage heated her up.
definitions.definitionCn: （性方面）唤起、激发。
definitions.exampleCn: 按摩让她兴奋起来。

definitions.definition: A system that raises the temperature of a room or building. Compare heater.
definitions.definitionCn: 提高房间或建筑物温度的系统。与heater比较。

definitions.definition: The act of making something hot.
definitions.example: The crucible was subjected to several heatings.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某物变热的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 坩埚经过多次加热。

definitions.definition: Causing heat.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生热量的。

definitions.definition: A writing; a written document.
definitions.definitionCn: 书写；书面文件。

definitions.definition: Written characters; style of writing.
definitions.definitionCn: 手写字符；书写风格。

definitions.definition: Type made in imitation of handwriting.
definitions.definitionCn: 模仿手写的字体。

definitions.definition: An original instrument or document.
definitions.definitionCn: 原始文书或文件。

definitions.definition: The written document containing the dialogue and action for a drama; the text of a stage play, movie, or other performance. Especially, the final form used for the performance itself.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含戏剧对话和动作的书面文件；舞台剧、电影或其他表演的文本。尤指用于表演本身的最终形式。

definitions.definition: A file containing a list of user commands, allowing them to be invoked once to execute in sequence.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含用户命令列表的文件，允许一次性调用以顺序执行。

definitions.definition: A system of writing adapted to a particular language or set of languages.
definitions.definitionCn: 适应特定语言或语言集合的书写系统。

definitions.definition: Short for prescription.
definitions.definitionCn: 处方的简称。

definitions.definition: To make or write a script.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作或编写脚本。

definitions.definition: A legendary serpentine or reptilian creature.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种传说中的蛇形或爬行类生物。

definitions.definition: An animal of various species that resemble a dragon in appearance:
definitions.definitionCn: 多种外形类似龙的动物：

definitions.definition: (with definite article, often capitalized) The constellation Draco.
definitions.definitionCn: （常与定冠词连用，首字母大写）天龙座。

definitions.definition: A fierce and unpleasant woman; a harridan.
definitions.example: She’s a bit of a dragon.
definitions.definitionCn: 凶悍不讨人喜欢的女人；泼妇。
definitions.exampleCn: 她有点像个母夜叉。

definitions.definition: (with definite article, often capitalized) The (historical) Chinese empire or the People's Republic of China.
definitions.example: Napoleon already warned of the awakening of the Dragon.
definitions.definitionCn: （常与定冠词连用，首字母大写）（历史上的）中华帝国或中华人民共和国。
definitions.exampleCn: 拿破仑早已警告过东方巨龙的觉醒。

definitions.definition: Something very formidable or dangerous.
definitions.definitionCn: 极其可怕或危险的事物。

definitions.definition: A type of playing-tile (red dragon, green dragon, white dragon) in the game of mahjong.
definitions.definitionCn: 麻将游戏中的一种牌（红中、发财、白板）。

definitions.definition: A luminous exhalation from marshy ground, seeming to move through the air like a winged serpent.
definitions.definitionCn: 沼泽地升起的发光雾气，像带翼蛇般在空中游动。

definitions.definition: A short musket hooked to a swivel attached to a soldier's belt; so called from a representation of a dragon's head at the muzzle.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种挂在士兵腰带旋转环上的短火枪；因枪口饰有龙头图案得名。

definitions.definition: A background process similar to a daemon.
definitions.definitionCn: 类似守护进程的后台程序。

definitions.definition: A variety of carrier pigeon.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种信鸽品种。

definitions.definition: A transvestite man, or more broadly a male-to-female transgender person.
(ditransitive) To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
definitions.example: Waiter, please bring me a single malt whiskey.
definitions.definitionCn: （双及物动词）将某物运送给某人或某地。
definitions.exampleCn: 服务员，请给我来一杯单一麦芽威士忌。

definitions.definition: To supply or contribute.
definitions.example: The new company director brought a fresh perspective on sales and marketing.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供或贡献。
definitions.exampleCn: 新来的公司董事为销售和市场营销带来了全新的视角。

definitions.definition: To occasion or bring about.
definitions.example: The controversial TV broadcast brought a storm of complaints.
definitions.definitionCn: 引发或导致。
definitions.exampleCn: 那场有争议的电视广播引发了一片投诉浪潮。

definitions.definition: To raise (a lawsuit, charges, etc.) against somebody.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某人提起（诉讼、指控等）。

definitions.definition: To persuade; to induce; to draw; to lead; to guide.
definitions.definitionCn: 说服；诱导；吸引；引导；带领。

definitions.definition: To produce in exchange; to sell for; to fetch.
definitions.example: What does coal bring per ton?
definitions.definitionCn: 以交换方式产生；以……价格出售；卖得。
definitions.exampleCn: 每吨煤能卖多少钱？

definitions.definition: To pitch, often referring to a particularly hard thrown fastball.
definitions.example: The closer Jones can really bring it.
definitions.definitionCn: 投球，常指投出特别有力的快速球。
definitions.exampleCn: 终结者琼斯确实能投出强劲的球。

definitions.definition: To give birth, conceive, beget, be born; to develop (as a fetus); to nourish, sustain (as life).
definitions.definitionCn: 生育、受孕、孕育、出生；发育（如胎儿）；滋养、维持（如生命）。

definitions.definition: Knowledge, perception, or sight.
Range of sight.
To know, perceive or understand.
To discover by sight; to catch sight of; to descry.
(thieves' cant) A house, especially a den of thieves.
A Japanese unit of length equal to six shakus
An expression of affection, especially romantic affection, usually in the form of greeting card, gift, or message given the object of one's affection, especially on February 14th.
definitions.example: Such an extravagant valentine was unexpected.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种表达爱意的方式，尤指浪漫情感，通常以贺卡、礼物或留言的形式赠予心仪对象，尤其在2月14日。
definitions.exampleCn: 如此奢华的礼物出乎意料。

definitions.definition: A person to whom a valentine is given or from whom it is received, especially on February 14th.
definitions.example: Won't you be my valentine?
definitions.definitionCn: 收到或送出礼物的人，尤其在2月14日。
definitions.exampleCn: 你愿意做我的爱人吗？

definitions.definition: In a strong or powerful manner.
definitions.example: In the third race, Renowned Blaze finished strongly to win, paying sixteen dollars.
definitions.definitionCn: 以强大或有力的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 在第三场比赛中，著名烈焰以强劲的冲刺获胜，赔付十六美元。

definitions.definition: Very much.
definitions.example: His reply was strongly suggestive of a forthcoming challenge to the governor.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的回答强烈暗示即将对州长发起挑战。

definitions.definition: A convenience store, originally one that sold coffee and similar basic items.
definitions.definitionCn: 一家便利店，最初是售卖咖啡及类似基本用品的店铺。

definitions.definition: A coffee shop; an establishment selling coffee and sometimes other non-alcoholic beverages, simple meals or snacks, with a facility to consume them on the premises.
definitions.definitionCn: 咖啡馆；出售咖啡，有时也提供其他非酒精饮料、简餐或小食，并设有堂食设施的场所。

definitions.definition: A small restaurant of any genre.
definitions.example: 1982, Joni Mitchell, Chinese Café / Unchained Melody (song)
definitions.definitionCn: 任何类型的小餐馆。
definitions.exampleCn: 1982年，琼尼·米歇尔，《中国咖啡馆 / 奔放的旋律》（歌曲）

definitions.definition: Any of numerous large, complex naturally-produced molecules composed of one or more long chains of amino acids, in which the amino acid groups are held together by peptide bonds.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何由一条或多条氨基酸长链组成的大型复杂天然分子，其中氨基酸基团通过肽键连接。

definitions.definition: (nutrition) One of three major classes of food or source of food energy (4 kcal/gram) abundant in animal-derived foods (i.e. meat) and some vegetables, such as legumes.
definitions.definitionCn: （营养学）三大类食物或食物能量来源之一（每克4千卡），在动物源性食物（如肉类）及某些蔬菜（如豆类）中含量丰富。

definitions.definition: (nutrition) A food rich in protein, often a meat or meat substitute.
definitions.definitionCn: （营养学）富含蛋白质的食物，通常指肉类或肉类替代品。

definitions.definition: (money) A piece of currency, usually metallic and in the shape of a disc, but sometimes polygonal, or with a hole in the middle.
definitions.definitionCn: （钱）一种货币单位，通常为金属制成、圆盘形状，但有时呈多边形或中间有孔。

definitions.definition: A token used in a special establishment like a casino.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于赌场等特殊场所的代币。

definitions.definition: That which serves for payment or recompense.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作支付或报酬的物品。

definitions.definition: Money in general, not limited to coins.
definitions.example: She spent some serious coin on that car!
definitions.definitionCn: 泛指金钱，不限于硬币。
definitions.exampleCn: 她在那辆车上花了一大笔钱！

definitions.definition: One of the suits of minor arcana in tarot, or a card of that suit.
definitions.definitionCn: 塔罗牌中小阿卡纳的一种花色，或该花色的牌。

definitions.definition: A corner or external angle.
definitions.definitionCn: 角落或外角。

definitions.definition: A small circular slice of food.
definitions.definitionCn: 一小片圆形食物。

definitions.definition: A cryptocurrency.
definitions.example: What's the best coin to buy right now?
definitions.definitionCn: 一种加密货币。
definitions.exampleCn: 现在买哪种币最好？

definitions.definition: To make of a definite fineness, and convert into coins, as a mass of metal.
definitions.example: to coin a medal
definitions.definitionCn: 将金属块制成特定成色并铸造成硬币。
definitions.exampleCn: 铸造一枚奖章。

definitions.definition: (by extension) To make or fabricate.
definitions.example: Over the last century the advance in science has led to many new words being coined.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）创造或编造。
definitions.exampleCn: 过去一个世纪，科学进步催生了许多新词。

definitions.definition: To acquire rapidly, as money; to make.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速获取（如金钱）；赚取。

definitions.definition: To choose or make a decision (to do something)
definitions.definitionCn: 选择或决定（做某事）

definitions.definition: To choose (a candidate) in an election
definitions.definitionCn: 在选举中选择（候选人）

definitions.definition: One who is elected.
definitions.definitionCn: 被选举者。

definitions.definition: A two-man track cycling event in which partners take turns to race round the track a number of times, and then must exchange places with a partner by means of a hand sling.
definitions.definitionCn: 双人场地自行车赛，搭档轮流绕赛道骑行数圈后，需通过手拉方式与同伴交换位置。

definitions.definition: The deliberate commission of an act of violence to create public fear through the suffering of the victims in the furtherance of a political or social agenda.
definitions.definitionCn: 故意实施暴力行为，通过受害者的痛苦制造公众恐惧，以推进政治或社会议程。

definitions.definition: The use of unlawful violence against people or property to achieve political objectives.
definitions.definitionCn: 为达成政治目的，对人员或财产使用非法暴力。

definitions.definition: A form of psychological manipulation through warfare to the purpose of political or religious gains, by means of deliberately creating a climate of fear amongst the inhabitants of a specific geographical region.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过战争进行心理操纵，以获取政治或宗教利益，手段是在特定地理区域的居民中刻意营造恐惧氛围。

definitions.definition: To spend money, time, or energy on something, especially for some benefit or purpose; used with in.
definitions.example: We'd like to thank all the contributors who have invested countless hours into this event.
definitions.definitionCn: 为了某种利益或目的而花费金钱、时间或精力；与in连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们感谢所有为这次活动投入无数时间的贡献者。

definitions.definition: To clothe or wrap (with garments).
definitions.definitionCn: 给（某人）穿衣或包裹（衣物）。

definitions.definition: To put on (clothing).
definitions.definitionCn: 穿上（衣服）。

definitions.definition: To envelop, wrap, cover.
definitions.definitionCn: 包裹、缠绕、覆盖。

definitions.definition: To commit money or capital in the hope of financial gain.
definitions.definitionCn: 投入金钱或资本以期获得经济收益。

definitions.definition: To ceremonially install someone in some office.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式任命某人担任某职务。

definitions.definition: To formally give (someone) some power or authority.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式授予（某人）某种权力或权威。

definitions.definition: To formally give (power or authority).
definitions.definitionCn: 正式授予（权力或权威）。

definitions.definition: To surround, accompany, or attend.
definitions.definitionCn: 围绕、伴随或陪同。

definitions.definition: To lay siege to.
definitions.example: to invest a town
definitions.definitionCn: 包围、围攻。
definitions.exampleCn: 围攻一座城镇。

definitions.definition: To make investments.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行投资。

definitions.definition: To prepare for lost wax casting by creating an investment mold (a mixture of a silica sand and plaster).
definitions.definitionCn: 通过制作投资模具（硅砂和石膏的混合物）为失蜡铸造做准备。

definitions.definition: To be involved in; to form strong attachments to.
definitions.definitionCn: 参与其中；形成强烈依恋。

definitions.definition: The act of something being invested; an investment.
definitions.definitionCn: 被投资的行为；一项投资。

definitions.definition: To roll or fold up; to wind round; to entwine.
definitions.definitionCn: 卷起或折叠；缠绕；盘绕。

definitions.definition: To envelop completely; to surround; to cover; to hide.
definitions.example: to involve in darkness or obscurity
definitions.definitionCn: 完全包裹；环绕；覆盖；隐藏。
definitions.exampleCn: 使陷入黑暗或模糊。

definitions.definition: To complicate or make intricate, as in grammatical structure.
definitions.definitionCn: 使复杂化或错综复杂，如语法结构。

definitions.definition: To connect with something as a natural or logical consequence or effect; to include necessarily; to imply.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为自然或逻辑结果或影响与某事物关联；必然包含；暗示。

definitions.definition: To take in; to gather in; to mingle confusedly; to blend or merge.
definitions.definitionCn: 纳入；收集；混乱地混合；融合或合并。

definitions.definition: To envelop, enfold, entangle.
definitions.example: He's involved in the crime.
definitions.definitionCn: 包裹、缠绕、纠缠。
definitions.exampleCn: 他卷入了这起犯罪。

definitions.definition: To engage (someone) to participate in a task.
definitions.example: By getting involved in her local community, Mary met lots of people and also helped make it a nicer place to live.
definitions.definitionCn: 让（某人）参与一项任务。
definitions.exampleCn: 通过参与当地社区活动，玛丽结识了许多人，也帮助让社区变得更宜居。

definitions.definition: To raise to any assigned power; to multiply, as a quantity, into itself a given number of times.
definitions.example: a quantity involved to the third or fourth power
definitions.definitionCn: 将某数升至任意指定幂次；使某量自乘给定次数。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个升至三次或四次幂的量。

definitions.definition: The act or practice of admitting.
definitions.definitionCn: 接纳的行为或实践。

definitions.definition: Permission to enter, or the entrance itself; admittance; entrance; access
definitions.example: I request admission for two adults
definitions.definitionCn: 进入的许可，或进入本身；准入；入口；通道。
definitions.exampleCn: 我请求允许两位成人进入。

definitions.definition: The granting of an argument or position not fully proved; the act of acknowledging something asserted; acknowledgement; concession.
definitions.definitionCn: 对未完全证明的论点或立场的认可；承认某人所主张之事的行为；承认；让步。

definitions.definition: Acquiescence or concurrence in a statement made by another, and distinguishable from a confession in that an admission presupposes prior inquiry by another, but a confession may be made without such inquiry.
definitions.definitionCn: 对他人陈述的默许或同意，与供认的区别在于，接纳预设了他人事先的询问，而供认可能无需此类询问即可作出。

definitions.definition: A fact, point, or statement admitted; as, admission made out of court are received in evidence
definitions.definitionCn: 被承认的事实、观点或陈述；例如，庭外作出的接纳可作为证据接受。

definitions.definition: Declaration of the bishop that he approves of the presentee as a fit person to serve the cure of the church to which he is presented.
definitions.definitionCn: 主教宣布认可被推荐者作为适合的人选，担任其被推荐教区的牧师职务。

definitions.definition: The cost or fee associated with attendance or entry.
definitions.example: There is no way he has seen that show, the admission is more than he makes in a week.
definitions.definitionCn: 与出席或进入相关的费用或收费。
definitions.exampleCn: 他绝不可能看过那场演出，入场费比他一周赚的还多。

definitions.definition: To lift (something) and take it to another place; to transport (something) by lifting.
definitions.definitionCn: 举起（某物）并移至别处；通过提举运输（某物）。

definitions.definition: To transfer from one place (such as a country, book, or column) to another.
definitions.example: to carry an account to the ledger
definitions.definitionCn: 从一个地方（如国家、书籍或专栏）转移到另一个地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 将账目记入分类账。

definitions.definition: To convey by extension or continuance; to extend.
definitions.example: The builders are going to carry the chimney through the roof.  They would have carried the road ten miles further, but ran out of materials.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过延伸或持续来传达；扩展。
definitions.exampleCn: 建筑工人打算将烟囱穿过屋顶。他们本想把路再延伸十英里，但材料用完了。

definitions.definition: To move; to convey using force
definitions.definitionCn: 移动；用力搬运。

definitions.definition: To lead or guide.
definitions.definitionCn: 引导或带领。

definitions.definition: To stock or supply (something); to have in store.
definitions.example: The corner drugstore doesn't carry his favorite brand of aspirin.
definitions.definitionCn: 储存或供应（某物）；有库存。
definitions.exampleCn: 街角的药店不卖他喜欢的阿司匹林品牌。

definitions.definition: To adopt (something); take (something) over.
definitions.example: I think I can carry Smith's work while she is out.
definitions.definitionCn: 采纳（某物）；接管。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想我能接替史密斯外出时的工作。

definitions.definition: To adopt or resolve on, especially in a deliberative assembly
definitions.example: The court carries that motion.
definitions.definitionCn: 采纳或决定，尤其在审议会议上。
definitions.exampleCn: 法庭通过了那项动议。

definitions.definition: In an addition, to transfer the quantity in excess of what is countable in the units in a column to the column immediately to the left in order to be added there.
definitions.example: Five and nine are fourteen; carry the one to the tens place.
definitions.definitionCn: 在加法中，将一列中超出可计数单位的数量转移到左边一列以便相加。
definitions.exampleCn: 五加九等于十四；把一进位到十位。

definitions.definition: To have, hold, possess or maintain (something).
definitions.example: Always carry sufficient insurance to protect against a loss.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有、持有、占有或维持（某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 始终购买足够的保险以防损失。

definitions.definition: To be transmitted; to travel.
definitions.example: The sound of the bells carried for miles on the wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 被传播；传播。
definitions.exampleCn: 钟声随风传了几英里。

definitions.definition: To insult, to diss.
definitions.definitionCn: 侮辱，贬低。

definitions.definition: To capture a ship by coming alongside and boarding.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过靠近并登船来捕获船只。

definitions.definition: To transport (the ball) whilst maintaining possession.
definitions.definitionCn: 在保持控球的同时运输（球）。

definitions.definition: To have on one's person.
definitions.example: she always carries a purse;  marsupials carry their young in a pouch
definitions.definitionCn: 随身携带。
definitions.exampleCn: 她总是带着钱包；有袋动物把幼崽放在育儿袋里。

definitions.definition: To be pregnant (with).
definitions.example: The doctor said she's carrying twins.
definitions.definitionCn: 怀孕（带着）。
definitions.exampleCn: 医生说她怀了双胞胎。

definitions.definition: To have propulsive power; to propel.
definitions.example: A gun or mortar carries well.
definitions.definitionCn: 有推进力；推进。
definitions.exampleCn: 枪或迫击炮射程很远。

definitions.definition: To hold the head; said of a horse.
definitions.example: to carry well, i.e. to hold the head high, with arching neck
definitions.definitionCn: 昂着头；指马。
definitions.exampleCn: 昂首挺胸，即高昂着头，脖子弯曲。

definitions.definition: To have earth or frost stick to the feet when running, as a hare.
definitions.definitionCn: 奔跑时脚上粘着泥土或霜，如野兔。

definitions.definition: To bear or uphold successfully through conflict, for example a leader or principle
definitions.definitionCn: 在冲突中成功支持，例如领袖或原则。

definitions.definition: To succeed in (e.g. a contest); to succeed in; to win.
definitions.example: The Tories carried the election.
definitions.definitionCn: 在（如竞赛中）成功；获胜。
definitions.exampleCn: 保守党赢得了选举。

definitions.definition: To get possession of by force; to capture.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过武力获取；捕获。

definitions.definition: To contain; to comprise; have a particular aspect; to show or exhibit
definitions.definitionCn: 包含；包括；有特定方面；展示或显示。

definitions.definition: To bear (oneself); to behave or conduct.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现（自己）；行为或举止。

definitions.definition: To bear the charges or burden of holding or having, as stocks, merchandise, etc., from one time to another.
definitions.example: A merchant is carrying a large stock;  a farm carries a mortgage;  a broker carries stock for a customer;  to carry a life insurance.
definitions.definitionCn: 承担持有或拥有（如股票、商品等）的费用或负担，从一段时间到另一段时间。
definitions.exampleCn: 商人持有大量库存；农场有抵押贷款；经纪人为客户持有股票；持有寿险。

definitions.definition: To have a weapon on one's person; to be armed.
definitions.definitionCn: 随身携带武器；武装。

definitions.definition: To be disproportionately responsible for a team's success.
definitions.example: He absolutely carried the game, to the point of killing the entire enemy team by himself.
definitions.definitionCn: 不成比例地负责团队的成功。
definitions.exampleCn: 他完全主导了比赛，以至于独自消灭了整个敌方队伍。

definitions.definition: Transportation.
definitions.example: carryings away of goods
definitions.definitionCn: 运输。
definitions.exampleCn: 货物的搬运。

definitions.definition: Forcefully, vigorously.
definitions.definitionCn: 有力地，强有力地。

definitions.definition: Of the production of a sound: loudly, powerfully.
definitions.definitionCn: （指声音的发出）响亮地，有力地。

definitions.definition: To a great degree; very much.
definitions.definitionCn: 在很大程度上；非常。

definitions.definition: Chiefly; for the most part.
definitions.definitionCn: 主要地；大部分地。

definitions.definition: The combination of circumstances at a given moment; a state of affairs.
definitions.example: The United States is in an awkward situation with debt default looming.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定时刻各种情况的组合；事态。
definitions.exampleCn: 美国正面临债务违约的尴尬局面。

definitions.definition: The way in which something is positioned vis-à-vis its surroundings.
definitions.example: The Botanical Gardens are in a delightful situation on the river bank.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物相对于其周围环境的摆放方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 植物园位于河岸，环境宜人。

definitions.definition: The place in which something is situated; a location.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物所处的地点；位置。

definitions.definition: Position or status with regard to conditions and circumstances.
definitions.definitionCn: 在条件和环境方面的地位或状态。

definitions.definition: A position of employment; a post.
definitions.definitionCn: 就业职位；岗位。

definitions.definition: A difficult or unpleasant set of circumstances; a problem.
definitions.example: Boss, we've got a situation here...
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列困难或令人不快的状况；问题。
definitions.exampleCn: 老板，我们这儿出状况了……

definitions.definition: To set aside for a purpose.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某一目的而预留。

definitions.definition: To distribute according to a plan, generally followed by the adposition to.
definitions.example: The bulk of K–12 education funds are allocated to school districts that in turn pay for the cost of operating schools.
definitions.definitionCn: 按计划分配，通常后接介词to。
definitions.exampleCn: K-12教育资金的大部分被分配给学区，学区再用于支付学校运营费用。

definitions.definition: To reserve a portion of memory for use by a computer program.
definitions.definitionCn: 为计算机程序预留一部分内存。

definitions.definition: Having been granted an allocation; having received (something) as part of a plan or scheduled disbursement; having been assigned (something) that was set aside for a particular purpose.
definitions.definitionCn: 已获得分配；作为计划或预定支出的一部分已收到（某物）；已被指定（某物）用于特定目的。

definitions.definition: The person or thing in the fifth position.
definitions.definitionCn: 第五位的人或物。

definitions.definition: One of five equal parts of a whole.
definitions.definitionCn: 整体的五等分之一。

definitions.definition: The fifth gear of an engine.
definitions.definitionCn: 引擎的第五档。

definitions.definition: A quantity of liquor equal to one-fifth of a gallon, or, more commonly, 750 milliliters (that is, three quarters of a liter).
definitions.definitionCn: 相当于五分之一加仑的酒量，更常见的是750毫升（即四分之三升）。

definitions.definition: The musical interval between one note and another seven semitones higher (the fifth note in the major/minor scale)
definitions.definitionCn: 一个音符与另一个高七个半音的音符之间的音程（大调/小调音阶中的第五个音）。

definitions.definition: The fifth voice in a polyphonic melody.
definitions.definitionCn: 复调旋律中的第五声部。

definitions.definition: To support something fifth, after four others have already done so.
definitions.definitionCn: 在已有四人支持后，第五个支持某事。

definitions.definition: To divide by 5, equates to multiplying a denominator by 5
definitions.definitionCn: 除以5，等同于将分母乘以5。

definitions.definition: The ordinal form of the number five.
definitions.definitionCn: 数字五的序数形式。

definitions.definition: A written work edited and published, as by a certain editor or in a certain manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 由特定编辑或以特定方式编辑并出版的书面作品。

definitions.definition: The whole number of copies of a work printed and published at one time.
definitions.example: The first edition was soon sold.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次印刷并出版的作品总印数。
definitions.exampleCn: 第一版很快售罄。

definitions.definition: A particular instance of an event.
definitions.example: The 2014 edition of the Tour de France started in Leeds, Yorkshire.
definitions.definitionCn: 某一事件的具体实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 2014年环法自行车赛从约克郡利兹出发。

definitions.definition: To represent in words.
definitions.example: The feeling is difficult to describe, but not unpleasant.
definitions.definitionCn: 用言语表达。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种感受难以描述，但并非不悦。

definitions.definition: To represent by drawing; to draw a plan of; to delineate; to trace or mark out.
definitions.example: to describe a circle by the compasses;   a torch waved about the head in such a way as to describe a circle
definitions.definitionCn: 通过绘画表现；绘制平面图；勾勒轮廓；描画或标出。
definitions.exampleCn: 用圆规画一个圆；火炬在头顶挥舞，划出一个圆形。

definitions.definition: To give rise to a geometrical structure.
definitions.example: The function describes a very complex surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生一种几何结构。
definitions.exampleCn: 该函数描述了一个非常复杂的曲面。

definitions.definition: To introduce a new taxon to science by explaining its characteristics and particularly how it differs from other taxa.
definitions.example: The fungus was first described by a botanist.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过解释其特征，特别是与其他分类单元的区别，向科学界引入一个新的分类单元。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种真菌最初由一位植物学家描述。

definitions.definition: To distribute into parts, groups, or classes; to mark off; to class.
definitions.definitionCn: 划分为部分、群体或类别；标出界限；分类。

definitions.definition: The act of correcting.
definitions.definitionCn: 纠正的行为。

definitions.definition: A substitution for an error or mistake.
definitions.definitionCn: 对错误或失误的替代。

definitions.definition: Punishment that is intended to rehabilitate an offender.
definitions.definitionCn: 旨在使犯罪者改过自新的惩罚。

definitions.definition: An amount or quantity of something added or subtracted so as to correct.
definitions.definitionCn: 为纠正而增加或减少的某物数量或量。

definitions.definition: A decline in a stock market price after a large rise.
definitions.definitionCn: 股市大幅上涨后的价格下跌。

definitions.definition: (procedure word, military) a station's indication that previous information was incorrect and will continue with correct information from the last correct transmitted
definitions.example: I have four T-80 tanks at grid Three-niner-niner-four-eight-eight, Correction: Grid Three niner-niner-four-eight-five. How copy? Over.
definitions.definitionCn: （程序用语，军事）某站点表示之前的信息有误，并将从上次正确传输的信息开始继续提供正确信息。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在网格三九-九四-八八处有四辆T-80坦克，更正：网格三九-九四-八五。收到否？完毕。

definitions.definition: Anything that is found (usually valuable), as objects on an archeological site or a person with talent.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何被发现的东西（通常是有价值的），如考古遗址上的物品或有才华的人。

definitions.definition: The act of finding.
definitions.definitionCn: 发现的行为。

definitions.definition: To encounter or discover by accident; to happen upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 偶然遇到或发现；碰巧发现。

definitions.definition: To encounter or discover something being searched for; to locate.
definitions.example: I found my car keys. They were under the couch.
definitions.definitionCn: 遇到或发现正在寻找的东西；定位。
definitions.exampleCn: 我找到了我的车钥匙。它们就在沙发下面。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To discover by study or experiment direct to an object or end.
definitions.example: Water is found to be a compound substance.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语）通过研究或实验发现直接指向某个对象或目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 水被发现是一种化合物。

definitions.definition: To gain, as the object of desire or effort.
definitions.example: to find leisure; to find means
definitions.definitionCn: 获得，作为欲望或努力的目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 找到闲暇；找到方法。

definitions.definition: To attain to; to arrive at; to acquire.
definitions.example: Looks like he found a new vehicle for himself!
definitions.definitionCn: 达到；到达；获得。
definitions.exampleCn: 看起来他为自己找到了一辆新车！

definitions.definition: To point out.
definitions.example: He kept finding faults with my work.
definitions.definitionCn: 指出。
definitions.exampleCn: 他一直在挑剔我的工作。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To decide that, to discover that, to form the opinion that.
definitions.example: I find your argument unsatisfactory.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语）决定，发现，形成某种观点。
definitions.exampleCn: 我认为你的论点不令人满意。

definitions.definition: To arrive at, as a conclusion; to determine as true; to establish.
definitions.example: to find a verdict; to find a true bill (of indictment) against an accused person
definitions.definitionCn: 得出结论；确定为真；确立。
definitions.exampleCn: 作出裁决；对被告提出起诉书。

definitions.definition: To supply; to furnish.
definitions.example: to find food for workmen
definitions.definitionCn: 提供；供给。
definitions.exampleCn: 为工人提供食物。

definitions.definition: To provide for
definitions.example: He finds his nephew in money.
definitions.definitionCn: 供养。
definitions.exampleCn: 他给侄子提供金钱。

definitions.definition: To determine or judge.
definitions.example: The jury finds for the defendant.
definitions.definitionCn: 决定或判断。
definitions.exampleCn: 陪审团裁定被告无罪。

definitions.definition: To discover game.
definitions.definitionCn: 发现猎物。

definitions.definition: To run.
definitions.definitionCn: 跑。

definitions.definition: To move swiftly.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动。

definitions.definition: (fluids) To flow.
definitions.definitionCn: （流体）流动。

definitions.definition: (of a vessel) To sail before the wind, in distinction from reaching or sailing close-hauled.
definitions.definitionCn: （船只）顺风航行，区别于横风或抢风航行。

definitions.definition: To control or manage, be in charge of.
definitions.example: He is running the candidate's expensive campaign.
definitions.definitionCn: 控制或管理，负责。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正在为这位候选人昂贵的竞选活动操办。

definitions.definition: To be a candidate in an election.
definitions.example: I have decided to run for governor of California.
definitions.definitionCn: 在选举中成为候选人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已决定竞选加利福尼亚州州长。

definitions.definition: To make run in a race or an election.
definitions.example: He ran his best horse in the Derby.
definitions.definitionCn: 让某人或某物参加赛跑或选举。
definitions.exampleCn: 他让最好的马参加了德比大赛。

definitions.definition: To exert continuous activity; to proceed.
definitions.example: to run through life; to run in a circle
definitions.definitionCn: 持续活动；进行。
definitions.exampleCn: 度过一生；循环往复。

definitions.definition: To be presented in the media.
definitions.example: Her picture ran on the front page of the newspaper.
definitions.definitionCn: 在媒体上出现。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的照片登上了报纸头版。

definitions.definition: To print or broadcast in the media.
definitions.example: run a story; run an ad
definitions.definitionCn: 在媒体上印刷或播出。
definitions.exampleCn: 刊登报道；播放广告。

definitions.definition: To smuggle (illegal goods).
definitions.example: to run guns; to run rum
definitions.definitionCn: 走私（非法物品）。
definitions.exampleCn: 走私枪支；走私朗姆酒。

definitions.definition: To sort through a large volume of produce in quality control.
definitions.example: Looks like we're gonna have to run the tomatoes again.
definitions.definitionCn: 在质量控制中筛选大量农产品。
definitions.exampleCn: 看来我们得再检查一遍西红柿了。

definitions.definition: To extend or persist, statically or dynamically, through space or time.
definitions.definitionCn: 在空间或时间上静态或动态地延伸或持续。
