definitions.definition: The ability to act first or on one's own.
definitions.definitionCn: 先发制人或自主行动的能力。

definitions.definition: An issue to be voted on, brought to the ballot by a sufficient number of signatures from among the voting public.
definitions.definitionCn: 一项待投票的议题，由足够数量的选民签名后提交至选票。

definitions.definition: A perfect and/or early example of a particular style.
definitions.definitionCn: 某一风格的完美典范和/或早期范例。

definitions.definition: An artistic work of lasting worth, such as a film or song.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有持久价值的艺术作品，如电影或歌曲。

definitions.definition: The author of such a work.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类作品的作者。

definitions.definition: A major, long-standing sporting event
definitions.definitionCn: 一项历史悠久的大型体育赛事。

definitions.definition: One learned in the literature of Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome; a student of classical literature.
definitions.definitionCn: 精通古希腊和古罗马文学的人；古典文学的学生。

definitions.definition: The study of Ancient Greek and Latin, their literature, history, etc., sometimes inclusive of the study of the ancient Mediterranean generally.
definitions.definitionCn: 对古希腊语和拉丁语及其文学、历史等的研究，有时也泛指对古代地中海地区的研究。

definitions.definition: Something that simulates a system or environment in order to predict actual behaviour.
definitions.example: The most reliable simulation predicts that the hurricane will turn north.
definitions.definitionCn: 模拟系统或环境以预测实际行为的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 最可靠的模拟预测飓风将转向北方。

definitions.definition: The process of simulating.
definitions.example: Despite extensive simulation in the design phase, the aircraft failed to behave as expected.
definitions.definitionCn: 模拟的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 尽管在设计阶段进行了大量模拟，飞机仍未能按预期表现。

definitions.definition: A video game designed to convey a more or less realistic experience, as of a sport or warfare.
definitions.example: Some kids in the classroom will be playing simulations after school.
definitions.definitionCn: 旨在传达或多或少真实体验的视频游戏，如体育或战争模拟。
definitions.exampleCn: 教室里的一些孩子放学后会玩模拟游戏。

definitions.definition: Assuming an appearance which is feigned, or not true.
definitions.definitionCn: 假装出虚假或不真实的外表。

definitions.definition: The act of falling over in order to be awarded a foul, when no foul has been committed.
definitions.definitionCn: 在未发生犯规时故意摔倒以骗取犯规的行为。

definitions.definition: (often pluralized) Trouble; distress; misfortune; adversity.
definitions.example: Music won't solve all the world's ills, but it can make them easier to bear.
definitions.definitionCn: （常复数）麻烦；痛苦；不幸；逆境。
definitions.exampleCn: 音乐无法解决世间所有弊病，但能让它们更易承受。

definitions.definition: Harm or injury.
definitions.example: I wouldn't want you to do me ill.
definitions.definitionCn: 伤害或损伤。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不希望你对我造成伤害。

definitions.definition: Evil; moral wrongfulness.
definitions.definitionCn: 邪恶；道德上的错误。

definitions.definition: A physical ailment; an illness.
definitions.example: I am incapacitated by rheumatism and other ills.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体疾病；病症。
definitions.exampleCn: 我因风湿病和其他疾病而行动不便。

definitions.definition: PCP, phencyclidine.
definitions.definitionCn: 苯环利定（PCP）。

definitions.definition: Evil; wicked (of people).
definitions.definitionCn: 邪恶的；恶毒的（指人）。

definitions.definition: Morally reprehensible (of behaviour etc.); blameworthy.
definitions.definitionCn: 道德上应受谴责的（指行为等）；应受责备的。

definitions.definition: Indicative of unkind or malevolent intentions; harsh, cruel.
definitions.example: He suffered from ill treatment.
definitions.definitionCn: 暗示不友善或恶意的意图；严酷的，残忍的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他遭受了虐待。

definitions.definition: Unpropitious, unkind, faulty, not up to reasonable standard.
definitions.example: ill manners; ill will
definitions.definitionCn: 不吉利的，不友善的，有缺陷的，未达到合理标准的。
definitions.exampleCn: 无礼举止；恶意

definitions.definition: Unwell in terms of health or physical condition; sick.
definitions.example: I've been ill with the flu for the past few days.
definitions.definitionCn: 健康或身体状况不佳；生病的。
definitions.exampleCn: 过去几天我因流感而生病。

definitions.definition: Having an urge to vomit.
definitions.example: Seeing those pictures made me ill.
definitions.definitionCn: 有呕吐的冲动。
definitions.exampleCn: 看到那些照片让我感到恶心。

definitions.definition: (hip-hop slang) Sublime, with the connotation of being so in a singularly creative way.
definitions.definitionCn: （嘻哈俚语）极致的，带有独特创意方式的意味。

definitions.definition: Extremely bad (bad enough to make one ill). Generally used indirectly with to be.
definitions.example: That band was ill.
definitions.definitionCn: 极其糟糕（糟糕到令人不适）。通常间接与“to be”连用。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个乐队糟透了。

definitions.definition: Unwise; not a good idea.
definitions.definitionCn: 不明智的；不是个好主意。

definitions.definition: Not well; imperfectly, badly; hardly.
definitions.definitionCn: 不好地；不完美地，糟糕地；几乎不。

definitions.definition: An act of interpreting or explaining what is obscure; a translation; a version; a construction.
definitions.example: the interpretation of a dream, or of an enigma.
definitions.definitionCn: 对晦涩内容的解释或说明；翻译；译本；释义。
definitions.exampleCn: 对梦境或谜语的解读。

definitions.definition: A sense given by an interpreter; an exposition or explanation given; meaning .
definitions.example: Commentators give various interpretations of the same passage of Scripture.
definitions.definitionCn: 解释者给出的含义；阐述或说明；意义。
definitions.exampleCn: 注释者对同一段经文给出了不同的解释。

definitions.definition: The discipline or study of translating one spoken or signed language into another (as opposed to translation, which concerns itself with written language).
definitions.definitionCn: 将一种口语或手语翻译成另一种语言的研究或学科（区别于笔译，笔译涉及书面语言）。

definitions.definition: The power of explaining.
definitions.definitionCn: 解释的能力。

definitions.definition: An artist's way of expressing his thought or embodying his conception of nature.
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术家表达思想或体现其自然观念的方式。

definitions.definition: An act or process of applying general principles or formulae to the explanation of the results obtained in special cases.
definitions.definitionCn: 将一般原理或公式应用于解释特殊情况所得结果的过程或行为。

definitions.definition: An approximation that allows aspects of a mathematical theory to be discussed in ordinary language.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种近似方法，使数学理论的某些方面能用日常语言讨论。

definitions.definition: (model theory) An assignment of a truth value to each propositional symbol of a propositional calculus.
definitions.definitionCn: （模型论）对命题演算中每个命题符号赋予真值的过程。

definitions.definition: The practice and discipline of explaining natural and cultural heritage to visitors at museums, historic sites, zoos, aquaria, science centres, art galleries, etc. Also called heritage interpretation, mediation, guiding, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 向博物馆、历史遗址、动物园、水族馆、科学中心、美术馆等场所的游客解释自然与文化遗产的实践与学科。也称为遗产阐释、解说、导览等。

definitions.definition: Any of several animals related to Equus ferus caballus.
definitions.definitionCn: 几种与家马相关的动物。

definitions.definition: Equipment with legs.
definitions.definitionCn: 带腿的设备。

definitions.definition: Type of equipment.
definitions.definitionCn: 设备类型。

definitions.definition: A mass of earthy matter, or rock of the same character as the wall rock, occurring in the course of a vein, as of coal or ore; hence, to take horse (said of a vein) is to divide into branches for a distance.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种土质物质，或与围岩性质相同的岩石，出现在矿脉（如煤或矿石）中；因此，矿脉“分叉”指其在一定距离内分成支脉。

definitions.definition: The sedative, antidepressant, and anxiolytic drug morphine, chiefly when used illicitly.
definitions.definitionCn: 镇静、抗抑郁和抗焦虑药物吗啡，主要指非法使用时。

definitions.definition: An informal variant of basketball in which players match shots made by their opponent(s), each miss adding a letter to the word "horse", with 5 misses spelling the whole word and eliminating a player, until only the winner is left. Also HORSE, H-O-R-S-E or H.O.R.S.E. (see Variations of basketball#H-O-R-S-E).
definitions.definitionCn: 篮球的一种非正式变体，玩家需模仿对手的投篮，每次未中则向“HORSE”一词添加一个字母，累计五次未中拼出完整单词并淘汰该玩家，直至只剩胜者。也称HORSE、H-O-R-S-E或H.O.R.S.E.（见篮球变体#H-O-R-S-E）。

definitions.definition: (among students) A translation or other illegitimate aid in study or examination.
definitions.definitionCn: （学生用语）学习或考试中的翻译或其他不正当辅助手段。

definitions.definition: (among students) horseplay; tomfoolery
definitions.definitionCn: （学生用语）胡闹；愚蠢行为。

definitions.definition: To frolic, to act mischievously. (Usually followed by "around".)
definitions.definitionCn: 嬉戏，调皮捣蛋。（通常后接“around”）

definitions.definition: To provide with a horse; supply horses for.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供马匹；为……配备马。

definitions.definition: To get on horseback.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑上马背。

definitions.definition: To sit astride of; to bestride.
definitions.definitionCn: 跨坐；骑跨。

definitions.definition: (of a male horse) To copulate with (a mare).
definitions.definitionCn: （公马）与（母马）交配。

definitions.definition: To take or carry on the back.
definitions.definitionCn: 背负或驮运。

definitions.definition: To place (someone) on the back of another person, or on a wooden horse, etc., to be flogged; (hence) to flog.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某人）放在他人背上或木马等上施以鞭刑；（由此引申）鞭打。

definitions.definition: To urge at work tyrannically.
definitions.definitionCn: 以专制方式催促工作。

definitions.definition: To charge for work before it is finished.
definitions.definitionCn: 在工作完成前收费。

definitions.definition: A legally declared or recognized condition of insolvency of a person or organization.
definitions.definitionCn: 依法宣告或承认的个人或组织破产状态。

definitions.definition: To make a donation; to give away something of value to support or contribute towards a cause or for the benefit of another.
definitions.example: He donated an etching from his own collection to the new art gallery.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行捐赠；将某件有价值的东西赠予他人，以支持某项事业或为他人谋取利益。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将自己收藏的一幅蚀刻版画捐赠给了新美术馆。

definitions.definition: Relating to genetics or genes.
definitions.definitionCn: 与遗传学或基因有关。

definitions.definition: Caused by genes.
definitions.definitionCn: 由基因引起。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to origin (genesis).
definitions.definitionCn: 关于起源（发生）的。

definitions.definition: Based on shared membership in a linguistic family.
definitions.example: Chinese has borrowed several words from English, but it does not have a genetic relationship to English.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于同一语系中的共同成员关系。
definitions.exampleCn: 汉语从英语借用了几个词，但与英语没有亲缘关系。

definitions.definition: Based on a shared membership in a religious family.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于同一宗教体系中的共同成员关系。

definitions.definition: The design and operation of a system or process to make it as good as possible in some defined sense.
definitions.definitionCn: 在某种定义下，使系统或过程的设计与运行达到尽可能最优。

definitions.definition: Physical matter; material.
definitions.definitionCn: 物质；材料。

definitions.definition: The essential part of anything; the most vital part.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何事物的本质部分；最关键的要素。

definitions.definition: Substantiality; solidity; firmness.
definitions.example: Some textile fabrics have little substance.
definitions.definitionCn: 实在性；坚固性；牢固性。
definitions.exampleCn: 某些纺织面料缺乏质地。

definitions.definition: Material possessions; estate; property; resources.
definitions.example: a man of substance
definitions.definitionCn: 物质财富；产业；财产；资源。
definitions.exampleCn: 有资产的人

definitions.definition: A form of matter that has constant chemical composition and characteristic properties.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有恒定化学成分和特性属性的物质形态。

definitions.definition: Drugs (illegal narcotics)
definitions.example: substance abuse
definitions.definitionCn: 毒品（非法麻醉品）
definitions.exampleCn: 药物滥用

definitions.definition: Hypostasis.
definitions.definitionCn: 本质实体。

definitions.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
definitions.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物分成两块或多块的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 股骨上有一处干净的断裂，因此应该容易愈合。

definitions.definition: A physical space that opens up in something or between two things.
definitions.example: He waited minutes for a break in the traffic to cross the highway.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物内部或两物之间出现的物理空间。
definitions.exampleCn: 他等了几分钟，等车流出现间隙好穿过高速公路。

definitions.definition: A rest or pause, usually from work.
definitions.example: Let’s take a five-minute break.
definitions.definitionCn: 休息或暂停，通常指工作间隙。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们休息五分钟吧。

definitions.definition: A time for students to talk or play.
definitions.definitionCn: 学生可以交谈或玩耍的时间。

definitions.definition: A short holiday.
definitions.example: a weekend break on the Isle of Wight
definitions.definitionCn: 短暂的假期。
definitions.exampleCn: 怀特岛上的周末短假。

definitions.definition: A temporary split with a romantic partner.
definitions.example: I think we need a break.
definitions.definitionCn: 与恋人的暂时分手。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想我们需要分开一段时间。

definitions.definition: An interval or intermission between two parts of a performance, for example a theatre show, broadcast, or sports game.
definitions.definitionCn: 表演（如戏剧、广播或体育比赛）两部分之间的间隔或中场休息。

definitions.definition: A significant change in circumstance, attitude, perception, or focus of attention.
definitions.example: big break
definitions.definitionCn: 环境、态度、看法或关注焦点的重大变化。
definitions.exampleCn: 重大突破。

definitions.definition: The beginning (of the morning).
definitions.example: at the break of day
definitions.definitionCn: （早晨的）开始。
definitions.exampleCn: 破晓时分。

definitions.definition: An act of escaping.
definitions.example: It was a clean break.
definitions.definitionCn: 逃跑的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 那是一次彻底的逃脱。

definitions.definition: The separation between lines, paragraphs or pages of a written text.
definitions.definitionCn: 书面文本中行、段落或页之间的分隔。

definitions.definition: A keystroke or other signal that causes a program to terminate or suspend execution.
definitions.definitionCn: 导致程序终止或暂停执行的按键或其他信号。

definitions.definition: A point or condition in a program at which operation may be suspended during debugging so that the state of the program at that point can be investigated. A breakpoint.
definitions.definitionCn: 程序中可在调试期间暂停操作的点或状态，以便调查该点的程序状态。断点。

definitions.definition: A change, particularly the end of a spell of persistent good or bad weather.
definitions.definitionCn: 变化，尤指持续好或坏天气的结束。

definitions.definition: A large four-wheeled carriage, having a straight body and calash top, with the driver's seat in front and the footman's behind.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种大型四轮马车，车身笔直，有折叠顶篷，车夫座位在前，仆从座位在后。

definitions.definition: (equitation) A sharp bit or snaffle.
definitions.definitionCn: （马术）一种锐利的马嚼子或轻勒。

definitions.definition: A short section of music, often between verses, in which some performers stop while others continue.
definitions.example: The fiddle break was amazing; it was a pity the singer came back in on the wrong note.
definitions.definitionCn: 音乐中的短片段，常出现在段落之间，部分演奏者停止而其他人继续。
definitions.exampleCn: 小提琴间奏太精彩了；可惜歌手回来时唱错了调。

definitions.definition: The point in the musical scale at which a woodwind instrument is designed to overblow, that is, to move from its lower to its upper register.
definitions.example: Crossing the break smoothly is one of the first lessons the young clarinettist needs to master.
definitions.definitionCn: 木管乐器设计为超吹的音阶点，即从低音区过渡到高音区。
definitions.exampleCn: 平稳跨过这个音区是单簧管初学者需要掌握的第一课之一。

definitions.definition: Usu. plural An area along a river that features steep banks, bluffs, or gorges (e.g., Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument, US).
definitions.definitionCn: 通常用复数。河流沿岸陡峭河岸、悬崖或峡谷的区域（例如美国密苏里河上游断崖国家保护区）。

definitions.definition: A section of extended repetition of the percussion break to a song, created by a hip-hop DJ as rhythmic dance music.
definitions.definitionCn: 嘻哈DJ为创造节奏舞曲而对歌曲打击乐段进行重复扩展的部分。

definitions.definition: To separate into two or more pieces, to fracture or crack, by a process that cannot easily be reversed for reassembly.
definitions.example: If the vase falls to the floor, it might break.

definitions.definition: To divide (something, often money) into smaller units.
definitions.example: Can you break a hundred-dollar bill for me?

definitions.definition: To cause (a person or animal) to lose spirit or will; to crush the spirits of.
definitions.example: Her child's death broke Angela.

definitions.definition: To be crushed, or overwhelmed with sorrow or grief.
definitions.example: My heart is breaking.

definitions.definition: To interrupt; to destroy the continuity of; to dissolve or terminate.
definitions.example: I had won four games in a row, but now you've broken my streak of luck.

definitions.definition: To ruin financially.
definitions.example: The recession broke some small businesses.

definitions.definition: To violate, to not adhere to.
definitions.example: He broke his vows by cheating on his wife.

definitions.definition: (of a fever) To pass the most dangerous part of the illness; to go down, in terms of temperature.
definitions.example: Susan's fever broke at about 3 AM, and the doctor said the worst was over.

definitions.definition: (of a spell of settled weather) To end.
definitions.example: The forecast says the hot weather will break by midweek.

definitions.definition: (of a storm) To begin; to end.
definitions.example: Around midday the storm broke, and the afternoon was calm and sunny.

definitions.definition: (of morning, dawn, day etc.) To arrive.
definitions.example: Morning has broken.

definitions.definition: To render (a game) unchallenging by altering its rules or exploiting loopholes or weaknesses in them in a way that gives a player an unfair advantage.
definitions.example: Changing the rules to let white have three extra queens would break chess.

definitions.definition: To stop, or to cause to stop, functioning properly or altogether.
definitions.example: Did you two break the trolley by racing with it?

definitions.definition: To cause (a barrier) to no longer bar.
definitions.example: break a seal

definitions.definition: To destroy the arrangement of; to throw into disorder; to pierce.
definitions.example: The cavalry were not able to break the British squares.

definitions.definition: (of a wave of water) To collapse into surf, after arriving in shallow water.
To burst forth; to make its way; to come into view.
To interrupt or cease one's work or occupation temporarily.
definitions.example: Let's break for lunch.

definitions.definition: To interrupt (a fall) by inserting something so that the falling object does not (immediately) hit something else beneath.
definitions.example: He survived the jump out the window because the bushes below broke his fall.

definitions.definition: To disclose or make known an item of news, etc.
definitions.example: I don't know how to break this to you, but your cat is not coming back.

definitions.definition: (of a sound) To become audible suddenly.
To change a steady state abruptly.
definitions.example: His coughing broke the silence.

definitions.definition: To suddenly become.
definitions.example: The arrest was standard, when suddenly the suspect broke ugly.

definitions.definition: Of a male voice, to become deeper at puberty.
Of a voice, to alter in type due to emotion or strain: in men generally to go up, in women sometimes to go down; to crack.
definitions.example: His voice breaks when he gets emotional.

definitions.definition: To surpass or do better than (a specific number), to do better than (a record), setting a new record.
definitions.example: He broke the men's 100-meter record.

definitions.definition: (most often in the passive tense) To demote, to reduce the military rank of.
To end (a connection), to disconnect.
definitions.example: I couldn't hear a thing he was saying, so I broke the connection and called him back.

definitions.definition: (of an emulsion) To demulsify.
To counter-attack
To lay open, as a purpose; to disclose, divulge, or communicate.
To become weakened in constitution or faculties; to lose health or strength.
To fail in business; to become bankrupt.
To destroy the strength, firmness, or consistency of.
definitions.example: to break flax

definitions.definition: To destroy the official character and standing of; to cashier; to dismiss.
To make an abrupt or sudden change; to change the gait.
definitions.example: to break into a run or gallop

definitions.definition: To fall out; to terminate friendship.
To terminate the execution of a program before normal completion.
To suspend the execution of a program during debugging so that the state of the program can be investigated.
An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly; a similar fin at the side of a ray or similar fish
definitions.definitionCn: 动物（鸟、蝙蝠、昆虫）身体上使其能够飞行的附属器官；鳐鱼或类似鱼类侧面的类似鳍。

definitions.definition: Human arm.
definitions.definitionCn: 人类的手臂。

definitions.definition: Part of an aircraft that produces the lift for rising into the air.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞机上产生升力使其升空的部分。

definitions.definition: One of the large pectoral fins of a flying fish.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞鱼的大型胸鳍之一。

definitions.definition: One of the broad, thin, anterior lobes of the foot of a pteropod, used as an organ in swimming.
definitions.definitionCn: 翼足类动物足部宽而薄的前叶之一，用作游泳器官。

definitions.definition: Any membranaceous expansion, such as that along the sides of certain stems, or of a fruit of the kind called samara.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何膜状扩展物，例如某些茎干两侧或称为翅果的果实上的结构。

definitions.definition: Either of the two side petals of a papilionaceous flower.
definitions.definitionCn: 蝶形花的两片侧花瓣之一。

definitions.definition: A side shoot of a tree or plant; a branch growing up by the side of another.
definitions.definitionCn: 树木或植物的侧枝；沿另一枝条生长的分枝。

definitions.definition: Passage by flying; flight.
definitions.example: to take wing
definitions.definitionCn: 通过飞行的通道；飞行。
definitions.exampleCn: 起飞

definitions.definition: Motive or instrument of flight; means of flight or of rapid motion.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞行的动机或工具；飞行或快速运动的手段。

definitions.definition: A part of something that is lesser in size than the main body, such as an extension from the main building.
definitions.example: the west wing of the hospital
definitions.definitionCn: 某物比主体尺寸较小的部分，例如主建筑的延伸部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 医院的西翼

definitions.definition: Anything that agitates the air as a wing does, or is put in winglike motion by the action of the air, such as a fan or vane for winnowing grain, the vane or sail of a windmill, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何像翅膀一样搅动空气的东西，或通过空气作用产生类似翅膀运动的物体，例如扬谷用的扇子或叶片、风车的翼板或帆等。

definitions.definition: A protruding piece of material on a tampon to hold it in place and prevent leakage.
definitions.definitionCn: 卫生棉条上用于固定位置并防止渗漏的突出材料片。

definitions.definition: An ornament worn on the shoulder; a small epaulet or shoulder knot.
definitions.definitionCn: 佩戴在肩部的装饰物；小肩章或肩饰。

definitions.definition: A cosmetic effect where eyeliner curves outward and ends at a point.
definitions.definitionCn: 眼线向外弯曲并收尾于一点的美容效果。

definitions.definition: A fraction of a political movement. Usually implies a position apart from the mainstream center position.
definitions.definitionCn: 政治运动的一个分支。通常指与主流中心立场不同的立场。

definitions.definition: An organizational grouping in a military aviation service:
definitions.definitionCn: 军事航空服务中的组织分组：

definitions.definition: A panel of a car which encloses the wheel area, especially the front wheels.
definitions.definitionCn: 汽车上包围车轮区域的面板，尤其是前轮。

definitions.definition: A platform on either side of the bridge of a vessel, normally found in pairs.
definitions.definitionCn: 船舶驾驶台两侧的平台，通常成对出现。

definitions.definition: That part of the hold or orlop of a vessel which is nearest the sides. In a fleet, one of the extremities when the ships are drawn up in line, or when forming the two sides of a triangle.
definitions.definitionCn: 船舶货舱或下层甲板最靠近船舷的部分。在舰队中，当船只排成一线或形成三角形两侧时的一端。

definitions.definition: A position in several field games on either side of the field.
definitions.definitionCn: 几种场地运动中场地两侧的位置。

definitions.definition: A player occupying such a position, also called a winger
definitions.definitionCn: 占据该位置的球员，也称为边锋

definitions.definition: A háček.
definitions.definitionCn: 扬抑符（háček）。

definitions.definition: One of the unseen areas on the side of the stage in a theatre.
definitions.definitionCn: 剧院舞台侧面不可见的区域之一。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The insignia of a qualified pilot or aircrew member.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）合格飞行员或空勤人员的徽章。

definitions.definition: A portable shelter consisting of a fabric roof on a frame, like a tent without sides.
definitions.definitionCn: 由框架上的织物屋顶组成的便携式遮蔽物，类似无侧面的帐篷。

definitions.definition: On the Enneagram, one of the two adjacent types to an enneatype that forms an individual's subtype of his or her enneatype
definitions.example: Tom's a 4 on the Enneagram, with a 3 wing.
definitions.definitionCn: 在九型人格中，与核心类型相邻的两种类型之一，形成个体九型人格的子类型。
definitions.exampleCn: 汤姆在九型人格中是4型，带有3型侧翼。

definitions.definition: To injure slightly (as with a gunshot), especially in the wing or arm.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻微伤害（如枪伤），尤指翅膀或手臂。

definitions.definition: To fly.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞行。

definitions.definition: (of a building) To add a wing (extra part) to.
definitions.definitionCn: （指建筑）增加侧翼（额外部分）。

definitions.definition: To act or speak extemporaneously; to improvise; to wing it.
definitions.definitionCn: 即兴行动或发言；临时发挥；即兴而为。

definitions.definition: To throw.
definitions.definitionCn: 投掷。

definitions.definition: To furnish with wings.
definitions.definitionCn: 配备翅膀。

definitions.definition: To transport with, or as if with, wings; to bear in flight, or speedily.
definitions.definitionCn: 用翅膀或如同用翅膀运输；在飞行中或快速地承载。

definitions.definition: To traverse by flying.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过飞行穿越。

definitions.definition: A type of scuba harness with an attached buoyancy compensation device: see wikipedia:Backplate and wing
definitions.definitionCn: 一种带有浮力补偿装置的水肺背带：参见维基百科：背板与侧翼

definitions.definition: A flip (hairstyle)
definitions.definitionCn: 一种翻转发型（侧分发型）。

definitions.definition: Heroin
definitions.definitionCn: 海洛因

definitions.definition: A room in a house where a bed is kept for sleeping.
definitions.example: Please don't enter my bedroom without knocking.
definitions.definitionCn: 卧室是房子里放置床用于睡觉的房间。
definitions.exampleCn: 请进我卧室前先敲门。

definitions.definition: An impossibility
definitions.example: Late 14th century: “Madame,” quod he, “this were an impossible!” — Geoffrey Chaucer, ‘The Franklin's Tale’, Canterbury Tales
definitions.definitionCn: 不可能之事
definitions.exampleCn: 14世纪末：“夫人，”他说道，“这简直是不可能的事！”——杰弗里·乔叟，《富兰克林的故事》，《坎特伯雷故事集》

definitions.definition: Not possible; not able to be done or happen.
definitions.example: It is difficult, if not impossible, to memorize 20,000 consecutive numbers.
definitions.definitionCn: 不可能的；无法做到或发生的。
definitions.exampleCn: 即使并非完全不可能，记住两万个连续数字也是困难的。

definitions.definition: (of a person) Very difficult to deal with.
definitions.example: You never listen to a word I say – you're impossible!
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）极难应付的。
definitions.exampleCn: 你从不听我说一个字——你简直不可理喻！

definitions.definition: Imaginary
definitions.example: impossible quantities, or imaginary numbers
definitions.definitionCn: 虚构的
definitions.exampleCn: 不可能的数值，或虚数

definitions.definition: The chemical element with atomic number 78 and symbol Pt; a dense, malleable, ductile, highly unreactive, silverish-white transition metal of great value.
definitions.definitionCn: 原子序数为78、符号为Pt的化学元素；一种密度大、可塑性强、延展性好、高度不活泼、银白色的贵重过渡金属。

definitions.definition: A whitish grey colour, like that of the metal.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种类似该金属的灰白色。

definitions.definition: A single or album that has achieved platinum sales, i.e. over 1 million or 2 million.
definitions.definitionCn: 销量达到白金级别的单曲或专辑，即超过100万或200万张。

definitions.definition: To reach platinum level in a game
definitions.example: I platinumed in Clash of Clans yesterday.
definitions.definitionCn: 在游戏中达到白金级别。
definitions.exampleCn: 我昨天在《部落冲突》中达到了白金级别。

definitions.definition: Of a whitish grey colour, like that of the metal.
definitions.definitionCn: 呈灰白色，类似该金属的颜色。

definitions.definition: Of a musical recording that has sold over one million copies (for singles), or two million (for albums).
definitions.definitionCn: 指销量超过100万张（单曲）或200万张（专辑）的音乐唱片。

definitions.definition: In psychotherapy and psychiatry, a state of mind producing serious, long-term lowering of enjoyment of life or inability to visualize a happy future.
definitions.example: I used to suffer from depression, but now I'm mostly content with my life.
definitions.definitionCn: 在心理治疗和精神病学中，一种导致严重、长期降低生活享受能力或无法想象幸福未来的心理状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 我曾患有抑郁症，但现在对生活基本感到满足。

definitions.definition: An area that is lower in topography than its surroundings.
definitions.definitionCn: 地形上低于周围区域的地区。

definitions.definition: In psychotherapy and psychiatry, a period of unhappiness or low morale which lasts longer than several weeks and may include ideation of self-inflicted injury or suicide.
definitions.definitionCn: 在心理治疗和精神病学中，持续数周以上的不快乐或低落情绪，可能包括自伤或自杀的念头。

definitions.definition: An area of lowered air pressure that generally brings moist weather, sometimes promoting hurricanes and tornadoes.
definitions.definitionCn: 气压较低的区域，通常带来潮湿天气，有时会引发飓风和龙卷风。

definitions.definition: A period of major economic contraction.
definitions.definitionCn: 经济严重收缩的时期。

definitions.definition: Four consecutive quarters of negative, real GDP growth. See NBER.
definitions.example: The Great Depression was the worst financial event in US history.
definitions.definitionCn: 连续四个季度实际国内生产总值负增长。参见美国国家经济研究局。
definitions.exampleCn: 大萧条是美国历史上最严重的金融事件。

definitions.definition: The act of lowering or pressing something down.
definitions.example: Depression of the lever starts the machine.
definitions.definitionCn: 向下按压或压下的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 压下杠杆即可启动机器。

definitions.definition: A lowering, in particular a reduction in a particular biological variable or the function of an organ, in contrast to elevation.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种降低，特别是特定生物变量或器官功能的减弱，与提升相对。

definitions.definition: To place something over or upon, as to conceal or protect.
definitions.example: He covered the baby with a blanket.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物覆盖或置于某物之上，以隐藏或保护。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用毯子盖住婴儿。

definitions.definition: To be over or upon, as to conceal or protect.
definitions.example: The blanket covered the baby.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于某物之上，以隐藏或保护。
definitions.exampleCn: 毯子盖在婴儿身上。

definitions.definition: To be upon all of, so as to completely conceal.
definitions.example: Regular hexagons can cover the plane.
definitions.definitionCn: 完全覆盖某物表面。
definitions.exampleCn: 正六边形可以铺满平面。

definitions.definition: To set upon all of, so as to completely conceal.
definitions.example: You can cover the plane with regular hexagons.
definitions.definitionCn: 将某物完全覆盖在表面上。
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以用正六边形铺满平面。

definitions.definition: To put on one's hat.
definitions.definitionCn: 戴上帽子。

definitions.definition: To invest (oneself with something); to bring upon (oneself).
definitions.example: The heroic soldier covered himself with glory.
definitions.definitionCn: （使自己）披上（某物）；招致（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 英勇的士兵赢得了荣耀。

definitions.definition: (of a publication) To discuss thoroughly; to provide coverage of.
definitions.example: The magazine covers such diverse topics as politics, news from the world of science, and the economy.
definitions.definitionCn: （指出版物）深入讨论；提供报道。
definitions.exampleCn: 这本杂志涵盖政治、科学新闻和经济等多样话题。

definitions.definition: To deal with or include someone or something.
definitions.definitionCn: 处理或包括某人或某事。

definitions.definition: To be enough money for.
definitions.example: Ten dollars should cover lunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 足够支付某物的钱。
definitions.exampleCn: 十美元应该够付午餐。

definitions.definition: To act as a replacement.
definitions.example: I need to take off Tuesday. Can you cover for me?
definitions.definitionCn: 作为替代者。
definitions.exampleCn: 我周二需要请假。你能替我顶班吗？

definitions.definition: To have as an assignment or responsibility.
definitions.example: Can you cover the morning shift tomorrow? I'll give you off next Monday instead.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为任务或职责。
definitions.exampleCn: 你明天能值早班吗？我下周一给你放假。

definitions.definition: To make a cover version of (a song that was originally recorded by another artist).
definitions.definitionCn: 翻唱（最初由其他艺人录制的歌曲）。

definitions.definition: (law enforcement) To protect using an aimed firearm and the threat of firing; or to protect using continuous, heaving fire at or in the direction of the enemy so as to force the enemy to remain in cover; or to threaten using an aimed firearm.
definitions.definitionCn: （执法）用瞄准的枪支和开火威胁进行保护；或通过持续猛烈地向敌人方向射击迫使敌人躲藏；或用瞄准的枪支进行威胁。

definitions.definition: To provide insurance coverage for.
definitions.example: Does my policy cover accidental loss?
definitions.definitionCn: 提供保险保障。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的保单涵盖意外损失吗？

definitions.definition: To copulate with (said of certain male animals such as dogs and horses).
definitions.example: I would like to have my bitch covered next spring.
definitions.definitionCn: （指某些雄性动物如狗和马）与雌性交配。
definitions.exampleCn: 我希望明年让我的母狗配种。

definitions.definition: To protect or control (a piece or square).
definitions.example: In order to checkmate a king on the side of the board, the five squares adjacent to the king must all be covered.
definitions.definitionCn: 保护或控制（一个棋子或格子）。
definitions.exampleCn: 要将棋盘边上的王将死，王相邻的五个格子必须全部被控制。

definitions.definition: To extend over a given period of time or range, to occupy, to stretch over a given area.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖特定时间段或范围；占据；延伸至特定区域。

definitions.definition: To defend a particular player or area.
definitions.definitionCn: 防守特定球员或区域。

definitions.definition: That which covers or conceals; a cover; something spread or laid over or wrapped about another.
Action of the verb to cover.

A reflexive, often habitual behavior, especially one occurring in a context that often features attempts at deception by persons under psychological stress (such as a poker game or police interrogation), that reveals information that the person exhibiting the behavior is attempting to withhold.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种反射性的、常为习惯性的行为，尤其出现在心理压力下的人试图欺骗的场合（如扑克游戏或警方审讯），会泄露该行为者试图隐瞒的信息。

definitions.definition: That which is told; a tale or account.
definitions.definitionCn: 被讲述的内容；故事或叙述。

definitions.definition: A private message to an individual in a chat room; a whisper.
definitions.definitionCn: 聊天室中发给个人的私密消息；悄悄话。

definitions.definition: (archaic outside of idioms) To count, reckon, or enumerate.
definitions.example: All told, there were over a dozen.  Can you tell time on a clock?  He had untold wealth.
definitions.definitionCn: （除习语外已古旧）计算、估算或列举。
definitions.exampleCn: 总共算来有十多个。 你会看钟表时间吗？ 他拥有数不尽的财富。

definitions.definition: To narrate.
definitions.example: I want to tell a story;  I want to tell you a story.
definitions.definitionCn: 叙述。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想讲个故事； 我想给你讲个故事。

definitions.definition: To convey by speech; to say.
definitions.example: Finally, someone told him the truth.  He seems to like to tell lies.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过言语传达；说。
definitions.exampleCn: 终于有人告诉了他真相。 他似乎喜欢说谎。

definitions.definition: To instruct or inform.
definitions.example: Please tell me how to do it.
definitions.definitionCn: 指导或告知。
definitions.exampleCn: 请告诉我该怎么做。

definitions.definition: To order; to direct, to say to someone.
definitions.example: Tell him to go away.
definitions.definitionCn: 命令；指示，对某人说。
definitions.exampleCn: 叫他走开。

definitions.definition: To discern, notice, identify or distinguish.
definitions.example: Can you tell whether those flowers are real or silk, from this distance?  No, there's no way to tell.
definitions.definitionCn: 辨别、注意、识别或区分。
definitions.exampleCn: 你能从这么远看出那些花是真花还是丝绸做的吗？ 不，没法分辨。

definitions.definition: To reveal.
definitions.example: Time will tell what became of him.
definitions.definitionCn: 揭示。
definitions.exampleCn: 时间会揭示他的结局。

definitions.definition: To be revealed.
definitions.definitionCn: 被揭示。

definitions.definition: To have an effect, especially a noticeable one; to be apparent, to be demonstrated.
definitions.example: Sir Gerald was moving slower; his wounds were beginning to tell.
definitions.definitionCn: 产生影响，尤其是明显的影响；显现出来，得到证明。
definitions.exampleCn: 杰拉德爵士行动变慢了；他的伤口开始显现影响。

definitions.definition: To use (beads or similar objects) as an aid to prayer.
definitions.definitionCn: 使用（珠子或类似物品）作为祈祷的辅助工具。

definitions.definition: To inform someone in authority about a wrongdoing.
definitions.example: I saw you steal those sweets! I'm going to tell!
definitions.definitionCn: 向权威人士告发不当行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 我看见你偷了那些糖果！我要去告发！

definitions.definition: (authorship) To reveal information in prose through outright expository statement -- contrasted with show
definitions.example: Maria rewrote the section of her novel that talked about Meg and Sage's friendship to have less telling and more showing.
definitions.definitionCn: （写作中）通过直白的说明性陈述来揭示信息——与“展示”相对。
definitions.exampleCn: 玛丽亚重写了小说中关于梅格和塞奇友谊的部分，减少了讲述，增加了展示。

definitions.definition: A hill or mound, originally and especially in the Middle East, over or consisting of the ruins of ancient settlements.
definitions.definitionCn: 一座小山或土丘，最初且尤其在中东地区，覆盖或由古代定居点的废墟构成。

definitions.definition: Objects that are connected to or remind their owner of past events.
definitions.example: George has a collection of World War II memorabilia.
definitions.definitionCn: 与过去事件相关或能唤起主人回忆的物品。
definitions.exampleCn: 乔治收藏了一批二战纪念品。

definitions.definition: Things worth remembering: noteworthy points.
definitions.definitionCn: 值得铭记之事：值得注意的要点。

definitions.definition: To give by sentence or judicial determination; to assign or apportion, after careful regard to the nature of the case; to adjudge
definitions.example: the arbitrators awarded damages to the complainant
definitions.definitionCn: 通过判决或司法裁定给予；在仔细考虑案件性质后分配或分派；判决
definitions.exampleCn: 仲裁员裁定赔偿申诉人损失

definitions.definition: To determine; to make or grant an award.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定；作出或授予裁决

definitions.definition: To give (an award).
definitions.example: Four or five of these medals are awarded every year.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予（奖项）
definitions.exampleCn: 每年颁发四五枚这样的奖章

definitions.definition: To give (a person) an award.
definitions.example: He was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature.
definitions.definitionCn: 授予（某人）奖项
definitions.exampleCn: 他被授予诺贝尔文学奖。

definitions.definition: A statement, especially one given under oath; testimony
definitions.definitionCn: 证词，尤指宣誓后所作之陈述；证言

definitions.definition: A written recommendation of someone's worth or character
definitions.definitionCn: 对某人价值或品格的书面推荐

definitions.definition: A tribute given in appreciation of someone's service etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 为感谢某人服务等而给予的致敬

definitions.definition: A match played in tribute to a particular player (who sometimes receives a proportion of the gate money).
definitions.definitionCn: 为向某位特定球员致敬而进行的比赛（该球员有时可获得部分门票收入）

definitions.definition: To change place.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变位置。

definitions.definition: To change in state or status
definitions.definitionCn: 改变状态或地位。

definitions.definition: To move through time.
definitions.definitionCn: 随时间推移。

definitions.definition: To be accepted.
definitions.definitionCn: 被接受。

definitions.definition: In any game, to decline to play in one's turn.
definitions.definitionCn: 在任何游戏中，轮到某人时放弃出牌。

definitions.definition: To do or be better.
definitions.definitionCn: 做得更好或成为更好。

definitions.definition: To take heed.
definitions.definitionCn: 注意。

definitions.definition: Death, dying; the end of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 死亡，临终；某事的终结。

definitions.definition: The fact of going past; a movement from one place to another or a change from one state to another.
definitions.definitionCn: 经过的事实；从一个地方到另一个地方的移动或从一种状态到另一种状态的变化。

definitions.definition: The act of approving a bill etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 批准法案等的行为。

definitions.definition: The act of passing a ball etc. to another player.
definitions.definitionCn: 将球等传给另一名球员的行为。

definitions.definition: A form of juggling where several people pass props between each other, usually clubs or rings.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种杂耍形式，多人之间传递道具，通常是棍棒或环。

definitions.definition: The ability of a person to be regarded as a member of an identity group or category different from their own.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个人被视为属于与自己不同的身份群体或类别的能力。

definitions.definition: That passes away; ephemeral.
definitions.definitionCn: 转瞬即逝的；短暂的。

definitions.definition: Pre-eminent, excellent, extreme.
definitions.definitionCn: 卓越的，优秀的，极端的。

definitions.definition: Vague, cursory.
definitions.definitionCn: 模糊的，粗略的。

definitions.definition: Going past.
definitions.example: passing cars
definitions.definitionCn: 经过的。
definitions.exampleCn: 过往的车辆。

definitions.definition: Surpassingly, greatly.
definitions.definitionCn: 极其，非常。

definitions.definition: An opportunity to test something out; a test.
definitions.example: They will perform the trials for the new equipment next week.
definitions.definitionCn: 测试某事物的机会；一次测试。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们下周将对新设备进行试验。

definitions.definition: Appearance at judicial court in order to be examined.
definitions.definitionCn: 在法庭上出庭接受审查。

definitions.definition: A difficult or annoying experience.
definitions.example: That boy was a trial to his parents.
definitions.definitionCn: 一段困难或令人烦恼的经历。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个男孩是他父母的一个麻烦。

definitions.definition: A tryout to pick members of a team.
definitions.example: soccer trials
definitions.definitionCn: 选拔队员的选拔赛。
definitions.exampleCn: 足球选拔赛。

definitions.definition: A piece of ware used to test the heat of a kiln.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于测试窑炉温度的一件器皿。

definitions.definition: An internal examination set by Eton College.
definitions.definitionCn: 伊顿公学设置的一次内部考试。

definitions.definition: To carry out a series of tests on (a new product, procedure etc.) before marketing or implementing it.
definitions.example: The warning system was extensively trialed before being fitted to all our vehicles.
definitions.definitionCn: 在营销或实施前对（新产品、程序等）进行一系列测试。
definitions.exampleCn: 该预警系统在安装到我们所有车辆之前经过了广泛试用。

definitions.definition: To try out (a new player) in a sports team.
definitions.example: The team trialled a new young goalkeeper in Saturday's match, with mixed results.
definitions.definitionCn: 在运动队中试用（新队员）。
definitions.exampleCn: 球队在周六的比赛中试用了一名新的年轻守门员，结果喜忧参半。

definitions.definition: To display for others to see, especially in regard to wearing clothing while performing the role of a fashion model
definitions.example: She modelled the shoes for her friends to see.
definitions.definitionCn: 展示给别人看，尤指穿着服装扮演时装模特角色
definitions.exampleCn: 她试穿鞋子给朋友们看。

definitions.definition: To use as an object in the creation of a forecast or model
definitions.example: They modelled the data with a computer to analyze the experiment’s results.
definitions.definitionCn: 用作创建预测或模型的对象
definitions.exampleCn: 他们用计算机对数据建模以分析实验结果。

definitions.definition: To make a miniature model of
definitions.example: He takes great pride in his skill at modeling airplanes.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作微缩模型
definitions.exampleCn: 他对自己制作飞机模型的技艺深感自豪。

definitions.definition: To create from a substance such as clay
definitions.example: The sculptor modelled the clay into the form of a dolphin.
definitions.definitionCn: 用黏土等材料塑造
definitions.exampleCn: 雕塑家用黏土塑造出海豚的形状。

definitions.definition: To make a model or models
definitions.definitionCn: 制作模型或模型作品

definitions.definition: To be a model of any kind
definitions.example: The actress used to model before being discovered by Hollywood.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为任何类型的模特
definitions.exampleCn: 这位女演员在被好莱坞发掘前曾当过模特。

definitions.definition: The art of sculpting models from clay etc. to create a representation of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 用黏土等材料塑造模型以表现某物的艺术。

definitions.definition: The representation of depth in a two-dimensional image.
definitions.definitionCn: 二维图像中深度的表现。

definitions.definition: The profession of someone who models clothes.
definitions.definitionCn: 服装模特这一职业。

definitions.definition: The construction and use of a computer model of a physical system.
definitions.definitionCn: 物理系统计算机模型的构建与使用。

definitions.definition: The learning of a new skill by copying other people.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过模仿他人学习新技能。

definitions.definition: To commit (official papers) to some office.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（官方文件）提交至某办公室。

definitions.definition: To place in an archive in a logical place and order
definitions.definitionCn: 以逻辑顺序和位置归档存放。

definitions.definition: To store a file (aggregation of data) on a storage medium such as a disc or another computer.
definitions.definitionCn: 将文件（数据集合）存储于磁盘或另一台计算机等存储介质上。

definitions.definition: (with for) To submit a formal request to some office.
definitions.example: She filed for divorce the next day.
definitions.definitionCn: （与for连用）向某办公室提交正式请求。
definitions.exampleCn: 她第二天就提交了离婚申请。

definitions.definition: To set in order; to arrange, or lay away.
definitions.definitionCn: 整理有序；排列或收存。

definitions.definition: To move in a file.
definitions.example: The applicants kept filing into the room until it was full.
definitions.definitionCn: 排成纵队行进。
definitions.exampleCn: 申请者不断鱼贯而入，直到房间满员。

definitions.definition: To smooth, grind, or cut with a file.
definitions.example: I'd better file the bottoms of the table legs. Otherwise they will scratch the flooring.
definitions.definitionCn: 用锉刀打磨、研磨或切割。
definitions.exampleCn: 我最好把桌腿底部锉平，否则它们会刮伤地板。

definitions.definition: To defile
definitions.definitionCn: 玷污

definitions.definition: To corrupt
definitions.definitionCn: 腐蚀

definitions.definition: Any particle that has been removed by a file or similar implement; a shaving.
definitions.example: The process left metal filings all over the bench and the part.
definitions.definitionCn: 被锉刀或类似工具去除的任何颗粒；碎屑。
definitions.exampleCn: 加工过程让金属屑散落在工作台和零件上。

definitions.definition: The act of storing documents in an archive; archiving.
definitions.definitionCn: 将文件存入档案的行为；归档。

definitions.definition: Something that has been officially filed; a document on file.
definitions.definitionCn: 已正式提交的材料；存档文件。

definitions.definition: Someone who has control over something or someone.
definitions.definitionCn: 对某事或某人有控制权的人。

definitions.definition: The owner of an animal or slave.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物或奴隶的主人。

definitions.definition: The captain of a merchant ship; a master mariner.
definitions.definitionCn: 商船的船长；资深海员。

definitions.definition: The head of a household.
definitions.definitionCn: 一家之主。

definitions.definition: Someone who employs others.
definitions.definitionCn: 雇佣他人的人。

definitions.definition: An expert at something.
definitions.example: Mark Twain was a master of fiction.
definitions.definitionCn: 某方面的专家。
definitions.exampleCn: 马克·吐温是小说大师。

definitions.definition: A tradesman who is qualified to teach apprentices.
definitions.definitionCn: 有资格教授学徒的工匠。

definitions.definition: A schoolmaster.
definitions.definitionCn: 校长。

definitions.definition: A skilled artist.
definitions.definitionCn: 技艺精湛的艺术家。

definitions.definition: A man or a boy; mister. See Master.
definitions.definitionCn: 男人或男孩；先生。参见Master。

definitions.definition: A master's degree; a type of postgraduate degree, usually undertaken after a bachelor degree.
definitions.example: She has a master in psychology.
definitions.definitionCn: 硕士学位；一种研究生学位，通常在学士学位后攻读。
definitions.exampleCn: 她拥有心理学硕士学位。

definitions.definition: A person holding such a degree.
definitions.example: He is a master of marine biology.
definitions.definitionCn: 持有该学位的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是海洋生物学硕士。

definitions.definition: The original of a document or of a recording.
definitions.example: The band couldn't find the master, so they re-recorded their tracks.
definitions.definitionCn: 文件或录音的原版。
definitions.exampleCn: 乐队找不到原版母带，于是重新录制了他们的曲目。

definitions.definition: The primary wide shot of a scene, into which the closeups will be edited later.
definitions.definitionCn: 场景的主广角镜头，特写镜头稍后将剪辑进去。

definitions.definition: A parajudicial officer (such as a referee, an auditor, an examiner, or an assessor) specially appointed to help a court with its proceedings.
definitions.example: The case was tried by a master, who concluded that the plaintiffs were the equitable owners of the property. [...]
definitions.definitionCn: 特别任命协助法院诉讼的准司法官员（如仲裁员、审计员、审查员或评估员）。
definitions.exampleCn: 该案由一名主事官审理，他裁定原告是财产的衡平法所有者。[……]

definitions.definition: A device that is controlling other devices or is an authoritative source.
definitions.example: a master database
definitions.definitionCn: 控制其他设备或作为权威来源的设备。
definitions.exampleCn: 主数据库。

definitions.definition: A person holding an office of authority, especially the presiding officer.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任权威职务的人，尤其是主持官员。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A person holding a similar office in other civic societies.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）在其他民间社团中担任类似职务的人。

definitions.definition: To be a master.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为大师。

definitions.definition: To become the master of; to subject to one's will, control, or authority; to conquer; to overpower; to subdue.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为……的主人；使服从于自己的意志、控制或权威；征服；压倒；制服。

definitions.definition: To learn to a high degree of proficiency.
definitions.example: It took her years to master the art of needlecraft.
definitions.definitionCn: 学习到高度熟练的程度。
definitions.exampleCn: 她花了多年时间掌握了针线技艺。

definitions.definition: To own; to possess.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有；占有。

definitions.definition: (especially of a musical performance) To make a master copy of.
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指音乐表演）制作母版。

definitions.definition: (usually with in) To earn a Master's degree.
definitions.example: He mastered in English at the state college.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与in连用）获得硕士学位。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在州立大学获得了英语硕士学位。

definitions.definition: (in combination) A vessel having a specified number of masts.
definitions.example: a two-master
definitions.definitionCn: （用于组合词）有特定数量桅杆的船只。
definitions.exampleCn: 双桅船。

definitions.definition: A master's degree.
definitions.definitionCn: 硕士学位。

definitions.definition: To communicate, usually by means of speech.
definitions.example: Although I don't speak Chinese I managed to talk with the villagers using signs and gestures.
definitions.definitionCn: 交流，通常通过言语进行。
definitions.exampleCn: 虽然我不会说中文，但我用手势和符号设法与村民交谈。

definitions.definition: To discuss; to talk about.
definitions.example: That's enough about work, let's talk holidays!
definitions.definitionCn: 讨论；谈论。
definitions.exampleCn: 工作的事就到此为止，咱们聊聊假期吧！

definitions.definition: To speak (a certain language).
definitions.example: We talk French sometimes.
definitions.definitionCn: 说（某种语言）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们有时说法语。

definitions.definition: (chiefly used in progressive tenses) Used to emphasise the importance, size, complexity etc. of the thing mentioned.
definitions.example: Are you interested in the job? They're talking big money.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于进行时）用于强调所提及事物的重要性、规模、复杂性等。
definitions.exampleCn: 你对这份工作感兴趣吗？他们说的可是大钱。

definitions.definition: To confess, especially implicating others.
definitions.example: She can be relied upon not to talk.
definitions.definitionCn: 坦白，尤其指牵连他人。
definitions.exampleCn: 可以信赖她不会泄密。

definitions.definition: To criticize someone for something of which one is guilty oneself.
definitions.example: I am not the one to talk.
definitions.definitionCn: 自己犯错却指责他人。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不是那种说风凉话的人。

definitions.definition: To gossip; to create scandal.
definitions.example: Aren't you afraid the neighbours will talk?
definitions.definitionCn: 散布流言；制造丑闻。
definitions.exampleCn: 你不怕邻居说闲话吗？

definitions.definition: (chiefly used in progressive tenses) To influence someone to express something, especially a particular stance or viewpoint or in a particular manner.
definitions.example: That's not like you at all, Jared. The drugs are talking. Snap out of it!
definitions.definitionCn: （主要用于进行时）影响某人表达某事，尤指特定立场、观点或方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 贾里德，这完全不像你。是毒品在作祟。清醒点！

definitions.definition: A conversation or discussion; usually serious, but informal.
definitions.example: We need to have a talk about your homework.
definitions.definitionCn: 对话或讨论；通常严肃但非正式。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们需要谈谈你的作业。

definitions.definition: A lecture.
definitions.example: There is a talk on Shakespeare tonight.
definitions.definitionCn: 讲座。
definitions.exampleCn: 今晚有一场关于莎士比亚的讲座。

definitions.definition: Gossip; rumour.
definitions.example: There's been talk lately about the two of them.
definitions.definitionCn: 流言；传闻。
definitions.exampleCn: 最近有关于他俩的传言。

definitions.definition: (preceded by the; often qualified by a following of) A major topic of social discussion.
definitions.example: She is the talk of the day.
definitions.definitionCn: （前面加the；常后接of限定）社会讨论的主要话题。
definitions.exampleCn: 她是当下的话题人物。

definitions.definition: (preceded by the) A customary conversation by parent(s) or guardian(s) with their (often teenaged) child about a reality of life; in particular:
definitions.definitionCn: （前面加the）父母或监护人与（通常为青少年的）孩子就生活现实进行的惯常对话；特指：

definitions.definition: (not preceded by an article) Empty boasting, promises or claims.
definitions.example: The party leader's speech was all talk.
definitions.definitionCn: （前面不加冠词）空谈、空头承诺或吹嘘。
definitions.exampleCn: 党领袖的演讲全是空话。

definitions.definition: (usually plural) Meeting to discuss a particular matter.
definitions.example: The leaders of the G8 nations are currently in talks over nuclear weapons.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用复数）就特定事项举行的会议。
definitions.exampleCn: 八国集团领导人目前正就核武器问题进行会谈。

definitions.definition: The act or process of explaining.
definitions.example: The explanation was long and drawn-out.
definitions.definitionCn: 解释的行为或过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个解释冗长而拖沓。

definitions.definition: Something that explains, makes understandable.
definitions.example: An explanation for the UFO sightings was easily found.
definitions.definitionCn: 能解释清楚、让人理解的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 关于UFO目击事件的解释很容易找到。

definitions.definition: A resolution of disputed points pursuant to discussion; a mutual clarification of disputed points; reconciliation.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过讨论解决争议点；对争议点的相互澄清；和解。

definitions.definition: The act of arriving or something that has arrived.
definitions.example: The early arrival of the bride created a stir.
definitions.definitionCn: 到达的行为或已到达的事物。
definitions.exampleCn: 新娘的提前到达引起了轰动。

definitions.definition: The attainment of an objective, especially as a result of effort.
definitions.example: The arrival of the railway made the local tourist industry viable.
definitions.definitionCn: 目标的达成，尤指通过努力实现的结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 铁路的建成使当地旅游业得以发展。

definitions.definition: A person who has arrived.
definitions.example: There has been a significant growth in illegal arrivals.
definitions.definitionCn: 到达的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 非法入境者数量显著增长。

definitions.definition: To allow (something) to happen, to give permission for.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许（某事）发生，给予许可。

definitions.definition: To allow (someone) to do something; to give permission to.
definitions.definitionCn: 允许（某人）做某事；给予许可。

definitions.definition: To allow for, to make something possible.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……留出余地，使某事成为可能。

definitions.definition: To allow, to admit (of).
definitions.definitionCn: 允许，容许（有）。

definitions.definition: (pronounced like noun) To grant formal authorization for (something).
definitions.example: The Building Department permitted that project last week.
definitions.definitionCn: （发音类似名词）正式授权（某事）。
definitions.exampleCn: 建筑部门上周批准了那个项目。

definitions.definition: (pronounced like noun) To attempt to obtain or succeed in obtaining formal authorization for (something).
definitions.example: We've been busy permitting the State Street development.
definitions.definitionCn: （发音类似名词）试图获得或成功获得（某事的）正式授权。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们一直忙于为州街开发项目申请许可。

definitions.definition: To hand over, resign (something to someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）移交、让与（某人）。

definitions.definition: A defined part of a section.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个章节中定义的部分。

definitions.definition: A subpart of a legal document such as law.
definitions.definitionCn: 法律文件（如法律）的子部分。

definitions.definition: (taxonomy, zoology) An informal taxonomic category below section and above family.
definitions.definitionCn: （分类学，动物学）位于节之下、科之上的非正式分类类别。

definitions.definition: (taxonomy, botany) A taxonomic rank below the section, but above the species.
definitions.definitionCn: （分类学，植物学）位于节之下、种之上的分类等级。

definitions.definition: To insert subsections (into some text, etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 将子节插入（某些文本等）中。

definitions.definition: The package consisting of the bullet, primer, and casing containing gunpowder; a round of ammunition.
definitions.definitionCn: 由弹头、底火和装有火药的弹壳组成的组件；一发弹药。

definitions.definition: (by extension) A prefabricated subassembly that can be easily installed in or removed from a larger mechanism or replaced with another interchangeable subassembly.
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）一种预制的子组件，可轻松安装到较大机构中或从中拆卸，也可替换为其他可互换的子组件。

definitions.definition: A vessel which contains the ink or toner for a computer printer and can be easily replaced with another.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于计算机打印机的墨水或碳粉容器，可轻松更换为另一个。

definitions.definition: Magnetic tape storage, used for storing (backup) copies of data.
definitions.definitionCn: 磁带存储设备，用于存储（备份）数据副本。

definitions.definition: A removable enclosure containing read-only memory devices, used for rapid loading of software onto a home computer or video game console.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种装有只读存储器设备的可拆卸外壳，用于将软件快速加载到家用计算机或视频游戏机上。

definitions.definition: A small paper package, e.g. in an old book about making printer's type: After all the type has been cast: "The Boy will paper up each sort in a cartridge by itself".
definitions.definitionCn: 一种小型纸包装，例如在一本关于制作印刷字模的旧书中所述：所有字模铸好后，“男孩会将每种字模单独用纸包成一个小包”。

definitions.definition: Mutual good, shared by more than one.
definitions.definitionCn: 共同利益，为多人所共享。

definitions.definition: A tract of land in common ownership; common land.
definitions.definitionCn: 一块共同拥有的土地；公地。

definitions.definition: The people; the community.
definitions.definitionCn: 民众；社区。

definitions.definition: The right of taking a profit in the land of another, in common either with the owner or with other persons; so called from the community of interest which arises between the claimant of the right and the owner of the soil, or between the claimants and other commoners entitled to the same right.
definitions.definitionCn: 在他人土地上获取收益的权利，与土地所有者或其他人员共同享有；因权利主张者与土地所有者之间，或权利主张者与其他享有相同权利的共有者之间产生的共同利益而得名。

definitions.definition: To communicate (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 交流（某事）。

definitions.definition: To converse, talk.
definitions.definitionCn: 交谈，谈话。

definitions.definition: To have sex.
definitions.definitionCn: 发生性关系。

definitions.definition: To participate.
definitions.definitionCn: 参与。

definitions.definition: To have a joint right with others in common ground.
definitions.definitionCn: 与他人共同享有对公共土地的联合权利。

definitions.definition: To board together; to eat at a table in common.
definitions.definitionCn: 共同用餐；在同一张桌子上吃饭。

definitions.definition: A dining hall, usually at a college or university.
definitions.definitionCn: 餐厅，通常指大学或学院的食堂。

definitions.definition: A central section of (usually an older) town, designated as a shared area, a common.
definitions.example: The Renaissance festival started with the "peasants" meeting in the commons.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常指较老）城镇的中心区域，被指定为共享区域，即公共用地。
definitions.exampleCn: 文艺复兴节始于“农民”在公共用地的集会。

definitions.definition: The mutual good of all; the abstract concept of resources shared by more than one, for example air, water, information.
definitions.example: "The tragedy of the commons" is that none wish to make sacrifices of their or their family's interests for the common good.
definitions.definitionCn: 所有人的共同利益；由多人共享资源的抽象概念，例如空气、水、信息。
definitions.exampleCn: “公地悲剧”在于无人愿意为公共利益牺牲自己或家庭的利益。

definitions.definition: An outhouse.
definitions.definitionCn: 户外厕所。

definitions.definition: (Oxford University) Food served at a fixed rate from the college buttery, distinguished from battels.
definitions.definitionCn: （牛津大学）以固定价格从学院食品储藏室提供的食物，与“battels”区分。

definitions.definition: Food in general; rations.
definitions.definitionCn: 泛指食物；口粮。

definitions.definition: Evidence of a long-term debt, by which the bond issuer (the borrower) is obliged to pay interest when due, and repay the principal at maturity, as specified on the face of the bond certificate. The rights of the holder are specified in the bond indenture, which contains the legal terms and conditions under which the bond was issued. Bonds are available in two forms: registered bonds, and bearer bonds.
definitions.definitionCn: 长期债务凭证，债券发行人（借款人）有义务在到期时支付利息，并在到期日偿还本金，具体条款载明于债券票面。持有人权利由债券契约规定，其中包含债券发行的法律条款与条件。债券有两种形式：记名债券和不记名债券。

definitions.definition: A documentary obligation to pay a sum or to perform a contract; a debenture.
definitions.example: Investors face a quandary. Cash offers a return of virtually zero in many developed countries; government-bond yields may have risen in recent weeks but they are still unattractive. Equities have suffered two big bear markets since 2000 and are wobbling again. It is hardly surprising that pension funds, insurers and endowments are searching for new sources of return.
definitions.definitionCn: 支付款项或履行合同的书面义务；公司债券。
definitions.exampleCn: 投资者面临两难困境。在许多发达国家，现金回报率几乎为零；政府债券收益率虽在近几周有所上升，但仍缺乏吸引力。自2000年以来，股票已遭遇两次大熊市，目前再次动荡不安。养老基金、保险公司和捐赠基金正在寻找新的收益来源，这并不令人意外。

definitions.definition: A partial payment made to show a provider that the customer is sincere about buying a product or a service. If the product or service is not purchased the customer then forfeits the bond.
definitions.definitionCn: 向供应商支付的预付款，表明客户购买产品或服务的诚意。若未购买该产品或服务，客户将丧失此保证金。

definitions.definition: (often in the plural) A physical connection which binds, a band.

definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）物理连接物，带子。
definitions.exampleCn: 囚犯被铁链捆绑着带到法庭。

definitions.definition: An emotional link, connection or union; that which holds two or more people together, as in a friendship; a tie.

definitions.definitionCn: 情感纽带、联系或结合；将两人或多人维系在一起的关系，如友谊；羁绊。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们从小就是朋友和邻居，即使政治观点截然不同，也无法打破他们之间的友谊纽带。

definitions.definition: Moral or political duty or obligation.
definitions.definitionCn: 道德或政治责任与义务。

definitions.definition: A link or force between neighbouring atoms in a molecule.

definitions.definitionCn: 分子中相邻原子之间的连接或作用力。
definitions.exampleCn: 有机化学主要研究碳键的各种变化形式。

definitions.definitionCn: 具有约束力的协议，盟约。

definitions.definition: A bail bond.

definitions.definitionCn: 保释金。
definitions.exampleCn: 保释金一经缴纳，法警立即释放了囚犯。

definitions.definition: Any constraining or cementing force or material.

definitions.definitionCn: 任何约束或粘合的力量或材料。

definitions.definition: In building, a specific pattern of bricklaying.
definitions.definitionCn: 建筑中特定的砌砖图案。

definitions.definition: In Scotland, a mortgage.

definitions.definitionCn: 连接电气化铁路相邻铁轨的重型铜线或铜棒，用作电路的一部分。

definitions.definition: To connect, secure or tie with a bond; to bind.

definitions.definition: To lay bricks in a specific pattern.

definitions.definition: To express a wish for; to entreat; to request.

definitions.definition: To require; to demand; to claim.
definitions.definitionCn: 需要；要求；主张。

definitions.definition: To miss; to regret.
definitions.definitionCn: 思念；遗憾。

definitions.definition: Wished-for, longed-for
definitions.definitionCn: 被渴望的，被期盼的。

definitions.definition: To authenticate by means of belief; to surmise; to suppose to be true, especially without proof
definitions.example: We assume that, as her parents were dentists, she knows quite a bit about dentistry.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过信念来确认；推测；假定为真，尤指无证据时
definitions.exampleCn: 我们假设，由于她的父母是牙医，她对牙科相当了解。

definitions.definition: To take on a position, duty or form
definitions.example: Mr. Jones will assume the position of a lifeguard until a proper replacement is found.
definitions.definitionCn: 承担职位、职责或形式
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯先生将担任救生员一职，直到找到合适的替代者。

definitions.definition: To adopt a feigned quality or manner; to claim without right; to arrogate
definitions.example: He assumed an air of indifference
definitions.definitionCn: 采取虚假的品质或态度；无权声称；僭取
definitions.exampleCn: 他摆出一副漠不关心的样子

definitions.definition: To receive, adopt (a person)
definitions.definitionCn: 接纳、收养（某人）

definitions.definition: To adopt (an idea or cause)
definitions.definitionCn: 采纳（某个想法或事业）

definitions.definition: Closed, shut.
definitions.definitionCn: 关闭，紧闭。

definitions.definition: Narrow; confined.
definitions.example: a close alley; close quarters
definitions.definitionCn: 狭窄的；受限的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一条狭窄的小巷；拥挤的住处

definitions.definition: At a little distance; near.
definitions.example: Is your house close?
definitions.definitionCn: 在短距离内；附近。
definitions.exampleCn: 你家近吗？

definitions.definition: Intimate; well-loved.
definitions.example: He is a close friend.
definitions.definitionCn: 亲密的；深受喜爱的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是一位亲密的朋友。

definitions.definition: Oppressive; without motion or ventilation; causing a feeling of lassitude.
definitions.definitionCn: 闷热的；不通风的；令人感到倦怠的。

definitions.definition: (Ireland, England, Scotland) Hot, humid, with no wind.
definitions.definitionCn: （爱尔兰、英格兰、苏格兰）湿热无风的。

definitions.definition: (of a vowel) Articulated with the tongue body relatively close to the hard palate.
definitions.definitionCn: （指元音）发音时舌体相对靠近硬腭。

definitions.definition: Strictly confined; carefully guarded.
definitions.example: a close prisoner
definitions.definitionCn: 严格限制的；严密看守的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一名严密看管的囚犯

definitions.definition: Out of the way of observation; secluded; secret; hidden.
definitions.definitionCn: 避开观察的；隐蔽的；秘密的；隐藏的。

definitions.definition: Nearly equal; almost evenly balanced.
definitions.example: a close contest
definitions.definitionCn: 几乎相等的；几乎势均力敌的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一场势均力敌的比赛

definitions.definition: Short.
definitions.example: to cut grass or hair close
definitions.definitionCn: 短的。
definitions.exampleCn: 把草或头发剪短

definitions.definition: Dense; solid; compact.
definitions.definitionCn: 密集的；坚实的；紧凑的。

definitions.definition: Concise; to the point.
definitions.example: close reasoning
definitions.definitionCn: 简洁的；切中要害的。
definitions.exampleCn: 严密的推理

definitions.definition: Difficult to obtain.
definitions.example: Money is close.
definitions.definitionCn: 难以获得的。
definitions.exampleCn: 钱很难弄到。

definitions.definition: Parsimonious; stingy.
definitions.definitionCn: 吝啬的；小气的。

definitions.definition: Adhering strictly to a standard or original; exact.
definitions.example: a close translation
definitions.definitionCn: 严格遵循标准或原版的；精确的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一份精确的翻译

definitions.definition: Accurate; careful; precise; also, attentive; undeviating; strict.
definitions.example: The patient was kept under close observation.
definitions.definitionCn: 准确的；仔细的；精确的；同时，专注的；不偏离的；严格的。
definitions.exampleCn: 病人被置于严密观察之下。

definitions.definition: Marked, evident.
definitions.definitionCn: 明显的，显而易见的。

definitions.definition: Someone or something that closes.
definitions.example: In our organization, the VP of Sales usually acts as the closer.

definitions.definition: Someone or something that concludes.
definitions.example: The DJ chose a fantastic track as his closer at the end of the night.

definitions.definition: The last stone in a horizontal course, if smaller than the others; a piece of brick finishing a course.
A relief pitcher who specializes in getting the last three outs of the game. See Wikipedia:closer (baseball)
definitions.example: They brought their closer in for the ninth.

definitions.definition: To transport oneself by sitting on and directing a horse, later also a bicycle etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑乘马匹或自行车等交通工具出行。

definitions.definition: To be transported in a vehicle; to travel as a passenger.
definitions.definitionCn: 乘坐车辆；作为乘客出行。

definitions.definition: (chiefly US and South Africa) To transport (someone) in a vehicle.
definitions.example: The cab rode him downtown.
definitions.definitionCn: （主要在美国和南非）用车载送（某人）。
definitions.exampleCn: 出租车载他去市中心。

definitions.definition: Of a ship: to sail, to float on the water.
definitions.definitionCn: （指船只）航行，漂浮在水面上。

definitions.definition: To be carried or supported by something lightly and quickly; to travel in such a way, as though on horseback.
definitions.example: The witch cackled and rode away on her broomstick.
definitions.definitionCn: 被某物轻快托起或支撑着移动；像骑马一样行进。
definitions.exampleCn: 女巫咯咯笑着，骑上扫帚飞走了。

definitions.definition: To traverse by riding.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑马穿越某地。

definitions.definition: To convey, as by riding; to make or do by riding.
definitions.example: How many races have you ridden this year?
definitions.definitionCn: 通过骑行完成或进行某事。
definitions.exampleCn: 今年你参加了多少场比赛？

definitions.definition: To support a rider, as a horse; to move under the saddle.
definitions.example: A horse rides easy or hard, slow or fast.
definitions.definitionCn: （指马）承载骑手；在马鞍下移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 马骑起来或轻松或费力，或慢或快。

definitions.definition: To mount (someone) to have sex with them; to have sexual intercourse with.
definitions.definitionCn: 与（某人）发生性关系；进行性交。

definitions.definition: To nag or criticize; to annoy (someone).
definitions.definitionCn: 唠叨或批评；惹恼（某人）。

definitions.definition: Of clothing: to gradually move (up) and crease; to ruckle.
definitions.definitionCn: （指衣物）逐渐上移并起皱；形成褶皱。

definitions.definition: To rely, depend (on).
definitions.definitionCn: 依赖，依靠（于）。

definitions.definition: Of clothing: to rest (in a given way on a part of the body).
definitions.definitionCn: （指衣物）以特定方式贴合身体某部位。

definitions.definition: To play defense on the defensemen or midfielders, as an attackman.
definitions.definitionCn: （长曲棍球中）作为攻击手防守后卫或中场球员。

definitions.definition: To manage insolently at will; to domineer over.
definitions.definitionCn: 傲慢地随意支配；专横对待。

definitions.definition: To overlap (each other); said of bones or fractured fragments.
definitions.definitionCn: （指骨骼或骨折碎片）相互重叠。

definitions.definition: To monitor (some component of an audiovisual signal) in order to keep it within acceptable bounds.
definitions.definitionCn: 监控（音视频信号的某组件）以保持其处于可接受范围。

definitions.definition: In jazz, a steady rhythmical style.
definitions.definitionCn: （爵士乐中）稳定的节奏风格。

definitions.definition: A path cut through woodland.
definitions.definitionCn: 林间开辟的小径。

definitions.definition: The act of one who rides; a mounted excursion.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑行行为；骑马短途旅行。

definitions.definition: A festival procession.
definitions.definitionCn: 节日游行队伍。

definitions.definition: Any of the three administrative divisions of Yorkshire and some other northern counties of England.
Electoral district or constituency.
The process where the cells in the body regenerate and repair themselves.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体细胞再生和自我修复的过程。

definitions.definition: An act of healing, as by a faith healer.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过信仰治疗师等方式进行的治愈行为。

definitions.definition: The psychological process of dealing with a problem or problems.
definitions.definitionCn: 处理一个或多个问题的心理过程。

definitions.definition: To make better from a disease, wound, etc.; to revive or cure.
definitions.example: This bandage will heal your cut.

definitions.definition: To become better or healthy again.
definitions.example: Bandages allow cuts to heal.

definitions.definition: To reconcile, as a breach or difference; to make whole; to free from guilt.
definitions.example: to heal dissensions

definitions.definition: To hide, conceal, and keep secret, especially for a secret society (such as the masons).
(now especially in the phrase "hele in") To cover or conceal (a seedling, plant, roots, etc).

definitions.definitionCn: 父亲，即男性家长。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的父亲始终陪伴在他身边。

definitions.definition: (familiar) Used to address one's father
definitions.example: Happy Father's Day, Dad!
definitions.definitionCn: （亲切称呼）用于称呼自己的父亲
definitions.exampleCn: 父亲节快乐，爸爸！

definitions.definition: Used to address an older adult male
definitions.definitionCn: 用于称呼年长男性

definitions.definition: A lump or piece.
A blow; act of striking something.
To throw against something; to dash.
The act of placing or putting in place; the act of locating or positioning; the state of being placed.
definitions.definitionCn: 放置或安放的行为；定位或确定位置的行为；被放置的状态。

definitions.definition: A location or position.
definitions.example: It seems to me that the placement of that poster could be better.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个地点或位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 在我看来，那张海报的摆放位置可以更好。

definitions.definition: The act of matching a person with a job
definitions.example: The agency does not guarantee placement, but they work on commission.
definitions.definitionCn: 将人与工作匹配的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 该机构不保证安排工作，但他们按佣金收费。

definitions.definition: The act of observing, and the fact of being observed (see observance)
definitions.definitionCn: 观察的行为，以及被观察的事实（参见遵守）

definitions.definition: The act of noting and recording some event; or the record of such noting.
definitions.definitionCn: 记录某些事件的行为；或此类记录的记载。

definitions.definition: A remark or comment.
definitions.definitionCn: 评述或评论。

definitions.definition: A judgement based on observing.
definitions.definitionCn: 基于观察作出的判断。

definitions.definition: Performance of what is prescribed; adherence in practice; observance.
definitions.definitionCn: 对规定事项的履行；实践中的遵守；遵从。

definitions.definition: A regime under which a subject is routinely observed.
definitions.definitionCn: 受试者被定期观察的制度。

definitions.definition: Philosophically as: the phenomenal presence of human being existence.
definitions.definitionCn: 哲学上指：人类存在的现象性呈现。

definitions.definition: An artist’s or photographer’s workshop or the room in which an artist works.
definitions.example: His studio was cramped when he began as an artist.
definitions.definitionCn: 艺术家或摄影师的工作室，或艺术家工作的房间。
definitions.exampleCn: 他刚开始从事艺术创作时，工作室非常狭小。

definitions.definition: An establishment where an art is taught.
definitions.example: As he gained a reputation, he took larger space and took students into his studio,
definitions.definitionCn: 教授艺术的场所。
definitions.exampleCn: 随着名声渐长，他租用了更大的空间，并招收学生进入他的工作室。

definitions.definition: A place where radio or television programs, records or films are made.
definitions.example: The recording studio had some slight echo, but was good enough to make a demo.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作广播、电视节目、唱片或电影的地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 录音棚有些轻微回声，但足以制作样带。

definitions.definition: A company or organization that makes films, records or other artistic works.
definitions.example: The studios still make films, but they rely on the strength of their distribution.
definitions.definitionCn: 制作电影、唱片或其他艺术作品的机构或公司。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些制片厂仍在制作电影，但依赖其发行实力。

definitions.definition: A studio apartment.
definitions.example: It’s a lovely little studio with almost a river view.
definitions.definitionCn: 单间公寓。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是一间可爱的小单间，几乎能看到河景。

definitions.definition: To go or come into an enclosed or partially enclosed space.

definitions.definitionCn: 进入或进入一个封闭或部分封闭的空间。

definitions.definition: To cause to go (into), or to be received (into); to put in; to insert; to cause to be admitted.

definitions.definition: To go or come into (a state or profession).
definitions.example: My twelve-year-old son will be entering his teens next year.  She had planned to enter the legal profession.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入（某种状态或职业）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我十二岁的儿子明年将进入青春期。  她曾计划进入法律行业。

definitions.definition: To type (something) into a computer; to input.
definitions.example: Enter your user name and password.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某内容）输入电脑；输入。
definitions.exampleCn: 输入你的用户名和密码。

definitions.definition: To record (something) in an account, ledger, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某内容）记录在账户、分类账等中。

definitions.definition: To become a party to an agreement, treaty, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 成为协议、条约等的一方。

definitions.definition: To become effective; to come into effect.
definitions.definitionCn: 生效；开始实施。

definitions.definition: To go into or upon, as lands, and take actual possession of them.
definitions.definitionCn: 进入或踏上（如土地），并实际占有它们。

definitions.definition: To place in regular form before the court, usually in writing; to put upon record in proper from and order.

definitions.definition: To file, or register with the land office, the required particulars concerning (a quantity of public land) in order to entitle a person to a right of preemption.
definitions.definitionCn: 向土地管理局提交并登记关于（一定量公共土地）的必要细节，以赋予某人优先购买权。

definitions.definition: To deposit for copyright the title or description of (a book, picture, map, etc.).

definitions.definitionCn: 为版权登记（书籍、图片、地图等）的标题或描述。
definitions.exampleCn: 根据国会法案登记。

definitions.definition: To initiate; to introduce favourably.
definitions.definitionCn: 启动；有利地引入。

definitions.definition: Action of the verb to enter
definitions.definitionCn: 动词“进入”的动作。

definitions.definition: One who adjusts, especially for the insurance industry's employment title "loss adjuster" (or "claims adjuster" in the United States).
definitions.definitionCn: 调整者，尤指保险业职称"损失理算师"（美国称"理赔员"）。

definitions.definition: A knob or disc that is passed through a loop or (buttonhole), serving as a fastener.

definitions.definitionCn: 穿过环或（纽扣孔）的旋钮或圆盘，用作扣件。

definitions.definitionCn: 用手指按压以闭合或断开电路或启动装置的机械装置。
definitions.exampleCn: 帕特按下搅拌机上标有"碎冰"的按钮。

definitions.definition: An on-screen control that can be selected as an activator of an attached function.

definitions.definitionCn: 可被选作附加功能激活器的屏幕控件。
definitions.exampleCn: 点击形似房屋的按钮返回浏览器主页。

definitions.definition: A badge worn on clothes, fixed with a pin through the fabric.

definitions.definitionCn: 用别针穿过布料固定在衣物上的徽章。

definitions.definition: A bud.

definitions.definition: The head of an unexpanded mushroom.
definitions.definitionCn: 未展开的蘑菇伞盖。

definitions.definition: A methaqualone tablet (used as a recreational drug).

definitions.definition: To fasten with a button.

definitions.definition: To be fastened by a button or buttons.

definitions.definitionCn: 通过纽扣扣合。

definitions.definition: To stop talking.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止说话。

definitions.definition: The dung of sheep.
definitions.definitionCn: 羊粪。

definitions.definition: A remote control.
definitions.definitionCn: 遥控器。

definitions.definition: A boy servant, or page.
