definitions.definitionCn: 一支士兵或警察的分遣队，尤指骑炮兵、装甲部队或州警。

definitions.definition: Soldiers, military forces (usually "troops").
definitions.definitionCn: 士兵、军事力量（通常用"troops"表示）。

definitions.definition: A company of stageplayers; a troupe.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个剧团；戏班。

definitions.definition: A basic unit of girl or boy scouts, consisting of 6 to 10 youngsters.
definitions.definitionCn: 由6至10名青少年组成的童子军基本单位。

definitions.definition: (collective) A group of baboons.
definitions.definitionCn: （集合）一群狒狒。

definitions.definition: A particular roll of the drum; a quick march.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定的鼓点节奏；快速行军。

definitions.definition: Mushrooms that are in a close group but not close enough to be called a cluster.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧密排列但未达到簇生程度的蘑菇群。

definitions.definition: To move in numbers; to come or gather in crowds or troops.
definitions.definitionCn: 成群移动；以人群或队伍形式聚集。

definitions.definition: To march on; to go forward in haste.
definitions.definitionCn: 行进；匆忙前进。

definitions.definition: To move or march as if in a crowd.
definitions.example: The children trooped into the room.
definitions.definitionCn: 如同人群般移动或行进。
definitions.exampleCn: 孩子们成群走进房间。

definitions.definition: To take by the arm; to take up in one's arms.
definitions.definitionCn: 用手臂挽住；用双臂抱起。

definitions.definition: To supply with armour or (later especially) weapons.
definitions.example: The king armed his knights with swords and shields.
definitions.definitionCn: 为某人提供盔甲或（后来尤指）武器。
definitions.exampleCn: 国王用剑和盾武装了他的骑士们。

definitions.definition: To prepare a tool or a weapon for action; to activate.
definitions.example: Remember to arm the alarm system before leaving for work.
definitions.definitionCn: 准备工具或武器以供使用；激活。
definitions.exampleCn: 上班前记得启动警报系统。

definitions.definition: To cover or furnish with a plate, or with whatever will add strength, force, security, or efficiency.
definitions.example: to arm the hit of a sword; to arm a hook in angling
definitions.definitionCn: 用金属板或任何能增加强度、力量、安全性或效率的东西覆盖或装备。
definitions.exampleCn: 给剑柄加装护手；在钓鱼中给鱼钩加装倒刺。

definitions.definition: To furnish with means of defence; to prepare for resistance; to fortify, in a moral sense.
definitions.definitionCn: 提供防御手段；准备抵抗；在道德意义上加强。

definitions.definition: To take up weapons; to arm oneself.
definitions.definitionCn: 拿起武器；武装自己。

definitions.definition: To fit (a magnet) with an armature.
definitions.definitionCn: 为（磁铁）安装电枢。

definitions.definition: (sometimes in combination) Equipped, especially with a weapon.
definitions.example: nuclear-armed
definitions.definitionCn: （有时用于组合词）装备有武器的，尤指携带武器。
definitions.exampleCn: 核武装的

definitions.definition: (of a weapon) Prepared for use; loaded.
definitions.definitionCn: （指武器）准备就绪；已上膛。

definitions.definition: Furnished with whatever serves to add strength, force, or efficiency.
definitions.definitionCn: 配备有能增加强度、力量或效率的装置。

definitions.definition: Having prickles or thorns.
definitions.definitionCn: 长有刺或荆棘的。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in combination) Having an arm or arms, often of a specified number or type.
(of a creature) Possessing arms of a specified number or type.
definitions.example: the four-armed creature.

definitions.definition: (heraldry, of animals) Having horns, claws, teeth, a beak, etc. in a particular tincture, as contrasted with that of the animal as a whole.
To build or alter according to personal preferences or specifications.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据个人喜好或规格建造或改造。

definitions.definition: A person who shops.
definitions.definitionCn: 购物者。

definitions.definition: A free local newspaper containing advertisements for local shops etc; sometimes includes discount coupons.
definitions.definitionCn: 一份免费的地方报纸，包含当地商店等的广告；有时附有折扣券。

definitions.definition: A kind of bicycle suited to riding short distances.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种适合短途骑行的自行车。

definitions.definition: A plastic shopping bag.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个塑料购物袋。

definitions.definition: Edible, sweet-tasting confectionery containing sugar, or sometimes artificial sweeteners, and often flavored with fruit, chocolate, nuts, herbs and spices, or artificial flavors.
definitions.definitionCn: 可食用的甜味糖果，含糖或有时含人工甜味剂，常添加水果、巧克力、坚果、香草香料或人工香料调味。

definitions.definition: A piece of confectionery of this kind.
definitions.definitionCn: 指此类糖果中的一块。

definitions.definition: (slang, chiefly US) crack cocaine.
definitions.definitionCn: （俚语，主要用于美国）可卡因。

definitions.definition: To cook in, or coat with, sugar syrup.
definitions.definitionCn: 用糖浆烹制或裹上糖浆。

definitions.definition: To have sugar crystals form in or on.
definitions.example: Fruits preserved in sugar candy after a time.
definitions.definitionCn: 使内部或表面形成糖晶体。
definitions.exampleCn: 水果经一段时间后保存在冰糖中。

definitions.definition: To be formed into candy; to solidify in a candylike form or mass.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成糖果状；凝固成类似糖果的形态或团块。

definitions.definition: A unit of mass used in southern India, equal to twenty maunds, roughly equal to 500 pounds avoirdupois but varying locally.
(within a machine or machinery) Any mechanical means for the conversion or control of motion, or the transmission or control of power.
definitions.definitionCn: （机器或机械装置内部）用于转换或控制运动，或传输或控制动力的任何机械手段。

definitions.definition: Any combination of cams, gears, links, belts, chains and logical mechanical elements.
definitions.definitionCn: 凸轮、齿轮、连杆、皮带、链条及逻辑机械元件的任意组合。

definitions.definition: A group of entities, such as objects, that interact together.
definitions.example: political machine
definitions.definitionCn: 一组相互作用的实体，例如物体。
definitions.exampleCn: 政治机器。

definitions.definition: A mental, physical or chemical process.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种心理、物理或化学过程。

definitions.definition: Any process of, or system designed to manage useful energy conversion.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何旨在管理有用能量转换的过程或系统。

definitions.definition: The theory that all natural phenomena can be explained by physical causes.
definitions.definitionCn: 所有自然现象均可由物理原因解释的理论。

definitions.definition: A small, usually round or cylindrical object designed for easy swallowing, usually containing some sort of medication.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种小型、通常为圆形或圆柱形的物体，设计用于方便吞咽，通常含有某种药物。

definitions.definition: (definite, i.e. used with "the") Contraceptive medication, usually in the form of a pill to be taken by a woman; an oral contraceptive pill.
definitions.example: Jane went on the pill when she left for college.
definitions.definitionCn: （特指，即与"the"连用）避孕药物，通常以女性服用的药片形式存在；口服避孕药。
definitions.exampleCn: 简上大学时开始服用避孕药。

definitions.definition: A comical or entertaining person.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个滑稽或有趣的人。

definitions.definition: A contemptible, annoying, or unpleasant person.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个可鄙、令人讨厌或令人不快的人。

definitions.definition: A small piece of any substance, for example a ball of fibres formed on the surface of a textile by rubbing.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何物质的小片，例如纺织品表面因摩擦形成的纤维球。

definitions.definition: A baseball.
definitions.definitionCn: 棒球。

definitions.definition: A bullet (projectile).
definitions.definitionCn: 子弹（射弹）。

definitions.definition: A rounded rectangle indicating the tag or category that an item belongs to.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个圆角矩形，表示项目所属的标签或类别。

definitions.definition: Of a woven fabric surface, to form small matted balls of fiber.
definitions.definitionCn: （指机织织物表面）形成小的缠结纤维球。

definitions.definition: To form into the shape of a pill.
definitions.example: Pilling is a skill rarely used by modern pharmacists.
definitions.definitionCn: 形成药丸的形状。
definitions.exampleCn: 制丸是现代药剂师很少使用的技能。

definitions.definition: To medicate with pills.
definitions.example: She pills herself with all sorts of herbal medicines.
definitions.definitionCn: 用药物进行治疗。
definitions.exampleCn: 她用各种草药给自己治疗。

definitions.definition: To persuade or convince someone of something.
definitions.definitionCn: 说服或使某人相信某事。

definitions.definition: The peel or skin.
definitions.definitionCn: 果皮或外皮。

definitions.definition: To peel; to remove the outer layer of hair, skin, or bark.
definitions.definitionCn: 剥皮；去除毛发、皮肤或树皮的外层。

definitions.definition: To peel; to make by removing the skin.
definitions.definitionCn: 剥皮；通过去除表皮来制作。

definitions.definition: To be peeled; to peel off in flakes.
definitions.definitionCn: 被剥皮；成片剥落。

definitions.definition: To pillage; to despoil or impoverish.
definitions.definitionCn: 掠夺；抢劫或使贫困。

definitions.definition: An inlet on the coast; a small tidal pool or bay.
definitions.definitionCn: 海岸上的小海湾；小型潮汐池或海湾。

definitions.definition: A small wheel or roller, specifically the wheel of a gun carriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 小轮或滚轮，特指炮架上的轮子。

definitions.definition: The ball on top of a flagpole.
definitions.definitionCn: 旗杆顶端的球体。

definitions.definition: On a wooden mast, a circular disc (or sometimes a rectangle) of wood near or at the top of the mast, usually with holes or sheaves to reeve signal halyards; also a temporary or emergency place for a lookout. "Main" refers to the mainmast, whereas a truck on another mast may be called (on the mizzenmast, for example) "mizzen-truck".
definitions.definitionCn: 木制桅杆顶部或附近的一个圆形木盘（有时为矩形），通常带有孔洞或滑轮以穿引信号升降索；也指临时或紧急的瞭望位置。"主"指主桅，而其他桅杆上的此类装置可能被称为（例如后桅上的）"后桅顶盘"。

definitions.definition: A semi-tractor ("semi") trailer; a lorry.
definitions.example: Mexican open-bed trucks haul most of the fresh produce that comes into the United States from Mexico.
definitions.definitionCn: 半挂牵引车（"半挂"）拖车；卡车。
definitions.exampleCn: 墨西哥敞篷卡车运输了大部分从墨西哥进入美国的新鲜农产品。

definitions.definition: Any motor vehicle designed for carrying cargo, including delivery vans, pickups, and other motorized vehicles (including passenger autos) fitted with a bed designed to carry goods.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何设计用于运载货物的机动车辆，包括厢式货车、皮卡及其他装有载货货斗的机动车辆（包括乘用车）。

definitions.definition: A garden cart, a two-wheeled wheelbarrow.
definitions.definitionCn: 花园手推车，一种两轮独轮车。

definitions.definition: A small wagon or cart, of various designs, pushed or pulled by hand or pulled by an animal, as with those in hotels for moving luggage, or in libraries for transporting books.
definitions.definitionCn: 各种设计的小型推车或手拉车，可手推、手拉或畜力牵引，如酒店中搬运行李的推车，或图书馆中运输书籍的推车。

definitions.definition: A pantechnicon (removal van).
definitions.definitionCn: 家具搬运车（搬家货车）。

definitions.definition: A flatbed railway car; a flatcar.
definitions.definitionCn: 铁路平板车；平车。

definitions.definition: A pivoting frame, one attached to the bottom of the bed of a railway car at each end, that rests on the axle and which swivels to allow the axle (at each end of which is a solid wheel) to turn with curves in the track; a bogie.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种枢转框架，安装在铁路车厢底板两端底部，支撑在车轴上并可旋转，使车轴（两端各装有一个实心车轮）能随轨道弯道转向；转向架。

definitions.definition: The part of a skateboard or roller skate that joins the wheels to the deck, consisting of a hanger, baseplate, kingpin, and bushings, and sometimes mounted with a riser in between.
definitions.definitionCn: 滑板或旱冰鞋上连接车轮与板面的部件，由吊架、底板、主销和衬套组成，有时中间装有垫片。

definitions.definition: A platform with wheels or casters.
definitions.definitionCn: 带轮子或脚轮的平台。

definitions.definition: Dirt or other messiness.
definitions.definitionCn: 污垢或其他脏乱物。

definitions.definition: To drive a truck: Generally a truck driver's slang.
definitions.definitionCn: 驾驶卡车：通常为卡车司机俚语。

definitions.definition: To convey by truck.
definitions.example: Last week, Cletus trucked 100 pounds of lumber up to Dubuque.
definitions.definitionCn: 用卡车运输。
definitions.exampleCn: 上周，克莱图斯用卡车运送了100磅木材到迪比克。

definitions.definition: To travel or live contentedly.
definitions.example: Keep on trucking!
definitions.definitionCn: 愉快地旅行或生活。
definitions.exampleCn: 继续前进！

definitions.definition: To persist, to endure.
definitions.example: Keep on trucking!
definitions.definitionCn: 坚持，忍耐。
definitions.exampleCn: 继续前进！

definitions.definition: (film production) To move a camera parallel to the movement of the subject.
definitions.definitionCn: （电影制作）将摄像机平行于被摄物体移动。

definitions.definition: To fight or otherwise physically engage with.
definitions.definitionCn: 打斗或以其他方式身体接触。

definitions.definition: To run over or through a tackler in American football.
definitions.definitionCn: 美式橄榄球中冲撞或越过拦截者。

definitions.definition: To fail; run out; run short; be unavailable; diminish; abate.
definitions.definitionCn: 失败；耗尽；短缺；不可用；减少；减弱。

definitions.definition: To give in; give way; knuckle under; truckle.
definitions.definitionCn: 屈服；让步；认输；顺从。

definitions.definition: To deceive; cheat; defraud.
definitions.definitionCn: 欺骗；欺诈；诈骗。

definitions.definition: To tread (down); stamp on; trample (down).
definitions.definitionCn: 踩（下）；践踏；踩踏。

definitions.definition: (often in the plural) Small, humble items; things, often for sale or barter.
definitions.definitionCn: （常复数）小件廉价物品；待售或交换的物件。

definitions.definition: The practice of paying workers in kind, or with tokens only exchangeable at a shop owned by the employer [forbidden in the 19th century by the Truck Acts].
definitions.definitionCn: 以实物或仅能在雇主商店兑换的代币支付工人的做法（19世纪被《工资支付法》禁止）。

definitions.definition: Garden produce, groceries (see truck garden).
definitions.definitionCn: 园艺产品、杂货（参见菜园）。

definitions.definition: (usually with negative) Social intercourse; dealings, relationships.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常与否定词连用）社交往来；交易；关系。

definitions.definition: To trade, exchange; barter.
definitions.definitionCn: 交易；交换；以物易物。

definitions.definition: To engage in commerce; to barter or deal.
definitions.definitionCn: 从事商业活动；进行交易或买卖。

definitions.definition: To have dealings or social relationships with; to engage with.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……有交往或社会关系；与……打交道。

definitions.definition: A device or organ that detects certain external stimuli and responds in a distinctive manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 能检测特定外部刺激并以独特方式响应的装置或器官。

definitions.definition: Telecommunication or telecommunications.
definitions.definitionCn: 电信或远程通信。

definitions.definition: A telco (phone company) or telecom company.
Something which is emitted or sent out; issue.
definitions.example: the emission was mostly blood
definitions.definitionCn: 发出或送出的东西；流出物。
definitions.exampleCn: 排出的主要是血液。

definitions.definition: The act of emitting; the act of sending forth or putting into circulation.
definitions.example: the emission of heat from a fire
definitions.definitionCn: 排放的行为；发出或投入流通的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 火散发出的热量。

definitions.definition: A practitioner of physic, i.e. a specialist in internal medicine, especially as opposed to a surgeon; a practitioner who treats with medication rather than with surgery.
definitions.definitionCn: 内科医生，即内科专家，尤指与外科医生相对；以药物治疗而非手术治疗的从业者。

definitions.definition: A medical doctor trained in human medicine.
definitions.definitionCn: 接受人类医学培训的医学博士。

definitions.definition: To reveal, uncover, make visible, bring to light, introduce to.
definitions.definitionCn: 揭示、发现、使可见、曝光、引入。

definitions.definition: To subject photographic film to light thereby recording an image.
definitions.definitionCn: 将摄影胶片暴露于光线中从而记录影像。

definitions.definition: To abandon, especially an unwanted baby in the wilderness.
definitions.definitionCn: 遗弃，尤指将不想要的婴儿弃于荒野。

definitions.definition: To submit to an active (mostly dangerous) substance like an allergen, ozone, nicotine, solvent, or to any other stress, in order to test the reaction, resistance, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 使接触活性（多为危险）物质，如过敏原、臭氧、尼古丁、溶剂，或任何其他应激源，以测试反应、抵抗力等。

definitions.definition: To make available to other parts of a program, or to other programs.
definitions.definitionCn: 使程序的其他部分或其他程序可用。

definitions.definition: (usually followed by to) Vulnerable, susceptible.
definitions.example: The bike chain is open and exposed to tough environmental conditions such as temperature changes, humidity, rain, dirt and road salt.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常后接to）易受影响的、敏感的。
definitions.exampleCn: 自行车链条暴露在外，易受温度变化、湿度、雨水、污垢和道路盐分等恶劣环境条件的影响。

definitions.definition: A grouping of smaller peoples or tribes as a nation.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为国家的小民族或部落群体。

definitions.definition: The inhabitants of a region, especially the native inhabitants.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个地区的居民，尤其是原住民。

definitions.definition: (plural: folks) One’s relatives, especially one’s parents.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数：folks）某人的亲属，特别是父母。

definitions.definition: Folk music.
definitions.definitionCn: 民间音乐。

definitions.definition: People in general.
definitions.example: Young folk, old folk, everybody come, / To our little Sunday School and have a lot of fun.
definitions.definitionCn: 泛指人们。
definitions.exampleCn: 年轻人、老年人、大家都来，/ 参加我们的小小主日学校，享受许多乐趣。

definitions.definition: A particular group of people.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定的一群人。

definitions.definition: The members of one's immediate family, especially one's parents
definitions.example: My folks visit us at Christmas.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的直系亲属，尤其是父母。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的家人圣诞节时来看望我们。

definitions.definition: People in general; everybody or anybody.
definitions.example: Lots of folks like to travel during the holidays.
definitions.definitionCn: 泛指人们；每个人或任何人。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多人喜欢在假期旅行。

definitions.definition: The police.
definitions.definitionCn: 警察。

definitions.definition: (California) Late 19th and early 20th century migrants to California from Iowa and other parts of the Midwestern United States.
A pointer or index that indicates something.
definitions.definitionCn: 指示某物的指针或索引。

definitions.definition: A meter or gauge.
definitions.definitionCn: 仪表或计量器。

definitions.definition: The needle or dial on such a meter.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类仪表上的指针或刻度盘。

definitions.definition: Any of many substances, such as litmus, used to indicate the concentration of a substance, or the degree of a reaction.
definitions.definitionCn: 多种物质（如石蕊）中的任何一种，用于指示某种物质的浓度或反应程度。

definitions.definition: A plant or animal whose presence is indicative of some specific environment.
definitions.definitionCn: 其存在表明特定环境的植物或动物。

definitions.definition: A measure, such as unemployment rate, which can be used to predict economic trends.
definitions.definitionCn: 可用于预测经济趋势的指标，如失业率。

definitions.definition: A turn signal; each of the flashing lights on each side of a vehicle which indicate a turn is being made to left or right, or a lane change etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 转向灯；车辆两侧闪烁的灯光之一，用于指示正在左转、右转或变道等。

definitions.definition: A bird, the honeyguide.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种鸟，即响蜜鴷。

definitions.definition: An incorporeal and sometimes divine messenger from a deity, or other divine entity, often depicted in art as a youthful winged figure in flowing robes.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种无形且有时来自神祇或其他神圣实体的神圣信使，常在艺术中被描绘为身着飘逸长袍、长有翅膀的年轻形象。

definitions.definition: (Abrahamic tradition) One of the lowest order of such beings, below virtues.
definitions.definitionCn: （亚伯拉罕传统）此类存在中最低等级者，位于德性天使之下。

definitions.definition: A person having the qualities attributed to angels, such as purity or selflessness.
definitions.example: Thanks for making me breakfast in bed, you little angel.
definitions.definitionCn: 具备天使特质的人，如纯洁或无私。
definitions.exampleCn: 谢谢你为我端来床上早餐，你真是个小天使。

definitions.definition: Attendant spirit; genius; demon.
definitions.definitionCn: 守护灵；天才；恶魔。

definitions.definition: (possibly obsolete) An official (a bishop, or sometimes a minister) who heads a Christian church, especially a Catholic Apostolic church.
definitions.definitionCn: （可能已过时）主持基督教教会的主教或牧师，尤指天主教使徒教会。

definitions.definition: An English gold coin, bearing the figure of the archangel Michael, circulated between the 15th and 17th centuries, and varying in value from six shillings and eightpence to ten shillings.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种英国金币，上刻天使长米迦勒像，流通于15至17世纪，价值从六先令八便士到十先令不等。

definitions.definition: (originally Royal Air Force) An altitude, measured in thousands of feet.
definitions.example: Climb to angels sixty. (“ascend to 60,000 feet”)
definitions.definitionCn: （原为英国皇家空军用语）以千英尺为单位的高度。
definitions.exampleCn: 爬升至天使六十。（意为“上升至六万英尺”）

definitions.definition: An unidentified flying object detected by air traffic control radar.
definitions.definitionCn: 空中交通管制雷达探测到的不明飞行物。

definitions.definition: An affluent individual who provides capital for a startup, usually in exchange for convertible debt or ownership equity; an angel investor.
definitions.definitionCn: 为初创企业提供资本的富裕个人，通常以可转换债券或股权作为交换；天使投资人。

definitions.definition: The person who funds a show.
definitions.definitionCn: 资助演出的人。

definitions.definition: To support by donating money.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过捐款提供支持。

definitions.definition: A person who has Angelman syndrome.
definitions.definitionCn: 患有天使综合征的人。

definitions.definition: To hunt seals.
definitions.example: They're organizing a protest against sealing.
definitions.definitionCn: 捕猎海豹。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们正在组织一场反对捕杀海豹的抗议活动。

definitions.definition: To place a seal on (a document).
definitions.definitionCn: 在（文件）上盖章。

definitions.definition: To mark with a stamp, as an evidence of standard exactness, legal size, or merchantable quality.
definitions.example: to seal silverware
definitions.definitionCn: 加盖印章，作为标准精度、法定尺寸或适销质量的证明。
definitions.exampleCn: 给银器加盖封印。

definitions.definition: To fasten (something) so that it cannot be opened without visible damage.
definitions.example: The cover is sealed. If anyone tries to open it, we'll know about it.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（某物）封好，使其在无可见损坏的情况下无法打开。
definitions.exampleCn: 盖子被封住了。如果有人试图打开，我们会知道的。

definitions.definition: To prevent people or vehicles from crossing (something).
definitions.example: The border has been sealed until the fugitives are found.
definitions.definitionCn: 阻止人或车辆穿越（某处）。
definitions.exampleCn: 边境已被封锁，直到找到逃犯为止。

definitions.definition: To close securely to prevent leakage.
definitions.example: I've sealed the bottle to keep the contents fresh.
definitions.definitionCn: 严密关闭以防泄漏。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已封好瓶子以保持内容物新鲜。

definitions.definition: To place in a sealed container.
definitions.example: I've sealed the documents in this envelope.
definitions.definitionCn: 放入密封容器中。
definitions.exampleCn: 我已将文件封入这个信封。

definitions.definition: To place a notation of one's next move in a sealed envelope to be opened after an adjournment.
definitions.example: After thinking for half an hour, the champion sealed his move.
definitions.definitionCn: 将下一步棋的记法放入密封信封中，待休会后再打开。
definitions.exampleCn: 思考半小时后，冠军封存了他的棋步。

definitions.definition: To guarantee.
definitions.example: The last-minute goal sealed United’s win.
definitions.definitionCn: 确保。
definitions.exampleCn: 最后一分钟的进球确保了联队的胜利。

definitions.definition: To fix, as a piece of iron in a wall, with cement or plaster, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 用水泥或灰泥等将（如墙上的铁件）固定。

definitions.definition: To close by means of a seal.
definitions.example: to seal a drainpipe with water
definitions.definitionCn: 通过封印关闭。
definitions.exampleCn: 用水封住排水管。

definitions.definition: To confirm or set apart as a second or additional wife.
definitions.definitionCn: 确认或指定为第二任或额外妻子。

definitions.definition: To tie up animals (especially cattle) in their stalls.
definitions.definitionCn: 将动物（尤其是牛）拴在畜栏里。

definitions.definition: Closed by a seal.
definitions.definitionCn: 被封印封闭的。

definitions.definition: Preventing entrance.
definitions.definitionCn: 防止进入的。

definitions.definition: Of a road that has an asphalt or macadamised surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 指铺有沥青或碎石路面的道路。

definitions.definition: Not subclassable; from which one cannot inherit.
definitions.definitionCn: 不可子类化的；无法继承的。

definitions.definition: The process, or the power, of governing; government or administration.
definitions.definitionCn: 治理的过程或权力；政府或行政管理。

definitions.definition: The specific system by which a political system is ruled.
definitions.definitionCn: 政治体系被统治的具体制度。

definitions.definition: The group of people who make up an administrative body.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成行政机构的群体。

definitions.definition: The state of being governed.
definitions.definitionCn: 被统治的状态。

definitions.definition: Accountability for consistent, cohesive policies, processes and decision rights.
definitions.definitionCn: 对一致、连贯的政策、流程和决策权的问责。

definitions.definition: A test under controlled conditions made to either demonstrate a known truth, examine the validity of a hypothesis, or determine the efficacy of something previously untried.
definitions.definitionCn: 在受控条件下进行的测试，旨在证明已知真理、检验假设的有效性或确定未经尝试之物的效能。

definitions.definition: Experience, practical familiarity with something.
definitions.definitionCn: 经验，对某事物的实际熟悉。

definitions.definition: To conduct an experiment.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行实验。

definitions.definition: To experience; to feel; to perceive; to detect.
definitions.definitionCn: 体验；感受；察觉；发现。

definitions.definition: To test or ascertain by experiment; to try out; to make an experiment on.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过实验进行测试或确定；尝试；对……进行实验。

definitions.definition: To start (an institution or organization).
definitions.definitionCn: 创办（机构或组织）。

definitions.definition: To begin building.
definitions.definitionCn: 开始建造。

definitions.definition: To melt, especially of metal in an industrial setting.
definitions.definitionCn: 熔化，尤指工业环境中的金属。

definitions.definition: To form by melting a metal and pouring it into a mould; to cast.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过熔化金属并倒入模具来成型；铸造。

definitions.definition: Having a basis.
definitions.example: She offered a well-founded hypothesis.
definitions.definitionCn: 有根据的。
definitions.exampleCn: 她提出了一个有理有据的假设。

definitions.definition: The act of complaining.
definitions.definitionCn: 抱怨的行为。

definitions.definition: A grievance, problem, difficulty, or concern.
definitions.example: I have no complaints about the quality of his work, but I don't enjoy his company.
definitions.definitionCn: 不满、问题、困难或担忧。
definitions.exampleCn: 我对他的工作质量没有怨言，但我不喜欢和他相处。

definitions.definition: In a civil action, the first pleading of the plaintiff setting out the facts on which the claim is based; The purpose is to give notice to the adversary of the nature and basis of the claim asserted.
definitions.definitionCn: 在民事诉讼中，原告首次提交的诉状，陈述其主张所依据的事实；目的是告知对方所主张权利的性质和依据。

definitions.definition: In criminal law, the preliminary charge or accusation made by one person against another to the appropriate court or officer, usually a magistrate. However, court proceedings, such as a trial, cannot be instituted until an indictment or information has been handed down against the defendant.
definitions.definitionCn: 在刑法中，一人向适当法院或官员（通常是治安法官）提出的初步指控或控告。然而，在针对被告的起诉书或告发书下达之前，不能启动审判等法庭程序。

definitions.definition: A bodily disorder or disease; the symptom of such a disorder.
definitions.example: Don't come too close; I've got this nasty complaint.
definitions.definitionCn: 身体失调或疾病；此类失调的症状。
definitions.exampleCn: 别靠太近；我得了这种讨厌的病。

synonyms: reporting an offence/offense to the police/authorities

definitions.definition: To beat, smack or slap a person's buttocks, with the bare hand or other object, as punishment, gesture, or form of sexual interaction.
definitions.definitionCn: 用手掌或其他物体击打、拍打或抽打他人臀部，作为惩罚、姿态或性互动形式。

definitions.definition: To soundly defeat, to trounce.
definitions.definitionCn: 彻底击败，痛击。

definitions.definition: To hit very hard
definitions.definitionCn: 猛烈击打。

definitions.definition: To move rapidly.
definitions.example: The ship was really spanking along.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速移动。
definitions.exampleCn: 那艘船正飞速前进。

definitions.definition: A form of physical punishment in which a beating is applied to the buttocks.
definitions.example: Domestic spanking is often endured over the knee (or lap), formal spanking rather applied over a contraption such as a tresle or A-frame, with or without constraints
definitions.definitionCn: 一种体罚形式，击打部位为臀部。
definitions.exampleCn: 家庭中的打屁股常被置于膝上（或大腿上）承受，正式打屁股则多采用如支架或A型架等装置，可能带有约束或无约束。

definitions.definition: An incident of such punishment, or such physical act in a non-punitive context, such as a birthday spanking.
definitions.definitionCn: 此类惩罚事件，或非惩罚性情境中的此类身体行为，如生日打屁股。

definitions.definition: Fast and energetic.
definitions.example: a spanking pace
definitions.definitionCn: 快速而充满活力的。
definitions.exampleCn: 飞快的步伐。

definitions.definition: Brisk and fresh.
definitions.example: a spanking breeze
definitions.definitionCn: 清新而凉爽的。
definitions.exampleCn: 清新的微风。

definitions.definition: (now usually with “new”) An intensifier.
definitions.example: a spanking good time
definitions.definitionCn: （现常与“new”连用）加强语气的词。
definitions.exampleCn: 一段极其愉快的时光。

definitions.definition: The location of an event that attracts attention.
definitions.example: the scene of the crime
definitions.definitionCn: 吸引注意力的事件发生地点。
definitions.exampleCn: 犯罪现场。

definitions.definition: The stage.
definitions.example: They stood in the centre of the scene.
definitions.definitionCn: 舞台。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们站在场景中央。

definitions.definition: The decorations; furnishings and backgrounds of a stage, representing the place in which the action of a play is set
definitions.example: behind the scenes
definitions.definitionCn: 舞台的装饰、陈设和背景，代表戏剧动作发生的场所。
definitions.exampleCn: 在幕后。

definitions.definition: A part of a dramatic work that is set in the same place or time. In the theatre, generally a number of scenes constitute an act.
definitions.example: The most moving scene is the final one, where he realizes he has wasted his whole life.
definitions.definitionCn: 戏剧作品中设定在同一地点或时间的一部分。在剧院中，通常多个场景构成一幕。
definitions.exampleCn: 最感人的场景是最后一幕，他意识到自己虚度了一生。

definitions.definition: The location, time, circumstances, etc., in which something occurs, or in which the action of a story, play, or the like, is set up
definitions.definitionCn: 某事发生的地点、时间、环境等，或故事、戏剧等情节设定的背景。

definitions.definition: A combination of objects or events in view or happening at a given moment at a particular place.
definitions.example: He assessed the scene to check for any danger, and agreed it was safe.
definitions.definitionCn: 在特定地点、特定时刻可见或发生的事物或事件的组合。
definitions.exampleCn: 他评估了现场以检查是否有任何危险，并确认安全。

definitions.definition: A landscape, or part of a landscape; scenery.
definitions.definitionCn: 风景，或风景的一部分；景色。

definitions.definition: An exhibition of passionate or strong feeling before others, creating embarrassment or disruption; often, an artificial or affected action, or course of action, done for effect; a theatrical display
definitions.example: The crazy lady made a scene in the grocery store.
definitions.definitionCn: 在他人面前展示激情或强烈情感，造成尴尬或混乱；常指为效果而做的做作或夸张的行为或行动；戏剧性的表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个疯女人在杂货店里大吵大闹。

definitions.definition: An element of fiction writing.
definitions.definitionCn: 小说写作的一个元素。

definitions.definition: A social environment consisting of an informal, vague group of people with a uniting interest; their sphere of activity; a subculture.
definitions.example: She got into the emo scene at an early age.
definitions.definitionCn: 由一群有共同兴趣的非正式、模糊人群组成的社会环境；他们的活动领域；亚文化。
definitions.exampleCn: 她很小就进入了情绪摇滚圈子。

definitions.definition: A solid or hollow sphere, or roughly spherical mass.
definitions.example: a ball of spittle; a fecal ball
definitions.definitionCn: 实心或空心的球体，或近似球形的团块。
definitions.exampleCn: 一团唾液；一团粪便

definitions.definition: A round or ellipsoidal object.
definitions.definitionCn: 圆形或椭圆形的物体。

definitions.definition: (mildly, usually in the plural) A testicle.
definitions.definitionCn: （温和用语，通常用复数）睾丸。

definitions.definition: A leather-covered cushion, fastened to a handle called a ballstock; formerly used by printers for inking the form, then superseded by the roller.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种皮革包裹的垫子，固定在称为球柄的手柄上；过去印刷工用于给印版上墨，后被滚筒取代。

definitions.definition: A large pill, a form in which medicine was given to horses; a bolus.
definitions.definitionCn: 大药丸，一种给马服用的药物形态；大丸剂。

definitions.definition: To form or wind into a ball.
definitions.example: to ball cotton
definitions.definitionCn: 形成或缠绕成球状。
definitions.exampleCn: 将棉花绕成球

definitions.definition: To heat in a furnace and form into balls for rolling.
definitions.definitionCn: 在炉中加热并滚成球状以便轧制。

definitions.definition: To have sexual intercourse with.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……发生性关系。

definitions.definition: To gather balls which cling to the feet, as of damp snow or clay; to gather into balls.
definitions.example: The horse balls; the snow balls.
definitions.definitionCn: 聚集粘在脚上的球状物，如湿雪或黏土；聚集成球。
definitions.exampleCn: 马粪球；雪球。

definitions.definition: (usually in present participle) To be hip or cool.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常用现在分词）时髦或酷。

definitions.definition: To play basketball.
definitions.definitionCn: 打篮球。

definitions.definition: To punish by affixing a ball and chain
definitions.definitionCn: 通过锁上铁球和铁链进行惩罚。

definitions.definition: A formal dance.
definitions.definitionCn: 正式舞会。

definitions.definition: A very enjoyable time.
definitions.example: I had a ball at that concert.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常愉快的时光。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在那场音乐会上玩得很开心。

definitions.definition: Speaking or acting with bravado to achieve (something)
definitions.definitionCn: 虚张声势地说话或行动以达成（某事）

definitions.definition: To engage in sexual intercourse.
definitions.definitionCn: 进行性交。

definitions.definition: Very. Intensifier.
definitions.example: It is balls cold out there.
definitions.definitionCn: 非常。加强语气的词。
definitions.exampleCn: 外面冷得要命。

definitions.definition: To put a load on or in (a means of conveyance or a place of storage).
definitions.example: The dock workers refused to load the ship.
definitions.definitionCn: 装载到（运输工具或存储场所）上或内。
definitions.exampleCn: 码头工人拒绝装船。

definitions.definition: To place in or on a conveyance or a place of storage.
definitions.example: He loaded his stuff into his storage locker.
definitions.definitionCn: 放入运输工具或存储场所中。
definitions.exampleCn: 他把自己的东西装进了储物柜。

definitions.definition: To put a load on something.
definitions.example: The truck was supposed to leave at dawn, but in fact we spent all morning loading.
definitions.definitionCn: 给某物加上负载。
definitions.exampleCn: 卡车本应黎明出发，但实际上我们整个早上都在装货。

definitions.definition: To receive a load.
definitions.example: The truck is designed to load easily.
definitions.definitionCn: 接收负载。
definitions.exampleCn: 这辆卡车设计得易于装载。

definitions.definition: To be placed into storage or conveyance.
definitions.example: The containers load quickly and easily.
definitions.definitionCn: 被放入存储或运输中。
definitions.exampleCn: 这些集装箱装卸快速方便。

definitions.definition: To fill (a firearm or artillery) with munition.
definitions.example: I pulled the trigger, but nothing happened. I had forgotten to load the gun.
definitions.definitionCn: 给（火器或火炮）装填弹药。
definitions.exampleCn: 我扣动扳机，但没反应。我忘了给枪上膛。

definitions.definition: To insert (an item or items) into an apparatus so as to ready it for operation, such as a reel of film into a camera, sheets of paper into a printer etc.
definitions.example: Now that you've loaded the camera [with film], you're ready to start shooting.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（一件或多件物品）插入设备中以便其准备运行，例如将胶卷装入相机、将纸张装入打印机等。
definitions.exampleCn: 既然你已经给相机装上了胶卷，就可以开始拍摄了。

definitions.definition: To fill (an apparatus) with raw material.
definitions.example: The workers loaded the blast furnace with coke and ore.
definitions.definitionCn: 给（设备）填充原材料。
definitions.exampleCn: 工人们将焦炭和矿石装入高炉。

definitions.definition: To be put into use in an apparatus.
definitions.example: The cartridge was designed to load easily.
definitions.definitionCn: 被投入设备中使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 这种弹匣设计得易于装填。

definitions.definition: To read (data or a program) from a storage medium into computer memory.
definitions.example: Click OK to load the selected data.
definitions.definitionCn: 从存储介质读取（数据或程序）到计算机内存中。
definitions.exampleCn: 点击“确定”加载所选数据。

definitions.definition: To transfer from a storage medium into computer memory.
definitions.example: This program takes an age to load.
definitions.definitionCn: 从存储介质传输到计算机内存中。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个程序加载需要很长时间。

definitions.definition: To put runners on first, second and third bases
definitions.example: He walks to load the bases.
definitions.definitionCn: 让跑垒员上一垒、二垒和三垒。
definitions.exampleCn: 他保送上垒，形成满垒局面。

definitions.definition: To tamper with so as to produce a biased outcome.
definitions.example: The wording of the ballot paper loaded the vote in favour of the Conservative candidate.
definitions.definitionCn: 篡改以产生有偏见的结果。
definitions.exampleCn: 选票的措辞使投票偏向保守党候选人。

definitions.definition: To ask or adapt a question so that it will be more likely to be answered in a certain way.
definitions.definitionCn: 提出或调整问题，使其更可能以某种方式回答。

definitions.definition: To encumber with something negative, to place as an encumbrance.
definitions.example: The new owners had loaded the company with debt.
definitions.definitionCn: 用负面事物拖累，作为负担。
definitions.exampleCn: 新所有者让公司背负了债务。

definitions.definition: To provide in abundance.
definitions.example: He loaded carbs into his system before the marathon.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量提供。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在马拉松前大量摄入碳水化合物。

definitions.definition: To weight (a cane, whip, etc.) with lead or similar.
definitions.definitionCn: 用铅或类似物加重（手杖、鞭子等）。

definitions.definition: To adulterate or drug.
definitions.example: to load wine
definitions.definitionCn: 掺假或下药。
definitions.exampleCn: 给酒掺假。

definitions.definition: To magnetize.
definitions.definitionCn: 磁化。

definitions.definition: Burdened by some heavy load; packed.
definitions.example: Let's leave the TV; the car is loaded already.
definitions.definitionCn: 被重物压着；装满了。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们别管电视了；车已经装满了。

definitions.definition: (of a projectile weapon) Having a live round of ammunition in the chamber.
definitions.example: No funny business; this heater's loaded!
definitions.definitionCn: （指射弹武器）枪膛内有实弹。
definitions.exampleCn: 别耍花招；这把枪可是上了膛的！

definitions.definition: Possessing great wealth.
definitions.example: He sold his business a couple of years ago and is just loaded.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有巨大财富。
definitions.exampleCn: 他几年前卖掉了生意，现在富得流油。

definitions.definition: Drunk.
definitions.example: By the end of the evening, the guests in the club were really loaded.
definitions.definitionCn: 喝醉了。
definitions.exampleCn: 到了晚上结束时，俱乐部里的客人真的都醉了。

definitions.definition: Pertaining to a situation where there is a runner at each of the three bases.
definitions.example: It's bottom of the ninth, the bases are loaded and there are two outs.
definitions.definitionCn: 指每个垒上都有跑垒员的情况。
definitions.exampleCn: 现在是第九局下半，满垒，两人出局。

definitions.definition: (also used figuratively) a die or dice being weighted asymmetrically, and so biased to produce predictable throws.
definitions.example: He was playing with loaded dice and won a fortune.
definitions.definitionCn: （也用作比喻）骰子被不对称加重，从而偏向产生可预测的结果。

definitions.definitionCn: 赋予声誉或荣誉；使著名。

definitions.definition: A newspaper featuring illustrations.
definitions.definitionCn: 一份以插图为特色的报纸。

definitions.definition: Total income or cash flow minus expenditures. The money or other benefit a non-governmental organization or individual receives in exchange for products and services sold at an advertised price.
definitions.definitionCn: 总收入或现金流减去支出。非政府组织或个人以广告价格出售产品和服务所获得的金钱或其他利益。

definitions.definition: Benefit, positive result obtained.

definitions.definitionCn: 收益，获得的积极结果。

definitions.definition: In property law, a nonpossessory interest in land whereby a party is entitled to enter the land of another for the purpose of taking the soil or the substance of the soil (coal, oil, minerals, and in some jurisdictions timber and game).
definitions.definitionCn: 在财产法中，一种非占有性的土地权益，一方有权进入他人的土地，以获取土壤或土壤中的物质（煤炭、石油、矿产，在某些司法管辖区还包括木材和猎物）。

definitions.definition: To benefit (somebody), be of use to (somebody).
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）受益，对（某人）有用。

definitions.definition: (construed with from) To benefit, gain.
definitions.definitionCn: （与from连用）受益，获利。

definitions.definition: (construed with from) To take advantage of, exploit, use.
definitions.definitionCn: （与from连用）利用，剥削，使用。

definitions.definition: Someone from the continent.
definitions.definitionCn: 来自大陆的人。

definitions.definition: A member of the Continental army.
definitions.definitionCn: 大陆军的一员。

definitions.definition: Paper scrip (paper money) issued by the continental congress, largely worthless by the end of the war.
definitions.definitionCn: 大陆会议发行的纸币，到战争结束时基本一文不值。

definitions.definition: (by extension) The smallest amount; a whit; a jot.
definitions.example: I don't care a continental!
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）极小的数量；一丁点；丝毫。
definitions.exampleCn: 我毫不在乎！

definitions.definition: Of or relating to a continent or continents.
definitions.example: continental drift
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于大陆的。
definitions.exampleCn: 大陆漂移。

definitions.definition: Of the mainland, as opposed to an island offshore
definitions.example: continental Europe
definitions.definitionCn: 属于大陆的，相对于近海岛屿而言。
definitions.exampleCn: 欧洲大陆。

definitions.definition: (chiefly in the UK) Relating to, or characteristic of, continental Europe
definitions.example: continental breakfast
definitions.definitionCn: （主要在英国）与欧洲大陆相关的，或具有其特点的。
definitions.exampleCn: 欧陆式早餐。

definitions.definition: Of or relating to the confederated colonies collectively, in the time of the Revolutionary War.
definitions.example: continental money
definitions.definitionCn: 属于或关于革命战争时期联合殖民地的。
definitions.exampleCn: 大陆货币。

definitions.definition: That which alternates with something else; vicissitude.
definitions.definitionCn: 与某物交替出现；变迁。

definitions.definition: A substitute; an alternative; one designated to take the place of another, if necessary, in performing some duty.

definitions.definition: A proportion derived from another proportion by interchanging the means.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过互换比例项从另一比例推导出的比例。

definitions.definition: A replacement of equal or greater value or function.
definitions.definitionCn: 功能或价值相等或更大的替换物。

definitions.definition: Figures or tinctures that succeed each other by turns.
definitions.definitionCn: 轮流出现的图形或纹章。

definitions.definition: To perform by turns, or in succession; to cause to succeed by turns; to interchange regularly.
definitions.definitionCn: 轮流或依次进行；使交替发生；有规律地互换。

definitions.definition: To happen, succeed, or act by turns; to follow reciprocally in place or time; followed by with.

definitions.definitionCn: 轮流发生、接续或行动；在位置或时间上相互跟随；后接with。
definitions.exampleCn: 涨潮和退潮相互交替。

definitions.definition: To vary by turns.
definitions.example: The land alternates between rocky hills and sandy plains.
definitions.definitionCn: 轮流变化。
definitions.exampleCn: 这片土地交替出现岩石丘陵和沙质平原。

definitions.definition: To perform an alternation (removal of alternate vertices) on (a polytope or tessellation); to remove vertices (from a face or edge) as part of an alternation.
definitions.definitionCn: 对多面体或镶嵌图形进行交替操作（移除交替顶点）；作为交替操作的一部分，从面或边上移除顶点。

definitions.definition: Happening by turns; one following the other in succession of time or place; first one and then the other (repeatedly)

definitions.definition: Other; alternative.

definitions.definitionCn: 其他的；替代的。

definitions.definition: (of leaves) Distributed singly at different heights of the stem, and at equal intervals as respects angular divergence.

definitions.definition: To replace or enhance human labor with machines.

definitions.definition: A piece of jewelry worn on the ear.

definitions.definition: To receive pleasure or satisfaction from something

definitions.definition: To be satisfied or receive pleasure.

definitions.definition: The act of achieving or performing; a successful performance; accomplishment

definitions.exampleCn: 完成游戏并不会给你100%的分数，除非你解锁了所有成就

definitions.definition: (grammar) The lexical aspect (aktionsart) of verbs or predicates that change in an instant.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）瞬间变化的动词或谓词的词汇体（动作类型）

definitions.definitionCn: 限制某物用途或价值的缺陷或不足。

definitions.definitionCn: 快速投球手使球旋转，导致球在空中侧向移动。

definitions.definition: (often with "right" and/or "proper") A fool.

definitions.definition: (usually in the plural) A woman's breast

definitions.definition: A nightwatchman.
definitions.definitionCn: 守夜人。

definitions.definition: A short, pointed beard, like that of King Charles I.

definitions.definition: A mechanical device through which liquids or gases can be passed in a regulated manner.

definitions.definition: An artificial nipple (definition 1) used for bottle-feeding infants.

definitions.definition: Any small physical protrusion, such as the lumps on the F and J keys on computer keyboards.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何小的物理凸起，例如计算机键盘上F键和J键上的凸点。

definitions.definition: Any small physical protrusion on an automotive, a machine part or any other part that fits into a groove on another part.
definitions.definitionCn: 汽车、机器零件或其他零件上任何小的物理凸起，可嵌入另一零件的凹槽中。

definitions.definition: A perforated segment that fits into part of the breech of a muzzle-loading gun, on which the percussion cap is fixed.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种带孔的部件，安装在滑膛枪后膛部分，用于固定火帽。

definitions.definition: A short tube threaded at both ends, used as a connector.
definitions.definitionCn: 两端有螺纹的短管，用作连接器。

definitions.definition: The assessed value of an asset from which the tax owing is computed.
definitions.definitionCn: 计算应缴税款的资产评估价值。

definitions.definition: An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound.
definitions.example: It’s a good thing that television doesn’t transmit smell.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种允许传输实时视觉图像（通常还包括声音）的电子通信媒介。
definitions.exampleCn: 电视不传输气味是件好事。

definitions.definition: A device for receiving television signals and displaying them in visual form.
definitions.example: I have an old television in the study.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种接收电视信号并以视觉形式显示的设备。

definitions.definition: Collectively, the programs broadcast via the medium of television.

definitions.definitionCn: 通过电视媒介播出的所有节目统称。

definitions.definition: Vision at a distance.

definitions.definition: The amount of air breathed in or out during normal respiration.

definitions.definition: To remark upon; to mention.

definitions.definition: To become aware of; to observe.

definitions.definition: To be noticeable; to show.

definitions.definition: The state of being a child.

definitions.definition: (by extension) The early stages of development of something.

definitions.definition: A character or glyph representing an idea, concept or object.

definitions.definition: Free from sound or noise; absolutely still; perfectly quiet.

definitions.definition: Undiagnosed or undetected because of an absence of symptoms.

definitions.definition: An on-off light, semaphore, or other device used to give an indication to another person.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于向他人发出指示的开关灯、信号灯或其他装置。

definitions.definition: Useful information, as opposed to noise.
definitions.definitionCn: 有用信息，与噪声相对。

definitions.definition: A signalling interaction between cells

definitions.definitionCn: 蘑菇的伞盖部分。

definitions.definition: A bullet used to shoot someone.

definitions.definition: An international appearance.

definitions.definition: The whole top of the head of a bird from the base of the bill to the nape of the neck.

definitions.definitionCn: 球面或其他凸面的一部分。
