definitions.definition: A testicle of an animal.
definitions.definitionCn: 动物的睾丸。

definitions.definition: A stand or table with a smooth, flat top of stone, commonly marble, on which to arrange the pages of a book, newspaper, etc. before printing; also called imposing stone.
definitions.definitionCn: 带有光滑平坦石质（通常为大理石）台面的架子或桌子，用于在印刷前摆放书报等页面；也称拼版台。

definitions.definition: To pelt with stones, especially to kill by pelting with stones.
definitions.example: She got stoned to death after they found her.
definitions.definitionCn: 用石头投掷，尤指用石头砸死。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们发现她后，她被石头砸死了。

definitions.definition: To wall with stones.
definitions.definitionCn: 用石头砌墙。

definitions.definition: To remove a stone from (fruit etc.).
definitions.definitionCn: 去除（水果等）的核。

definitions.definition: To form a stone during growth, with reference to fruit etc.
definitions.definitionCn: （水果等）生长过程中形成核。

definitions.definition: To intoxicate, especially with narcotics. (Usually in passive)
definitions.definitionCn: 使醉倒，尤指用麻醉剂。（通常用被动语态）

definitions.definition: To do nothing, to stare blankly into space and not pay attention when relaxing or when bored.
definitions.definitionCn: 无所事事，放松或无聊时茫然凝视虚空。

definitions.definition: To lap with an abrasive stone to remove surface irregularities.
definitions.definitionCn: 用磨石打磨以去除表面不平整。

definitions.definition: Testicles; balls.
definitions.definitionCn: 睾丸；阴囊。

definitions.definition: Courage.
definitions.definitionCn: 勇气。

definitions.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.
definitions.example: As they accelerated onto the motorway, the wind tore the plywood off the car's roof-rack.
definitions.definitionCn: 大气实际或感知的运动，通常由对流或气压差引起。
definitions.exampleCn: 当他们加速驶上高速公路时，风把车顶行李架上的胶合板掀掉了。

definitions.definition: Air artificially put in motion by any force or action.
definitions.example: the wind of a cannon ball;  the wind of a bellows
definitions.definitionCn: 由任何力量或作用人为产生的空气运动。
definitions.exampleCn: 炮弹的风；风箱的风

definitions.definition: The ability to breathe easily.
definitions.example: After the second lap he was already out of wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻松呼吸的能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 跑完第二圈后，他已经喘不上气了。

definitions.definition: News of an event, especially by hearsay or gossip. (Used with catch, often in the past tense.)
definitions.example: Steve caught wind of Martha's dalliance with his best friend.
definitions.definitionCn: 关于某事件的消息，尤指传闻或流言。（与catch连用，常用过去时态。）
definitions.exampleCn: 史蒂夫听说了玛莎与他最好朋友的暧昧关系。

definitions.definition: One of the five basic elements in Indian and Japanese models of the Classical elements).
definitions.definitionCn: 印度和日本古典元素模型中五种基本元素之一。

definitions.definition: Flatus.
definitions.example: Eww. Someone just passed wind.
definitions.definitionCn: 肠胃气。
definitions.exampleCn: 呃，有人放屁了。

definitions.definition: Breath modulated by the respiratory and vocal organs, or by an instrument.
definitions.definitionCn: 由呼吸和发声器官或乐器调节的气息。

definitions.definition: The woodwind section of an orchestra. Occasionally also used to include the brass section.
definitions.definitionCn: 管弦乐队的木管乐器组。偶尔也用于包括铜管乐器组。

definitions.definition: A direction from which the wind may blow; a point of the compass; especially, one of the cardinal points, which are often called the "four winds".
definitions.definitionCn: 风可能吹来的方向；罗盘点；尤指基本方位点，常被称为“四方风”。

definitions.definition: Types of playing-tile in the game of mah-jongg, named after the four winds.
definitions.definitionCn: 麻将牌中的风牌类型，以四方风命名。

definitions.definition: A disease of sheep, in which the intestines are distended with air, or rather affected with a violent inflammation. It occurs immediately after shearing.
definitions.definitionCn: 羊的一种疾病，肠道内充满气体，或更确切地说是受剧烈炎症影响。常发生在剪毛后立即出现。

definitions.definition: Mere breath or talk; empty effort; idle words.
definitions.definitionCn: 仅仅是呼吸或空谈；徒劳的努力；空洞的言语。

definitions.definition: A bird, the dotterel.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种鸟，鸻。

definitions.definition: The region of the solar plexus, where a blow may paralyze the diaphragm and cause temporary loss of breath or other injury.
definitions.definitionCn: 太阳神经丛区域，受到打击可能麻痹膈肌，导致暂时性呼吸困难或其他损伤。

definitions.definition: The act of winding or turning; a turn; a bend; a twist.
definitions.definitionCn: 缠绕或转动的动作；一次转动；一个弯曲；一个扭转。

definitions.definition: To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.
To cause (someone) to become breathless, as by a blow to the abdomen, or by physical exertion, running, etc.
definitions.example: The boxer was winded during round two.

definitions.definition: To cause a baby to bring up wind by patting its back after being fed.
To turn a boat or ship around, so that the wind strikes it on the opposite side.
To expose to the wind; to winnow; to ventilate.
To perceive or follow by scent.
definitions.example: The hounds winded the game.

definitions.definition: To rest (a horse, etc.) in order to allow the breath to be recovered; to breathe.
To turn a windmill so that its sails face into the wind.
To turn coils of (a cord or something similar) around something.
definitions.example: to wind thread on a spool or into a ball

definitions.definition: To tighten the spring of a clockwork mechanism such as that of a clock.
definitions.example: Please wind that old-fashioned alarm clock.

definitions.definition: To entwist; to enfold; to encircle.
To travel in a way that is not straight.
definitions.example: Vines wind round a pole.  The river winds through the plain.

definitions.definition: To have complete control over; to turn and bend at one's pleasure; to vary or alter or will; to regulate; to govern.
To introduce by insinuation; to insinuate.
To cover or surround with something coiled about.
definitions.example: to wind a rope with twine

definitions.definition: To cause to move by exerting a winding force; to haul or hoist, as by a winch.
To turn (a ship) around, end for end.
A phase.
definitions.example: Completion of an identifiable stage of maintenance such as removing an aircraft engine for repair or storage.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个阶段。
definitions.exampleCn: 完成维护中一个可识别阶段，例如拆卸飞机发动机进行维修或存放。

definitions.definition: A platform; a surface, generally elevated, upon which show performances or other public events are given.
definitions.example: The band returned to the stage to play an encore.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个平台；通常抬高的表面，用于表演或其他公共活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 乐队回到舞台加演了一曲。

definitions.definition: A floor or storey of a house.
definitions.definitionCn: 房屋的一层或楼层。

definitions.definition: A floor elevated for the convenience of mechanical work, etc.; scaffolding; staging.
definitions.definitionCn: 为方便机械工作等而抬高的地板；脚手架；工作台。

definitions.definition: A platform, often floating, serving as a kind of wharf.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个平台，通常是浮动的，用作一种码头。

definitions.definition: A stagecoach, an enclosed horsedrawn carriage used to carry passengers.
definitions.example: The stage pulled into town carrying the payroll for the mill and three ladies.
definitions.definitionCn: 驿站马车，一种封闭式马拉客车，用于载客。
definitions.exampleCn: 马车驶入小镇，载着工厂的工资和三位女士。

definitions.definition: A place of rest on a regularly travelled road; a station; a place appointed for a relay of horses.
definitions.definitionCn: 在常行道路上的休息处；站点；指定换马的地方。

definitions.definition: A degree of advancement in a journey; one of several portions into which a road or course is marked off; the distance between two places of rest on a road.
definitions.example: a stage of ten miles
definitions.definitionCn: 旅程中的一段进程；道路或路线划分的若干部分之一；路上两个休息处之间的距离。
definitions.exampleCn: 十英里的一段路程。

definitions.definition: The number of an electronic circuit’s block, such as a filter, an amplifier, etc.
definitions.example: a 3-stage cascade of a 2nd-order bandpass Butterworth filter
definitions.definitionCn: 电子电路模块的数量，例如滤波器、放大器等。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个三级级联的二阶带通巴特沃斯滤波器。

definitions.definition: The place on a microscope where the slide is located for viewing.
definitions.example: He placed the slide on the stage.
definitions.definitionCn: 显微镜上放置载玻片以供观察的位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将载玻片放在载物台上。

definitions.definition: A level; one of the sequential areas making up the game.
definitions.example: How do you get past the flying creatures in the third stage?
definitions.definitionCn: 一个级别；构成游戏的连续区域之一。
definitions.exampleCn: 你如何在第三关通过那些飞行生物？

definitions.definition: A place where anything is publicly exhibited, or a remarkable affair occurs; the scene.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何事物公开展示或发生重大事件的地方；场景。

definitions.definition: The succession of rock strata laid down in a single age on the geologic time scale.
definitions.definitionCn: 在地质时间尺度上一个时代沉积的岩层序列。

definitions.definition: To produce on a stage, to perform a play.
definitions.example: The local theater group will stage "Pride and Prejudice".
definitions.definitionCn: 在舞台上制作，表演一出戏剧。
definitions.exampleCn: 当地剧团将上演《傲慢与偏见》。

definitions.definition: To demonstrate in a deceptive manner.
definitions.example: The salesman's demonstration of the new cleanser was staged to make it appear highly effective.
definitions.definitionCn: 以欺骗性方式演示。
definitions.exampleCn: 销售员对新清洁剂的演示是事先安排好的，以显得效果极佳。

definitions.definition: To orchestrate; to carry out.
definitions.example: A protest will be staged in the public square on Monday.
definitions.definitionCn: 精心策划；执行。
definitions.exampleCn: 周一将在公共广场举行抗议活动。

definitions.definition: To place in position to prepare for use.
definitions.example: We staged the cars to be ready for the start, then waited for the starter to drop the flag.
definitions.definitionCn: 放置到位以备使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们将车辆就位准备出发，然后等待发令员挥旗。

definitions.definition: To determine what stage (a disease, etc.) has progressed to
definitions.definitionCn: 确定（疾病等）已发展到哪个阶段。

definitions.definition: The process or an instance of washing or being washed by water or other liquid.
definitions.example: I'm going to have a quick wash before coming to bed.
definitions.definitionCn: 用水或其他液体清洗的过程或实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 我打算睡前快速洗一下。

definitions.definition: A liquid used for washing.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于清洗的液体。

definitions.definition: A lotion or other liquid with medicinal or hygienic properties.
definitions.example: hand wash
definitions.definitionCn: 具有药用或卫生性质的洗剂或其他液体。
definitions.exampleCn: 手洗。

definitions.definition: The quantity of clothes washed at a time.
definitions.example: There's a lot in that wash: maybe you should split it into two piles.
definitions.definitionCn: 一次清洗的衣物量。
definitions.exampleCn: 那堆要洗的衣服太多了，也许你应该分成两堆。

definitions.definition: A smooth and translucent painting created using a paintbrush holding a large amount of solvent and a small amount of paint.
definitions.definitionCn: 用蘸有大量溶剂和少量颜料的画笔创作的平滑半透明画作。

definitions.definition: The sound of breaking of the seas, e.g., on the shore.
definitions.example: I could hear the wash of the wave.
definitions.definitionCn: 海浪拍打海岸等的声音。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能听到海浪拍打的声音。

definitions.definition: The wake of a moving ship.
definitions.example: Sail away from the wash to avoid rocking the boat.
definitions.definitionCn: 移动船只的尾流。
definitions.exampleCn: 驶离尾流区域，避免船只摇晃。

definitions.definition: The turbulence left in the air by a moving airplane.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞机移动时在空气中留下的湍流。

definitions.definition: Ground washed away to the sea or a river.
definitions.definitionCn: 被冲刷入海或河流的土地。

definitions.definition: A piece of ground washed by the action of water, or sometimes covered and sometimes left dry; the shallowest part of a river, or arm of the sea; also, a bog; a marsh.
definitions.definitionCn: 被水流冲刷、时而淹没时而裸露的土地；河流或海湾最浅的部分；也指沼泽或湿地。

definitions.definition: A shallow body of water.
definitions.definitionCn: 浅水体。

definitions.definition: In arid and semi-arid regions, the normally dry bed of an intermittent or ephemeral stream; an arroyo or wadi.
definitions.definitionCn: 在干旱和半干旱地区，间歇性或季节性河流通常干涸的河床；干谷或旱谷。

definitions.definition: A situation in which losses and gains or advantages and disadvantages are equivalent; a situation in which there is no net change.
definitions.definitionCn: 损失与收益、优势与劣势相当的情况；无净变化的情况。

definitions.definition: A fictitious kind of sale of stock or other securities between parties of one interest, or by a broker who is both buyer and seller, and who minds his own interest rather than that of his clients.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一利益方之间或既是买方又是卖方、只顾自身利益不顾客户的经纪人之间进行的股票或其他证券的虚假交易。

definitions.definition: Waste liquid, the refuse of food, the collection from washed dishes, etc., from a kitchen, often used as food for pigs; pigwash.
definitions.definitionCn: 厨房产生的废液、食物残渣、洗碗水等，常作为猪食；猪食。

definitions.definition: In distilling, the fermented wort before the spirit is extracted.
definitions.definitionCn: 蒸馏过程中，提取酒精前的发酵麦芽汁。

definitions.definition: A mixture of dunder, molasses, water, and scummings, used in the West Indies for distillation.
definitions.definitionCn: 西印度群岛用于蒸馏的混合物，由酒糟、糖蜜、水和浮渣组成。

definitions.definition: A thin coat of paint or metal laid on anything for beauty or preservation.
definitions.definitionCn: 为美观或保护而涂在物体上的薄层涂料或金属。

definitions.definition: The blade of an oar.
definitions.definitionCn: 船桨的桨叶。

definitions.definition: The backward current or disturbed water caused by the action of oars, or of a steamer's screw or paddles, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 由船桨、轮船螺旋桨或明轮等动作引起的逆流或扰动的水流。

definitions.definition: Ten strikes, or bushels, of oysters.
definitions.definitionCn: 十蒲式耳的牡蛎。

definitions.definition: The upper surface of a member or material when given a slope to shed water; hence, a structure or receptacle shaped so as to receive and carry off water.
definitions.example: a carriage wash in a stable
definitions.definitionCn: 构件或材料的上表面，为排水而设的斜面；也指为接收和排水而设计的结构或容器。
definitions.exampleCn: 马厩中的马车清洗处。

definitions.definition: A lighting effect that fills a scene with a chosen colour.
definitions.definitionCn: 用选定颜色充满场景的灯光效果。

definitions.definition: (stagecraft) A lighting fixture that can cast a wide beam of light to evenly fill an area with light, as opposed to a spotlight.
definitions.definitionCn: （舞台技术）能投射宽光束均匀照亮区域的灯具，与聚光灯相对。

definitions.definition: To clean with water.
definitions.example: Dishwashers wash dishes much more efficiently than most humans.
definitions.definitionCn: 用水清洁。
definitions.exampleCn: 洗碗机洗碗比大多数人高效得多。

definitions.definition: To move or erode by the force of water in motion.
definitions.example: Heavy rains wash a road or an embankment.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过流动水的作用移动或侵蚀。
definitions.exampleCn: 暴雨冲刷道路或堤岸。

definitions.definition: To separate valuable material (such as gold) from worthless material by the action of flowing water.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过流水作用从无用物质中分离有价值物质（如黄金）。

definitions.definition: To clean oneself with water.
definitions.example: I wash every morning after getting up.
definitions.definitionCn: 用水清洁自己。
definitions.exampleCn: 我每天早上起床后都洗漱。

definitions.definition: To cover with water or any liquid; to wet; to fall on and moisten.
definitions.example: Waves wash the shore.
definitions.definitionCn: 用水或任何液体覆盖；弄湿；落下并湿润。
definitions.exampleCn: 波浪冲刷海岸。

definitions.definition: To move with a lapping or swashing sound; to lap or splash.
definitions.example: to hear the water washing
definitions.definitionCn: 发出轻拍或泼溅声地移动；轻拍或泼溅。
definitions.exampleCn: 听到水声拍打。

definitions.definition: To be eroded or carried away by the action of water.
definitions.definitionCn: 被水的作用侵蚀或冲走。

definitions.definition: To be cogent, convincing; to withstand critique.
definitions.definitionCn: 有说服力、令人信服；经得起批评。

definitions.definition: To bear without injury the operation of being washed.
definitions.example: Some calicoes do not wash.
definitions.definitionCn: 经得起清洗而不受损。
definitions.exampleCn: 有些印花布不耐洗。

definitions.definition: To be wasted or worn away by the action of water, as by a running or overflowing stream, or by the dashing of the sea; said of road, a beach, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 被水流（如溪流、洪水或海浪）冲刷而损耗或磨损；指道路、海滩等。

definitions.definition: To cover with a thin or watery coat of colour; to tint lightly and thinly.
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖一层薄薄的水性颜色；轻轻淡淡地着色。

definitions.definition: To overlay with a thin coat of metal.
definitions.example: steel washed with silver
definitions.definitionCn: 覆盖一层薄金属。
definitions.exampleCn: 镀银的钢。

definitions.definition: To cause dephosphorization of (molten pig iron) by adding substances containing iron oxide, and sometimes manganese oxide.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过添加含氧化铁（有时含氧化锰）的物质使（熔融生铁）脱磷。

definitions.definition: To pass (a gas or gaseous mixture) through or over a liquid for the purpose of purifying it, especially by removing soluble constituents.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（气体或混合气体）通过或流经液体以净化，特别是通过去除可溶性成分。

definitions.definition: The act or process of converting the controlling of a machine or device to a more automatic system, such as computer or electronic controls.
definitions.definitionCn: 将机器或设备的控制转换为更自动化系统（如计算机或电子控制）的行为或过程。

definitions.definition: A written or oral indication of a fact, opinion, or belief.
definitions.definitionCn: 对事实、观点或信念的书面或口头说明。

definitions.definition: A list of items for various legal purposes, e.g. customs declaration.
definitions.definitionCn: 为各种法律目的（如海关申报）列出的项目清单。

definitions.definition: The act or process of declaring.
definitions.definitionCn: 宣告的行为或过程。

definitions.definition: The act, by the captain of a batting side, of declaring an innings closed.
definitions.definitionCn: 击球方队长宣布一局结束的行为。

definitions.definition: In common law, the formal document specifying plaintiff's cause of action, including the facts necessary to sustain a proper cause of action, and to advise the defendant of the grounds upon which he is being sued.
definitions.definitionCn: 在普通法中，明确原告诉讼理由的正式文件，包括维持适当诉讼理由所需的事实，并告知被告被起诉的依据。

definitions.definition: The specification of an object, such as a variable or function, establishing its existence but not necessarily describing its contents.
definitions.definitionCn: 对对象（如变量或函数）的说明，确立其存在但不一定描述其内容。

definitions.definition: A thing whose name cannot be remembered; thingamajig, doohickey.
definitions.definitionCn: 记不住名字的东西；玩意儿，小机件。

definitions.definition: Any device or machine, especially one whose name cannot be recalled. Often either clever or complicated.
definitions.example: He bought a neat new gadget for shredding potatoes.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何设备或机器，尤指记不住名称的，常指精巧或复杂的。
definitions.exampleCn: 他买了个切土豆的新奇小工具。

definitions.definition: Any consumer electronics product.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何消费电子产品。

definitions.definition: A sequence of machine code instructions crafted as part of an exploit that attempts to divert execution to a memory location chosen by the attacker.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为漏洞利用的一部分而精心设计的一段机器码指令序列，试图将执行流程转向攻击者选定的内存位置。

definitions.definition: To increase the speed of a motor, or to operate at a higher speed.
definitions.example: He revved the engine in a rather macho style.
definitions.definitionCn: 为了提高电机的速度，或者以更高的速度运行。
definitions.exampleCn: 他以一种相当男子气概的方式猛踩油门。

definitions.definition: Revolution
A member of the Christian clergy; a minister.
The action of trying at something.
definitions.example: It was worth the attempt.
definitions.definitionCn: 尝试某事的行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 这次尝试是值得的。

definitions.definition: An assault or attack, especially an assassination attempt.
definitions.example: 1584 No man can charge us of any attempt against the realm. (Allen's Defence Of English Catholics, cited after Edinburgh review 1883, p. 378)
definitions.definitionCn: 攻击或袭击，尤指暗杀企图。
definitions.exampleCn: 1584年，无人能指控我们对王国有所图谋。（艾伦《为英国天主教徒辩护》，引自《爱丁堡评论》1883年，第378页）

definitions.definition: To try.
definitions.example: A group of 80 budding mountaineers attempted Kilimanjaro, but 30 of them didn't make it to the top.
definitions.definitionCn: 尝试。
definitions.exampleCn: 80名初出茅庐的登山者试图攀登乞力马扎罗山，但其中30人未能登顶。

definitions.definition: To try to move, by entreaty, by afflictions, or by temptations; to tempt.
definitions.definitionCn: 试图通过恳求、磨难或诱惑来动摇；引诱。

definitions.definition: To try to win, subdue, or overcome.
definitions.example: one who attempts the virtue of a woman
definitions.definitionCn: 试图赢得、征服或克服。
definitions.exampleCn: 试图玷污女子贞洁的人。

definitions.definition: To attack; to make an effort or attack upon; to try to take by force.
definitions.example: to attempt the enemy's camp
definitions.definitionCn: 攻击；对……发起进攻或努力；试图以武力夺取。
definitions.exampleCn: 试图袭击敌营。

definitions.definition: The striking of one body against another; collision.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个物体对另一个物体的撞击；碰撞。

definitions.definition: The force or energy of a collision of two objects.
definitions.example: The hatchet cut the wood on impact.
definitions.definitionCn: 两个物体碰撞产生的力或能量。
definitions.exampleCn: 斧头在撞击时砍入木头。

definitions.definition: A forced impinging.
definitions.example: His spine had an impingement; L4 and L5 made impact, which caused numbness in his leg.
definitions.definitionCn: 被迫的冲击。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的脊柱受到撞击；L4和L5发生碰撞，导致他的腿麻木。

definitions.definition: A significant or strong influence; an effect.
definitions.example: His friend's opinion had an impact on his decision.
definitions.definitionCn: 显著或强烈的影响；效果。
definitions.exampleCn: 他朋友的意见对他的决定产生了影响。

definitions.definition: To collide or strike, the act of impinging.
definitions.example: When the hammer impacts the nail, it bends.
definitions.definitionCn: 碰撞或打击，冲击的行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 当锤子撞击钉子时，钉子会弯曲。

definitions.definition: To compress; to compact; to press into something or pack together.
definitions.example: The footprints of birds do not impact the soil in the way those of dinosaurs do.
definitions.definitionCn: 压缩；压实；压入某物或挤在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 鸟类的脚印不会像恐龙的脚印那样对土壤产生影响。

definitions.definition: To influence; to affect; to have an impact on.
definitions.example: I can make the changes, but it will impact the schedule.
definitions.definitionCn: 影响；作用；对……产生影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 我可以做出改变，但这会影响日程安排。

definitions.definition: To stamp or impress onto something.
definitions.example: Ideas impacted on the mind.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……上盖章或压印。
definitions.exampleCn: 思想印在脑海中。

definitions.definition: The first section of the Christian New Testament scripture, comprising the books of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, concerned with the life, crucifixion, death, resurrection, and teachings of Jesus.
definitions.definitionCn: 基督教新约圣经的第一部分，包括马太福音、马可福音、路加福音和约翰福音，涉及耶稣的生平、受难、死亡、复活及教导。

definitions.definition: An account of the life, crucifixion, death, resurrection, and teachings of Jesus, generally written during the first several centuries of the Common Era.
definitions.definitionCn: 关于耶稣生平、受难、死亡、复活及教导的记述，通常写于公元纪年的最初几个世纪。

definitions.definition: The teaching of Divine grace as distinguished from the Law or Divine commandments.
definitions.definitionCn: 与律法或神圣诫命相区别的神恩教导。

definitions.definition: A message expected to have positive reception or effect, one promoted as offering important (or even infalliable) guiding principles.
definitions.definitionCn: 预期会获得积极接受或效果的信息，被宣扬为提供重要（甚至无误）指导原则的内容。

definitions.definition: That which is absolutely authoritative (definitive).
definitions.definitionCn: 绝对权威（决定性）的事物。

definitions.definition: Gospel music.
definitions.definitionCn: 福音音乐。

definitions.definition: To instruct in the gospel.
definitions.definitionCn: 传授福音。

definitions.definition: To cause (something) to cease to be in one's possession or capability due to unfortunate or unknown circumstances, events or reasons.
definitions.example: He lost his hearing in the explosion.
definitions.definitionCn: 因不幸或未知的情况、事件或原因，使（某物）不再属于自己或不再拥有能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在爆炸中失去了听力。

definitions.definition: To wander from; to miss, so as not to be able to find; to go astray from.
definitions.example: I lost my way in the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 偏离；错过，以致无法找到；迷失方向。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在森林里迷了路。

definitions.definition: To fail to win (a game, competition, trial, etc).
definitions.example: We lost the football match.
definitions.definitionCn: 未能赢得（比赛、竞争、审判等）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们输掉了足球比赛。

definitions.definition: To be unable to follow or trace (somebody or something) any longer.
definitions.example: Mission control lost the satellite as its signal died down.
definitions.definitionCn: 无法再追踪或跟随（某人或某物）。
definitions.exampleCn: 随着信号减弱，任务控制中心失去了与卫星的联系。

definitions.definition: To cause (somebody) to be unable to follow or trace one any longer.
definitions.example: We managed to lose our pursuers in the forest.
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）无法再追踪或跟随自己。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们设法在森林里甩掉了追踪者。

definitions.definition: To cease exhibiting; to overcome (a behavior or emotion).
definitions.definitionCn: 不再表现出；克服（某种行为或情绪）。

definitions.definition: To shed, remove, discard, or eliminate.
definitions.example: When we get into the building, please lose the hat.
definitions.definitionCn: 脱落、移除、丢弃或消除。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们进入大楼后，请摘下帽子。

definitions.definition: Of a clock, to run slower than expected.
definitions.example: It's already 5:30? My watch must have lost a few minutes.
definitions.definitionCn: （指钟表）走得比预期慢。
definitions.exampleCn: 已经5:30了？我的表肯定慢了几分钟。

definitions.definition: (ditransitive) To cause (someone) the loss of something; to deprive of.
definitions.definitionCn: （双宾语动词）使（某人）失去某物；剥夺。

definitions.definition: To fail to catch with the mind or senses; to miss.
definitions.example: I lost a part of what he said.
definitions.definitionCn: 未能用头脑或感官捕捉到；错过。
definitions.exampleCn: 他说的有一部分我没听清。

definitions.definition: To cause to part with; to deprive of.
definitions.definitionCn: 使失去；剥夺。

definitions.definition: The process by which something is lost; a loss.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物丢失的过程；损失。

definitions.definition: That loses or has lost.
definitions.example: Being on the losing team is disappointing.
definitions.definitionCn: 丢失的或已失去的。
definitions.exampleCn: 在输掉的队伍里令人失望。

definitions.definition: The part of a plant, generally underground, that anchors and supports the plant body, absorbs and stores water and nutrients, and in some plants is able to perform vegetative reproduction.
definitions.example: This tree's roots can go as deep as twenty metres underground.
definitions.definitionCn: 植物的部分，通常位于地下，用于固定和支撑植物体，吸收并储存水分和养分，在某些植物中还能进行营养繁殖。
definitions.exampleCn: 这棵树的根可深入地下二十米。

definitions.definition: A root vegetable.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种根茎类蔬菜。

definitions.definition: The part of a tooth extending into the bone holding the tooth in place.
definitions.example: Root damage is a common problem of overbrushing.
definitions.definitionCn: 牙齿延伸入骨骼的部分，用于固定牙齿。
definitions.exampleCn: 根部损伤是过度刷牙的常见问题。

definitions.definition: The part of a hair under the skin that holds the hair in place.
definitions.example: The root is the only part of the hair that is alive.
definitions.definitionCn: 头发在皮肤下的部分，用于固定头发。
definitions.exampleCn: 根部是头发唯一存活的部分。

definitions.definition: The part of a hair near the skin that has not been dyed, permed, or otherwise treated.
definitions.example: He dyed his hair black last month, so the grey roots can be seen.
definitions.definitionCn: 靠近皮肤、未经染色、烫发或其他处理的头发部分。
definitions.exampleCn: 他上个月把头发染黑了，所以能看到灰色的发根。

definitions.definition: The primary source; origin.
definitions.example: The love of money is the root of all evil.
definitions.definitionCn: 主要来源；起源。
definitions.exampleCn: 贪财是万恶之源。

definitions.definition: Of a number or expression, a number which, when raised to a specified power, yields the specified number or expression.
definitions.example: The cube root of 27 is 3.
definitions.definitionCn: 对于数字或表达式，将其乘方到指定幂次后得到该数字或表达式的数。
definitions.exampleCn: 27的立方根是3。

definitions.definition: A square root (understood if no power is specified; in which case, “the root of” is often abbreviated to “root”).
definitions.example: Multiply by root 2.
definitions.definitionCn: 平方根（若未指定幂次则默认如此；此时“的根”常简写为“根”）。
definitions.exampleCn: 乘以根号2。

definitions.definition: A zero (of an equation).
definitions.definitionCn: （方程的）零解。

definitions.definition: The single node of a tree that has no parent.
definitions.definitionCn: 树结构中无父节点的唯一节点。

definitions.definition: The primary lexical unit of a word, which carries the most significant aspects of semantic content and cannot be reduced into smaller constituents. Inflectional stems often derive from roots.
definitions.definitionCn: 单词的主要词汇单位，承载语义内容的最重要方面，且无法再分解为更小的成分。屈折词干常源于词根。

definitions.definition: (philology) A word from which another word or words are derived.
definitions.definitionCn: （语文学）衍生出其他单词的词。

definitions.definition: The fundamental tone of any chord; the tone from whose harmonics, or overtones, a chord is composed.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何和弦的基础音；构成和弦的泛音或谐音的基础音。

definitions.definition: The lowest place, position, or part.
definitions.definitionCn: 最低的位置、地点或部分。

definitions.definition: In UNIX terminology, the first user account with complete access to the operating system and its configuration, found at the root of the directory structure; the person who manages accounts on a UNIX system.
definitions.example: I have to log in as root before I do that.
definitions.definitionCn: 在UNIX术语中，拥有操作系统及其配置完全访问权限的第一个用户账户，位于目录结构的根目录；管理UNIX系统账户的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 做那件事之前，我必须先以root身份登录。

definitions.definition: The highest directory of a directory structure which may contain both files and subdirectories.
definitions.example: I installed the files in the root directory.
definitions.definitionCn: 目录结构中的最高目录，可包含文件和子目录。
definitions.exampleCn: 我将文件安装在根目录下。

definitions.definition: A penis, especially the base of a penis.
definitions.definitionCn: 阴茎，尤指阴茎根部。

definitions.definition: An act of sexual intercourse.
definitions.example: Fancy a root?
definitions.definitionCn: 性交行为。
definitions.exampleCn: 想来一次性交吗？

definitions.definition: A sexual partner.
definitions.definitionCn: 性伴侣。

definitions.definition: Ancestry.
definitions.example: I have both Irish and German roots.
definitions.definitionCn: 祖先。
definitions.exampleCn: 我有爱尔兰和德国血统。

definitions.definition: Beginnings; origin.
definitions.example: Jazz has its roots in blues.
definitions.definitionCn: 起源；开端。
definitions.exampleCn: 爵士乐源于蓝调。

definitions.definition: To lead by persuasion or influence; incite or prevail upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过说服或影响来引导；煽动或说服。

definitions.definition: To cause, bring about, lead to.
definitions.example: His meditation induced a compromise.   Opium induces sleep.
definitions.definitionCn: 导致、引起、引发。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的沉思促成了一项妥协。鸦片引发睡眠。

definitions.definition: To cause or produce (electric current or a magnetic state) by a physical process of induction.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过感应物理过程引起或产生（电流或磁状态）。

definitions.definition: To infer by induction.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过归纳法推断。

definitions.definition: To lead in, bring in, introduce.
definitions.definitionCn: 引入、带入、介绍。

definitions.definition: To draw on, place upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加、置于之上。

definitions.definition: To make ready for a specific future purpose; to set up; to assemble or equip.
definitions.example: We prepared the spacecraft for takeoff.
definitions.definitionCn: 为特定未来目的做准备；设立；组装或装备。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们为航天器的发射做好了准备。

definitions.definition: To make ready for eating or drinking; to cook.
definitions.example: We prepared a fish for dinner.
definitions.definitionCn: 为食用或饮用做准备；烹饪。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们为晚餐准备了一条鱼。

definitions.definition: To make oneself ready; to get ready, make preparation.
definitions.example: We prepared for a bumpy ride.
definitions.definitionCn: 让自己做好准备；准备好，做准备工作。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们为颠簸的旅程做好了准备。

definitions.definition: To produce or make by combining elements; to synthesize, compound.
definitions.example: She prepared a meal from what was left in the cupboards.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过组合元素来生产或制造；合成，混合。
definitions.exampleCn: 她用橱柜里剩下的东西准备了一顿饭。

definitions.definition: Preparation
definitions.definitionCn: 准备

definitions.definition: To gain (success, reward, recognition) through applied effort or work.
definitions.example: You can have the s'mores: you earned them, clearing the walkway of snow so well.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过应用努力或工作获得（成功、奖励、认可）。
definitions.exampleCn: 你可以吃棉花糖夹心饼：你应得的，因为你把走道上的雪清理得这么好。

definitions.definition: To receive payment for work.
definitions.example: He earns seven million dollars a year as CEO.  My bank account is only earning one percent interest.
definitions.definitionCn: 因工作而获得报酬。
definitions.exampleCn: 他作为CEO年薪七百万美元。我的银行账户只赚取百分之一的利息。

definitions.definition: To receive payment for work.
definitions.example: Now that you are earning, you can start paying me rent.
definitions.definitionCn: 因工作而获得报酬。
definitions.exampleCn: 既然你开始赚钱了，就可以开始付我房租了。

definitions.definition: To cause (someone) to receive payment or reward.
definitions.example: My CD earns me six percent!
definitions.definitionCn: 使（某人）获得报酬或奖励。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的定期存款让我赚取百分之六的利息！

definitions.definition: To achieve by being worthy of.
definitions.example: to earn a spot in the top 20
definitions.definitionCn: 通过配得而实现。
definitions.exampleCn: 跻身前20名

definitions.definition: To curdle, as milk.
definitions.definitionCn: （牛奶）凝结。

definitions.definition: To long; to yearn.
definitions.definitionCn: 渴望；思念。

definitions.definition: To grieve.
definitions.definitionCn: 悲伤。

definitions.definition: To connect two or more things.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接两个或多个事物。

definitions.definition: (of a Web page) To contain a hyperlink to another page.
definitions.example: My homepage links to my wife's.
definitions.definitionCn: （指网页）包含指向另一个页面的超链接。
definitions.exampleCn: 我的主页链接到我妻子的主页。

definitions.definition: To supply (somebody) with a hyperlink; to direct by means of a link.
definitions.example: Haven't you seen his Web site? I'll link you to it.
definitions.definitionCn: 向（某人）提供超链接；通过链接引导。
definitions.exampleCn: 你没看过他的网站吗？我发链接给你。

definitions.definition: To post a hyperlink to.
definitions.example: Stop linking those unfunny comics all the time!
definitions.definitionCn: 发布超链接。
definitions.exampleCn: 别再一直发那些不好笑的漫画链接了！

definitions.definition: To demonstrate a correlation between two things.
definitions.definitionCn: 证明两个事物之间存在关联。

definitions.definition: To combine objects generated by a compiler into a single executable.
definitions.definitionCn: 将编译器生成的对象合并为单个可执行文件。

definitions.definition: To skip or trip along smartly; to go quickly.
definitions.definitionCn: 轻快地跳跃或疾行；快速移动。

definitions.definition: Linkage
definitions.definitionCn: 连接

definitions.definition: Serving to connect other things together.
definitions.example: Conjunctions frequently function as linking words in a sentence.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于将其他事物连接在一起。
definitions.exampleCn: 连词在句子中常起连接作用。

definitions.definition: Any condition, circumstance, opportunity or means, particularly favorable to success, or to any desired end.
definitions.example: The enemy had the advantage of a more elevated position.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何条件、环境、机会或手段，尤其有利于成功或达成任何预期目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 敌人占据了更高地势的优势。

definitions.definition: Superiority; mastery; — used with of to specify its nature or with over to specify the other party.
definitions.definitionCn: 优势；掌控——与of连用指明其性质，或与over连用指明另一方。

definitions.definition: Superiority of state, or that which gives it; benefit; gain; profit
definitions.example: Having the faster car is of little advantage.
definitions.definitionCn: 状态上的优势，或带来优势的事物；利益；收益；利润
definitions.exampleCn: 拥有更快的汽车几乎没什么优势。

definitions.definition: The score where one player wins a point after deuce but needs the next to carry the game.
definitions.definitionCn: 平局后一方赢得一分但需再得一分才能获胜的比分。

definitions.definition: The continuation of the game after a foul against the attacking team, because the attacking team are in an advantageous position.
definitions.definitionCn: 进攻方犯规后比赛继续，因为进攻方处于有利位置。

definitions.definition: Interest of money; increase; overplus (as the thirteenth in the baker's dozen).
definitions.definitionCn: 利息；增长；盈余（如面包师的一打中的第十三个）。

definitions.definition: To provide (someone) with an advantage, to give an edge to
definitions.definitionCn: 为（某人）提供优势，赋予其有利条件。

definitions.definition: To do something for one's own benefit; to take advantage of
definitions.definitionCn: 为自身利益行事；利用。

definitions.definition: The act of extending; a stretching out; enlargement in length or breadth; an increase
definitions.definitionCn: 延伸的行为；伸展；长度或宽度的增加；增长

definitions.definition: The state of being extended
definitions.definitionCn: 被延伸的状态

definitions.definition: That property of a body by which it occupies a portion of space (or time, e.g. "spatiotemporal extension")
definitions.definitionCn: 物体占据空间（或时间，例如“时空延伸”）的属性

definitions.definition: A part of a building that has been extended from the original
definitions.definitionCn: 从原建筑扩展出的部分

definitions.definition: Capacity of a concept or general term to include a greater or smaller number of objects; — correlative of intension.
definitions.definitionCn: 概念或一般术语包含对象数量多或少的容量；——内涵的相对词

definitions.definition: A written engagement on the part of a creditor, allowing a debtor further time to pay a debt.
definitions.definitionCn: 债权人允许债务人延期偿还债务的书面约定

definitions.definition: The operation of stretching a broken bone so as to bring the fragments into the same straight line.
definitions.definitionCn: 拉伸骨折的骨头以使碎片对齐的操作

definitions.definition: An exercise in which an arm or leg is straightened against resistance.
definitions.definitionCn: 手臂或腿部对抗阻力伸直的运动

definitions.definition: A simple offensive action, consisting of extending the weapon arm forward.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种简单的进攻动作，包括将武器臂向前伸展

definitions.definition: A numerical code used to specify a specific telephone in a telecommunication network.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于指定电信网络中特定电话的数字代码

definitions.definition: A file extension.
definitions.example: Files with the .txt extension usually contain text.
definitions.definitionCn: 文件扩展名
definitions.exampleCn: 扩展名为.txt的文件通常包含文本

definitions.definition: An optional software component that adds functionality to an application.
definitions.example: a browser extension
definitions.definitionCn: 为应用程序添加功能的可选软件组件
definitions.exampleCn: 浏览器扩展

definitions.definition: The set of tuples of values that, used as arguments, satisfy the predicate.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为参数使用时满足谓词的元组集合

definitions.definition: (grammar) A kind of derivative morpheme applied to verbs in Bantu languages.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）班图语言中应用于动词的一种派生语素

definitions.definition: A young servant or follower; a trained military attendant in service of a lord.
definitions.definitionCn: 年轻的仆从或随从；服务于领主的受训军事侍从。

definitions.definition: A minor nobleman with an honourable military rank who had served as a page and squire.
definitions.definitionCn: 拥有荣誉军衔的次等贵族，曾担任侍童和扈从。

definitions.definition: (by extension) An armored and mounted warrior of the Middle Ages.
definitions.example: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）中世纪的装甲骑兵。
definitions.exampleCn: 亚瑟王与圆桌骑士。

definitions.definition: (modern) A person on whom a knighthood has been conferred by a monarch.
definitions.definitionCn: （现代）由君主授予骑士爵位的人。

definitions.definition: A brave, chivalrous and honorable man devoted to a noble cause or love interest.
definitions.definitionCn: 献身于崇高事业或爱情，勇敢、侠义且高尚的人。

definitions.definition: A chess piece, often in the shape of a horse's head, that is moved two squares in one direction and one at right angles to that direction in a single move, leaping over any intervening pieces.
definitions.definitionCn: 国际象棋棋子，常呈马头形状，走法为沿一个方向移动两格，再垂直移动一格，可跨越中间棋子。

definitions.definition: A playing card bearing the figure of a knight; the knave or jack.
definitions.definitionCn: 印有骑士图案的扑克牌；即侍从或杰克。

definitions.definition: Any of various nymphalid butterflies of the genus Ypthima.
definitions.definitionCn: 属于眼蝶属的各种蛱蝶。

definitions.definition: (modern) A generic name for various mushrooms belonging to the fungal order gilled mushrooms; scientific name Tricholoma.
definitions.definitionCn: （现代）泛指真菌目下多种蘑菇的通用名称；学名为口蘑属。

definitions.definition: To confer knighthood upon.
definitions.example: The king knighted the young squire.

definitions.definition: To promote (a pawn) to a knight.
An application for the removal of a cause or suit from an inferior to a superior judge or court for re-examination or review.
definitions.definitionCn: 将案件或诉讼从下级法官或法院移送至上级法官或法院进行复审或审查的申请。

definitions.definition: The mode of proceeding by which such removal is effected.
definitions.definitionCn: 实现此种移送的程序方式。

definitions.definition: The right of appeal.
definitions.definitionCn: 上诉权。

definitions.definition: An accusation; a process which formerly might be instituted by one private person against another for some heinous crime demanding punishment for the particular injury suffered, rather than for the offense against the public.
definitions.definitionCn: 指控；一种程序，过去可由私人针对另一人提起，针对某种严重罪行，要求惩罚所遭受的特定伤害，而非针对公共违法行为。

definitions.definition: An accusation of a felon at common law by one of his accomplices, which accomplice was then called an approver.
definitions.definitionCn: 普通法中由同案犯对重罪犯的指控，该同案犯当时被称为“告发者”。

definitions.definition: A summons to answer to a charge.
definitions.definitionCn: 传唤以回应指控。

definitions.definition: A call to a person or an authority for help, proof or a decision; entreaty.
definitions.example: He made an appeal for volunteers to help at the festival.
definitions.definitionCn: 向某人或权威机构请求帮助、证据或裁决；恳求。
definitions.exampleCn: 他呼吁志愿者在节日期间提供帮助。

definitions.definition: Resort to physical means; recourse.
definitions.definitionCn: 诉诸物理手段；求助。

definitions.definition: Power to attract or interest.
definitions.definitionCn: 吸引或引起兴趣的能力。

definitions.definition: A call to or use of a principle or quality for purposes of persuasion.
definitions.definitionCn: 为说服目的而援引或使用某种原则或品质。

definitions.definition: To call upon another to decide a question controverted, to corroborate a statement, to vindicate one's rights, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 请求他人裁决争议问题、证实陈述、维护自身权利等。

definitions.definition: To call on (someone) for aid
definitions.example: I appeal to all of you to help the orphans.
definitions.definitionCn: 向（某人）请求援助。
definitions.exampleCn: 我呼吁你们所有人帮助孤儿。

definitions.definition: (informal elsewhere) To apply for the removal of a cause from an inferior to a superior judge or court for the purpose of reexamination or for decision.
definitions.definitionCn: （非正式场合）申请将案件从下级法院移送至上级法院以进行复审或裁决。

definitions.definition: To be attractive.
definitions.example: That idea appeals to me.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有吸引力。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个想法吸引了我。

definitions.definition: To ask an umpire for a decision on whether a batsman is out or not, usually by saying "How's that" or "Howzat".
definitions.definitionCn: 向裁判询问击球手是否出局的决定，通常通过说“How's that”或“Howzat”。

definitions.definition: To accuse (someone of something).
definitions.definitionCn: 指控（某人某事）。

definitions.definition: To summon; to challenge.
definitions.definitionCn: 传唤；挑战。

definitions.definition: To invoke (used with to).
definitions.definitionCn: 援引（与to连用）。

definitions.definition: The pointing of a weapon, as a gun, a dart, or an arrow, or object, in the line of direction with the object intended to be struck; the line of fire; the direction of anything, such as a spear, a blow, a discourse, a remark, towards a particular point or object, with a view to strike or affect it.
definitions.example: Take time with the aim of your gun.
definitions.definitionCn: 武器（如枪、飞镖或箭）或物体指向目标预定击中的方向线；射击线；任何事物（如矛、打击、话语、评论）朝向特定点或目标的方向，旨在击中或影响该目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 花时间校准你的枪口目标。

definitions.definition: The point intended to be hit, or object intended to be attained or affected.
definitions.definitionCn: 预定击中的点，或意图达到或影响的目标。

definitions.definition: Intention or goal
definitions.example: My number one aim in life is to make money to make my parents, siblings and kids happy.
definitions.definitionCn: 意图或目标
definitions.exampleCn: 我人生的首要目标是赚钱，让父母、兄弟姐妹和孩子幸福。

definitions.definition: The ability of someone to aim straight; one's faculty for being able to hit a physical target
definitions.example: The police officer has excellent aim, always hitting the bullseye in shooting practice.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人瞄准的能力；击中物理目标的技能
definitions.exampleCn: 这位警官枪法精准，射击训练中总能命中靶心。

definitions.definition: Conjecture; guess.
definitions.definitionCn: 推测；猜测。

definitions.definition: To point or direct a missile, or a weapon which propels as missile, towards an object or spot with the intent of hitting it
definitions.example: He aimed at the target, but the arrow flew straight over it.
definitions.definitionCn: 将导弹或发射导弹的武器指向或对准某物体或地点，意图击中它
definitions.exampleCn: 他瞄准了靶子，但箭却径直飞过了靶子。

definitions.definition: To direct the intention or purpose; to attempt the accomplishment of a purpose; to try to gain; to endeavor;—followed by at, or by an infinitive
definitions.example: to aim at a pass
definitions.definitionCn: 引导意图或目的；试图完成某个目标；努力争取；尝试；——后接at或不定式
definitions.exampleCn: 试图传球

definitions.definition: To direct or point (e.g. a weapon), at a particular object; to direct, as a missile, an act, or a proceeding, at, to, or against an object
definitions.example: She aimed a punch at her ex-boyfriend.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（如武器）指向或对准特定物体；将导弹、行动或过程指向、对准或针对某物体
definitions.exampleCn: 她朝前男友挥出一拳。

definitions.definition: To direct (something verbal) towards a certain person, thing, or group
definitions.example: to aim a satirical comment at Communists in general
definitions.definitionCn: 将（言语性内容）指向特定的人、事物或群体
definitions.exampleCn: 对共产主义者发表讽刺评论。

definitions.definition: To guess or conjecture.
definitions.definitionCn: 猜测或推测。

definitions.definition: Strong affection.
definitions.definitionCn: 深情厚爱。

definitions.definition: A person who is the object of romantic feelings; a darling, a sweetheart, a beloved.
definitions.definitionCn: 浪漫情感的对象；亲爱的，心上人，挚爱。

definitions.definition: A term of friendly address, regardless of feelings.
definitions.example: Hello love, how can I help you?
definitions.definitionCn: 友好称呼，无关情感。
definitions.exampleCn: 你好亲爱的，有什么能帮你的？

definitions.definition: A thing, activity etc which is the object of one's deep liking or enthusiasm.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人深深喜爱或热衷的事物、活动等。

definitions.definition: Sexual desire; attachment based on sexual attraction.
definitions.definitionCn: 性欲；基于性吸引的依恋。

definitions.definition: Sexual activity.
definitions.definitionCn: 性行为。

definitions.definition: An instance or episode of being in love; a love affair.
definitions.definitionCn: 恋爱中的一段经历或插曲；风流韵事。

definitions.definition: Used as the closing, before the signature, of a letter, especially between good friends or family members, or by the young.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于信件结尾签名前，尤其好友、家人或年轻人之间。

definitions.definition: Alternative letter-case form of Love.
definitions.definitionCn: “爱”一词的另一种大写形式。

definitions.definition: A thin silk material.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种薄丝绸面料。

definitions.definition: A climbing plant, Clematis vitalba.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种攀缘植物，铁线莲。

definitions.definition: (usually transitive, sometimes intransitive, stative) To have a strong affection for (someone or something).
definitions.example: I love my spouse.   I love you!
definitions.definitionCn: （通常及物，有时不及物，状态动词）对（某人或某物）怀有深厚感情。
definitions.exampleCn: 我爱我的配偶。我爱你！

definitions.definition: To need, thrive on.
definitions.example: Mold loves moist, dark places.
definitions.definitionCn: 需要，依赖。
definitions.exampleCn: 霉菌喜欢潮湿阴暗的地方。

definitions.definition: To be strongly inclined towards something; an emphatic form of like.
definitions.example: I love walking barefoot on wet grass;  I'd love to join the team;  I love what you've done with your hair
definitions.definitionCn: 强烈倾向于某事；强调形式的“喜欢”。
definitions.exampleCn: 我喜欢赤脚走在湿草地上；我很想加入团队；我喜欢你做的发型。

definitions.definition: (usually transitive, sometimes intransitive) To care deeply about, to be dedicated to (someone or something).
definitions.definitionCn: （通常及物，有时不及物）深切关心，致力于（某人或某物）。

definitions.definition: To derive delight from a fact or situation.
definitions.example: I love the fact that the coffee shop now offers fat-free chai latte.
definitions.definitionCn: 从事实或情况中获得愉悦。
definitions.exampleCn: 我很高兴咖啡店现在提供脱脂柴拿铁。

definitions.definition: To have sex with (perhaps from make love).
definitions.example: I wish I could love her all night long.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……发生性关系（可能源自“做爱”）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我希望我能整夜爱她。

definitions.definition: To praise; commend.
definitions.definitionCn: 赞美；称赞。

definitions.definition: To praise as of value; prize; set a price on.
definitions.definitionCn: 珍视其价值；定价。

definitions.definition: An instance of a disease or poor health.
definitions.example: Her grandmother had passed away after a long illness.
definitions.definitionCn: 疾病或健康状况不佳的实例。
definitions.exampleCn: 她的祖母在长期患病后去世了。

definitions.definition: A state of bad health or disease.
definitions.example: Many working days this year have been lost through illness.
definitions.definitionCn: 健康状况不佳或疾病的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 今年因疾病损失了许多工作日。

definitions.definition: (especially Britain) A group of sporting activities including track and field, road running, cross country and racewalking.
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指英国）一组包括田径、公路跑、越野跑和竞走的体育活动。

definitions.definition: (especially US) Physical activities such as sports and games requiring stamina, fitness and skill.
definitions.definitionCn: （尤指美国）需要耐力、体能和技巧的体育和游戏等身体活动。

definitions.definition: A situation which allows a mutually exclusive choice between two or more possibilities; a choice between two or more possibilities.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种允许在两个或多个可能性之间进行互斥选择的情况；在两个或多个可能性之间做出的选择。

definitions.definition: One of several mutually exclusive things which can be chosen.
definitions.definitionCn: 可供选择的几个互斥事物之一。

definitions.definition: The remaining option; something available after other possibilities have been exhausted.
definitions.definitionCn: 剩余的选择；在其他可能性用尽后仍可用的东西。

definitions.definition: Alternative rock
definitions.definitionCn: 另类摇滚。

definitions.definition: To hang down.
definitions.definitionCn: 垂下。

definitions.definition: To arch over (something); to vault.
definitions.definitionCn: 拱形覆盖（某物）；成穹状。

definitions.definition: To hang; to depend.
definitions.definitionCn: 悬挂；依赖。

definitions.definition: To pen; to confine.
definitions.definitionCn: 关押；限制。

definitions.definition: To consider pending; to delay or postpone (something).
definitions.definitionCn: 搁置；延迟或推迟（某事）。

definitions.definition: Awaiting a conclusion or a confirmation.
definitions.definitionCn: 等待结论或确认。

definitions.definition: Begun but not completed.
definitions.definitionCn: 已开始但未完成。

definitions.definition: About to happen; imminent or impending.
definitions.definitionCn: 即将发生；迫近。

definitions.definition: While waiting for something; until.
definitions.example: Pending the outcome of the investigation, the police officer is suspended from duty.
definitions.definitionCn: 在等待某事期间；直到。
definitions.exampleCn: 在调查结果出来之前，该警官被停职。

definitions.definition: During.
definitions.example: Pending the investigation, the police officer is suspended from duty.
definitions.definitionCn: 在……期间。
definitions.exampleCn: 在调查期间，该警官被停职。

definitions.definition: To set the boundaries or limits of.
definitions.definitionCn: 设定边界或限制。

definitions.definition: To ascertain definitely; to figure out, find out, or conclude by analyzing, calculating, or investigating.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过分析、计算或调查明确确定；找出、发现或得出结论。

definitions.definition: To fix the form or character of; to shape; to prescribe imperatively; to regulate; to settle.
definitions.definitionCn: 固定形式或特征；塑造；强制规定；调节；解决。

definitions.definition: To fix the course of; to impel and direct; with a remoter object preceded by to.
definitions.example: The news of his father's illness determined him to depart immediately.
definitions.definitionCn: 确定方向；推动并引导；后接介词to指向更远的目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 父亲生病的消息使他决定立即出发。

definitions.definition: To bring to a conclusion, as a question or controversy; to settle authoritative or judicial sentence; to decide.
definitions.example: The court has determined the cause.
definitions.definitionCn: 对问题或争议作出结论；通过权威或司法判决解决；裁决。
definitions.exampleCn: 法院已裁决此案。

definitions.definition: To resolve on; to have a fixed intention of; also, to cause to come to a conclusion or decision; to lead.
definitions.example: I determined to go home at once.
definitions.definitionCn: 下定决心；有固定意图；亦指促使得出结论或决定；引导。
definitions.exampleCn: 我决定立刻回家。

definitions.definition: To define or limit by adding a differentia.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过添加种差来定义或限定。

definitions.definition: To bring to an end; to finish.
definitions.definitionCn: 使结束；完成。

definitions.definition: A non-commissioned officer army rank with NATO code OR-4. The rank below a sergeant but above a lance corporal and private.
definitions.definitionCn: 北约代码OR-4的军士军衔，低于中士但高于一等兵和列兵。

definitions.definition: A non-commissioned officer rank in the police force, below a sergeant but above a private or patrolman.
definitions.definitionCn: 警察部队中的士官衔级，低于警长但高于警员或巡警。

definitions.definition: A worker in charge of the wagonway, reporting to the deputy.
definitions.definitionCn: 负责马车道的工人，向副手汇报。

definitions.definition: The white linen cloth on which the elements of the Eucharist are placed; a communion cloth.
definitions.definitionCn: 放置圣餐元素的白亚麻布；圣餐布。

definitions.definition: A body corporate, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members, and powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members.
definitions.definitionCn: 依法或经法律授权设立的法人实体，其存续独立于成员存续，且权力与责任区别于成员。

definitions.definition: The municipal governing body of a borough or city.
definitions.definitionCn: 自治市或城市的市政管理机构。

definitions.definition: In Fascist Italy, a joint association of employers' and workers' representatives.
definitions.definitionCn: 在法西斯意大利，雇主与工人代表的联合协会。

definitions.definition: A protruding belly; a paunch.
definitions.definitionCn: 凸出的腹部；大肚子。

definitions.definition: Nice
definitions.definitionCn: 好的。

definitions.definition: To subject to the process of acclimation.
definitions.example: I became conditioned to the absence of seasons in San Diego.
definitions.definitionCn: 适应环境的过程。
definitions.exampleCn: 我逐渐习惯了圣地亚哥没有季节变化的状态。

definitions.definition: To subject to different conditions, especially as an exercise.
definitions.example: They were conditioning their shins in their karate class.
definitions.definitionCn: 使适应不同条件，尤指作为训练。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们在空手道课上锻炼胫骨。

definitions.definition: To place conditions or limitations upon.
definitions.definitionCn: 施加条件或限制。

definitions.definition: To shape the behaviour of someone to do something.
definitions.definitionCn: 塑造某人的行为以使其做某事。

definitions.definition: To treat (the hair) with hair conditioner.
definitions.definitionCn: 用护发素处理（头发）。

definitions.definition: To contract; to stipulate; to agree.
definitions.definitionCn: 订立契约；规定条件；达成一致。

definitions.definition: To test or assay, as silk (to ascertain the proportion of moisture it contains).
definitions.definitionCn: 测试或检验，如丝绸（以确定其含水量）。

definitions.definition: (colleges) To put under conditions; to require to pass a new examination or to make up a specified study, as a condition of remaining in one's class or in college.
definitions.example: to condition a student who has failed in some branch of study
definitions.definitionCn: （大学）设定条件；要求补考或完成指定课程，作为留级或继续学业的条件。
definitions.exampleCn: 对某学科不及格的学生设定条件。

definitions.definition: To impose upon an object those relations or conditions without which knowledge and thought are alleged to be impossible.
definitions.definitionCn: 赋予对象那些据称是知识和思想所必需的关系或条件。

definitions.definition: The process of modifying a person or animal's behaviour.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变人或动物行为的过程。

definitions.definition: Any preparation or training, especially athletic training of the body.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何准备或训练，尤指身体运动训练。

definitions.definition: The storage of a material specimen under specified temperature, humidity for a specified time prior to testing.
definitions.definitionCn: 在测试前，将材料样本在指定温度、湿度下存放指定时间。

definitions.definition: To make a reply or response to.
definitions.example: He answered the question.
definitions.definitionCn: 作出答复或回应。
definitions.exampleCn: 他回答了这个问题。

definitions.definition: To speak in defence against; to reply to in defence.
definitions.example: to answer a charge or accusation
definitions.definitionCn: 为辩护而发言；为辩护而答复。
definitions.exampleCn: 回应指控或控告

definitions.definition: To respond to a call by someone at a door or telephone, or other similar piece of equipment.
definitions.example: Nobody answered when I knocked on the door.
definitions.definitionCn: 回应某人通过门、电话或其他类似设备的呼叫。
definitions.exampleCn: 我敲门时没人应答。

definitions.definition: To suit a need or purpose satisfactorily.
definitions.example: It answers the need.
definitions.definitionCn: 满足某种需求或目的。
definitions.exampleCn: 它满足了需求。

definitions.definition: To be accountable or responsible; to make amends.
definitions.example: He has a lot to answer for.
definitions.definitionCn: 承担责任或负责；弥补过失。
definitions.exampleCn: 他有很多需要负责的事。

definitions.definition: To file a document in response to a complaint.
definitions.definitionCn: 提交文件以回应投诉。

definitions.definition: To correspond to; to be in harmony with; to be in agreement with.
definitions.definitionCn: 与……相符；与……协调；与……一致。

definitions.definition: To be opposite, or to act in opposition.
definitions.definitionCn: 相对或对立行动。

definitions.definition: To be or act in conformity, or by way of accommodation, correspondence, relation, or proportion; to conform; to correspond; to suit; usually with to.
definitions.definitionCn: 以符合、适应、对应、关联或比例的方式行事；符合；对应；适合；通常与to连用。

definitions.definition: To respond to satisfactorily; to meet successfully by way of explanation, argument, or justification; to refute.
definitions.definitionCn: 满意地回应；通过解释、论证或辩护成功应对；反驳。

definitions.definition: To be or act in compliance with, in fulfillment or satisfaction of, as an order, obligation, or demand.
definitions.example: He answered my claim upon him.
definitions.definitionCn: 遵守、履行或满足命令、义务或要求。
definitions.exampleCn: 他回应了我对他的要求。

definitions.definition: To render account to or for.
definitions.definitionCn: 向……交代或负责。

definitions.definition: To atone for; to be punished for.
definitions.definitionCn: 为……赎罪；因……受惩罚。

definitions.definition: To be or act as an equivalent to, or as adequate or sufficient for; to serve for; to repay.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为……的等价物或足够之物；充当；回报。

definitions.definition: With speed; in a rapid manner.
definitions.example: She packed her case rapidly and hurried out.
definitions.definitionCn: 迅速地；以快速的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 她迅速收拾好箱子，匆匆走了出去。

definitions.definition: A rack of thirty beers.
definitions.definitionCn: 一排三十瓶啤酒。

definitions.definition: The cardinal number occurring after twenty-nine and before thirty-one, represented in Arabic numerals as 30.
definitions.definitionCn: 在二十九之后、三十一之前的基数，用阿拉伯数字表示为30。

definitions.definition: To build or alter according to personal preferences or specifications.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据个人喜好或规格建造或改造。

definitions.definition: A Latin American woman. (Compare Latino.)
definitions.definitionCn: 拉丁美洲女性。（与Latino比较。）

definitions.definition: To grasp a concept fully and thoroughly, especially (of words, statements, art, etc.) to be aware of the meaning of and (of people) to be aware of the intent of.
definitions.example: I'm sorry. I don't understand.
definitions.definitionCn: 为了全面而彻底地掌握一个概念，尤其（指词语、陈述、艺术等）意识到其含义，以及（指人）意识到其意图。

definitions.exampleCn: 我理解你有包裹给我？

definitions.definition: (obsolete outside circus, acrobatics) To stand underneath, to support.
definitions.definitionCn: （除马戏、杂技外已过时）站在下方，支撑。

definitions.definition: Having been comprehended.
definitions.definitionCn: 已被理解。

definitions.definition: Indicates comprehension on the part of the speaker.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示说话者已理解。

definitions.definition: The form of existence belonging to a particular object, entity etc.; a mode of being.

definitions.definition: The change undergone by a word when used in a construction (for instance am => 'm in I'm)

definitions.definition: The result of modifying something; a new or changed form.

definitions.example: Due to his sunbathing, Jim's body experienced modifications: he got a tan.

definitions.definition: A change to a word when it is borrowed by another language
definitions.example: The Chinese word "kòu tóu" had a modification made to become the English "kowtow".
definitions.definitionCn: 单词被另一种语言借用时发生的变化。

definitions.definition: (of a decade of life) Early.

Recently, assurance has been used, in England, in relation to life contingencies, and insurance in relation to other contingencies. It is called temporary assurance, in the time within which the contingent event must happen is limited.

definitions.definition: To direct the attention of.

definitions.definition: To strengthen; refresh; support.
definitions.definitionCn: 加强；更新；支持。

definitions.definition: To execute; perform.
definitions.example: All have sworn him an oath that they should frame his will on earth.
definitions.definitionCn: 执行；完成。
definitions.exampleCn: 所有人都向他发誓，他们将在地上实现他的意志。

definitions.definition: To cause; to bring about; to produce.
definitions.definitionCn: 导致；引起；产生。

definitions.definition: To profit; avail.
definitions.definitionCn: 获益；有用。

definitions.definition: To fit; accord.
definitions.definitionCn: 适合；一致。

definitions.definition: To succeed in doing or trying to do something; manage.
definitions.definitionCn: 成功完成或尝试做某事；设法做到。

definitions.definition: The highest or uppermost part of something.
definitions.example: His kite got caught at the top of the tree.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物的最高或最上部。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的风筝卡在了树顶。

definitions.definition: A child’s spinning toy; a spinning top.
definitions.example: The boy was amazed at how long the top would spin.
definitions.definitionCn: 儿童旋转玩具；陀螺。
definitions.exampleCn: 男孩对陀螺能旋转这么久感到惊奇。

definitions.definition: (heading) Someone who is eminent.
definitions.definitionCn: （标题）杰出的人物。

definitions.definition: (BDSM) A dominant partner in a BDSM relationship or roleplay.
definitions.definitionCn: （BDSM）BDSM关系或角色扮演中的主导方。

definitions.definition: A man penetrating or with a preference for penetrating during homosexual intercourse.
definitions.example: I prefer being a top, and my boyfriend prefers being a bottom.
definitions.definitionCn: 同性性行为中插入或偏好插入的一方。
definitions.exampleCn: 我更喜欢做攻，而我的男友更喜欢做受。

definitions.definition: A top quark.
definitions.definitionCn: 顶夸克。

definitions.definition: The utmost degree; the acme; the summit.
definitions.definitionCn: 最高程度；顶点；顶峰。

definitions.definition: (ropemaking) A plug, or conical block of wood, with longitudinal grooves on its surface, in which the strands of the rope slide in the process of twisting.
definitions.definitionCn: （制绳）一种表面有纵向凹槽的木塞或锥形木块，绳索在扭转过程中股线在其上滑动。

definitions.definition: (sound) Highest pitch or loudest volume.
definitions.example: She sang at the top of her voice.
definitions.definitionCn: （声音）最高音调或最大音量。
definitions.exampleCn: 她以最大音量歌唱。

definitions.definition: (wool manufacture) A bundle or ball of slivers of combed wool, from which the noils, or dust, have been taken out.
definitions.definitionCn: （羊毛加工）一束或一团已梳理羊毛的毛条，已去除落棉或灰尘。

definitions.definition: (obsolete, except in one sense of phrase on top of) Eve; verge; point.
definitions.definitionCn: （古语，除短语“on top of”的一种含义外）前夕；边缘；点。

definitions.definition: The part of a cut gem between the girdle, or circumference, and the table, or flat upper surface.
definitions.definitionCn: 切割宝石介于腰围或圆周与台面或平坦上表面之间的部分。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) Topboots.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数）高筒靴。

definitions.definition: A stroke on the top of the ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打球的顶部。

definitions.definition: A forward spin given to the ball by hitting it on or near the top.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过击打球顶或近顶处给予球的前旋。

definitions.definition: (in restaurants, preceded by a number) (A table at which there is, or which has enough seats for) a group of a specified number of people eating at a restaurant.
definitions.definitionCn: （餐厅中，前接数字）一张可容纳指定人数用餐的桌子。

definitions.definition: To cover on the top or with a top.
definitions.example: I like my ice cream topped with chocolate sauce.
definitions.definitionCn: 用顶部覆盖或加上顶部。
definitions.exampleCn: 我喜欢在冰淇淋上浇巧克力酱。

definitions.definition: To cut or remove the top (as of a tree)
definitions.example: I don't want to be bald, so just top my hair.
definitions.definitionCn: 砍掉或移除顶部（如树顶）。
definitions.exampleCn: 我不想秃头，所以只修剪一下头发。

definitions.definition: To excel, to surpass, to beat.
definitions.example: Titanic was the most successful film ever until it was topped by another Cameron film, Avatar.
definitions.definitionCn: 超越、胜过、击败。
definitions.exampleCn: 《泰坦尼克号》曾是史上最成功的电影，直到被卡梅隆的另一部电影《阿凡达》超越。

definitions.definition: To be in the lead, to be at number one position (of).
definitions.example: Celine Dion topped the UK music charts twice in the 1990s.
definitions.definitionCn: 处于领先地位，位居第一。
definitions.exampleCn: 席琳·迪翁在20世纪90年代两次登顶英国音乐排行榜。

definitions.definition: To commit suicide.
definitions.example: Depression causes many people to top themselves.
definitions.definitionCn: 自杀。
definitions.exampleCn: 抑郁症导致许多人自杀。

definitions.definition: To murder.
definitions.definitionCn: 谋杀。

definitions.definition: (BDSM) To be the dominant partner in a BDSM relationship or roleplay.
definitions.example: Giving advice to the dominant partner on how to run the BDSM session is called "topping from the bottom".
definitions.definitionCn: （BDSM）在BDSM关系或角色扮演中作为主导方。
definitions.exampleCn: 向主导方提供如何运行BDSM活动的建议被称为“从下方主导”。

definitions.definition: (gay sexuality) To be the partner who penetrates in anal sex.
definitions.definitionCn: （同性性行为）在肛交中作为插入方。

definitions.definition: (gay sexuality) To anally penetrate.
definitions.definitionCn: （同性性行为）进行肛交插入。

definitions.definition: To rise aloft; to be eminent; to tower.
definitions.example: lofty ridges and topping mountains
definitions.definitionCn: 高耸；杰出；屹立。
definitions.exampleCn: 高耸的山脊和巍峨的山峰。

definitions.definition: To predominate.
definitions.example: topping passions
definitions.definitionCn: 主导。
definitions.exampleCn: 主导的激情。

definitions.definition: To excel; to rise above others.
definitions.definitionCn: 超越；胜过他人。

definitions.definition: To raise one end of (a yard, etc.), making it higher than the other.
definitions.definitionCn: 抬起（帆桁等）的一端，使其高于另一端。

definitions.definition: (dyeing) To cover with another dye.
definitions.example: to top aniline black with methyl violet to prevent greening
definitions.definitionCn: （染色）用另一种染料覆盖。
definitions.exampleCn: 用甲基紫覆盖苯胺黑以防止变绿。

definitions.definition: To put a stiffening piece or back on (a saw blade).
definitions.definitionCn: 在（锯片）上加装加固片或背衬。

definitions.definition: To arrange (fruit, etc.) with the best on top.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（水果等）最好的放在上面摆放。

definitions.definition: (of a horse) To strike the top of (an obstacle) with the hind feet while jumping, so as to gain new impetus.
definitions.definitionCn: （马）跳跃时用后蹄击打（障碍物）顶部以获得新动力。

definitions.definition: To improve (domestic animals, especially sheep) by crossing certain individuals or breeds with other superior breeds.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过将某些个体或品种与其他优良品种杂交来改良（家畜，尤其是羊）。

definitions.definition: To cut, break, or otherwise take off the top of (a steel ingot) to remove unsound metal.
definitions.definitionCn: 切割、打断或以其他方式去除（钢锭）顶部以去除不纯金属。

definitions.definition: To strike (the ball) above the centre; also, to make (a stroke, etc.) by hitting the ball in this way.
definitions.definitionCn: 击打（球）中心以上部位；也指以此方式击球（打出击球等）。

definitions.definition: The uppermost field of a dartboard; the double-20 field
definitions.example: Scoring 38 more points leaves him with tops for the win.
definitions.definitionCn: 飞镖盘的最上方区域；双倍20分区。
definitions.exampleCn: 再得38分使他以最高分获胜。

definitions.definition: Great; excellent.
definitions.definitionCn: 极好的；出色的。

definitions.definition: At the very most; as a maximum.
definitions.example: Your essay should be two pages, tops.
definitions.definitionCn: 至多；作为最大值。
definitions.exampleCn: 你的文章最多两页。

definitions.definition: To make easy or easier.
definitions.definitionCn: 使变得容易或更容易。

definitions.definition: To help bring about.
definitions.definitionCn: 帮助促成。

definitions.definition: To preside over (a meeting, a seminar).
definitions.definitionCn: 主持（会议、研讨会）。

definitions.definition: To move on skis
definitions.definitionCn: 滑雪

definitions.definition: To travel over (a slope etc.) on skis; to travel on skis at (a place), (especially as a sport)
definitions.definitionCn: 用滑雪板滑行（如斜坡等）；在（某地）进行滑雪运动（尤指作为一项运动）

definitions.definition: A group of sports utilizing skis as primary equipment.
definitions.definitionCn: 以滑雪板为主要器材的一系列运动项目。

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The duties or taxes imposed on imported or exported goods.
definitions.example: Customs of £200 were due on all the wine we took back from France.
definitions.definitionCn: （复数形式）对进出口货物征收的关税或税费。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们从法国带回的所有葡萄酒需缴纳200英镑关税。

definitions.definition: (in the singular) The government department or agency that is authorised to collect the taxes imposed on imported goods.
definitions.example: Customs has pulled us over on our way for an inspection.
definitions.definitionCn: （单数形式）被授权征收进口货物税款的政府部门或机构。
definitions.exampleCn: 海关在途中拦下我们进行检查。

definitions.definition: Frequent repetition of the same behavior; way of behavior common to many; ordinary manner; habitual practice; method of doing, living or behaving.
Traditional beliefs or rituals
definitions.example: The Ancient Egyptian culture had many distinctive and interesting beliefs and customs.

definitions.definition: Habitual buying of goods; practice of frequenting, as a shop, factory, etc., for making purchases or giving orders; business support.
Long-established practice, considered as unwritten law, and resting for authority on long consent; usage. See Usage, and Prescription.
Familiar acquaintance; familiarity.
Toll, tax, or tribute.
To make familiar; to accustom.
To supply with customers.
To pay the customs of.
To have a custom.
One who administers affairs; one who directs, manages, executes, or dispenses, whether in civil, judicial, political, or ecclesiastical affairs; a manager
definitions.definitionCn: 管理者；在民事、司法、政治或宗教事务中指导、管理、执行或分配事务的人；经理人

definitions.definition: A person who manages or settles the estate of an intestate, or of a testator when there is no competent executor; one to whom the right of administration has been committed by competent authority
definitions.definitionCn: 管理或处理无遗嘱者遗产的人，或在无合格遗嘱执行人时管理有遗嘱者遗产的人；经主管当局授权管理事务的人

definitions.definition: One who is responsible for software installation, management, information and maintenance of a computer or network
definitions.definitionCn: 负责计算机或网络的软件安装、管理、信息及维护的人员

definitions.definition: That which has a distinct existence as an individual unit. Often used for organisations which have no physical form.
definitions.definitionCn: 作为独立个体单位存在的事物。常指没有实体形态的组织。

definitions.definition: The existence of something considered apart from its properties.
definitions.definitionCn: 脱离其属性而考虑的事物存在。

definitions.definition: Anything about which information or data can be stored in a database; in particular, an organised array or set of individual elements or parts.
definitions.definitionCn: 数据库中可存储信息或数据的任何事物；尤指有组织的个体元素或部分构成的阵列或集合。

definitions.definition: The state or quality of being or existence.
definitions.example: The group successfully maintains its tribal entity.
definitions.definitionCn: 存在或实存的状态或性质。
definitions.exampleCn: 该群体成功维持了其部落实体。

definitions.definition: A spirit, ghost, or the like.
definitions.definitionCn: 灵魂、鬼魂或类似存在。

definitions.definition: An alien lifeform that has no corporeal body.
definitions.definitionCn: 没有物质躯体的外星生命形态。

definitions.definition: A game of chance, in which a small ball is made to move round rapidly on a circle divided off into numbered red and black spaces, the one on which it stops indicating the result of a variety of wagers permitted by the game.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种碰运气的游戏，小球在标有数字的红黑相间的圆形区域中快速旋转，停止的位置决定了游戏允许的各种赌注的结果。

definitions.definition: A small toothed wheel used by engravers to roll over a plate in order to produce rows of dots.
definitions.definitionCn: 雕刻师使用的一种小齿轮，在版面上滚动以产生一排排点状痕迹。

definitions.definition: A similar wheel used to roughen the surface of a plate, as in making alterations in a mezzotint.
definitions.definitionCn: 类似的一种轮子，用于粗糙版面表面，例如在修改美柔汀版画时使用。

definitions.definition: The locus of a point on a plane curve that rolls without slipping along another fixed plane curve.
definitions.definitionCn: 平面曲线上的一点在另一固定平面曲线上无滑动滚动时的轨迹。

definitions.definition: Any of the small incisions on a sheet of stamps, used as an alternative to perforations.
definitions.definitionCn: 邮票张上的小切口，用作齿孔的替代方案。

definitions.definition: A cylindrical curler for the hair.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于卷发的圆柱形卷发器。

definitions.definition: To separate or decorate by incisions made with a small toothed wheel.

definitions.definition: An item of clothing other than a mitten, covering all or part of the hand and fingers, but usually allowing independent movement of the fingers.

definitions.definitionCn: 除连指手套外，覆盖全部或部分手和手指的衣物，但通常允许手指独立活动。
definitions.exampleCn: 我戴手套保暖。

definitions.definition: A baseball mitt.
definitions.definitionCn: 棒球手套。

definitions.definition: The ability to catch a hit ball.
definitions.example: Frederico had a great glove, but he couldn't hit a curveball, so he never broke into the pros.
definitions.definitionCn: 接住击球的能力。
definitions.exampleCn: 弗雷德里科防守能力出色，但打不了曲线球，因此始终未能进入职业联赛。

definitions.definition: A condom.
definitions.definitionCn: 安全套。

definitions.definition: (with definite article) A challenge from one to another.

definitions.definitionCn: （与定冠词连用）向某人发出的挑战。

definitions.definition: To catch the ball in a baseball mitt.
definitions.example: He gloved the line drive for the third out.
definitions.definitionCn: 用棒球手套接球。
definitions.exampleCn: 他用手套接住平飞球完成第三次出局。

definitions.definition: To put a glove or gloves on.
definitions.example: Maxwell gloved his hand so that he wouldn't leave fingerprints, then pulled the trigger.
definitions.definitionCn: 戴上手套。
definitions.exampleCn: 麦克斯韦戴上手套以免留下指纹，然后扣动了扳机。

definitions.definition: To touch a delivery with one's glove while the gloved hand is on the bat. Under the rules of cricket, the batsman is deemed to have hit the ball.
definitions.definitionCn: 在戴手套的手握球棒时，用手套触碰投球。根据板球规则，击球员被视为击中了球。

definitions.definition: A harmonic set of three or more notes that is heard as if sounding simultaneously.
definitions.definitionCn: 三个或更多音符构成的和声组合，听起来如同同时发声。

definitions.definition: A straight line between two points of a curve.
definitions.definitionCn: 曲线上两点之间的直线。

definitions.definition: A horizontal member of a truss.
definitions.definitionCn: 桁架的水平构件。

definitions.definition: The distance between the leading and trailing edge of a wing, measured in the direction of the normal airflow.
definitions.definitionCn: 机翼前缘与后缘之间的距离，沿正常气流方向测量。

definitions.definition: An imaginary line from the luff of a sail to its leech.
definitions.definitionCn: 从帆的前缘到后缘的假想线。

definitions.definition: A keyboard shortcut that involves two or more distinct keypresses, such as Ctrl+M followed by P.
definitions.definitionCn: 涉及两个或更多不同按键的键盘快捷键，例如先按Ctrl+M再按P。

definitions.definition: The string of a musical instrument.
definitions.definitionCn: 乐器的弦。

definitions.definition: A cord.
definitions.definitionCn: 绳索。

definitions.definition: An edge that is not part of a cycle but connects two vertices of the cycle.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接环上两个顶点但不属于环的边。

definitions.example: He looped some cord around his fingers.
definitions.definitionCn: 由纤维（如绳索）的加捻纱线（股线）制成的细长、柔软、可弯曲的一段；（不可数）作为商品考虑的此类加捻股线。
definitions.exampleCn: 他在手指上绕了一些绳子。

definitions.definition: A small flexible electrical conductor composed of wires insulated separately or in bundles and assembled together usually with an outer cover; the electrical cord of a lamp, sweeper ((US) vacuum cleaner), or other appliance.
definitions.definitionCn: 由单独或成束绝缘的导线组成的小型柔性电导体，通常带有外护套组装在一起；灯具、吸尘器（美国英语：vacuum cleaner）或其他电器的电源线。

definitions.definition: A unit of measurement for firewood, equal to 128 cubic feet (4 × 4 × 8 feet), composed of logs and/or split logs four feet long and none over eight inches diameter. It is usually seen as a stack four feet high by eight feet long.
definitions.definitionCn: 测量木柴的单位，等于128立方英尺（4×4×8英尺），由四英尺长且直径不超过八英寸的原木和/或劈柴组成。通常表现为四英尺高、八英尺长的堆垛。

definitions.definition: Any influence by which persons are caught, held, or drawn, as if by a cord.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何像绳索一样捕捉、束缚或吸引人的影响力。

definitions.definition: Any structure having the appearance of a cord, especially a tendon or nerve.
definitions.example: spermatic cord; spinal cord; umbilical cord; vocal cords
definitions.definitionCn: 任何外观像绳索的结构，尤指肌腱或神经。
definitions.exampleCn: 精索；脊髓；脐带；声带

definitions.definition: To furnish with cords
definitions.definitionCn: 用绳索装备

definitions.definition: To tie or fasten with cords
definitions.definitionCn: 用绳索捆绑或固定

definitions.definition: To flatten a book during binding
definitions.definitionCn: 装订时压平书籍

definitions.definition: To arrange (wood, etc.) in a pile for measurement by the cord.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（木材等）堆成堆以便按考得（cord）计量。

definitions.definition: A person who subscribes to a publication or a service
definitions.example: Our magazine has over ten thousand subscribers.
definitions.definitionCn: 订阅出版物或服务的人
definitions.exampleCn: 我们的杂志有一万多名订阅者。

definitions.definition: A store where books are bought and sold.
definitions.definitionCn: 买卖书籍的商店。

definitions.definition: Sensation, particularly through the skin.
definitions.example: The wool on my arm produced a strange feeling.
definitions.definitionCn: 感觉，尤其是通过皮肤的感受。
definitions.exampleCn: 手臂上的羊毛产生了一种奇怪的感觉。

definitions.definition: Emotion; impression.
definitions.example: The house gave me a feeling of dread.
definitions.definitionCn: 情感；印象。
definitions.exampleCn: 这栋房子给我一种恐惧的感觉。

definitions.definition: (always in the plural) Emotional state or well-being.
definitions.example: You really hurt my feelings when you said that.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）情绪状态或幸福感。
definitions.exampleCn: 你说那话时真的伤害了我的感情。

definitions.definition: (always in the plural) Emotional attraction or desire.
definitions.example: Many people still have feelings for their first love.
definitions.definitionCn: （常用复数）情感吸引或欲望。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多人仍对初恋怀有感情。

definitions.definition: Intuition.
definitions.example: He has no feeling for what he can say to somebody in such a fragile emotional condition.
definitions.definitionCn: 直觉。
definitions.exampleCn: 他对于在如此脆弱的情绪状态下能对别人说什么毫无感觉。

definitions.definition: An opinion, an attitude.
definitions.definitionCn: 观点，态度。

definitions.definition: An item's relative importance.
definitions.example: He set his e-mail message's priority to high.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个项目的相对重要性。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将自己的电子邮件优先级设为高。

definitions.definition: A goal of a person or an organisation.
definitions.example: She needs to get her priorities straight and stop playing games.
definitions.definitionCn: 个人或组织的目标。
definitions.exampleCn: 她需要理清优先顺序，别再玩游戏了。

definitions.definition: The quality of being earlier or coming first compared to another thing; the state of being prior.
definitions.example: In bankruptcy law, a business' debt to its employees has priority over its debt to a landlord, so the employees must be paid first.
definitions.definitionCn: 相较于其他事物更早或先出现的性质；优先状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 在破产法中，企业对员工的债务优先于对房东的债务，因此必须优先支付员工工资。

definitions.definition: (of a name) A superior claim to use by virtue of being validly published at an earlier date.
definitions.definitionCn: （指名称）因较早有效发表而享有的优先使用权。
