definitions.example: Bill tried to stun the snake by striking it on the head.
definitions.definitionCn: 使丧失能力；尤指通过引发方向感丧失或昏迷。
definitions.exampleCn: 比尔试图击打蛇的头部使其晕眩。

definitions.definition: To shock or surprise.
definitions.example: He stood there stunned, looking at the beautiful, breath-taking sunrise.
definitions.definitionCn: 使震惊或惊讶。
definitions.exampleCn: 他站在那里目瞪口呆，看着美丽绝伦的日出。

definitions.definition: To hit the cue ball so that it slides without topspin or backspin (and with or without sidespin) and continues at a natural angle after contact with the object ball
definitions.definitionCn: 击打主球使其无上旋或下旋（可带侧旋），并在撞击目标球后以自然角度继续滚动。

definitions.definition: Having an effect that stuns.
definitions.example: The stunning jolt from the taser gun made the criminal stop fleeing.
definitions.definitionCn: 具有使人晕眩效果的。
definitions.exampleCn: 电击枪带来的惊人一击让罪犯停止了逃跑。

definitions.definition: Exceptionally beautiful or attractive.
definitions.example: That woman is stunning!
definitions.definitionCn: 异常美丽或迷人的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那个女人美得惊人！

definitions.definition: Amazing; wonderfully good.
definitions.example: The film was stunning.
definitions.definitionCn: 令人惊叹的；极好的。
definitions.exampleCn: 这部电影令人震撼。

definitions.definition: The act by which a person or animal is physically stunned.
An alignment of astronomical objects whereby one object comes between the observer (or notional observer) and another object, thus obscuring the latter.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种天文现象，即一个天体位于观测者（或假想观测者）与另一个天体之间，从而遮蔽后者。

definitions.definition: Especially, an alignment whereby a planetary object (for example, the Moon) comes between the Sun and another planetary object (for example, the Earth), resulting in a shadow being cast by the middle planetary object onto the other planetary object.
definitions.definitionCn: 尤指一种排列，其中行星天体（如月球）位于太阳与另一行星天体（如地球）之间，导致中间行星天体在另一行星天体上投下阴影。

definitions.definition: A seasonal state of plumage in some birds, notably ducks, adopted temporarily after the breeding season and characterised by a dull and scruffy appearance.
definitions.definitionCn: 某些鸟类（尤其是鸭类）在繁殖季节后暂时呈现的季节性羽毛状态，其特征是外观暗淡且邋遢。

definitions.definition: Obscurity, decline, downfall
definitions.definitionCn: 隐没、衰落、败落

definitions.definition: Of astronomical bodies, to cause an eclipse.
definitions.example: The Moon eclipsed the Sun.
definitions.definitionCn: （指天体）发生食现象。
definitions.exampleCn: 月球遮蔽了太阳。

definitions.definition: To overshadow; to be better or more noticeable than.
definitions.definitionCn: 使相形见绌；比……更出色或更引人注目。

definitions.definition: (Irish grammar) To undergo eclipsis.
definitions.definitionCn: （爱尔兰语法）经历辅音弱化。

definitions.definition: To influence or alter.
definitions.example: The experience affected me deeply.
definitions.definitionCn: 影响或改变。
definitions.exampleCn: 那次经历深深影响了我。

definitions.definition: To move to emotion.
definitions.example: He was deeply affected by the tragic ending of the play.
definitions.definitionCn: 触动情感。
definitions.exampleCn: 他被戏剧悲剧结局深深打动。

definitions.definition: Of an illness or condition, to infect or harm (a part of the body).
definitions.example: Hepatitis affects the liver.
definitions.definitionCn: 指疾病或状况，感染或损害（身体部位）。
definitions.exampleCn: 肝炎影响肝脏。

definitions.definition: To dispose or incline.
definitions.definitionCn: 使倾向于；使有意向。

definitions.definition: To tend to by affinity or disposition.
definitions.definitionCn: 因亲和或性情而趋向。

definitions.definition: To assign; to appoint.
definitions.definitionCn: 分配；指定。

definitions.definition: To make a show of; to put on a pretense of; to feign; to assume. To make a false display of.
definitions.example: He managed to affect a smile despite feeling quite miserable.
definitions.definitionCn: 假装；做作；伪装；假扮。做出虚假表现。
definitions.exampleCn: 尽管感到非常痛苦，他还是勉强装出微笑。

definitions.definition: To aim for, to try to obtain.
definitions.definitionCn: 追求；试图获得。

definitions.definition: To feel affection for (someone); to like, be fond of.
definitions.definitionCn: 对（某人）产生喜爱；喜欢；钟爱。

definitions.definition: To show a fondness for (something); to choose.
definitions.definitionCn: 表现出对（某物）的喜爱；选择。

definitions.definition: One's mood or inclination; mental state.
definitions.definitionCn: 某人的情绪或倾向；心理状态。

definitions.definition: A desire, an appetite.
definitions.definitionCn: 欲望；胃口。

definitions.definition: A subjective feeling experienced in response to a thought or other stimulus; mood, emotion, especially as demonstrated in external physical signs.
definitions.definitionCn: 对想法或其他刺激产生的主观感受；情绪、情感，尤其体现在外部身体迹象上。

definitions.definition: A mass, assemblage, or sum of particulars; something consisting of elements but considered as a whole.
definitions.definitionCn: 由多个细节组成的集合、整体或总和；由元素构成但被视为整体的某物。

definitions.definition: A mass formed by the union of homogeneous particles; – in distinction from a compound, formed by the union of heterogeneous particles.
definitions.definitionCn: 由同质粒子结合形成的团块；区别于由异质粒子结合形成的化合物。

definitions.definition: A set (collection of objects).
definitions.definitionCn: 一个集合（对象的集合）。

definitions.definition: The full chromatic scale of twelve equal tempered pitches.
definitions.definitionCn: 包含十二个等程音高的完整半音阶。

definitions.definition: The total score in a set of games between teams or competitors, usually the combination of the home and away scores
definitions.definitionCn: 队伍或选手之间一系列比赛的总得分，通常为主客场得分之和。

definitions.definition: (roofing) Crushed stone, crushed slag or water-worn gravel used for surfacing a built-up roof system.
definitions.definitionCn: （屋顶材料）用于铺设组合屋顶系统的碎石、碎矿渣或水磨砾石。

definitions.definition: Solid particles of low aspect ratio added to a composite material, as distinguished from the matrix and any fibers or reinforcements, especially the gravel and sand added to concrete.
definitions.definitionCn: 添加到复合材料中的低纵横比固体颗粒，区别于基体、纤维或增强材料，尤指加入混凝土的砾石和砂。

definitions.definition: Any of the five attributes that constitute the sentient being.
definitions.definitionCn: 构成有情众生的五种属性之一。

definitions.definition: To bring together; to collect into a mass or sum.
definitions.example: The aggregated soil.
definitions.definitionCn: 聚集；收集成团或总和。
definitions.exampleCn: 聚合的土壤。

definitions.definition: To add or unite (e.g. a person), to an association.
definitions.definitionCn: 将（如某人）加入或联合到某个协会中。

definitions.definition: To amount in the aggregate to.
definitions.example: There are ten loads, aggregating five hundred bushels.
definitions.definitionCn: 总计达到。
definitions.exampleCn: 有十车货物，总计五百蒲式耳。

definitions.definition: Formed by a collection of particulars into a whole mass or sum; collective; combined; added up.
definitions.definitionCn: 由多个细节集合成整体团块或总和而形成的；集体的；组合的；累加的。

definitions.definition: Consisting or formed of smaller objects or parts.
definitions.definitionCn: 由较小对象或部分构成或形成的。

definitions.definition: Formed into clusters or groups of lobules.
definitions.example: aggregate glands
definitions.definitionCn: 形成小叶簇或小叶群。
definitions.exampleCn: 聚合腺体

definitions.definition: Composed of several florets within a common involucre, as in the daisy; or of several carpels formed from one flower, as in the raspberry.
definitions.definitionCn: 由共同总苞内的多个小花组成，如雏菊；或由一朵花的多个心皮组成，如覆盆子。

definitions.definition: Having the several component parts adherent to each other only to such a degree as to be separable by mechanical means.
definitions.definitionCn: 各组成部分仅以可机械分离的程度相互附着。

definitions.definition: United into a common organized mass; said of certain compound animals.
definitions.definitionCn: 联合成共同有机团块；指某些复合动物。

definitions.definition: An interval of space or time in which one set of events or phenomena is completed.
definitions.example: the cycle of the seasons, or of the year
definitions.definitionCn: 一段空间或时间间隔，其中一组事件或现象完成。
definitions.exampleCn: 季节或一年的循环。

definitions.definition: A complete rotation of anything.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何物体的完整旋转。

definitions.definition: A process that returns to its beginning and then repeats itself in the same sequence.
definitions.example: electoral cycle
definitions.definitionCn: 一个过程，返回起点后以相同顺序重复自身。
definitions.exampleCn: 选举周期。

definitions.definition: The members of the sequence formed by such a process.
definitions.definitionCn: 由该过程形成的序列中的成员。

definitions.definition: In musical set theory, an interval cycle is the set of pitch classes resulting from repeatedly applying the same interval class to the starting pitch class.
definitions.example: The interval cycle C4 consists of the pitch classes 0, 4 and 8; when starting on E, it is realised as the pitches E, G# and C.
definitions.definitionCn: 在音乐集合论中，音程循环是指对起始音高重复应用相同音程类所得到的音高类集合。
definitions.exampleCn: 音程循环C4包含音高类0、4和8；从E开始，它实现为音高E、升G和C。

definitions.definition: A series of poems, songs or other works of art.
definitions.example: The "Ring of the Nibelung" is a cycle of four operas by Richard Wagner.
definitions.definitionCn: 一系列诗歌、歌曲或其他艺术作品。
definitions.exampleCn: 《尼伯龙根的指环》是理查德·瓦格纳创作的四部歌剧组成的循环。

definitions.definition: A programme on a washing machine, dishwasher, or other such device.
definitions.example: Put the washing in on a warm cycle.
definitions.definitionCn: 洗衣机、洗碗机或其他类似设备上的程序。
definitions.exampleCn: 将衣物放入温水循环中洗涤。

definitions.definition: A pedal-powered vehicle, such as a unicycle, bicycle, or tricycle, or a motorized vehicle that has either two or three wheels.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种脚踏驱动的车辆，如独轮车、自行车或三轮车，或具有两个或三个轮子的机动车辆。

definitions.definition: A single, a double, a triple, and a home run hit by the same player in the same game.
definitions.example: Jones hit for the cycle in the game.
definitions.definitionCn: 同一名球员在同一场比赛中击出一垒打、二垒打、三垒打和本垒打。
definitions.exampleCn: 琼斯在那场比赛中完成了循环全垒打。

definitions.definition: A closed walk or path, with or without repeated vertices allowed.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条闭合的路径或轨迹，允许或不允许重复顶点。

definitions.definition: (algebraic topology) A chain whose boundary is zero.
definitions.definitionCn: （代数拓扑）边界为零的链。

definitions.definition: An imaginary circle or orbit in the heavens; one of the celestial spheres.
definitions.definitionCn: 天空中假想的圆或轨道；天体之一。

definitions.definition: An age; a long period of time.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个时代；一段漫长的时间。

definitions.definition: An orderly list for a given time; a calendar.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定时间的有序列表；日历。

definitions.definition: One entire round in a circle or a spire.
definitions.example: a cycle or set of leaves
definitions.definitionCn: 一个圆或螺旋中的完整一圈。
definitions.exampleCn: 一轮或一组叶子。

definitions.definition: A discharge of a taser.
definitions.definitionCn: 泰瑟枪的一次放电。

definitions.definition: To ride a bicycle or other cycle.
definitions.definitionCn: 骑自行车或其他循环车辆。

definitions.definition: To go through a cycle or to put through a cycle.
definitions.definitionCn: 经历一个循环或使某物经历一个循环。

definitions.definition: To turn power off and back on
definitions.example: Avoid cycling the device unnecessarily.
definitions.definitionCn: 关闭电源再重新开启。
definitions.exampleCn: 避免不必要地重启设备。

definitions.definition: To maintain a team's possession of the puck in the offensive zone by handling and passing the puck in a loop from the boards near the goal up the side boards and passing to back to the boards near the goal
definitions.example: They have their cycling game going tonight.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过在球门附近沿板墙循环控球和传球，再传回球门附近板墙，以保持球队在进攻区的控球权。
definitions.exampleCn: 他们今晚的循环进攻战术正在上演。

definitions.definition: To wound or cause physical harm to a living creature.
definitions.definitionCn: 伤害或对生物造成身体伤害。

definitions.definition: To damage or impair.
definitions.definitionCn: 损坏或削弱。

definitions.definition: To do injustice to.
definitions.definitionCn: 不公正对待。

definitions.definition: A greeting or farewell using the word "ciao".
definitions.definitionCn: 使用“ciao”一词的问候或告别。

definitions.definition: Hello, hi.
definitions.definitionCn: 你好，嗨。

definitions.definition: Bye, goodbye.
definitions.definitionCn: 再见，拜拜。

definitions.definition: In an active manner.
definitions.example: He was actively listening.
definitions.definitionCn: 以积极的方式。
definitions.exampleCn: 他正在积极倾听。

definitions.definition: (grammar) In the active form; not passive.
definitions.example: a word used actively
definitions.definitionCn: （语法）以主动形式；非被动。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个被积极使用的词。

definitions.definition: To make complex; to modify so as to make something intricate or difficult.
definitions.definitionCn: 使复杂化；修改以使其变得错综复杂或困难。

definitions.definition: To involve in a convoluted matter.
definitions.example: Don't complicate yourself in issues that are beyond the scope of your understanding.
definitions.definitionCn: 卷入复杂的事情中。
definitions.exampleCn: 不要让自己卷入超出理解范围的问题。

definitions.definition: Difficult or convoluted.
definitions.example: It seems this complicated situation will not blow over soon.
definitions.definitionCn: 困难或复杂的。
definitions.exampleCn: 看来这个复杂的局面不会很快平息。

definitions.definition: Folded longitudinally (as in the wings of certain insects).
definitions.definitionCn: 纵向折叠（如某些昆虫的翅膀）。

definitions.definition: A manservant having charge of wines and liquors.
definitions.definitionCn: 负责酒水的男仆。

definitions.definition: The chief male servant of a household who has charge of other employees, receives guests, directs the serving of meals, and performs various personal services.
definitions.definitionCn: 家庭中主管其他佣人、接待宾客、指挥用餐服务并执行各种私人事务的首席男仆。

definitions.definition: A valet, a male personal attendant.
definitions.definitionCn: 贴身男仆，男性私人侍从。

definitions.definition: To buttle, to dispense wines or liquors; to take the place of a butler.
definitions.definitionCn: 担任管家职务，分发酒水；替代管家职责。

definitions.definition: A sexually promiscuous woman or girl.
definitions.example: She's a slut, but I love her.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个性滥交的女人或女孩。
definitions.exampleCn: 她是个荡妇，但我爱她。

definitions.definition: Any sexually promiscuous person, often a gay man.
definitions.definitionCn: 任何性滥交的人，常指男同性恋者。

definitions.definition: Someone who seeks attention through inappropriate means or to an excessive degree.
definitions.example: a press slut
definitions.definitionCn: 通过不当方式或过度程度寻求关注的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个媒体狂。

definitions.definition: A disloyal individual; someone who does not commit to a particular thing.
definitions.example: That guy was a job slut; he changed jobs way too often and quickly, to the point that employers will no longer hire him.
definitions.definitionCn: 不忠诚的人；不专注于特定事物的人。
definitions.exampleCn: 那家伙是个工作狂，他换工作太频繁太快，以至于雇主不再雇佣他。

definitions.definition: A slovenly, untidy person, usually a woman.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个邋遢、不整洁的人，通常是女人。

definitions.definition: A bold, outspoken woman.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个大胆、直言不讳的女人。

definitions.definition: A female dog.
definitions.definitionCn: 一只母狗。

definitions.definition: A maidservant.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个女仆。

definitions.definition: A rag soaked in a flammable substance and lit for illumination.
definitions.definitionCn: 浸有易燃物质用于照明的破布。

definitions.definition: To wear slutty clothing or makeup, or otherwise behave in a slutty manner.
definitions.definitionCn: 穿着暴露或化妆放荡，或以放荡方式行事。

definitions.definition: (usually with around) To visit places frequented by men, with the intention of engaging in sexual intercourse by means of flirting.
definitions.definitionCn: （常与around连用）去男人常去的地方，意图通过调情发生性关系。

definitions.definition: A preventative medical regiment of HIV medicines used to protect against HIV seroconversion after an exposure.
definitions.example: Some doctors will prescribe pre-exposure prophylaxis to promiscuous people that have a hard time controlling themselves or their condom usage to prevent them from getting AIDS.
definitions.definitionCn: 用于预防HIV血清转化的预防性药物方案，在暴露后使用以保护免受感染。
definitions.exampleCn: 一些医生会为难以控制自己或避孕套使用的滥交人群开具暴露前预防药物，以防止他们患上艾滋病。

definitions.definition: Preparation.
definitions.definitionCn: 准备。

definitions.definition: A prep school.
definitions.definitionCn: 预科学校。

definitions.definition: A student or graduate of a prep school, a preppy.
definitions.definitionCn: 预科学校的学生或毕业生，即预科生。

definitions.definition: Homework, work set to do outside class time, used widely in public schools and preparatory schools but not state schools.
definitions.definitionCn: 家庭作业，即课外时间完成的任务，广泛用于公立学校和预科学校，但公立学校不常用。

definitions.definition: Preparatory level; the last two levels or the fourth and fifth years of preschool; the two levels before first grade.
definitions.definitionCn: 预备阶段；学前教育的最后两个阶段或第四和第五年；一年级之前的两个阶段。

definitions.definition: To prepare.
definitions.definitionCn: 准备。

definitions.definition: (grammar, strict sense) Any of a class of non-inflecting words typically employed to connect a following noun or a pronoun, in an adjectival or adverbial sense, with some other word: a particle used with a noun or pronoun (in English always in the objective case) to make a phrase limiting some other word.
definitions.definitionCn: （语法，严格意义上）任何一类不变化词，通常用于连接随后的名词或代词，以形容词或副词的意义与另一个词相关联：与名词或代词（英语中总是宾格）一起使用以构成短语，限制其他词。

definitions.definition: A proposition; an exposition; a discourse.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个命题；一个阐述；一篇论述。

definitions.definition: Firmly or securely fixed in place; stable.
definitions.example: That rope is dangerously loose. Make it fast!
definitions.definitionCn: 牢固或安全地固定在某处；稳定的。
definitions.exampleCn: 那根绳子松得很危险，把它系紧！

definitions.definition: Firm against attack; fortified by nature or art; impregnable; strong.
definitions.definitionCn: 防御坚固的；天然或人工加固的；坚不可摧的；强固的。

definitions.definition: (of people) Steadfast, with unwavering feeling. (Now mostly in set phrases like fast friend(s).)
definitions.definitionCn: （指人）坚定的，感情不动摇的。（现多用于固定短语如“fast friend(s)”）

definitions.definition: Moving with great speed, or capable of doing so; swift, rapid.
definitions.example: I am going to buy a fast car.
definitions.definitionCn: 移动速度极快的，或能够快速移动的；迅速的，快速的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我打算买一辆快车。

definitions.definition: Causing unusual rapidity of play or action.
definitions.example: a fast billiard table
definitions.definitionCn: 导致游戏或动作异常快速的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一张快速的台球桌

definitions.definition: (of a piece of hardware) Able to transfer data in a short period of time.
definitions.definitionCn: （指硬件）能在短时间内传输数据的。

definitions.definition: Deep or sound (of sleep); fast asleep (of people).
definitions.definitionCn: （指睡眠）深沉的；酣睡的（指人）。

definitions.definition: (of dyes or colours) Not running or fading when subjected to detrimental conditions such as wetness or intense light; permanent.
definitions.example: All the washing has come out pink. That red tee-shirt was not fast.
definitions.definitionCn: （指染料或颜色）在潮湿或强光等不利条件下不褪色或变色的；持久的。
definitions.exampleCn: 所有洗过的衣服都变成了粉红色。那件红色T恤衫不防褪色。

definitions.definition: Tenacious; retentive.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧抓不放的；有保持力的。

definitions.definition: Having an extravagant lifestyle or immoral habits.
definitions.example: a fast woman
definitions.definitionCn: 生活方式奢侈或习惯不道德的。
definitions.exampleCn: 一个放荡的女人

definitions.definition: Ahead of the correct time or schedule.
definitions.example: There must be something wrong with the hall clock. It is always fast.
definitions.definitionCn: 早于正确时间或预定时间的。
definitions.exampleCn: 大厅的钟一定有问题，它总是快。

definitions.definition: (of photographic film) More sensitive to light than average.
definitions.definitionCn: （指摄影胶片）对光比一般更敏感的。

definitions.definition: In a firm or secure manner, securely; in such a way as not to be moved; safe, sound .
definitions.example: Hold this rope as fast as you can.
definitions.definitionCn: 以牢固或安全的方式，稳固地；以不可移动的方式；安全地，完好地。
definitions.exampleCn: 尽可能紧地抓住这根绳子。

definitions.definition: (of sleeping) Deeply or soundly .
definitions.example: He is fast asleep.
definitions.definitionCn: （指睡眠）深沉地，酣畅地。
definitions.exampleCn: 他睡得很沉。

definitions.definition: Immediately following in place or time; close, very near .
definitions.example: Fast by the sturdy batsman the ball unheeded sped. / That ain't my style, said Casey. Strike one, the umpire said.
definitions.definitionCn: 在位置或时间上紧接着；接近的，很近的。
definitions.exampleCn: 球飞快地掠过强壮的击球手身旁。/ 那不是我的风格，凯西说。裁判喊道：“一好球。”

definitions.definition: Quickly, with great speed; within a short time .
definitions.example: Do it as fast as you can.
definitions.definitionCn: 快速地，以高速；在短时间内。
definitions.exampleCn: 尽可能快地做这件事。

definitions.definition: Ahead of the correct time or schedule.
definitions.example: I think my watch is running fast.
definitions.definitionCn: 早于正确时间或预定时间的。
definitions.exampleCn: 我觉得我的表走快了。

definitions.definition: To restrict one’s personal consumption, generally of food, but sometimes other things, in various manners (totally, temporally, by avoiding particular items), often for religious or medical reasons.
definitions.example: Muslims fast during Ramadan and Catholics during Lent.
definitions.definitionCn: 限制个人消费，通常是食物，但有时也包括其他东西，以各种方式（完全禁食、定时禁食、避免特定食物），常出于宗教或医疗原因。
definitions.exampleCn: 穆斯林在斋月期间斋戒，天主教徒在四旬期期间斋戒。

definitions.definition: A person who looks after and guides tourists
definitions.definitionCn: 照顾并引导游客的人

definitions.definition: A person who delivers messages
definitions.definitionCn: 传递信息的人

definitions.definition: A company that delivers messages
definitions.definitionCn: 传递信息的公司

definitions.definition: A company that transports goods
definitions.definitionCn: 运输货物的公司

definitions.definition: A user who earns access to a topsite by uploading warez
definitions.definitionCn: 通过上传盗版软件获得顶级站点访问权限的用户

definitions.definition: To deliver by courier.
definitions.example: We'll have the contract couriered to you.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过快递递送
definitions.exampleCn: 我们会将合同快递给您。

definitions.definition: To transfer data to a computer on a network, especially to a server on the Internet.
definitions.example: You will have to convert your photograph to a jpg format if you wish to upload it.
definitions.definitionCn: 将数据传输到网络上的计算机，尤其是互联网上的服务器。
definitions.exampleCn: 如果你希望上传照片，必须将其转换为jpg格式。

definitions.definition: Having been uploaded; having been digitally sent from one's computer to someone else's.
definitions.definitionCn: 已上传；已从自己的计算机以数字方式发送到他人的计算机。

definitions.definition: A list of employees who receive salary or wages, together with the amounts due to each.
definitions.definitionCn: 一份领取薪金或工资的员工名单，以及应付给每个人的金额。

definitions.definition: The total sum of money paid to employees.
definitions.definitionCn: 支付给员工的总金额。

definitions.definition: The calculation of salaries and wages and the deduction of taxes etc.; the department in a company responsible for this.
definitions.definitionCn: 薪金和工资的计算以及税款等的扣除；公司中负责此项工作的部门。

definitions.definition: Bribes paid to people
definitions.definitionCn: 向他人支付的贿赂。

definitions.definition: To place on a payroll.
definitions.definitionCn: 列入工资单。

definitions.definition: A book or an encyclopedia of recipes and cookery tips.
definitions.definitionCn: 一本食谱或烹饪技巧的百科全书。

definitions.definition: (by extension) Any book of strategies.
definitions.example: The Anarchist's Cookbook
definitions.definitionCn: （引申义）任何策略手册。
definitions.exampleCn: 《无政府主义者食谱》

definitions.definition: A unit of weight (mass) equal to 2240 pounds (a long ton) or 2000 pounds (a short ton) or 1000 kilograms (a metric ton).
definitions.definitionCn: 重量（质量）单位，等于2240磅（长吨）或2000磅（短吨）或1000千克（公吨）。

definitions.definition: A unit of volume; register ton.
definitions.definitionCn: 容积单位；登记吨。

definitions.definition: In refrigeration and air conditioning, a unit of thermal power defined as 12,000 BTU/h (about 3.514 kW or 3024 kcal/h), originally the rate of cooling provided by uniform isothermal melting of one short ton of ice per day at 32 °F (0 °C).
definitions.definitionCn: 在制冷和空调领域，热功率单位，定义为12000 BTU/小时（约3.514千瓦或3024千卡/小时），最初指在32°F（0°C）下，一短吨冰每天均匀等温融化所提供的冷却速率。

definitions.definition: A large amount.
definitions.example: I've got tons of work to do.
definitions.definitionCn: 大量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我有一大堆工作要做。

definitions.definition: A speed of 100 mph.
definitions.definitionCn: 每小时100英里的速度。

definitions.definition: One hundred pounds sterling.
definitions.definitionCn: 一百英镑。

definitions.definition: One hundred runs.
definitions.definitionCn: 一百分。

definitions.definition: (etc.) One hundred points scored.
definitions.definitionCn: （等等）获得一百分。

definitions.definition: Fashion, the current style, the vogue.
Fashionable society; those in style.
The common tunny, or horse mackerel.
The action of expressing thoughts, ideas, feelings, etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 表达思想、观点、情感等的动作。

definitions.definition: A particular way of phrasing an idea.
definitions.definitionCn: 表达某个想法的特定措辞方式。

definitions.definition: A colloquialism or idiom.
definitions.example: The expression "break a leg!" should not be taken literally.
definitions.definitionCn: 口语或习语。
definitions.exampleCn: "祝好运！"这个表达不应按字面理解。

definitions.definition: A facial appearance usually associated with an emotion.
definitions.example: Her expression changed from joy to misery after realising her winning lottery ticket had expired.
definitions.definitionCn: 通常与情绪相关的面部表情。
definitions.exampleCn: 意识到中奖彩票过期后，她的表情从喜悦转为痛苦。

definitions.definition: An arrangement of symbols denoting values, operations performed on them, and grouping symbols.
definitions.definitionCn: 表示数值、对数值进行的运算以及分组符号的符号排列。

definitions.definition: The process of translating a gene into a protein.
definitions.definitionCn: 将基因转化为蛋白质的过程。

definitions.definition: A piece of code in a high-level language that returns a value.
definitions.definitionCn: 高级语言中返回值的代码片段。

definitions.definition: A specific blend of whisky.
definitions.definitionCn: 特定混合的威士忌。

definitions.definition: The act of pressing or squeezing out.
definitions.example: expression from a gland
definitions.definitionCn: 压榨或挤出的动作。
definitions.exampleCn: 腺体分泌物。

definitions.definition: The tone of voice or sound in music.
definitions.definitionCn: 音乐中的语调或声音。

definitions.definition: To furnish with decorations.
definitions.example: We decorated the Christmas tree with tinsel and baubles.
definitions.definitionCn: 用装饰品来布置。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们用金属箔和小饰品装饰了圣诞树。

definitions.definition: To improve the appearance of an interior of, as a house, room, or office.
definitions.example: There's some paint left over from when we decorated the guest bedroom.
definitions.definitionCn: 改善房屋、房间或办公室等内部空间的外观。
definitions.exampleCn: 装饰客房时剩下了一些油漆。

definitions.definition: To decorate an interior space, as a house, room, or office.
definitions.example: People tend to decorate for the holidays or special events.
definitions.definitionCn: 装饰室内空间，如房屋、房间或办公室。
definitions.exampleCn: 人们倾向于为节日或特殊活动进行装饰。

definitions.definition: To honor by providing a medal, ribbon, or other adornment.
definitions.example: He was a decorated soldier who served in three wars.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过授予奖章、绶带或其他饰物来表示荣誉。
definitions.exampleCn: 他是一位在三次战争中服役过的受勋士兵。

definitions.definition: To extend a method, etc. by attaching some further code item.
definitions.example: It makes sure that the field name argument is not empty, and that the field specified there is an actual existing field in the class which declares the method decorated with this attribute.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过附加一些额外的代码项来扩展方法等。
definitions.exampleCn: 它确保字段名称参数不为空，并且指定的字段是声明了带有此属性修饰的方法的类中实际存在的字段。

definitions.definition: Decoration
definitions.definitionCn: 装饰。

definitions.definition: A clue.
definitions.example: I needed a hint to complete the crossword.
definitions.definitionCn: 一条线索。
definitions.exampleCn: 我需要一个提示来完成填字游戏。

definitions.definition: A tacit suggestion that avoids a direct statement.
definitions.example: He gave me a hint that my breath smelt.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种避免直接陈述的含蓄暗示。
definitions.exampleCn: 他暗示我口臭。

definitions.definition: A small, barely detectable amount of.
definitions.example: I could taste a hint of lemon in the wine.
definitions.definitionCn: 少量、几乎察觉不到的量。
definitions.exampleCn: 我能尝出酒中一丝柠檬的味道。

definitions.definition: Information in a computer-based font that suggests how the outlines of the font's glyphs should be distorted in order to produce, at specific sizes, a visually appealing pixel-based rendering. Also known as hinting.
definitions.example: This font does not scale well; at small point sizes it has no hinting at all, and the hints that it has for the 10- and 12-point letter 'g' still need work.
definitions.definitionCn: 计算机字体中的信息，用于建议如何扭曲字体轮廓，以便在特定尺寸下生成视觉上吸引人的像素渲染。也称为提示。
definitions.exampleCn: 这个字体缩放效果不佳；在小字号下完全没有提示，而它在10号和12号字母'g'上的提示仍需改进。

definitions.definition: An opportunity; occasion; fit time.
definitions.definitionCn: 机会；时机；合适的时间。

definitions.definition: To suggest tacitly without a direct statement; to provide a clue.
definitions.example: She hinted at the possibility of a recount of the votes.
definitions.definitionCn: 以不直接陈述的方式含蓄地暗示；提供线索。
definitions.exampleCn: 她暗示了重新计票的可能性。

definitions.definition: To bring to mind by a slight mention or remote allusion; to suggest in an indirect manner.
definitions.example: to hint a suspicion
definitions.definitionCn: 通过轻微提及或间接暗示使人想起；以间接方式建议。
definitions.exampleCn: 暗示一种怀疑。

definitions.definition: To develop and add hints to a font.
definitions.example: The typographer worked all day on hinting her new font so it would look good on computer screens.
definitions.definitionCn: 为字体开发并添加提示。
definitions.exampleCn: 排字师花了一整天为她的新字体添加提示，使其在电脑屏幕上看起来更美观。

definitions.definition: A liquid to consume; a drink, such as tea, coffee, liquor, beer, milk, juice, or soft drinks, usually excluding water.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种供饮用的液体；饮料，如茶、咖啡、酒、啤酒、牛奶、果汁或软饮料，通常不包括水。

definitions.definition: (A gift of) drink money.
definitions.definitionCn: （作为礼物的）酒钱。

definitions.definition: An advantage of something, especially when contrasted with its disadvantages (cons).
definitions.example: What are the pros and cons of buying a car?
definitions.definitionCn: 某事物的优点，尤其与其缺点相对比时。
definitions.exampleCn: 购买汽车有哪些利弊？

definitions.definition: A person who supports a concept or principle.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持某个概念或原则的人。

definitions.definition: A professional sportsman.
definitions.definitionCn: 职业运动员。

definitions.definition: Professional.
definitions.example: When it comes to DIY, he's a real pro.
definitions.definitionCn: 专业的。
definitions.exampleCn: 说到DIY，他真是个行家。

definitions.definition: A prostitute.
definitions.definitionCn: 妓女。

definitions.definition: A proproctor.
definitions.definitionCn: 监考员。

definitions.definition: A repetitive style of music originally produced for use in a continuous DJ set. The central rhythmic component is most often in common time (4/4), where time is marked with a bass drum on each quarter note pulse, a backbeat played by snare or clap on the second and fourth pulses of the bar, and an open hi-hat sounding every second eighth note.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种最初为连续DJ混音而制作的重复性音乐风格。其核心节奏部分通常采用4/4拍，每拍以低音鼓标记脉冲，第二和第四拍以军鼓或拍手声形成反拍，每两个八分音符出现一次开镲声。

data.chinese: Techno 的中文翻译是：**铁克诺**（一种电子音乐流派）。

definitions.definition: A clash or disagreement, often violent, between two or more opposing groups or individuals.
definitions.example: The conflict between the government and the rebels began three years ago.
definitions.definitionCn: 两个或多个对立群体或个人之间的冲突或分歧，常伴随暴力。
definitions.exampleCn: 政府与叛乱分子之间的冲突始于三年前。

definitions.definition: An incompatibility, as of two things that cannot be simultaneously fulfilled.
definitions.example: I wanted to attend the meeting but there's a conflict in my schedule that day.
definitions.definitionCn: 两种无法同时实现的事物之间的不相容性。
definitions.exampleCn: 我想参加那次会议，但当天日程有冲突。

definitions.definition: To be at odds (with); to disagree or be incompatible
definitions.definitionCn: 与……不一致；存在分歧或不兼容。

definitions.definition: To overlap (with), as in a schedule.
definitions.example: It appears that our schedules conflict.
definitions.definitionCn: （日程等）与……重叠。
definitions.exampleCn: 看来我们的日程有冲突。

definitions.definition: A bitmap image format for pictures with support for animations and up to 256 distinct colors per frame, including a fully transparent color.
definitions.definitionCn: 支持动画且每帧最多256种不同颜色（包括完全透明色）的位图图像格式。

definitions.definition: An image encoded in GIF file format; such a file.
definitions.definitionCn: 以GIF文件格式编码的图像；此类文件。

definitions.definition: Any short video without audio, usually one which loops
definitions.definitionCn: 任何没有音频的短视频，通常循环播放。

definitions.definition: To create a GIF file of (an image or video sequence, especially relating to an event).
definitions.example: he GIFed the highlights of the debate
definitions.definitionCn: 创建（图像或视频序列，尤其与事件相关的）GIF文件。
definitions.exampleCn: 他将辩论的精彩片段制成了GIF。

definitions.definition: One or more very small, short bursts of light.
definitions.definitionCn: 一个或多个非常微小、短暂的闪光。

definitions.definition: A very short moment of time.
definitions.definitionCn: 极短的一瞬间。

definitions.definition: To twinkle; sparkle
definitions.definitionCn: 闪烁；发光。

definitions.definition: To wink
definitions.definitionCn: 眨眼。

definitions.definition: The chaffinch.
definitions.definitionCn: 苍头燕雀。

definitions.definition: A young, attractive, slim male, usually having little body hair.
definitions.definitionCn: 年轻、有魅力、身材纤细的男性，通常体毛较少。

definitions.definition: A weak or effeminate man, whether gay or not.
definitions.definitionCn: 柔弱或女性化的男性，无论是否为同性恋。

definitions.definition: A player in a multi-user dungeon or other roleplaying game who engages in obnoxious or abusive behaviour.
definitions.definitionCn: 在多用户地牢或其他角色扮演游戏中，从事令人反感或辱骂行为的玩家。

definitions.definition: To engage in obnoxious or abusive behaviour in a multi-user dungeon or other roleplaying game, for example by griefing or by equipping a low-level character with advanced equipment from another player.
definitions.definitionCn: 在多用户地牢或其他角色扮演游戏中，从事令人反感或辱骂行为，例如通过恶意破坏或为低级角色装备来自其他玩家的高级装备。

definitions.definition: To chirp or twitter.
definitions.definitionCn: 发出唧唧声或啁啾声。

data.chinese: 抱歉，我无法提供该词的翻译。请提供其他词汇。

definitions.definition: One who connects.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接者。

definitions.definition: A device (or, more precisely, a mating pair of devices, often a plug and a socket) for connecting together two wires, cables, or hoses, allowing electricity or fluid to flow but also allowing easy disconnection and reconnection when necessary.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于连接两根电线、电缆或软管的设备（更确切地说，是一对匹配的设备，通常是一个插头和一个插座），允许电流或流体通过，同时便于在需要时轻松断开和重新连接。

definitions.definition: A highway or freeway road which connects to another highway or freeway. It can be part of an interchange or a longer roadway such as the 1.5 mile (2.5 kilometer) U.S. Route 24 Connector.
definitions.definitionCn: 连接另一条高速公路或快速路的高速公路或快速路。它可以是立交桥的一部分，也可以是更长的道路，例如1.5英里（2.5公里）长的美国24号公路连接线。

definitions.definition: A line connecting two shapes in presentation software.
definitions.definitionCn: 演示软件中连接两个形状的线条。

definitions.definition: A software component that provides access from an application program to an external database or data source, such as a JDBC connector.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种软件组件，提供从应用程序到外部数据库或数据源的访问，例如JDBC连接器。

definitions.definition: Any of a group of cards of consecutive face value, useful in forming straights etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 一组连续面值的牌中的任何一张，有助于形成顺子等。

definitions.definition: To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.
definitions.example: We need to wire that hole in the fence.
definitions.definitionCn: 用金属丝固定，尤指用于酒瓶、软木塞或栅栏。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们需要用铁丝把栅栏上的那个洞封住。

definitions.definition: To string on a wire.
definitions.example: wire beads
definitions.definitionCn: 将物品串在金属丝上。
definitions.exampleCn: 串珠子。

definitions.definition: To equip with wires for use with electricity.
definitions.example: Do you know how to wire a plug?
definitions.definitionCn: 安装电线以便通电使用。
definitions.exampleCn: 你知道如何给插头接线吗？

definitions.definition: To add something into an electrical system by means of wiring; to incorporate or include something.
definitions.example: I'll just wire your camera to the computer screen.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过布线将某物接入电气系统；纳入或包含某物。
definitions.exampleCn: 我只需把你的相机连接到电脑屏幕上。

definitions.definition: (usually passive) To fix or predetermine (someone's personality or behaviour) in a particular way.
definitions.example: There's no use trying to get Sarah to be less excitable. That's just the way she's wired.
definitions.definitionCn: （通常被动）以特定方式固定或预设（某人的性格或行为）。
definitions.exampleCn: 想让莎拉不那么容易激动是没用的，她天生就是这种性格。

definitions.definition: To send a message or monetary funds to another person through a telecommunications system, formerly predominantly by telegraph.
definitions.example: The detective wired ahead, hoping that the fugitive would be caught at the railway station.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过电信系统（早期主要为电报）向他人发送消息或汇款。
definitions.exampleCn: 侦探提前发了电报，希望逃犯能在火车站被抓获。

definitions.definition: To make someone tense or psyched up. See also adjective wired.
definitions.example: Coffee late at night wires me good and proper.
definitions.definitionCn: 使某人紧张或兴奋。参见形容词“wired”。
definitions.exampleCn: 深夜喝咖啡让我彻底精神亢奋。

definitions.definition: To install eavesdropping equipment.
definitions.example: We wired the suspect's house.
definitions.definitionCn: 安装窃听设备。
definitions.exampleCn: 我们在嫌疑人的房子里装了窃听器。

definitions.definition: To snare by means of a wire or wires.
definitions.definitionCn: 用金属丝或网捕捉。

definitions.definition: To place (a ball) so that the wire of a wicket prevents a successful shot.
definitions.definitionCn: （板球）将球置于三柱门铁丝附近，使击球难以成功。

definitions.definition: Equipped with wires, so as to connect to a power source or to other electric or electronic equipment; connected by wires.
definitions.definitionCn: 配备电线，以便连接电源或其他电子设备；通过电线连接。

definitions.definition: Equipped with hidden electronic eavesdropping devices.
definitions.definitionCn: 装有隐藏的电子窃听装置。

definitions.definition: Reinforced, supported, tied or bound with wire.
definitions.definitionCn: 用金属丝加固、支撑、捆绑或固定。

definitions.definition: Very excited, overstimulated; high-strung.
definitions.example: After three cups of coffee she was too wired to sleep.
definitions.definitionCn: 极度兴奋、过度刺激；神经紧张的。
definitions.exampleCn: 喝了三杯咖啡后，她兴奋得睡不着。

definitions.definition: Having wiry feathers.
definitions.definitionCn: （鸟）有硬如金属丝的羽毛。

definitions.definition: Being a pair in seven card stud with one face up and one face down.
definitions.definitionCn: （七张梭哈）两张明牌和一张暗牌组成一对。

definitions.definition: Being three of a kind as the first three cards in seven card stud.

definitions.definition: To return or have a specific value.

definitions.definition: A type of hotel or lodging establishment, often located near a major highway, which typically features a series of rooms the entrances of which are immediately adjacent to a parking lot to facilitate convenient access to automobiles parked there.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种酒店或住宿设施，通常位于主要高速公路附近，其典型特征是一系列房间的入口紧邻停车场，以便方便使用停放在那里的汽车。

definitions.definition: A low-cost short-stay hotel, often with hourly rates rather than daily rates, and notorious for permitting illicit sexual activities; love hotel.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种低成本短住酒店，通常按小时计费而非按天计费，因允许非法性行为而臭名昭著；情人旅馆。

definitions.definition: To go in the reverse direction.

definitions.definition: To support.

definitions.definitionCn: （指风）改变方向，与正常模式相反；即北半球逆时针转向，南半球顺时针转向。

definitions.definition: (of a square sail) To brace the yards so that the wind presses on the front of the sail, to slow the ship.
definitions.definitionCn: （指横帆）调整帆桁使风压向帆面，以减慢船速。

definitions.definition: (of an anchor) To lay out a second, smaller anchor to provide additional holding power.
definitions.definitionCn: （指锚）布设第二只较小的锚以增加抓力。

definitions.definition: (of a hunting dog) To stand still behind another dog which has pointed.
definitions.definitionCn: （指猎犬）在另一只已指示目标的猎犬身后静止不动。

definitions.definition: To push or force backwards.

definitions.definitionCn: 向后推或强行后退。

definitions.definition: To get upon the back of; to mount.

definitions.definition: To make a back for; to furnish with a back.

definitions.definition: To adjoin behind; to be at the back of.
definitions.definitionCn: 紧邻……之后；位于……的背面。

definitions.definition: To write upon the back of, possibly as an endorsement.

definitions.definitionCn: 在……背面书写，可能作为背书。

definitions.definition: (of a justice of the peace) To sign or endorse (a warrant, issued in another county, to apprehend an offender).

definitions.definition: (in combination) Having specified type of backing.

definitions.exampleCn: "哪里有人焚烧书籍，最终也会焚烧人类"是海因里希·海涅的著名引文。

definitions.definition: A price that has been quoted for buying or selling.
definitions.example: Let's get a quotation for repairing the roof before we decide whether it's worth doing.
definitions.definitionCn: 已报出的买卖价格。
definitions.exampleCn: 在决定是否值得修理屋顶前，我们先获取一份维修报价。

definitions.definition: The act of setting a price.

definitions.definition: A quota, a share.

definitions.definition: To represent in words.

definitions.definition: To represent by drawing; to draw a plan of; to delineate; to trace or mark out.

definitions.definition: To distribute into parts, groups, or classes; to mark off; to class.

definitions.definition: Ready, appropriate, suitable, or in keeping

definitions.definition: Following, afterwards in either time or place.

definitions.definition: (manner) In a consistent manner.

definitions.definitionCn: 按规则规定的特定体重类别，与公开级或重量级分开。

definitions.definition: A competitive weight division as prescribed by the rules, between the heavier middleweight and the lighter featherweight.
definitions.definitionCn: 按规则规定的竞技体重分级，介于较重的中量级和较轻的羽量级之间。

definitions.definition: One of little consequence or ability.
definitions.definitionCn: 无足轻重或能力低下的人。

definitions.definition: A person who cannot handle their drink; one who gets drunk on very little alcohol.
definitions.definitionCn: 酒量差的人；喝很少酒就醉的人。

definitions.definition: A political candidate with little chance of winning
definitions.definitionCn: 胜选希望渺茫的政治候选人。

definitions.definition: Lacking in earnestness, ability, or profundity
definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏认真、能力或深度。

definitions.definition: Having less than average weight
definitions.definitionCn: 体重低于平均水平。

definitions.definition: Lacking in strength
definitions.definitionCn: 缺乏力量。

definitions.definition: Having a small footprint or performance impact
definitions.definitionCn: 占用空间小或性能影响小。

definitions.definition: To change place or posture; to go, in any manner, from one place or position to another.
definitions.example: A ship moves rapidly.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变位置或姿势；以任何方式从一个地方或位置移动到另一个地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 船快速移动。

definitions.definition: To act; to take action; to begin to act
definitions.example: Come on guys, let's move: there's work to do!
definitions.definitionCn: 行动；采取行动；开始行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 来吧伙计们，我们动起来：有活要干！

definitions.definition: To change residence, for example from one house, town, or state, to another; to go and live at another place. See also move out and move in.
definitions.example: I decided to move to the country for a more peaceful life.
definitions.definitionCn: 改变住所，例如从一栋房子、城镇或州搬到另一处；去另一个地方居住。参见“搬出”和“搬入”。
definitions.exampleCn: 我决定搬到乡下，过更平静的生活。

definitions.definition: (and other games) To change the place of a piece in accordance with the rules of the game.
definitions.example: My opponent's counter was moving much quicker round the board than mine.
definitions.definitionCn: （及其他游戏）按照游戏规则改变棋子的位置。
definitions.exampleCn: 对手的棋子比我快得多地在棋盘上移动。

definitions.definition: To cause to change place or posture in any manner; to set in motion; to carry, convey, draw, or push from one place to another
definitions.example: The horse moves a carriage.
definitions.definitionCn: 以任何方式使改变位置或姿势；使运动；从一个地方搬运、输送、拉或推到另一个地方。
definitions.exampleCn: 马拉着马车。

definitions.definition: To transfer (a piece or man) from one space or position to another, according to the rules of the game
definitions.example: She moved the queen closer to the centre of the board.
definitions.definitionCn: 根据游戏规则，将（棋子或人物）从一个空格或位置转移到另一个。
definitions.exampleCn: 她把皇后移近棋盘中央。

definitions.definition: To excite to action by the presentation of motives; to rouse by representation, persuasion, or appeal; to influence.
definitions.example: This song moves me to dance.
definitions.definitionCn: 通过提出动机来激发行动；通过陈述、劝说或呼吁来唤醒；影响。
definitions.exampleCn: 这首歌让我想跳舞。

definitions.definition: To arouse the feelings or passions of; especially, to excite to tenderness or compassion, to excite (for example, an emotion).
definitions.example: That book really moved me.
definitions.definitionCn: 激发情感或激情；特别是，激起温柔或同情，激发（例如，一种情绪）。
definitions.exampleCn: 那本书真的打动了我。

definitions.definition: To propose; to recommend; specifically, to propose formally for consideration and determination, in a deliberative assembly; to submit
definitions.example: I move to repeal the rule regarding obligatory school uniform.
definitions.definitionCn: 提议；推荐；具体地，在审议会议上正式提出供考虑和决定；提交。
definitions.exampleCn: 我提议废除关于强制校服的规定。

definitions.definition: To mention; to raise (a question); to suggest (a course of action); to lodge (a complaint).
definitions.definitionCn: 提及；提出（问题）；建议（行动方案）；提出（投诉）。

definitions.definition: To incite, urge (someone to do something); to solicit (someone for or of an issue); to make a proposal to.
definitions.definitionCn: 激励、敦促（某人做某事）；向（某人）请求（关于某个问题）；提出建议。

definitions.definition: To apply to, as for aid.
definitions.definitionCn: 向……申请，例如寻求帮助。

definitions.definition: To request an action from the court.
definitions.example: An attorney moved the court to issue a restraining order.
definitions.definitionCn: 请求法院采取行动。
definitions.exampleCn: 一名律师请求法院发出限制令。

definitions.definition: To bow or salute upon meeting.
definitions.definitionCn: 见面时鞠躬或致意。

definitions.definition: To sell, to market (especially, but not exclusively, illegal products)
definitions.definitionCn: 销售、推销（尤其但不限于非法产品）。

definitions.definition: Emotionally affected; touched.
definitions.example: What happened to that girl in the film was so awful - I was extremely moved.
definitions.definitionCn: 情感上受影响；感动。
definitions.exampleCn: 电影里那个女孩的遭遇太可怕了——我深受感动。

definitions.definition: The state of organisms preceding their death, characterized by biological processes such as metabolism and reproduction and distinguishing them from inanimate objects; the state of being alive and living.
definitions.example: Having experienced both, the vampire decided that he preferred (un)death to life.  He gave up on life.
definitions.definitionCn: 生物死亡前的状态，以新陈代谢和繁殖等生物过程为特征，并以此区别于无生命物体；存活且活着的状态。
definitions.exampleCn: 两者都经历过之后，吸血鬼决定他更喜欢（非）死亡而非生命。他放弃了生命。

definitions.definition: The animating principle or force that keeps an inorganic thing or concept metaphorically alive (dynamic, relevant, etc) and makes it a "living document", "living constitution", etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 使无生命物体或概念隐喻性地保持活力（动态、相关等）并使其成为“活文件”、“活宪法”等的驱动原则或力量。

definitions.definition: Lifeforms, generally or collectively.
definitions.example: It's life, but not as we know it.   She discovered plant life on the planet.   The rover discovered signs of life on the alien world.
definitions.definitionCn: 生命形式，通常或集体而言。
definitions.exampleCn: 这是生命，但并非我们所知的那种。她在那个星球上发现了植物生命。探测器在外星世界发现了生命迹象。

definitions.definition: A living individual; the fact of a particular individual being alive. (Chiefly when indicating individuals were lost (died) or saved.)
definitions.example: Many lives were lost during the war.   Her quick thinking saved many dogs' lives.
definitions.definitionCn: 活着的个体；特定个体存活的事实。（主要用于指示个体失去（死亡）或获救时。）
definitions.exampleCn: 战争期间许多生命逝去。她反应迅速，拯救了许多狗的生命。

definitions.definition: Existence.
definitions.example: Man's life on this planet has been marked by continual conflict.   the eternal life of the soul
definitions.definitionCn: 存在。
definitions.exampleCn: 人类在这个星球上的生命一直以持续的冲突为标志。灵魂的永恒生命。

definitions.definition: A period of time during which something has existence.
definitions.definitionCn: 某物存在的一段时间。

definitions.definition: Animation; spirit; vivacity.
definitions.definitionCn: 活力；精神；生气。

definitions.definition: A biography.
definitions.example: His life of the founder is finished, except for the title.
definitions.definitionCn: 传记。
definitions.exampleCn: 他的创始人传记已完成，只差标题。

definitions.definition: Nature, reality, and the forms that exist in it.
definitions.definitionCn: 自然、现实及其存在的形式。

definitions.definition: An opportunity for existence.
definitions.definitionCn: 存在的机会。

definitions.definition: The life insurance industry.
definitions.example: I work in life.
definitions.definitionCn: 人寿保险行业。
definitions.exampleCn: 我在人寿保险行业工作。

definitions.definition: A life assured under a life assurance policy (equivalent to the policy itself for a single life contract).
definitions.definitionCn: 人寿保险单下的被保生命（对于单一生命合同，等同于保单本身）。

definitions.definition: A person who teaches, especially one employed in a school.
definitions.definitionCn: 教师，尤指受雇于学校的人。

definitions.definition: The index finger; the forefinger.
definitions.definitionCn: 食指。

definitions.definition: An indication; a lesson.
definitions.definitionCn: 指示；教训。

definitions.definition: The second highest office in the Aaronic priesthood, held by priesthood holders of at least the age of 14.
definitions.definitionCn: 亚伦祭司职分中的第二高职位，由至少14岁的祭司职分持有人担任。

definitions.definition: A device for transmitting conversations and other sounds in real time across distances, now often a small portable unit also capable of running software etc.
definitions.definitionCn: 一种用于实时远距离传输对话及其他声音的设备，如今常指可运行软件等功能的便携式小型装置。

definitions.definition: To call (someone) using a telephone.
definitions.definitionCn: 用电话呼叫（某人）。

definitions.definition: A speech segment that possesses distinct physical or perceptual properties, considered as a physical event without regard to its place in the phonology of a language.
To give up or relinquish control of, to surrender or to give oneself over, or to yield to one's emotions.
definitions.definitionCn: 放弃或交出控制权，投降或放纵自己，或屈服于情感。

definitions.definition: To desist in doing, practicing, following, holding, or adhering to; to turn away from; to permit to lapse; to renounce; to discontinue.
definitions.definitionCn: 停止做、实践、遵循、持有或坚持某事；背离；允许失效；放弃；中止。

definitions.definition: To leave behind; to desert as in a ship or a position, typically in response to overwhelming odds or impending dangers; to forsake, in spite of a duty or responsibility.
definitions.example: Many baby girls have been abandoned on the streets of Beijing.
definitions.definitionCn: 抛弃；如弃船或弃守阵地，通常因应压倒性劣势或迫在眉睫的危险；不顾职责或责任而遗弃。
definitions.exampleCn: 许多女婴曾被遗弃在北京的街头。

definitions.definition: To subdue; to take control of.
definitions.definitionCn: 制服；掌控。

definitions.definition: To cast out; to banish; to expel; to reject.
definitions.definitionCn: 驱逐；放逐；开除；拒绝。

definitions.definition: To no longer exercise a right, title, or interest, especially with no interest of reclaiming it again; to yield; to relinquish.
definitions.definitionCn: 不再行使某项权利、所有权或利益，尤其无意再收回；屈服；放弃。

definitions.definition: To surrender to the insurer (an insured item), so as to claim a total loss.
definitions.definitionCn: 向保险公司放弃（投保物品），以索赔全损。

definitions.definition: A yielding to natural impulses or inhibitions; freedom from artificial constraint, with loss of appreciation of consequences.
Abandonment; relinquishment.
